title: 100% Invisibility Exploit VS Hardcore SMP
content:
100% Invisibility Exploit VS Hardcore SMP














Season


2






Episode


50






Upload date


Oct 8, 2025






POV


SpokeIsHere






Featured Creators (Description)


Mapicc
Leow0ok
TheRealSquiddo
Jepexx














we found unstable smp glitch and of course abused it to its full potential...





100% Invisibility Exploit VS Hardcore SMP
 is the 77th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


It starts when 
Mapicc
 discovers a glitch that gives true invisibility, hiding the player even in armour. 
Spoke
 and Mapicc decide to abuse this glitch, finding a new player, 
JackLIVE_XD
, who seems to be live streaming and messing around with him. They start by breaking and placing blocks around him and setting him on fire. Jack assumes this is the tutorial. They then convince him that they are the creators of Minecraft, and that Spoke and Mapicc were there to guide him. Netherite players suddenly appear, the players being 
ApexPoint
, who was a notorious griefer, and 
ZeroCycleDEMON3D
. Spoke and Mapicc panic, and Spoke starts leading Jack away from the players with stone blocks, but they catch up and corner Jack. The players start trying to rob Jack, and Spoke tries to help him escape and Mapicc helps create a distraction. However, this fails and Jack end up getting invited to and joining ApexPoint and ZeroCycle's team, and they lead him away.

Spoke and Mapicc go to the BAT headquarters to warn 
Leow0ok
 of ApexPoint's return. Leo informs Spoke that BAT's spies had something strange hidden in the mountains, presumably belonging to ApexPoint. The mission was to sneak into the place and steal all the stashed items. Spoke teaches Leo how to do the true invisibility glitch, except he tells him he cannot use it. The plan is for Leo to act as a distraction while Spoke and Mapicc raid the base. Leo pretends he is a front door salesman and Spoke and Mapicc invade the base, however, all the chests they have are empty. Mapicc then discovers a secret room behind a painting which leads to a fully obsidian box with a gold throne and a door in the back of the room surrounded by iron bars. Spoke breaks the gold throne, assuming that was the stashed items, and finds a secret chest under the table with TNT. Spoke leaves the painting room and enters another room with a hole filled with sheep and cows, and also sees Jack open a secret passage. Mapicc tries entering the room, but accidentally sets himself on fire with the lava, and it reveals him. ApexPoint hears them and goes back into the base. Mapicc escapes into the wall and Spoke starts attacking ApexPoint. Someone sets off a TNT minecart and it reveals Spoke. Spoke and Mapicc escape.

Mapicc and Spoke create a secret base in the sky. They head to a cherry forest with houses, and they plan to troll the people living there. 
TheRealSquiddo
 appears at the base. They start opening chests and trapdoors near her, and they also try fishing rod her and moving around in boats. Mapicc traps Squiddo inside a stone box. ApexPoint, ZeroCycle, and Jack show up. They ask her whether she had seen either Spoke or Mapicc. Spoke and Mapicc start punching everyone, placing cobwebs, setting people on fire, and throwing tridents. Spoke starts setting Squiddo's house on fire. Spoke accidentally gets set on fire and reveals himself, and ApexPoint starts attacking him. Spoke and Mapicc escape back to the spot where they made themselves invisible, and go back. Spoke and Mapicc start getting bored, so Spoke pulls out a soundboard. Spoke first plays a discord message ping, then he plays the sound of stone breaking. This makes the group think someone is mining near them. Mapicc and Spoke start playing noises, which make ApexPoint and ZeroCycle think Jack is the one making the noises. ApexPoint finds another player near them, and assumes they're the one making the noises, so they kill them. ApexPoint splits up with ZeroCycle and Jack to head back to their base, while ZeroCycle and Jack leave to raid another base. Spoke and Mapicc both follow ZeroCycle and Jack.

While Jack and ZeroCycle are preparing to raid the base, Spoke and Mapicc discover the owner of the base is 
Jepexx
. Spoke and Mapicc put on fake voices (not voice changers) to warn Jepexx. Spoke and Mapicc pretend to be a devil and an angel, then ZeroCycle and Jack appear to raid the base. Mapicc takes the horse while Spoke and Jepexx escape up the mountain and into the ocean. Spoke repeatedly breaks ZeroCycles boat, causing him to fall behind. Spoke steals Jacks boat, so Jack gets into ZeroCycles boat. Spoke steals that boat as well. Mapicc, Jepexx, and Spoke escape to an island with the horse. Spoke and Mapicc then follow ZeroCycle and Jack into a tunnel to their secret base and as they reunite with ApexPoint, The team has a fight about whether the creators of Minecraft were messing with them or not while Spoke and Mapicc investigate around the base. Spoke decides to build a dripstone trap in the floor. Spoke accidentally places a wither rose on Mapicc, revealing him. Jack, who is still live streaming, says his chat saw a nametag. Mapicc wind charges upward to get on the roof, accidentally knocking Spoke off of a small hill. Spoke takes damage from this, and he gets revealed as well. Spoke breaks into the house through a window, but they see him anyway. Mapicc makes a nether portal and they escaped through the nether. Spoke traps the nether portal with a TNT minecart, but they enter through a different nether portal. Spoke and Mapicc start running. They enter a bastion, and ZeroCycle gets distracted by the gold blocks. Spoke and Mapicc leave the bastion. 

After running for a while, Spoke manages to lose them and escapes into a nether portal into him and Mapicc's secret base. Unfortunately, ApexPoint, ZeroCycle, and Jack appear as well. They start blowing up the base with TNT, and Spoke starts running. Spoke tridents up the water into the base and cuts off the water source. Spoke and Mapicc make a plan to invade their base. As they turn themselves invisible again, ApexPoint, ZeroCycle, and Jack watches them. The team also starts abusing this glitch, however, they all take some form of damage before they could get too annoying. Spoke and Mapicc blow up and burn all of their items. Spoke and Mapicc also accidentally take damage, revealing themselves, and a fight breaks out. Spoke and Mapicc continue wrecking havoc and blowing up everything.

Spoke asks ApexPoint for a truce, and ApexPoint agrees. Spoke makes a chair to commence the dealing process, and makes ApexPoint build his chair on top of Spokes dripstone trap he made earlier. Spoke breaks the block under ApexPoint's chair, and ApexPoint falls directly into the trap, killing him and banning him off of the server. Mapicc and Spoke immediately start attacking ZeroCycle as well, killing  and banning ZeroCycle off of the server. Jack hides in the floor, and Spoke and Mapicc talk about possibilities of inviting Jack to their team. Spoke and Mapicc return to the invisibility exploit, and blow it up.

title: 1000 Players Simulate Civil War in Minecraft
content:
"
Till we meet again, friend.
"
This article contains major spoilers from recently released episodes. Please proceed with caution.






1000 Players Simulate Civil War in Minecraft














Episode


133






Upload date


May 16, 2026






POV


ParrotX2






Arcs


The Kingdoms Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


TheobaldTheBird
FlameFrags
Saparata
Lomedy
Fymada
4CVIT
Yungyx
Wemmbu
Jaden_MAN
















"After I Became King of the Unstable SMP, the world split into two different sides: the new players, and the old ones. Soon enough, most of these players left my Kingdom and joined Cindercrest. And just like that... a Civil War had begun.





1000 Players Simulate Civil War in Minecraft
 is the 133rd episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.                                                



Plot


Parrot
 starts the episode by telling the viewers that after he became King, the world split into two different sides. There are the new players who poured into the server and the old players who have been on the Unstable SMP for months or even years. Parrot believes that the old players are very mad that he and the new players are destroying what they created. So, they split off from his 
Kingdom
 and formed 
Cindercrest
, who had the main goal of wiping Parrot and the new players from the server. Because of that, Parrot formed a massive army of his own to fight off Cindercrest. He stations his army in different major cities, and he believed that Cindercrest would attack Fort Feather first where his eastern gateway is. Parrot and his two friends 
TheobaldTheBird
 and 
ReinaDrop
, along with their army stand ontop of the wall of Fort Feather to scout for Cindercrest. Parrot uses his spyglass and sees a bunch of Cindercrest's players on boats heading towards them. 

They see 
Saparata
, the leader of Cindercrest who uses one of his player's as bait to set up the hidden mines in Fort Feather. Parrot tells his army to launch the TNT cannons, unfortunately for him one of the TNT cannons actually blows up members of his army. They continue to fight until they see a redstone blimp in the sky, Parrot knows that the blimp has Cindercrest players and tells his army to build up in the sky. Parrot and his army build up and see 
ShoeBilly
 in the sky who starts killing the players in the sky with a mace. The blimp continues to head closer to Fort Feather and Parrot realizes that the fight is already over. Parrot tells his army to get on horses and escape through a tunnel in a storage room. Parrot uses a TNT trap in the storage room and manages to kill a huge chunk of Cindercrest's players. He and his army use the tunnel and go to 
Merchant City
. In the moment, Parrot realizes what he's actually going through, he saw that Cindercrest was far stronger and smarter than he thought. Since his army was made up of mostly new players, winning this civil war was way harder than he thought. Luckily, Fort Feather is only one of the cities inside of the kingdom, and if Cindercrest wanted to win the war, they'd have to keep moving deeper. Now that they had taken over 
Fort Feather
, they gained access direct path to Merchant City, where the 
Merchant City Vanguard
 are already waiting. 

Parrot reaches the end of the tunnel and walks to the surface to regroup with whoever made it alive, as he tries to tell everyone the bad news, 
PrinceTetra
 stops him in his tracks and says they already heard the news of what happened at Fort Feather and threatens to blow up the entire place if Parrot tries anything. Parrot is confused and says they're apart of his army too, PrinceTetra asks Parrot to give them a reason to fight Cindercrest, otherwise they have no choice to kill him or turn him in. Parrot tells them if they don't fight Cindercrest, they're going to lose the war, but PrinceTetra puts him in a dilemma, he asks what makes him believe that they won't end up like the rest of his army that just died. Parrot goes quiet, Theo tries to convince Parrot to say anything, but nothing comes out of his mouth. PrinceTetra counts down from ten, Parrot speaks up after five seconds, he asks when it's ever going to end and that he doesn't expect everyone to survive the war, so he gives them all the chance to leave the war. He says if they don't beat Cindercrest, it won't ever end, and if Cindercrest wins, tens of thousands of new players are going to die, whoever else is left will live in a world where food is scarce, where people will die for no reason, which was how the server was like before Parrot, and he makes it clear that he became king to change that. Parrot says when he became king, he promised to protect everyone on the server, and so he asks the guards if they want to kill him, then to do it right then and there and that Cindercrest is already coming. The guards stand down and PrinceTetra asks what his plan is to defeat Cindercrest.

White flags are built across the top of the castle. Parrot, Theo, Reina, and a few guards stand on top and wait for Cindercrest to arrive. Theo notices that his donkey Dingus and Parrot's horse are being ridden, which excites him that they're going to get their horses back, but Reina says to calm down otherwise the whole plan fails. When Saps comes into distance, Parrot tells him that they surrender, Saps doesn't believe it whatsoever. 
FlameFrags
 believes otherwise and wants to barge right in, Saps says they will come in, but via their blimp. Although they probably thought Saps outsmarted them, they played right into Parrot's hands. If it looked like there was a trap under the gate, there wasn't, and them using the blimp was all apart of his plan. Parrot watches the blimp come closer and tells the vanguard to prepare for battle. He goes up to Theo and Reina and ask if the machine was ready, Theo says it is. Parrot then goes to explain that Cindercrest used their blimp to take over the fort while avoiding all their ground defenses, but in the time that they marched from Fort Feather to Merchant City, he ordered a new 
machine
, which uses complicated redstone to counter the blimp strategy. Parrot keeps a watch on the blimp, he then shoots an arrow in the middle of the trapdoors of the machine and informs Reina of when to activate. He keeps watching the blimp until it's directly in the middle of the city, he tells Reina to get ready. Once the trapdoors open, he tells Reina to start it, sounds of TNT exploding starts to play, and the Cindercrest army that are falling down from the blimp start to die off. He then tasks Reina to let the vanguard into the inner area of Merchant City, Parrot tells them to target anyone in netherite. They push forward and attack when Cindercrest is weak, afterwards, Parrot looks at Saps from the top of the castle and watches as he and the rest of Cindercrest march away from the city. 

With the victory given to Parrot, he heads back to his castle with the vanguard. However, he knew it wouldn't be long until Cindercrest would attack again, or where they would go next or what strategies they would use. By the time they made it back, word had spread around the server, as Parrot and his army walk down the obsidian highway, players stand on the side of it and cheer for them. Just as they're about to walk into the 
Northern Council
, Parrot hears TNT being set off and tells the vanguard to back off. Dozens of players get blown up, Parrot and Theo notices somebody trying to escape the scene, Reina mines to them and tells Theo not to kill them since they could interrogate the player. They take this player, soldier73, down to the prison. Parrot asks them where Cindercrest is headed next, but she doesnn't tell Parrot that. Parrot asks questions about any other leads, but she doesn't budge at all. Parrot then apologizes for what she's about to go through and tells Reina she can do whatever she wants to her. Reina starts to drown soldier73 down to half a heart, where she then says she'll talk. Reina asks where Cindercrest is headed towards, in which soldier73 says High Water City and that she was sent to kill Parrot. Reina walks out the cell and tells Parrot they should head out, as the entire council is waiting for him.

Parrot begins the meeting with all of the leaders of the cities inside of his kingdom, he has all of them introduce themselves and their positions of whatever city they lead. Right after, Parrot tells them Cindercrest has declared war on his kingdom and although they were beaten at Merchant City, he knows they're coming back, which is the reason why he brought them all there. 
Horace
 asks if Parrot knows where they're headed next, and Parrot says 
Highwater City
, which makes sense since that city is responsible for 80% of the food source coming into the kingdom. If Cindercrest were to seize the entirety of the city and prevent all the food from coming, they would win this war. Parrot then tells 
4CVIT
 to build a cannon in Highwater City, but 4C says he doesn't have time or resources to. He asks 
Fymada
 to tear down the railraods and automatic farms in 
Capitol City
 to build these machines, Fymada seems unsure about it since that was used to evacuate the towns, but Parrot says if they don't have another weapon to defeat them, there would be no place for anybody to evacuate to. 4C then asks theoretically if he were to get these materials, how quickly does Parrot expect him to build it, Parrot asks the question back, how quickly does he think he can build it? 4C says about eight hours, Parrot tells him to make it six and that he'll go fend off Cindercrest, he asks for 
CorporalPaul
, the leader of 
The LAW
 for his help. 

Parrot explains if Cindercrest was really going for HIghwater City next, they'd be in huge trouble. After the events of Merchant City, Parrot knows they won't use the blimp again. If they wanted to defeat Cindercrest at Highwater, 4C would have to build the machine in time. Since then Parrot knew they were heading to Highwater City, he deduces the path that they would probably be taking to go to it in order to delay them.

Parrot sees the massive army headed towards his direction, he tells his team their plan is to delay them and to not take any fights they don't have to take. Parrot walks in the middle with Flame, Parrot says he's glad they're finally having this conversation between just the two of them. Parrot wanted to talk to him specifically, not because he's the strongest player in Cindercrest, but because they used to be friends who fought in wars together. Parrot doesn't understand why Flame joined and he asks him why he joined and if he even knows who they are. Flame says he does and knows there's a whole story behind it. Parrot goes on to say those same players were the same people who destroyed an entire civilization that he made, and if they beat him in the war, they're going to take over his kingdom and kill tens of thousands of new players who don't deserve to die. He tells Flame he doesn't understand why he'd join them and asks if it was a mixup, Flame says it's a long story and that 
Lomedy
 has his beliefs, Flame goes to bring Lomedy up to explain it himself. Parrot asks if Lomedy was the reason Flame joined Cindercrest, Lomedy says he is and that he's like everybody else in Cindercrest. Lomedy asks if Parrot even knows why he joined Cindercrest, he goes on to say Parrot becoming king is horrible, he lets people die from starvation and his kingdom is unsafe to the point where bandits killing people. He says it's hard to see as a farmer, Parrot tries to say he's been trying, but Flame interrupts and asks if it really is true that this is happening. Parrot says he's been trying his best, Lomedy says it's not enough and asks if he really cares about the server. Parrot asks would he be standing there if he didn't. Lomedy sees that he doesn't seem convinced, Flame says Parrot has a point and that he's been attacked by bandits within the kingdom too. Lomedy says he doesn't like to see people die, but he has no choice and that stopping Parrot is their best option. Parrot tells the two that he has a legion of hundreds of players, and that if they try to push forwards on the bridge instead of wrapping around the mountain, they won't hesitate to kill and to tell Saps that. 

Parrot goes back to his army, he doesn't see the the army of lawmen anywhere, which makes the total amount of their army lower than expected. Parrot reminds them the point of the battle is to not let them cross the bridge until the machine is fully built. The front group uses their bows as a wall of cobwebs is built. Theo hits Billy with slow falling and Parrot asks him to deal with Billy. A bunch of them get hunched up together and Theo manages to get tons of kills with his TNT minecarts. title: 1000 Players Simulate UNDERGROUND Civilization in Minecraft
content:
1000 Players Simulate UNDERGROUND Civilization in Minecraft














Episode


134






Upload date


May 21, 2026






POV


Wemmbu






Arcs


The Kingdoms Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


Yungyx
Jaden_MAN
FlameFrags
Saparata
ParrotX2
TheobaldTheBird
Dione4k












1000 Players Simulate UNDERGROUND Civilization in Minecraft
 is the 134th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


Wemmbu
 starts the episode off by joining an underground civilization with a thousand players. He has to get used to surviving without the luxuries of the surface, integrate with the new society, and complete missions in order to rank up through the civilization, all to save his friend 
Eggchan
.

Yungyx
 welcomes Wemmbu to the caves, he splashes them both with night vision so they can see better, then asks Wemmbu to follow him. Wemmbu asks why he had to get rid of all his items, yungy says he's not allowed anything better than iron until he proves his loyalty to their king, 
Arachn1d
. Yungy takes Wemmbu down to the bottom feeder section of the civilization, he tells Wemmbu not to come up without him saying so and that there's going to be a mission soon. 

Obviously, Wemmbu didn't join by choice. Arachn1d captured egg and threatened to ban him if Wemmbu didn't join. Wemmbu plans on finding egg first and save him and leave the civilization. The only way that's possible is if he becomes loyal to the civilization enough to where they trust him to tell where egg is. The best way to do that is with his strength through combat, as he's one of the strongest players.

Jaden_MAN
 approaches Wemmbu as he's crafting wooden tools, Wemmbu asks how he ended up here and Jaden says he didn't want Wemmbu to get captured alone. Wemmbu starts telling Jaden about his plans about finding Egg, Jaden puts down a sign that says Yungy is right above them listening in on their conversation. Wemmbu changes the subject and says it's stupid of them to try and save Egg and that they need to gear up. 

Wemmbu and Jaden set off to explore the civilization in order to get better equipment and in order to find egg. Their night vision runs out, Jaden sees 
The_Codmaster14
 from a distance, the two catch up with each other and Codmaster brings them into his home. He shows off the decor in his house, Wemmbu sees that his chests are invisible and that everything down there is scuffed. He then asks Codmaster why it's so dark, Codmaster says it's to ward off attackers and there's only light at the bottom and only the higher ups get access to night vision. Wemmbu asks how they're able to rank up, Codmaster says they'll have to get the attention of the higher ups then prove their strength. Wemmbu says it's not possible to do that without his items, Codmaster says that's the point and that they're stuck down there and to just enjoy life. Codmaster begins to show off his skin, yungy falls through the roof into the house and instructs them to go to the mines and if they don't comply, they'll be banned.

The three of them are brought to the mines, Yungy says they're expected to mine all day and to mine resources for the king or they die. Codmaster expresses his hatred for the mines and Jaden says he's tired of underground civilizations. They grab mining supplies in the storage chests, there are dozens of players down there as well, presumably mining resources to craft armor and weapons for the kingdom. They all mine in their own separate directions and use a chest minecart to ship it back to the kingdom. Codmaster says they'll have to bring back three chests worth of materials each, he then warns them to be careful since his last friend group died down there. They find unmined space, Wemmbu tries to strip mine, but is way too slow with just a wooden pickaxe, so he comes up with an idea; he mines the top block and Jaden mines the bottom block while Codmaster places down rails behind them. This doubles their efficiency, they shortly stumble across a deep dark biome. Wemmbu goes around to break the shriekers and sets it off twice while doing so. Codmaster tells him to stop and to stay in path of the mine, Wemmbu goes up and says there's no more shriekers left, but sets off another shrieker outside of his vision. A warden spawns and they run out of their mine. A bunch of players begin to die, they see another warden in front of them, and so Wemmbu runs into another strip mine to hide. Some people begin to hit Wemmbu in order to get the wardens to detect them, so Wemmbu kills them. Yungy and few of the guards barge into the mines to kill the wardens, he then asks who summoned the wardens, everyone goes to Wemmbu and snitches on him.

Wemmbu, Jaden, and Codmaster then all get sent to jail. Wemmbu asks why they're in jail, Codmaster says he should be the one asking him and Wemmbu says he's asking because he knows what's going on. Codmaster thinks Wemmbu is blaming him, but Wemmbu says it's Jaden's fault. Jaden says Wemmbu was responsible for summoning the warden and Wemmbu says that was CGI. They wonder about how long they're going to be there for, Codmaster says until they find out their sentence, which might be forever. Yungy comes and brings the three out of their cell and takes them to an interrogation room. Yungy asks who was the one to summon the warden, he splashes strength to look intimidating and looks right at Codmaster. Wemmbu breaks the tinted glass and runs out, yungy catches up with him with his Elytra and takes him back. Yungy asks again if Wemmbu did it, Wemmbu says it wasn't any of them and that it was another group of players, Codmaster decides to be honest and says it was Wemmbu. Because Codmaster snitched, he's able to walk freely with the downside that all of his items are taken. 

As for Wemmbu and Jaden, they're taken to their quarters and given a set of iron armor and some weapons. Yungy flies up to the second floor of the arena and begins to announce a fight between Wemmbu and Jaden is about to start. The two of them don't want to fight, Wemmbu charges his bow and accidentally shoots Jaden. Yungy says he's going down there in ten seconds if they don't start to fight right now. They come closer to each other, Jaden places a web and they just keep shielding. Yungy shoots Wemmbu and gets him down to three hearts as a warning to start fighting. The two actually start to fight. The two of them drain each other of their golden apples and healing, arachn1d storms in and asks what yungy is doing with them, and yungy says they were responsible for spawning a warden and killing tens of players. Arachn1d tells him they're the most valuable players in the civilization and that yungy is wasting them in a deathmatch. At the same time, Wemmbu crafts signs and writes to Jaden asking if he has anymore healing, but Jaden writes back that he doesn't, Wemmbu writes that if they make him fight again to just run. Arachn1d then goes down to them, Wemmbu breaks the sign, and arachn1d apologizes to them and that this should've never happened. To make it up, he offers to rank them up to regular citizens if they complete one mission. Wemmbu says he'll do it as long as he gives back egg right after, and Arachn1d says he'll think about it. Wemmbu says he won't do it unless arachn1d agrees to it, arachn1d says egg is safe and sound, but it would be a shame if that stopped being the case, so he suggests Wemmbu to work in order to keep him safe. Wemmbu and Jaden leave the arena, as they go and find Codmaster, Wemmbu looks up across a lake and sees 
FlameFrags
 staring back at him before walking away. 

They go back to Codmaster's house, Wemmbu says they have a mission tomorrow and Codmaster says they're dead and wishes them luck. Wemmbu asks what's wrong about a mission, and Codmaster says people who usually go on missions are in netherite and enchantments and that they're only in full iron. Wemmbu gets the idea and crafts fishing rods so they can get enchanted books. They only get fish, Wemmbu asks if any of them caught treasures, Codmaster thought they wanted to fish for food and says the water is too shallow to get any kinds of treasure. Wemmbu asks if they can enchant, Codmaster says there's a place, but only for higher ranks. He says he might know a guy that can help, he's the richest of all the bottom dwellers and purposely fails his missions so he can enjoy life down at the bottom. If they're able to impress him, they'll be able to use his enchantment table before the mission, but if they don't, he might kill them. Codmaster takes them to this player and warns them to not say anything out of line. They take a bunch of twist and turns in the caves, they reach a random area of the caves and Codmaster says they have arrived. He goes into a corner and whispers the word burger into the walls, which opens a hidden door. He thanks Regrub for opening the door, which just so happens to be burger backwards.

They go down a few ominous paths until they finally meet this rich player, The_BanditKing. He welcomes the two strongest players on the Unstable SMP, but drop the act and asks why he shouldn't kill them. Wemmbu says Codmaster says he was willing to give gear and allow them to use his enchantment table, BanditKing says it doesn't sound compelling and asks if there's anything for him. Wemmbu offers him two pieces of sugar cane, BanditKing starts to get his guards to take care of them, Wemmbu says he doesn't lose anything for letting them use his enchantment table, but BanditKing says if there's nothing in it for him, then he doesn't care. Jaden tells BanditKing outside of the civilization, him and Wemmbu are the strongest players and it wouldn't be a good idea to get on their bad side. BanditKing agrees to let them use his enchantment table, Wemmbu asks if they can take diamonds, but BanditKing says not to test their luck. Once they enchant all their armor, BanditKing tells them if they make it back alive, he'll give them lessons about how to act.

After they leave, Wemmbu confesses he stole the enchantment table, Codmaster says they're going to die if he finds out. Wemmbu asks if Codmaster has iron, which he says no, so Wemmbu sneaks into the mines and steals some diamonds and a stack of iron and brings it back home to smelt. With all the iron they have, they make an anvil and make better armor. They then go sneaking around stealing cobwebs around the lake and takes another anvil from another house. They return home and tells Codmaster they'll do the mission and put in a good word for him, Wemmbu asks if he wants to join them on their mission, but he says he's good and likes his peaceful life.

On the surface, Yungy tells them they're heading towards a base of a player who produces valuable resources and that they're friends with this player. In order to prove their loyalty and rank up, yungy needs to get all these resources from the kingdom. Wemmbu questions the fact that there's nobody to help them on this mission, but yungy reassures them that it's only one player and they can get these resources and that this was a loyalty test. Yungy points them straight to a stone wall in a mountain. Wemmbu and Jaden walk up to it, Jaden says burger to see if it would activate, but it doesn't. Wemmbu goes up to the wall and repeatedly says hello, he sees 
Dione4K
, who's excited to see them. Dione asks how 
Wemmbu's civilization
 is doing, Wemmbu says it got blown up a long time ago by Jaden, Jaden mentions that Dione was also a pirate, and Dione says that was part of his side plot and shows them what he's been doing. They open up the chests he has, which is all filled with firework rockets. Wemmbu asks how he's even getting the resources as creepers don't spawn, and Dione says he can't answer that. Dione says this is his life's work and asks what he can help them with, they both go silent and Jaden asks if he's willing to sell any fireworks, Dione says not really since it's his own personal project. Yungy says their next mission is soon, which is to take over 
Merchant City
 and to win the war. Wemmbu doesn't know they're in a war, yungy says to not worry about it and flies off. They look through all the chests and see there's nothing of value, Wemmbu finds a stack of gold ore and takes it. They return to Codmaster's house, Wemmbu mentions that they should get full protection 4 diamond armor if they're going to head to a war. They tell Codmaster that they ranked up and asks to enchant more stuff, Jaden notices the sudden change in attitude and asks Codmaster what happened. Wemmbu asks why he doesn't rank up, Codmaster says arachn1d values strength only and he's accepted that, and he's also accepted the peaceful life, which is why he doesn't want to hang around with them. Yungy comes by and says the seller they're talking to is scamming them and if they wanted enchantments, then to go over to the enchantment store. Once it's Wemmbu's turn, he starts killing the spiders for experience, Yungy asks what enchantment he's trying to get and Wemmbu replies protection 4, Yungy says Wemmbu really is broke, which leads Wemmbu to jokingly hit Yungy. Yungy tells the guards to bring Jaden in with him and they're going to share the same five minute limit as Wemmbu tried critting him out. Jaden asks Yungy what his favorite thing is in order to stall, he makes a terrible joke and tries to force them out. Jaden says Yungy couldn't even survive anything and challenges him to do a water bucket clutch from a high distance. Jaden and yungy talk for a while, which gives Wemmbu enough time to get decent diamond armor and tools. Their time is up when the next person in line speaks up and says they've been in there for over an hour. Yungy says the strongest weapon of the Spiders are cobwebs, he teaches Wemmbu how to web someone and drain their water, which Wemmbu already knows how to do. Yungy tells them to finish gearing up and to meet at the tavern for the attack on Merchant City.

Wemmbu and Jaden walk around the civilization, they see people have houses of their own and talk about wanting to own one themselves and keep going. They've already been to most of the civilization and haven't gone one direction, so they head over there and find the tavern named Weave's Drop. They enter the tavern, all the customers are in full netherite, BanditKing is the bartender and welcomes them in and asks what they want. Jaden asks for strength and Wemmbu asks for night vision, BanditKing goes in the back and gets the potions and they both pay. He tells them to find a table to sit at and they go sit in the corner of the tavern. One of the players named Trixxio keeps looking at Wemmbu, he splashes strength and speed and says Wemmbu killed six of his friends and hundreds of other Spiders and that he can't work alongside him. They start fighting, Jaden comes to help, but Wemmbu says he can take the fight by himself. Nobody else intervenes and they head up to the second level, Wemmbu says he'll spare him if he stops fighting, but takes it back as he wants the netherite armor. They drop down to the first floor and yungy tells them to stop fighting and that he shouldn't even be fighting with royalty in the first place. Yungy then says they're heading to Merchant City now and even though they're outnumbered, they should be able to handle it. Speaking of items, Yungy says arachn1d allows them to use their items, but doesn't trust them with their Elytras just yet. Wemmbu takes his mace and yungy says it usually takes a month to get to royalty, but if they do well in battle, Yungy will be sure to get them up to the highest rank. BanditKing jumps in and asks to join the battle too, Yungy says he's willing to take him in. Yungy calls in the chungies and they're given a shulker box full of gear.

The army leaves the underground and heads to the surface, down to Merchant City. Before they storm in, they stop at a village to gear up on potions and whatnot. Yungy then instructs everyone to put on the armor with trims from the shulker boxes that was given, they move closer before potting up. They all run through the fields, Yungy flies around and splashes the 
Merchant City Vanguard
 with invisibility. Wemmbu goes up top and begins attacking the guards, a big fight breaks out right after. The invis wears out, Wemmbu webs the guards in one area and maces them. It starts raining too, which makes Jaden way stronger since he has a riptide trident. The guards begin to retreat, yungy tells them all to come back to the middle. He tells them 
Cindercrest
 is one their way with more Spiders to secure the city and to loot everything they can and meet back at the caves once done.

Back at Weave's Drop, Wemmbu asks Yungy who the people are with the fire shields, he says they're visitors from Cindercrest, allies of arachn1d's kingdom. Wemmbu pulls Jaden aside and tries to talk to him, Yungy comes up to them and asks what they're talking about. Wemmbu asks Yungy when they're going to rank up and Yungy steps back. He asks if they get a house and Yungy says they can, so he leads them to find a house that fits the both of them. Yungy brings them to a house with a broken roof, he says it's the best house for them since it's right below his mega mansion and he can look down on them at all times. Yungy tells them to enjoy and pretend to fly away, he spies on them and they both notice. Wemmbu writes on a sign to Jaden that he wants to look for egg and tells Jaden to distract Yungy. Jaden asks Yungy where he can survive, Yungy is intrigued and is willing to do the water bucket clutch from a high distance again, and so the two start talking about the extreme lengths they would go to do a clutch while Wemmbu goes out of their sight.

He thinks the castle could have a lot of protection as well, or just simply underground. He wind charges up a leg of a spider, he's unsure if the guards in the castle are at their computers, so he sneaks around. He digs right beneath their feet and into the infrastructure of the castle. He digs up back into a hallway and a guard doesn't notice him, he walks downstairs with confidence and spots more guards, so he goes up a few steps and digs through the wall and into a bedroom. Since he hasn't gotten caught, he keeps walking with confidence in a place where he's not supposed to be. Wemmbu walks around and assumes the people are there to guard and is going to pretend that he's going to guard it too. A royalty member named Andaboar comes through a secret passageway in between bookshelves and says they didn't know arachn1d already made Wemmbu royalty and congratulates him. They say coincidentally Arachn1d wants to speak with Wemmbu and offers to take him there. Before they enter, they tell Wemmbu that no items are allowed, so the both of them store their items in an ender chest. Arachn1d welcomes Wemmbu and says he has another mission for him. Wemmbu says no, and asks for egg back before working any longer. Arachn1d says Wemmbu doesn't have power and he decides whether or not egg lives, and if he completes the mission, he'll be ranked up to royalty, which gives him access to the entire civilization, secret areas, prisons, and everything else. Arachn1d tells Wemmbu that they're fighting a war against 
Parrot
, the most important area in Parrot's kingdom is 
Highwater City
, which is where most of the food supplies gets sent to, but if they take over it, Parrot's kingdom would starve to death. Wemmbu thinks Arachn1d wants to take over the city by himself, but arachn1d just wants him to assassinate the leader of the city, 
ParamountX
, and leave no witnesses. Wemmbu asks don't they already know that he's involved because of the Merchant City attack, arachn1d is tired of his questions, so he says he'll allow Wemmbu to use an elytra for this mission. Before Wemmbu heads off, arachn1d tells him he won't find egg sneaking around his castle uninvited.

Yungy steps up and says Wemmbu doesn't deserve it and that he's only there for egg, and once he finds egg, he's gone. orbital strike cannon
. He sees

 standing on top of a ledge, he asks if they're allies and realizes that he is, a group of players begin attacking Wemmbu and he sends a stab shot right where he is and accidentally launches himself up high up. invisible assassin

title: 100 Days Arc
content:
Story


Spoke sneaks into 
Point Nemo
, the secret base of 
Ashswagg
 and 
TheRealSquiddo
. He spends a while searching the base, uncovering secret vaults and passages, before finally finding a villager, which Ash plans to trade to 
Reddoons
. Spoke rigs the trade, stealing the payment and killing the villager, then steals everything else in the entire base, but is forced to burn most of it to stop Ash from finding it again. He follows Ash to a different secret base, where Ash catches him, revealing he sold the dragon egg to Reddoons, and that there's nothing left for Spoke.

Spoke sneaks into the base of Reddoons and 
Yeah Jaron
. He spies on them for a while, and is forced to visit 
PlanetLord
 for a duplicate of a pet he accidentally kills. Planet and 
Mapicc
 follow him back, and they all spy together. Spoke pranks Jaron as he’s showing his friend 
Baconnwaffles0
 around the base. They prepare for the final raid of every item, which is successfully completed despite Jaron’s attempted interferences. However, Reddoons reveals they missed the dragon egg room, and claims it for himself, so Spoke promises to hunt him down until he gives it up.

Spoke finds their new base and hides inside. He messes up multiple trade deals they attempt to make while also stealing from their farms. After multiple close calls, he discovers they have a villager, but before he can steal it, thieves raid the base. Spoke blows them up, but accidentally destroys the entire base with them, including all his wealth.

Spoke sneaks into the 
Bounty Assassin Team
’s base, but gets trapped inside there, forcing him to be stealthy once more. However, B.A.T. knows he’s there and are intent on killing him, believing him to be the player they’re hunting: 
The Director
. He begins calling himself that without knowing what it means. Eventually, he goes on a pranking spree, dangling pets over the void, destroying farms, and setting off fireworks. In the end, he gets captured and interrogated by BAT, but escapes with chorus fruit. While they chase him, he manages to lose them and successfully escapes, fleeing the base.

title: 100 Days Hidden in a Minecraft Chunk Base
content:
100 Days Hidden in a Minecraft Chunk Base














Season


2






Episode


10






Upload date


Apr 26, 2025






POV


SpokeIsHere






Arcs


100 Days Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


Reddoons
Jepexx
Yeah Jaron
buzzman02














lowkey best base i've raided so far...





100 Days Hidden in a Minecraft Chunk Base
 is the 37th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


Spoke shows the base he is about to infiltrate and hide in for the next 100 days which is owned by 
Reddoons
 and 
Yeah Jaron
. Out of the 1000 players online, it is considered to be the #1 base. 

Spoke follows Jaron inside the base but as he was about to go inside the door closed. Spoke tries placing a block on the observer but the door kept closing before he could make it inside. Spoke decides to use an elytra and firework rockets. Spoke cannot make too much noise because Reddoons was inside the base.

The goals of the base were 'Build An Empire, Get Rich and Get More Rich'. Spoke was snooping around but then Reddoons came down he hid behind the bookshelves that were used for the enchanting table setup. Consequently, the book on the enchanting table opened and faced towards 
Spoke
. Luckily, Reddoons didn't spot it.

Spoke tried hopping downbut he took fall damage that makes noise that could alert Reddoons about his whereabouts. 

On day 3, Spoke went to his stash to get some potion materials, ender pearls and even a chorous fruit. Spoke went back inside the base but when he tried hopping up using a boat, he almost immediately got spotted. Once Reddoons left, Spoke went up and block his cobblestone to hide his tracks. Spoke noticed Jaron's nametag in a  contraption below. Spoke noticed some automatic farms. One produced beeswax, another produced pumpkins. Spoke tried going up the stairs but Reddoons was blocking  him, Spoke waited for Reddoons to pass and he went up and even saw a cactus farm, a wheat farm, a carrot farm, a wheat farm, a potato farm and a sweetberry farm. 

Spoke decides  to mine out his secret bunker but Reddoons came back up and before Spoke could block it Reddoons saw it. Spoke wasn't sure if his cover was blown, but Reddoons simply just covered it up probably thinking it was his basemate's tunnel. 

On Day 5, Spoke goes up another layer and finds an automatic sugarcane farm; but then Spoke heard a chest open. It was Jaron. 

On Day 6, Spoke decides to build his secret base near the automatic cactus farm. 

On Day 7, He mined out the area for his base, and placed down his brewing stand, a crafting table and four furnaces. He also mined out the floor and stored  the loot he stole from the last base he raided in 
I Survived 100 Days Inside a Hidden Base
 and 
I Spent 100 Days Hidden in a Secret Minecraft Base...
. 

On Day 8, he made a room to make a map of the base. Spoke realises his invisibility ran out and reinvis. 

On Day 9, Spoke explores the base and he finds their storage. Spoke doesn't steal Reddoons opens the chest so he doesn't make sound, Spoke saw a board for their upcoming trades and in how many days that trade would take in. On the opposite board it was the enemies list with Spoke, 
Mapicc
, EvilMaster and 
PlanetLord
 included on it. Finally Reddoons dropped down. Spoke decides this is his chance to find some crazy farms.

On Day 10, Spoke finds the chests of Pumpkins, Melons and Honey Bottles and some ominous potions. 

On Day 11, Spoke heard someone climbing up the ladder which was Reddoons. Spoke thought he was fine until his invisibility ran out. Spoke hid behind the wall of their storage room. Spoke needed to stay crouched or he'll be exposed. Spoke jumps down leaving him barely alive with 2 hearts. Somehow his damage noise was just out of range  and Reddooons didn't notice; when he was out of sight, Spoke quickly drank another potion of invisibility. 

On Day 12, Spoke goes back to his secret base and replaced his walls with melons and pumpkins.

On Day 13, he finished renovating his base. 

On Day 14,  Spoke crafted some hoppers, and created a model of how Spoke would leech off their farms and take it's resources. 

On Day 15, he put his plan in action. and implemented it on the automatic sugarcane farm. 

He was practically finished on Day 16, but then he saw Reddoons right through the walls. Reddoons opened some chests but he didn't spot Spoke's hoppers. 

On Day 17, Spoke was able to start mining. 

On Day 18, Spoke connected the tunnel to his secret base.

On Day 19,  Spoke made the bunker even prettier. 

On Day 20, Spoke lit the tunnels with torches and checked how much profit he made from the farms. 

On Day 21, He went back out to search out for better farms. 

On Day 22, Spoke spotted a new chest that was added to the storage room which was filled with cobwebs. 

On Day 23, Spoke went all the way up to see whats at the top of the secret base. Spoke saw Jaron's nametag but somehow he was above the roof. So, Spoke found a spot in the wall and dug up. However, instead of seeing a secret room he saw the night sky. Since Spoke was curious why Jaron was standing on the top of the mountain he sticked around. 

On Day 24, Spoke was replenishing his invisibility when 2 players showed up. The players demanded Jaron to drop the items but in return Jaron asked them to show him their items. Jaron realised they weren't here to trade but they were here to rob him. Jaron tried running but Spoke, and the players chased after him incase someone died. Spoke realized he needed Jaron alive if he wanted to gain more profit so Spoke places cobwebs on them trying to slow them down just so Jaron could escape. They then tried to escape once Spoke equipped his armor. Spoke then stroke a deal with them that would come in handy later.

On Day 25, Spoke checked when Jaron's next trade would occur. (17 days from now). 

On Day 26, Spoke checked how much the farms had made. 

On Day 27, Spoke got distracted.

On Day 28, Spoke made an ender pearl stasis to get out of trouble. 

On Day 29, Spoke was going to find more farms to raid but he almost broke the block right infront of Reddoons. Spoke eventually found what seemed to be a lava farm and also a cobblestone farm. 

On Day 30, Spoke discovered a chorous fruit farm but it didn't seem like it was working; so, Spoke began to fix their farm for them. Although Reddoons was right behind Spoke, Reddoons didn't notice Spoke and neither did Spoke. 

On Day 31, Spoke remembered his goal of rigging a farm. Eventually, Spoke found something useful; a mushroom farm which is a key ingredient in making fermented spider eyes which are used to brew invisibility potions. 

On Day 32, Spoke finished rigging the mushroom farm and connected it to his secret base. 

On Day 33, Spoke was staying productive and kept searching. Until Spoke noticed Reddoons returning on a flying machine with a minecart with a chest. Spoke waited for Reddoons to leave and checked and in the chest there was 192 torches, 36 diamonds, and 256 golden carrots. 

On Day 34. Spoke was back at the secret base and he added the new rooms he found to his map.

On Day 35, Spoke used his stolen lava buckets to add some "new features". 

On Day 36, Spoke finished adding his new features. 

On Day 37, Spoke was about to leave but then he noticed Reddoons was coming towards his direction. Spoke quickly got on the stairs to avoid Reddoons as Spoke was running out of invisibility. Spoke hid in the wall. 

On Day 38, Spoke drank a potion of invisibility to reinvis. 

On Day 39, Spoke expanded his bunker even more.

On Day 40, Spoke was back to exploring and he found an automatic potion brewer. Spoke takes a bunch of Harming and Poison potions. 

On Day 41, Spoke spotted Jaron which reminded Spoke tomorrow was the day of the trade. 

On Days 42 and 43, The player had arrived. Spoke had the bandits set up stasises and the bandits reappeared and killed the player. Spoke had rigged their stasises because Spoke knew the bandits would kill him; so Spoke threw poison and harming on them which killed them. 

On Day 44, Spoke went back inside the base like nothing happened. 

On Day 45, Spoke saw some new trades added to the board despite recent events. 

On Day 46, Spoke made his bunker even prettier. 

On Day 47, Spoke made some hoppers, and chests. 

On Day 48, Spoke rigged a bunch of farms; secretly taking items from the farms.

On Days 49 and 50, Spoke finished connecting all the tunnels. 

On Day 51, Spoke noticed he stole 0 items so he decided to check but he saw Reddoons at the farm. Spoke watched Reddoons place a new sign on the trading board.

On Day 52, Spoke finally fixed the problem. 

On Day 53, Spoke remembered another trade was coming up. 

On Day 54, Jaron seemed to be grabbing some items.

On Day 55, Spoke was waiting for Jaron to go to the top but instead Jaron started running down one of the tunnels. 

On Day 56, They finally made it to the top where another player was waiting. Spoke tried to troll them.

On Day 57, FartSteve08 tried to kill Spoke for trying to interrupt their trade. Spoke elytra'd away from FartSteve. 

On Day 58, To make up for not getting items Spoke decided to search for valuables inside the base.

On Day 59, Spoke renovated his bunker.

On Day 60 and 61, Spoke checked all his rigged farms to see if they were getting him items. 

On Day 62, Spoke decides to rig the Chicken egg farm. 

On Day 63, Spoke had the hoppers completely set out.

On Day 64, Spoke connected everything.

On Day 65, Spoke made his system more time efficient because he came up with a design to lead all the hoppers of the rigged farms into one singular chest.

On Days 66 and 67, Spoke mined out all the area.

On Day 68, Spoke set out with a mission of finding the best farm. Spoke found out that trades were coming up in 4 and 15 days respectively. Spoke changed the coordinates of the trades coming up in 4 days from 9000 ~ -7200 to 45000 ~ -600

On Day 69, Spoke watched Reddoons do his normal routine and when he looked at the board he didn't suspect a thing. Reddoons went on the flying machine and Spoke followed it from  the ground.

On Day 70, Spoke kept following the flying machine. 

On Day 71, Reddoons finally stopped the machine. 

On Day 72, Under the snow was Hopper Minecarts that would pick up any items dropped. The player Spoke asked to be bait was 
Jepexx
. Unfortunately Jepexx was AFK which hampered Spoke's plan. 

On Day 73, Jepexx was nowhere near his computer. So, Reddoons left.

On Day 74, Spoke followed Reddoons back. 

On Day 75, Spoke was back on the mission of finding the best farm. 

On Day 76, Spoke found a pitcher pod and torchflower seeds farm using sniffers.

On Day 77, Spoke decides to rig this farm anyways. 

On Day 78, Spoke finished connecting it all. 

On Day 79,  Spoke noticed Jaron's next trade was in 2 days.

On Day 80, Spoke went on top of the mountain ready to fish the items towards him.

On Day 81, The trade had begun. 

On Day 82, Spoke did nothing.

On Day 83, Spoke cleared his mind by doing some therapeutic building. Spoke also threw eggs everywhere; even in the lava. 

On Day 84, Spoke realised he is a failure.

On Day 85, Spoke realised some pumpkins aren't going to save him from his bad decisions.

On Day 86, Spoke decided to get some fresh air which meant going out into the base. 

On Day 87, Spoke decided to rig the chorous fruit farm but he ran out of hoppers.

On Day 88, Spoke just stole from the chorous fruit chest.

On Day 89, Spoke had a blast in the base.

On Day 90, Spoke decided to check on what Jaron's been doing at the bottom of the base.

On Day 91, Spoke saw the raid bar and freaked out because a team on the server called 
The Invisible Mafia
 killed all the villagers and mobs don't spawn for unknown reasons and raids need at least a minimum of one villager. Therefore, the base somehow had a villager. 

On Day 92, Spoke decided to try and steal the villager.

On Day 93, Spoke went down a water chute but found nothing.

On Day 94, Spoke went back up but he got stuck. He couldn't mine up because Jaron was right there. Spoke managed to swim down and break a glass to escape.

On Day 95, Spoke did nothing.

On Day 96, Spoke cleared out room for the materials to steal the villager.

On Day 97, Spoke had his closest moment with death and he descended into the farm. 

On Days 98 and 99, Raiders had placed TNT inside the base and found Spoke's secret base. Spoke crafted diamond armour and enchanted it. Spoke also equipps his 
netherite chestplate.
 Spoke makes a trap to kill all of them. The bandits say Spoke killed Jimmy. Spoke accidentally blows up the whole base with his trap. 

On Day 100, Jaron and Reddoons come back to their destroyed base and confront Spoke. Spoke escapes.

title: 100 Days as King of the Unstable SMP
content:
100 Days as King of the Unstable SMP














Episode


118






Upload date


Feb 28, 2026






POV


ParrotX2






Featured Creators (Description)


TheobaldTheBird
Fymada
Horace_Altman
DragonMC__
Lezy
4CVIT
LettuceK
















People of the Unstable SMP. Thank you for coming today and thank you for voting for me and crowning me as the king of this server.



ParrotX2
's opening speech as King of Unstable


100 Days as King of the Unstable SMP
 is the 118th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


On the Unstable SMP, every one in ten players make it out of spawn alive, but even those who get to escape do not live for long. The players have accepted this as how Unstable is, but in the first time in history, they had voted for a king of the server, and that person is 
Parrot
.

The episode begins with Parrot standing on top of the Northern Council and giving a speech to the entire server, he tells everybody that he has seen power be in the wrong hands and ensures that it wouldn't happen again. He promises to take responsibility and make sure that everyone can live peacefully. The crowd boos and shouts that they wanted 
LettuceK
 to be king. Parrot hears the backlash and says if players can not spawn onto the server safely within a hundred Minecraft days, or thirty three hours, he'd resign from king. Parrot knew Lettuce was unable to save spawn even with his powers, and if Parrot managed to do so, he'd prove everyone that he was worthy of being king.

Parrot has a meeting with his friends, 
Theo
, 
Fymada
, and 
Horace
. Theo thinks Parrot is crazy for attempting to make spawn a safe place in such a short amount of them when Lettuce was unable to during his regime. Fymada and Horace has their own plans on how they could improve the server and Theo says he'd be Parrot's royal guard. Theo asks what their first decree is, Parrot says they'll have to take back spawn. The two go to spawn and start their mission of killing off all the withers. As they get closer up to the top of spawn, the withers start focusing on them, which prevents more deaths from happening. At the same time, Parrot helps out players and gives them protection and food to make sure they get to a safe place. They kill off the withers at the top, but the rest of the withers are down under and they've been slowly drained of their armor and resources. Luckily, Fymada and Horace come to assist killing off all the withers and regear. On the fifth day, players no longer die from withers and the new players joining the server walk up to Parrot and praise him for saving them. However, players may still die from fall damage, so he asks Horace to rebuild the entirety of spawn.

The next step of Parrot's journey of being king, he needs to give people a safe place to go, and players usually head to 
Capital City
 for that. However, Capital City is ran by a corrupt mayor and Parrot goes to declare Fymada the new mayor. When Parrot, Theo, and Fymada step foot into the city, 
SirPig
 tells Parrot that the three of them have taxes to be paid or else they'd be escorted out. Parrot tells him that's going to be a problem since he's king now and grants Fymada the title of the mayor of Capital City. They hold a meeting with the players there, Fymada starts up by saying there will be an expansion to the city and reduce the percentages of taxes so players can keep what they earn. After Fymada has her speech, Parrot and Theo go back to their old potion shop and reminisces of the past. As they're about to head out, 
DragonMC
 comes to visit and tells them before they go, on behalf of Capital City, they're given horses for being king. Dragon says the first horse Parrot chooses is destined to be fate and will be the horse for the entirety of his kingship. Parrot looks through all of the horses and sees a lone white horse out of all of the horses there. He sits on the horse and tames it first try. This horse was truly fate, as it was extremely fast and could jump very high. As for Theo, he tamed a donkey and Parrot forces him to keep it.

After making room for more players, Parrot's next step is to supply players with food so they don't starve. Parrot and Theo visit the train station and meet up with an old friend, 
lezy
, and asks for two tickets to 
Redstone Town
. Lezy gives the tickets for free and says the king doesn't need to pay. Parrot, still with the mindset that they're still players, decides to pay it either way. Parrot and Theo spend the next few days on the railway on their horses and ironically runs out of food, so they make a pitstop at a village to buy food. As they walk into the tavern, Parrot says what's up and the entire place goes quiet. One person speaks up and asks what they're doing there. Parrot goes up to the owners and asks if they can buy food, the owners say yes and says they can get twenty steaks for a few diamonds, Theo pays and they only give two steak. Parrot says they need food to get to Redstone Town, but the owners say he's ruining the server and that nobody likes him. The players in the tavern all start booing and pushing them out. They make it to Redstone Town and visits 
4CVIT
, Parrot asks 4CVIT to help them out with an automatic chicken farm, but 4CVIT refuses to help since the members of the town would be upset with him. This forces Parrot and Theo to build it on their own, and they spend several Minecraft days attempting it, with 4CVIT watching in the distance. 4CVIT feels bad seeing Parrot build so many chicken farms when he could've been finished way earlier, but 4CVIT is not able to provide them with a chicken and tells them that they can get one through an auction over at 
Merchant City
. 

They head over to Merchant City and asks the auctioneer what the average price of a chicken is, the auctioneer tells them a thousand diamonds, but the two of them only have a total of 400 diamonds, so they decide to play games around the city to earn diamonds. The first game they head to is an archery game, one shot is three diamonds, each target is worth one to three diamonds depending on the distance respectively, and the minecart at the back is worth ten diamonds. Parrot shoots the minecart and uses the prize to buy more shots and hits the minecart over and over again. The owner of the game gets angry and accuses Parrot of cheating, so he makes Parrot stand back further to make the shot harder, but it doesn't change anything and Parrot makes the shots still. The owner makes Parrot stand even further back on top of a house that's fifty blocks away, Parrot charges his bow and times it, he hits the shot and asks to buy more shots, but the owner gets frustrated and refuses to sell anymore and says he's went into debt from the game and storms off. They had garnered over 900 diamonds, which may be enough to buy the chicken, so they head over to the auction. During the auction, Theo bids for a Law-owned spear and an enchanted golden apple, but Parrot tells Theo to stop bidding on anything besides the chicken. Parrot notices the person sitting right next to Theo may be a problem, since he bid over 800 on an enchanted book. The last item is the chicken, Parrot and the other person bidding goes back and forth, when the price goes up too high, Parrot tells him that without the chicken, his kingdom will fall and bids everything they have. The other player bids more than what they have, as Parrot thinks they're going to lose the bet, Theo steps up and bids over a hundred thousand diamonds, thinking that it was a hundred more than what the previous bid was, winning the auction immediately. Parrot quietly leaves with the chicken and tells the auctioneer they'll have the payment in the future. 

Back at Redstone Town, 4CVIT and the other members of the city had built farms that can produce more food than necessary. They spend the next few Minecraft days breeding the chicken and storing chickens into the farms to their fullest limit. After their hard work, they stand on top of a hill and look at the farm. Parrot says they may be able to win people over, Theo asks if it bothers Parrot that people still hate him even with all the effort he's been putting, and that people still want Lettuce to be king. Parrot says it did bother him a little, but it's not to make people like him and only wants to do what's right. They wait several more Minecraft days for the farm to work its magic, they now have a new problem; transporting all of the chicken would take a long time using railroads. Parrot follows the minecarts full of chicken while Theo goes ahead and deals with whatever players or situation may be waiting for them. On the second wave of players, a group of lawmen try to attack Theo, but he kills them off and one runs away, Theo chases them. Theo's horn is blown, signaling to Parrot that it's safe to continue, but Parrot notices 
SargeLAW
, who says he's going to stop Parrot from being king. Parrot tells him if he destroys the chicken supplies, he won't be able to become king and will cause players to die. SargeLAW says if Parrot succeeds on becoming king, they wouldn't have a server to play on, especially with a king like Parrot. SargeLAW and his group of lawmen begin looking through the minecart chests, which were all empty. Parrot slowly backs up away from 
The Law
 and had managed to juke them. The truth was he had 4CVIT transport all the chicken using a happy ghast and that they'd buy him as much time as possible. 

On the 94th day, Parrot made it back to spawn, which had been fully reconstructed. Parrot is astonished at how quickly Horace rebuilt spawn. Horace brings Parrot to the designated food giver and shows them where players spawn now. Afterwards, he rides through the obsidian highway and greets the players that he stumbles across, but every time he stops to talk to them, they tell him how he had ruined the server. Parrot goes back to the Northern Council and down to the prison where he looks at Lettuce. Parrot asks Lettuce why people still hate him despite all of his work, it's only the new players that are supportive, not the old ones, and asks why that may be the case. Parrot mentions before they locked Lettuce up, he said the server was unrepairable and asks if that may be related. Lettuce only answers by saying, "Who knows?" Parrot calls him pathetic and says he did everything Lettuce could never do in thirty hours, Lettuce says if he really wanted to save all the players, he could've, he then asks Parrot why he didn't choose to. Parrot says he could've done something about it, Lettuce says sometimes you have to do whatever it takes to protect the people and that he'll find out soon enough and wishes him luck as a king and that he's surprised Parrot had made it this far as king.

On the hundredth day, an influx of the player base had grown exponentially, and Parrot's kingdom has grown with it. Parrot and Theo stand up top of the castle looking down at Northern Council. Parrot asks Theo if it was strange that players used up so many resources on withers to use at spawn, and that he thought it may be trollers or griefers, but doesn't understand why people would've taken it that far. Parrot says he doesn't care about who is responsible for it and focuses on what's more important: building up his kingdom.



Trivia


A player can be seen wearing netherite armor with quartz trims, the same ones used by 
The Director
 during Fymada's speech in Capital City.

1v100





Minecraft Combat Master VS 100 Hunters
 is the 80th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


The video begins with a recap of the fight in 
SOLO Player VS Hardcore Minecraft SMP
 which was between 
FlameFrags
 and 
Wemmbu
 with 
Spoke
 watching invisible and from the sidelines. As Flame was about to go to the courtroom where 
Parrot
 and 
Theo
 had trapped 
Wemmbu
, the leader of 
The Law
, 
LettuceK
 showed up at his base. Lettuce calls Flame to the new Law base which is about 100 blocks from Flame's base. Lettuce says he recruited around 100 goons (from the nether) to take down Flame. Flame is impressed by how they built a new base in just one day. Lettuce introduces him to 
Deputy_Ace
; his right-hand man. Lettuce tries to persuade Flame to drop all his items in his inventory and ender chest and sit in a prison cell for a fortnight but Flame refuses. Lettuce gave Flame three more days to think and rehabilitate to become a law-abiding citizen. Flame calls his best friend 
Lomedy
 to help him gear up to fight the Law. Flame calls Lomedy to 
Merchant City
 and on the way, Flame tells him about the recent encounter with LettuceK. Flame makes a plan to disguse themselves with a law shield to learn about their battle strategies. Flame and Lomedy sneak into Law territory. Flame warns Lomedy to communicate with signs only and to not speak so their identity isn't blown. They search for Lettuce as the players are just "yapping". Flame and Lomedy listen in on LettuceK's  conversations. Lettuce makes an announcement of their gear shipment. Flame and Lomedy are stopped by Lettuce at the front gate as they try  to intercept the gear shipment. Lettuce tells them use of invisibility is prohibited in the Law Base. Flame stops Lomedy from speaking by breaking his signs. Lettuce threatens them to kick them out of Law and take action for breaking their simplest rule if they don't drink milk or speak. They run away into the nearby river. 42hunterdude is killed by LettuceK. Lomedy tries to convince Flame to turn himself in but he doesn't listen. They successfully intercept the shipment and kill the whole party plus their happy ghast. They take the shipment for themselves. Lomedy tells Flame he didn't have to kill them and Lomedy questions Flame's violent ways. Flame tells Lomedy about his motives. He explains that he is hunting Wemmbu because he is trying  to show that real skill doesn't come from power, orbital strike cannons, maces or dishonor. He explains that if people like Wemmbu prevail, people will forget about skill. Lomedy says that Flame should attack the Law right now. Flame makes another wolf machine.  Lettuce makes a speech about how Flame could stop this pointless bloodshed could stop if he turns himself in. Flame refuses. They fight and eventually, Flame comes out on top forcing Lettuce to run and killing his entire army. Flame goes back to his base. 

Parrot
 shows up and he asks Flame why he didn't show up at the 
Capital City
 courtroom. Flame says that he was fighting off the Law.



Trivia


The video's original title was SOLO Player VS 100 Minecraft Hunters.
