Welcome to BAT!



Leow0ok
 to 
ParrotX2
, in 
I Got Hunted by the World's Best Minecraft Player
The 
Bounty Assassin Team
, commonly known as 
BAT
, was a team of players featured in 
Unstable Universe
 
Season 2
.

History


ItzRealMe
 tries to assassinate 
ParrotX2
. A team of people save him from ItzRealMe. They escape to the nether. They invite Parrot to Bounty Assassin Team. In the meeting room there was a blackboard with a list of players captioned The Director List, indicating they have already started to investigate 
the Director
, likely overhearing 
Ashswagg
's talk in the 
Far Lands
. Parrot and 
Leow0ok
 see ItzRealMe inside of Parrot’s house. They start constructing a prison around ItzRealMe.

Parrot is given his own room in the 
BAT Headquarters
. BAT tries to kill ItzRealMe, but are forced to run away as he has a mace. ItzRealMe later finds Parrot in the BAT Headquarters. BAT saves Parrot. ItzRealMe tells Parrot that 
The Director
 is the one who hired him to assassinate him. 

BAT tries to kill 
FlameFrags
 but fail and run away. 

MrCube6
 tries to assassinate Parrot by trapping him under the void. 
Derapchu
 finds Parrot and saves him. Parrot sees an invisible player sitting in one of the chairs.

Derapchu is trapped by MrCube6 on a pressure plate. Parrot and the team have to figure out which redstone lines to activate to save him and the entire base from exploding within a certain amount of time. MrCube6 also says that he sent a TNT bomber plane towards their base. They are able to save Derapchu.

Parrot sets up a trap and catches MrCube6. They trap him in a prison. MrCube6 manages to escape. MrCube6 steals all of the gear from the headquarters. He gives these items to 
4CVIT
. Parrot and Derapchu take the shulker boxes of items back. A team of bandits try to steal from Parrot and Derapchu, but fail.

BAT finds MrCube6 and detains him. They interrogate MrCube6. They give MrCube6 a dandelion. MrCube6 escapes with a stasis chamber, but not before he gives Parrot a book. The book states something about a dandelion, implying that The Director somehow knew that MrCube6 got a dandelion.

Parrot finds a chest in his room with a sign saying to run. Inside the chest is two stacks of ender pearls and an invisibility potion. The BAT headquarters go into lockdown mode, so Parrot uses an invisibility potion and hides. The BAT tries to find Parrot to presumably kill him. Parrot flies away to make his own base.

BAT finds Parrot and claim that he’s The Director. Parrot runs to the nether. They find Parrot on the nether roof. Parrot manages to escape.

JumperWho
 finds Parrot in an abandoned city. JumperWho tells him that she was the one who put the chest and the sign in his room. Parrot becomes a JumperWho spy to figure out how he had been framed for being The Director.

JumperWho gives Parrot the pieces of evidence that BAT thought showed he was The Director. Leow0ok does a "mole check" to see if any of JumperWho’s spies were moles by having them hold a green shield. Parrot takes a green banner off of the wall and combines it with his shield. Parrot is the only spy who holds a green shield, showing that he is a mole. Parrot manages to escape.

Parrot finds a book asking Parrot to meet up with him. Parrot spies on BAT’s meeting. JumperWho betrays him. Parrot manages to escape during the chaos. JumperWho tells Parrot that he was actually just pretending to betray Parrot because BAT didn’t trust her. Parrot discovers that someone was spying on them. JumperWho uses a goat horn to call back her spy. They kill the spy.

BAT watches Parrot and The Director have a conversation, which convinces BAT that Parrot is not The Director. The Director teleports away. Leow0ok discovers that JumperWho killed a spy, and kick her off the team.

A player named 
TruOriginal
 tries to kill Nufuli, Parrot, and Leow0ok using hacks. They are eventually able to escape. The BAT headquarters is destroyed by TruOriginal who uses a hack to use other people's usernames and skins. TruOriginal tries to kill them. Leow0ok stays behind so BAT can escape. Leow0ok eventually escapes and finds BAT.

TruOriginal tries to kill them but eventually runs away. BAT make a new base that Parrot and Nufuli guard. TruOriginal tries to kill them again. He changes time to try and kill them. BAT lead TruOriginal into a trap to try and kill him, but he teleports Parrot into the trap, almost killing him. He is luckily able to escape. They pretend that they have a second trap and scare TruOriginal away.

TruOriginal finds Parrot and 
Nufuli
. Unbeknownst to him, Parrot and Nufuli were above a secret underground base, where Derapchu and Leow0ok were AFK sleeping in real life. TruOriginal deletes all of Parrot's items. TruOriginal teleports Parrot thousands of blocks into the sky. Nufuli saves Parrot from dying.

TruOriginal kidnaps Derapchu and Leow0ok. He pretends to be Leow0ok using a hack and tries to kill Parrot and Nufuli. Using a trap, they are able to kill TruOriginal.

Nufuli leaves the team, and as he is leaving, the Director kills him. They see the Director and try to kill him. The Director uses a pearl cannon to escape. BAT use the pearl cannon to try and go after the Director. They find themselves in an obsidian room, where the Director tries to kill them using an army of zombies with netherite armor and weapons. They are able to escape.

BAT go over to a redstone shop to see if the Director is there. They eventually find a player wearing the same armor as the Director. They force him to drink milk, revealing he is MrCube6. The real Director comes over and saves MrCube6. The Director tries to kill BAT using TNT but fails.

JumperWho rejoins BAT after saving Parrot. She leads them to a secret base that she created. The Director gives BAT a message, telling Parrot to meet up with him in one week. SpokeIsHere finds the secret base BAT live in and secretly pranks them and steals from them, and pretends he's the Director. Spoke is eventually caught and is forced to escape.

BAT spies on the Director and Parrot having their conversation. JumperWho's spies spy on a list of suspects for people who could potentially be the Director. They see all of them online while the Director and Parrot have their conversation. Parrot sees the Director hold a chest plate with a red armor trim, causing him to believe the Director is Spoke, as Spoke wears that chest plate. Parrot convinces Leow0ok and Derapchu to pretend to be spies so that Parrot can threaten to kill the supposed spies unless JumperWho confesses. This plan fails as Leow0ok and Derapchu stop pretending to be spies after JumperWho doesn't confess.

While JumperWho and Derapchu are out of the base, Leow0ok tries to kill Parrot. He eventually decides to spare Parrot's life. Parrot tells Leow0ok to leave and he obliges.

JumperWho and Derapchu find Parrot at Wifies' base, and Parrot tells them about Leow0ok trying to kill him. The Director finds them, and so they try to kill them. The Director traps JumperWho and Derapchu in an obsidian room over the void.

Parrot and Leow0ok make a plan to save JumperWho and Derapchu using a happy ghast. Leow0ok saves them using a happy ghast while Parrot distracts the Director.

After Parrot leaves BAT. BAT is remade in 
The Amplified
. 
Mapicc
 and 
SpokeIsHere
 join BAT. 

Spoke burns down a village by mistakes. He tries to cover up his tracks but his crimes are spotted by Leow0ok. Spoke then kills a lot of spies. Leow0ok demands for Spoke's execution but JumperWho is insistent on finding evidence first. Leo proves that Spoke tries to kill him and uses his spies as sodliers. He solidifies his alliance with LAW and LettuceK. 

JumperWho betrays Leow0ok and takes her spies and leaves. They fight Leow0ok in BAT vault. The result of the battle is Leow0ok, leader of BAT is ousted and joins LAW and member conflicts lead to the Spies rallying around JumperWho and leaving. 

Some spies are arrested by LAW for betraying Leow0ok and imprisoned. These Spies are later broken out by Spoke, Mapicc, Minutetech and JumperWho. 

BAT spies are present on the final battle against The LAW on both sides. A spy reveals the location of Leow0ok leading to his death. JumperWho continues with her spies and allies with Spoke

title: Breaking Hardcore Minecraft to Get Revenge
content:
Breaking Hardcore Minecraft to Get Revenge














Episode


105






Upload date


Jan 21, 2026






POV


SpokeIsHere






Arcs


BAT Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


Leow0ok
Mapicc
PrinceZam
JumperWho














i broke the laws of minecraft with cool glitches to absolutely annihilate bro





Breaking Hardcore Minecraft to Get Revenge
 is the 105th episode feature in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


On the Unstable SMP, 
Spoke
 has learned to break the laws and physics of Minecraft, he's had close encounters with death multiple times, and with these game-breaking exploits, he'd become unstoppable. The only person stopping him is his greatest enemy, 
Leow0ok
. Spoke swore to put an end to Leo's time on the Unstable, and so his mission starts when Spoke, 
Mapicc
, and 
PrinceZam
 find a village full of people. Spoke sends Zam to be the trader while Spoke and Mapicc dig underneath all of the houses and connecting them all to a machine, Spoke builds a redstone machine that's rigged to TNT minecarts and comes up onto the surface and makes a platform for all of them to stand on, Spoke says they're going to pay a price for not giving them their resources and uses a glitch to break the piece of obsidian underneath, which set off the redstone and destroyed the entire village, Spoke then kills all of the people that lived in the village. After they stashed their resources, they then head towards Leo's location.

They traveled back to the amplified lands, which looked a bit more different than the last time they were there. The jungle biome had turned into a snowy one, with all the bases there being abandoned. Spoke looks back and reminisces about the times where him and Leo were friends. They go to the snowy biome where 
JumperWho
's vault is located, they go down the cave where the entrance is and spots blocks that were recently dropped there. In the vault itself, there was nothing and they had just missed their chance to find and kill Leo. As they were looking around, they hear somebody brewing nearby and begin destroying the vault to find where the noise is coming from. Spoke sees water going up the entrance that wasn't there before, they come outside and try to find whoever was stalking them. To Spoke, nothing about this made sense, this person was smarter than the average spy and realizes that this person was different. They head back to the castle Spoke and Mapicc built, they planned on building traps around the castle, but ended up ditching the plan when Mapicc accidentally blew up his trap in the middle of building it. Spoke came up with another trap that was invisible, using a glitch that makes water float and by water logging it, it only activates when you place a block on it or using string. Zam and Mapicc show Spoke their traps they attempted to make, and Spoke thinks the stalker would think they were stupid, and so Spoke had to make a backup plan. They go to the nether and jump down Spoke's secret tunnel and make another portal nearby to go into a cave to make a secret ender pearl stasis. The three set their stasis in case the stalker ever found them, and they can teleport out using a fishing rod whenever. They portal back to the front of the castle and see that somebody came by and set off and destroyed their traps and placed redstone torches all over to light up the place. Spoke sees something up on a tower, Zam says that it's an arrow. Spoke has not been able to get a glimpse of this person, Zam and Mapicc said they should leave, but Spoke has a feeling this was connected to Leo. They traveled a hundred blocks out and built a skybase at height limit so the stalker wouldn't be able to reach them. Spoke shows Zam and Mapicc the exploit he used in the village, how he can break blocks from afar and set off redstone wherever he wants. 

The next few hours, they camp out on their skybase, but everything was quiet. Spoke spots a beacon across from them and sees beacons of light coming closer to them and disappeared. Spoke makes another stasis in the base and goes down to investigate where the beacons came from, he sees in the distance an abandoned base with the first players he'd seen on his journey, and goes closer up to see why they were there. Spoke sees Leo working with soldiers from The Law. The beacons helped Spoke know Leo was out there and was about to find them, and with Spoke knowing about it, he has the upper hand on Leo. They start heading towards the skybase, Spoke knows Mapicc and Zam don't stand a chance against the lawmen, so he intervenes and kills one of the soldiers. Spoke goes full invis, only putting on his armor to jump a soldier when they're straggling and left alone. Leo groups the lawmen up so none of them die, and Spoke jumps in and TNT minecarts them, but it doesn't kill them. Spoke goes down into a cave in attempt to blow them up with TNT, but that also doesn't work. Spoke appears to be trapped in cobwebs with no way out, he blocks himself in and gets stasised into the base when Zam accidentally blows up part of the base practicing carts. Spoke tells them that Leo is coming and explains what had happened, and so they prepared more defenses and waited for the battle to start. 

Leo and the group of lawmen start to bridge up to their base, they make another stasis so they can go full on rampage and pull it to get back safely. Zam then notices that they called for more backup and a lot more lawmen were coming from below and bridging upwards as well. Spoke pearls onto Leo's bridge and blows up and stasises back up, the lawmen from below get closer to them as well, and Zam carts them from above and destroys their platform. Leo and the lawmen's forces were slowed down, but they still end up getting into the base. Spoke realizes this was an outnumbered duel and all of them would all eventually die. With only one more option to win, Spoke sets up the exploit one last time and tells Zam to bow the lawmen off while he sets up the minecarts. Spoke, Mapicc, and Zam all run away from the base using a sand bridge and Spoke sets off the TNT, breaking the bridge as they run. They all run away and laugh, they then pot invis and go back to Leo to finally kill him once and for all, Leo tried to fight back, but pulled his stasis once his totem popped. They then use an exploit to calculate the coordinates of Leo's stasis using his arrows on the ground, and they head towards the direction of the stasis. The episode ends with Spoke's own stasis being pulled, the very one that was supposed to be a secret.

title: Breaking Into Minecraft's Most Illegal Vault
content:
Breaking Into Minecraft's Most Illegal Vault














Season


1






Episode


3






Upload date


May 4, 2024






POV


Wemmbu






Arcs


The PrinceZam Empire Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


SpokeIsHere
 (Main opponent)
JamatoP
ParrotX2
Tyrad
RealReeon
Sharkilz
Only_A_Squid














Rumored to house millions of illegal items, breaking into this vault will instantly make any player the richest on our server. Which is why I knew I had to raid the vault myself.





Breaking Into Minecraft's Most Illegal Vault
 is the third episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
 and the first episode released by 
Wemmbu
. 



Plot


The episode starts with 
Wemmbu
 stuck in a room filled with minecarts, which prevents him from doing anything. The vault he is in belongs to a player named 
SpokeIsHere
 and protects hundreds of thousands of exploited items. 

Everything starts when 
Wemmbu
 notices a new player on the server, 
Spoke
, heading to another player's base and, out of boredom, decides to follow him invisibly. By chance, he catches an interesting conversation between him and 
JamatoP
 about illegal exploits. Unsure what exactly is going on, but knowing the bad history that Spoke previously had with exploits, he decides to continue following out of suspicion. 

Wemmbu cautiously follows them, and, after overhearing an illegal armor exploit and finding out that these two are the only people who know about it, he realizes how risky this is. He escapes to a nearby cave and decides he is going to discover every single exploit Spoke and Jamato know. He trails Spoke for the next few days until he is able to confront him in the end about the illegal armor he is wearing.



 
 
 
 
Spoke and JamatoP plotting inside Jamato's base
 
 


Spoke brushes the inquiry off while emphasizing the normality of the armor and hoe much he grinded to obtain it.  Wemmbu knows Spoke is clearly lying as he saw him obtain the armor a few days ago while he was trailing him. He leaves the end knowing Spoke is clearly hiding something. He gets even more suspicious when Spoke announces a server-wide recruitment to protect builds called 
The Wonders.
 Knowing Spoke usually doesn't care about those sort of things, he suspects they may have something to do with the exploits. He applies for a guardian position, knowing the risks he is be facing.



 
 
 
 
Wemmbu flexing his orbital cannon
 
 
Spoke asks Wemmbu to show him one talent in order to get the job. Wemmbu brings him to an open field and then shows him his secret weapon, an 
orbital strike cannon
 that he built himself, which greatly surprises Spoke. After he blows up the entire field, Spoke sees Wemmbu's power and gives him the job. Spoke warns Wemmbu that if he catches him inside any of The Wonders, he will be kicked out of the guardian team and 
further actions will be taken.


Not wanting to get on the bad side of an exploiter, Wemmbu guards his monument faithfully. Every time he tries to enter The Wonders, Spoke somehow knows about it and stops him, then goes to the end. Wemmbu decides to go to the end to figure out what is significant about it. He catches Spoke in the midst of building something, then realizes Spoke hollowed out the end pillars and is working inside of them. When confronted about it, Spoke is clearly stressed out and justifies it, saying it is an end project, and orders Wemmbu not to come in. He tries to shift the conversation onto Wemmbu, asking him why he isn't guarding his Wonders.

Wemmbu doubles down and Spoke refuses to tell him what he is up to, saying that there is nothing to know about and asks him to protect The Wonders. Wemmbu respawns the ender dragon, resetting the end pillars and deleting all of Spoke's shulkers. Spoke gets mad and comes up while not wearing the exploited armor, then gets further interrogated by Wemmbu. He restates that he was simply checking his shulkers, which Wemmbu doesn't buy one bit. Spoke then shifts the blame on Wemmbu, asking him why he is here and why he built an orbital strike cannon. He admits he was in the end because he received a little 
package
 from Jamato to work on his project.



 
 
 
 
Wemmbu chasing Spoke to the outer end islands
 
 


Wemmbu laughs it off, exposing the stupidity of the excuse (why would he hide for his project), and asks him what Jamato has to do with all of this. Spoke says Jamato asked him to kill Wemmbu and attacks Wemmbu, doing little to no damage. Wemmbu realizes how useless he is and decides to talk to Jamato. He mocks Spoke's weak attacks, and after a while, decides to pop Spoke's totem. Wemmbu easily intimidates Spoke while mocking him and hitting him with his fists. Spoke continues to boast about his supposed crazy power. He escapes to the outer end islands, so Wemmbu continues to chase after him until he loses him.

Wemmbu decides to head to Jamato's base to talk to him, but realizes both Jamato and Spoke have completely vanished from both of their bases. He decides to check inside of The Wonders and spots Spoke doing something inside of one of them. Spoke seems relieved that some 
items
 are still here, so Wemmbu decides to confront him. Spoke is mad, seeing Wemmbu inside of The Wonders, as he ignored his warnings. He yet again tries to justify that this is a storage room, despite the extremely suspicious setup and illegal armor. Spoke asks Wemmbu to leave, but Wemmbu laughs it off. Spoke says he is going to be gone for a while and that he is packing up for a trip, which is an obvious lie, so Wemmbu starts attacking him.



 
 
 
 
 
Spoke and Wemmbu inside The Wonders
 
 


Spoke secures the armor and a brawl ensues, which Wemmbu is obviously winning. After a while, Spoke decides to put on his illegal armor, but he still continues to lose. He starts pearling everywhere to escape. Wemmbu pops Spoke's totems twice and two pieces of Spoke's armor break, but Spoke barely manages to get away inside of a wall in a split second. On his trail, Wemmbu manages to hear him through the walls as Spoke decides to try to break every machine inside of The Wonders so nobody can get their hands on them, especially Wemmbu. He finally loses Spoke and realizes he took every single exploited item inside of the chests during the fight. Disappointed, he continues his search with 
ParrotX2
, a new player, until they start noticing that the monuments are getting destroyed to cover up what is under them.

Luckily for Wemmbu, the destruction of the wonders angers Parrot, who decides to protect them, not knowing their true purposes. After a bit of manipulation, Parrot gives Wemmbu Spoke's coords, millions of blocks out. Wemmbu finds an enormous vault, presumably protecting the exploited items. He decides to start breaking in around the bottom of the vault until he hits the first obstacle: soul sand and lava. He easily gets across until he hears a guard's voice. Wemmbu tries to advance sneakily, limiting all noise, but is spotted by the guard 
Tyrad
. A fight quickly ensues and Wemmbu manages to escape by chorus fruiting out of the prison.



 
 
 
 
 
Full view of The Vault created by Spoke
 
 


Wemmbu reenters the prison and reengages with Tyrad, seemingly stuck in his own prison. The fight seems much more even. Wemmbu carts Tyrad and gets a few good hits, but Tyrad keeps pushing. Wemmbu continues the fight out of the prison and manages to get away using invisibilty potions. He tries to break in for the third time, but this time, much more sneakily, making sure nobody notices him. While Tyrad is looking for him, he manages to slip past the first defense and enter the next one, where he is attacked by underwater wardens. He barely manages to get past it while being shot by wardens. He notices through the walls two other guards, 
RealReeon
 and 
Sharkilz_
, messing around.

The two of them are clearly not taking this seriously while Wemmbu continues to advance through the base's defense. Tyrad informs the other guards about Wemmbu's break in, so they all start looking for him. Wemmbu gets mining fatigue while he is mining, but that doesn't stop him as he continues to get through the defenses while drinking milk until he actually makes it inside of the vault's rooms.

Wemmbu explores the vault's corridors, blocking off certain paths so he doesn't encounter guards. He narrowly avoids them, as they are not taking this seriously, hitting each other and joking around. He gets spotted as he is potting up and a 3 v 1 ensues. After splashing himself with swiftness, Wemmbu escapes by blocking the paths, aided by the elder guardian's mining fatigue. He frenetically looks around until he finds his way down the prison into a lower floor as the hunters are catching up to him. 

Wemmbu starts killing the elder guardians and manages to get to an even lower floor using an elevator where he is yet again spotted while carelessly moving around. Sharkilz and Reeon immediately start attacking him, Wemmbu does good damage and manages to fend them off for a bit, giving him time to escape deeper into the vault. In a brilliant manner, Wemmbu manages to trap both Sharkilz and Reeon in the lower floor using obsidian, allowing him time to prepare and explore. He reaches the guard's storage room and steals useful equipment.



 
 
 
 
 
Moments before Tyrad's death
 
 


 
 
 
 
 
Moments before getting trapped
 
 


The guards find him and attack him again, and he uses end crystal to blow the hunters up, where he manages to kill 
Tyrad
 and run away by blocking everything off. The hunters hesitate a little, but decide to continue chasing after him, despite the death of their comrade. Wemmbu almost manages to kill Sharkilz using end crystals, but he is saved by the arrival of a large quantity of vexes, which all start attacking Wemmbu. He kills all of them and starts walking around. He realizes that the two guards are not following him anymore. Wemmbu wanders around the base until he finds a hidden passage under soul sand, leading him to another floor.

Wemmbu finds the two guards waiting in a corridor on that floor, and after spying on them for a little,  he decides to attack them yet again. Everything is going well until he is ambushed by a third guard, 
Only_A_Squid
, which turns the tide of the battle. Wemmbu is forced to run away. He manages to escape for a little while using chorus fruit until he is found again. He manages to swim up a water column and block everything behind him. The hunters, out of milk, aren't able to keep up, so Wemmbu narrowly escapes death. He gets some rest while the hunters fetch milk.

Wemmbu finds an elevator activated by a random button, and he manages to go back to where he originally came from, where he finds an odd bubble column, bringing him to a totally new huge and decorated room. A trapped chest sits on a single TNT. While laughing, Wemmbu breaks the TNT, only to find himself falling as the ground below him breaks into a totally new room. 

Spoke menacingly tells Wemmbu that he sees him as he tries to escape by climbing the sides of the huge pit with water. Spoke says that this is a lot worse than a vault as TNT starts falling from the sky. He announces to Wemmbu that he isn't going to be able to leave the prison as payback for what he did earlier. As Wemmbu is getting shot from all sides by wardens, he tries to mine into the walls of the prison, but is stopped by Spoke, who pushes him into the pit as lava is falling from the sky. Wemmbu tries to chorus fruit out, but the wardens pop his totem. Spoke announces that he is actually gonna kill him, unlike what Wemmbu did in the end.



 
 
 
 
 
Wemmbu completely trapped in minecarts
 
 


He finally manages to chorus fruit out, but he is yet again trapped in a room filled with chest minecarts, preventing him from doing anything. Surprised, Wemmbu comes to the realization that he is completely cornered. Spoke mocks Wemmbu, laughing about his inability to find the vault and the way he is currently trapped. He is attacked by a warden stuck with him, so he decides to do everything in his power to escape. Spoke boasts about getting the best prison designers to create this trap while he tries to chorus fruit everywhere.


Wemmbu tries to find a weakness inside the trap where he can break the walls, but to no avail. He manages to break a few minecarts, giving him just enough room to mine out of the walls using a milk bucket, where he escapes the first layer of the prison. Spoke continues to ramble about his perfect revenge until he notices that Wemmbu actually escaped.
 
 
 
 
 
Spoke mocking Wemmbu's escape
 
 


Spoke is clearly flustered as Wemmbu tries to break in inside the actual rooms of the prison. He is burning to the lava while Spoke mocks him trough the glass separating him from the inside of the prison. Wemmbu finds a hole in the lava defense, bringing him back inside the vault, where he restocks and prepares to fight Spoke.



 
 
 
 
 
The Vault's exit
 
 


Wemmbu doesn't hesitate and jumps Spoke, who escapes the exact same way as him before: blocking up the tunnels. Wemmbu runs after him and finds a suspicious trap door leading to a room filled with lava. He gets splashed by a ton of bad effects, meaning he fell into a trap. Wemmbu finds a flaw in the trap and kills the witches throwing potions at him. 

After escaping the trap using chorus fruit, Wemmbu wanders around the base, where he finds tons of false traps until he discovers a bubble column hiding a trapdoor leading to a crawling tunnel leading to a door leading to an underwater exit. Wemmbu laughs as he gets out, seeing Spoke crouching at the other end of the exit. He attacks him without hesitation. Spoke pretends to be indiferrent to Wemmbu leaving the prison, even though he is clearly shocked.

Spoke escapes using an ender pearl stasis chamber.

Debut


I Survived Minecraft's Most Corrupt City










Welcome to the mines.



Reddoons to 
Parrot
, in 
I Survived Minecraft's Most Corrupt City


Capital City
, led by 
Reddoons
 (and quoted by 
Ash
 to be 'basically his'), is a civilization in 
Unstable Universe
. The city is split into two parts: The Mines, and The City. The City is empty and it is dubious if The City was always a ruse for The Mines or citizens of Capital City were placed into The Mines prematurely to produce more diamonds.



Allyship


Most of Capital City's plot relevance is with it's allyship with 
The Invisible Mafia
. In 
I Infiltrated The Minecraft Mafia
, it is expanded upon that the allyship between Capital City and The Invisible Mafia is a one-way transactional relationship where Red will supply the Mafia with goods and the Mafia will remain neutral with Red.

In 
I Discovered a Minecraft Sky Civilization
, guards are shown to be stationed at Capital City, but in 
I Infiltrated The Minecraft Mafia
 they are gone, so it can be assumed that between videos, stations ended at Capital City, along with more interpersonal things like Red's position in the mafia.



The Mines


The Mines are a subsection of Capital City, being where most people in Capital City reside. It is alluded to be some kind of equivalent to a labor camp--minus it being prisoners placed in there; made to mine for valuable ores all day until nightfall. The Mines subsection was watched over 
CoinMonke
 as a warden.

The pitfall most workers found themselves in was the promise to be able to leave The Mines if they reach an absurd quota of diamonds, mostly being impossible without the help of Parrot stealing from Red's vaults. 

It gradually grew to also have a roulette table, following Red's gambling motifs, to kill one player after a week as a punishment for being the target of Red's suspicions.

The Mines are now seemingly defunct after I Survived Minecraft's Most Corrupt City.



History


ParrotX2
, 
Wifies
, and 
deanthebean9
 tried to steal from Capital City. They are caught by Reddoons and five invisible guards. Reddoons says that they each need to get 1000 diamond blocks. They try to escape, but fail. Reddoons says they now need to get 10,000 diamond blocks.

They found a group of miners, with 
CoinMonke
 as the warden. Parrot spent his time mining. Parrot and his friends stole from Capital City vaults. Parrot gave 
PikaTM
 more than 3,000 diamond blocks and he was let free for meeting his quota. Parrot gave more people diamonds he stole from Capital City for them to be set free.

Reddoons found out about people getting set free and saw that his diamonds have been stolen. He tripled the required quota. Using "the smugglers", Parrot and Wifies were able to get white wool. They broke into one of the vaults using the wool, as there were sculk sensors detecting sound. They got in and stole the diamond blocks. Coming back to the mine, Reddoons caught them. Parrot and Wifies stored all of the shulker boxes of diamonds in pots to not get caught with the items.

Reddoons figured out that they used the pots to store the diamonds. Reddoons made it so whoever has the lowest amount of diamonds plays a game of roulette to decide if they live or not. Deanthebean9 and Parrot were tied for lowest. Parrot loses, but CoinMonke said he couldn't kill him, as he didn't want to kill him. Parrot threatened to tell Reddoons that he had not done his job unless he helped them steal from Reddoons. They found a bunch of different locks in the vault, but luckily they were able to brute force through them by trying all combinations, and breaking the redstone. They realized they forgot to bring shulkers and leave. CoinMonke told them Reddoons planned to lock down all of his vaults.

Parrot overheard Reddoons talking to CoinMonke. Reddoons mentioned that 
Ash
 suggested they kill people. Reddoons forces people to play a game which decides if they live or do not live. Reddoons rigs it so 
LuigiToan
 dies. CoinMonke refuses to kill him. Reddoons kills LuigiToan himself.

CoinMonke agreed to give the miners gear to steal Reddoons' diamonds for leverage. The team got caught. Reddoons gambled if they can leave or not. Reddoons let everyone free except for Parrot, deanthebean9, and Wifies, even though he won his bet. Reddoons brought them to Ash and 
The Invisible Mafia
. Ash suggested they join the Mafia, but they said no. They tried to force them to join, but CoinMonke activated their stasis chamber and they escaped.

Members of 
Skyblock Civilization
 investigated Capital City. They pretended to be members of The Mafia to infiltrate however, the invisible players were able to tell the fake ones and attack the Skyblock Civilization members.

Spoke
, 
Mapicc
 and 
Leow0ok
 were sent on a mission to trade with Reddoons. The leader of the mission was disappointed by Red's offerings. Since Red 
wasn't rich enough anymore
, the gold player just went with it and they left.

Reddoons constructed a new 
Capital City
 near 
Spawn
 and abandoned this city after the downfall of the Mafia. 

Wemmbu
 passed by the abandoned Capital City on his way to find 
FlameFrags
.

LettuceK
 cleared 
TheobaldTheBird
 and Parrot's items, took them to the abandoned Capital City and asked 
Deputy_Ace
 to kill them, after Parrot was caught escaping the prison. Surprisingly, Deputy_Ace betrayed Lettuce and sacrificed himself to buy enough time to let them escape.



Trivia


Capital City is named after 
a city Reddoons owned
 in Lifesteal SMP Season 3.

I Became a Minecraft Combat Master
100 Days as King of the Unstable SMP
I Exposed a Corrupt Minecraft Civilization






Debut


The Unstable SMP Experience












But, anyways, uh, I guess I should say, "Welcome to Capital City, Parrot!"



Reddoons
 to 
ParrotX2
, in 
The Unstable SMP Experience


Capitol City
 is a city lead by 
Fymada
, located near spawn. It was previously known as 
Capital City
 before Fymada was appointed as Mayor, and will be referred as 
Capital City 2.0
 below before renaming to distinguish it from the abandoned 
Capital City
. Centered a few hundred blocks from 
Spawn
, this metropolis is a safe space for all players. It is home to many shops, jobs, and houses. Hundreds of players live here—which formerly included 
ParrotX2
 and 
TheobaldTheBird
.



Structure


Capitol City is home to many shops and structures. The city takes a "Desert Empire" theme, being made out of a lot of sandstone and other yellow blocks. But this is not all, as there are some more mental structuring as well. The City has many rules, some are not that great or fair. For example, there is a 90% tax on all items sold. The currency is diamonds, so for every 100 diamonds you make, you will only get 10 
after
 taxes. Most of these goods are sold on "Market Street". This is also where you could have had found 
ParrotX2
, as he used to run a potion shop there as well. There are many different buildings and places in Capitol City as well, each having their importance. 



Main Building


 
 
 
 
Picture of the Building 
 
 


The Main Building is one of Capitol City's most important attractions. Built in the middle of the complex, this tower is huge, reaching over a hundred blocks in height. This is also where you will most likely find 
Reddoons
, the owner of the city. He does meetings and tax calculations on the top floor. For people who want to explore The Main Building, there are only two known ways of reaching higher floors. You can either climb the ladder to the top—which will take a while or use the secret mini elevators that are reserved for guards and important people, as seen in 
Wemmbu
's "
Orbital Strike Cannon vs Unstable SMP
". Either way, you still must get a reservation before climbing to the top, as 
Reddoons
 is almost always busy. 



Train Station


 
 
 
 
 
Picture of the Station 
 
 
Capitol City's Train Station is an important part of the civilization. It consists of 50 tracks each leading to separate stations all across the spawn area of 
Unstable
. It costs four diamonds per ticket now, due to inflation, which might not 
seem
 like a lot, but it is because of taxes. In total, with 90% taxes, it actually costs forty diamonds to get only four back. Anyhow, you buy a ticket from the front desk for that price and your good to go—it just might take a while to wait in line. On the bright side though, you can look around to find less popular front desks, i.e like the one that 
Lezy
 ran, which had no people in line for it. 

Grand Hotel


 
 
 
 
 
Picture of the Hotel
 
 


The Grand Hotel is not just for a temporary stay, it's also a business outpost of some kind. Although not much is known about it canon-wise, it is still an important part of the city, being the second largest building in the complex. It can house up to 800 players due to some simple math, although there have still been reports that stay is way too expensive—even from 
Theo
 himself, who was in major debt to the hotel, having to give up his elytra, which he later received back after "paying back" his debts. 



Post Office/Mail Building


 
 
 
 
 
Picture of the Mailing Complex
 
 


The Mail Building/Post Office is home to the city's mailing industry, located near Merchant Street. Here is where you pick up and drop off mail, and from there, the workers will take care of the rest, carefully sorting out and placing your deliveries where they are supposed to be. The line is long, just like the Train Station, but you can still have a faster waiting experience if you just look around for a shorter line. 



The Lionels


 
 
 
 
 
Picture of the Left Lionel
 
 


The Lionels are some of the most exotic attractions in the entire city. They resemble two huge lions, each on a short pillar. They have a powerful sense in them that suggests to the city's strong power.



History


ParrotX2
 and 
Theo
 went to Capital City 2.0, where 
Parrot
 found a job in a potion shop, and a secret job with 
Theo
 of taking players out of spawn safely to Capital City 2.0.  They made a lot of diamonds doing this, but they do get in trouble from 
Reddoons
 when he caught them invading the 90% tax and 
Parrot's
 failure to pay rent on time. 
Reddoons
 promised to forgive them, and let them keep all their diamonds if they rescue one of 
Reddoons
' friend, 
Hexatope
 from spawn. 
Parrot
 said that he did not do that anymore, as it was cruel that saving people was pay-to-win, as only the people who paid for saving could actually get saved. 
Parrot
 said he would only do it if 
Reddoons
 clears the debt of every player in the city, which surprisingly, 
Reddoons
 immediately agreed. Everyone was happy with what 
Parrot
 did, and he became a city hero.

In 
SOLO Player VS World's Largest Minecraft Server
, 
FlameFrags
 went into Capital City 2.0 to retrieve potions from 
mrlegend101
. 

In 
Orbital Strike Cannon VS Unstable SMP
, 
Wemmbu
 entered the city, threatened the guard with 
stab shot
 and met 
SirPig_
. He asked where 
FlameFrags
 was. 
SirPig_
 initially refused to answer, but after part of the city got nuked he told Wemmbu that Flame had gone to 
The Law
's old base southwest of the city (not the 
Law City
, which is southeast of the city).

In 
How I DIED on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP
, 
Wemmbu
, with a new identity after faking his death, was a peaceful guard of Capital City, until 
Boosfer
 and his massive 50 player army tried to take it over in the 
Battle of Capital City 2.0
. 
Boosfer
 lost, but said he's comming back for more.

Salvationism
, a former leader in Capital City 2.0, allied with 
Wemmbu
, and helped set up a trap to kill 
FlameFrags
 and 
Boosfer
, but the plan failed and 
Salvationism
 was killed in the process. 

It is revealed that 
SirPig
 was the new leader of the city, but he was just as bad as 
Reddoons
. 

SpokeIsHere
 planned to nuke the city and brings the server into ruins, however, 
Parrot
 stepped in and eventually convinces 
Spoke
 from destroying Capital City 2.0.



The Kingdoms Arc


Parrot
, after becoming king, fires 
SirPig
 from as the mayor, giving 
Fymada
 the role instead. She lowers taxes from 90% to 10% and receives mostly positive support. The city's name was changed to 
Capitol City
.

Parrot
 becomes king but his policies are generally unfriendly towards OG's and old players in the server. The reason for this is over population and lack of resources. The 
Capitol City Police
 almost take over the running off the city. New players who try to enter are killed at the gate and the new players already at Capitol City are forced to live in crowded buildings with a 2x2 for a room.  

Shoebilly
 teams up with the 
Police
 to find 
Parrot
. He kills some innocent players when he was fighting with 
Theo
 but when he enters the building he starts killing every single player. The police force is also engaged in the massacre possibly killing up to 100 players or even more. The police force warned that that was just the start and threatened on doing a purge of new players in the city. Luckily for all the new players, the plot failed however for the players who originally lived in Capitol city as well as OG's throughout the server, their conditions are not getting better. 
Parrot's
 regime seems to favour new players which could be the reason why players like 
Arachn1d
 and 
Yungyx
 are able to recruit hundreds of players into their armies and get a lot of support.



Trivia


We know the name was changed from Capital City to Capitol City through the newspaper 
DanchoGold
 gave to 
ParrotX2
 in 
I Exposed a Corrupt Minecraft Civilization
, and the sign in the recently refurbished 
Spawn
 in 
I Created the World's Largest Minecraft Army
.

title: Cart PvP/Carting
content:
Cart PvP
 or 
Carting
 is one of the strongest yet hardest PvP styles in Minecraft. It can pop players in one shot by explosion, but requires more sequential actions and is much harder to master compared with end crystals or respawn anchors. If triggered via a Flame bow, it is called Insta cart and deal moderate damage (roughly equivalent to a TNT) and can be performed in milliseconds. If triggered via flint and steel and a crossbow, it is called X-bow and deal massive damage (roughly between a respawn anchor and an end crystal, often popping the cart PvPer themselves).

title: Chunk suppressor
content:
Chunk Suppressor/Update Suppressor
 is a machine that stops game updates in a specific area, often to perform exploits like duplicating items. In the context of computer science and data processing, "chunk suppressor" refers to "mode-suppression," a technique in file-sharing systems like BitTorrent that prevents the sharing of the most frequently requested data chunks to ensure stability and prevent network congestion.



Function: An update suppressor machine prevents the game from processing updates in a designated "chunk" of the game world.


Purpose: This can be used for exploits, such as creating duplicate items ("shadow items") or for creating areas where sounds no longer play.


Mechanism: It works by creating a state that forces the game to stop a series of block updates and skip them, often by triggering a specific, controlled crash or an error state.

, Cindercrest, and

, in 
1000 Players Simulate Civil War in Minecraft

Unstable SMP: Civil War






Debut


Searching for a Civilization that Doesn't Exist










Overview and Backstory


Cindercrest
 is a faction led by 
Saparata
 that kills new players or forces them to work for them. They are one of the only factions to have all of the most powerful fighters on the server working with them . It is seen as one of the richest factions to be ever on the server able to equip thousands of players with full netherite armor and make them stacked. They are the main antagonists in 
Kingdoms
.


The leader of Cindercrest is 
General Saparata
, who controls the entire Grand Cindercrest Army. His goals are to take over 
Parrot's kingdom
 (Probably making himself king). Due to its alliance with 
Arachn1d's Kingdom
, it is likely he acknowledges 
Arachn1d
 as a king as well and a valid pretender to the throne.

According to Cindercrest the new players joining the server have been taking up huge amounts of resources, leading to supposed food shortage for "old players". Therefore they've made it their primary goal to eliminate the server's new players, destroy 
ParrotX2
's kingdom and kill everyone not involved with them. According to 
Saparata
 (leader of Cindercrest), after he and his friends almost starved to death and his friends were killed by bandits 
Saparata
 decided to create Cindercrest to enact revenge on the "new players" of the server blaming them for the food and resource shortage. Despite that Cindercrest attacks also old players that are not loyal to him (contrary to their belief)



History


Cindercrest attacks 
Skymore Civilization
 along side 
ShoeBilly
 and kills all but 10 of their 1000 members, enslaving the survivors. 8 more of the survivors die.  

Zoe444
 escapes from Cindercrest. She leaves a set of clues for her friend 
ReinaDrop
 to find. 

ParrotX2
 and 
TheobaldTheBird
 return to Skymore with a handfull of guards but they find Skymore abandoned. 
ShoeBilly
 and his team blow the same horn that Parrot uses to signal the guards tricking them into riding straight into a trap. It is presumed that Shoebilly and his gang kill all of the guards Parrot brings to Skymore.

TheobaldTheBird
 kills 5 members of Cindercrest. he then fights 
ShoeBilly_
. 

Cindercrest gathered thousands of maxed out netherite players to march towards 
Spawn
 to lock it down. 
FlameFrags
 and 
ShoeBilly_
 were seen on its giant airship. This is because Lomedy likes Cindercrest.

After 
FlameFrags
 is recruited by Cindercrest, 
Saparata
 leads the grand Cindercrest army to Fort Feather. Their plan is to take over the training ground via an aerial assault using the giant blimp that they have. With almost no casualties they manage to take over the fort with relative ease. The army stationed there is overwhelmed and flees and many are killed. It is a major victory for Cindercrest but Parrot's escape tunnels allow most of his legion to escape in time.

Saparata says that to achieve victory Cindercrest should use the orbital strike cannons. He sends FlameFrags on a mission to get the cannons while the rest of the army regroups. FlameFrags fails to obtain the cannons from 
Wemmbu
 and 
Eggchan.
 Without the cannons the Cindercrest army marches to merchant city anyway. They see that Parrot has put white flags on merchant city and says that he has come to surrender. FlameFrags says that they should storm merchant city as 
Parrot
 is surrendering but 
Saparata
 sees it as a trick and orders another aerial assault using the blimp. Turns out it was a trick but the other way around as Parrot used reverse psychology to make Saparata attack from the air. When they drop down below with slow falling Parrot uses a special arrow cannon to kill all the Cindercrest soldiers dropping down and in the end only FlameFrags and 
Lomedy
 get down. Flame retreats from battle and sees that the Grand Cindercrest army has also retreated. It is a major defeat for Cindercrest and they lose the momentum they gained. Cindercrest also does not have as many troops as Parrot's kingdom and it is more difficult for them to obtain players.

Earlier, FlameFrags had said that Cindercrest should form an alliance with the 
Arachn1d kingdom.
 Saparata did not take this seriously then but after losing a major battle he reconsiders. He orders the Grand Cindercrest army to march towards Arachn1d's kingdom saying that he wants to make an alliance with them. FlameFrags starts to lose hope in Cindercrest but Lomedy is not swayed.

Saparata forms a alliance with the Arachn1d kingdom. After that he plans to march onto Highwater city. After the loss at merchant city Saparata asks a Cindercrest player to assasinate Parrot. He manages to blow up about a dozen of his guards and innocent people too but fails to actually kill him. Parrot tortures the player for information in which he tell him that Cindercrest is planning to take 
Highwater.


Parrot says that Highwater is very important since 80% of the food in his kingdom is in the city. If the grand Cindercrest army was to take Highwater it would mean that Parrot's kingdom would starve. He prepares lots of defences at 
Highwater.


Cindercrest attempts to take a path to Highwater which involves a bridge. FlameFrags and Lomedy talk Parrot. Lomedy says its Parrots fault for the fact that the people are starving. After the conversation ends about 60 of Parrots army delay the Grand Cindercrest army. They are almost overwhelemed but 
The LAW
 legion arrives to rescue Parrot in time. 

The LAW legion is eventually overwhelmed by The Grand Cindercrest army and the army marches to 
Highwater.
 Parrot prepares a defence involving a minigun and a huge arrow cannon which can decimate an army. He knows that if he wins the battle Parrot might win the civil war however 
Saparata
 is not stupid and has a plan.

Saparata has a conversation with Parrot in which he calls Parrot weak in almost every single way. Afterwards Parrot gives the order to fire the arrow cannons. The huge arrow cannons destroy the Grand Cindercrest army in minutes. Shoebilly attempts to take down the cannon but Parrot's anti air defence forces him to retreat. Finally only the last 60 members of the Grand Cindercrest army are left.

Saparata orders the last of his army (Including himself, 
Lomedy
 & 
Shoebilly
) to do one last suicide charge. While Parrot wipes out the last of the army FlameFrags comes in and blows up the anti air defence allowing Shoebilly to destroy the huge arrow cannon. 

Cindercrest's plan is revealed. They had planned to use their entire army as bait so that Parrots defences would be fully immobilized. Saparata blows his goat horn and Wemmbu & 
Yungyx
 come in. Wemmbu attacks the city with his orbital cannons completely destroying King Parrots army and the 
Arachn1d kingdom
 helps the remaining Cindercrest soldiers to wipe out the remnants of Parrots army. Parrot is helpless against Wemmbu's orbital strikes and with his army destroyed he, 
TheobaldtheBird
 & 
Reina
 all flee from the destroyed city. It is a decisive Cindercrest victory as now Parrot's kingdom has a chance to collapse from within and Cindercrest has also destroyed one of Parrots legions. 
Saparata
 gives a speech inviting all the old players of the server to unite under Cindercrest saying that they will "bring back rule to those who deserve it".

Ironically, between the two of us, You're more fit to be a jester than a king.



ClownPierce
 to

, in 
I Created the World's Largest Minecraft Army


ClownPierce
, also known as 
Clown
, is one of the two main antagonists (alongside 
Ashswagg
) of 
Unstable Universe
 
Season 1
. He is one of the secondary antagonists of Unstable Universe Season 2 alongside 
the Law's Elite Force.




Personality


ClownPierce has a reputation of being both ruthless and dangerous. He takes extreme measures to achieve his goals, such as relentlessly hunting down 
ParrotX2
 with the help of his team during the events of 
I Got Hunted by Minecraft's Deadliest Players
. He enjoys entertainment and often torments his targets with grand entrances or complex games, social experiments, and scavenger hunts. The fear and terror he inflicts onto the server have caused him to gain some notable enemies, with some people even going as far as creating entire alliances based on killing Clown. 

He is also known to have one weak spot (an "achilles' heel" as described by Parrot), that being 
Branzy
. He is also close friends with FerreMC, they care about each other’s life, but they don’t usually have to worry about each other because both Ferre and Clown are very skilled players. 



History


Season 1


PrinceZam
 pays ClownPierce to assassinate 
ParrotX2
.

Parrot
 and 
Wifies
 find ClownPierce in a carnival. This is where he plans to have a fair 1v1 with Parrot. Parrot and Wifies 2v1 ClownPierce. They get mining fatigue meaning that they can not break out and have to fight ClownPierce. 
Leow0ok
, 
Willsion
, and 
Woogiex
, enemies of ClownPierce break Parrot and Wifies out before they die.

ClownPierce follows Parrot to 
Wemmbu's Civilization
 and tries to kill him. He overhears Parrot trying to team with 
Wemmbu
. He starts killing Wemmbu’s villagers for information, but Wemmbu says he has no good information.

Wemmbu tells PrinceZam’s guards that Parrot joined the colony, and later a team of people with red and white trims begin trying to kill Wemmbu and eggchan. The invisible player is revealed to be ClownPierce.

Leow0ok agrees to put Parrot in an obsidian vault as bait for ClownPierce. Wifies decides to go with him. ClownPierce, 
FerreMC
, and 
Mugm_
 come over and try to break in and kill Parrot. A fight between people against and with ClownPierce ensues. The team against ClownPierce runs away. Wifies comes to his base and sees that ClownPierce blew up the terrain around it.

Parrot comes back and convinces Leow0ok’s team to help him kidnap 
BranzyCraft
, as he’s the only person ClownPierce cares about. They go to negotiate with ClownPierce now that they have Branzy. FerreMC comes back with Wifies as a hostage. Parrot agrees to let Branzy go, and ClownPierce lets Wifies go.

Parrot fights ClownPierce in a 1v1. He’s secretly made a trap with 30,000 TNT. Parrot is unable to kill ClownPierce with his trap. He discovers ClownPierce blew up Leow0ok’s team headquarters secret meeting room.

Parrot discovers a book in his house. The book says to meet him at specific coordinates, and it has been written by ClownPierce. He thinks this book might have the answers to why certain players have disappeared from the server. Parrot and Wifies go to these coordinates and find two players, 
Jaden_MAN
 and 
Spongs
, who call themselves the game masters. They state that for the quest, they can only use items that they give them, and they can not cheat. They go on a quest to get items, while 
Kierrrr
 and 
Its_Dev_
 hinder them. At the end, ClownPierce tells Parrot to put his spyglass in the item frame.

ClownPierce traps Wemmbu and PrinceZam in a prison, but Wemmbu escapes using an ender pearl cannon. The rest of the members remain.

Parrot, Wifies, 
Derapchu
, 
JumperWho
, 
_Kenadian_
, and 
Rekrap2
 are trapped by ClownPierce in a prison called 
Proton
. They eventually escape using a honey stasis chamber and outside visitors.

ClownPierce traps Wemmbu and PrinceZam in an escape room designed by 
Wato1876
. In the end, Clown states that he has destroyed all the ominous trial vaults, meaning that, most importantly, heavy cores and maces are no longer obtainable on the server. And the few left are the last and only ones.

Wato1876 goes to 
Skyblock Civilization
 to avoid ClownPierce.

FlameFrags
 gives ClownPierce a mace that he stole from Wemmbu. Clown gives it to FerreMC. ClownPierce is seen helping 
ashswagg
 in 
The Mafia
.

ClownPierce and FerreMC destroy 
ManePear
’s tree. Wemmbu and Eggchan escape by going into the nether. Wemmbu and eggchan agree to team with Parrot to kill ClownPierce.

Wemmbu distracts ClownPierce by fighting him while 
SpokeIsHere
 destroys the Mafia.



Season 2


We got mentioned about Clown first that it is known that he executed 
Verda
 and citizens of "mining town" because they resisted to tell where the 
Verdaria
 was.

It is rumored that ClownPierce claimed the entire Nether dimension as 
his territory
. He constructed a massive, highly-secured vault to store his wealth and began hunting any player who entered the dimension without permission. His goal was to create a monopoly over Netherite and other essential Nether resources.

ClownPierce’s growing monopoly eventually forced rivals into a desperate alliance. FlameFrags and Parrot (With 
TheobaldTheBird
) launched a high-stakes infiltration mission with dual objectives: FlameFrags wanted to make an assassination of ClownPierce in order to get information about Wemmbu, while Parrot aimed to breach and loot his secure vault. But, they had some kind of accident, and Flame betrays Parrot and Theo and tells Clown where their location is in exchange for Wemmbu's location.

They then went to location of the birds 
(Parrot and Theo)
 and while Parrot gets to escape, Theo is being captured. Parrot jumped down attempting to negotiate, but in result got captured also.

Clown apologizes and tells Flame that he knows nothing about Wemmbu location and proceeds to execute Parrot, but Flame accepts it and tells Clown that they'd have to get through him first, betraying him in result. Clown runs away to catch Parrot so his vault isn't ransacked leaving his army behind.

Some time later, Clown is met by Parrot, who came to request an order of 40,000 TNT to use to defend his kingdom from 
Cindercrest
. Clown, still holding a grudge against Parrot for raiding his vault, charges three times the price (60,000 diamonds up from 20,000). Parrot initially declines the offer, however Clown tells him that Cindercrest have already departed towards his kingdom, revealing that Cindercrest purchased goods from Clown prior to their conversation, and says they would stand no chance without potions, technology, or gear. Parrot reluctantly agrees to the deal and pays Clown the diamonds. Clown tells Parrot before he leaves that he is welcome to come back to him whenever he needs to buy more things, however warns him that if he comes back for any reason other than that, he would kill him.

CoinMonke, 
I Survived Minecraft's Most Corrupt City


CoinMonke
, also known as 
Coin
, is a supporting character in 
Unstable Universe
. He formerly worked as a guard in 
Capital City
. He betrayed Reddoons after the death of LuigiToan and escaped to the Far Lands. LuigiToans journal reveals that he and CoinMonke were friends before the events of 
Mining City
, and it is implied that Luigi told Coin about the Far Lands and they planned to escape together before Coin became a warden at Capital City. 



Personality


CoinMonke first appears as a rude and nagging individual, being in charge of collecting the diamond quotas in Capital City. He gives numerous amounts of threats to the workers, and is quick to burst at them when offended. He is strict and often belittles the workers if they are not producing enough diamonds.

It is later revealed that he heavily dislikes the thought of killing, unable to kill 
ParrotX2
 or 
LuigiToan
 during the roulette events of 
I Survived Minecraft's Most Corrupt City
. His pacifism lead to him being fired by 
Reddoons
, however CoinMonke returns to Mining City for LuigiToans funeral, showing how sensitive he can be. He also offers to assist in the uprising against Capital City, however, Parrot and Wifies insist on Coin going home because he had everything to lose. Despite this Coin stays behind to protect his friends, and while 
Dean
, Wifies, and Parrot were being threatened by 
Ashwagg
 and the 
Mafia
, CoinMonke pulls their stasis and helps them escape, showing how loyal and determined he is to stand for what is right.    

CoinMonke, although he was a minor character, had great character development, and was loyal to his friends after he realized how corrupt 
Reddoons
 was.    



History


LuigiToan and CoinMonke are revealed to be formerly friends in a book.

Parrot, 
Wifies
, and 
deanthebean9
 are forced to mine for diamonds for Reddoons in capital city and have to reach a quota of 10,000 diamond blocks. They find a group of miners with CoinMonke as the warden.

Parrot and his friends steal from Capital city vaults. Parrot gives 
PikaTM
 more than 3,000 diamond blocks so CoinMonke lets him free. Parrot gives more people diamonds he stole from Capital city for them to be set free.

Reddoons finds out about the people getting set free and sees that his diamonds have been stolen.

Reddoons makes it so whoever has the lowest amount of diamonds plays a game of roulette to decide if they live or not. Deanthebean9 and Parrot are tied for lowest. Parrot loses, but CoinMonke says he can’t kill him, as he doesn’t want to kill him. Parrot threatens to tell Reddoons that he didn’t do his job unless he helps them steal from Reddoons. 

CoinMonke tells them Reddoons plans to lock down all of his vaults.

Parrot overhears Reddoons talking to CoinMonke. Reddoons mentions that ashswagg suggested they kill people. Reddoons forces people to play a game which decides if they live or do not live. Reddoons rigs it so LuigiToan dies. CoinMonke refuses to kill him. Reddoons kills LuigiToan himself.

CoinMonke agrees to give the miners gear to steal Reddoons diamonds for leverage. The team gets caught. Reddoons gambles if they can leave or not. Reddoons lets everyone free except for Parrot, deanthebean9, and Wifies, even though he won his bet. Reddoons brings them to ashswagg and the Mafia. Ashswagg suggests they join the Mafia, but they say no. They try to force them to join, but CoinMonke activates their stasis chamber and they escape.

CoinMonke escapes to 
Far Lands
.

CoinMonke is part of a team that tries to break into the Tomb of the Mafia and is the only member who survives. He joins Parrot and 
TheobaldTheBird
 when they journey back to the closer end islands.

 just die, and I'm stuck here, and nobody ever trusts me again.



deanthebean9, 
Unstable SMP: The First War


deanthebean9
, more commonly known as 
Dean
, was a supporting character in Unstable Universe. Dean was a teammate of 
ParrotX2
 and 
Wifies
, and a former member of 
The Invisible Mafia
, Dean was portrayed as an unintelligent and relatively unskilled player. 



History


While Parrot and Wifies fly to create an 
End Civilization
. They notice an invisible player following them. They use the totem of the player revealing he is deanthebean9. Parrot and Wifies allow him to join the civilization. 

Parrot goes into the Mafia’s base to get rid of deanthebean9's stasis chamber. They are successful in getting rid of it. 

The civilization is eventually taken over by the Mafia. 

Parrot, Wifies, and deanthebean9 try to steal from Capital City. They are caught by 
Reddoons
 and five guards. Reddoons says that they each need to get 1000 diamond blocks. They try to escape, but fail. He says they now need to get 10,000 diamond blocks. 

They find a group of miners, with 
CoinMonke
 as the warden. Parrot and his friends steal from Capital city vaults. Parrot gives PikaTM more than 3,000 diamond blocks and he is let free for meeting his quota. Parrot gives more people diamonds he stole from Capital City for them to be set free. 

Reddoons finds out about the people getting set free and sees that his diamonds have been stolen. He triples the required quota. CoinMonke is fired. Using "the smugglers", Parrot and Wifies are able to get white wool. They break into one of the vaults using the wool, as there are sculk sensors detecting sound. They get in and steal the diamond blocks. Coming back to the mine, Reddoons catches them. Parrot and Wifies store all of the shulker boxes of diamonds in pots to not get caught with the items.

Reddoons figures out that they used the pots to store the diamonds. Reddoons makes it so whoever has the lowest amount of diamonds plays a game of roulette to decide if they live or not. Deanthebean9 and Parrot are tied for lowest. Parrot loses, but CoinMonke says he can’t kill him, as he doesn’t want to kill him. Parrot threatens to tell Reddoons that he didn’t do his job unless he helps them steal from Reddoons. They find a bunch of different locks in a vault, but luckily they are able to brute force through them by trying all combinations, and breaking the redstone. They realize they forgot to bring shulkers and leave. CoinMonke tells them Reddoons plans to lock down all of his vaults.

The miners overhear Reddoons talking to CoinMonke. Reddoons mentions that 
ashswagg
 suggested they kill people. Reddoons forces people to play a game which decides if they live or do not live. Reddoons rigs it so 
LuigiToan
 dies. CoinMonke refuses to kill him. Reddoons kills LuigiToan himself.

CoinMonke agrees to give the miners gear to steal diamonds from Reddoons for leverage. The team gets caught. Reddoons gambles if they can leave or not. Reddoons lets everyone free except for Parrot, deanthebean9, and Wifies, even though he won his bet. Reddoons brings them to ashswagg and the Mafia. Ashswagg suggests they join the Mafia, but they decline. They try to force them to join, but CoinMonke activates their stasis chamber.

Parrot and his team run away. The Mafia stops chasing them. The Mafia finds them underground and begin blowing up the area. They are able to escape. The team goes into the nether, and again, the Mafia finds them there and begins exploding the area. Using suspicious stew giving fire resistance, they go underground and escape to the overworld.

While boating, a Mafia member finds them. They manage to use the players totem of undying by exploding them with a TNT minecart. He is teleported to the void for not being invisible. While inside of an ancient city, Mafia members come in and begin exploding the ancient city. A warden spawns. They escape to the nether. After travelling a million blocks out, they find two players, 
R4trick
 and 
Finiahn
, who agree to help them cross an obsidian wall that is owned by the Mafia. R4trick says there are thousands of Mafia members.

Parrot starts destroying an iron farm, but the Mafia members find them destroying it, and R4trick runs away. They escape using invisibility. They loot a trial chamber, but find that all of the ominous vaults were removed. They hear people who are revealed in a later episode to be 
SpokeIsHere
 and his friends, and start mining out. They go to the nether to escape.

They go onto the nether roof with horses and begin making it to the farlands. The Mafia finds them and begins killing them. They escape to the overworld.

Right before getting to the farlands, deanthebean9 tells Parrot that he has been the reason the Mafia found them every time. Deanthebean9 leaves because he feels guilty.

Parrot finds deanthebean9 in a house, but Parrot still doesn’t trust him. 

Deanthebean9 joins the Mafia to secretly help Parrot and regain trust. Parrot goes to visit deanthebean9, but sees he isn’t there. Parrot sees a bunch of TNT bomber planes heading towards spawn. He pops the totem of undying of one of the Mafia members, revealing it is deanthebean9. Deanthebean9 is teleported into the void and dies. 



Trivia


The 9 in the username deanthebean9 is due to the fact that the first 8 iterations of "deanthebean" were already taken.


Dean held onto the goat horn that Parrot and Wifies gave him at the start of "The Search for Minecraft's Far Lands"
[1]
.

Deputy_Ace
, or Ace was a major antagonist in Unstable Universe. He is the secondary antagonist of 
The Kings Arc
 serving as 
LettuceK’s
 right hand man, alongside 
The Law Elite Force.




Personality


Deputy_Ace
 is a serious and loyal member of The Law, however he is shown to really question LettuceK's decision making and overall view on "justice." His views were shown when he opposed using an orbital cannon on the people of 
the Great Sea
, executing 
Wemmbu
, and assassinating 
Parrot
. 



History


Deputy_Ace is seen briefly in 
FlameFrags
 video 
100 Hunters VS Minecraft Combat Master
 as someone who sits at the desk and guards the prison. 

Deputy_Ace is confronts 
LettuceK
, informing him that all the lawmen are dead. Lettuce tells him that what Unstable needs is a king. 

Deputy_Ace along with 
loppezz
 take 
Wemmbu
 and displays him being captured to the entire server during LettuceK's speech. Ace, along with loppezz and LettuceK bring Wemmbu back to the prison however, 
SpokeIsHere
 splashes them with invisibility. Wemmbu later gets caught due to a player snitching on him.  

Deputy_Ace hunts down 
FlameFrags
 despite him being exiled. Flame outruns him and kills his horse. FlameFrags practices a new strategy he found with 
Lomedy
 and his farmers until he gets confronted by Ace. Ace fights FlameFrags and leaves afterwards, promising to bring more players. After he returns, his army raids Lomedy's farm and attacks FlameFrags. Flame is able to kill the army until they begin using slow falling. Flame loses again and Lomedy gets arrested by The Law.

He was present when Wemmbu arrived at The Law's Great Sea base to destroy the orbital cannon, however hesitated to fire the cannon which lead to it being destroyed, and ultimately chose not to pursue Wemmbu, allowing him to escape.  

Deputy_Ace sabotages the prison, allowing Parrot to escape. 

Deputy_Ace is instructed by LettuceK to kill Parrot and 
TheobaldTheBird
. He refuses, killing the other netherite Law soldiers, giving them the gear, and helps them escape. Deputy_Ace gives his pickaxe to TheobaldTheBird and holds off The Law. He is ultimately killed by 
SargeLAW
.  



Thumbnails




Trivia


Deputy_Ace is one of LettuceK's only two friends, the other being loppezz, as mentioned by LettuceK on a reaction of the Parrot Law Arc Finale. The rest of 
the Elite Force
 are just "coworkers."

Bro. We're in a cage, and you're saying this is good?!



Derapchu
, to 
Parrot
 in 
Escaping Proton: Minecraft's Most Secure Prison


Derapchu
 is a character in 
Unstable Universe
. He's a former member working for 
Spoke
 to take over the Unstable SMP, and a member of 
Bounty Assassin Team
. 



Personality


Derapchu is a sincere and funny character, he is loyal to his cause and dislikes people who disagree with his ideas, such as 
Kenadian
 or Spoke. He is incredibly loyal to Jumperwho and they have always been on the same team. He is willing to do what he needs to in order to survive, although he is willing to put everything on the line for his team. Since joining BAT, we see a more insecure and gentle side of him. He is insecure due to the way people often dismiss him and dumb and airheaded, although he admittedly is clumsy and gets into bad situations. He feels the need to overcompensate for his lack of general ability and the fact that he always seems to need saving, as well as various other factors. He is often overly apologetic even when no one is blaming him, due to the fact he is so used to being the cause of issues. This insecurity, though, pushes him to do better, which leads to him risking his life and saving 
ParrotX2
 from 
MrCube6
. 



History


Season 1


Derapchu is hired to be a guard of one of 
The Wonders
.

Derapchu is convinced to not let 
ParrotX2
 fire an 
Orbital Strike Cannon
. Derapchu later agrees to team with Parrot to build a new orbital cannon to stop an orbital cannon from destroying the Frosted Palace Wonder.

Derapchu is seen as a guard for Spoke in an end base.

Derapchu is 
chunk banned
 in an ocean.

Parrot and 
Rekrap2
 free Derapchu by destroying the chunk ban. Derapchu agrees to team with Parrot to break more people out.

Parrot and Rekrap and Derapchu go over to the next prison, which is built in a jungle. They start breaking into the prison. They manage to explode the chunk ban using a TNT cannon.

While travelling to the 
Zam Empire
, the server crashes. When they join, they are sent back to a previous save. It turns out that PrinceZam had added a new defense which makes it so that the server crashes when getting too close to certain locations. This is called a memory ban.

The team go to a nether prison, and try to break in. They discover that there are three chunk bans in this prison. They manage to destroy one of the chunk bans.

They move onto an ice themed prison. Using flying machines, they are able to free 
Fantst
. Fantst agrees to join their team to break people out of prisons.

They go to a sky prison. They are able to destroy the chunk ban.

Fantst chunk bans himself as he thinks that the prisons will just get harder and harder to break people out of.

They go to a new end prison and use TNT minecarts to destroy the chunk ban. The player released has no interest of teaming with them. The team goes over to the first end prison they went to, and easily destroy the chunk ban using TNT minecarts. The player freed is 
JumperWho
, who agrees to help them.

The team uses the nether to avoid the memory bans that crash the server. They find the prison that holds Spoke and Wifies and try to break in. They retreat back to a cave to plan an escape. They figure out how they can chunk ban the guards. They set up an underground chunk ban setup, and have JumperWho lead the guards to the chunk ban. They manage to chunk ban all of the guards. Parrot is able to get 
_Kenadian_
 to help them break out Spoke and Wifies using a wither bore. They kill the baby piglins which are holding chunk bans using flying machines and TNT minecarts. They are successful in breaking out Wifies. They also accidentally break out Spoke.

Derapchu is seen as a part of 
Leow0ok
’s team to kill 
ClownPierce
.

Parrot is sent to get a heart of the sea for a quest. This heart of the sea is Derapchu’s most prized possession.

Parrot, Wifies, JumperWho, _Kenadian_, Rekrap2, and Derapchu are put inside of a prison called 
Proton
 by ClownPierce. They escape the prison by making a honey stasis chamber and having Wemmbu give them contraband items.



Season 2


Derapchu joins 
Bounty Assassin Team


The Director
 hires 
MrCube6
 to assasinate Parrot by trapping him under the void. Derapchu finds Parrot and saves him. Parrot sees an invisible player sitting in one of the chairs.

Derapchu is trapped by MrCube6 on a pressure plate. Parrot and the team have to figure out which redstone lines to activate to save him and the entire base from exploding within a certain amount of time. MrCube6 also says that he sent a TNT bomber plane towards their base. They are able to save Derapchu.

Parrot sets up a trap and catches MrCube6. They trap him in a prison. MrCube6 manages to escape. MrCube6 steals all of the gear shulker boxes from the headquarters. MrCube6 gives these items to 
4CVIT
. Parrot and Derapchu take the shulker boxes of items back. A team of bandits try to steal from Parrot and Derapchu, but fail.

BAT finds MrCube6 and detains him. They interrogate MrCube6. They give MrCube6 a dandelion. MrCube6 escapes with a stasis chamber, but not before he gives Parrot a book. The book states something about a dandelion, implying that The Director somehow knew that MrCube6 got a dandelion.

Parrot finds a chest in his room with a sign saying to run. Inside the chest is two stacks of ender pearls and an invisibility potion. The 
BAT Headquarters
 go into lockdown mode, so Parrot uses an invisibility potion and hides. BAT tries to find Parrot to presumably kill him. Parrot flies away to make his own base.

BAT finds Parrot and claim that he’s The Director. Parrot runs to the nether. They find Parrot on the nether roof. Parrot manages to escape.

Parrot spies on BAT’s meeting with the help of JumperWho. JumperWho betrays him revealing his location. Parrot manages to escape during the chaos. 

BAT watches Parrot and The Director have a conversation, which convinces BAT that Parrot is not The Director.

The BAT headquarters is destroyed by TruOriginal who uses a hack to use other people's usernames and skins. TruOriginal tries to kill them. Leow0ok stays behind so BAT can escape. Leow0ok eventually escapes and finds BAT.

TruOriginal tries to kill them but eventually runs away. BAT make a new base and guard it. TruOriginal tries to kill them again. BAT lead TruOriginal into a trap to try and kill him, but he teleports Parrot into the trap, almost killing him. He is luckily able to escape. They pretend that they have a second trap and scare TruOriginal away.

Derapchu and Leow0ok are kidnapped by TruOriginal while they are sleeping.

Nufuli leaves the team, and as he is leaving, the Director kills him. They see the Director and try to kill him.

Derapchu is trapped in an obsidian box by the Director. He is later saved by Leow0ok who uses a happy ghast to save him.

Derapchu works as a guard in 
Paragon
.

District 13
 was a rebellion against 
The Invisible Mafia
 (inspired by District 13 shown in the Hunger Games).

It was founded by 
ParrotX2
, along with his allies 
Wifies
, 
Wato1876
, 
Kenadian
, 
TheobaldTheBird
, 
R4trick
, 
Finahn
, 
Derapchu
, 
Rekrap2
, and 
JumperWho
. It was built by 
Horace_Altman
 who later left the same day it was founded.

Later District 13 would be reformed to fight The Law and 
LettuceK
 with ParrotX2 and SpokeIsHere as their leaders. Horace Altman would come back to rebuild the base and it would be continued to use as the HQ of the resistance.



History


District 13 is founded by some the former members of Far Lands. After the main headquarters were created, Horace decided to leave and join the Mafia.  

Some district 13 members go looking for new people to add to the team, 
Parrot
 was suspicious of the person they found (Yusai) and killed the new member.

SpokeIsHere
 and 
Mapicc
 are added to District 13 as they find a book allegedly containing the coordinates of where every stasis chamber is stored. They go to the coordinates and find a new book appearing to be coordinates to something else. District 13 is disappointed as they believe the book is likely fake.

Everyone but 
Parrot
 and 
Wifies
 either leave District 13 or join the 
Mafia
 due to minimal progress.

Wemmbu
 and 
eggchan
 join District 13. 
Spoke
, 
Mapicc
, 
Wemmbu
, 
eggchan
, and 
Parrot
 break into the spawn prison where they force people to join the 
Mafia
. 
Wato1876
 and 
Kenadian
 help them. The team eventually succeeds in destroying every stasis chamber.

By the time of the Unstable SMP election, the former resistance base had been turned into a town by a small group of players. Parrot, Theo, Horace, and Fymada would arrive at the base seeking to use it as a staging ground for a rebellion against LettuceK and The Law, where they would ally with it's new inhabitants. Horace would restore the base to it's former glory, and with the arrival of reinforcements in the form of Spoke, Mapicc, Wemmbu, FlameFrags, PrinceZam, JumperWho, JadenMAN, MinuteTech, and other recruits; the District 13 resistance group was officially reformed and set out to defeat The Law in a final confrontation at the Northern Council. At the end of the battle of the Northern Council, District 13 would decide the fate of LettuceK allowing him to live however imprisoning him for life.



Trivia


Named after a destroyed district from the Hunger Games trilogy.


The alliance made to destroy The Law has also been called The Ultimate Alliance. It has also been called The Avengers (Not to be confused with 
The Avengers
 created by Jaden_Man)
