Plot


FlameFrags
 participates in a PVP tournament hosted by 
AJTHEBOLD
 to get another rematch against 
Wemmbu.
 The point of the tournament is to determine who is the strongest PVPer. Each fighter has 3 totems. If all of them pop they get their stasis pulled back into the lobby and get disqualified.

Flame first fights 
Willsion
 and easily beats him. Flame then watches other players fight including 
WyLL
, 
FerreMC
, 
Wemmbu
, 
Conexion
, and  
TheobaldTheBird
 which actually kills his enemy. AJ has 
Horace Altman
 clean out the arena. 

Flame teases Wemmbu by taking his shulker boxes and beating him up with his fists. Flame then watches Wemmbu fight Wyll which Wemmbu wins. Flame fights Ferre and gives a recap of Ferre's playstyle in fighting and his past. Flame beats Ferre and goes into the minigames to talk with the other contestants. It was there Flame realized the power of Theo's carts so he decided to go into 
Merchant City
 to buy blast protection. Flame then fights Theo and switches his netherite leggings with his diamond leggings with blast protection periodically to negate the cart's damage and switch back to his protection IV leggings to block Theo's melee damage. Flame wins and then moves into the finals.


Wemmbu and Flame begin preparing for their match. When the finals start, Wemmbu begins macing Flame while also using melee. However, it didn't take long for Flame to figure out his pattern and block his mace hits. Flame ends up popping Wemmbu's totem after comboing him. Flame taunts Wemmbu until he pops his totem by pillaring up and macing him multiple times. Wemmbu eventually ends up running out of wind charges and has to use armour stands + his wind burst mace to launch himself but Flame already knew he was going to do that thus avoiding him when he does that. Wemmbu's helmet and leggings break. Flame's armour breaks too letting Wemmbu pop his totem. Wemmbu's chestplate breaks and Flame shoots him, popping his totem again. Flame pops Wemmbu for the third time making him win the tournament. Flame begins teasing Wemmbu after he wins the tournament.

"My aura alone woke up the night."



Eggchan
, to 
Wemmbu
.
Eggchan
, or simply 
Egg
, is 
Wemmbu
's best friend and teammate on the Unstable SMP.



Personality


Eggchan is a composed and lighthearted individual. He claims his eye 'sees all,' but his render distance says otherwise. He always allies himself with Wemmbu and is one of the few people he trusts. When he's first introduced, Egg was originally a pacifist, claiming that wars can only produce more wars, but in recent episodes, he forgoes this sentiment in favor of the belief that 'sometimes death is the only answer.' He is generally distrusting and picks up on other players odd or sneaky behavior very quickly.     

Egg is more than willing to risk himself to save others that he trusts as seen in recent videos. He is usually depicted as the brains between Wemmbu and himself, although he is seen as a more unskilled and unserious player than his ally. He enjoys simple and calm tasks, such as fishing, saying that after he escaped Proton, he was going to go somewhere to fish for the rest of his time of the server. He opposes lying and advocated protecting the 
Snow Civilization
 from the Mafia, rather than using its citizens to advance Wemmbu’s training.    



History


Season 1


PrinceZam
 tells 
Wemmbu
 to do him a favor. He wants Wemmbu to make him 
a colony
 to help guard a vault he has. PrinceZam also tells him not to ever go inside. Wemmbu gets his friend eggchan to help him build this empire.

FlameFrags
 tries to kill them, but using a TNT minecart trap they are able to escape. Eggchan accidentally breaks all of Wemmbu’s armor.

A team of people including 
Jaden_MAN
 come and try to kill them. They are able to win the war against them using traps.

Wemmbu has a professional builder, 
Horace_Altman
 help build the empire. They invite a couple of people to the empire.

ClownPierce
 is seen chasing an invisible player,

Eight-Fold


Eight-Fold is a game on the Unstable SMP. It's very similar to Poker.

In this game, players are each dispensed two different items. Each item has a different point value, ranging from Dirt with 1 point to Netherite Ingot with 8 points. 

Players place bets on their victory. All players must match or exceed the bet of the other. Whoever has the best hand wins. Players can also fold, automatically losing the game.

title: Ender Pearl Cannon
content:
Ender Pearl Cannon
 is a mechanism to teleport player or entities to a specific location on the server. It is widely used on the 
Unstable SMP
.



Mechanism


Ender Pearl Cannon use TNT duper to provide momentum for aligned ender pearl and offsets velocity to determine target location. The pearl loads the chunks during travelling.



History


The Invisible Mafia
 used a pearl cannon to transport pearls from 
Spawn
 to 
Mafia Stasis Chambers
, which 
Spoke
 went through to destroy the stases.

Wemmbu
 and 
Egg
 were exiled to 
Great Sea
 through a pearl cannon after 
Jaden
 took Egg as hostage and forced him to clear his inventory.

Wemmbu traveled to 
Far Lands
 to retrieve mace from 
Sharpness
 through a pearl cannon built by 
4CVIT
. Later 
the Avengers
 went through the same pearl cannon to hunt down Wemmbu.

 escaped through an ender pearl cannon near 
BAT Headquarters
, and 
BAT
 followed them through, only to find themselves in a director-trimmed netherite zombie trap. 
Parrot

Theo
 to drain and corner 
the Invisible Knight
 and force them to use the same cannon in order to force reveal their identity.

Spoke
 went through a pearl cannon again built by 
4CVIT
 that leads to a lighthouse and 
JamatoP
's flowery mountain house near 
Far Lands
. 
Wemmbu
 went through the same pearl cannon only to find he go to the wrong quadrant of the Far Lands.

Jumper
 and

 to travel faster than

 and

 who had elytra or riptide trident to 
the Law
 base.

 and later destroyed by 
_x_6_00
 when Spoke and Jumper tried to forcefully go through.

Mapicc
 led Spoke and Jumper through an ender pearl cannon that leads near 
Far Lands
 when escaping 
Null Hunters
 but

 told them the target location was wrong so they had to find Mapicc and Revenant's camp in the Far Lands.

title: Escaping Paragon: The Perfect Minecraft Prison
content:
Escaping Paragon: The Perfect Minecraft Prison














Season


2






Episode


23






Upload date


June 28, 2025






POV


ParrotX2






Arcs


The Director Arc
 (finale)






Featured Creators (Description)


Wifies
JumperWho
Horace Altman














Hidden millions of blocks out on our Minecraft server, Paragon was built by my friend to trap me forever. And even though it's considered perfect, I promise that someday, somehow, I'm going to escape.





Escaping Paragon: The Perfect Minecraft Prison
 is the 50th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


Parrot gets trapped in a cell in a prison named Paragon. Wifies arrives at the cell to give Parrot some food. He then leaves after. Parrot had snuck some items and he used his fishing rod to pull Wifies away from his flying machine and uses a wind charge to get on it and he escapes the cell. However upon escaping Parrot realizes that there's way more to this prison that just one cell. Wifies tells Parrot that it's impossible to escape the prison and that when Parrot realizes they will build a world where Parrot doesn't have to worry about dying and Wifies doesn't have to worry about Parrot dying.

Wifies clears all of Parrot's items and after he realizes that he has one boat left, he tells Parrot to throw his spyglass. Parrot throws his spyglass out of the tower they were standing on and asks Wifies why would he want his spyglass. Parrot plans on killing Wifies after this. Parrot crafts a wooden sword and upon seeing Wifies he tries to kill him but after his totem pops he got teleported away. After this Parrot rushes to get the spyglass he threw because it reminded him of who Wifies used to be before he faked his death. Parrot then tries to escape by bridging to the walls, however, 2 guards splash him with slow falling and push him off the bridge. Parrot decides to check the nether as well, however, there was also a wall there. Parrot decides to explore the prison and he finds Wifies' house. He burns the house down. Parrot decides to build his own house and also go fishing until Wifies shows up and starts fishing as well. Parrot plans on making it seem like he is escaping to distract the guards.

Parrot goes to the nether to trade with piglins for ender pearls to set a stasis at his house and also make it look like he is trying to escape through the nether roof and as soon as the guards find out they stop him from doing so. After his stasis activates he celebrates by taunting Wifies and starts towering to the walls of the prison until Wifies shows up and tells him to get down before he hurts himself. Parrot tries to convince Wifies that he gave up and he doesn't care if it takes weeks or even months to kill him and escape. Wifies pretends to go AFK and when Parrot decides to try to kill him using dripstone but Wifies moves away at the last second.

Over the next few weeks Parrot and Wifies play minigames like Hide and Seek, Parkour and more. Wifies opens the wall to the outside world and tells Parrot to take a look at those dandelions. Wifies also tells Parrot how he knew about the dandelions from when Parrot and BAT had imprisoned MrCube. Wifies told Parrot that he had leverage over Jumper and that if she didn't listen to him, he would leak the identities of all of her spies. Wifies tells Parrot that if you could control something that someone cares about, you can control that person and that's why the guards work in the prison 24/7 and without them the prison wouldn't function. Parrot and Wifies patch up the hole. Parrot manages to trap one of the guards and it was revealed to be Jumper. Jumper tells Parrot that she was a guard along with Leowook and Derapchu and she begs him not to escape because Wifies will just reveal the identities of her spies if he does. Wifies falls into the room that Parrot trapped Jumper in and dismisses her. Parrot tells Wifies that they can still leave the prison and go back to spawn or far away from spawn and he eventually realizes that it wont work on him.

Wifies tells Parrot that he has been tracking his entire inventory and starts telling him every item that he has. Wifies clears Parrot's inventory again except this time, Parrot keeps the spyglass since Wifies is unaware of his spyglass. Wifies brings Parrot back to the same tower where the cell from the beginning of the video is except this time he takes Parrot to a chamber that looks similar to the one that MrCube used to try to kill him. Wifies clears out his entire inventory too and tells Parrot to step on a pressure plate. Wifies also steps on the pressure plate and tells Parrot that if any of them step off of the pressure plate, the TNT below them explodes and they both die. Parrot shows Wifies the spyglass and tells him why he didn't let it despawn. Wifies tells Parrot that he killed that version of himself and that he had to and shouts out the guards' and Parrot tells Wifies that he never gave up on Wifies and he hoped that one day he would snap out of it and become who he used to be. He even tells Wifies that when he gets out of the prison he won't remember him as the person who did horrible things and killed people but as the person he used to be. Wifies tells Parrot to give him the spyglass before he hurts himself and Parrot responds by saying "It's all yours" just like that one time when Wifies gave him the spyglass before getting chunk banned by Spoke and drops his spyglass to the pressure plate. After Parrot leaves, Wifies starts to look back at all the memories he had with Parrot back when they were friends and he starts running for the spyglass. After getting the spyglass the TNT blows up and he dies in the explosion. 

The video concludes with Parrot getting some food and blocks and leaving the prison.



Analysis


We learn how MrCube6 knew about the dandelion in the BAT's Prison dandelion incident - it was JumperWho, threatened by Wifies revealing all of her spies' identities.


We learn about the philosophical principles of manipulation and people owning.


The final act of Wifies grabbing the spyglass restores his sanity.


The blow of Wifies, holding the spyglass, has symbolical contribution to the plot - it represents the lost genuine point of their friendship.

title: Escaping Prison on the Unstable SMP
content:
Escaping Prison on the Unstable SMP














Season


2






Episode


65






Upload date


Nov 29, 2025






POV


Wemmbu






Arcs


The Kings Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


SpokeIsHere
PrinceZam
Fantst
Baablu
loppezz
LettuceK
Lomedy
















I have to escape before I am executed.





Escaping Prison on the Unstable SMP
 is the 92nd episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


It's been a week since 
Wemmbu
 was put in solitary confinement and 
LettuceK
 lets him out of his cell. While Wemmbu was waiting out his time in solitary confinement, he thought about his previous escape attempt and how Spoke bypassed the security, meaning there's a way to escape. As the next day start, the prisoners get their food and begin their new job of tree chopping. 
Loppezz
 instructs the prison guard to only give the prisoners one milk bucket to mine, but the guard is lenient and gives them more. 
Fantst
 tries to smuggle a bucket to Wemmbu, but loppezz catches them and tells Wemmbu to drop the bucket, and Wemmbu drops all but one. Afterwards, they get to the inventory checking area, 
PrinceZam
, 
Baablu
, and Fantst all go before Wemmbu. They anger loppezz to the point where by the time Wemmbu goes in, she is yelling at the others while Wemmbu secretly puts the cake back into the chest, making him appear to have more inventory space than he does. He drops everything except a milk bucket, some logs, and one cake. They go back to their cells and loppezz says she's had enough and is taking a break. When the lights go off, Wemmbu crafts a full set of wooden tools, a boat, signs, and trapdoors. He gets rid of the evidence and waits out the night. 

A new day arrives and loppezz says she hired someone to whip them into shape. 
SargeRaxby
 says they will be the future of The Law and leads them to a rec room. SargeRaxby stands on stage, talking about how The Law has lots of enemies and has to be strong. While he's talking, Wemmbu picks up water from a nearby pond. SargeRaxby then makes them begin their training, starting off with archery and brings Baablu and Fantst up first. Wemmbu talks to Zam using signs, saying they need to come up with an actual plan to escape rather than doing the same things over and over again. Zam says they'll be put in solitary again, but Wemmbu says it's better to escape, and they need to plan with Baablu and Fantst as well. Zam thinks they should leave the two, but Wemmbu says they all need to work together or else Lettuce will execute him. They try to break the sign, but the mining fatigue makes it too slow, so they come up with a plan while they can. Wemmbu tells Zam to take the blame about having the sign, and Wemmbu asks Zam if he has any invisibility in his ender chest, in which he doesn't. The sergeant catches them writing on a sign and scolds Zam while he begs for his life. Wemmbu gets Fantst and asks if he has invisibility potions, but Fantst says he doesn't know. The sergeant catches them and breaks the sign. They go to the next training area, which is a fighting arena. Wemmbu and Baablu go first, they fight until one of their totems pop, and Wemmbu ends up winning. While Zam and Fantst are fighting, Wemmbu puts down another sign and asks Baablu if he has invisibility, and he says he thinks so. Wemmbu then says they need to break their armor and asks Baablu if he knows where an ender chest is around here, but Baablu says no. As Wemmbu writes they need to scout for on, he's called up to fight Zam. Wemmbu ends up beating Zam, since Zam was already low on health. As a reward, Wemmbu gets to keep his totem. The sergeant doesn't item check them, thinking they don't have anything, and over the course of the next few days, the guards don't either since they assumed the prisoners thought escape was impossible. 

The next time they work, they're put into a wheat farm, and Wemmbu goes into the furthest corner and uses his water bucket to climb up the lights and get a few levers that activated the glowstone lamps. While walking through the prison, they find out the guard rooms have ender chests in them. When they get back to their cells, Lettuce brings a new prisoner, 
Lomedy
. During lunch break, Wemmbu writes to Baablu they need to get to an ender chest now, then tells Zam to distract the guards when the doors open. Wemmbu and Baablu are unable to open the door without a key access, so they take a button from the guards panel and begin placing it in spots where redstone may open it. Loppezz runs in from hearing all the commotion, Wemmbu and Baablu hide inside of the panel and sneaks past loppezz while the door is still open. They make it to the second level, but need to be cautious about the guards in the walls still. Wemmbu then comes up with the idea to pop his totem using fall damage to get rid of the mining fatigue. He breaks the dispenser that acts as the key reader, and places a button where it was to open the door just slightly. They make it in and find the ender chest, Baablu places down a shulker with invisibility pots when loppezz catches him. Wemmbu sneaks around, but is eventually caught by loppezz too. She makes them do an inventory check, Wemmbu manages to smuggle a cake, while Baablu smuggles in one invis pot. They're put into solitary confinement, and Spoke comes through a secret door, keeping his promise of coming back. Wemmbu tells Spoke to leave and that he didn't mean to get put back in solitary confinement. Spoke says the invis potion is the last key to Wemmbu's escape, and if they can keep it a secret between them then he can escape. Wemmbu still doesn't accept Spoke's deal, and Spoke says he needs him as much as he needs him, then teleports out.

The next day during lunch break, Wemmbu tells Zam they need to leave. Their job is to mine again, Wemmbu and Baablu dig a tunnel and get their helmet durability down to 1 and does it for the rest of the prisoners in secret. They all gather up in a tunnel and Baablu splashes invis. They try to break each others armor, but runs low on food and starts to get low. Lettuce overhears them talking about needing food, and catches them in their escape attempt. Wemmbu and Baablu dig out as Lettuce and loppezz blow up the area in search for them. They make it into a cave and digs up, Lettuce is right on their tail, they almost make it free until their hole is blown up. They're sent back to the prison and is forced to mend their armor. Lettuce then puts all four of them in permanent solitary confinement. Zam thinks they'll be in confinement forever, but Wemmbu says there's another way out and to just wait. When the lights go off, Spoke comes in and kills two guards. Before they can head forward, Spoke asks Wemmbu to accept his part of the deal, but Wemmbu still won't do it. Spoke says the blame of the guard's deaths will be put on Wemmbu's hands unless he agrees, so Wemmbu says yes. Wemmbu lets Baablu and Fantst out and they start to fight off the guards. They head to Lomedy's cell and get him to escape, but Lomedy says he's safe in there and will abide to them. Loppezz comes with a large army of guards, but all the guards die and loppezz manages to run off. They make it out of the ravine and onto The Law's main ground, and bunch of netherite guards show up, and the prisoners run. Wemmbu and loppezz face each other, and loppezz backs off when she gets low. Wemmbu uses this chance to escape since he wasn't able to do much more in that fight.

Wemmbu knows The Law will stop at nothing to execute him, he could've handled all of the netherite guards with the right resources, but he's missing his two fighting techniques, Elytra macing and orbital strike cannons. Wemmbu doesn't have enough power to destroy all of Law, so he heads back to the Farlands to obtain more orbital strike cannons.



Trivia


Wemmbu accidentally held out contraband, his boat, in front of SargeRaxby, but went unnoticed.


In one of Lettuce's stream, Spongs mentioned that he was supposed to be in prison and escape alongside Wemmbu, but he was unable to come to the recording in time.

title: Escaping Proton: Minecraft's Most Secure Prison
content:
Escaping Proton: Minecraft's Most Secure Prison














Season


1






Episode


15






Upload date


Aug 17, 2024






POV


ParrotX2






Arcs


The PrinceZam Empire Arc
 (finale, ParrotX2 POV)






Featured Creators (Description)


Kenadian
Wifies
rekrap2
JumperWho
Derapchu
Leow0ok
Wemmbu
Spongs
Rejoicin
Falcuno
Twirps
YouriBuilds
eggchan














This
 is the most secure prison in all of Minecraft. Nothing in here is certain except for one thing: if you get trapped, there's no escape. But I promise that someday, somehow, I'm gonna break out.





Escaping Proton: Minecraft's Most Secure Prison
 is the 15th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


After 
ParrotX2
 and 
Wifies
 arrive at 
Proton
, they find that the cell they are put in is rather large, with a hilly plains terrain and a river cutting through it. Directly across the hill they are standing on are multiple leafless cherry trees, which they immediately chop down and turn into slabs so they can scale to the build-limit-high crying obsidian walls with a broken green line that circulates it. They decide to stop at one of the green platforms, which Wifies steps on, getting him 
chunk banned
 by a fox ban. 

Parrot goes back down and waits until a guard arrives. He tries to convince the guard to free Wifies, but the guard doesn't say anything and ignores his request. He gives Parrot a pearl and leads him through a tunnel that takes him to a nearly identical cell to the previous one, but with red platforms and acacia trees. Parrot goes to an unfinished house with a crafting table and two signs that read "
if you can see this
" and "
jumperwho
 and 
derapchu
 were here.
" 

rekrap2
 arrives shortly after and tells Parrot that he was with 
_Kenadian_
 before he got transferred to the red cell. Parrot informs him that he was with Wifies, but he got chunk banned. He shows Rekrap the signs, and Rekrap explains that the prison is newly built and that it contains all of the missing players that Parrot was searching for. Rekrap informs him that before he was with Kenadian, he was with 
Wemmbu
, but he managed to escape before they started moving the prisoners. 

Rekrap asks Parrot what they were doing in the previous cell, and Parrot tells him that they were scaling to the top of the walls. They didn't manage to do so before Wifies got banned and suggests that they try again. While gathering materials, Wifies is freed, and Parrot tries to whisper to him, "Are you all good?" before crashing. Parrot attempts to message Wifies again, only to discover the same thing. He tells Rekrap to message him, which makes Rekrap crash. Parrot tries again, only to crash. Parrot then tries to type in the normal chat, butit doesn't show up in the log at all. 

Parrot and Rekrap go down to see if the walls reach bedrock, only to discover that they do. They scale the walls all the way to build height and find the two other cells that are connected to a central room, as well as an outer wall of one layer of obsidian. They go down via waterfall and Parrot almost falls to his death. They decide to write signs that say "
and Parrot ∋ and rek,"
 "
message from ∋ parrot and rek ∋∋ went to top --,
" "
saw three cells ∋ also small outer ∋ walls,
" "
red green blue ∋ cells. 2 ppl per ∋ cell. as of now, we think it is," "parrot, rekrap, ∋ wifies, jumper, ∋ derapchu, ∋ kenadian,
" and "
messaging is ∋ also banned for ∋ some reason,
" in front of Jumper and Derapchu's signs. 

Rekrap asks if they should scale the entrances which are curved to see if they can look through them. While scaling, Parrot talks about how calculated Proton is, especially compared to 
PrinceZam's
 prison. Rekrap discusses how there has to be a weak spot like the 
Death Star
 from 
Star Wars
, Parrot retorts, saying to look around. Rekrap retorts that he has to believe 'cause what else are they supposed to do. Rekrap goes mining while Parrot looks around. Parrot almost dies while wandering around which made them decide to make a wheat farm. Rekrap tries to discuss possible ways to escape a chunkban but Parrot can't think of possible ways to do so and neither can Rekrap. Parrot then decides to go mining while Rekrap gathers food, agreeing to meet back up in 10 minutes. When Parrot returns he doesn't see Rekrap but does see a guard who hits and gestures for him to get going. The guard gives Parrot a pearl, which Parrot keeps, then asks the guard if they want to use the bridge that he and Rekrap made, to which the guard agrees.

The guard then leads Parrot to the blue cell, where he finds Kenadian, with Ken confirming that he came from the green cell. Parrot informs Ken he was with Wifies first, then with Rek, while Ken informs him he was with Rek first, then Derapchu. Parrot is happy that Ken is with him because he knows what he's doing, to which Ken hesitates, saying that it's a lot easier from the outside. Ken then informs Parrot that there are rings of bubble elevators in the outside that can be seen just about when one builds high enough. Parrot then goes inside a wooden shack that has a sign on it saying, "
I am safe ∋ - Wifies ∋ - Jumper.
" Parrot and Ken then discuss the prison. Ken points out the three beacons and informs Parrot that they came from the control room, which means that there really are only three cells. Parrot then stops and asks Ken to repeat himself; Ken then pointed at the beacons, the ones coming off to the side. Parrot then leads Ken to the tunnel, discussing how Ken said the beacons come from the control room and how Parrot and Rek were discussing the possibility of a control room earlier. Parrot then grills Ken about making the assumption that the beacons are coming from the control room while Ken tries to defend his case. Parrot then interrogates Ken about the fact that he doesn't know anybody else on the server who's capable of making a prison like this, and that he doesn't know how Ken ended up in the prison, but that he wants Ken to be honest with him about whether or not they made the prison. Ken eventually relents saying that he may have in fact designed it and didn't inform Parrot 'cause he didn't want him to get mad. Ken then confirms that Clown hired him to design the prison but that he didn't know what he was gonna use it for. They then climb to build height and Parrot tells Ken that he doesn't care that Ken designed the prison 'cause it doesn't affect him and that it probably helps them because he knows the entire inner layout. And that Parot understands Ken keeping it a secret from them 'cause he didn't want them getting mad, to which Ken interrupts saying it wasn't just that, that with his knowledge of the cell their chances of escape was 0, that he patched so many ways to escape but that they can still try but that it's his knowledge against him and why he's pretty much given up and that it's nice in the prison anyway. Parrot then asks, "Is it though?" Ken replies "It's cozy." Parrot then tells him that if they don't try then they have no shot in the first place and that he wants to get everyone out, that he doesn't know how but he's gonna try but that if he wants to help then he's gonna have to be truthful 100% of the time. Ken agrees. They then go back to the shack to discuss the layout of the prison. Ken then informs him that they've modified the prison but that he'll try his best. Parrot then asks for all the information Ken knows, and Ken gives a rundown of everything he knows about the prison's design and possible courses of action. Ken suggests maps to distribute amongst the prisoners. Parrot then points out that the guards don't really patrol the inside of the cells and brings up the possibility of getting someone inside to bring an ender chest.

A guard arrives while Parrot gathers wheat and leads him to the green cell. Parrot finds a cobblestone shack with three signs in it that read "
rekrap and ∋ jumper,
" "
you can turn ∋ chunkbans on ∋ and off,
" and "
at least 2-3 ∋ different guards.
" Parrot finds Derapchu and catches up with him because of how long it's been since they last saw each other. Derapchu then informs Parrot that there used to be a lot more people in the prison and that Wemmbu was one of them, but he escaped. Parrot then tells Derapchu that Ken built the prison; Derapchu then exclaims that he hates Ken, but Parrot reasons that it's good 'cause he knows the ins and outs of the prison. Parrot then discusses how to spread messages between the prisoners using maps with copies of each of the cells. Derapchu and Parrot then go mining for redstone. Eventually they find some and test it out by having Derapchu place blocks that say "HI" and "YO" while Parrot sees if it shows up in his map. They then keep a number of maps among them and plan to distribute them by the time they get redistributed. They then see a guard coming and say their farewells.

Parrot then follows the guard, who leads him to the red cell, and along the way, Parrot guesses there's at least 2 or 3 guards and lists off what he's observed: one sprint-jumps the whole way, and the one who was currently leading him turns around a lot. When Parrot arrives, he makes a map and greets Jumper. Parrot then tells Jumper about their map plan and gives Jumper one. Parrot then discovers that the maps blank out after moving, so he makes a cartography table to hopefully fix the problem. They then test out various blocks they can use for writing and find out that diorite is the most legible. They then write, place, andseveral diorite blocks until it shows up on the map as a dot. They run out of diorite in the middle of it and go mining; once they have a good number, then they make a flat plane of dirt for the purpose of writing. Parrot then convinces Jumper to go into solitary confinement in order to expand the map. Jumper then goes to build height and pearls out in order to get caught by guards. 
Leo
 suddenly arrives at the cell as a visitor and asks Parrot what was up with Jumper. Parrot asks Leo how many guards took Jumper, and he said 3. Parrot feels bad because of how quickly the guards took Jumper, and Leo is upset at the fact his teammate got taken to solitary confinement. Leo asks Parrot for help breaking out his teammates, and Parrot agrees 'cause he was already planning to do that anyway. Leo then tells Parrot he needs to make a stasis chamber so he can come back later. Parrot then asks Leo how long he's waiting until he or someone else comes but is teleported away before he can answer. Parrot then makes a sign that says, "
Grab the maps in ∋ the chest,
" and hides it behind a wall. Parrot asks for a pearl to pearl into the tunnel, which the guard does give, but Parrot decides to go through the bridge instead to save his pearl. Parrot asks the guard where Jumper went, but they don't answer. Parrot hits the guard and hides; the guard slashes Parrot and takes out half his health.

Parrot is taken to the green cell where he reunites with Wifies, where they lament the fact that they couldn't talk with one another without crashing. Parrot gives Wifies a map and finds that someone in the blue cell has a map. Wifies then tells Parrot that, as he was transported, he heard a voice he's never heard before. Parrot tells Wifies about Leo wanting a stasis chamber made using honey, for which they would need saplings, and Wifies informs Parrot that the cells are large enough to spawn wandering traders but that they would still need to figure out how to get emeralds. Parrot opens his map again and finds that the person in the blue cell has written "...---..." (SOS) in their cell. They decide to reply with "EMERALD" (./--/./.-./.-/.-../-..), while the other person has also written "..-/--./---/---/-.." (UGOOD). They decide to leave it up for 5 minutes and go down mining to look for emeralds and find 3. They then resurface and take down the message. A guard then comes to get Parrot while he is in the middle of taking down Wifies' diorite structure. Parrot fails to pearl into the tunnel the first time and had to be given another one. While Parrot is crossing the tunnel, he hears 
eggchan
 ask if there was anybody there and to help him. Parrot tried to listen in on where eggchan was but was made to continue walking by the guard.

Parrot is back in the red cell with Rek and finds out he was the one who sent the code and that Rek has 6 emeralds. They then split up to look for the wandering trader, and Rek gives Parrot 3 emeralds. Parrot doesn't find anything and goes back to get bonemeal. Rek finds the wandering trader in the snow mountain who has a birch sapling trade for 5 emeralds. Parrot trades for one of the saplings and asks Rek if he heard "Wemmbu's friend" in the hallway, which Rek confirms he did, but that he didn't say anything back 'cause he was scared of how rough the guard was. Parrot then explains to Rek about Leo wanting a stasis chamber and that they can make one out of honey. They get a hive tree after the third attempt and attempt to get more. Parrot dives under the river to try to find sand but discovers there aren't any, but Rek informs him that wandering traders trade for sand. They then keep trying to get hive trees. Parrot realizes they'd need sticky pistons but don't know how to obtain slime. Parrot then makes a sign for the next round of prisoners that says, "
Shear trees ∋ turn into bonemea ∋ grow trees ∋ get hives.
" A guard then comes to fetch Rek out of the cell and into the green cell. Parrot sneakily follows Rek and the guard but doesn't cross the line and goes back to the red cell and goes back to the green one. Another guard then comes to fetch Parrot; along the way, he asks who is inside the cells and if he's allowed to go in there. Naturally the guard doesn't answer.

Before arriving at the blue cell, Parrot blocks off the guard with wooden blocks before seeing the diorite Morse code that Rek made and didn't get rid of. Parrot goes to Ken and explains what has happened so far and their plans to get stasis chambers. Ken then realizes that there shouldn't even be emeralds in the cells and that they might not have mined them all, which means they have a chance to get out, but it's still risky. Parrot then relays another problem: he wants to get everyone out, but Jumper is in solitary. Parrot then asks Ken how to get Jumper out, and the only thing Ken can think of is to take full control of the control room. Wemmbu then suddenly appears and asks Parrot if he has the stasis set up. Parrot is confused because it's only been 4 hours at this point; Wemmbu is confused because why would setting up soulsand and water take so long? Parrot then informs him they don't have soulsand. Wemmbu asks if they have redstone; Parrot confirms they do. Wemmbu then asks if they have slime; Parrot confirms they don't and that there's probably some sort of mob switch. Parrot then asks if Wemmbu only has 10 minutes of visitation like Leo did; Wemmbu confirms he does. Ken and Parrot then tell Wemmbu that he came to the prison for nothing. Parrot then asks if Wemmbu expected there to be a stasis chamber set up already, which Wemmbu confirms, to which Parrot says they need at least a couple more hours. Wemmbu then asks what they need; Parrot tells him they need honey and that it's set up in another cell. Wemmbu is confused about there being another cell; Parrot asks him if Leo told him anything at all, to which Wemmbu confirms he didn't. Parrot then explains that there are 3 cells and 6 prisoners and that they are being rotated around. Wemmbu then asks about Egg and Zam; Parrot is confused and asks what he means. Wemmbu explains that there were a lot more people when he was in the prison and asks if there were anybody aside from the 6 people. When Parrot doesn't answer, Wemmbu exclaims that they're wasting time. Parrot then explains that Egg is in a maximum-security solitary confinement chamber. Wemmbu then asks how Leo escaped. Parrot becomes confused and frustrated and asks what Wemmbu was even doing there. Wemmbu then explains that Leo just told him to go there and that they had a stasis chamber set up, that he went through the entire visiting process naked only to find that they've been bumming around and don't even have a stasis chamber set up. Parrot tells him to come back in 6 hours, but Wemmbu tells him that he isn't sure if they'll let him in again 'cause he had to pull some strings to even enter and that they most likely did not want him to be there. Wemmbu then asks why they can't just message him when they have one set up; Parrot tells him to try messaging him right now; Wemmbu crashes, of course. They go to the wooden shack, and Parrot tells Wemmbu how it is, that they're playing with time. Wemmbu interrupts him, saying they don't have time for a yap speech, and asks how much time they need. Parrot tells him 6 hours, and Ken contests the 6-hour claim, saying that he's being optimistic. Parrot then says the 6 hours is only for having the stasis chamber set up, not necessarily for having a plan of escape. Parrot asks Wemmbu if he wants to send a message of any kind to Egg; Wemmbu questions him about that since he's supposedly in solitary confinement, and Parrot explains he can talk to him through the walls. Wemmbu then says to tell Egg, "Keep it pushing, man." Wemmbu then confirms the stasis chamber is getting done in 6 hours, and he gets stasised away. Parrot and Wifies then confirm that not only do they have to build a stasis chamber in 6 hours, but that they have to ensure it doesn't get found within that timeframe. Parrot then decides to destroy the Morse code but gets interrupted when he sees a guard watching him for who knows how long before getting transported. While getting transported, Parrot keeps stopping, and the guard poisons him because of it. Parrot gets down to 1 heart and tells the guard not to hit him anymore.

When Parrot arrives at the green cell, he tells the guard, "You are a sad, miserable little guard." Parrot meets up with Wifies and tells him that the guards may be catching onto them because Rek didn't get rid of their Morse code and 'cause a guard saw the honey farms that they started. Wifies asks Parrot how long solitary confinement takes, 'cause he heard Jumper ramble, "Bro, this guy really made me go into the center for the map," which was 5 hours ago. Parrot then tells Wifies that the voice he heard was Egg's and that Wemmbu was arriving in 5 & 1/2 hours. They then go to look for wandering traders. Wifey finds one, but it didn't have any useful trades. Wifies hits the trader with an axe, assuming it would only get it low only to kill it. Parrot then proposes following Wifies while invis, and Wifies retorts that he'll just get caught when they come to fetch him. Parrot then says he just needs to relay the plan to Jumper. Parrot asks Wifies if he wants to get to the top since he never really saw it, and Wifies agrees. While climbing, Parrot says that he feels like he's lost all sense of time while in the prison, then falls but manages to water clutch. They find another wandering trader (without llamas) on the way back to the staircase that sells 8 sand for 1 emerald; Parrot buys 16 sand before realizing he also sells 1 slimeball for 4 emeralds. Since Parrot only has 2 emeralds left, he and Wifies go looking for emeralds. Parrot and Wifies managed to find 2 emeralds before the trader despawned, so Parrot buys 1 slimeball. Parrot doesn't want to buy anything else from the trader, so they decide to kill him but do so prematurely, preventing an item drop. Since they don't have an invisibility potion, Wifies jokingly proposes that Parrot disguise himself as a crying obsidian. Parrot then wonders if the chunk bans in the tunnels get turned off all at once or one by one; Wifies answers that it's more intuitive for it to be all at once. Parrot then runs down their plan again; Parrot follows Wifies using the crying obsidian skin and then goes in the other tunnel. He then laments that if he gets caught, he'll be put in solitary confinement. A guard then arrives to fetch Wifies, and Parrot follows them.

After Wifies and the guard enter the tunnel, Parrot puts on the crying obsidian skin and sneakily follows them, crouching and staying at the side when another guard passes by. Once the guard passes by, Parrot sprints towards the blue cell and builds up into the other tunnel toward the red cell, removing his obsidian skin halfway through. He then talks to Jumper through the floor and informs her that they found a way out; Jumper then asks if they can take her out first. Parrot then says that he thought she'd be let out in 30 minutes, and Jumper cries that she's been there for 6 or 7 hours. Parrot asks Jumper if she still has the map, and she confirms that she does and has been reading the Morse code. Parrot then says that they've found someone who can sneak contraband into the prison and that they're going to break into the control room to free her with the signal being ".../---/..." (SOS), which she can read through her map. Parrot then informs Jumper that they're not going to leave anybody behind and guesses that the netherite block will open when they get to the control room and that she can swim up using the water above the cell, which Jumper forgot about. Parrot then wonders if he's trapped because the two sides have chunkbans on them before a guard arrives who slashes and poisons him, then backs him towards the blue cell as Jumper says the code aloud, to which Parrot tells her to shut up. The guard then leads him into a solitary confinement cell located between the blue and green cells. Parrot heals himself with watermelons, then confirms that the calibrated sculk sensor strength is 12, meaning he can't make any sound aside from eating, walking, and jumping. He then looks at the map where he sees someone write the following code: "..../---/-././-.--" (HONEY). Parrot then paces around singing "10,000 Bottles of Water on the Wall, then humming, then calling out to see if there was anybody outside his cell, then says that he feels so bad for Jumper, then staring at the lava, then spinning his compass. Eventually a guard opens his cell and splashes him with poison, who he repeatedly tells not to hit him, before leading him into the blue cell.

When Parrot arrives, the guard drops a rotten flesh for him, to which Parrot says, "Ok, bro, you're real funny." Parrot goes down to eat the rotten flesh, then meets with Derapchu. Parrot then asks Derapchu if he's been in the red cell recently, and Derapchu says yes. Parrot then asks how much honey he's seen there, and Derapchu answers that he hasn't seen any honey but has seen 20 hive trees.  greets them, but they remain silent but greet crouch him.  asks why they want to escape; the prisoners laugh, baffled, and ask what he means by why they want to escape. . The civilization is later taken over by 
The Invisible Mafia
.

Fantst joins the 
Far Lands Civilization
 as a warrior. The civilization was later destroyed by 
The Invisible Mafia
.



Season 2


Fantst takes over the 
Ice Mountain Civilization
. He implants a bomb in the civilization. Fantst eventually blows up the entire base despite Wemmbu and 
loppezz
's attempts to stop him. Wemmbu tries to kill Fantst but fails as he runs away.

Fantst and Baablu try to duplicate ender dragons to destroy 
Spawn
 after Baablu convinces Wemmbu to revive the ender dragon while Wemmbu tries to get elytras to trade with people for items. Wemmbu and Minutetech try to kill Fantst but he runs away again.

Fantst, Baablu, Sharpness and a bunch of Wemmbu's other enemies chase Wemmbu down in the fartherlands.

Fantst is trapped in LettuceK’s prison with 
Baablu
, 
Wemmbu
, 
PrinceZam
, and Blurpinstein. He attempts to make an escape, success is unknown.

title: Far Lands
content:
Far Lands














Alias


Farlands






Status


Active






Info




Current Members


First Generation Players
Farland Zombies






Former Members


Horace_Altman
Far Lands Civilization
Ashswagg
ParrotX2
TheobaldTheBird
The Avengers
Wemmbu








Appearances




Appears In


The Search for Minecraft's Far Lands
Unstable SMP: The First War
Unstable SMP: Doomsday
I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Farlands
I Got REVENGE on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP
I Explored to the END of the Minecraft Farlands
I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Void
I Explored the Minecraft Farlands
Searching For 1000 Players Who Went Missing






Debut


The Search for Minecraft's Far Lands







The 
Far Lands
 is a terrain that "replaces the world border" and generates 12 million blocks from 
Spawn
. The more you traverse into the Far Lands, the more glitches occur, and more terrain is corrupted and deleted. The glitches are said to change a lot. The end of the Far Lands is the Minecraft void. There are many directions in the Far Lands; however, the one seen the most is the direction towards the 
Far Lands Civilization
 and SerpentBound's kingdom. 
PlanetLord
 says that he thinks that the player who first discovered The Far Lands was the one to make it such a mysterious places and generated all of these Biomes, glitches and exploits.



Places and Terrain


The Far Lands have many historical places and 
echoes
 which have been seen in many Unstable SMP episodes. These are some of the mentioned places. Direction is labelled after each place.



Ashswagg's House (unknown)


Ashswagg
 lived in a house in the Far Lands. He abandoned the house and lived in an underground base since 
the Invisible Mafia
 disbanded.



The Far Lands Civilization (+Z)


Main article: 
Far Lands Civilization


The 
Far Lands Civilization
 was one of the last resistance cells fighting against the Invisible Mafia. It had 3 districts to organize themselves and used beacon signals to communicate with other resistance cells. Its remoteness meant that other resistance cells could not help it when it was overrun by the Mafia. The final battle against The Mafia lasted a few minutes before the civilization was overrun and destroyed by The Mafia. Its ruins still stand as a memory of the terror of the Mafia.



 
 
 
 
The Far lands Civilization
 
 


The Far Lands Portal (±X, ±Z)


 
 
 
 
The Underworld Portal from 
I Explored the Minecraft Farlands
 
 


This is a portal in the Far lands which allows people in the Far Lands to quickly travel millions of blocks. The portal first leads to 
the Underworld
, where 
the people in the Underworld
 allow others to travel using the portals. These people are allied to 
JamatoP
, whom they seem to recognize. There are many portals spanning all the directions of the Far Lands. 
Wemmbu
 and JamatoP went from −X Far Lands to +Z Far Lands in 
I Explored the Minecraft Farlands
.



The Spikelands (+Z)


 
 
 
 
The Spikelands from 
I Got REVENGE on the Unstable SMP
.
 
 


This is not a very important place in The Far Lands, as the Far Lands has other terrain; however, it is important to the lore as this is the place where 
The Avengers
 were defeated by 
FlameFrags
 and 
Wemmbu
, and this is where the rivalry between Flame and Jaden began. Funnily enough, somewhere in this biome, there is an 
echo
 of a player named 
Burgle5
 who starved to death. 



The Cherry Grove (+Z)


This is also another overlooked aspect of the Far Lands; however, due to its natural beauty,p> 



 
 
 
 
 
The Zam empire echo from 
I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Farlands
 
 


This is one of the anomalies in The Far Lands, as a nexact copy of 
Zam Empire
 is found by 
Wemmbu
 and 
Eggchan
. There is also a real echo of FlameFrags and other higher-ranking members of 
Zam Empire
 before 
PrinceZam
 himself. There is no real explanation why this happens.



The Far Lands Temple (+Z)


 
 
 
 
 
The Far Lands Temple from 
I Explored the Minecraft Farlands
 (Cameo)
 
 


This is a place with the statues of all the first-generation players in the Far Lands. A first-generation player is a player who is wealthy and wants to be in the Far Lands. This is also where 
Lakerek
 was killed and where we first found out about the forge.



Serpentbound's Kingdom (+Z)


 
 
 
 
 
Serpentbound's Kingdom from 
I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Void
 
 


This article is about the golden kingdom in the void beyond Far Lands.  For 
Horace_Altman
's Civilization, see 
Far Lands Civilization
.



This is the most influential place in the Far Lands. It is owned by some of the 
First Generation Players
. After the death of 
Lakerek
, 
Serpentbound333
 became the highest authority in the kingdom, hence the kingdom's name. These players are very hostile to intruders, and they know about something called 
the Forge
 that presumably is a place to dupe weapon-related items and structures like 
maces
, bottles of enchanting and 
Orbital Strike Cannons
. During 
the Power Arc
, 
Wemmbu
 invaded the civilization for answers about the Forge. Wemmbu managed to kill some of the first-generation players, but they refused to tell anything about the Forge. Wemmbu ended up leaving without any answers and instead used the Orbital Strike Cannons near the civilization. In 
I Explored the Minecraft Farlands
 Wemmbu met some first-generation players again but avoided the kingdom. These first-generation players are very rich, so rich in fact that they had 3 double chests of maces and some of the only villagers on the server. This means that they can infinitely produce rare items such as experience bottles and mending books. They also have an unknown method of getting netherite that Serpentbound referred to as a trade secret (presumably related to the Forge). This is odd because the portals in the Far Lands don't work, and the select few that do only lead to 
the Underworld
. 
JamatoP
 also knows this kingdom and maintains good relationship with it. They may also have some kind of relationship with the underworld, as the Soul Keepers have a portal that leads near Serpentbound's Kingdom.



The Red Plain (+Z)


 
 
 
 
 
The Red Plain in 
Searching For 1000 Players Who Went Missing
 
 


The red plain is a biome covered with netherrack and crimson nylium and trees made of unusual blocks. It is where Revenant and 
Mapicc
 built their camp after escaping 
Null Hunters
. The camp had been looted by Null Hunters before 
Spoke
 and 
Jumper
 came. It has a tunnel to a flowery plain biome. It is one of the many biomes in The Far Lands and it also has a floating mineshaft in the sky filled with Lost Players. These Lost players are players who have been trapped in The Far Lands and they could be also referred to as Farlands Zombies. 



PlanetLord's Base and The Biome (+Z)


 
 
 
 
 
PlanetLord's Base from 
Searching For 1000 Players Who Went Missing
 
 


PlanetLord
 built his base in a biome with periodic, intertwined, and stacked sine waves of grass blocks. It had a maxed out enchanting table, tree farm, food farm and multiple other players. Its goal was to help players who get lost in Far Lands. It was later taken over by 
Null Hunters
. This base is in a weird, hard to describe biome and it was in the path to The Dark Forest.  



The Dark Forest (+Z)


 
 
 
 
 
The 
NULL
 Leader being trapped in The Dark Forest from 
Searching For 1000 Players Who Went Missing
.
 
 


Is a forest that is completely dark and torches can operate only in shorter-than-usual range. Nametags are hidden even without crouching here.  Because of the darkness having reinforcements here or allies is very hard and this is one of the most dangerous biome in The Farlands.  Spoke, Jumper and 
Mapicc
 managed to isolate Null Hunters and even capture their leader using the darkness. PlanetLord even said something about people being corrupted because of the darkness. The 
NULL leader
 was forced to lead them to a staircase that leads to Null Hunters' tunnels as well as possibly Null Hunters'  true leader. He seemed scared, for his rank and his life and also refused to continue (If he was seen with Spoke, he would have probably been labeled as a traitor) and was brutally killed. The staircase he led them to seemed to go infinitely down.  



The Fabric (+Z)


This is a biome that resemble Wifies's World that Doesn't Exist ARG series' thumbnails, with lots of tunnels inside a dark open space. It is on the side of the aforementioned staircase. It is possibly in the space between the Overworld and 
the Underworld
 due to Spoke exclaiming how deep the staircase is. Spoke, Jumper and Mapicc met 
Jamato
 in a torch-lit altar here.



The Road of Null (unknown)


Anticsparty06
 managed to offset the pearl cannon to the Road of Null before being killed and landed in the Far Lands. Therefore the Road of Null must be somewhere in the Far Lands, if not further in the void.



Inhabitance


In the Far Lands, you will most likely find 3 types of individual player entities. First, there are the 
Farland Zombies
, people trapped in with no clear way out, (Some of these players are just trapped from earlier adventures though majority have been trapped by 
NULL
) 
First Generation Players
, who are more experienced and richer "zombies".  
Echoes
. Not real players, just predictions of them that repeat over and over. Almost nothing is known about them, and finally 
NULL
 who patrol The Farlands and capture escaped players. (Farlands Zombies)

The 
Null Hunters
 is known to recently starting to take over Far Lands. This created more Farland Zombies who had to survive in the resource-scarce region or refugees like in PlanetLord's base. NULL, however is not invincible. Despite their resource advantage they can be killed like how a entire squadron was destroyed in The Dark Forest. NULL hunters in The Farlands are also less experienced and thus do not have Totems Of Undying that can teleport them since they usually fight players who have like iron armour and do not usually need them



Glitches and Mechanics


The Far Lands has many glitches and mechanics that make it a truly mysterious place on the Unstable SMP. These are some of the seen glitches and mechanics of the Far Lands.

This includes infinite repeating loops of past historical events. The main echoes that the Far Lands give home to include the 
Zam Empire
 creation echo and the First Generation Players vs Elder Guardian. Echoes, or memories, are repetitions of past events. They occur in the Far Lands as well as in 
the Underworld
.

Perhaps the biggest elephant in the room is the repeating patterns of the Far Lands. These patterns take existing structures, whether man-made or not, and make them so that they infinitely repeat. A few of the infinite repeating patterns include the infinite dungeon and spawner that 
Wemmbu
 and 
Eggchan
 looted, gaining over 64 enchanted golden apples. Another massive repeating pattern is the infinite array of 
Orbital Strike Cannons
. These are the very orbitals that Wemmbu uses to this day. It is unknown what creates a repeating pattern because it's not as though they only repeat naturally generated structures, but they also include the orbital cannons, which aren't natural. This implies that there are duplication glitches in the Far Lands, which would explain how the 
OG players
 got to be so rich in the first place, and are likely related to 
the Forge
. 
Sharpness
 also only went to the Far Lands to try and find a duplication glitch.

Another glitch is that of connection between 
the Underworld
 and the Far Lands, because when you use a nether portal anywhere but the Far Lands, it takes you to the nether, but when you use an existing nether portal in the Far Lands (you cannot build one), it takes you to the Underworld. This is interesting because it implies that there is a significant history that links the Underworld and the Far Lands together. 
Null Hunters
 can light portals in the Far Lands but not normal players. It is unclear whether these portals lead to the Nether or the Underworld.

A staircase was found to go infinitely down in the Far Lands. It is theorized to connect to the Underworld. It was in the Dark Forest.

Nametags are hidden even without crouching in the Dark Forest. But they do show in the staircase as well as in the fabric biome.

PlanetLord has said that the first person who discovered the Farlands generated all of these glitches. 



Trivia


The four protagonist have all been to Far Lands. The sequence of arrival is 
Parrot
, 
Wemmbu
, 
Flame
 and 
Spoke
.

title: Farland Zombies
content:
Intro


 
 
 
 
 


The Farlands is located 12 millon blocks from 
Spawn
 and is a weird terrain glitch that basically changes the world around it. But with it comes a problem. Back in the servers old days, the Farlands was not known to exist until players, trying to reach what should have ben the world border, found IT instead. The weird part about this is that the game did not get laggy as they pressed on with their exploration. They entered, explored and exited bringing the news to everyone they met. 





Getting Lost


As news spread many players went to the farlands to colonize. The great part about this was that, since the farlands was so far away, no griefers would try to bomb it. Many people went to build there to build their homes. Houses were built, towns were made, but then, players got too adventurous. They went too far and they lost track of how to get back. Since the debug menu (for seeing coordinates) was not working, as we saw in 
Wemmbu
's POV, people could not figure out how to get back, nor did they have the resources required to. They were stuck in a land with dangerous terrain and a glitchy atmosphere, thus becoming the infamous "Farland Zombies"*. 

*In order to become a Farland Zombie, our definition would be to have been in the farlands for more than 26,300 in-Minecraft Days, 7/8 of which cannot be with any social interaction. More than 1/8 social interaction is called a 
First Generation Player
.






 
 
 
 
Farlands Zombie BaguetteBattler8 (right) next to his house
 
 


The Life


Because of the size of the farlands, it is almost impossible to find another player. Most zombies only see a player once every 2 real life years, and most of the time it's just a random explorer who does not care about the zombie. Zombies usually live in cheap houses with little-to-no interior design. They survive only on farms they tend, for their sustenance. Usually, the farms are growing carrots or potatoes as they serve enough hunger points to survive. Items like netherite and 
Maces
 are one of the hardest items to obtain on the SMP, but in the farlands, a single diamond is worth more. The Farlands is a place where the 
needs
 are way more expensive and hard to find than the 
wants
. A Zombie has almost no hope of escaping unless someone helps them do so.  



Farland Zombie List (Confirmed)


BaguetteBattler8


Wemmbu found this player in "
I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Farlands
" when he was trying to retrieve one of his Maces from 
Conexion
. This was when he confirmed that Farland Zombies were real. 



Burgle5


Wemmbu found this player in the video "
I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Fartherlands
". This player was found in the ice spikes mega biome, and was actually an echo, a ghost player that has past



Players who have escaped Null Hunters


Spoke
, 
Mapicc
 and 
Jumper
 found players that have escaped Null in the Far Lands. Some tried to rob Mapicc, and others stayed at refuges like 
PlanetLord's base
.

FerreMC
, also known as 
Ferre
, is a character in 
Unstable Universe
. He is the teammate and righthand man of 
ClownPierce
.



History


Season 1


Leow0ok
 agrees with 
ParrotX2
 and 
Wifies
 to put Parrot in an obsidian vault as bait for ClownPierce. Wifies decides to go with him. ClownPierce, FerreMC, and 
Mugm_
 come over and try to break in and kill Parrot. A fight between people against and with ClownPierce ensues.

Parrot convinces Leow0ok’s team to help him kidnap 
BranzyCraft
, as he’s the only person ClownPierce cares about. They go to negotiate with ClownPierce now that they have Branzy. FerreMC comes back with Wifies as a hostage. Parrot agrees to let Branzy go, and ClownPierce lets Wifies go. ClownPierce and FerreMC find Parrot's jungle base and destroy it.

Wemmbu
 and 
Eggchan
 set up a job where people can hire them to blow up things. 
Woogiex
 hires them to blow up Ferre’s base. They find that Ferre has a secret tunnel system in his tower, so they go to investigate. Ferre catches him and Wemmbu tries to escape. He goes underground, and eventually Ferre leaves. Wemmbu and eggchan come back to destroy the base. They send three TNT missiles to destroy the base. They are able to destroy the base using TNT, and are able to escape by going underground.

ClownPierce puts 
PrinceZam
 and Wemmbu in a prison. FerreMC is seen as a guard at this prison.

FerreMC joins the Invisible Mafia and becomes the leader of the diamond players.

ClownPierce and FerreMC destroy 
ManePear's Treehouse
. Wemmbu and eggchan escape by going into the nether.

Wemmbu tries to kill ClownPierce and FerreMC but fails. FerreMC threatens to kill eggchan if Wemmbu doesn’t let ClownPierce kill him. Ferre fails to kill eggchan and they escape. They almost kill Ferre by breaking all of his armor. Ferre gives them a mace in exchange for his life to be spared. (Not without Wemmbu attempting to kill him until Eggchan convinces Wemmbu not to)

Wemmbu, 
Wato1876
 and eggchan distract ClownPierce and FerreMC by fighting them while 
SpokeIsHere
 destroys 
The Invisible Mafia
.



Season 2


ParrotX2, FlameFrags, and TheobaldTheBird take FerreMC hostage. He is eventually able to escape.



Trivia


FerreMC is confirmed to be part of a Nether Civilization consisting of ClownPierce, Mugm, and other powerful players who aim to monopolize resources only obtainable in the nether.


FerreMC is ClownPierce's righthand man.

Appears in

Debut

Latest Appearence


I Joined the World's Largest Minecraft Server (Wemmbu)








FieldsOfElysium
 is a supporting character in 
Unstable Universe
. He is the current ruler of 
The Wheat Kingdom
 and wields a mace.



History


FieldsOfElysium is seen in the beginning telling a hostile group to leave. When the group tries to resort to violence, 
Wemmbu
 steps in and threatens them with his mace. 
Yungyx
, the leader, flees. FieldsOfElysium thanks Wemmbu for the help and offers him bread which Wemmbu vehemently declines yet is given anyway.

Wemmbu is concerned for the kingdom's safety, which prompts FieldsOfElysium to tell him the story of an old protector they had that has since left the server, and owned a mace. He tells Wemmbu to look for 
LordSirWessley
, as he is the only person the hero told about the whereabouts of the mace. Wemmbu leaves hastily after FieldsOfElysium tells him the festival Wessley would be at would be ending soon. 

Wemmbu returns with the mace and gives it to FieldsOfElysium. The monarch thanks him profusely and offers him anything the kingdom has in return, including two horses, one for Wemmbu and the other for his best friend, 
Eggchan
.
