title: Finding 1000 Players Who Went Missing
content:
Finding 1000 Players Who Went Missing














Episode


130






Upload date


May 8, 2026






POV


SpokeIsHere






Arcs


NULL






Featured Creators (Description)


JamatoP
Mapicc
JumperWho
DylPickleYT
CookieBunsquat














It was always going to end like this...



Finding 1000 Players Who Went Missing
 is the 130th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.

Plot


Spoke
 recaps his previous episode where he went to the 
Farlands
, where it is rumored that thousands of players disappeared and was waiting to be found. If they wanted to bring the server back to peace, he'd have to act fast, as well as avoiding the people who've been behind all of this: 
NULL
. When Spoke, 
Mapicc
, and 
JumperWho
 found the deepest part of the Farlands, instead of finding the missing players, they found 
JamatoP
, who was behind it all.

The episode starts with Mapicc wondering how Jamato is still alive, Jamato brushs it off says that that's what 
he
 wanted them to belive but there's a bigger problem at hand, being NULL and the players. Spoke thinks to himself that Jamato returning felt off and it wasn't a coincidence. Jamato gives the three of them a shulker box with some gear, in one of the slots has a book with Spoke's name on it signed by Jamato. Spoke opens the book and it tells him that he'll never find the players and that Mapicc and Jumper will turn on him, and that if he tries anything, Jamato would reveal everything and put an end to it all. Jamato had blackmailed Spoke, he's unsure to why Jamato would do such a thing. However, the book was signed by Jamato, which would be his biggest mistake.

The four of them reach the exit, Spoke stalls and tries to get Jamato to go up first while Spoke gives them the book. Jamato "accidentally" picks up the book and gives it back to them. Mapicc reads it and says they got the same book, Spoke opens it back up and the contents of it changed, now saying to enjoy the kit and to stay safe. Spoke burns the book and heads up with them, as he goes up the steps, he picks up another book named "
Spoke_Log_Full
", in which Jamato had been keeping track of Spoke the entire time since he joined the server. Spoke knows Jamato is trying to use his past against him, and if his real intentions were to lead them away, he'd have to sabotage Jamato's plans. He burns that book too then speaks up and says they should look where they came from if they spent all that time going down, Jumper agrees and asks why they're going up, and Jamato says they're moving forward.  

When they get out of the stairway system, new terrain of terricotta spike-like terrain with bridges built across each from each other, and hundreds of villager houses cover the floor appear right before their eyes. Mapicc asks what bridge they should take, Jamato says NULL occupies most of the Nether and has thousands of players, so they can't take them all in a fight, but that they can't find the missing players without finding NULL. Jamato offers to take them to a secret back way to find the players. Spoke intervenes and says they can't take down NULL with just the four of them and that they should head towards the opposite direction to find more rebel groups to help them. Jamato says the numbers don't mean anything and that they're not going to fight, he then asks if Spoke doesn't trust him. Jumper jumps in and is on Jamato's side, believing they're getting closer. Spoke says it'll take time, but if this is their only hope, then he isn't willing to take that chance and decides to head north by himself. Mapicc is onboard, Jumper sounds unsure, and Jamato agrees to go with whatever plan Spoke has, telling him he's making a mistake under his breath. 

Spoke was curious to see what Jamato was willing to do to turn them back, but just as he has that thought, a Nether portal appears on the pillar right in front of them. They water downwards and try to keep heading north, more portals appear, which makes Spoke blow the bridges up to dodge them. The 
Null hunters
 chase after them and they're forced to fight them or knock them down. Although Jumper and Jamato thinks it's risky to keep going north, Spoke decides to keep on going and head towards the hunters and fight. They fend off the hunters and Spoke breaks their portal, Spoke starts bridging towards a new pillar as the Null hunters wait on top for them. Spoke pearls onto a bridge nearby, the hunters catch up and get him down to half a heart. The other three kill off a few more hunters, giving some time to traverse. More hunters show up, Spoke and Mapicc use knockback swords to knock the hunters off and kill them. 

Eventually, they find a new biome and they bridge towards it. As they enter Jamato tells them it's still not too late to turn back, they don't have to cross back on the bridges, but they need to head the right way. Mapicc says he recognizes this group because Revenant says a rainbow forest has a group of stacked players. Mapicc asks Jamato if he's been around here, in which he says he hasn't. Spoke is uncertain what Jamato even wants, one moment he uses his group to turn them back and the next he's okay with just following them. Little did both of them know, they were headed towards a trap. They go deeper into the biome and find a player towering up a tree, Mapicc wind charges him off and they clutch. They try to ask the player, chromesanctuary, questions, but they appear to not have a mic and they start running; they follow. A piston fall trap gets pulled, and Chrome asks what they're doing in their biome. Spoke tries to convince them they're good and that they're trying to work with them. Chrome doesn't believe him when he has full netherite and a Null shield. He then says they'll let them talk to their leader, and Spoke says he can try and explain what they're trying to do with the leader. Jamato says they'll take off their gear in order for to gain the Rainbow Forest's group's trust. The players let them out and lead them back to the surface, Spoke tries to tell them he's trying to save them, but Chrome says they love the Farlands and getting rich. They reach the leader of the group, DylPickle, who welcomes them to Pickletopia. He makes his group give them space and asks what they're here for. Jumper says they were taken by force, but asks for any gear if he has any, which he says all their gear is taken up. Chrome asks why he was willing to give them gear, and DylPickle tells him he sees they're good people by their vibes and puts Chrome in a cage. He says all the gear here is taken up, but there's a secret place with gear that he forgot where it was located, and so he gives Spoke a lodestone compass that leads to it.

They begin their adventure towards the stash, Spoke suggests getting the gear and coming back to camp to gather them all together to head into the Nether. Spoke mutes in-game and talks to himself, he questions what Jamato is trying to do and tries to figure out what his next play is. They reach a new biome, a red sand desert with fast ravagers spawning. As they go deeper in the biome, more and more ravagers spawn, their armor begins to break, so they tower up. They come up with the idea to use lava to kill the ravagers, which works wonderfully, and so they set off to find the stash. The compass starts to loop around, Spoke digs around while the other three distract the ravagers. He finds a ladder going downwards and goes down to see what it is first, he finds diamonds, golden apples, and enchanted books, and so he goes up to tell the rest of them to come down with him. As they go back down, the whole stash is cleared, no chests or ore blocks left. Spoke digs into the walls to see if there's anything else and discovers a tunnel behind one of the paintings. They follow down it and spot the Null hunters, who had just robbed them. They follow and dig to the hunters and begin attacking them. Eventually a hunter is killed, but the hunter's inventory shows no sign of taking anything from the vault. Spoke gets infuriated at the fact that NULL took it all and possibly followed them underneath all along and thinks something is fishy. He points out that Jamato hadn't fought the whole time and was watching. They mine out and say they're dead if they ever come across Dylan again, so they just don't go back to his camp without all his gear.

They dodge the rest of the ravagers and reach the edge of the biome, entering a mythical forest biome. They try to mend their armor with the little amount of sculk blocks around, but either it's not enough or they don't have mending. Jumper spots a river from afar, Spoke tries to make a boat from the nether wood out of the forest's trees, but Jamato came prepared and makes them boats. The four of them sail through the river and Spoke mutes and talks to himself again. He doesn't know what Jamato's game plan is still and no matter what he does he can't get away from Jamato. He thinks killing Jamato is the only way to stop him but doesn't have a way of how yet. Jumper spots a village nearby. Spoke suggests taking off any NULL related gear they have and to have Jumper be the one to talk to them without striking as a threat. The leader of the village, CookieBunsquat, welcomes them and mentions that if they came through the sand biome, they wouldn't have made it out alive. Spoke says that it was all Dylan's fault, Cookie says to never trust him since he just wants everyone dead. Cookie slowly walks closer to Jumper and says she used to be one of her 
spies
. Cookie looks at Spoke and says he looks familiar too and remembers that they have a file on him. Spoke brushes that aside and asks for help and for food, Cookie leads them to their wheat farm. Spoke says they were misleading a little bit and tells her their mission is to save the missing players from NULL. She's willing to help out and gives them basic necessities.  

Jamato asks if she has an anvil and she leads him into her house. Spoke watches Jamato from a distance, he makes an excuse of mining sculk to mend his armor and leaves. He goes out of distance from everybody else and gets an invis potion from his ender chest, he walks up to the window and spies on Jamato. He gets the idea of killing Jamato right then and there, he sees that Jamato isn't holding a totem out either. Spoke thinks it's now or never, so he runs back to the group and mine an ender chest for the obsidian. He creates a Nether portal and puts on the Null armor to pretend to be a hunter. He digs into the house from below and waits right behind Jamato. As soon as Jamato takes off his chestplate Spoke pots with strength and crits him out. Jamato pulls out a totem at the last second and stasises away. Jumper and Mapicc see Spoke and believes NULL is there. They attack Spoke and the rest of the village comes to kill who they believe is a Null hunter. Spoke pearls out the window and tons of Nether portals begin spawning all over the village. Jumper goes to assist Cookie, leaving Mapicc and Spoke alone to fight. 

Spoke tries to run away in order to not reveal his identity to Mapicc, but the fight leads to their armor breaking which makes it harder to survive in time. Spoke jumps into a huge cave and tries to riptide trident away using the water, but Mapicc is still able to catch up. With a minute left, he doesn't have enough time to run and hide his identity and, unfortunately for him, Mapicc pops his totem which gets rid of his invisibility. Spoke tries to tell Mapicc that there's a lot he doesn't understand, but Mapicc deflects and asks Spoke if he's insane. Mapicc says that Jumper was captured because of him. Spoke asks Mapicc if he understands that Jamato is the leader of NULL and that Jamato's been blackmailing Spoke since the very start. Mapicc says he's lost it and is ludicrous; he's the reason why they lost all their allies. Spoke says they need to make a portal and save Jumper, but Mapicc says he's not going with him and that Spoke can go take on NULL with half his armor by himself. Spoke tells him that this is exactly what Jamato wanted and that him and Jumper only follow orders and that's all they do on the server. Mapicc leaves and Spoke is defeated. He doesn't know how else to explain it to Mapicc, but he tells himself there's still a chance to win. With no food and millions of blocks out, there can't be anything worse than now. Spoke begins to reminisce about old adventures he had on the server: blowing up farms, being hunted by the 
Invisible Mafia
, his lava cast house. He didn't think it could get any worse. 

He comes across a dead end in the cave and looks up to a crack. He builds upwards and finds himself inside a maze. Spoke tells Jamato to bring his guards to take all his gear and everything. he begins to chide himself about how he could've rallied up Parrot's guards, could've then gone to Planet, to Dylan, to Cookie, and created an army of his own. He begins to realize he's going to the be the last person to know about these players. He starts to blame himself that these missing players are going to be missing forever. He goes upwards, but the top of the maze is entirely sculk. He drops back down to find food and immediately runs out of hunger. The Null hunters start showing up but they don't attack him. They only following him wherever he goes. He reaches a dead end and tries to get the hunters to back off, but they stand there. A Nether portal spawns right in front of Spoke.  

Jamato comes through and asks Spoke if he's even surprised to see him and that it was always going to end like this. Spoke asks why he did any of this. Jamato ignores the question and asks how many people are going to take the fall for him and that he keeps going and ruining everything and even killing him wouldn't be enough to save the world. Spoke asks why he took a thousand players, and that they can be real with each other now that they're alone without Mapicc or Jumper. Jamato says everyone deserves to make their own way, explore the world, make their own choices, but it always ended with Spoke; with death and destruction, and that's why NULL exists, to bring all the bad players to justice. He goes on to say everything he's done wasn't enough. It wasn't easy to capture Spoke, and not only that he survived, but he also managed to kill and to keep fighting and that he resents that. Spoke brings up the fact that he took Mapicc way before NULL started going after him. Jamato says he realized something after Spoke killed his soldiers; there was no point in capturing Spoke himself when he already had someone to do it for him. Spoke thinks that Mapicc was in on it the whole time, but Jamato says he sent a message to NULL to let Mapicc escape, and from there, he found Spoke and brought him right where he needed him. Jamato also brings up the fact that Spoke brought NULL to all the rebel camps, and that all the leaders of those groups are all in his hands. Spoke is devastated and says it was always going to end like this. Jamato asks why it will end exactly how it will, he says he owns the truth and can tell them anything he wants to, but nothing he could make up would be better than what Spoke did to himself. He'd ruined his own life better than Jamato could do. Jamato says he's done here and turns towards the portal, Spoke stops him and asks if he's going to tell them, and Jamato says the better question is how long does he think he can hide the truth. 

After he goes through the portal, Spoke breaks the portal and wanders off to try and find an exit. Eventually, he finds a white gateway, but he also notices Mapicc standing in the maze from a distance. He tells Mapicc the exit is nearby and they can leave. Mapicc says Jamato told him that 
Leo
 didn't try to kill him, it was Spoke, and that Jamato told him everything. Spoke tries to say that Jamato is trying to turn Mapicc against him. Mapicc says they could've roamed the server freely if he didn't try to kill Jamato, but Spoke wanted to have his pride moment with Leo and that he dragged them all back into this. Spoke says if he told them if he tried to kill Jamato, they would've turned against him there, but because of his decision they were able to go back to spawn and kill Leo. Spoke tries to convince Mapicc that they can explore the server still. He just wants to go back to spawn and leave. Mapicc puts on a new full set of netherite armor and says he's not going to let Spoke leave. Spoke asks Mapicc if he's insane. Mapicc says he got manipulated this entire time to be on his side. Mapicc pearls and catches Spoke in webs and crits him out. 

Alt
, the last existing piece of an exploted armor set, finally breaks after two years. Mapicc asks if he thought this was how it was going to end and what his goal was. Spoke asks if he wanted it to end like this. Mapicc says that Spoke just wanted to get away with it. Spoke wants Mapicc to kill him now that he has nothing left, but Mapicc asks where the exit is. Spoke points him towards the direction he came from. Mapicc says he's going to leave alone and suggests Spoke to live out in the Farlands or he can push NULL and die. Mapicc says something about if he ever sees Spoke at spawn again before getting interrupted by the Null hunters coming from a portal and jumping him. Mapicc thinks Spoke was behind this, he tries to fight back, but they're stronger and break all of his armor. They capture Mapicc and lead him into the Nether as Spoke apologizes softly. Jamato comes out of the portal. He says this is Spoke's legacy now, not as the hero he claims to be, but as the reason why all the rebels fell. He says if he ever wants to see Mapicc again, he'd have to drop everything on the floor. Spoke drops everything and Jamato burns it. He then forces Spoke to drop everything in his ender chest. Jamato burns that as well. Next, Jamato tells Spoke to go through the portal and says this is the end, not for the server, but it's a new era that would be better. Without 
him
.



Trivia


This is the lowest a protagonist has ever been having nothing in there inventory nothing in there echest and no friends to help them and being captured on top of that.


This marks the first time in a long time where a protagonist has nothing to their name.


The biome that the group emerged from the staircase is a direct reference to This episode referenced 
Wifies
' popular "
Destroying a World That Doesn't Exist
" ARG video.


People on Twitter have caught onto the fact that the reaction roles for Spoke in the Unstable Events server have decreased significantly. This could've possibly hinted towards the fact that Jamato was erasing Spoke from the server.
[
1
]


Another detail to back this up is that Spoke's name hasn't been mentioned by any of the other protagonist's in their videos in a while either
[
2
]
, but all three other protagonists have been mentioning or seeing each other almost every video.


At around 24:41, 
JamatoP's
 name is shown as "JamatoB".


When Spoke was looking at Jamato through the window, a flower pot with a rose could also be seen, which could be said to be 
iMajesticRose
, showing the two players that have "ruined" Spoke's life on the server.
[
3
]


Spoke is the third and possibly last protagonist to have their ender chest cleared, not counting 
Parrot
, as Parrot has not used an ender chest since 
Season 1
.

Wemmbu's ender chest was cleared in 
I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Farlands
 and Flame blew up the items inside his ender chest in 
SOLO Player VS World's Largest Minecraft Server
.


Spoke's legendary chestplate 
Alt
 was ironically broken by his former best friend 
Mapicc
, surviving 130 
episodes
 all the way from the very first one.


Another person on Twitter gathered the following information from a Mapicc stream about this video:
[
4
]


Spoke allows Mapicc to freestyle his lines in every video that he's in.


Spoke's pickaxe breaking was intentional.


Mapicc was watching Instagram Reels for a majority of the video.


Mapicc didn't hear Spoke say sorry to him when he went through the portal.

 was, and how they took most of the resources on the server. However, rumors say how the resources were never destroyed, but stored somewhere hundreds of thousands of blocks out in a tomb in the End dimension. Parrot and 
Theo
 head out to the outer End islands, and they both nearly drop into the void after entering an end gateway. They make it to the end of the first End rings, so they use a flying machine to travel the rest of the way there. Hours pass, and they get to a huge island filled with cherry blossom trees. The two follow the path that leads to a massive door. In front of the door has two hoppers, which means a key is needed to access it. Parrot spots players coming and both of them hide. Parrot notices that one of the players was 
CoinMonke
, one of his friends is part of the group that was trying to access the tomb too. One of the other players try to break the door down, but is suddenly given the darkness effect. An invisible player in full netherite with a quartz eye trim appears right behind them once the darkness wears off. The invisible player drinks milk, revealing themselves to be 
Marlowww
, Minecraft's best PvPer. The group is confident they can take Marlowww in a fight, having an advantage with players, but they quickly drop. Parrot and Theo decide to save Coin and run off the island.

Parrot, Theo, and Coin flies away from the island, heading towards an End station. They head inside, where everybody there is playing games and gambling. Parrot looks around, everyone stares back at him intimidatingly. Two of the people that were playing games begin to argue, and a fight breaks out, causing one of them to die. Coin lets Parrot run free and makes him talk to Rasplin. Parrot asks Rasplin for any hints on the tomb, but Rasplin wants to play a game of eight-fold for it. He says he has a key to the tomb, but Theo thinks he could be scamming. They play the first round, and Parrot loses. They keep going, with wagers going higher and higher each round. On the last round, Parrot has a good hand, and Rasplin wants Parrot to wager everything, his armor, totems, and shulker boxes in exchange for the key. Parrot wagers everything in and he loses. Then, the darkness sets in again, and Rasplin instantly gets killed by Marlowww. Parrot goes through an escape tunnel, but before leaving, he looks at Marlowww, and she's staring back at him. 

Parrot and Theo come back to the island where the tomb is located, Theo gives Parrot his Elytra since he has no armor. Parrot says they stand no chance fighting against Marlowww, and they only need to get the key from her. His idea is to lock the hoppers so the key can't be put in the hoppers and have Theo take it while Parrot shoots her away with a punch bow. Marlowww comes back to the island and they wait until she's gone to set the plan in motion. Parrot locks the hoppers and hides behind a rock to wait for Marlowww to come back. As Marlowww is coming back, Parrot is prepared to shoot and Marlowww is about to put the key in until she says, "Don't you know that I can see you right there?" Parrot, thinking his cover has been blown, hides behind the rock. However, it was another player was hiding nearby and Marlowww kills them. Marlowww then drops the key and Parrot manages to get the shot off, and Theo gets the key. They meet back at a lake where Parrot said to come to if they ever split off and lose each other. The two hide inside a cave for days until Marlowww leaves the island to enter the tomb. Days go by, and Parrot thinks enough time has passed, so they go and unlock the door to the tomb. 

Once inside, a huge elevator leads them down to what appears to be a huge maze. Parrot and Theo wander around until the darkness effect hits them. Knowing that Marlowww appears whenever the darkness effect is given, Theo tells Parrot to run. Theo says he'll do his best to fend off Marlowww. Parrot hides for a bit and comes back to the fighting grounds, with no trace of Theo anywhere. Parrot had a choice to either leave empty-handed, or try and find Theo, knowing he could still be alive, so he keeps going. Parrot finds a chest with all of Theo's loot and a sign written by Marlowww saying if Parrot keeps going, he'd end up dead like Theo. Parrot decides to keep going, and eventually makes it to the end of the maze, which leads to a massive cave with two invisible diamond trim statues in front of the door leading to the stash. Parrot walks closer to the door, and the darkness effect kicks in. Parrot flies away before the darkness wears off and before he's confronted by Marlowww. He stumbles into another part of the cave and explores further down. At the end, he finds what appears to be Marlowww's secret base. Marlowww has bookshelves full of books, using them to journal what happens day by day, and Parrot reads through them. The books show that Marlowww's best friend joined the Mafia and that Marlowww joined herself to protect her friend, the stash is set to kill any remaining Mafia members if any items were taken from it, and that Marlowww was never a monster, but only appearing to be one in order to protect her friend and anybody else. The last one reveals that Marlowww didn't kill Theo because he reminded her too much of her best friend, the two would protect their friends with their life. Parrot puts the book back, and turns around to see Marlowww. He realizes Marlowww isn't even and is only doing what's best to protect other players. Marlowww pulls a hidden lever that reveals the remaining ender pearl stasis chambers, then she walks away. Parrot apologizes and walks to the front of the door where the stash is located. He enters it, going down another big cave, and another door at the end of it awaits. He walks right through and finds the stash. There are tons of rooms, each built for specific resources. Parrot looks around, only to take nothing. 

He comes back up and reunites with Theo and gives all his items back. The two begin to head back, Marlowww watches them from the island and goes back to being invisible. Theo asks if Parrot found the tomb and how much he took, and Parrot said he took nothing and that he was wrong about Marlowww and everybody else. Parrot says he's done hunting treasure and that he doesn't know what to do after. He asks if Theo would come with him once he figures it out, and Theo happily agrees.

FlameFrags
, also known as 
Flame
, is one of the four main protagonists of 
Unstable Universe
 alongside 
ParrotX2
, 
SpokeIsHere
, and 
Wemmbu
. He was formerly one of the two secondary antagonists (alongside 
PrinceZam
) during 
Season 1
, being a high-ranking guard for the 
Zam Empire
, one of the formal archenemies of Wemmbu and 
Eggchan
. He was the most recent one to be added to the protagonists, uploading his own perspective only since the beginning of 
Season 2
. He was also a diamond tier 
Mafia
 member who refused to hold a mace due to a strong code of honor he abides by. 



Personality


Flame is a highly skilled and combat-focused player whose personality has largely centered around his pride in his fighting skills and fortitude. He has demonstrated capabilities to endure long fights and shows resilience and resourcefulness even in the face of impossible odds.  Thus, he's earned himself the title of being called The Immortal Demon. 

He can be condescending towards lower-skilled players, reflecting a confident attitude towards PvP. His self-worth is deeply intertwined with his title, causing him to stubbornly defend his reputation and taking on difficult challenges and fighting strong opponents in a constant battle to prove himself.  

He has shown great care for his friend, 
Lomedy
. Going great lengths to save him and their relationship. Flame struggles to show his emotions outside of battle and will sometimes prioritize a fight over personal relationships. He seems to be afraid of letting others get too close and then losing them.  

Flame loves dogs and builds 
machines
 to unleash their combat power.  



Gear




Relationships


Lomedy


Flame met Lomedy during his Solo Players arc when he was being hunted down by a toxic Minecraft civilization. After fighting some of their men, he began looking for resources and found Lomedy’s farm. He decided to use the farm as a base for resources, despite Lomedy’s refusal. While their relationship was rocky at first, Flame defended his farm and ended up receiving Lomedy’s trust, when the farmer gifted Flame his old teammate’s mace to fight the toxic players. After defeating the civilization, Flame returned the mace and left the farm.

Over the course of the server, the two would help each other out with various missions. Flame assisted Lomedy in the Farm War, and Flame tried to help Lomedy after his mace was stolen.

When 
The Law
 was hunting down Flame, they captured Lomedy and held him in prison to use as leverage against Flame. When Flame broke into the Law prison to free Lomedy, he refused to leave. He did not like that Flame was killing players and being needlessly cruel. It wasn’t until Flame defeated the Law and apologized to Lomedy that he left with Flame.

After the Law, Flame and Lomedy created a base in the mesa to live in together.



Wemmbu


When Flame worked under 
PrinceZam
, he was ordered to pretend to betray the Empire and attack Wemmbu. He raided his kingdom multiple times.

When Flame was in the 
Invisible Mafia
, he kidnapped Wemmbu’s best friend, 
Eggchan
, and took his mace.

Wemmbu fought Flame at his base. Flame won the battle and showed Wemmbu around his base.

Flame participated in a PVP tournament that Wemmbu also competed in. They taunted each other throughout and fought each other in the finals where Flame won.

Flame frees his friend, 
Jaden
, from an underground civilization. When Jaden reveals it was Wemmbu who trapped him, he worked together with a few other players, 
The Avengers
, to hunt him down in the 
Far Lands
. Flame tricked one of the players, 
Sharpness
, to give him a mace that he had stolen from Wemmbu. Flame betrays the Avengers and returns Wemmbu’s mace.

After being ordered by 
Spoke
, Flame goes to an abandoned mafia outpost where he finds Wemmbu. Wemmbu fights him using orbital strike canons, defeating him and making him run from the fight. Flame vowed to get revenge.

Someone tells Flame that Wemmbu had died, but he did not believe it. He hunted down Wemmbu, protecting 
Boosfer
 who claimed to know where he was. He hunted down 
ClownPierce
 in the nether after being falsely told that he had killed Wemmbu, and eventually the teamed up with 
Parrot
 to unveil the Invisible Knight who they suspected to be Wemmbu. They trapped an Ender Pearl canon and revealed Wemmbu’s identity using dogs, with Flame insisting they have a rematch for the unfair fight they had previously. Wemmbu agreed, but they were interrupted by The Law.

The two put their fight on hold to hunt down the Law. They fought the Law’s army of 1000 players together. Afterwards, they fought once more, where Wemmbu gives up and tells Flame that he can be the Strongest Player.

Flame found out that Wemmbu had been imprisoned by the Law, and he was exiled from the server.

Flame and Wemmbu team up once again to fight The Law, along with Spoke and Parrot. They succeeded, but Flame attacked Wemmbu’s friend, Jaden, for stealing Lomedy’s mace. Wemmbu protected him.



ManePear


The two both worked under PrinceZam together in the 
Zam Empire
. However, ManePear betrayed the empire, which caused them to fight and seperate.

When Flame joined the 
Invis Mafia
, Mane fought against them. Wemmbu told Mane that he had fought a diamond player who did not use a mace, who Mane figured out was Flame. Mane managed to hunt down Flame and they fought, but Wemmbu and 
Eggchan
 interrupted the fight, causing Flame to flee. Mane tried to find him again, but Wemmbu didn’t tell him where he was.

When Flame was exiled from Unstable by the law, he sought out the masters of every weapon in order to become a master of Minecraft combat. For the spear, he found ManePear, who was living in a cave far away from the rest of the server. Mane trains Flame in exchange for Flame’s help at killing a group of players that had been annoying Mane.

When Flame was captured by the Law, Mane invaded the prison to rescue him, going against his former “lone wolf” persona.

You dropped TNT on me, you dropped wardens, and you had

Flame likes to say "bro", "like" and "dude" during combat.


Flame had a dog, 
Ashen
, who was regarded as an almighty god called the “Immortal Dog” by a group of potion masters. This reputation was earned because Ashen killed two players, however Flame says that says more about the players than the dog.


Flamefrags and 
ManePear
 are commonly known as the Blindfold Brothers.

Till we meet again, friend.
"
This article contains major spoilers from recently released episodes. Please proceed with caution.


"
The Ash Will Rise.
"
This article is unfinished or outdated by new episode info. You can help Unstable Universe Wiki by 
expanding it
.
Additional Notes: Page is missing information on every video since 
SOLO Player VS Minecraft's Deadliest Faction




History


Season 1


The PrinceZam Empire Arc


FlameFrags is seen guarding a castle in the 
Zam Empire
.

ManePear
, 
Sorhin
, and Flame attack Wemmbu and 
JamatoP
 in the latter's base, asking if they know anything about SpokeIsHere. After a short clash, they agree to take Wemmbu to the Zam Empire.

Flame is sent by PrinceZam to pretend to betray the Zam Empire and kill Wemmbu. Flame fails to kill Wemmbu due to a TnT minecart trap pulled off by him and his friend eggchan.

Wemmbu sees that Flame and Merffinn are trying to invade 
Roshambo’s Civilization
. Flame nearly kills Roshambo, but Wemmbu stops him. Wemmbu challenges Flame to a 1v1. He manages to get everyone in Roshambo's Civilization to evacuate, and then escapes using a stasis chamber.

The Zam Empire destroys 
Wemmbu's Civilization
. They trap Wemmbu in an obsidian box while Flame and ManePear fight, with the former being indignant over the idea of a traitor keeping the armor of the empire after Mane betrayed them to work with Wemmbu.



The Invisible Mafia Arc


After the Zam Empire falls, Flame joins 
The Invisible Mafia
 as a diamond player. He threatens to kill eggchan unless Wemmbu gives him a 
mace
. After successfully winning their duel utilizing slow falling and his superior skill in sword PvP, he gives the mace to 
ClownPierce
.

Flame kills 
Dimofyy
 after trapping Parrot and a few members of the 
Warriors District
.



Season 2


The Toxic War Arc


After the mafia falls, he retreats to live by himself in a base he constructed, but is constantly harassed by bandits. Three players try to trap him at his base but fail. He kills all of the players. A team of players including SpokeIsHere try to kill him. Flame finds one of the bandits' base, kills them, and steals their netherite sword.

A team of players try to steal from Flame despite 
TheobaldTheBird
, their leader, telling them not to. Flame kills them. Flame travels to 
Merchant City
 to trade for gear. While he is leaving, a team of players from 
Bounty Assassin Team
 try to kill him. They fail to kill him and run away.

Wemmbu tries to kill Flame at his base at spawn. They eventually stop fighting. Spoke and a team of players try to kill Flame again but fail.

A team of players destroy Flame's base. Flame kills most of the players, but one of the members of the team escapes. The team finds him again and manage to steal his netherite sword. FlameFrags is able to kill them by splashing a strength potion and using his fist. FlameFrags finds two of the members of the team at his camp, who mention a player named 
Razor
. FlameFrags kills them both. He picks up a lodestone compass from one of the players and follows it to a base.

Flame finds the leader of the team, Razor2gud, and tries to kill him. Razor says that he'll only fight him if FlameFrags uses worse items, such as not using netherite armor, weapons, and strength potions. Flame agrees to this, only for Razor to have his team try to kill Flame. Flame is able to kill all of them except for Razor, who escapes.

Flame finds a map showing the locations of every base owned by the team. He goes to a bunker to try and get materials for destroying more bases, and kills everyone there. Flame finds a team of players in diamond armor, including Razor. Flame kills their entire team except for Razor, who runs away again. While destroying the base they fought in, Flame finds another lodestone compass in a hidden barrel that supposedly leads to Razor's base.

Flbthp

multiple Invisible Guy(s)

them
.



History


This player has an elytra, and Mace, as revealed in 
Searching For My Friend Who Went Missing
. He was seen falling into dripstone placed by 
Wemmbu
, and when his totem popped, his name tag was revealed (while holding a Mace). He had the same armor and armor trims as the 
Invisible Guy
.

Even earlier Wemmbu had popped his totem, revealing his nametag for a split second before flying away and invising again.

Horace_Altman
, also known as 
Horace
, is a supporting character featured in 
Unstable Universe
. He is the current mayor of 
Newtopia
. He is also an important helper for 
Unstable Universe
 videos behind the scenes.



Personality


Horace is hardworking and relatively friendly. He is an incredibly talented builder and built 
Wemmbu's Civilization
, 
The End Civilization
, 
Capital City
, 
Skyblock Civilization
, 
District 13
 and 
Eggchan's Civilization
. He has a deadpan sense of humor and often tries to stay out of conflict due to him being a builder and not PvP oriented. 

He also takes a lot of pride in his building, and is very upset when his civilizations get destroyed. He holds a grudge against 
the Invisible Mafia
, claiming he knows them very well because they keep destroying his builds. He also holds a slight grudge against 
Parrot
, when he remarks several times about the fact Parrot promised that the End Civilization would not be destroyed, which turned out to be false.  He has been an incredibly helpful player at several points in the story and is in general very dedicated and generous. Unfortunately he joined the Invisible Mafia due to these reasons, after helping Eggchan in the Egg Civilization. 



History


Season 1


Horace helps PrinceZam build the 
Zam Empire
.

Horace helps build 
Wemmbu's Civilization
.

Horace helps build the 
The End Civilization
. The civilization is later taken over by the Mafia.

Horace helps build Capital City.

Horace creates the 
Far Lands Civilization.
 Horace is the leader of the civilization. The Mafia later destroys the civilization. After the destruction of the civilization,

Horace joins 
District 13
. He later leaves District 13 and joins the Mafia because Parrot broke his trust saying that the Far Lands were never going to be destroyed.



Season 2


Horace builds a tower for eggchan in 
Eggchan's Civilization
. He is then recruited to Eggchan's Civilization.

Horace joins the election for ruler of Unstable SMP, and was kicked out of the elections in the second round of voting. Horace also befriends 
Parrot
 and 
Fymada
 while The Purge is happening.

He helps fight the 
The Law
 alongside 
District 13
 he gets many kills and votes to kill Lettuce.



Season 3


Horace builds a castle at 
Spawn
 under 
Parrot's
 orders for new players to spawn and get food while they are heading out into the server. 

Horace becomes the mayor of Newtopia.

 in

While his first real appearance was in 
I Created Minecraft's Greatest Civilization
, Horace actually appears on the tab list in 
It's Impossible to Catch this Player
 in spectator mode, which was likely not intentional.


Horace has been hired by both ChuckNasty and Sipover for videos regarding Unstable, and rather for their own videos.


He and his team actually creates most of the builds on Unstable behind the scenes. His minecraft account has a "Realms Mapmaker" official cape that only 410 people in the world have according to 
namemc.com
.

title: How I "DIED" on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP
content:
How I "DIED" on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP














Season


2






Episode


47






Upload date


Sep 27, 2025






POV


Wemmbu






Arcs


The Fake Identity Arc
















I got banned on the Unstable SMP.





How I "DIED" on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP
  is the 74th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


After 
Wemmbu
 faked his own death, two people learned the truth, 
Boosfer
 and 
Boomie
, Wemmbu killed Boomie and his next goal is to get rid of Boosfer. Wemmbu needs to stay anonymous to keep his identity hidden, he's unable to go to 
Capital City
 as the owner of the potion shop there, 
Parrot
, had started getting suspicious of him being invisible, so he heads over to 
Merchant City
. He talks to one of the merchants and they explained that valuable items were sold in the inner layer of the city, so Wemmbu goes over and speaks to other merchants, who tell him that potion ingredients were all out of stock and were waiting for shipments from the Nether. The ingredients are monopolized by a team of the deadliest players in Minecraft, making these ingredients harder to come by. The merchants at the portal tell him the shipment should arrive in ten minutes, which Wemmbu has enough invis potions to wait out, while waiting, 
FlameFrags
 comes by and waits for a shipment of ender pearls. The nether guards as well as 
FerreMC
 come to receive their payment and give the merchants the shipment. Hearing that pearls were high in demand, Wemmbu trades some in exchange for the potion materials and heads out, he quickly leaves Merchant City after using up his last potion and digs in a mountain to brew more as his invisibility runs out. Once brewing enough potions to hunt Boosfer again, he plans on going back to the End dimension to talk to 
eggchan
 and ask about Boosfer's whereabouts. When he arrives in the End, instead of being greeted with 
MinuteTech
, who usually protects the End dimension, he finds 
Salvationism
 there, who was also there to hunt for Boosfer. Wemmbu goes around the island looking for Minute, instead he spots players in the base raiding it, they claim that they defeated Minute and begins to attack Wemmbu, and he lets Salvationism kill them to keep his identity hidden. They look around the base and Wemmbu sees egg hiding behind leaves, who says they were the only people who have found him. Wemmbu asks egg what happened here, in which he explains Flame came asking for Wemmbu, but Minute wouldn't tell him, so they started fighting, which caused Minute to leave the main island and hasn't returned. Wemmbu tells Salvationism to look for anymore bandits as he asks egg for information about Boosfer, who is now teamed with Flame. Wemmbu goes to tell Salvationism he knows where Boosfer is and gets them to join along.

Although Wemmbu wanted to go alone, Salvationism insisted on bringing reinforcements in Capital City since they're the leader of the guard force over there. They go to a crowded part of the city to announce a mission, nobody stops to hear them out. The next scene shows Wemmbu, Salvationism and three guards heading over to Flame's base, one haven't ever been in a fight before. They spot Flame's base and Wemmbu devises a new plan, he would scout himself and tells the guards to stand back unless told otherwise. He spots Boosfer there all alone, he sneaks up close and Boosfer hears him and steps outside and spots Wemmbu. Boosfer asks why Wemmbu is attacking him and that he's guarding his secret from Flame. While fighting, the guards come charging in, which Wemmbu didn't tell them to do so yet, but Boosfer seemed to be struggling, so he stands back to let them finish the job. As that's happening, Flame arrives back at his base and Wemmbu instructs them to run. Flame kills all of the guards and lets Salvationism runs away before focusing on Wemmbu, he decides to run away from the fight since he's unable to use any of his signature weapons while in disguise. Thinking he's in the clear, Wemmbu mends his armor when Flame and Boosfer catch up to him, Wemmbu uses his riptide trident to get reach an ocean and actually get away this time.

Wemmbu heads back to Capital City and sees that Salvationism also managed to successfully escape from the battle and they walk further into Capital City, Wemmbu doesn't even know why he's there and says he's going to deal with it himself, but Salvationism says that they're going to build a void trap in the desert. They gather up more guards this time around and tells them the plan, they begin their journey back to Flame's base and make it to the desert biome right next to the badlands biome where Flame's base is located, Wemmbu goes to Flame's base to see if he's there so they can start building the trap. Wemmbu doesn't contribute to the trap and lets Salvationism and their guard force deal with it while he played Clash Royale. After a bit, Salvationism asks Wemmbu to come help as they're scared Flame would come anytime soon while Wemmbu was in the middle of a Clash Royale match. Salvationism tells Wemmbu that he could've helped with the hole, in which Wemmbu said he isn't going to help, but is taken aback by the sheer size of the hole. Salvationism shows Wemmbu the world eater and asks for his help placing signs so they don't get suspicious, Wemmbu doesn't care to help and digs in a hole and goes back to playing Clash Royale. After a while, the signs have all been placed as well as the sand on top of it, Salvationism asks Wemmbu to bait them towards the trap. 

Wemmbu goes over to the base and stands there, they ask why he's back, he pots up and targets Boosfer specifically. Flame asks Boosfer why he should keep helping him out and asks for leads on where Wemmbu is, Boosfer lies and says he'll tell Flame if he kills the invisible person. As soon as Flame jumps on Wemmbu, he riptide tridents out and towards the direction of the trap. Wemmbu runs into the trap zone and experiences a lag spike, Flame managed to save himself from falling into the trap using cobwebs, as Boosfer saves himself by landing on the edge of the trap. Flame begins to fight the guards, Wemmbu gets a few hits in before deciding to target Boosfer again. Flame starts to struggle and asks Boosfer for help, Boosfer is struggling himself but is still able to tell Flame where a small stash is located inside of the walls, which gave him enough gear to kill off the rest of the guard force as well as Salvationism. 

Wemmbu now being the only one alive, goes towards a waterfall and riptides up it, briding up and across the void, attempting to fishing rod Boosfer off, or using anything to knock him off in general. For the last time, Flame asks Boosfer where Wemmbu is otherwise he's going to kill him. Now out of the trap, Wemmbu and Flame fight each other while Boosfer spectates. Wemmbu asks Flame if he enjoys working for Boosfer, but he's only working with him to figure out where a friend is, and Wemmbu asks if Boosfer has given any proof of said information and that he's been helping Boosfer and killed off an entire army all for information that Boosfer may not even have. 

They both realize that they're fighting for nothing, Boosfer tries to push the blame onto Flame saying that they pulled the trap on Flame and not him, but Wemmbu counters the argument by saying he's apart of Capital City and that they only wanted Flame dead is because he's working with Boosfer and that they didn't have anything against him. Flame finally realizes that Boosfer has been lying about having leads on Wemmbu, and Boosfer says that he's closer to finding Wemmbu than he thinks. Wemmbu and Flame start to attack Boosfer, Boosfer runs back to Flame's base where he uses an escape tunnel Flame made for him. Dropping down, Wemmbu fails the clutch and pops a totem, revealing his identity for a second, he splashes invis again seconds before Flame drops down and fails the clutch too. Boosfer runs down the tunnel and blocks it off behind him, the two keep running down the tunnel, Boosfer runs out of blocks and tells Flame that 
ClownPierce
 killed Wemmbu last second before entering a Nether portal, Wemmbu tells Flame to break the portal with water as he pearls into the portal, which instantly sends him into the Nether. The screen turns black and Boosfer can be heard cheering as Wemmbu takes ticks of damage.

i sure hope nothing bad happens to this ice mountain





How I DESTROYED the Unstable SMP
 is the 43rd episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


The video begins with 
Wemmbu
 looting a trial chamber until 
loppezz
 calls him. Wemmbu gets startled and maces her until he realizes it's loppezz. Loppezz explains to Wemmbu that a team took over her ice mountain and she wanted him to help her get it back. Wemmbu gets into the ice mountain and attacks members of Fantst's team. Fantst says that if he keeps trying to kill his teammate he will blow up the ice mountain. Loppezz tells Wemmbu to stop because she tells him that they're not lying. 

Wemmbu and loppezz enter the ice mountain again but invisible. 
Fantst's
 teammate, 
homunculus1031
 spots them and puts them inside a cell. Wemmbu and loppezz annoy Fantst's teammate to leaving. Wemmbu tells loppezz that he cannot solve any problems without killing anyone. Loppezz insists that they try to defuse the bomb by putting water all over the insides of the base. While they are doing so homunculus spots them so they leave.

Wemmbu sneaks in to the ice base until a player spots him so he kills them. Homunculus gets Fantst to stop being afk and informs him that Wemmbu is back in the base. Fantst and Homunculus both attack Wemmbu and Wemmbu almost kill both of them until Fantst blows up the ice mountain base. Loppezz watches the explosion and feels helpless. Wemmbu kills Homunculus and right as he's about to kill Fantst he teleports away using a statis chamber. Wemmbu goes back to loppezz and gives her a full set of netherite armour before leaving.

https://x.com/i/status/1940451912140407244


There was an Unstable Event where players build Snow Civilization 2.0.

title: How I Escaped Minecraft's Largest Prison
content:
How I Escaped Minecraft's Largest Prison














Season


1






Episode


14






Upload date


Aug 31, 2024






POV


Wemmbu






Arcs


The PrinceZam Empire Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


ClownPierce
‪
PrinceZam
eggchan
FerreMC
Pangi
Kenadian
Spepticle
loppezz
SykerMC
dol9hin
LuckyMixx
_Tai
Twirps
Horace_Altman














trapped in a tiny world





How I Escaped Minecraft's Largest Prison
 is the 14th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


The episode starts off with a recap of last episode’s ending. 
Wemmbu
 and 
PrinceZam
 are kidnapped and forced into an obsidian box with no roof, containing a hyperrealistic world simulating normal Minecraft with the same biomes and features as the real game. They are each given three totems for their indefinite stay.

Wemmbu collects a bit of wood before Zam finds him and immediately starts attacking him. He pops all three of Wemmbu’s totems before he manages to escape. Wemmbu explores the world and gears himself up before 
ClownPierce
, their captor, announces that a few new prisoners are joining them. He heads to the place where he spawned in by an ender pearl cannon to kill the new players for their totems, but instead, 
Eggchan
 drops into the world. He says that he was with 
Pangi
, a former 
Zam Empire
 guard, during the security checks. He only has one totem, though. They build a trap for Pangi and get Wemmbu his totem. 

Wemmbu and Egg build a rough draft of a skybase in a corner of the world away from Zam and get themselves iron armour. They run into Zam, who has half diamond armour, and Pangi. Zam offers them to join the 
Zam Empire 2.0
, but Wemmbu declines, and they start fighting. Zam has a Flame and Power bow, and Wemmbu and Egg realise that they are extremely undergeared. They barely make it out alive and return to home base. 

Wemmbu dives underground to get diamond gear while Egg starts making a creeper farm for gunpowder. They want to escape the prison by using an ender pearl cannon because that was the method Clown used to get them into the prison, and that there are certainly 
chunk bans
 behind the walls. 

Wemmbu resurfaces from his mining excursion right in the middle of the Zam Empire 2.0. He investigates the empire and steals some semi-useful resources when he sees that Zam and Pangi aren’t there. He returns to Egg and tells him the news. They craft diamond armour and start fishing for enchantments. Egg catches a Protection III book, a Looting book, an Infinity and a Power IV bow, and other random enchants while Wemmbu comes up empty-handed.

Their fishing trip is quickly interrupted by Clown announcing that he will send a juggernaut into the prison to kill them. If they manage to pop his totem, he will teleport away and they’ll be safe. Wemmbu and Egg head to the Zam Empire 2.0 to negotiate a temporary peace treaty. Zam says that they can team up if they put the Zam Empire insignia onto their shields. Egg accepts but Wemmbu refuses, so they start fighting again.

The juggernaut, 
FerreMC
, Clown’s right-hand man, attacks them. They decide to team up anyway, and eventually pop Ferre’s totem, along with his helmet, with no deaths.

Wemmbu and Egg go back to building their creeper farm. They head to the Zam Empire 2.0 to spy, and see that Zam has obtained obsidian and created a nether portal. Pangi goes through and is chunk banned. Wemmbu tells Egg to get the obsidian with his charm, but he only succeeds in making friends with Zam. Seeing that Zam has obsidian, it won’t be long until he has maxed out gear from an enchanting table. 

Wemmbu and Egg head back to their dysfunctional creeper farm and realise that they need Zam’s help to fix it. Wemmbu jumps Zam in his villager trading hall and asks him to help with their creeper farm, as well as how he got obsidian and villagers, since there is no village or lava pool  in this prison. He says that he got the obsidian from a raid and that zombie villagers spawn in here. He agrees to help them with their creeper farm and form a temporary alliance. He tells them that with the amount of gunpowder they need (two and a half stacks), they could use an alternative method and just get it the old-fashioned way, by killing creepers.

They reach the creeper farm and Zam inspects it. He tells Egg to never use the tutorial he did again. The only advice he comes up with is to make it larger, since the spawn area is too small. They head back to the Zam Empire 2.0, but are met with a surprise. Clown announces that he knows about their escape plans, and that since a certain someone in the prison is so obsessed with 
orbital cannons
, he’d send them a little gift.

Not five seconds after, a ball of TNT strikes the Zam Empire 2.0. Multiple orbital cannon shots strike the base. Wemmbu digs underground to hide from the explosives. Once the detonations end, there is nothing left of the Zam Empire 2.0. 

Zam starts blaming everything on Wemmbu, that the entire reason he has nothing left is because Wemmbu came knocking on his door that day when he wanted Zam’s help to catch 
SpokeIsHere
. He not only blew up his first empire, but also caused the second one to be decimated. Wemmbu tells him that Clown wouldn’t let Zam kill him just to mess with them for his own personal enjoyment. He takes off all of his armour, and sure enough, Clown’s voice sounds again, this time announcing another juggernaut attack. 

Realising that now they have a bigger enemy to deal with, Zam and Wemmbu team up again for the time being. Since they don’t have Pangi to help this time, they decide to sacrifice some of their gunpowder to cart Ferre. Ferre soon arrives, and a fight ensues. After a while, Ferre tells them to pause and drop all of their carts, because apparently they aren’t allowed to have them. Zam distracts Ferre while Wemmbu charges up his bow and they pop Ferre’s totem from a cart. He is teleported out. 

Zam tells Wemmbu that he’ll leave them alone again if they don’t come bother him. However, their peace is interrupted when Clown says that there will be new prisoners joining them. They head towards the entrypoint and see Zam giving a speech to the prisoners, 
_Kenadian_
, 
LuckyMixx
, 
Spepticle
, 
loppezz
, 
SykerMC
, and 
Dol9hin
. He says that they will rebuild the Zam Empire, but shows no interest in escaping. Wemmbu tells everyone that they have an escape plan, and if anyone joins them, they can escape them as well. 

Wemmbu and Egg recruit _Kenadian_, a master escapist, LuckyMixx, and Spepticle to their team. They ask Kenadian what he knows about this prison, and he tells them that he doesn’t have an escape plan. They fill him in on their plans and ask him if it will work. He says that he doesn’t know anything about TNT mechanics, and that they’ll have to calculate the distance they need to shoot the ender pearl. They end up with about 350 blocks. 

LuckyMixx logs off and Wemmbu gears up Kenadian and Spepticle while Egg wanders about. He spots Zam’s team approaching and they prepare for battle. Zam attacks, but after exchanging blows, finally sees that Clown simply won’t let him kill Wemmbu, so retreats. 

Wemmbu and his team can finally work in peace, so Kenadian builds the design with redstone components, honey blocks, active rails, an anvil, and other components. He briefs Wemmbu and Egg on how it works: an ender pearl is thrown along the side of the honey blocks while the piston pushes them up and down. The rails are angled to shoot the pearl, and when a lever is flicked, the ender pearl will be shot by the exploding TNT across the chunk bans and to freedom.

Spepticle goes out once it’s night to gather ender pearls for all four of them and some extra TNT. However, as he is swimming up the water to the machine, Clown tells them that he sees their escape attempt and has to put a stop to it. He teleports the newcomers away through preset ender pearl stases and releases his guards into the prison to break the machine. 

The ender pearls that Wemmbu and Egg needed to both escape were with Spepticle, who is now gone, leaving them with only one ender pearl. Wemmbu reasons that the only way they can both escape is if they stall the guards until nighttime, then collect a pearl for Egg and escape. However, the guards arrive sooner than expected, and, knowing that only one of them can escape, Egg tells Wemmbu to go. They exchange bows and he gives Wemmbu his totem in case things go awry. Egg stalls the guards as Wemmbu crafts and sets up all of the TNT carts and the ender pearl, then pulls the lever.

The TNT explodes and the ender pearl flies out of sight, but nothing happens. Wemmbu falls to the ground and the guards immediately swarm on him. He tries to fight, but the guards end up popping his totem. Knowing that he’s probably going to be taken prisoner again as well, Wemmbu gives up and surrenders, putting away his weapon. Before the guards can take him away, though, everything goes black. 

The pearl flies all the way across the inner obsidian wall, through the obsidian spikes, through the chunk bans, through the outer wall, all the way to the other side. 

Egg messages Wemmbu that the guards have captured him, but Wemmbu quickly runs, away from the prison and towards freedom.



Trivia


People often mistaken this video as episode 15 and 
Parrot's video
 as episode 14 because Parrot's video was posted before this video. But Wemmbu has stated that his video comes first in canon.


The title of this video used to be "Can I Escape Minecraft's Largest Prison?", but was changed to the current title.

title: How I HUNTED the Unstable SMP
content:

Season


2

15

May 20, 2025

Featured Creators (Description)


WyLL_

Pro4D
Expchan
Wato1876
















assassins are hunting me please help





I Got HUNTED on the Unstable SMP
 is the 42nd episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


The video begins with Wemmbu looting the 
abandoned BAT base
 until he gets attacked by three players. One of them has a full set of netherite armour. The three players build an obsidian pillar and stand over it. Wemmbu realizes why they are standing on a pillar and holds his totem of undying to survive the arrow canon. Wemmbu runs away from the base but he decides to return just to spy on one of the players who attack him. The player goes on a mining trip so Wemmbu holds his pets hostage. Wemmbu kills two of his pets but gives him one of his dogs back only to kill the dog and kill him too.

The guy in netherite armour with emerald trims then attacks Wemmbu again. After escaping, Wemmbu tries to mace him until the netherite guy pulls his stasis chamber. Wemmbu goes back to the BAT base to continue looting it and get resources in case he gets attacked again. He then heads to another base until an invisible person starts wearing armour. The invisible player tells Wemmbu that he is about to die and blows up the entire base. Wemmbu survives the explosion and gets ambushed by two invisible players. Wemmbu kills both of them using the mace and gets a free set of netherite armour along with a lodestone compass.

The lodestone compass leads to Mafia City. The netherite guy with emerald trims along with four other people without trims. The guy with trims reveals himself and it turns out that he was Wyll the entire time. Wyll tells Wemmbu to move away from where they were standing and he blows it up. Wyll tells Wemmbu that he could trust him because he could've killed him but he didn't. He then gives Wemmbu a tour around his base (aka Ash's old castle). Wyll then tells Wemmbu to kill a player named Gigasigma37. He finds him in an old house in Zam Empire and eventually kills him. Wyll tells Wemmbu that he lied and traps him into the void. Wemmbu barely manages to escape using MrCube's void trap in the old BAT base.

Wemmbu returns to Mafia City and infiltrates Wyll's group and begins stealing their resources. Wyll notices something suspicious and decides to get everyone to drink milk to reveal themselves. Wemmbu  tries to kill Wyll. He pops his totem and Wyll starts mending. Wemmbu goes back into the old Ashswagg castle to steal more of their resources. Wyll warns his team that Wemmbu may be around until he notices that Wemmbu forgot to switch his shield. They jump him and Wemmbu manages to kill all of them using an arrow cannon and just as he's about to kill Wyll, he uses a statis chamber to escape.



Trivia


The video's original title was "How I HUNTED a Hardcore Minecraft SMP" before changing it to "How I HUNTED the Unstable SMP". As of current, it is now "I Got HUNTED on the Unstable SMP".

wemmbu
 becomes the hero.. kinda





How I SAVED the Unstable SMP
 is the 47th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


Wemmbu
 travels to a stronghold to go to the end to get elytras and sell them to get rich. Upon entering a stronghold, he finds out there are people living in there. He meets 
Baablu
 in the stronghold. As Wemmbu finds the stronghold, Baablu tells him not to enter the portal because someone is keeping it for themselves. Baablu wants Wemmbu to respawn the ender dragon but he needs end crystals. Wemmbu and Baablu set their stasises and head to the 
Wormhole Vault
. They finally find the end crystals in a stash and leave the vault via stasis chamber. 

Wemmbu goes in to the end and meets 
MinuteTech
. Minute asks why Wemmbu is in the end. Wemmbu tells Minute he has to respawn the ender dragon. Wemmbu attempts to respawn the ender dragon but Minute wont let him so he tries to kill Minute. During the fight, Wemmbu spawns withers to distract Minute. Baablu enters the end to fight Minute. Minute warns Wemmbu about what he's about to do but Wemmbu respawns the dragon anyways. Wemmbu helps Baablu kill Minute now that he successfully respawned the dragon until 
Fantst
 appears out of nowhere and begins attacking Wemmbu. Baablu reveals that he was just using Wemmbu to respawn the dragon.

Wemmbu and Minute head to the outer end islands. Minute explains that Baablu wants to respawn the ender dragon so that they can duplicate them and destroy spawn completely. Wemmbu didn't care about saving spawn although he did care about Fantst and Baablu being on the same team. Wemmbu and Minute realize they could've won the fight if they didn't waste their resources on fighting each other. Wemmbu and Minute get jumped by members of Fantst's team and they try to escape the fight due to minimal resources but they follow them. Wemmbu and Minute manage to kill all of them except for one. 

Wemmbu and Minute search for an unlooted end city and after travelling 100k blocks away from the main end island, they find 2 unlooted end cities, one of them with a ship. They loot the end city but they were followed by the same person who they spared due to lack of resources. They then get jumped by Fantst, Baablu and the rest of the team. Wemmbu and Minute get geared enough and they manage to fight them off. They head to the main end island and restock before returning and heading to the main end island.

They notice there are now 3 ender dragons. Wemmbu maces one of them and almost kills it. Fantst, Baablu and their entire attempt to kill Wemmbu and Minute. They kill some people in their team and pop all of Fantst and Baablu's totems. Fantst escapes along with everyone else who hasn't been killed in their team. Wemmbu goes back to the overworld now that his job is done.

title: How I SURVIVED a Hardcore Minecraft Tournament
content:
tournament of the strongest





How I SURVIVED a Hardcore Minecraft Tournament
 is the 49th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.





How I SURVIVED a Hardcore Minecraft Tournament














Season


2






Episode


22






Upload date


Jun 25, 2025






POV


Wemmbu






Arcs


The Power Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


FlameFrags
AJTHEBOLD
Loppezz
Epaxial
Willsion
FerreMC
WyLL_
TheobaldTheBird
conexion
Horace Altman














Plot


Wemmbu
 participates in a PVP tournament hosted by 
AJTHEBOLD
 to get another rematch against 
FlameFrags
. The point of the tournament is to determine who is the strongest PVPer. Each fighter has 3 totems. If all of them pop, they get their stasis pulled back into the lobby and get disqualified. However, elytra aren't allowed, giving Wemmbu a major disadvantage. 

The first fight is Wemmbu vs. 
Epaxial
. Wemmbu uses his mace and also pillars up above Epaxial to pop his totem with the mace. Wemmbu easily pops the rest of Epaxial's totems, disqualifying him. Wemmbu watches the other matches. FlameFrags wins against 
Willsion
, 
Wyll
 and 
Ferre
 win their matches, 
TheobaldTheBird
 accidentally kills his opponent, and 
Sharpness
 wins against 
Horace
 while using his fists.

Horace begins cleaning up the arena, but he is seen with a wooden pickaxe. Wemmbu gives him his pickaxe to help him. Wemmbu heads to the festival, where Flame begins teasing him. Wyll peers towards Wemmbu to tell him that he will be fighting him the next round. Wyll happened to be correct, as his next fight was against him. Wyll has access to stacks of god apples and slow-falling arrows, making the fight annoying for Wemmbu. After a few close calls, Wemmbu wins the fight.

Wemmbu watches the other matches, and everyone is dismissed into the festival. Wyll tells Wemmbu that he's going to fight Sharpness next and gives him advice on how he can win against Sharpness, along with telling him not to use any mace techniques against Sharpness when Flame is watching. They return to the festival, and everyone starts teasing Wemmbu.

The next match happens to be Sharpness, as Wyll mentioned, along with an ice arena. During their fight, Wemmbu notices that FlameFrags wasn't watching the fight, so he begins using some of his mace techniques against Sharpness. Wemmbu notices that Flame returned, and he stops using his mace techniques. Sharpness pops Wemmbu's totem. Wemmbu is now on his last totem, and if he wants to win the match, he will have to listen to Wyll's advice. Wemmbu wins against Sharpness. Flame also won his match, putting them both in the finals.

Wemmbu and Flame begin preparing for their match. When the finals start, Wemmbu begins macing Flame while also using melee. However, it didn't take long for Flame to figure out his pattern and block his mace hits. Flame ends up popping Wemmbu's totem after comboing him. Flame taunts Wemmbu until he pops his totem by pillaring up and macing him multiple times. Wemmbu eventually ends up running out of wind charges and has to use armor stands and his wind burst mace to launch himself, but Flame already knew he was going to do that, thus avoiding him when he does that. Wemmbu's helmet and leggings break. Flame's armor breaks too, letting Wemmbu pop his totem. Wemmbu's chestplate breaks, and Flame shoots him, popping his totem again. Flame pops Wemmbu for the third time, making him win the tournament. Flame begins teasing Wemmbu after he wins the tournament.

title: How I SURVIVED the Unstable SMP
content:
How I SURVIVED the Unstable SMP














Season


2






Episode


11






Upload date


May 3, 2025






POV


Wemmbu






Arcs


The Power Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


Eggchan
FlameFrags
Hexatope
Cave_
Mixiku
novagriddy
Pro4D
RecallingMan














elytra-macing is overpowered





How I SURVIVED the Unstable SMP
 is the 38th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


Wemmbu
 gets threatened by a player in iron armour while he has no armour while monologuing about how he wants to survive in a server where people are destined to become powerful. Wemmbu kills the player with his mace. Wemmbu and 
Eggchan
 mine for basic armour and materials. They attempt to find leather to make an enchanting table however they realized that mobs don't spawn in the server. Eggchan suggests that they find the base of the guy who threatened to kill Wemmbu. As soon as they arrive to the base, Eggchan distracts the people in the team while Wemmbu steals anything valuable from them. Wemmbu finds 5 leather and notices Eggchan getting robbed. Wemmbu grabs Eggchan and they run from them. Wemmbu kills almost everyone in the team but one of the members. Wemmbu gets so distracted at trying to kill the remaining player that all the items from the previous people they killed had despawned.

They head back to the village/base from the team they robbed from and enchant their gear. They head closer to spawn to get more books to get better enchantments. Upon their journey to spawn they find lots of structures that have been looted until they find a base that appears operational with stacked players in it too. Wemmbu spots cows in their base so they attempt to steal two cows from them. While doing so, Wemmbu and Eggchan make a base and try digging under the cow patch to steal two cows. The team's leader spots oddly placed cobblestone and they find Wemmbu and Eggchan. They all chase Wemmbu and he eventually kills one of them. He uses their weakest member as leverage to get them to stop trying to kill him. Wemmbu steals some of the books in their enchanting table and they start trying to kill him again. The team is fed up on the leader forcing them to follow his orders so they decide to kill him instead of Wemmbu.

Eggchan tells Wemmbu to stop risking himself doing other things instead of achieving their goals. He tells Wemmbu he won't watch his rematch against 
FlameFrags
 because he's leaving to focus on his studies and gives Wemmbu his armour, elytra and rockets before logging off. 

Wemmbu returns to the base ready to wipe out the entire team and notices them hosting a funeral for their leader and expressing how much they hate him. He then kills everyone else in the team and loots the entire base. 

Wemmbu enters Flame's house and tells him that he wants a rematch since 
he lost to him the last time they fought
. Wemmbu's totem pops as FlameFrags combos him but he goes to a more open space and starts macing Flame. Wemmbu breaks Flame's shield and almost kills him before Flame enters his house. Wemmbu begins griefing Flame's house to try to kill him. Flame exits his house again to splash Wemmbu with slow falling before he can mace him. Eventually they agree to stop fighting because the fight would've taken a long time if they continued. They start arguing over who won the fight until the video cuts to Flame giving Wemmbu a tour of his house.   



Trivia


This is the shortest Unstable Universe video as it is less than 25 minutes long.


This video was originally titled "How I SURVIVED a Hardcore Minecraft SMP" before being changed to "How I SURVIVED the Unstable SMP"
