title: How I Solved Minecraft's Largest Escape Room
content:
How I Solved Minecraft's Largest Escape Room














Season


1






Episode


17






Upload date


Sep 27, 2024






POV


Wemmbu






Arcs


The PrinceZam Empire Arc
 (finale)






Featured Creators (Description)


PrinceZam
Wato1876
ClownPierce
eggchan














trapped by 
clownpierce
 again





How I Solved Minecraft's Largest Escape Room
 is the 17th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


The episode starts off with 
Wemmbu
 and 
PrinceZam
 locked inside of a large escape room created by 
ClownPierce
. Inside of the small box they are in has an end portal with four eyes filled and a wind charge inside of an item frame. Wemmbu tries to use the wind charge to gain height and get out of the hole, but instead redstone goes off, and it dispenses a trapdoor. They use the trapdoor to go into crawl mode and escape the first room.

The second room has even more trapdoors, their plan was to use the trapdoors on the floor and stay in crawl mode to crawl out the wall again. The plan works and now they're onto the third puzzle. Because Wemmbu took so long, Zam said he could've solved it by himself. A flashback appears of the last episode, showing Zam attempting to kill Wemmbu inside of Proton.

The third room has hoppers that consists of a bunch of different items, there is also a dropdown to another room with pigs down below. They can't access the next room without an item to break their fall, so they look for anything to help progress. Wemmbu uses a snowball to get the raw iron that was placed in an item frame and smelts it. With the iron ingot and the rest of the items given, Wemmbu crafts a crossbow and has tipped weaving arrows. He uses the crossbow and kills a pig, which spawns a cobweb where it dies. They manage to get down safely.

The fourth room has a goat placed inside of a house. Zam finds a bucket inside of the house and milks the goat to get rid of the mining fatigue. They mine out the floor, as well as the autocrafter inside of the house. Copper is scattered all around in item frames and they craft it into a raw copper block. They try to use all the blocks they have to crawl into the hole in the middle, the path down to the fifth room. Eventually they find a way to get into crawl mode, the most important item being the pink concrete powder.

The fifth room is a small room, and another goat is with them. The room is also surrounded by a bigger sphere. Wemmbu builds up with the few blocks he has remaining, not enough to get out of the room, but enough to see into the hoppers outside of the room. Zam asks for the blocks and builds out since he had an autocrafter on him still. Wemmbu manages to put the concrete powder and iron door inside of a hopper, which lets Zam to access the next room. There is a dispenser underneath the floor, which allows Zam to give Wemmbu items from down under. He gives Wemmbu a leaping potion and the concrete. Wemmbu makes it out, but gets mining fatigue as soon as he reaches the top of the small room. He is unable to get the concrete powder back. Being softlocked, 
Wato
, the creator of the escape room, comes to assist them. He shows Wemmbu the intended way to solve the room and stasises out. Wemmbu goes into crawl mode and goes to where Zam is. The next room is right below the dispenser, powdered snow is waiting for them beneath.

The sixth room is the biggest one so far, being a manmade Mesa biome, having access to powdered snow, an armadillo, and the first room to be able to freely break blocks without mining fatigue. They find rabbit hide, which makes them think they need leather boots for the powdered snow. While messing around, Wemmbu finds out they can very briefly jump on powdered snow before they start sinking, which leads them to attempt three consecutive parkour jumps to get to a hopper that was barely out of reach. The two take turns, running out of food in the process. After many attempts, Wemmbu finally makes the jump. They now have four rabbit hide and three leather, which is enough to make leather boots. They get lost and don't know where to build up until Zam notices a gold platform above. Wemmbu lets Zam go up first. Wemmbu messages Zam asking what's at the top, Zam goes quiet. Wato comes back, seeing that Wemmbu is stuck. They go through with the emergency exit, which is to use the armadillo to break through a wall near a patch of gold ore. Wato gives Wemmbu a milk bucket so he can break the lectern to get out.

Wemmbu gets out of the room and ends up on the outsides of the escape room. He takes potions from a random station that are located in specific areas. Wemmbu breaks into another room and uses the bucket Wato gave him to pick up water and swim out. Wemmbu tries to cheese the room, Wato hits Wemmbu with a sword, causing Wemmbu to give up the bucket. On a random armor stand has maxed out Netherite boots on them, Wemmbu takes them. A hopper right next to it contained some eyes of ender and a maxed out Netherite sword. Wato forces Wemmbu to do the rest of the room legitimately, which Wemmbu does.

After finishing the room that was broken into, Wemmbu obtains a wind charging potion. He finds a bunch of chickens stacked on top of each other, splashes them and kills them. This launches him into another room with a bunch of dispensers and flowing lava. Wemmbu breaks a bunch of things inside of the room and cheeses it by wind charging out. Wato doesn't like that and forces Wemmbu to solve it legitimately again. Wemmbu manages to figure it out, but with Wato's help.

The next step to progress is to build upwards using the sand blocks he has, held up by tripwire hooks and redstone torches. Wemmbu makes it and Wato leaves. Wato tells Wemmbu to tread carefully, since he's worried about Wemmbu falling for the same tricks. Wemmbu finally meets back up with Zam. In the time they were separated, Zam obtained a heavy core and a few enchanted books. Zam gives Wemmbu the heavy core and a enchanted book with wind burst on it, which Wemmbu crafts a mace and enchants. Wemmbu uses the mace on an armor stand, which allows both of them to gain enough height to get onto the next platform. This technique is used for the next few platforms until they make it to a room with brewing stands and magma cubes. They use the slime block to brew oozing potions, splashing them onto the magma cubes and turning them into slime, giving them over a stack of slime balls. Wemmbu crafts them into slime blocks, which gives them just enough blocks to get to the next platform.

Wemmbu maces up into a room once again, with an actual puzzle inside of the room. He uses a fishing rod to get Zam up with him. Wemmbu realizes that they need to use the resources inside of the room to reach the next platform. Zam suggests using the mace instead to gain more height and to reserve resources. Wemmbu maces Zam and rods Zam up and they do that multiple times until they make it up top. They get to the end of the platform, with nowhere else to go, they mace up one more time. On top of the box is a hole that leads to where they started. They drop down and fill the end portal. Once entering the End, ClownPierce congratulates them for escaping.

Clown demands for the mace back, but Wemmbu refuses to until Clown tells him where 
Eggchan
 is. Wemmbu whispers to Zam to give him the netherite armor and mace, Clown instructs Wato to respawn the Ender Dragon, but Wato flakes. Wemmbu tells Zam to go through the portal when he drops Clown. Zam makes it out and Clown respawns the dragon himself. Wemmbu and Clown begins to fight. Wemmbu's armor breaks and Wemmbu gives up the mace. Clown says he just gave up one of the last remaining maces on the server and that things are about to go down. Clown then flies off to the end islands. The episode ends with Wemmbu killing the dragon and going through the end portal.

title: How I Stole 10,356,000 Duped Items
content:
How I Stole 10,356,000 Duped Items














Season


1






Episode


4






Upload date


May 13, 2024






POV


SpokeIsHere






Arcs


The Exploit Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


Mapicc
Roshambogames
‪
ManePear
FlameFrags
Leow0ok
TheRealSquiddo
Jepexx
PlanetLord














Millions of duped items have flooded our server, and as a result, the players have stashed the items in vaults all around the server. So, it’s my job to destroy them all...





How I Stole 10,356,000 Duped Items
 is the 4th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


The episode begins with 
SpokeIsHere
 explaining how one week ago, millions of duped items appeared on the server. The players stashed them in secure vaults that were supposedly unbreachable, until he found one of them.

Spoke starts digging into their defenses and breaks into a room filled with players. He later realizes that they are just armor stands and spots a hole in the center, which he assumes leads to what he is looking for. He bridges over but sees that he would die from the fall, so he opens his ender chest and grabs a pearl to clutch with. Once inside, there are rows of double chests filled with the duped items. He blew everything up, but fell through the floor and clutched with another ender pearl, ending up standing in front of 
Roshambogames
 in an obsidian box filled with end crystals with a bow pointed at his face.

Roshambo threatens to shoot Spoke and blow him up if he tries anything stupid and tells him that there’s a player on his way to kill him right now. Instead of taking his chances, Spoke shoots himself and blows up the end crystal. He then elytras out of the prison, leaving Roshambogames behind.

Spoke resolves to get rid of the duped items once and for all, but decides to keep the two pieces of exploited armor. He heads toward spawn and discovers that someone had set it on fire. Someone starts playing music nearby and finds the base of 
Mapicc
, a player who hates Roshambo. He tells Spoke that he used to steal from him all the time, but that he somehow got really rich all of a sudden. He then reveals that he heard everything Spoke said, including the fact that Roshambo has duped items. Spoke offers to help him raid the vaults on the condition that they don’t keep any of the duped items. Mapicc agrees.

They head over to the 
Zam Empire
, supposedly where the second vault is. Spoke splashed himself with invis and proceeds to tell Mapicc that he has a big target on his back. They dig down into the first floor and run into 
FlameFrags
 and 
Leow0ok
, two of 
PrinceZam
 guards. Mapicc tells the guards that Spoke is his little brother and that he doesn’t like to talk. Spoke’s invisibility runs out and FlameFrags, Leow0ok, and another guard Merfinn start chasing them. They escape and elytra onto the roof of a nearby building.

Spoke explains that the real reason why they came to the Zam Empire was to not only destroy the duped items, but to also bring them back to the way they were, which means that they can’t destroy any builds or kill any players, or else they would be just as bad as Roshambo. They pearl back into the castle and enter the vault, blowing up as many duped items as they can. The server starts lagging and they get away by pearling into the walls. They elytra onto a balloon and head into the nether. They build up onto the roof of the portal and watch the guards elytra away, heading back into the overworld.

Mapicc asks Spoke how Roshambo knew how to dupe items in the first place and Spoke reveals to him that he was the one who found the dupe glitch. He tells Mapicc that this was before he saw the consequences of his actions and that he had used a lot of the duped items to pay players to do stuff. Mapicc is angry at first but calms down once Spoke says that an old friend convinced him to never touch exploits again.

Mapicc suggests that they head to 
TheRealSquiddo's
 base, which might contain some of the duped items since Spoke paid her a lot of them. They find the duped items stashed in barrels around her base and Spoke sets a pile of netherite blocks on fire when Squiddo logs online. Spoke and Mapicc try to make up an excuse, but are interrupted by the fire that has spread throughout the castle. While trying to stop the fire, Spoke finds a chest with the coordinates of what he thinks are the coordinates of Roshambo’s vaults.

They head to the first set of coordinates and find an unassuming trading hall in a mountain. There is a pile of chests in the center that contain lots of enchanted books and emeralds, though they aren’t sure if they’re duped or not. They then find the duped items in barrels located at the columns and start carefully burning them. However, the owner of the trading hall, 
Jepexx
, discovers them and crashes out. He tells Spoke that these aren’t duped items and that he skipped his final exam grinding for them. Jepexx doesn’t know about the duped items in the barrels, so when he finds them, he tries to steal them to trade with villagers. Spoke apologizes and tries to compensate with a fully maxed out kit to distract Jepexx while Mapicc breaks the barrels and burns them. Jepexx gets mad again, so they lead him out and tell him they have more emeralds for him. Mapicc starts a conversation with Jepexx while Spoke covers the trading hall with dirt to make it blend in with the hill. Once Spoke covers the trading hall up, he tells Jepexx that his trading hall disappeared and that he should probably check on his base to make sure it hasn’t disappeared. Once he leaves, they hide the rest of the duped items.

Spoke and Mapicc elytra back to spawn and decide to set an ender pearl stasis chamber. They search for a premade one and end up at 
Wemmbu's
 base, discovering his secret room under his house. They set their ender pearl stasis and head over to the second set of coordinates, a sky vault in the jungle. Once below the vault, they spot the outlines of players and their horses and decide to elytra up to check it out. The guards, 
PlanetLord
 and Leow0ok start attacking them and Spoke finds that he lost his TNT, so he and Mapicc start burning as much as the duped items as they can. Eventually, they realize that this isn’t going to work, so they retreat. 

Back on the ground, Spoke proposes an idea to use the 
orbital cannon
 to destroy the vault, because chances are, it was also made out of duped items. He leads Mapicc to the top of his prison where the orbital cannon is, but discovers that someone nuked part of the cannon. Spoke says that he thinks he knows where the builders kept the extra materials, so they head to the entrance of the prison. Once they get through the outer defenses, they ring a bell and spot pillagers arranged in arrows that point toward the items. They successfully retrieve the materials and fix the orbital cannon.

Spoke then shows Mapicc the button that will activate the orbital cannon and explains that the room they’re in was where he last saw 
JamatoP
. Mapicc presses the button and nothing happens. Spoke realizes that the cannon already went off and that they had to get to the vault before it was bombed to warn the guards. They don’t believe him, however, and start engaging with them. The orbital cannon strikes in the middle of their combat and everyone panics and elytras away from the zone. The duped items are completely gone, but the guards are furious. Spoke and Mapicc manage to knock them off of the vault, and they try to climb up a dirt pillar. Spoke threatens to shoot them off if they continue to advance and they pause. He takes the opportunity and asks them if there were any more vaults that they didn’t know about. The guards finally relent and tell them that there is a final vault. Spoke ends up shooting them off.

Spoke and Mapicc return to Mapicc’s base to discuss their plan to attack. Spoke suggests that they use the orbital cannon to strike the coordinates again. However, they are interrupted by an explosion that blows up Mapicc’s base. Spoke reasons that since the person who lit the TNT heard their conversation, they should strike the next vault now in case they told Roshambo. They activate the orbital cannon again and head to the third set of coordinates.

However when they arrive, they discover that the coordinates aren’t located at a vault, but instead at Jepexx’s base. They start a conversation with him and discover that this base meant a lot to him and that he lived here since almost the start of the server. Mapicc and Spoke fly away and Mapicc reveals to Spoke that these were the coordinates that the orbital cannon was set to strike. They decide to check if there was anything at the exact coordinates, so they dig into one of Jepexx’s wheat fields and find the actual vault under his base. Spoke reasons that Jepexx doesn’t even know that there is a vault under his field. They try to think of a solution and head down to Jepexx’s base to check things out again, but they’re too late.

The orbital cannon strikes, wiping out everything that was Jepexx’s home. Jepexx is devastated and tells Spoke to leave and that he’s done enough. Spoke and Mapicc feel very guilty, realizing that they took everything from an innocent player, and they swear never to touch the orbital cannon again, even against duped items. They resolve to find everyone who was affected by the duped items a new home at the end of this. 

Spoke and Mapicc leave Jepexx behind and head to the fourth and final set of coordinates before the final vault. There, they find a huge red and white mansion that they assume contains the duped redstone. Instead of redstone, they find a chest containing a book called “the final vault” by Roshambo. They realize that he probably already moved everything to the final vault and open the book, finding the coordinates to the final vault. Spoke knows that Roshambo is clearly up to no good because the coordinates are only a thousand blocks away from spawn. He knows for sure that there is nothing there, so they devise a plan to set an ender pearl stasis for Spoke. If anything goes wrong, Spoke tells Mapicc that he will message him and tell him to pull the stasis. 

Spoke then heads alone to the coordinates in the book and spots Roshambo. He leads him to the Soul Sand Vault, a stone wall with arrows of soul sand and wither skulls pointing into the ground. PlanetLord and Leow0ok are also stationed there, and ominously greet him. They lead him into the final vault and Spoke discovers that it isn’t a trap after all. However, when he looks into the chests, they are mostly empty, with a few containing soul sand and wither skulls arranged in the crafting recipe for a wither. Leow0ok tells him that this isn’t the real final vault and Roshambo digs out the blocks under Spoke, which drops him into an end portal. They respawn the ender dragon and several withers and tell him that this indeed was a trap all along. Roshambo and his henchmen start attacking Spoke. He messages Mapicc to pull the stasis, but it fails because the end isn’t freed from the dragon yet. 

In a voiceover, Spoke says that truthfully, he just wanted to stay there to prove to them that he could handle them, that he wasn’t afraid, when in reality, he was scared. Not of death, but of the fact that the chestplate and leggings he had on were the first and would be the last exploited items on this server and that if he lost or broke them, he would never forgive himself, as they were the only things left of Jamato. He wasn’t really sure if this was worth it anymore. 

Spoke reaches the end islands and concludes that if Roshambo, Leow0ok, and PlanetLord want to escape the end, then they would have to defeat the dragon, freeing him as well. He splashes himself with an invis potion, sneaking back to the main end island. He spots Roshambo and his henchmen getting chased by the withers. Eventually, they fly away into the void. Spoke follows them and reaches a massive end base, which he thinks is the final vault. He stalks them around the base, ending up in a giant chest room. Once his invis ran out, the Leow0ok discovers him, so he gears up for a fight, but Roshambo says that there’s no point in attacking anymore. Leow0ok asks him how he found the vault and Spoke tells them his plans. Roshambo laughs and reveals that they’re okay with trapping themselves in the end because their base was here. Spoke checks the chests and discovers that they’re all empty. 

Convinced that this is indeed the final vault, Spoke is persistent in his search despite Roshambo telling him that there is nothing here for him. Spoke then accuses them of moving the items into their ender chests, which Roshambo responds to by telling him to move on, that he was chasing a ghost. He says that finding and getting rid of the duped items wasn’t going to get Jamato back. Spoke is confused as to how he knew about Jamato, but all he gets in return is the information that the “someone” who told Roshambo (implied to be Wemmbu) was coming to kill him. Spoke argues that it’s Wemmbu who’s the bad guy, and that he tried to kill him once and would gladly do it again. Seeing no more use in staying, he flies away into the distance. 

Once back at Wemmbu’s base, Spoke tells Mapicc everything that happened. Mapicc says that it doesn’t make sense that Spoke had already found all of the vaults. Spoke tells him that they’ve already been to every single vault together… but they haven’t. Only Spoke was at the first vault, and it was the only vault Roshambo was actually at. 

They elytra to the first vault and jump into the room Roshambo was waiting for Spoke at. Spoke realizes that the lag he first experienced in the room wasn’t from all the end crystals and TNT, but from the hidden duped items. He mines into the floor but finds nothing. Then he mines into the walls and is greeted with countless barrels covering every inch of obsidian, all filled to the brim with duped items. This was the actual final vault. They start blowing up every single barrel, but Spoke stops in his tracks. He turns to Mapicc and says that if they blow everything up, Roshambo would lose all of his fortune. The big end base that was supposed to be his home would now be fair game. 

“I think we got a place to move into,” Spoke says.



Errors


In various sections of the video, the health bar switches from hardcore hearts to regular hearts.

title: How to Destroy the Unstable SMP
content:
How to Destroy the Unstable SMP














Season


1






Episode


1






Upload date


Apr 21, 2024






POV


SpokeIsHere






Arcs


The Exploit Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


JamatoP
ParrotX2














Spawning command blocks, item duplication, and world tearing - all exploits that were patched out of the game years ago. However, they have seemingly returned to our server..



How to Destroy the Unstable SMP
 is the first episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
 and the first episode released by 
SpokeIsHere
.



Plot


The video begins on a cold opening. 
SpokeIsHere
 tells 
JamatoP
 that the server is running out of time. He says that he discovered something that shouldn’t exist: a set of diamond armour with all four protection enchantments. The two enter Jamato’s base, where Spoke explains that a couple hours prior he was at a zombie farm enchanting his gear when he accidentally put all four protection enchantments on each piece.

Jamato tells Spoke that this was once possible in an older version of Minecraft and leads Spoke to an underground vault housing old Minecraft glitches and exploits that have never been possible to occur either at the same time or on the same server. These glitches include a spliced portal, a weaponless skeleton, a set of redstone-trimmed netherite armour with all the protection enchants that Spoke equips, and most notably, a machine that strips the data of blocks and transforms them into other blocks. 

Spoke realises what functioning ancient exploits could entail. He and Jamato both agree that nobody can find out about this, and Jamato says to start with the safe ones as to not raise suspicion. Spoke suggests they find a working duplication glitch to get the resources needed to test more exploits and build more machines. In voiceover, Spoke describes a duplication glitch that was patched years ago, but assuming it’s back he decides he has to use it. All he needs for it is a single shulker box, so he goes to the end to get one. In voiceover he says getting this shulker box “would prove to be the hardest part.” 

Spoke sees 
Wemmbu
 in the distance and approaches. Wemmbu tells Spoke that he has to leave and Spoke asks what he’s doing. Wemmbu says he’s just doing a “side-hobby project.” Wemmbu  asks about the armour Spoke is wearing, the redstone trimmed netherite armour from Jamato’s exploit vault. He asks what the armour is and where Spoke got it. Spoke lies, telling Wemmbu that he went mining and enchanted it at the zombie farm. Spoke changes the subject, wishing Wemmbu  luck on his project before asking if that's really what he is  doing. Wemmbu then shows Spoke a shulker box full of elytra, sarcastically saying “good luck finding an elytra,” and leaves the end. 

Spoke goes hunting for shulker shells in the nearby end cities and gets what he needs. Returning to the overworld, he brings Jamato to the dupe stash behind a painting in his base. They begin to duplicate gold, ancient debris, diamonds, emeralds, iron, experience bottles, shulker shells, anvils, and redstone components for the next couple of hours.

They devise a plan to use update suppression to splice a portal, but Spoke asks where they should build it. Jamato suggests putting it in a base that nobody would want to break into. However, neither of them can build something grand enough, so Jamato tells Spoke to ask 
TheRealSquiddo
 and her master builders to set up a meeting at spawn.

Spoke commissions Squiddo and her builders to build five 
Great Wonders
, paying thirteen shulker boxes of duped items. Squiddo tells Spoke that the builders can finish by the next day, but unable to wait, Spoke digs under one of the Wonders, the 
Pyramid of Anubis
, to build the 
chunk suppressor
 with Jamato. After finishing it, Jamato suggests waiting until everyone is offline to test it, but Spoke pulls the lever regardless, crashing the server. When rejoining, Jamato explains that while that wasn’t necessarily bad, it could mean that the builders find out. To be safe, Spoke  mines out to check on the builders and finds Squiddo standing in front of a spliced portal. Squiddo explains that she was trying to mine the portal when the server crashed, and after rejoining, she found it split in half. Squiddo says she needs to tell people about it, but Spoke talks her out of it, claiming it's just lag. He says he knows how to fix it and puts a block inside the portal, which breaks it. He again tells her that she shouldn’t tell anyone.

Mining back into the Pyramid, Spoke tells Jamato about what happened and Jamato tells him that that’s not how it works, which confuses both of them. They decide to lay low to test some smaller exploits. Spoke boats to the raid farm to see if he can obtain a glitched crossbow. He doesn’t find it , but says that he will check  after each glitch and heads to the next Wonder.

Under one of the Wonders in a netherrack room, Spoke transforms arrows of healing into uncraftable tipped arrows. Spoke goes back to the raid farm and again doesn’t find the crossbow, but brings back chests. He then attempts a dupe glitch that ultimately fails. Spoke goes back to the raid farm and again doesn’t find the crossbow. He comes back to the netherrack room with a brewing stand to attempt the two billion bottles glitch, but that also fails. Spoke goes back to the raid farm and finally finds the glitched crossbow. 

After showing Jamato the arrow and the crossbow, Spoke goes on to explain that certain exploits don’t work. He brings up the chunk suppressor, as they still don’t know how Squiddo’s Nether portal was spliced. Jamato explains that the suppressor wasn’t just working properly, it was working in a way it had never before. This confuses both of them, having never heard of anything like it before. 

Jamato offers to show Spoke another glitch that will not only dupe, but also stack totems of undying. The glitch is performed by dropping a totem on the ground and using an auto-clicker on the recipe book to turn one totem into a totem stack. The glitch gets Spoke a stack of eighty-five totems, which he uses to tank multiple crits from Jamato to test if they work. 

Wanting netherite, Spoke asks if they can dupe any. Instead, Jamato gives Spoke the illegal redstone trimmed netherite set on an armour stand. Spoke swaps the armour he’s wearing with the one on the stand, but then realises that there are a lot of entities in the room. He asks Jamato if there’s a way to make a force field to prevent a pie graph or chunk loader from picking them up. Spoke says that they’re absolutely not using chunk bans. Jamato says they may need to bring in more people, so they interview 
Roshambogames
, 
JumperWho
, 
Derapchu
, and 
Fantst
 to become the Guardians of the Wonders. Spoke pays them in duped items to not speak to anyone about this. Knowing he needs to hire one more person, he interviews Wemmbu to be the fifth Guardian. When asked for his skill, Wemmbu says they should go somewhere else. He shows Spoke an empty plains. A massive lag spike hits the area and moments later, circles of TNT appear and vaporise the field. This was a result of Wemmbu’s orbital cannon, which he’d previously built on the 
Lifesteal SMP
. Spoke is hesitant to hire him, and explains that if he is found inside any of the structures he will be kicked off of the Guardian team. 

Spoke returns to the netherrack room, swapping his armour again and accidentally unstacking his totems in the process. He sees this as a good thing, however, and reminds himself that the only reason he’s executing these exploits is to find answers, and that once he abuses them, the server will truly be ruined. 

Later, Spoke and Jamato are in a stone room under one of the Wonders. Using an exploit, they plan make blocks without data. The goal is to blow up a brewing stand with an end crystal that is on fire on the same frame as placing an enchanting table. They  have to log out, log back in, and see if it works. When logging back in, the book is removed from the enchanting table. They do the same thing with an ender chest and a wither skeleton skull, which turns them invisible. After doing this, they plan their next exploit. Jamato is worried they’ll become  overconfident and get caught from the impact this next glitch could have. He says in order to perform this glitch, they need “the goofiest and almost illegal mobs they can find.” Spoke sets up camp at the 
Crone
 and hunts the illegal mobs. He finds a skeleton, names it, and gives it a stack of wooden swords made using the recipe book glitch. After relogging, it creates the same weaponless skeleton found in Jamato’s exploit vault.

Meeting under the Crone, Spoke shows Jamato the three weaponless mobs he’s collected: the skeleton, a zombified piglin, and a wither skeleton. Jamato reveals that the Crone is on top of a stronghold, and that this exploit will put the mobs partially in the end and partially in the overworld, duping them. Because the mob exists in the end, it will be able to be teleported to the overworld multiple times. Spoke goes in to get the materials, which are hidden inside an end pillar. 

From the outside, Wemmbu hears Spoke talking to himself inside the pillar. Wemmbu asks what he’s doing, and Spoke frantically tells him not to come down into the pillar, saying that he’ll meet him on the surface. He tells Wemmbu that he’s working on an “end project,” but Wemmbu knows Spoke has been up to something and wants to know what they are. Spoke again says he’ll meet Wemmbu above, but Wemmbu proceeds to respawn the ender dragon, turning the shulker boxed of duplicated restone components into obsidian. Wemmbu continues to be confrontational, asking what Spoke has been up to. Spoke is at a loss for words and tries to muster an excuse. He says that Jamato sent him to get materials for his project, but Wemmbu does not believe that the redstone was legitimately obtained. He realises talking to Spoke is pointless and that he’s better off asking Jamato about it.

Spoke begins to attack Wemmbu, which he doesn’t react to until it becomes annoying. Wemmbu fights back, popping his totem. Spoke runs away, escaping through an end gateway and losing Wemmbu. He goes back, defeats the dragon, and goes through the central portal.

In voiceover, Spoke explains that if Jamato found out that Wemmbu was onto them, he would call off the operation. He decides that the next best step was to destroy every end portal so he could build the mob duper in peace. However, he realises that in order to truly stop Wemmbu he’d need to build something that could truly get rid of him for good. He knows there’s only one exploit capable of that. 

In Spoke’s base, Jamato asks what happened in the end. Spoke tells Jamato that he ran into a player, but that he doesn’t know what’s he and Jamato are building. He tells Jamato that they’re going to need to destroy the end portals, but Jamato protests. He tells Spoke that his goal is to save the server, not play god. Spoke tells him that he’s not playing god. Jamato continues, saying the only way to save the server is to bring it back to how it was. Spoke tells him that they’re the only players on the server with illegal armour, and that there’s a reason why they found it. He says they can’t stop now or they’ll never be able to build the final machine: the chunk splicer.

Jamato tells him that that was never the plan. He says it could fundamentally break the server and he won’t be a part of it anymore. He tells Spoke he shouldn’t be part of it either.

Watching Jamato walk off, Spoke realises he’s again alone. He thought that if Jamato wasn’t going to save the server from Wemmbu, he’d have to do it alone. He collects the materials he would need and heads towards the final Wonder with the intention of creating a command block. Once he acquires one, he intended to show Jamato how they could use it for good, but without Jamato, Spoke has a difficult time getting the machine to work, not realising the exploit he was using had been patched. 

But suddenly, Spoke discovers a never before seen glitch that hasn’t been possible ever before, proving that the server was truly unstable. None of that mattered to him anymore, however, because he’d finally gotten the command block and other illegal blocks. 

Spoke shows Jamato the items, but Jamato insists he gets rid of them and wants nothing to do with them. Spoke then realises when he say Squiddo earlier, Squiddo was wearing red trimmed netherite and suspects she stole the illegal armour. Spoke rushes back to the netherack room and the armour is still there but Wemmbu is waiting for him. The two begin a fight as Spoke manages to equip the illegal armour, throughout the fight Spoke uses his bedrock and Wemmbu breaks Spokes helmet and boots but Spoke manages to get out.  

Spoke decides to destroy the evidence inside of the wonders using an orbital TNT cannon. He constructs it a million blocks out but right before he fires Jamato enters. Spoke tells Jamato he's built the largest vault of illegal items and he's not going to destroy it but Jamato tells Spoke that he's not here to stop him. Jamato tells Spoke that after this he'll be leaving and he was just here to say goodbye. The two of them press the button and fire the cannon.  



Creators


SpokeIsHere
JamatoP
Wemmbu
TheRealSquiddo
Roshambogames
JumperWho
Derapchu
Fantst

Concrete Halls - C418


Aria Math - C418


More TBA

title: Hunting a Minecraft Player Who Disappeared
content:
Hunting a Minecraft Player Who Disappeared














Season


2






Episode


46






Upload date


Sep 22, 2025






POV


FlameFrags






Arcs


Skill vs Power Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


ParrotX2
Wemmbu
Salvationism
Boosfer
ClownPierce
FerreMC
ThatJacky
















boosfer bro





Hunting a Minecraft Player Who Disappeared
 is the 72nd episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


The video begins with a recap of 
Flame's
 identity and his fight against 
Wemmbu
 and about a rumor of Wemmbu's death.

Flame demands 
Boosfer
 to tell him what happened to Wemmbu. Boosfer in return demanded for payment Flame didn't have. Boosfer then ordered Flame to work for him to get information about Wemmbu. Flame reluctantly agrees. Boosfer demands Flame brew some potions to be ready for battle. He also ordered Flame to repair his armor and gear up for battle, Flame travels to 
Merchant City
 to acquire some ender pearls but since ender pearls are a Nether resource, and Nether resources are monopolized by a player named 
ClownPierce
 and his team, the ender pearl booth was out of stock. Therefore, Flame had to wait. Flame meets a player named 
The Invisible Knight.
 The nether shipment finally arrives and the guards at Merchant City are forced to bow down to 
FerreMC
, Clown's right-hand man. Flame receives the items and travels back to his base to find out Boosfer placing a bunch of Boosfer banners around his base.

When Flame had arrived back, Flame found Boosfer getting tossed around like a baby by The Invisible Knight and 
Capital City
 general 
Salvationism
 leading an army to kill Boosfer. As soon as Flame arrives they retreat leaving The Invisible Knight and Salvationism as the sole survivors. Flame asks Boosfer to give him his promised information on Wemmbu but Boosfer refuses stating that the players were there for Flame not him. Boosfer also added that was not his plan. Boosfer then offers Flame to retrieve him a helmet from 
ParrotX2
 as a favor. Boosfer states that Parrot has too many colors on his skin and he "pisses him off". Flame asks him if he retrieves the helmet, will he receive the information about Wemmbu. Boosfer dodges the question. Flame then travels to 
Capital City
 to meet Parrot in his potion shop. Parrot sighs as he meets Flame. Flame then demands Parrot to drop his potions then his helmet. Parrot questions him on the fact that he's demanding his helmet. Parrot asks him why Flame is asking for his helmet. Parrot realizes Flame is getting "Bossed around" stating that "The great Immortal demon getting bossed around by a random player". Parrot says Flame could tell him who it is and that he is an open-book. Flame replies with "Boosfer". Parrot starts laughing at Flame's reply. Flame getting frustrated starts getting violent at Parrot for making fun of him. Parrot says Boosfer is using him and Boosfer knows nothing about what happened to wemmbu and Boosfer is trying to get his get-back on him. Parrot states if Flame takes all his potions he becomes a "Boosfer henchmen" because Flame is getting bossed around by Boosfer. Parrot then drops Flame his helmet stating that if Flame takes his helmet he is an independent person but if he takes the helmet he is just another Boosfer Henchmen. Parrot then states the fight Flame wishes to seek is probably closer to Flame then he thinks. Parrot drops a quote from 
Wifies
: "You need me more than I need you."

Flame sees the horrendous new room Boosfer made that is basically a Boosfer shrine. Flame drops Boosfer Parrot's helmet then asking Boosfer for information about wemmbu. Boosfer keeps dodging the question stating he maybe will give the information. Boosfer thinks Flame gave him a fake helmet as the helmet had just Unbreaking III. Boosfer  then refuses to give Flame the information as the helmet was trash. Boosfer then demands Flame to build him an escape tunnel so he doesn't die in a future fight against The Invisible Knight and Capital City. Boosfer forces Flame to build an escape tunnel down to bedrock (Y -64). Boosfer splashes Flame with strength rather than haste to quicken the process. Flame builds a Nether Portal at the end of tunnel. Flame starts questioning Boosfer about the fact that he really has the information Flame wants. Flame starts critting out Boosfer frustrated of his lack of information on Wemmbu. The invisible Knight appears behind Flame. The Invisible Knight starts killing Boosfer, but Flame doesn't jump in until Boosfer promises to give him information he wants. Flame finally jumps in, but The Invisible Knight splashes Flame with weakness. The Invisible Knight leads Flame into a sand pit trap but the trap fails to kill either. Flame jumps into the pit and fights the horde of players lead by Salvationism. Boosfer also jumps in the pit eager to kill the horde. Eventually the horde of players are massacred by Flame and Boosfer leaving The Invisible Knight as the sole survivor. Flame starts chasing  the Invisible Knight but he is able to persuade Flame to turn on Boosfer. Both start chasing Boosfer but Boosfer escapes via escape tunnel that he forced Flame to build.



Trivia


For some reason, Flame removed Wemmbu, Clown, and Ferre from the description.

title: Hunting a Minecraft Player Who Doesn't Exist
content:
Hunting a Minecraft Player Who Doesn't Exist














Season


2






Episode


18






Upload date


May 31, 2025






POV


ParrotX2






Arcs


The Director Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


Leow0ok
JumperWho
Derapchu
SpokeIsHere
MrCube6
4CVIT
Wato1876
Mapicc














For months, a mysterious player called The Director has been terrorizing our team. But, I won't stop until I uncover their true identity. This is Hunting a Minecraft Player Who Doesn't Exist.





Hunting a Minecraft Player Who Doesn't Exist
 is the 45th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.  



Plot


The video starts with the ending of I Got Hunted by a Minecraft Hacker, where BAT chase the director across the destroyed BAT headquarters. Eventually, the Director uses a Enderpearl cannon and asked Parrot not to follow. Ignoring the warning, BAT followed. The Director is seen waiting in an obsidian room, and questions why Parrot follow him. Regardless of their answer, The Director activate a trap with multiple Full Netherite Zombies to attack them. Despite this, BAT managed to escape the trap by killing all the zombies, getting the extremely rare Netherite in the process. When going out, Parrot wonders how the Director get all the Netherite, considering the Mafia had mined out nearly all of the netherite on the server.

BAT then went to the Redstone Town, with the intention of finding out who the Director is by asking 4CVIT to list out every mass buyers. 4CVIT mentions about recent mass buyers, and said that he cannot list them out due to privacy. Parrot then bribes 4CVIT with a shoulder of netherite gear, and he mentions about a invisible guy in armor similar to The Director coming from a certain direction.

Parrot then hides and ambushes the buyer. When the buyer came, Parrot and his small team began to stealthily chase the buyer into an abandoned town, where they decide to strike. Eventually they forced the buyer to reveal himself, revealing to be MrCube6, who claims he is the director. BAT then decides to kill him when he never give any information, before the actual Director come. The Director gave one last warning to not chase him, in which Parrot still did. The Director said that they would have to guess who he is in 2 weeks or else bad things will happen. 

The Director then set off TNT, prompting BAT to fly up. Parrot's elytra broke on the way up, and began falling to his death. However, JumperWho showed  up and dropped Parrot an elytra, saving him. JumperWho eventually shows BAT her Void Base, which just happens to be in the same abandoned town Parrot and The Director first met. After giving a tour, Jumper asked BAT on what to do, which Parrot replies with the deal The Director made. BAT then decides to find out who the Director is with the help of Jumper. On one day, one of Jumper’s spies gave Parrot a book mentioning on The Director meeting with him in a week, and he could choose a place where he wants as he will always be watching where he is. Parrot then sees invis particles and told BAT to lockdown the base to find out who was inside their base.

Over the next few days, strange things began to happen to the base. Parrot, convinced that he is the Director, decided to chase after him. He is later revealed to be Spoke who claims to be the director. BAT corners Spoke and starts to interrogate him. Spoke explains that he doesn't know anything about the director, and that the hunt was all a waste of time. Just as BAT tries to kill him, Spoke eats a chorus fruit, leading to his escape.

With time being spent on hunting Spoke, Parrot only had a few days left before the meeting. Parrot then decides to ask the spies to cover every suspicious person while the Director is speaking to Parrot. At the end of the meeting, the Director “accidentally” held up Spoke’s chestplate, making Parrot suspicious that Spoke is the Director. However, Jumper said that Spoke is doing his normal things while Parrot has his meeting. Parrot is suspicious on Jumper, but after doing a trust test, BAT calms Parrot down.

In the last week, Parrot decides to spy on Spoke, but to no avail. On the last day though, Leow0ok sent Jumper and Derapchu to find any leads of the Director, but when they leave, he said that Parrot does not care about BAT and is simply only caring about chasing the director. He then attacks Parrot. He mentions how BAT was normal and rich until Parrot came. Parrot falls into the void using slow falling potions, but without fireworks or anything, he slowly drifts into the void with his elytra. He then talks to Leow0ok about his fate and how he misses him being supportive, but Leow0ok did not listen. Parrot then mentions on a phrase that Leo once said, which calms Leo down and saves him from being voided.

Parrot tells Leo to leave. Parrot decides to go back to the house he and Wifies made in the snow biome. Derapchu and Jumper managed to find him and questions why he wasn’t in the base, which Parrot said about the fight he has with Leow0ok. Eventually, the Director came. He proved again his superiority over Parrot by revealing him that the flash of the chestplate was done on purpose.  Derapchu and Jumper chase him down, only to fall in powdered snow in The Director’s trap. Desperate, Parrot finds Leo in the former BAT base and asked him to save Derapchu and Jumper, which he declines until Parrot made a offer to no longer chase the Director if he does, which Leo agrees. 

Parrot came up with a plan where Leo would fly on a Happy Ghast to save Jumper and Derapchu, while Parrot guesses who the Director is. Derapchu and Jumper is suprised to see Leo and initially declines to be saved, until Leo said he made terms with Parrot. Meanwhile, Parrot talks to the Director which he chose not to guess who the Director is. The Director then brings Parrot back to his house, asking Parrot to make the dog stand up, and when Parrot tries the dog doesn't do so, making Parrot realize that the dog inside of the house was not his. Parrot then again asks The Director what happened to Wifies, leading to The Director to drink a milk bucket and reveal that he is indeed Wifies and explains that he sends assassins to “kill” but yet spare Parrot, because he only wanted to study how Parrot works and behaves. Wifies then explains to him how he faked his death. He also explains that Parrot was never in any real danger, and he did everything to protect him. Then he reveals his plan to "create a world where nobody has to worry about dying ever again". He asks Parrot to follow him. Parrot refuses, saying that Wifies obviously isn't gonna kill him if he doesn't. Wifies says that while that's true, he will not hesitate to kill Parrots friends. Parrot, realizing that Wifies has changed, follows him.



Analysis


In the video, The Director wasted hundreds of fully trimmed sets of netherite on a zombie trap that didn’t even work. Netherite is extremely rare, since The Mafia (And probably The Director who is Wifies) mined all of it to a long distance out in the nether. Wifies turns out to be The Director, so who knows how rich he really is. He also had zombie spawn eggs, so that also proves he is super rich.

" told him. Flame starts asking players on the streets of the whereabouts of Luke4472 but everyone runs away from him.  A player named "SpringMike" attacks him and Flame kills him in 2 hits. After a while, a player named "
The_Codmaster14
" tries telling Flame he doesn't know anything about Luke4472. Eventually the player leads Flame to Luke4472's base. Flame points out the obvious banner of the 
Skullhound Bandits
, suggesting he got captured or even worse, killed. The player persuades Flame to help him find out what happened to Luke4472.      

Flame follows a path of gravel that eventually leads to a railway track. Flame makes an inference that Luke got intercepted by bandits while he was on the railway tracks. Flame decides he's going to let the bandits capture them. The_Codmaster14 is forced to go first as he is the bait. They notice a brick wall that's guarded by 3 bandits. They demand Flame to drop his sword. Flame refuses but instead places an ender chest and places it inside. The bandits now demand Flame to drop all of his ender chest's contents but Flame also refuses. They threaten Flame to take him hostage. Flame embraces and demands to be taken hostage. Flame also demands the bandits to take The_Codmaster14 too. They are escorted to a staircase and forced to live in an obsidian box. The bandits said that Flame is going to rot in the box until he decides to drop all of his ender chest's contents. Flame asks them where is Luke. The bandits said there is no Luke. In return Flame starts singing and The_Codmaster14 starts making even more singing. Flame said that he thought there was going to be another prisoner. The_Codmaster14 said the bandits are going to kill them. The_Codmaster14 demands Flame to make a plan. One of the players named  
AlbertJustice_
 starts insulting The_Codmaster14's skin saying his skin is 'chopped'. The bandit demands them to drop their armor, Flame agrees to drop it, but then kills him as he is organizing his inventory. The other bandits ran away seeing their comrade's death.      

Flame ransacks their outpost and finds Luke's armor, showing more proof of that Luke was here. Flame notes down Luke's armor trim which is redstone trim with wild armor trim on iron armor. Flame says that the sweet berries are suspicious due to the berries being a horrendous food source, he hints at the fact that they could've passed through a taiga, but The_Codmaster14 argues that idea is dumb. Flame argues that they should find the nearest taiga but The_Codmaster14 says that could be anywhere. Flame then resorted to making fun of his skin, he argues that Flame is reaching and connecting berries to a taiga is like connecting a fish to an ocean. Flame calls The_Codmaster14 a chicken, and he insults Flame by saying he is only good at PvP. The_Codmaster14 says Flame is chasing shadows, and Flame says that he would've done nothing and given up by now and if that's not the case, and to formulate a plan right now. He argues that his plans are reliant to hope. The_Codmaster14 says he wants to restart and Flame says for him to shut up. He starts protesting saying they wasted their time, so they part ways. Flame finds a banner belonging to the Skullhound Bandits. Flame keeps walking for presumably five hundred or so blocks. Flame finds three random players by the names of 
AdvancedKathrin
, 
Elm_0Paid2
 and 
VanadiumBaldine
. The group says they're searching for a certain group of bandits. Flame asks them how much of  the area they're familiar with. They respond with most of the area. Flame asks them to tell them the areas where bandits reside. They ask for payment. Flame offers some armor. They demand Flame's full set of Netherite Armor. The group tells Flame the bandits are at from the Northwest Region the exact same way Flame came from. Frustrated, Flame attacks them. Flame chases Elm_0Paid2; the group's leader. Flame chases him down into a hole as he doesn't have silk touch on his pickaxe. Elm_0Paid2 drops Flame the map. Flame goes northwest. Flame feels bad as northwest was the correct direction so he attacked them for no reason at all.     

Flame sees a huge amount of bandits guarding Luke. Flame uses his wolf rod to kill all the bandits garrisoned there. A total of 8 bandits. Flame frees Luke and asks him where did he learn about the supposed death of Wemmbu. Luke answered he was told by a player named 
MinuteTech
, the guardian of the End. Flame decides to go to the nearest stronghold which had a convenient Trial Chamber infused with it. So Flame geared up in the trial chamber; repairing his armor preparing to fight if Minute didn't tell him. When Flame and Luke arrived at the end, Flame kills a player who is talking to Minute. Minute; infuriated Flame, and they slip into a battle which had Luke glazing himself. Eventually Flame won by forcing Minute to run back into a end gateway. Flame decided to not pursue as the end gateway could be trapped. Frustrated, Flame decided to go back through the return portal of the End. Flame at his base is approached by a player named 
Boosfer
. According to Boosfer, he says he has information regarding Wemmbu.     



Trivia


The person who voices _keycapper at the beginning is different from the one at the end of the previous video.

Spoke's

, it was revealed that iMajesticRose was the daughter of

, a former Diamond Trimmed member of

.

 and

 his backstory. It turned out iMajesticRose and

 built the

 for

.

title: I Almost DIED on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP
content:
I Almost DIED on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP














Season


2






Episode


30






Upload date


July 23, 2025






POV


FlameFrags






Arcs


The Betrayal Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


Jaden MAN
LettuceK
Falcuno
Kieng
Mixiku
RecallingMan
qCxsh
creakyv
Twirps














Immortal P2





I Almost DIED on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP
 is the 57th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


The episode starts with 
Flame
 immediately being teleported into a trap that would drop him into the void. Flame clutches and saves himself, but 
LettuceK
 and his group of lawmen start to shoot at him to try and knock him down. Flame places a block above, but they start to use TNT to destroy the blocks, Flame thinks quickly and uses wind charges to knock the TNT off the block he is standing on. It destroys all the buttons and he's able to place ender chests above him, which are not affected by TNT explosions. While digging up, he restocks and kills half the lawmen before they decide to run away. 
Jaden_MAN
 shows up behind right after, Flame thinks he's there to kill him, but Jaden says he's over the entire situation and wants Flame to help get him full Netherite in exchange for giving away his mace. While they're heading to the location of a town, 
The Law
 sets off a TNT minecart trap which failed to kill Flame. The Law had learned to use carts in combat, but run out and is forced to run away. One of the lawmen had a Netherite helmet, which completed a fourth of the full set Jaden had requested.

Flame and Jaden make it to the town located inside of a mountain. Flame thinks they're there to trade for the Netherite, but Jaden informs Flame that he's a pirate and that he intends on stealing from the town. They quickly rob the town before The Law shows up, he ends up getting Netherite leggings from a player and gives it to Jaden. As soon as the robbery is done, The Law shows back up and attacks Flame, they go outside and spawn a Wither to help fight. Flame starts to mole in a cave and use TNT to do tons of damage, Lettuce and his lawmen are afraid of the tactic and backs off. Flame doesn't understand how The Law is finding them, and Jaden says they might just be following them and Flame accuses Jaden of telling them of his location, but Jaden reminds Flame that they're best friends and that he wouldn't betray. Flame says they should head to The Law's base and kill all of them, especially Lettuce to get Jaden his full set of Netherite. 

They head to The Law's base and Lettuce notices them and gets his guards to attack, some lawmen die and Lettuce instructs them all to head back into the base. Flame chases and is knocked into an obsidian box by an invisible player. Flame thinks they only tried to kill him with a dripstone at the bottom, but then hundreds of TNT start dropping down into the box, in which Lettuce claims is impossible to survive. Lettuce is shocked to see that Flame survived it, so they activate phase two of the trap: Wardens. Flame kills the first Warden, and they bring out two at once, and Flame kills both of them. With no other traps, Lettuce and his guards jump in to kill Flame themselves. Flame calls out for Jaden, but Jaden doesn't answer and runs away. Lettuce reveals that Jaden had been with The Law the entire time, they struck a deal to set Flame up, and every time Flame ran into The Law was because Jaden lead him to them. Flame gets constantly hit by slow falling arrows and gets drained of his resources while waiting for the effect to wear off. Once the effect wears off, Flame pearls out from one of the holes and drops a few more guards. Flame has a standoff with Lettuce and tells Lettuce that he failed to kill him, The Law tried to use TNT, Wardens, and even his own best friend against him and is still standing. Flame is ready to fight more, but Lettuce and his men say they're good and walk off.



Trivia


This episode shows that Flame shows empathy towards players who owns pets just like he does.

title: I Almost Got BANNED from the Unstable SMP...
content:
I Almost Got BANNED from the Unstable SMP...














Episode


95






Upload date


Dec 9, 2025






POV


SpokeIsHere






Arcs


BAT Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


Wemmbu
Leow0ok
Mapicc
JumperWho
PrinceZam














On the Unstable SMP, I have almost lost it all. My home was destroyed, my friends have left me, and now my life is on the line.





I Almost Got BANNED from the Unstable SMP...
 is the 95th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


Spoke
 looks down at 
Quackenstein123
 and his families base as 
Leow0ok
 and his group of spies blow the entire base up in search of their armor pieces. Before making a run for it, one of the spies shows Leo where Spoke and the family are hiding and they run down an escape tunnel. 
Mapicc
 waits for them at the end and they boat away, the spies catch up to them easily, so they dig into a cave and Spoke sends the family through a Nether portal for their safety. Spoke breaks the portal, Leo, 
JumperWho
, and their team of spies come in shortly after and forces Spoke to do an inventory check with his entire inventory and ender chest. They find no armor pieces, Jumper still defends Spoke due to lack of proof that he has the armor. Leo takes Spoke to spawn to hand him over to 
The Law
 and they go to the Northern Council to see 
LettuceK
 have his speech. When Lettuce brings 
Wemmbu
 out, Spoke gets the idea to have Wemmbu kill Leo for him. After the speech, Spoke pearls into the crowd, losing sight of Leo and goes invisible and follows The Law and Wemmbu on their way back to the prison, splashing them with invisibility, but loses track of Wemmbu immediately after. Spoke meets back up with Mapicc, who has infiltrated 
B.A.T.
 as one of their spies, and they go towards The Law's base, Spoke gets Mapicc to do a report of the entire building and routine of every guard. Spoke finds Leo near spawn and eavesdrops on his conversation with a spy, he follows them around and hears Leo asking players on where Spoke could be. Leo and the spy head to The Law's base and talks to Lettuce for a bit before heading towards Jumper's vault. Spoke follows along, watching Leo and Jumper in the middle of the vault from afar. Spoke then crafts a bunch of chests and bridges above them, planning to kill Leo. As he places a dripstone, a water droplet drips down and Leo notices, Spoke escapes without anybody seeing.

Spoke returns outside of The Law's base and Mapicc has his report of the prison, they dig into the prison using a blind spot and Spoke makes it into the prison. He finds Wemmbu and presented the offer of letting Wemmbu out if he completed his favor, but Wemmbu didn't want to work with Spoke. Spoke says the offer still stands before heading up and getting out. After days, Wemmbu made no progress in escaping and he couldn't find a time to get Leo alone to kill him, so he heads back to the vault and finds a message by Leo that says he needs guards to protect his spawn point at the 
old B.A.T. Headquarters
. Spoke flies towards the direction said in the book and finds blocks recently broken inside of the base and finds Leo's hidden base with a pearl stasis inside of it. Spoke makes up his mind on what he wants to do and goes back to the prison and breaks Wemmbu and the rest of the prisoners out. As they make it out the prison, the Netherite mercenaries arrive and Wemmbu runs, in which Spoke and 
PrinceZam
 run from as well. Spoke, Zam, and Mapicc head back to the 
B.A.T. Headquarters
 in the 
amplified
 lands where Wemmbu finds them again. Wemmbu asks for a favor, but Spoke wants Wemmbu for his favor first, and so they head to the other B.A.T. base and pulls Leo's stasis, Leo somehow manages to survive a mace attack from a big height and all of them start attack Leo, who seemed unfazed about being jumped by multiple people. As Leo's armor begins to break, Spoke's invisibility runs out, which was Leo's plan the whole time. After Leo caught Spoke, he stasises away. It was never about the armor, it was to see when Spoke was desperate enough to make a mistake and prove that Spoke was guilty. Spoke knows that the rest of B.A.T. would come, and he waits for them there as he has nothing else left to lose.



Trivia


Lettuce and loppezz are not credited in the description despite being in the video.


PrinceZam posted a screenshot on Twitter showing that he played TrucksandTrains in the video.
