title: I Bankrupted Minecraft's Richest Civilization
content:
I Bankrupted Minecraft's Richest Civilization














Season


1






Episode


11






Upload date


Jul 19, 2024






POV


SpokeIsHere






Arcs


The Exploit Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


Mapicc
ashswagg
PlanetLord
TheRealSquiddo
Jepexx
ManePear
JumperWho
roshambogames
Wemmbu














This civilization stashed MILLIONS of duped items, which we found and destroyed. But, somehow, they have returned richer than ever...



I Bankrupted Minecraft's Richest Civilization
 is the 11th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 

Plot


The episode begins with a voiceover from 
SpokeIsHere
, saying that after he and 
Mapicc
 destroyed 
Roshambogames's
 stash of duped items, they have somehow come back, richer than ever. They need to find out if these items were legit, or if they had discovered a new glitch. Spoke caught wind of Roshambo making stockpiles of these items, so they head to one.

The first location is a hole in the side of a mountain with chests lining one wall, but they are empty. They check everywhere, but are interrupted by 
PlanetLord
, which forces them to hide. Spoke and Mapicc emerge from the wall and catch Planet standing one shulker boxes of duped items, including totems, redstone, gunpowder, and emeralds. They grab the shulkers and chase after Planet. However, the server lags and Planet escapes. 

Spoke and Mapicc head back to their end base to make a plan. They decide to check the raid farm to see if the items in the shulkers are legit, and if it’s been lagging the server. It seems like Roshambo and his henchmen are using the farm. To prevent them from using the farm without breaking it, Spoke and Mapicc make a secret stash underground to contain all of the loot. They check to see if their storage system is working, but spot a group of 
invisible players
 arriving at the farm. They start blowing the farm up, so Spoke and Mapicc start fighting them. Mapicc sees that they’re all attacking Spoke, and he realises that this isn’t Roshambo. 

They head to land and Spoke is just about to drop when an isolated player that hasn’t interacted with anyone on this server named 
ashwagg
 shows up and shoos the attackers away. Ash says that he was just passing by when he saw the players chasing them and that he’ll see them around.

Spoke and Mapicc head back to Spoke’s base at 
spawn
. Spoke says that they need to check all of the farms to rig the ones that are lagging the server. However, they need a player who knows all of the farms on this server. The only choice is 
TheRealSquiddo
, who’s base they destroyed before. They head there and find Squiddo with her hamster, Garlic Hamster. Mapicc distracts Squiddo while Spoke finds a book with all of the coords of the all of the farms on this server. They are chatting with Squiddo when Ash appears. He wants to join them in their quest, but they refuse. He is persistent, though, and tells them to find him if they need anything. 

Spoke gives Mapicc the coord book and he leads them to a dysfunctional iron farm. They place soul soil under the sources of water to disrupt it, even though it’s already broken. They head to the next farm, but only find a railgun on a nearby hill. They search around the island, eventually finding a skyblock island. They check it out and discover that the cobblestone generator is built wrong, so they fix it. 

The third set of coordinates are at spawn, but the only thing at the location is a house made of TNT. They discover that the letter next to each coordinate is the dimension it’s in, so they head to the end instead and find an enderman farm. However, they find a 
PrinceZam
 guard named 
ManePear
 farming XP. They splash invis and spleef a block under him. Mapicc distracts him while Spoke messes up the farm. They both engage with Mane, pushing him back through into the overworld. That buys them time, and they rig the farm before Mane comes back and starts attacking again. They escape into the overworld and regroup at Spoke’s base.

They find Squiddo at their front door and politely tell her to leave. They turn around to find Ash in their house, and Spoke updates him on their progress. He still wants to help them, so they take him in and give him some coordinates to farms. They tell him to not destroy or blow up anything. He requests a copy of the coord book, but they refuse. After Ash leaves, they find that Squiddo has built a heart-shaped doorway at the pathway in front of their base. Mapicc says that Ash has a weird obsession with the coord book, wanting something from Spoke, and that he doesn’t care about him at all, but Spoke says that he’s just trying to be helpful. 

They head to the fourth set of coordinates, and, after digging underground for a while, they find a sugarcane farm that doesn’t even work. 

The fifth coordinates, however, are at the 
Zam Empire
. They head to a random house in the empire and sneak into the basement. To their disappointment, they find a simple rail duper in the enemy territory. Mapicc tests it and finds that it doesn’t even work. They just block the room off and leave. 

Spoke and Mapicc head to the sixth set of coordinates and see a giant prismarine box containing a guardian farm. Those aren’t where the coordinates lead, though. Instead, they lead to 
Jepexx's
 trading hall, whom they have a bad history of bombing his base. They find him lingering around his emerald beacons. Spoke and Mapicc sneak to the covered up entrance of the trading hall. Jepexx notices them, obviously, so they break into the trading hall and block it back up, making it look like they disappeared into the mountain. 

While in there, they splash all of his villagers with invis to make it look like they were gone. It doesn’t take long for Jepexx to come in. Spoke tells him that his villagers are gone, but Jepexx clearly doesn’t believe it. He goes to the back of his trading hall, where a bunch of nitwits that Mapicc also splashed with invis reside. Jepexx seems to have forgiven them, and tells them that these nitwits are for venting his anger upon. He also shows them the guardian farm they saw earlier and says that it’s a project he’s been working on. Spoke doesn’t believe him, though.

Jepex tells them of an ultimate farm that would fry their brains. Spoke and Mapicc tell him to lead them to it, and they find a bamboo farm and a pen with four pandas. Jepexx is giving them a tour of the place when two invis players jump them, targeting Jepex. They kill all of the pandas. Spoke yells, “Ash, call it off,” and a white firework bursts. The players leave, and they apologise to Jepexx before. After he leaves, Spoke theorises that Ash is following them. 

They head back to Spoke’s base and find Ash waiting for them there. Spoke explains to him what happened and asks him if he knew anything about that. He says that those were players he hired to help them, and that he was sorry that they attacked them. Mapicc realises that Ash is completely ignoring him. Mapicc become pissed, but Spoke chooses to believe Ash and gives him the next coordinates.

Spoke and Mapicc head to the seventh set of coordinates and dig underground. They find a giant melon farm that was definitely causing lag on the server, so they destroy it and blow it up. 

The eighth coordinates, however, are much more interesting. They find broken fish farm with Mane spamming the fishing rod, AFKing the farm. They realise that he isn’t even using the farm correctly, so they break it. While there, they decide to troll him and take him to an ocean monument. They box him in a 1 x 1 obsidian box with mining fatigue and chorus fruit proof any surface he can teleport to. Once they finish the trap, they wait, and he logs back on. Mane is confused as to where he is and starts yapping about some guy named Cedric. They just leave him there and head to the next farm, not having to deal with him for a few hours. 

The next farm is an upgraded iron farm that actually works. Spoke places a block of dirt over the ladder to the chest room so Roshambo won’t find the collection chamber. They also tamper with the gates leading to the kill chamber so that the golems can’t enter it. 

The ninth farm, however, isn’t really a farm. It’s just a giant crater in the ground that looks like someone blew the farm up. Mapicc theorises that it was Ash who did it, but Spoke won’t believe it until he has confirmation. To somewhat patch it up, they leave a sign saying “so sorry! - The Meteor,” surrounded by a bunch of stone hearts. 

They head to the other farm that Ash had been to, which was a cow farm, since there is steak everyone and a few living cows. It’s also been blown up, but this time, there was netherrack with fire lit on it. They also create dirt hearts and a sign that says “so sorry! - the rogue cow.” To save it, they put all of the items used to build the farm in a chest. 

Spoke and Mapicc head to the tenth location, which is a sheep farm built by Squiddo. Mapicc kills the sheep she was leading over, but she doesn’t seem too pissed. They also find a large flock of sheep in a hole in a nearby mountain, which Squiddo claims she didn’t lead over. Spoke thinks it’s Ash, because the sheep weren’t there when they first arrived. There’s also a nether portal with nothing on the other side. Mapicc kills most of the sheep and says that this is just Ash trying to manipulate Spoke into thinking he’s good. Spoke doesn’t believe him, and after a brief chat with Squiddo, they leave. 

The eleventh farm is the actual guardian farm by Jepexx’s trading hall. They see a player AFKing the farm and discover it’s 
JumperWho
. They want to troll her again, and they move her and her pretty little AFK chamber to the nether roof. Spoke clogs the item droppers while Mapicc transports Jumper. They splash invis and wait for Jumper to come back online. She quickly finds out who they are, but quickly lags out. They quickly trap her in an obsidian box, but she comes back online. They try to convince her that they weren’t the ones who moved her onto the roof, but she doesn’t believe them. They head back to the overworld, and Jumper goes AFK in a cave again, giving them time to spawn a few withers into the farm. 

They head to the twelfth farm, which is a cobweb farm, which had lagged out. They can’t figure out how the farm worked, or even how to use it, so they just changed the direction of a couple of hoppers. 

The thirteenth farm is in the nether. When they don’t find it at the coords, they go to the nether roof and discover a magma cube farm. Mapicc steals some magma cream from the chests before they mess up the rails at the bottom. 

At the next farm, they find a player AFK: Jumper again. This time, she’s sitting in front of her PC and watching a 
MinuteTech
 video on her phone. They sneak up on her and rig the farm, but she notices and starts attacking them. Spoke breaks the center of the farm while Mapicc exchanges hits with Jumper and knocks her off of the platform. After a while, she gets mad and threatens to call her team, 
Leow0ok
, 
Derapchu
, 
ParrotX2
, and 
Wifies
. Not having the best history with Parrot, Spoke and Mapicc leave. 

They find a hoglin farm at the next set of coordinates. They replace the warped fungus with crimson fungus, which causes excessive spawning of hoglins, breaking the farm. 

The fifteenth farm is much more complicated to ruin. They go inside the farm to the AFK chamber and find Mane, who somehow broke out of the guardian prison. He isn’t too happy to see them and starts attacking. They realise that they can’t beat him in PVP, so Mapicc spends an eternity distracting him while Spoke spends an eternity googling tutorials and crashing out on how to build a bedrock breaker. He eventually finds out that he was using sticky pistons instead of regular pistons, but that still doesn’t work. In the end, Mapicc builds that bedrock breaker while Spoke tries his best to stay alive. They lose Mane in the nether and meet back up underground. 

Spoke and Mapicc head back to their base to regear after they’re drained of resources. They head to the next farm, a bee farm where Squiddo is waiting. They open the collection chest for the farm and find sets of gear labeled “-A.” Spoke reasons that he was there when they were regearing. Mapicc refuses to take the armour because he says it’s blood armour. Spoke takes one set, feeling bad for Ash. In the end though, they give all of the armour to Squiddo.

They head to the seventeenth and eighteenth farms, which they find nothing of interest in. 

The nineteenth farm is a creeper farm, and they are about to rig it when two invis players show up and start blowing the farm up. Mapicc and Spoke immediately recognises this as Ash and pops one of the player’s totem, revealing them to the USmellLikeUpdog. He immediately starts begging for them to spare him, and that this was his first mission. Spoke is confused and asks him who sent him on this mission. He tells him that Ash is the leader, but is suddenly teleported to the void and dies, banning him off of the server. 

After that, Mapicc is enraged, and tells Spoke that Ash is the one behind all of this. Spoke doesn’t listen to him, though, and still believes in Ash. Mapicc has had enough, and after throwing Spoke the coord book, saying that he could complete this stupid quest on his own and flies off into the distance. Spoke tries following him to reason, but quickly runs out of fireworks. He tells Ash to meet him at the next farm. 

The next farm is a mob head farm, which Spoke pearls onto. Ash arrives and gives him an ender chest. Spoke tells him everything that happened and Ash explains that they were the players he had hired, and that they betrayed him. Spoke makes a copy of the entire coord book and gives it to Ash, saying that they were now on a time crunch and had to each go their separate ways. 

Before going to the next farm, Spoke revisits 
JamatoP's
 old base and recalls the memories they had. He had betrayed Jamato’s trust and left him behind, all wrapped up in his exploit arc. Spoke realises that he betrayed Mapicc the same way he betrayed Jamato. Jamato had took him in when no one else wanted to talk or even interact with him, and was there for him from the beginning. He and Mapicc were the two people that had actually cared enough to befriend him, so he didn’t want the same thing that happened with Jamato to happen with Mapicc. 

Spoke goes around spawn, searching for Mapicc, and finds him in his new base, right next to the one that was blown up. He makes amends with him and tells him that they don’t need to work with Ash anymore. They decide to go back to their end base to make a plan moving forward.

Spoke and Mapicc are in the middle of a peaceful session when they hear explosions in their end base out of nowhere. They fly out to see two invis players blowing up the base. At first, they think it’s Roshambo, but Mapicc realises that it’s 
Wemmbu
 and his new accomplice, 
eggchan
. They chase after Wemmbu, who is spamming TNT and withers, but they blow up a good chunk of their base before escaping. With no more home, Spoke and Mapicc set up a temporary bunker in the end dimension. 

Now they have to complete this mission more than ever to make sure that Roshambo won’t have the resources for another war. They head to the next farm in the coord book, a flower farm, where surprisingly, Roshambo and Planet and planting flowers. They head to them and ask why they were here. Roshambo says that they’ve changed and aren’t touching exploits anymore. Spoke doesn’t believe them and further questions them, but out of nowhere, the whole flower farm explodes. 

The sheer amount of TNT used to explode a simple flower farm shocks them all, and once the explosions clear out, Roshambo accuses them of blowing it up. Spoke and Mapicc protest that it wasn’t them, but in their minds, they knew it was Ash. Roshambo and Planet are skeptical, but seem to decide to believe them.

Spoke and Mapicc hurry to the next farm, but they are too late. It’s already been blown up. They check some of the previous locations, but they’ve all been blown up, including the skyblock island, Jepexx’s trading hall, and the guardian farm. Spoke is horrified, realising that he is the one who cause this, as he gave Ash all of the coords. 

They decide to head to the very last farm in an attempt to save it. It’s one of the rarest farms in the game, so they have to make this count. Spoke tells Mapicc that Ash won’t show himself if he’s there, so Mapicc flies off to a corner of the giant obsidian box the farm’s located in. Ash eventually shows up.

Spoke interrogates him, telling him that what he’s doing is wrong, but Ash just laughs in his face. He tells Spoke that Spoke knows nothing, and that this was his plan all along. He actually wasn’t the helpless player that they had assumed he was at the start. He wanted the exploits Spoke knew of, but knowing that he would never give him the exploits, he joined in on their little mission. Now that every farm except one was blown up, the blame would all be put on Spoke and Mapicc, since they were the only ones seen at all of the farms, other than the invis players. He leaves Spoke with an ominous warning to choose the right thing. 

Mapicc flies in after Ash leaves and Spoke briefs him on everything Ash told him. An insanely large group of players, all invis and wearing 
plain netherite armour
, shows up and starts attacking Mapicc with a goal to kill him. Spoke knows that Ash has ordered them not to kill him, as he needs Spoke for the exploits, so he lures the players into a cave. Mapicc changes his armour to plain netherite and splashes himself with invis to blend in with the crowd and go unnoticed. I'm currently falling 80 blocks onto a dripstone trap, the fall strong enough to kill me through full protection full Netherite armor - and ban me from the Unstable SMP. Most players would die here, but I'm not most players.





I Became Immortal on a Hardcore Minecraft Server
 is the 39th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. It is also the first episode released by 
FlameFrags
. 



Plot


The video begins in 
FlameFrags
 entering his house until he falls into a dripstone trap. He clutches the trap but gets ambushed by the trappers. One of the players attempt to blow him up with a minecart but it blows up before it gets to him. Flame leaves after most of his armour breaks and he kills the entire team. Flame stashes their gear in his stash of gear from killing players. Flame is determined to get a full set of netherite armour again and embarks on a journey to get it. 

Flame crafts new armour with the diamonds he gets and enchants it along with getting new gear before getting confronted by 
Spoke
 and his team of players that he assembled to kill Flame. Flame wipes most of the team out and follows one of the players. The player explains to their team that he needs to kill Flame with a netherite sword. Flame reveals himself and wipes everyone out except for the player he followed and then looted their base until he found the netherite sword. 

Flame continues his journey to get a full netherite set and begins to head to 
Merchant City
 until he gets robbed by 
TheobaldTheBird
's Cart-PvP students. Theo tells them not to rob Flame but they don't obey thus getting wiped out by Flame. Flame finally makes it to Merchant City and makes a trade with a fan and gets a netherite helmet and some totems for all the loot in his donkeys.  

As he heads out of Merchant City he gets attacked by 
Bounty Assassin Team
. One of the members, Parrot warns them not to attack Flame since it would be a waste of time and resources and he believes that they need all their resources to be used on 
The Director
. Flame's armour begins to break mid-fight but he realizes that the spies each have curse of vanishing on their armour to prevent anyone from taking the armour after a spy dies. Flame luckily kills a spy which has an extra set of armour that doesn't have curse of vanishing and he wears it. He picks up the spy's armour along with some XP bottles and the fight turns around with him wiping out all the spies. The rest of BAT run away after the spies get killed. Flame checks out all the loot from the fight and finds netherite boots without curse of vanishing.  

Flame heads back to his base to upgrade it by making more farms and expanding the base until 
Wemmbu
 shows up. Wemmbu explains that he wants to do a rematch against Flame since he hasn't ever won against him. The fight goes well at first, until Wemmbu begins rocket-macing him. Flame's shield breaks and his last totem pops. Without any other choice, he crafts slow-falling potions to counter his mace. Wemmbu gives up and they begin talking about who won the fight. Flame shows Wemmbu around his base and explains to Wemmbu that he's been fighting off Spoke's minions. Wemmbu gives Flame the coordinates one of Spoke's bases.  

Flame heads to Spoke's base to confront him and Spoke begins taunting him and telling him to drop all his items until attempting to kill Flame using TNT minecarts. Flame begins chasing Spoke and he activates a void trap. Flame clutches using ender pearls. Flame continues chasing Spoke until he activates another TNT minecart trap. Flame begins attacking Spoke again, thinking that he ran out of traps until Spoke activates a void trap that they had been standing on the entire time. Flame clutches by using a slow-falling potion that he had brewed during the fight with Wemmbu and he clutches. Spoke runs away and a group of players emerge. Flame takes out the entire group of players and he finally gets netherite leggings; finishing his full netherite set.   



Trivia


The video was originally titled "I Became Immortal on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP"


The is 
FlameFrags
' debut as the fourth protagonist of 
Unstable Universe
.

title: I Became King of the Unstable SMP
content:
I Became King of the Unstable SMP














Episode


112






Upload date


Feb 10, 2026






POV


ParrotX2






Arcs


The Kings Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


TheobaldTheBird
LettuceK
Boosfer
Purpled
Wemmbu
FlameFrags
SpokeIsHere
JumperWho
MinuteTech
Jaden_MAN
PrinceZam
Fymada
Horace_Altman
Leow0ok
Twirps
 (as Deputy_Ace)














After Lettuce paused the Unstable SMP election and declared himself the interim leader, he captured me and my best friend Theo.





I Became King of the Unstable SMP
 is the 112th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. This marks the end of 
Parrot
's perspective of 
The Kings Arc
.



Plot


Parrot
 starts off the episode by explaining how many players have tried ruling the Unstable SMP, but all have failed except one; 
LettuceK
. Lettuce started like any other player, all the way at the bottom and joined the corrupt 
Capital City
 and forced to mine for the rest of his life with no chance of escape. This was until Parrot came along and joined the mining civilization and managed to free everybody there. Ever since that day, Lettuce tried to fulfill his promise and created the group known as 
The Law
, hunting players that were corrupt, but was still undermined, and needed to have more power and become the king of the server. This lead to Lettuce sending a thousand players to their death against 
FlameFrags
 and 
Wemmbu
, he used the leverage of the aftermath to run an election and rig it for himself. Parrot, who saved Lettuce in the past, saw right through his lies and rivaled him against the competition. Throughout the entire election, Lettuce had blackmailed, framed, and attempted an assassination on Parrot, and after realizing Lettuce would've lost the election due to the second debate, he declared himself the first king of Unstable. Parrot ends off his dialogue by saying Lettuce had become what he swore once to destroy.

Lettuce, his right-hand man 
Deputy_Ace
, and eleven other lawmen take Parrot to prison on their happy ghasts. Parrot dislikes the idea of having to sit around and watch Lettuce become the king although he hadn't won the election and calls out Lettuce for power grabbing. Lettuce says he's scared of what would happen if he didn't win and says it's nothing personal. Parrot reminds Lettuce that they used to be friends back in the mining city, Lettuce says he hadn't forgotten and he wanted to be like Parrot when he freed him and hated that Parrot was his opponent. They make it to Law HQ and Lettuce brings Parrot down to the prison. Parrot says he's making a mistake, Lettuce says he's doing what needs to be done. Parrot asks what if he doesn't comply, and Lettuce says he would kill him, but doesn't want to and to not make it difficult with a saddened voice. Parrot goes ahead and follows, an inventory check is conducted and he gets cleared. Lettuce starts leading him to his cell and gives him a set of curse of binding copper armor as per protocol due to Wemmbu's previous escape attempts. After getting put into the solitary confinement cell, Lettuce tells Parrot if he ever wants to see 
Theo
 again, he'd have to admit that he was wrong about everything and to endorse him. Parrot asks if he's stupid for thinking Parrot would do any of that after his best friend got kidnapped and got sent to prison. Lettuce says no and knows eventually he'd do so. Lettuce and Ace leaves, a new commander named BenjaminTheI keeps watch of Parrot. Soon later, Ace returns and brings 
Th3Blurpenstein
 into solitary and tells Benjamin to look out for them. Parrot and Blurpenstein talk to each other and Blurpenstein reveals that Wemmbu had escaped this exact prison, Parrot asks how Wemmbu did so, Blurpenstein explains that the lights went out and a riot begun. Benjamin blocks off the iron bars and door so the two can't see each other anymore. Parrot thinks to himself no matter how hard he tried, he couldn't do anything as Lettuce became the king of the server. All of a sudden, the lights go out and a secret door opens up behind Parrot and a shulker box full of gear is placed right at the door. Parrot blows up the doors that requires keycards and runs out of the Law HQ. Parrot realizes that thousands of lawmen roam around the server and the potential of stumbling across one was very high. A lawman spots him and sees that Parrot was the escapee and says he's gonna snitch on Parrot. Parrot hits him back to knock him away and run the opposite direction, Parrot grabs a piece of cactus and intends to use it to break his armor. He isn't able to take on the fight with his copper armor and the lawman did eight hearts of damage per hit. Parrot gets multiple hits on the lawman and eventually gets all of his armor broken, he equips all of his diamond armor and locks in and demands where Theo is. The lawman tells Parrot to stop and tells him that Theo is at Smuggler's Pass. Parrot asks why he should believe him and the lawman describes the terrain of Smuggler's Pass and says he saw Theo there himself. As Parrot's heading off, the lawman says there's no chance he could free Theo as he'd have to be a smart player to do so and that he would report Parrot to Lettuce. Parrot charges up his crossbow and uses his flint and steel and TNT minecart to blow the lawman up instantly.

Parrot then walks all the way to the Smuggler's Pass and splashes invis. He goes down a tunnel inside of the mountain and sees a massive castle built inside of it. He sneaks his way into the castle without being seen and sees Theo standing in the middle surrounded by lava at the very bottom. Parrot splashes fire resistance and climbs up a lava flow. He then uses a punch bow to launch himself onto a manmade stalactite and bridges over to the platform, clutches with water, and splashes both of them with invis and tells Theo to hide. The two lawmen keeping an eye out bridged over to the platform and they use the time to cross over and escape. They catch up on what happened over the past few days, Theo says Parrot could not endorse him and they need a plan, Theo says Lettuce made him set another stasis chamber and gets teleported as soon as he says that. Lettuce comes seconds after and says he wants to prove to Parrot that his friend's life is always in his hands and reminds Parrot if he wants to free Theo, he needs his endorsement and that he can't get Parrot in the way. Parrot says his whole plan was to keep his friend hostage until he gets endorsed and asks Lettuce what kind of king he is for doing all of this. Lettuce says the only one that's fit to rule and one that's willing to do whatever it takes. Lettuce says he's going to hold an announcement at the 
Northern Council
 in two hours and expects Parrot to endorse him there, and if he doesn't, a lot of people would get hurt, and if he tries to fight back, the server would be too divided. Parrot says it won't happen after he got sent to prison, the election got held off, and his best friend got kidnapped. Parrot angrily demands Lettuce to give Theo back, Lettuce says it wouldn't happen, Parrot pots up and tries to attack Lettuce and he calls out his commanders to protect him. With no other choice, Parrot goes with Lettuce to the Northern Council.

Parrot and Lettuce ride a happy ghast all the way to the Northern Council, Lettuce reminds Parrot that him and Theo will die if he doesn't renounce his statements and that he's willing to offer them positions in his kingdom. The announcement starts, Lettuce first mentions that the election has been put on hold, but the remaining candidates had something to share. 
Boosfer
 goes first and says he was never interested in the election and asks for all his supporters to send his votes over to Lettuce. 
Purpled
 goes next and says the same thing as Boosfer and to have all his supporters to move their votes to Lettuce. It gets to Parrot's turn, he says the last time he was up on stage he called Lettuce a hypocrite and now wants to tell the server that it's still the case and will not be endorsing him after he kidnapped Theo and tells the crowd to not make Lettuce their king. Lettuce tells Parrot to follow him into the castle and asks him who he thinks he is for saying that, Parrot says he wouldn't endorse him no matter what and that Lettuce had the audacity to bring Parrot up on stage. Lettuce thought Parrot would come to his senses and gave him so many chances, but this was Parrot's last and makes Parrot follow him. Lettuce, Ace, and a dozen lawmen bring Parrot back to the mining city where Theo is being held hostage by two Law elite guards. Lettuce says they were there and forced to mine and never have the chance to escape and thinks Parrot regrets ever helping Lettuce out back then, Parrot says he doesn't regret it at all and that he saw a kind person and not the person that's standing in front of him now. Lettuce says he can't do it himself and makes Ace and the two elite guards the ones to kill them, him and the rest of the lawmen go on the other side of the island and blows the horn signaling Ace to kill Parrot and Theo. Parrot says this it it and says it was fun playing on the server with Theo. The camera goes off of Parrot and looks up, two hits are heard and the wither sound effect plays twice, hinting that two players died. It pans back down and Parrot is standing there. Parrot is shocked that Ace killed off the two guards and he says they have to go now. Lettuce comes back and maces Parrot and asks what Ace is doing, Parrot says there's a mine somewhere and goes down into it and covers it up. With the little time they have, Ace reveals that Lettuce had ignored everything he said for too long and that he was the one that freed Parrot out of the prison. Ace gives them his pickaxe and says he was going to hold them off and tells Parrot that he'd be a great king. Lettuce confronts Ace, Ace says what he's doing is wrong and what Parrot and Theo stand for is better than what Lettuce is doing. The last words Ace says before he gets killed off is "I'd rather die standing than live kneeling." They dig out of mining city and Parrot builds a tombstone for Ace. Parrot says they finally need to defeat Lettuce then says they need to return back to 
District 13
 to prepare. 

At the entrance of the District 13, Parrot calls out 
Horace
 and 
Fymada
 for following them. All four of them walk in and see a group of players who used this base as their town, Parrot goes on to explain to them about the election and Lettuce and if nobody was going to step up, Lettuce would be the permanent king of Unstable. The people see that Parrot was the one that stood up against Lettuce and agrees to help them out. They start setting up their plan, Horace would stay back with the others to rebuild the base as Parrot, Theo, and Fymada went out to recruit more players. Parrot and Theo tasked themselves to find 
Flame
 and 
Wemmbu
 each while Fymada recruited any players that she knew that were interested. Parrot recruited a few random players who were interested, but knew Wemmbu was practically impossible to find at this rate, so after a full day of looking, he returns back to District 13. Parrot sees the new revamped base and sees that Theo hadn't come back, so he teaches the new players how to PvP. After two days full of practice, Theo comes back and Horace reveals that he knew a Law stash full of loot and so Parrot and Theo go out to get it. They park their happy ghast at an island nearby and swims over to the Law stash where lawmen still guard it. They sneak into it and grab a few armor sets and Parrot writes on a sign to keep looking. Parrot sees a room being guarded by two lawmen and sees that it's a room that has chests full of potions. Parrot mines through the stone, but Theo coughs unmuted and alerts the lawmen that they're there. Theo says he only brought four minecarts to fight and that there's more in his ender chest, but is unable to get them since he gave his pickaxe to Parrot. The two go back to the island with their happy ghast and fly up, the lawmen begin to build up to them, Parrot tries to bow them off and kill them with fall damage, but the water saves them. Parrot uses his spyglass to look down and sees an invisible player with a trident and thinks it's 
Spoke
. Spoke summons multiple withers and blows up tons of lawmen, Parrot and Theo jump down to help him. Parrot asks what Spoke was doing there, Spoke says there's been too much that's happened since the last time they talked. They deal with the last few remaining lawmen and Spoke says that 
BAT
 had a revolution and now 
JumperWho
 and her spies are sided with Spoke and that he'd been searching for Parrot to combine forces. They loot more of the chests and Spoke explains that they fought a huge army at their prison and expected them to come to the Northern Council, but instead they were heading over to where they are now. The next wave of lawmen show up and get onto the island, at the same time, Wemmbu comes flying towards the castle and sets off an orbital strike cannon onto the castle. There are too many lawmen for all of them to deal at once, and Flame comes right after. It's revealed that Spoke had already recruited Flame and Wemmbu apart of their army. 

Parrot, Theo, Spoke, and Flame all ride back to District 13, but Spoke says the happy ghast is too slow, so he makes Theo fly back alone and the other three go back to the castle where Spoke has the rest of his army to go get them. At the castle, 
Mapicc
, Jumper, 
PrinceZam
, 
MinuteTech
, and 
Jaden_MAN
 are all there and welcome them in. They then all go back to District 13 and gears Parrot's army up. Parrot and Spoke step up and have their speech, Parrot starts off by saying they have all been affected by Lettuce and his army someway and somehow. Lettuce had hunted, blackmailed, and tried to kill all of them, all because true justice is served by doing whatever it took. Parrot says they're going to storm into the Northern Council and show Lettuce wrong. By the time they start heading off, Lettuce knew that they had all combined forces and gathered up all of Law to stop them. They step onto the Northern Council, Parrot steps up and has a talk with Lettuce first before heading head first. Parrot says Lettuce probably wished he banned him off, Lettuce asks what he thinks he's doing and that all of the server's problems are standing right behind Parrot and everyone that he's sacrificed would had been all for nothing and says Parrot is wrong for thinking Lettuce would let the world take everything from him again. Lettuce gives Parrot one last chance to turn back around, Parrot says it's too late to surrender and everybody behind him has a reason to fight back. The two wish each other good luck and backs up to their team, Wemmbu immediately sets off three orbitals and kills hundreds of lawmen in those shots. Parrot thinks Lettuce is stupid for thinking that this army was able to take down his army after wiping out a majority of the lawmen in a short amount of time. They all realize that neither Lettuce or the commanders were at the fight and go up to where Lettuce and his commanders were. Parrot says Lettuce let all of his people to die and ran like a coward, Lettuce reminds them again he isn't stupid and makes them turn around and hundreds of Lettuce's netherite lawmen come out of hiding and a second fight begins. Parrot knows he's not good enough to kill the players off individually, and goes off to be a distraction for the better PvPers of the army to get the kills. The perspective switches over to Theo's, who blows up multiple lawmen in one minecart each time. Back over to Parrot, he towers up and places his shulker boxes full of gear, Wemmbu flies over to regear as well, and Lettuce comes flying in and maces them off. Parrot starts to run out of resources and needs a way back onto the tower to regear, but it's practically impossible with how many lawmen are on him at once. Parrot goes onto the side of the Northern Council and builds up on the back of the election board to get to his shulkers. It switches back over to Theo again, who's shown to be destroying the lawmen once more.

After an hour of fighting, it was only Lettuce and a few remaining lawmen left, all of Parrot's army target Lettuce until it's down to his chestplate being the only armor piece remaining, he then flies out of the fight. They count who's there and see if anyone died, Wemmbu and Minute come back and says Lettuce managed to escape. They're all finally able to rest from all of the fighting and Parrot walks around the Northern Council just looking at the ground. Lettuce is then shown walking back through the front of the Northern Council. Parrot asks Lettuce what he's doing there and Lettuce says if they really want to kill him, to do it and that he doesn't want to live on a server that doesn't want him, and that his goal was to enforce the will of the server, but if the server doesn't want justice, he surrenders. Parrot makes Lettuce follow him, but some people like Flame wants to kill him right there. They all decide a vote to see who wants Lettuce dead and it ends in a tie. Flame asks why Parrot wants to keep Lettuce alive, Parrot says if they kill him, they're no better than him. Parrot says he will resume the election that Lettuce started and if Lettuce somehow manages to win, then that's the server's decision. Lettuce says he knew he wasn't going to win ever since Parrot's execution failed and says the server was too far gone now and he tried to warn Parrot. Parrot tells Lettuce that he's going to prison for a long time. Parrot looks at the warzone that they had caused, Wemmbu and 
eggchan
 come out and ask if he's gonna become king now, egg says he wouldn't vote for Parrot and Wemmbu says he'd vote for egg over Parrot, which was fine with him. Parrot asks where they're headed now, Wemmbu says he doesn't know and the two of them head off and says it was fun fighting alongside him.

The next scene shows Parrot with 5,828 votes and Lettuce has 3,973 votes. Parrot now wears a crown on his skin, him and Theo are inside of the castle ready to walk out, Theo asks what Parrot will do as king, Parrot says he doesn't know but he has some things planned. Parrot heads up and Theo tells him good luck and that he's proud of him, but not to let it get to his head since he's still not the biggest bird. Parrot steps up in front of the crowd as the episode ends.



Trivia


Mapicc, Jaden_MAN and a few others were not featured in the description, however, this may be Parrot overlooking at all of the people in the video.


While Parrot was looking for Wemmbu, he hears Wemmbu and eggchan open the Farlands end portal.


At the end of the video during the scenes District 13 decides LettuceK's fate, an invisible player can be spotted spying on them. This was confirmed to be one of Jumper's spies in Spoke's POV.


This is Parrot's 100th video.


Deputy_Ace's final words were also said in Parrot's 
finale
 of the Invisible Mafia arc, where Parrot told Ash the exact same thing when Ash tried to force him to join the Mafia.

powerrrr





I Became POWERFUL on a Hardcore Minecraft Server
 is the 66th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


The video starts with a recap of how he lost against 
Wemmbu
 and his title of "The Immortal Demon". 

A player named "RottenBanana" steals his iron and runs. 
Flame
 eventually kills RottenBanana. Flame; now in full iron makes a long trek to his base only to get ambushed by the 
Skullhound Bandits
. The Bandits chase him outside as he pillars up with cobblestone. The bandits make fun of him for losing to Wemmbu.  Flame runs back to his horse and runs away. Flame finds a spot in a mesa hill to build his new base as his old base was  overran by bandits and Wemmbu left a giant hole infront of it. Flame equips a diamond chestplate from his shulker box. Flame tames a wolf and explains his plan to breed a wolf army to take his revenge against Wemmbu.

Flame finds a town and the town's people don't drop anything due to his loss against Wemmbu. Flame massacres them. Flame takes everything from  their chests and their armadillos to make wolf armor and a silverfish exp farm. 

Flame calls 
Lomedy
 to make his base an actual functioning base. Lomedy makes an armadillo farm to get stacks of armadillo scutes. Flame uses the armadillo farm to make a cobweb farm. Coincidentally, the farm also gives him a bunch of experience, one of the most prized things in the server. Lomedy shows him his new base. Lomedy then asks him why is he building a new base. Flame tells him the whole story.  Lomedy gives Flame some motivation. Motivated, Flame decides to spin back on the bandits that he ran away from. Flame realizes a crucial issue. His lack of golden apples.

Flame decides to go to the nether to mine some gold. As he is mining for gold, he is ambushed by 
Clown's
 nether force. The guard attack him hoping to get a promotion if he kills Flame. The guard dies and Flame picks up his netherite chestplate. He has no time to wear it as he is quickly ambushed by another 2 guards also working for Clown. This time the guards are in full netherite armor. Flame uses his invisibility potion and runs into the lava escaping the guards. Luckily, the guards don't follow.

Flame makes an errand to 
Redstone Town
 to gather materials to build a redstone wolf machine. Flame builds a wolf machine. Flame travels back to his old base and this time, he kills all the 
Skullhound Bandits
 garrisoned there, including their leader: CraftedJoker. Flame picks up their loot including a netherite helmet, netherite leggings and netherite boots which is enough for him  to get a full set of Netherite Armor.

Flame goes to 
Capital City
 to question a citizen to learn about Wemmbu's whereabouts. There, he learns that Wemmbu died.



Trivia


The video was originally called I Became Powerful on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP before being changed to I Became Powerful on the Unstable SMP and then being reverted before being changed to I Became Powerful on a Hardcore Minecraft Server.

title: I Became a Bounty Hunter on the Unstable SMP
content:
I Became a Bounty Hunter on the Unstable SMP














Season


2






Episode


42






Upload date


Sep 12, 2025






POV


SpokeIsHere






Arcs


The BAT Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


Leow0ok
Mapicc
FlameFrags
Wemmbu
SmileyyMC
PlanetLord
TREELEAF2021














on the biggest hardcore minecraft server (Unstable SMP) I suddenly became an ASSASSIN! I needed to pull off traps, eliminate my targets, and of course... abuse MANIPULATION...





I Became a Bounty Hunter on the Unstable SMP
 is the 69th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


It all started when the invisible assassins ambushed 
Spoke
, 
Leow0ok
 and 
Mapicc
. They hurdle towards the ground only to find themselves saved by powdered snow under some carpets. They had survived a 100 block fall due to the carpets and powdered snow. Spoke and Mapicc discover that Leow0ok; the player they had been with, was the one who orchestrated  the whole trap. Leow0ok had betrayed them just to hand  them over to the bandits or so they thought. Spoke guesses that Leo had been paid about 64 diamonds for Spoke and some copper for Mapicc. Mapicc takes offense and says 1000 diamonds for him (Mapicc). Leo says Spoke should drop his Riptide III trident but Spoke makes a pitiful attempt at escape and Leo threatens to kill Mapicc. Mapicc makes a bluff that he could 10v1 them. Spoke decides he isn't going to argue with the guy who has 5 hit-men. Spoke drops the trident.  Leo makes an ominous laugh.

Leo says if they need food they'll  give it to them but if they try to run, they'll kill them. Spoke and Mapicc follow  them to the new and improved 
BAT Headquarters 2.0
. Spoke finds out that they weren't getting killed but rather they're being trained if  they're truly worthy of being a member of  
The Bounty Assassin Team
. Spoke's first mission is to find and kill the person who griefed and destroyed over 30 bases; 
ApexPoint
. Spoke has  to find him in the glitchy 
Amplified
. But Spoke had a plan : he places furnaces in the terrain and checks them an hour later as furnaces only smelt if there's a nearby player; effectively cutting the searching time by half. 

Using this, Spoke finally finds ApexPoint's base; a cramped obsidian box with a mooshroom, an enchanting table, 6 mangrove logs and finally ApexPoint. ApexPoint is preoccupied listening to YouTube Shorts or in other words, ApexPoint is AFK. Spoke carts ApexPoint but he lives  the initial blast and Spoke is tranced into a 1v1 against him but Spoke is drastically under geared compared to him. ApexPoint makes a terrible joke about everything he does is Amplified including his health. Spoke notices a pattern; he holds up his shield everytime Spoke places a rail. This would make sense to block a TNT minecart explosion but Spoke does a switch-a-roo. He places down a pot on top a rail. Since pots a feature where if you right-click on it you can store items. Using this mechanic Spoke places a pot and ApexPoint accidentally places his sword into the pot and Spoke breaks the pot successfully stealing the sword  from ApexPoint. ApexPoint, stunned is now half disarmed with only his Netherite Axe. ApexPoint decides he is going to run via his escape tunnel and Spoke loses him. 

Leo comes over to inspect Spoke's work. Spoke makes up some fake evidence but overall Leo normally wouldn't give it a pass but to an extent, Spoke did a good job and was successful on disarming the enemy. But in the time Spoke took to complete one, his opponents: 
SmileyyMC
 and 
PlanetLord
 did 2 and 3 missions respectively. Spoke tried  to continue his missions normally but it wasn't working as Smileyy stole Spoke's kill. In Spoke's building mission it was also a catastrophe. Spoke realizes his opponent: PlanetLord had made a better tower than him. Spoke complains about that his home is worse than Smileyy's and Planet as Smileyy has a bed and chests, Planet has all of those and on top of that, he also has flowers while Spoke has none of that luxury. Smileyy respectfully asks Spoke to quiet down as he is struggling to read his next mission due to Spoke's complaints.

Spoke tests his new idea to get out of cobwebs quickly: an Efficiency V, Unbraking III, Mending shears as in his last fight against ApexPoint, he was afraid that his pet fish George Junior would die. Spoke then shows off his drain kit which has 17 stacks of cobwebs or  1088 cobwebs alone, 4 sponge, 4 stacks of empty buckets or 64 buckets, and 2 stacks of chorus fruit or 128 chorus fruit. 

Spoke decides  to try and complete his next one. He meets a player named 
DrinkHotdogwater
 and asks him to clear some trees. Spoke asks him  if he could use a flint & steel but the player refuses replying with "Fire is  too dangerous". To the player's dismay, Spoke ignores him and lights the trees on fire but the fire quickly spiraled out of control. Spoke then meets a full gold player whose name is 
TREELEAF2021
 whose base had been exploded, griefed and lit on fire by none  other than ApexPoint. 

Spoke then meets ApexPoint on top the roof of that poor player's tower. Spoke and ApexPoint fight again as ApexPoint demands for his sword. Spoke drains ApexPoint 2 times as TREELEAF2021 cries. Spoke then drains ApexPoint a 3rd time. After a while Spoke is knocked off and he pops a Totem of Undying which saves his life from  the fall. Spoke realises his boots broke. Spoke tries to run but as he is running Spoke formulates a plan to get his point. But as he forms a plan his helmet breaks. Spoke crafts an iron helmet and iron boots and trances ApexPoint into fighting him again. Spoke lures ApexPoint to BAT hq to finish him off but as he is doing that, Spoke's leggings break and he crafts a new pair of iron leggings to replace his diamond ones. Spoke realises Ender Pearls are the items that could ruin his plan. So he tries to make ApexPoint waste as many as possible. Spoke runs to the top of a mountain and then from a water source he Trident-Pearls and with that, he pearls over 500 blocks. Leo asks Spoke how did the mission go. Spoke then lies his way by convincing Leo that ApexPoint is now deceased.

Spoke then says he is only losing by 2 missions to Smileyy and 3 missions to PlanetLord. Spoke got word that they were helping each other out by teaming. Spoke with "no other choice" disguises himself with invisibility and sits on a mountain waiting for 
FlameFrags
; the most wanted target of BAT. Spoke drops Flame a netherite ingot which peaks Flame's interest. Spoke then asks Flame to get him potions for  more. Spoke then says he found it from Smileyys chest; while flame was out getting the stolen potions, Spoke had  to do some more missions too like trapping the notorious trapper; 
fruitguppy4
. Spoke kills him as the trapper accidentally is blown into his own  obsidian box. The next mission was when 
ironezekiel
 asked Spoke to create Minecraft's most secure base. Spoke lowkey just made a moat of lava around a house and called it a day. 
The Executive
 appears again and tries to talk to Spoke but Spoke just runs away effectively ignoring him. Spoke then got word that Flame had completed his mission so Spoke stole Smileyy's Enchanted Golden Apple. Spoke then asks Flame to get him a Happy Ghast for more riches. Flame agrees. Spoke's next mission was to trap another trapper which he did by knocking  the trapper into his own pitfall trap. Spoke then asks Leo for some training but Spoke didn't care about getting better but he simply cared about getting closer to the leader of BAT: Leo. Spoke asks Leo for the highest priority target and as expected Leo answers Flame. Spoke realises he could've lured Flame into a death trap but Flame has proven he can survive anything thrown at him.  TREELEAF2021 comes with tidings for Spoke for defending his base. Spoke asks the player to bring him Mjölnir. Spoke sneaks into the knowledge library and he learns about Flame's rival: 
Wemmbu
. Spoke gives Flame a beacon. Flame obviously enraged he didn't get good loot attacks Spoke and Spoke escapes via escape route but before escaping Spoke drops Flame a book telling him to kill the members of the 
Skullhound Bandits
 and bring back their shields as evidence of  their deaths. Spoke then gives a lodestone compass to TREELEAF2021 to lure wemmbu to a specific set of coordinates that is supposedly belonged to the Stash of 
The Invisible Mafia
. Spoke asks Leo for some for Netherite Helmet, Netherite Boots, and Netherite Leggings. TREELEAF2021 gives Spoke "Mjolnir" which is just a Loyalty III, Channeling trident.  Once Flame retrieved the shields Flame was given the same set of coordinates as the Lodestone compass given to TREELEAF2021. Spoke goes full invisible and follows them.

Flame and Wemmbu duke it out. In the battle Spoke steals a shulker belonging to Flame as 'proof' of his death. Spoke then says he killed Flame to Leow0ok. Leo buys it.



Trivia


The video's original title was "I Survived as a Hardcore Assassin".

title: I Became a Minecraft Combat Master
content:
I Became a Minecraft Combat Master














Episode


117






Upload date


Feb 27, 2026






POV


FlameFrags






Arcs


The Kingdoms Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


TeamKalal
Lomedy
LettuceK
Twirps
Willsion
Spongs
4CVIT














I am a Minecraft Combat Master; a master of every weapon.





I Became a Minecraft Combat Master
 is the 117th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


FlameFrags
 has become a Minecraft combat master, having mastered every weapon there is. His next step is to become a Minecraft combat grandmaster, a fighter with no weakness. On the Unstable SMP, he is nowhere near ready for this journey and needs a base, so him and his best friend, 
Lomedy
, go back to his old base to try and fix it. Lomedy is disgusted at how bad the outside of his base looks. When they enter the actual base, it appears untouched, only being affected by the Law-themed walls, but then an invisible player in full netherite comes out and pulls a level and blows up the entire base. The person drinks milk and reveals to be a random player named HernandoDomin3_. He says he heard Flame is trying to train to become a combat grandmaster and asks Flame to fight him. Flame thinks it's a waste of time fighting this guy, but because the guy is so hesitant, Flame pots up and combos the guy, barely giving him the chance to get a hit on Flame. After four totem pops, Hernando runs away.

Flame and Lomedy begin reconstructing their base, Flame clears out the debris from past battles with The Law while Lomedy builds a new home for the two of them. In the distance, 
The Law
 horn is blown and a Law commander walks up to Flame and gives him a weekly newspaper. One page sticks out in particular, it mentions how more players than usual have been spotted with a certain shield pattern, this could be foreshadowing about 
arachn1d_
's attempt of trying to rule the server. The commander says that Flame's not wanted under their new leadership and tells him if he ever needs anything, just ask since they're neighbors. Flame remembered that The Law base was built in 24 hours, and so he asks for a group of lawmen to help clear out the debris. The commander explains how the lawmen will build, but appliances will have to be handled themselves, so Flame and Lomedy head to 
Merchant City
 to get potion materials. When they walk in, a player overhears them talking about nether items and says they haven't received shipment and needs to wait at the portal. Flame and Lomedy start getting shot with arrows with effects, Flame looks behind and sees 
Spongs
 and 
Willsion
 pretending to hide behind a tree and breaking it. The shipment arrives and Flame overpays for nether items and they leave back to their base, Spongs and Willsion follow them, but Flame gets them to stop. Knowing that the lawmen builds at a fast rate, they come back to a huge base fully built. 

Flame says The Law can protect his base when he's not there, but thinks it needs to be more fortified in case they aren't able to. Spongs and Willsion appear in front of them and is interested in helping them build traps around the base. They mess around the entire time and WIllsion asks Flame to get redstone materials. Although they came to Flame's base and demands Flame to get materials, Flame decides to do so to get peace and quiet away from Spongs. Spongs follows along and ragebaits him, Spongs stumbles across a group of players and walks up in front of them. They begin surrounding them and demands for Flame and Spongs to drop their items, Spongs gives them whatever random items he has in his inventory and Flame refuses to do so and walks away. This causes the group of players to attack Spongs, Flame tells him to turtle master while Flame preps for the fight. Flame uses his crossbow and TNT minecarts in this fight and kills all of them. Flame and Spongs then arrive at Redstone City, Spongs continues to ragebait Flame and gets told to be quiet. Flame finds 
4CVIT
 and trades a few diamond armor sets and a netherite sword for two redstone kits. After the trade, he doesn't find Spongs anywhere and assumes that he may have went back to the base, so Flame heads back.

Willsion and Lomedy show Flame a fall trap they made right in front of the base, Flame then asks Lomedy to build an XP farm so he can mend his gear. After Flame fixes his armor, he wonders why Spongs hasn't come back yet, then in the distance, he sees Spongs getting chased by even more players. Flame asks Lomedy for his mace to help deal with the players since TNT minecarts would destroy his base, and quickly kills off the group of players. Now that they almost have everything, the last thing Flame needs is wolves, but requires cows to breed them, so Flame and Lomedy head to 
Capital City
. They get stopped by a player saying Flame isn't welcome in Capital City, Flame has a flashback of him hitting a player off when this happened before, and he decides to spare the person and digs through the cobblestone wall. Lomedy is surprised Flame didn't kill him, Flame says even if he made the player believe he's a combat master, it doesn't matter what he says unless he proves that he is good. They find a few cows wandering around Capital City and decide to take them. On their way back home, Lomedy mentions how Flame dislikes Spongs and WIllsion, but says Willsion taught him a lot about trapping and takes an interest in trapping. Flame says he wouldn't enter that realm, but thinks they could combine PvP with trapping in certain cases, like if the fight is unwinnable and there are way too many players. When they arrive back at the base, a lawman stands in front of the base and informs the two of a wanted criminal around the area and they're after Flame. Flame thanks him for the information, as well as for the base. Lomedy starts breeding the cows and Flame builds his 
orbital dog cannon
 machine. Flame tells Lomedy to hide and to let him deal with whoever the assassin is.

Flame waits in the middle of his base, arachn1d_ stands up on top of his base and says he's been awaiting. Arachn1d says Flame killing his group of players was the worst mistake of his life, Flame tries to make excuses to get away from this. Arachn1d says his base will become his territory soon and there will be nothing to stop him, not The Law, not a king, not anything. Arachn1d says this wouldn't be the last time Flame would see him and to keep looking over his shoulder and walks away. A group of players with the spider shield pattern gets to Flame's base, Flame tries to reason with them, but they were hesitant on killing him to repay for the deaths of the players he killed earlier. Flame pulls his orbital dog cannon and kills half the players. Flame goes up his base and grabs another fishing rod from a shulker and sets off another round of wolves. This time, he kills off everybody except one who runs away, who he doesn't bother to chase. Lomedy comes out of hiding and asks if they'll get attacked more often and would Flame become evil again, Flame says he wouldn't kill people for no reason, just only focusing on becoming a combat grandmaster and that he's only getting attacked because of his reputation. Flame says because Lomedy wants to get better at trapping and he wants to get better at combat, they'll fight for survival and they'll use traps and wolves to fight those wars, and when there's not conflict, Flame will seek out more trainers. 



Trivia


This thumbnail suggests he grew throughout Season 2. In 
SOLO Player VS World's Largest Minecraft Server
, Flame was destroyed by 
Wemmbu
 and did not stand a chance.


The video is recorded in 4K, whereas other videos are recorded in 1440p.

title: I Became a Minecraft Killer
content:
I Became a Minecraft Killer














Episode


107






Upload date


Jan 25, 2026






POV


Wemmbu






Arcs


The Kings Arc
















it's time to ban minecraft's smartest player





I Became a Minecraft Killer
 is the 107th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


The episode begins where 
Wemmbu
's previous episode left off, 
Parrot
 stands right behind Wemmbu and 
eggchan
, wanting help from Wemmbu to take 
LettuceK
 down. Wemmbu wants to ban Parrot, as he's the one that revealed Wemmbu's secret identity to the server, which has caused a chain reaction to lead him to the situation he's at right now. Wemmbu knocks Parrot off into the water to talk to egg privately, egg says Parrot's offer is good, but Wemmbu says Lettuce would become king regardless and wants to kill Parrot, but not right now due to their lack of resources. Wemmbu tells egg to take his trident and to follow them from behind while he goes with Parrot.

They go towards the island with the dolphin tunnel leading to 
Capital City
, Parrot says they could fight off the lawmen, but Wemmbu says he can't, so Parrot gives Wemmbu invis and covers up to get all the lawmen off the island. There aren't enough dolphins in the tunnel, so Wemmbu goes out into the 
Great Sea
 to grab a dolphin and bring back. Wemmbu struggles to get the dolphin across the fence, Parrot says there's extra in the tunnel, so they head off. The guards get back onto the island and sees them as they leave. While traveling back to Capital City, more nametags can be seen coming from the other direction, so they exit the dolphin tunnel and dig into a wall and surfaces. Parrot says he has a happy ghast with loot in the cherry blossom biome, but he looks at a chest that detects any movement nearby and sees that it had been set off over a hundred times, they see that The Law held a stakeout at that very location and has to go off track. At a village, Parrot tries to tell Wemmbu to crouch, but it's already too late. Wemmbu alerted the three lawmen that were there, he tries to kill them, but Parrot says to run, and Wemmbu quickly realizes it was a bad idea to fight when one hit took half his health.

Wemmbu surfaces and Parrot comes up shortly after, Parrot tells him that they're going to a river, when they get close, Parrot checks to see if this is the right location. Egg whispers to Wemmbu and says that he's been following them as planned and that he joined 
The Law
 to blend in. Egg asks why he hasn't killed Parrot yet, Wemmbu explains that Parrot may have a contingency plan. Egg heads back into the cave he came from and leaves, Wemmbu goes towards Parrot, and they make it to a nautilus shop owned by 
CoinMonke
. Coin questions why Parrot is working with Wemmbu and says he doesn't trust Wemmbu, but Parrot explains that this is the only way to win the election, and so Coin calms down. Parrot asks for the fastest way to go back to spawn, Coin explains the plan as Wemmbu wanders around. They then get on the nautilus and begin traversing the river. In the middle of their expedition, lawmen had come from the opposite direction, and the two have to run back onto land. Wemmbu kills a lawman, but wasn't able to pick up the loot, Parrot tells Wemmbu to keep running. They stumble across a pig with a saddle, Parrot leads it and tells Wemmbu to tower up. Just as the lawmen are about to corner them, Parrot asks for Wemmbu's elytra, but he doesn't want to give it up, so Parrot makes Wemmbu fly off as he sits on the pig instead, and teaches him how to fly infinitely without using rockets. Wemmbu's elytra breaks in the process, but they had gotten far enough for The Law to stop chasing them.

Parrot says The Law might not know where they are anymore, Wemmbu questions how The Law knew where they were, Parrot says they knew they were coming from that direction and is covering most of Law territory. They keep traveling and reach a snowy biome where they find a massive manmade mountain. Parrot tells Wemmbu to stay behind as he checks it out, Wemmbu mines ice in the meantime and egg catches up with him. They talk for a minute, and Wemmbu says egg should leave before Parrot sees them together, egg asks if he's still set on killing Parrot, Wemmbu says he doesn't really care. Egg heads off and Wemmbu goes towards the mountain, Parrot shoots from behind to signal where he is. Wemmbu keeps noticing that Parrot stops and veers off while they're walking, he asks Parrot for the armor, and Parrot gives up the armor and calls out the inivisible player following them. 
SargeLAW
, a commander of The Law, reveals himself and starts chasing them with his group of lawmen. Wemmbu keeps instigating SargeLAW and says he can't kill him even if he was in three-fourths diamond armor. Wemmbu and the sergeant begin to fight, Parrot gets Wemmbu new armor from egg, who was in the crowd with all the other lawmen. Parrot splashes invis in a crowd of all the lawmen, Wemmbu switches to a Law shield and disguises himself with them. Wemmbu finds egg standing away from SargeLAW, who begun killing off his own lawmen. Parrot finds them and they start made it to the end of the Smuggler's Pass. Four lawmen find them, Wemmbu says he's going to kill them and tells egg to strength him up. As soon as the lawmen die, Parrot says they should head back to spawn, Wemmbu says he's going to kill him. title: I Became a Prisoner on the Unstable SMP
content:
I Became a Prisoner on the Unstable SMP














Season


2






Episode


63






Upload date


Nov 22, 2025






POV


Wemmbu






Arcs


The Kings Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


ParrotX2
SpokeIsHere
FlameFrags
LettuceK
loppezz
PrinceZam
Fantst
Baablu
















Why are there 5000 players here?!





I Became a Prisoner on the Unstable SMP
 is the 90th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


The episode begins in the end of 
2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Players
 where 
Wemmbu
 attempts to escape 
LettuceK
. He almost dies and Lettuce clears his inventory. Lettuce imprisons Wemmbu and tells him to put on a prisoner skin and assigns a cell for him. He also explains that during the night, all prisoners must be in their cell and on top of their bed and if he doesn't listen to the guards he will go to solitary. Lettuce tells 
loppezz
 to guard Wemmbu's cell. Wemmbu tries to break the cell and gets caught by loppezz. The next morning, loppezz assigns all the prisoners to do a task to clean the floor but they'll get fed before the job. Wemmbu encounters 
Baablu
 and 
Fantst
 in the prison too. Wemmbu tells them that they have to settle their differences if they want to escape. A guard emerges from the walls and warns them about escaping and punishes them by forcing them to work in a ravine.

Loppezz gives the prisoners an item check to make sure they aren't smuggling any items. They also receive a wooden pickaxe. They try to smuggle items, but the guards are suspicious of them. Fantst then covers for Wemmbu and Baablu as they try to make an exit for it, loppezz quickly catches up and brings them back inside. Baablu and Fantst gets sent back and Lettuce tells Wemmbu that he has a special assignment. They start heading towards spawn where nobody is to be seen. When the make it to the Northern Council, Lettuce instructs Wemmbu to sit in a corner until the event starts. When it starts, Lettuce begins his speech about the server needing a king, marking a new era of the Unstable SMP. Once the speech is over, they begin to head back to the prison. An invisible player follows them from behind and soon after splashes Wemmbu with invisibility, giving him the opportunity to run and escape. Wemmbu makes it to a base and loots it for food, the owner of the base returns and sees Wemmbu's invis particles and asks who he is. With no time left before 
The Law
 came, Wemmbu tries to get them to cover for him, but they snitch and Lettuce captures him. Loppezz corners him with iron bars, and while none of the guards are looking, Wemmbu gets on a horse that was in reach and attempts to escape, but the horse is too slow to outrun them. 

They make it back to the prison and Lettuce runs an inventory check on Wemmbu again. He leads Wemmbu to his office and reveals he knew Wemmbu smuggled in items and forces him to give him the items. Lettuce then enacts a new protocol because of Wemmbu's escape attempt and brings the rest of the prisoners into the office. He forces all of the prisoners to put on curse of binding armor, Wemmbu is then put in solitary confinement. As Wemmbu sits in his cell, the lights suddenly go out. An invisible player sneaks up to the window and they drink milk, it is revealed to be 
Spoke
. Spoke turns out to be the invisible player from earlier that helped Wemmbu. He proposes a deal to let Wemmbu out if he helps him using the orbital strike cannons he has left. Wemmbu thinks Spoke's only using him for his powers and would be imprisoned as a slave for Spoke, and declines the offer. Spoke says the offer is still available if Wemmbu does want to escape before heading off, remarking that he would like to see how Wemmbu escapes.



Trivia


This is PrinceZam's first appearance in an Unstable video in over a year, the last one being 
How I Solved Minecraft's Largest Escape Room
.


This video's original title was "I Became a Prisoner on the Unstable SMP". The other title used was "I Became a Minecraft Prisoner".


The featured creators in the scene showing the players are Parrot, Theo, Jaden, Flame(invis), Leo, Spoke, Horace, Yungwilx (without his skin)
