title: I Got Hunted by the Minecraft Mafia
content:
I Got Hunted by the Minecraft Mafia














Season


1






Episode


19






Upload date


Oct 5, 2024






POV


SpokeIsHere






Arcs


The Invisible Mafia Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


Mapicc
ashswagg
MinuteTech
PlanetLord
TheRealSquiddo
Baconnwaffles0
ManePear
loppezz
TheSorta
Arcn
Cristalit
Falcuno
Tai
Novagriddy
Naparizel
Dol9hin
RealReeon
R4trick
ParrotX2
Wemmbu
Derapchu
JumperWho
Leow0ok
roshambogames
PrinceZam
JamatoP














The MAFIA
 is after me. If I don’t give them my exploits, then they will destroy everything I love. Will we be able to survive the relentless invisible hunters with the help of our new friends? Or will I give in and reveal the exploits to 
Ash
...





I Got Hunted by the Minecraft Mafia
 is the 19th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


Spoke
 and 
Mapicc
 get found by the 
invisible players
 that were hunting them earlier. They get chased by the invisible players as they mine through the nether, Mapicc gets most of his armour broken by the invisible players and they almost die until 
MinuteTech
 shows up and starts killing them with a mace. Minute confronts them asking why they are fighting the invisible players and asks them how they even survived getting attacked. Minute further asks them why 
The Invisible Mafia
 was even attacking them. They don't know. They beg Minute to place an ender chest and they take resources. Minute asks them how many were there and they answer 50. Minute tells them to run. They dig up to the nether roof and run on the nether roof. Spoke asks Minute on how does he know about the Invis Mafia. They learn that Minute was actually apart of 
Ashswagg's
 Mafia. They learn about the Mafia's past that it didn't used to be so violent. But when Ashswagg came in power, he weaponized the members and made them set a stasis and thats when Minute left before he was forced to set a stasis. He had been on the run ever since. Mapicc suggests rolling up to 
Mafia City
 and killing Ashswagg. Minute says it is a miracle Mapicc isn't dead and it is a horrendous idea. Minute advises them to set up traps and normal PvP combat wouldn't cut it. Minute asks them if they have any friends and they answer they have 
TheRealSquiddo
 and 
Jepexx
 as friends but they don't fight, rendering them useless. They land at a remote location. Minute tells them he isn't looking for teammates but Spoke and Mapicc try to convince him on why they should team up. Minute thinks having teammates is a liability. Minute leaves and tells them he isn't looking for teammates. Mapicc tells Spoke to follow Minute and they invis and take off all their armor. They go through a portal. They follow Minute. They mine into Minute's stash. They are caught by Minute. Minute tries to kill them and Minute tells them reasons on why he shouldn't kill them. Spoke and Mapicc give them reasons like they're respectful, kind etc... but the convincing one was when Spoke threatened to dox the coordinates of the stash. Mapicc and Spoke tries to convince Minute to join their team. Minute ponders on whether he should move again. Minute gears them up with potions, golden apples, gear, bottles of enchanting, ender chests, enchanted golden apples and food. Spoke tells Minute to meet up at his hideout. Spoke says he has never been jumped in this hideout; and they even call Minute a friend but Minute doesn't see them as allies. They go to the nether roof and fly over there. They give Minute a tour of 
Spawn
 and Spoke's base. They come out but realise the front is blocked by obsidian so they try mining out but then they're attacked by 4 invisible players. They fight them. In the fight, Spoke keeps demanding Mapicc to mend his elytra and Mapicc gives  him the bottles of enchanting but Spoke misses. Minute maces one of them and the other 3 flee. They shot a white firework signaling retreat. Minute leads them to one of his traps. Minute gives them a few fireworks as Spoke had ran out completely. The Invisible players reappear attacking Mapicc. This time, there's a 
Copper-Trimmed
 player too. Minute hits one of them into a head-hitter trap. The trimmed player escaped.  

They thank Minute for helping them survive. Minute explains the trimmed player is a higher ranking player than the normal untrimmed foot soldier meaning Ashswagg is sending higher skilled players after them. Minute says he's down to team with them if they get better at surviving and PvP. They rejoice and says they could invite Jepexx. Minute asks who's Jepexx and they said they replied with the strongest player who formed the "Beacon Civilization" . Minute asks what happened to the 
The Ice Castle
 and they said it got 
Orbital Strike Cannon'ed
. Minute says they have to recruit more players. Minute gives them 3 pairs of coordinates and a pair of leather boots for the meantime. Minute says he's going to dig-up some old contacts and advises them to do the same. Spoke and Mapicc says its wraps for Ashswagg when they find 
their contacts.
 They realise nearly everyone hates them as Ashswagg framed them for destroying all the farms. They realise Ash isn't going to stop until either Spoke gives Ash the exploits (Impossible), Mapicc is dead, or Spoke's armor breaks which is his last armor given by 
JamatoP
 his 
illegal armor
. They realise Jepexx is not going to be at his home because thy orbital striked it, and his other base got blown up. They see an invisible player watching them from the distance. They start scheming a plan to kill the mafia member and they attack only to find out it was 
PlanetLord
. Planet says he isn't apart of the mafia and is watching them. Planet explains that 
they
 (here Planet thinks its Spoke and Mapicc) blew up Planet's flower farm. Spoke and Mapicc says they couldn't have blown it up. Mapicc asks Spoke on whether to recruit PlanetLord. Spoke and Mapicc form a plan to recruit Planet. Spoke apologizes for destroying his vaults but they were duped items. Spoke requests Planet for help; and explains they're currently being attacked by "
A
" and Planet says is this A person evil. They said that A blew up the farm. They ask Planet to whether he wants to join their team and Planet agrees. They find a Curse of Binding book and they trade 12 emeralds and a book for a Curse of Binding book. They trick Planet into wearing a Curse of Binding turtle shell. Although it does look like he's wearing a swimming cap.

They decide they're going to recruit Squiddo next but before they could even get out, they're ambushed by a 
Diamond-Trimmed
 Player. The trimmed player shoots Planet with a spectral arrow making Planet glow. Hundreds of Mafia members storm and they start mining in an attempt to escape but they then try elytra'ing out but fail due to the lack of resources and they run of one of the coordinates Minute gave to them. Planet doesn't have a chestplate nor a helmet. They try going through a nether portal but the invis players break it before they could go through. Mapicc gave Planet his armour in an attempt to save Planet. They realise they're focusing Planet because he was shot by the trimmed player. They realise they have to walk another 1000 blocks. They make it to the trap and pull it causing only 1 to keep pursuit. Spoke tells them to try and find a water cave and escape. They'll meet up later. They hide in a lava pool but eventually are caught. Planet escapes but Mapicc and Spoke are unable to. They eventually escape and meet up inside a desert temple. They mine away in the nether, They meet up at 
Wemmbu's
 bunker. Spoke asks Planet if he still had connections with 
Roshambogames
 and 
Leow0ok
 but Planet replies with kinda. Spoke asks Planet if he has more connections as Spoke is hated by over half the server. Planet says he's going to recruit a surprise member and leaves. Spoke thinks are there any other players other than Squiddo? Spoke thinks the 
ParrotX2
 group of 
Derapchu
 and 
JumperWho
 but immediately rejects it as they tried to kill Mapicc. Spoke also thinks about recruiting 
ManePear
. He does a flashback on what happened in 
I Bankrupted Minecraft's Richest Civilization
 where they distracted Mane. Spoke lures Mane over to the Ice Castle. Spoke gives Mane a proposition to join their team. Mane asks Spoke on why he needs the team and Spoke replies with that he is currently getting hunted by thousands of invisible players and that's the reason why they need Mane's help. Mane thinks they're trolling and doesn't believe them. Spoke decides to show Mane what the invisible players did to his house and the battlefield. Spoke asks Mane if he believes them but Mane asks them if he could pot up and attack them. Mane distracts them and he pots up. They threaten to kill "Cedric" if Mane doesn't stop attacking them and Mane stops instantaneously begging them not to. But Mane then faked it out and he keeps attacking them. They banana-cart Mane popping one of his totems. They run away. Spoke tells Mapicc to meet up at the Squiddo portal with sheep. Mane breaks the portal before they could get through. They try again and this time they get through and escape.  

They are then ambushed by 
a Diamond-Trimmed
 and 
a Gold-Trimmed Player
. They head towards one of Minute's traps. They use the leather boots that Minute gave them to stand on the powdered snow while the trimmed players fell into the trap. They decide to go recruit Squiddo. Squiddo says Spoke and Mapicc blew up her farms but Spoke and Mapicc said they got framed by the mafia. Squiddo says she's going to think about it; while she's thinking, Spoke and Mapicc rummage through her barrels searching for valuables. Spoke says anytime they try to prove of the invisible player's existence, they don't show up. Spoke says Squiddo has to believe they didn't do it and if Squiddo wants to get revenge for the destruction of her farms, she has to join them. She says she doesn't trust them anymore. Spoke and Mapicc says to try thinking again and almost drowns her. She thinks they decimated her house and was not natural events. Spoke tries to persuade her again by telling her even though she isn't good at combat, but she's good at building. They're interrupted by the same diamond-trimmed player approaching them. Spoke says for Squiddo to elytra out but she doesn't have neither an elytra nor firework rockets so Mapicc gave his elytra and firework rockets to Squiddo. Squiddo shows up and drops a spare elytra for Mapicc. Spoke and Mapicc try engaging the diamond-trimmed player but he shoots a black firework rocket and they ran away. They decide they're going to meet up with Minute again. They decide they're going to send the coordinates to Planet and Squiddo and they're hoping Minute assembled a god team consisting of 
ClownPierce
, 
FlameFrags
 and even convinced ManePear.

They decide to regear; while they're regearing, a Gold-Trimmed player ambushes them with a lot of wolves. They decide to run as more untrimmed players show up. They run towards a railway and run. Spoke and Mapicc run and dig into a wall but are caught by a gold-trimmed player. Spoke runs down into the cave but Mapicc is nowhere to be seen. Spoke meets Minute there. Minute asks Spoke on the fact that he recruited any players. Spoke says he recruited 2 players and Minute asks can they fight. Spoke says they can hit a Mafia player with a sword. Planet, 
Baconnwaffles0
, and Squiddo were the new recruits. Spoke says they look better than they look. Spoke says they were looking for more players and not skill! Minute asks Bacon on how many fights he has been in and Bacon says "I've lost count". Spoke says Squiddo is an awesome builder and has lots of contacts. Squiddo says she's been fighting the great Spider war. Spoke asks Minute on the fact whether he has gear for them. They take Minute's gear. Minute leads Spoke to a person who might have information on Mapicc's whereabouts. Spoke reveals his plan on how to take down the mafia. Spoke reveals that Ashswagg was after him because of Spoke's knowledge of exploits. Spoke says they might have to use the exploits to beat the mafia. Minute says he's not an exploiter. They hear mining noises and Minute instructs them to crouch to hide their nametags. Bacon runs away. They find a untrimmed 
player
 that Minute ruthlessly murders. They try to stop Minute from killing him but eventually fail. Minute says they have to get out of there. Planet said Minute killed a little kid and that's mean. Minute says this is for their safety. Spoke says he mentioned the existence of an outpost. Spoke says he wants to show up at the front door as that's the most likely location of Mapicc's whereabouts. Spoke is convinced Mapicc is at the outpost. Spoke asked Squiddo if she ever built an outpost for Ash but Squiddo said no but Ash gave her a pair of coordinates a while back. Minute seems increasingly more concerned as that means she had worked with Ashswagg before. Minute says this is a trap. Spoke thinks they should go there. Eventually Spoke and Planet convince Minute that they should go there. Spoke asks if Squiddo has the coordinates on her but she doesn't so they go back to her castle. They notice a diamond-trimmed player and Minute says for them to run as they have a mace. They run before they even engage. Minute says there's multiple although Spoke so far, has only seen one-at-a-time. Spoke asks Minute to drop him fireworks due to his depleting resources. They fly over to Squiddo's castle. They notice an army on the ground that's firing on them and pursuing them. They fly over the 
remains of The Zam Empire
. They leave while Minute and Spoke hold them off. Minute says Spoke should escape while he escapes. Spoke flies over the mafia's spawn prison. Spoke recircles over the remains of the Zam Empire. Spoke escapes by digging into the sandstone. Spoke messages Minute his coords and Minute regears him up. 

They meet up with Planet and Squiddo at Squiddos' castle. The coordinates were not on a paper or book but instead it was attached to a ocelot. 49984.36, 63.49, 49962.91.  Minute says that is a trap but they have no other choice. Minute says they have to spring the trap and have to persevere through it. Squiddo says she cannot follow them because she has to build for an anonymous person. Squiddo says they go investigate the coordinates and she'll go to her building operation and try to gain intel on the enemy. Minute asks Spoke to talk outside. Minute says he doesn't trust neither Planet nor Squiddo. Spoke says Planet is trustworthy and Squiddo is nice. Spoke says this is a trap but Squiddo is not in on it. Minute says whatever happens, don't do anything without telling him. Minute promises to get Mapicc back. Spoke takes some ender chests and totems from Squiddo in exchange for granite, andesite, and diorite. They travel 25,000 blocks to get there. Planet, Minute and Spoke decide to go to the coordinates which turned out to be a trap; Squiddo had betrayed. They got jumped by dozens diamond-trimmed players. Minute says for Spoke and Planet to escape while Minute fended them off. Due to this, Spoke and Planet escape. They realise they're the only ones left; Mapicc got captured; Minute probably got captured and Squiddo betrayed. Spoke also has no other options than to exploit. Spoke cannot give Ash the exploits because that'll end the server. Spoke also reveals that the exploits were bigger than duping. He also could've avoided this if Spoke didn't exploit in 
The Exploit Arc
. They roam around the server. Planet thinks Spoke is the only one who knew about it but Spoke says there was another 
player
 who taught him the exploits but he also warned Spoke to not use the exploits. Planet says they need to stop Ash but they really have to plans.

Spoke decides to start exploiting again even though Minute was against it. He schemes on getting stacked totems, bedrock, command blocks, and duping enchanted golden apples to defeat the mafia. Planet reluctantly agrees even though it is against his morals. Spoke says they'll begin with duplicating enchanted golden apples. They fly past a wonder and he told Planet he used to exploit under the wonders. They go to 
JamatoP's
 base which is now blown up. Spoke watches his old 
video
 on how to duplicate. He tries it himself only to find out the exploit was patched. Ash shows up mocking them for just finding out the exploits don't work anymore. Ash says Jamato showed him every exploit to find out that every exploit had been patched. The exploits and Spoke's worth to Ash was gone. Ash calls Planet "a little cotton ball". Ash reveals that Minute had joined the Mafia. Minute says he couldn't win the fight and therefore he was forced to join the mafia. Ash instructs Minute to kill them. Minute goes invisible and equips a diamond-trimmed chestplate and starts attacking them. They escape. Spoke says he's going to go as far as he can and go to the 
Far Lands
 and go into exile just like Jamato. Planet says Spoke should try finding Jamato. 

Spoke goes to a stronghold where he finds one of his stash of exploited mobs. There, he finds a mob with coordinates on it. He goes to the coordinates to find Jamato's second base. Although it was uninhabited, Spoke finds Jamato's will. He finds out Jamato is either dead or captured.

title: I Got Hunted by the World's Best Minecraft Player
content:
I Got Hunted by the World's Best Minecraft Player














Season


2






Episode


2






Upload date


Feb 17, 2025






POV


ParrotX2






Arcs


The Director Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


ItzRealMe
Leow0ok
JumperWho
Nufuli
Derapchu
DylPickleYT
RealReeon
Mixiku_
Naparizel
Hexatope














ItzRealMe
 is undisputedly the #1 ranked Minecraft player in the entire world. And he wants me dead... This is How I Got Hunted by the World's Best Minecraft Player.





I Got Hunted by the World's Best Minecraft Player
 is the 29th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


Upon exit of his house, 
Parrot
 finds a player named 
ItzRealMe
, the #1 best Minecraft Player in the world at PVP, who immediately attacks him. Parrot attempts to flee to an escape route, but finds it has been blocked up. However, the bounty hunters 
Leowook
, 
JumperWho
, 
Nufuli
, and 
Derapchu
 arrive with intent to kill Itz, though manage to escape by throwing a turtle master potion on him. The five flee to the nether, but when Parrot attempts to part ways, Leo tells him to come along back to their base, 
BAT Headquarters
—shaped like an infinity symbol and housing over thirty members—where they tell him it’s best to stay with them for now because if Itz is trying to kill Parrot, it’s likely he’ll chase him down, and BAT can kill Itz when he comes. Using automated chicken blasters, Parrot and Leo return to the former’s base to collect his remaining belongings. However, after finding that a chest beneath a tree now has one more dirt block than it did before, Parrot gets paranoid and leads Leo to the back of the house, explaining in voiceover that the pressure plate which opens his main door is connected to said chest, dropping another block in every time someone enters. If the infiltrant were to enter and exit, two blocks would be dropped, but since there is only one, it means someone is still inside. Looking through the back window, they do in fact find Itz stalking the front door. No longer caring about the items, Parrot and Leo leave. Since Itz is patient and likely won’t move, they devise a plan to build an enclosure around the house. 

In the meantime, Nufuli shows Parrot to his room "A5", a two story master sweet. He also explains that each of Leo’s close friends run their own team inside of BAT Headquarters. Jumper leads a spy team that keeps tabs on everything on the server. Derapchu’s team is “not worth explaining.” Nufuli himself is Leo’s right hand man, responsible for combat and base-related tasks.

After ensuring that Nufuli won’t tell Leo about this question, Parrot asks for the room number of the lead builder who will be overseeing the enclosure—C1. After Nufuli leaves, Parrot immediately gets to work on sending a private message to the builder, asking for suspended wall height to accommodate sand walls. Upon arrival at the trap, Parrot is pleased at the changes that have been made, and thus the group—Leo’s team as well as five additional invisible players—enter. They taunt Itz, and begin fighting. The sand walls then activate, and Parrot explains that he understood ten players would still not be enough to kill Itz, so he decided to shrink the playing field so that Itz cannot isolate any player or get away for long enough to restock. However, after Itz manages to mace five players, killing them, Parrot realizes that the tables have turned. No matter how many times they break his armor, he seems to replace them without needing a shulker. After returning to BAT Headquarters, Leo gets mad at Parrot for interfering with his plans, and that he should’ve said something because they are a team. Right before Parrot leaves to his room, Leo places him on house arrest, and under no circumstance will he do anything without first alerting someone, but Parrot disagrees by saying that he works alone.

He then leaves the base in the middle of the night with intent to do recon on Itz, only to be stopped by Leo who catches him in the chicken blaster room, and sternly says he shouldn’t be doing it alone, and the only reason he enforced communication is because they’re meant to be a team. After failing to convince Parrot to stay, Leo ends up coming with him. When asked what he’s going to do, Leo says he won’t intervene, but he will keep Parrot safe and help if help is required. Parrot coldly dismisses the latter, to which Leo mutters that “this isn’t how a team should work.” Upon being asked more questions, Parrot gets annoyed, and explains that during the prison building process, Parrot got one of Jumper’s lackeys to leave a fake postage box in the prison in hopes of Itz finding and picking it up, as it contains a fake set of coordinates and a map that Parrot can use to track him. However, as they near Itz’ location, his icon disappears, which means that he must know they’re here. After going fully invisible, Parrot and Leo spot an unfamiliar player named 
DylPickleYT
 on the shore and begin following them, discovering that he knows Itz and insists on being trained by him. Though Itz declines over and over, Dyl then says he has valuable information in exchange, thus pointing out Parrot and Leo who are spying on them. Parrot decides to fight and tells Leo not to get involved, not even taking the potions offered, but Leo begins helping anyway, knowing that Parrot will die otherwise. They begin using TNT minecarts to deal damage on Itz, popping two of his totems and forcing him to switch to mace attacks. At that, Parrot and Leo leave.

Upon a moment of reflection, Leo asks Parrot why he always wants to be alone, and Parrot, who asks if it seems like he’s trying to be, explains that after the war, two of his best friends were killed, and that he doesn’t want to put himself through that again. Leo understands, but he says having a team is better because when you’re part of one, you always have someone to watch your back and will help no matter what. He apologizes for getting mad about the sand trip, and extends Parrot an invitation to permanently stay at BAT Headquarters and work with the people there. However, Parrot grows hostile and says that the only reason they’re working together is for the common goal of killing Itz. Leo concedes and says that the offer will always stand. They return to headquarters where Parrot, once in his room, mutters about them thinking he’s stupid, and blames them for getting caught in the first place. However, his mailbox begins ringing. Instead of taking the message, he breaks the note block.

The next day, he receives mining fatigue, and discovers further that everybody is gone and Itz has arrived. With no way out, Parrot blocks the door to his suite and hides under the stairs, begging for help. Then he begins mining through the suite wall, hoping to reach the one beside it. Each suite is connected, so if he is able to break through enough of them, he will reach the airlock and be able to escape. He eventually reach the airlock, but just as he begins to mine out, Itz catches him. Knowing that his diamond pickaxe wouldn’t be able to mine faster than Itz’ netherite one, Parrot resigns, only to be saved by Leo and his team, who fly back and explode the airlock. Itz leaves. Leo then explains that they found Parrot through Jumper’s intelligence team. Overwhelmed by gratitude, Parrot apologizes for going behind their backs, and genuinely thanks everyone at BAT. Leo then welcomes him into the team.

While in his room, Parrot hears someone cough, and finds Itz standing above him. He quickly pulls the emergency button, but Itz tells him to relax by saying that since Parrot has a team now, it’s too much trouble to try and kill him. Parrot asks why he’s here and Itz explains that the reason he tried to kill him was because 
The Director
 told him to. He won’t try to kill Parrot anymore, but he does alert him that more people will be coming with the same intent, and tells him to run while he still can. Nufuli arrives right after Itz leaves, asking what happened, but Parrot lies and says he just accidentally clicked it, not fully trusting the team yet.



Trivia


This video has the first reference to 'the zone' as mentioned in Flame's 
I Got Trained By the World's Best Minecraft Player
. When the prison was built around Itz, Itz says that he was meditating, which is one of the steps to enter the zone.

Parrot and Leo fighting ItzRealMe

title: I Got Hunted by the World's Deadliest Assassin
content:
I Got Hunted by the World's Deadliest Assassin














Episode


128






Upload date


May 2, 2026






POV


Wemmbu






Arcs


The Kingdoms Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


ParrotX2
Dizzyu














im being hunted i dont have much time to type this message help





I Got Hunted by the World's Deadliest Assassin
 is the 128th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


Wemmbu
 begins the episode by telling the viewers he has lots of enemies who want to kill him for various reasons, unlike his friend 
Eggchan
, who is a pacifist and is liked by most players on the server, which confused the both of them when the 
invisible player
 from Wemmbu's last two videos comes to their front door saying they're going to take egg's life. Wemmbu wasn't going to let that happen and reminds them the last time they fought, it didn't end well for them. The player tells him if he stands in their way and the second he stands outside, he would die. Wemmbu steps out to figure out what the invisible player meant, when all of a sudden his totem instantly pops. The invisible player had gotten their hands on a railgun, jumps down on Wemmbu with a mace and pops Wemmbu a second time. Wemmbu realizes that, flies around and maces them, causing them to stasis out. Wemmbu is confused because the player was after egg, just as he says that, an explosion detonates right beneath him. The invisible player appears right where the crater is, ready for another fight, but not for long and tells Wemmbu they'll be back and stasises away again. Wemmbu eyes the railgun and flies over to blow it up.

They go back inside their base and question the player's true intentions, with no hesitation, Wemmbu hands egg over a stack of wind charges and his Crucible mace. Next, they need to find a way to track this player down, Wemmbu asks egg if he knows a way how, egg says no. Wemmbu says he has an idea and so they head over to 
Parrot
's castle. When they go up to Parrot, Wemmbu tells Parrot since he has experience tracking down mysterious players such as 
The Director
 and himself during the Fake Identity Arc, there's a new player going around trying to hunt egg down and wants Parrot's help to uncover this player's identity. Parrot tells them he's unable to help them since he's busy dealing with other issues and lacks the resources to hand over to them. Wemmbu says they need to lay low, so they sit outside of a tavern with other players around. In the meantime, they speculate who this player could be, they know this player owns a mace, no Elytra, has lots of stasises is, has decent amount of redstone knowledge, and could be anyone since they're invisible with a voice changer. A server interupts their conversation and tells them they can't loiter around and needs to buy a food or drink to sit there. Egg orders the most expensive item on the menu, being an enchanted golden apple. They try to come up with a plan, and it leads to nothing, egg says that they're cooked and he didn't want to believe that. The server comes back with their enchanted golden apples, egg eats it immediately just in case the assassin is already among them. Just as he says that, a group of players in full diamond and two netherite players jump egg and start killing random civilians. Wemmbu warns the players to run and to not get in the way of the fight, he ends up killing all of the players fighting. The server comes up to them before they leave asking for payment, Wemmbu tells him they'll pay it later and asks if he knows anything about the players that just attacked, and he says no.

Wemmbu asks what they should do now, egg says he has a plan, but it's unethical. He says to press F3 and says they're right outside of Parrot's kingdom, so Parrot has no reason to care to protect them. However, if the assassins go inside of the kingdom's vicinity, then it'd be a problem and would force Parrot to help. Wemmbu says he doesn't want Parrot's help since he didn't help them out earlier, and so he comes up with a better plan. They go on top of the statue where Wemmbu and 
Flame
's 
2v1000
 took place, Wemmbu says they're going to wait there until they're attacked. Egg uses all of his power to think and remember who these groups of players are, leading him to take off his armor to think, rearranging his blood flow to his brain, and resting in game and being vulnerable, all to say these players are just typical bandits with nothing special about them. Wemmbu asks why they even matter, egg says they can use their leader to lure out the assassins and to trust him. 

They go to the assassin's base of operations, Wemmbu has nothing on him and asks if it was really necessary for the plan to work, egg says to trust him and this is the only way to get the information they need. He heads up to the front of the base, he tells the two guards there he's defenseless and everything. The guards don't talk and gives him the signal to follow them. The leader of the group, 
dizzyu
, gets the guards to do an inventory check on him. Once it's done, they have an actual conversation, dizzy says it's unlike Wemmbu to come to them with nothing on him. Wemmbu asks who they were hired by, but he already knows and asks why the invisible player wants them dead. He then says if they were going to kill him there, they would've already done it, but they'd have no proof since he has no items on him. Dizzy tells his guards to lock him up, luckily for him, egg is right below him and dispenses items up from the ground. Being all geared back up, Wemmbu gives dizzy the chance to tell him what he knows or else his entire team dies. Wemmbu and the assassin group start fighting, his armor gets drained, so he resorts to using the guard's diamond armor set. He starts blowing up the place as well and kills off everyone besides dizzy, who surrenders. Wemmbu forces him to drop all his items. They interrogate dizzy and ask what he knows about the invisible player, dizzy says he knows as much as they do and that the invisible player paid them a hefty amount of diamond blocks to kill them both. They come up with the idea to use dizzy as bait, but the invisible player appears from behind a wall and crossbow minecarts them. This forces them to run outside, they jump in boats and stay in the water so the invisible player is unable to cart them. The invisible player catches up, Wemmbu tells egg to riptide away while he gets chased. After teleporting around for a bit, Wemmbu uses a stab shot to get height and uses the momentum to fly away quickly and dig underground to safety. He scours through all of his shulker boxes for any rockets, which he doesn't have. He also lost his stasis to the Farlands somehow as well, so he isn't able to restock on orbitals. He then takes random gear from his shulker boxes and uses a grindstone to disenchant them to mend his netherite armor.

Wemmbu then flies over to a village and asks if anyone is there and was willing to sell him any gear. He spots the invisible player awaiting him, who he didn't expect since he didn't know he was going to land there either. They ask if he's scared, Wemmbu pulls out his stab shots in attempt to shoot the player down, but runs out. When he's all out, a contraption is activated right below Wemmbu and launches him up in the air instantly into cobwebs and ancient debris, the machine starts to move and the player comes up with him. They get mining fatigue, so there's no point for Wemmbu to try and kill them. He then asks how they're able to teleport around freely, they ignore his question and says they were going to ban Wemmbu, but he's made a lot of enemies on the server and are willing to pay more for him alive. He asks who paid egg to die, they say it's for personal reasons that egg needs to die. Before they can reach their destination, the machine stops abruptly and the player goes to investigate and tells Wemmbu to stay. Once they leave, Parrot drinks milk and reveals himself to be inside of the machine as well and they break out of it. Parrot asks Wemmbu what the plan is, but Wemmbu thought Parrot had a plan since he was the one that came. They start to run, Parrot says he brought ingredients to craft firework rockets for Wemmbu and needs to get time alone to craft. They then go underground, Wemmbu tells Parrot to dig out while he fights the invisible player. Wemmbu tunnels and loses sight of the invisible player, digs up to Parrot and they make it to the surface safely. After they get away, Parrot explains egg came to him and convinced him to come save him and that if he saved Wemmbu, Wemmbu owed him a favor. Parrot then offers him a position in his guard force or to just be in his kingdom to be protected from the assassin. He says he appreciates the offer, but he doesn't want to run away and is going to ban the player right now.

Wemmbu walks back to the invisible player, who tells him he should've left with Parrot when he had the chance. They tell Wemmbu their whole plan was to weaken him until he complies, but even weakened he still stood strong. Wemmbu tells them when he defeats them, to know what's actually been going on. In the end, Wemmbu lands twelve consecutive hits on them and kills them. The episode ends with the voice of the assassin calling his name, Wemmbu looks back and sees a player with the exact same trims as the person he just killed standing there.



Trivia


This is the longest Wemmbu has gone without uploading ever since 
I Mastered Minecraft Combat
 to 
Unstable SMP: The Mafia
, which is precisely the same amount of days from Wemmbu's last upload (48 days for Mafia finale and 49 days for this video).


Wemmbu's 
orbitals
 ran out for the second time.


Parrot stated that Wemmbu owe him a favor, but actually he owes Wemmbu a favor for coming to the 
Northern Council
 and not killing him.


It is unsure when Wemmbu and Parrot's interactions take place, as 
I Created the World's Largest Minecraft Army
 takes place six hours to a week from 
Searching for a Civilization that Doesn't Exist
.


Wemmbu canonically somehow knows about The Director. Despite this, he's the only protagonist that doesn't have the word "director" mentioned by another player in any of his videos.

they want me gone bruh





I Got Hunted on the World's Largest Minecraft Server
 is the 91st episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


As 
Flame
 is leaving the radius of spawn, 
Deputy_Ace
 and three other lawmen follow him to capture him. He doesn't understand why they're chasing him when 
LettuceK
, the leader of 
The Law
, told him to get lost. With no other place to go, he goes to 
Lomedy's
 base to restock. Lomedy isn't pleased to see him and tells Flame to leave, but Flame convinces Lomedy to let him stay and restock. Before getting to his main goal of finding the people that can train him, he practices a technique with wind charges and pearls that allows him to pearl faster, making his movement more unpredictable. He runs short of wind charges and Lomedy's other teammate tells Flame there's a trial chamber not too far away from their base. Flame goes to the trial chamber and stumbles upon two bandits, who tell him to leave. Flame sticks to Lomedy's word to not cause any trouble, so instead of killing them for it, he tries to negotiate a trade, which they decline. He hears a horn being blown in the distance, which indicates that The Law is nearby, and he hides in a wall. The bandits are unaware, and when The Law shows up, they're stripped of their items and forced to surrender. While the lawmen aren't looking, Flame jumps in and takes the wind charges and leaves.

Flame goes back to Lomedy's base and asks for somebody to help him test the technique that he was practicing. Lomedy agrees under one condition: that Flame leaves his farm afterwards. He tests with Lomedy's teammates first and Lomedy last, and Lomedy tries to mace him, indicating that he was trying to kill Flame. Once they're done practicing, Deputy_Ace appears right behind them. The farmers are scared, but the deputy tells them he's only there for Flame. Flame says he agreed to their exile rules and doesn't know why The Law was chasing him. The deputy says his goal was to capture Flame dead or alive, preferably alive. The deputy says he would spare Flame and that he killed a thousand players, but Flame doesn't care and says the deputy can take in his sword if he manages to kill him, and they begin to fight. The deputy runs out of resources and says Flame can stop fighting him and there's nobody to blame but himself for what happens next before heading off. As Flame is gearing up before leaving for good, a dozen lawmen in full netherite come charging in from a distance. Lomedy and his farmers beg Flame to help, but Flame says he can't because they called him "not good" earlier. Lomedy even gives Flame his mace, and Flame finally agrees once they take back their words. Flame and the farmers begin to fight off the lawmen as they blow up Lomedy's farm at the same time. Flame is able to kill a few of them with the mace and his new technique, but some of the lawmen start to use slow-falling arrows on him. They keep hitting Flame with slow falling, and with Flame's armor being on low durability, he's unable to do anything. Flame says he's about to die, and Lomedy turns himself in to The Law to save Flame's life. Flame gets back on his horse to run, but two lawmen chase after him. One loses track while the other catches up, and Flame kills them in a matter of seconds.

Though Flame got away, he failed to defeat The Law, and his best friend had gotten arrested because his combat techniques still weren't good enough. He begins his journey to find the few remaining players that can teach him to improve, already having the first person in mind.



Trivia


The video's original title was I Became WANTED on the Unstable SMP before being changed to I Got Hunted on the World's Largest Minecraft Server,

I Got REVENGE on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP
 is the 55th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


After 
FlameFrags
 saved his best friend, 
Jaden_MAN
, from the 
Abandoned Civilization
, Jaden wanted to get revenge on 
Wemmbu
 for trapping him in there. Flame wanted to do it alone, but Jaden insisted they formed a team with all of Wemmbu's former enemies, so they went around the server and hired 
WyLL
, 
Willsion
, 
Spongs
, 
Fantst
, and 
Baablu
. They go around pressing players for clues on where Wemmbu could be, and 
4CVIT
 tells them that he was hunting 
Sharpness
 in the 
Farlands
. Flame and Jaden set a remote stasis chamber, and they all use an ender pearl cannon to teleport to the start of the Farlands. They walk past old structures and locations where Wemmbu and Sharpness had their fights until they make it to the next biome of the Farlands, where they see 
eggchan
. The team begins to jump Wemmbu, but Wemmbu manages to fly and lose sight of them. Baablu finds Wemmbu and the rest of them stack up to their location, but Spongs cobwebs them, giving Wemmbu enough time to fly away. 

They all agree to split up to cover more ground, Flame and Jaden go on their own to get some time away from Spongs and Willsion, as they traverse further into the Farlands, they spot Sharpness in the distance. Flame pots up and jumps Sharpness in hopes of trying to kill him for the mace. Sharpness puts the mace in his ender chest, Flame attacks him trying to scare him into taking it out, but Jaden had other plans, wanting to recruit Sharpness into their team. Flame reluctantly lets Sharpness join and asks how he got the mace, Sharpness explains that it's Wemmbu's mace and that he's there to dupe it. Due to the fact that the Farlands has weird glitches, Flame has an idea to pretend to know a dupe glitch, Flame uses his two Netherite swords and pretends that he duped his swords. Sharpness believes it and gives Flame the mace so that he could dupe the mace for all of them, they chase each other around, but agrees on a deal to give back the mace once Wemmbu was taken care of. 

Flame, Jaden, and Sharpness make it to the gravel biome and find the rest of their team who look badly beaten up. Flame is fed up with them and how they couldn't deal with Wemmbu without them there, and declares himself the leader of the team. He comes up with a plan of leading Wemmbu into a box where the rest of the team would hide and ambush him. Fantst says that Wemmbu told them to meet back at the ice spikes biome, and they build the box at the very bottom of the biome. Flame gives Jaden back his mace and they go towards Wemmbu, who's waiting at the very top of an ice spike. Wemmbu appears to be losing until somebody breaks out the box and they all run out. Their plan has everyone turn on each other, they all begin attacking each other instead of focusing on Wemmbu. Flame asks Jaden to give him back the mace, thinking Flame will use it on Wemmbu, Flame instead betrays the team and maces them. Both Flame and Wemmbu were low on resources and had no more gear, until eggchan came in and dropped shulker boxes that was left inside of the box. Flame pops all of their totems and they all leave, Flame gives Wemmbu his mace back since Flame doesn't use mace as his primary weapon. Wemmbu wonders if this bonded their friendship, but Flame says they aren't on the best terms or consider him as a friend and to not get it twisted. With no way out, Flame begins to walk back from where he came from, when all of a sudden his pearl stasis gets pulled.



Trivia


Spongs revealed in a

title: I Got Trained By a Minecraft Spear Master
content:
I Got Trained By a Minecraft Spear Master














Upload date


Jan 8, 2026






POV


FlameFrags






Arcs


The Kings Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


Twirps
LettuceK
ManePear
TeamKalal














Blindfold Brothers at full power / ManePear x FlameFrags the brothers are here today





I Got Trained By a Minecraft Spear Master
 is the 102nd episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


The spear is the newest weapon added to Minecraft, 
Flame
 goes on the search to find somebody who has already mastered the weapon. Rumor has it that his old teammate, 
ManePear
, who is the only person on the server that has mastered the spear, went missing over a year ago and hid inside of a cave away from everyone. Flame doesn't believe the rumors and goes into the cave himself, he sees a banner design with Mane's logo on it and a skeleton that Mane has mentioned that almost banned him off the server. ManePear shows up right behind Flame and asks why he's there, Flame says how it's random to see him again and has something in specific for him. Mane thinks that Flame is there to continue their fight after Mane betrayed the 
PrinceZam Empire
 a year ago, so he pots up and attacks Flame. Flame says the empire isn't the reason why he's here, but rather wanting to get trained, Mane wonders why Flame is coming to him for training and says Flame should be the one training him. Flame says he wants to learn the spear, Mane says he has no reason to help Flame, Flame tries to remind him that they used to be brothers, but with how things ended last time, Mane is sceptical. Mane agrees to help if Flame helps Mane kill off a group of stacked players, Flame doesn't trust that Mane will teach him if he helps, so Mane shows Flame the basic mechanics of the spear. Flame tries to jump around with the spear, but doesn't know how to use it as effectively as Mane. Mane says how their playstyles are completely different, Flame plays to survive, while Mane just plays for fun and more aggressively. Flame wants to learn more, but Mane says they need to do what they have to do first before he receives anymore training.

They head over to the people's base, before heading in, Mane tells Flame to hold and survive, and Mane will come in to quickdrop them. They jump in and attack the players living there, Flame uses the spear mechanics taught and gets a couple kills off with it. They kill all of the players and loot their gear, Mane starts to act weird and tries to leave Flame and give him the base for himself. Flame asks why he's trying to leave and Mane tells him that this was a one time deal, Flame keeps following Mane around to get him to keep training, Mane treats him like a fan and asks to be left alone, but Flame keeps insisting and says they can fight right there to get his point across. Finally, Mane agrees to train Flame more if that means Flame will leave him alone. While walking back into the cave, Mane uses a secret mechanic to move faster and lunge faster with the spear. When they get back down to his base, he tells Flame the secret mechanic, which is essentially an attribute swap with the spear. Flame then uses this chance to ask Mane for his help to track down any hidden base owned by 
The Law
. Flame asks Mane if he has any teams or empires to track down, Mane says no, and Flame says that he has a target for him. He explains how The Law exiled him and made him weak and has hunted him, he speculates that they have a hidden base where they gear up their army, Mane thinks that Flame brought them over to his base, but Flame says he didn't. Mane says no to Flame's proposal, Flame says they have armies with tons of players stacked with full netherite, Mane doesn't believe that an entire faction could be stacked with all netherite, as he's been hunting stacked players himself, but has never seen any team that rich. Flame keeps saying to Mane that he promises that he's telling the truth, Mane gets interested as he knows Flame is a man of his words, he agrees to help and Flame tells Mane that he can keep all the loot they find along the way.

They head off using horses, Flame doesn't know where they're going and Mane says they need to find information, and so they head to a nearby town. During their expedition, Flame explains how The Law has been chasing him and his plan is to learn all the types of weapons and become a combat master and live up to his reputation. Mane says how he was just like Flame, concerned about his reputation, but it took away enjoyment from playing the game. Flame says that if his name is something that is strong, then people would treat him like something, but if his name is nothing, then nobody would treat him. Mane says if Flame has something valuable other than his name, then he can be respected for other things. Flame says how his name is all he has, and Mane asks if he's ever thought about caring for people over a title, Flame says there was a point in time that was true, but not anymore. Mane gives Flame his advice, he says since Flame is such a prominent figure on the server, he's bound to be failed, betrayed, and used, and if he stopped caring about a title, he'd have much more freedom. Flame says he doesn't mind the competition over the title of being the strongest player, he just wants to be recognized for his skill.  

They arrive to the town, Mane tells Flame to stay low, but Flame comes up to the first civilian and asks if they know anything about The Law and that he wants to kill them. Mane pulls Flame aside and tells Flame to be slick, as the way Flame perceives himself is the reason he has bounties and that people have tried to hire Mane to kill Flame. They go back to the town and Mane goes and talks to the leader peacefully, but he says The Law told them not to trust Flame or anybody with him, so Mane goes back into the village and starts a commotion, saying how he's the leader now, blows the village up, and kills the civilians for not giving any leads to where The Law's base could be. Afterwards, Mane says that they messed up, they see a few stragglers that survived and tell them to get The Law over to their location and tell them that Flame and Mane are there. They explore the destroyed town a bit and read a journal, as soon as they finish, SargeLAW shows up to the town and asks what happened here. Flame admits to destroying the town and killing the players, and SargeLAW says that's not allowed. Mane confidently tells Sarge that he should've came with more people and that he wouldn't be able to take on this 2v1. Mane and Sarge fight, but it doesn't go anywhere, Sarge asks if they wanted more people and blows a horn, signaling tons of netherite lawmen to drop from the sky. The lawmen use weakness potions to weaken Flame and Mane, they still manage to get off a few kills using the spear, but are unable do much overall. Mane tells Flame it's time to run, and so they lunge out of the town. Mane manages to run off while the lawmen with Elytras catch up to Flame. He tries to spear them off, but there are too many of them. He tries to dig down and escape, but they also catch up to him and finally corner him. 

Unfortunately for Flame, The Law captured him and Mane left Flame to die. Sarge forces Flame to drop his whole inventory, Flame tries to stall and attempt to escape, but with all eyes on him, he wasn't able to do so. He drops everything except his spear, the lawmen dig a staircase up and they start to escort Flame. Flame attempts to escape, but doesn't know the timing of the spear. They reach a temporary Law compound, Sarge forces Flame to put on copper armor with curse of binding and put him in his cell. The prisoner across from Flame ragebaits him and successfully does so. Shortly after, Mane arrives to the prison and blows up the prison wall, splashing Flame with invis and gives him a shulker full of gear. Flame gets Mane to break his copper armor and they go full invis, causing the lawmen to lose track of them. Flame doesn't want to leave before getting his items back. so they look around searching for it. A lawman leaks where the location of his items are, so Flame breaks the window and finds his gear. Flame drops down and gets on a horse, combining it with the spear, he easily mows down a group of lawmen. They loot the dead lawmen's gear, Flame says he didn't think Mane would come saving him, but Mane says when the money calls, you have to come. They plan on breaking into the vault, Flame devises a plan by using TNT minecarts while Mane uses an Elytra to go with his spear. They ride a cart down to the vault and attempt to break in, but isn't able to with mining fatigue. 

With no other option, and with The Law coming, they wait on top a hill. They pot up and Flame uses his crossbow and TNT minecart strategy to kill off tons of lawmen, meanwhile, Mane spears through a bunch of the lawmen. The Law's army begins to dwindle down, and the last few remaining have Elytras and spears, which made it harder for them to kill. They massacre the remaining lawmen and return to the vault to let Mane loot it. Flame asks Mane if he'll ever return back to the main server, and Mane says probably not and that he enjoys what he's doing right now, not having to worry about anyone else. Flame says he's going to head out, but Mane stops him quickly and tells him despite him being harsh to Flame, no matter what, Flame will always be his little bro. As Flame actually heads out, Mane thanks Flame for finding him and says Flame could easily take down The Law by himself once he learns everything.



Trivia


This video is the second longest Unstable video Post Season 1, with the first being 
2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Players
.

This video also marks Flame's longest video on Unstable.


The skeleton inside of Mane's base is a reference to a message in his Discord where he said he died to a skeleton and that the fight went down to armor durability breaking.


This video is Flame's fastest viewed video.

title: I Got Trained By a Minecraft TNT Master
content:
I Got Trained By a Minecraft TNT Master














Episode


109






Upload date


Feb 2, 2026






POV


FlameFrags






Arcs


The Kings Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


TheobaldTheBird
ParrotX2
TeamKalal
Twirps
LettuceK














BIG BOOM 4/4





I Got Trained By a Minecraft TNT Master
 is the 109th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


FlameFrags
 explains that there's five main weapons that people think of that are in Minecraft: sword, bow, axe, spear, or mace. He says there's a super unique combat technique that very few players can even do; TNT minecart PvP, and he wants to master it. Flame heads to a 
Law
 member in netherite that's AFK and demonstrates how TNT minecart-ing works. He then explains the difficulty of this combat style, minecart damage could be negated with shields or blocks, blast protection could protect them, miss shots, even hitting yourself with the minecart, and much more. Flame wants to master this style to prevent accidentally blowing himself up, so he makes it his goal to find 
TheobaldTheBird
, whose specialty is TNT minecarts. Though, Flame is still exiled and goes invis and heads into 
Capital City
 to head over to Theo and 
Parrot
's potion shop. He overhears The Law trying to recruit new players and others going around telling people to vote for 
LettuceK
. He gets close to the potion shop, where he doesn't see Theo or Parrot, so he goes closer to get information. Two other players stand in front of the shop, they talk about Parrot and the election, mentioning that he now lives in the 
Northern Council
. Flame then heads over to the Northern Council using an invisible horse on the obsidian highway. A random player in iron armor pretends to be a lawman blocks the path with blocks and mentions how TheG0dofWar would kill him since he's strong, Flame punches him off the highway and the player falls to their death. 

Flame gets to the Northern Council and hides his horse somewhere, he doesn't know where the rooms are located, and uses a spyglass to look at the nametags above, which happened to be Theo and Parrot. To avoid going inside, he throws a wind charge at their window to get their attention. Parrot shoots a renamed arrow telling Flame to follow them when they leave to get to a safer place to talk. They make it far enough, Parrot says whoever was following them can come out now, Flame drinks a milk bucket and drops the invis. Parrot asks why Flame is there when he's exiled from Law territory still, Flame says he has a question for Theo, asking for training in TNT minecart PvP. Parrot says they don't have much time and needs to find 
Wemmbu
 out in the 
Great Sea
, Theo was stuck between the option of training Flame or help save the server, Parrot says the reason why Flame was even exiled is because of the death of the thousand lawmen, but Theo argues back that Parrot had also killed a lawman, making him just as guilty. Flame then mentions how he's trying to get back at The Law, how they didn't intend for it to happen, and Lettuce hadn't let go of trying to hunt him down. When Flame says him and Wemmbu are the two strongest, Theo clears his throat to remind Flame that he's also strong, and chooses to go to the Great Sea when Flame discarded him. Flame stops them and goes on and says if he doesn't train, he wouldn't be strong enough to take down The Law or have many players that are willing to take down The Law. Theo asks Parrot his opinion on it, Parrot says it's his choice and doesn't think Flame has bad intentions, Parrot heads off on his journey, and Theo agrees to train and says that it'd be more interesting than walking for hours on end.

Flame and Theo head out of spawn, Theo asks why Flame wants to learn cart, Flame explains to him that The Law has started to counter his only playstyle, being sword, with weakness and stops Flame from being a threat. Theo realizes he can't be caught with Flame when he's exiled, so he takes Flame to a remote location. The location they headed to is a big manmade forest where Theo used to train players in carts, Flame asks what happened to them, Theo reminds him that 
his students ran into Flame and all died
. On the training grounds, Theo explains the basics of carting and the potential it has. He tells Flame to shoot a cart first try and be a natural, Flame manages to do so, and Theo says to do it twice in a row. Flame says wouldn't that kill him, and Theo says to use the terrain and that the player's feet is their line of sight of where the explosion does the most damage. Flame does this first try and impresses Theo, he says no other player on Unstable has been able to do what he did. Theo says he was going to ditch Flame is he missed the carts and admits that he didn't prepare any carts, Flame says he's exiled from everywhere and can't trade. Theo asks if he's been to the black market, Flame says he did bad things the last time he was there, Theo says he has a guy there, so Flame agrees to come with. Heading over back to Capital City, a lawman follows them and stops them when he sees Flame in invisibility. Theo says that it's Parrot and someone accidentally splashed invis on him, Flame puts on his best Parrot impression, but the lawman says he needs to un-invis right now. Theo hints at Flame to start fighting and use carts in the fight, Flame pulls off good cart hits on the lawman and kills him off with his sword. 

Flame and Theo then head into the black market, which was close to the fight that just took place, Theo heads in first to avoid being caught with Flame, Flame says to signal his cart vendor. When it's Flame's turn to enter the black market, he's stopped by the other players of the black market because he robbed them the last time he was there. Flame threatens to kill everyone there, and the players back off. Flame goes to the cart vendor and asks for his prices, he says he takes anything from gapples and blocks of diamonds, Flame gives a stack of gaps for two shulker boxes full of carts. Flame then goes around asking people to trade for bottles of XP, someone goes up to him and says it's 16 bottles for every netherite piece, Flame gives them a shulker box full of netherite gear from all the Law members he's killed, the player gives him his whole stock. When it's time to leave the black market, The Law's horn is blown, and TheG0dofWar, the commander that the player from earlier was talking about, comes in, and everybody starts to hide. TheG0dofWar asks why everyone is hiding, and one player steps up and says that they're evading taxes, and TheG0DofWar says taxes don't matter anymore in Capital City since it doesn't affect Lettuce. Everyone starts to come out of hiding and TheG0dofWar asks if there's been any commotion, and the players rat out Flame's location. TheG0dofWar reminds Flame that he's exiled from the server and asks what makes him think he can stand in front of the God of war. Theo tries to diffuse the situation by talking it out like gentlemen, Flame tries to leave, but TheG0dofWar stops him and says they're dueling right then and there. The two start to fight, Flame gets boxed in and gets crit out. Flame pearls to the exit, Theo follows them, pretending to leave too, and splashes them all with invis so they can escape safely. Theo says Flame got bodied, but Flame says he didn't have speed or a shield and wasn't prepared to fight.

Back at Theo's training ground, he shows Flame the technique of using a crossbow to shoot the minecart. The difference between the crossbow and bow is that the speed of the arrow determines how much damage it does. Theo then shows Flame the best places to place the carts, especially on ledges. Flame practices the position and misses a lot of the shots, but then gets the right crosshair position and gets it off multiples times in a row. Theo explains if Flame's ever on flat ground, to use blocks as his advantage, placing a block right in front of his feet and then using flint and steel on top of the block. Flame has the idea of placing a block and standing on top of it to bow from above and practices that technique. Theo shows another technique, which is pearl carting, which requires charging up a bow while the pearl is in the air. Flame hits it, and Theo says he's already set since he's already one of the best cart PvPers on Unstable and that he has good mechanical skills and to focus on consistency. Theo has an idea for Flame, to go rematch TheG0dofWar to be an official cart PvPer and to get his revenge after getting dunked on.

Flame goes back to spawn and meditates on top of a lava cast in order to get into the zone. In the midst of meditating, a lawman named 
theQuad_
 yells at Flame to leave, Flame threatens to kill the lawman and instructs him to take him to TheG0dofWar. They arrive to a huge desert monument, TheG0dofWar is seen meditating in the middle of the colosseum. Flame makes 
theQuad_
 scream at TheG0dofWar and disrupt his meditation process. TheG0dofWar turns back and sees Flame and asks what he's doing there, Flame says he's there to have a rematch where he's actually prepared and geared for a battle. TheG0dofWar agrees and wants to see if Flame can stand against him. The fight starts off with just melee only, the fight then escalates down the waterfall, and Flame begins to use carts. Flame pops a few totems, causing TheG0dofWar to run into a cave, Flame restocks right outside the cave and heads in to continue the fight. Flame pops a couple more totems and TheG0dofWar runs out of the cave, shooting Flame with a punch bow to keep him inside. With all the commotion going on, a few lawmen from above start to watch the fight go down. Flame carts TheG0dofWar and pops even more totems, TheG0dofWar says the end is near for one of them, Flame asks if he's going to keep fighting, and he replies by saying he'll fight to his last breath. Flame says he doesn't want to kill him and only wanted to beat him to see if he could hold his word of being the God of war. Flame says that he's a worthy opponent and he can keep coming back to duel and improve, Flame makes him come back for a rematch when he's strong enough and not to waste his time.

With the God of war being defeated, he considers himself a master of TNT minecart PvP, and with every other weapon mastered, he's considered a Minecraft combat master, but has to prove it by putting it to the test by doing one last thing: taking down The Law. Flame wants to prove to himself that his skills are himself and not the weapons he wields, the episode ends with Flame saying his first step was already decided.



Trivia


In the comments of a reaction video to this episode, Theo said that Flame cut out parts of the training where he explained niche methods and many other techniques.


From this video onwards, Flame stopped using the armor HUD and saturation mods, possibly to make his videos seem as vanilla as possible.

title: I Got Trained By the World's Best Minecraft Player
content:
I Got Trained By a Minecraft Combat Master














Episode


104






Upload date


Jan 20, 2026






POV


FlameFrags






Arcs


The Kings Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


ItzRealMe
LettuceK
Twirps














the minecraft combat master himself....





I Got Trained By the World's Best Minecraft Player
 is the 104th episode feature in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


FlameFrags
 has two combat techniques left to master, so he continues to go around the server looking around. At the 
BAT infinity base
, he stumbles across 
ItzRealMe
, the former number one PvPer in Minecraft, who is now retired. Itz thinks Flame is there to kill him, but Flame says no and he just came across him and asked for training. Itz is skeptical and is trying to avoid conflict these days and reveals that he too was being hunted by 
The Law
 and was about to turn himself in. Flame says he was actually on his way to destroy The Law and the only way he could be able to was if Itz trained him, Itz says that's not a bad idea and that he's heard of Flame, so he agrees to help him out. Itz takes Flame up to the roof and tells him that every player has their strengths and weaknesses, weaker players are incapable of executing strategies while combat masters know how to execute every single one. He mentions that a combat master is strong because of the player, not the weapon they yield, but for a player, the weapon is their strongest suit, and without it, their skill with it. Itz instructs Flame to try and pop a totem with every weapon, or else he fails and Itz would drop the training. They first do sword, Flame breaks Itz's helmet and pops him shortly after. Flame pops Itz in spear and cart easily as well. In mace, however, Flame struggles as it's his weakest weapon, but still manages to get the totem pop.

They go upstairs and itz tells Flame his results, he says Flame's best gamemode is sword, his spear was also good, his cart could use some work, and his weakest gamemode being mace. Itz says Flame should switch to sword and cart as his primary weapons, and spear as his alternative option. Flame says he could definitely improve his mace skills, and so they go back down to practice. Itz explains the basics of the mace and teaches Flame how to attribute swap while attack normally and while falling down. Flame tries it on Itz and gets it first try, and so they move forward onto stun slamming, and Flame gets that down first try too. They get into the more advanced strategies, Itz shows Flame a technique called force grappling, which forces the enemy to launch into the air, pearling onto them, and macing them immediately, doing tons of damage. The next technique is by far the hardest, which is horizontal pearl catching, having to angle an ender pearl and look down and throw a wind charge right after, which will teleport the player above the other player unexpectedly, giving the chance to mace too. Itz explains the next technique, wind charge bhopping, Flame demonstrates the technique on Itz before he could finish, showing that he already knew it and surprises Itz. He says a combat master always finds new strategies and that's how they become a master. With all the new mace techniques learned, Flame could become a stronger mace fighter. Flame says he's going to apply all of these and asks Itz if he'd become a combat master on the Unstable SMP if he learned everything, but Itz says there's one strategy that all of the combat masters do that Flame doesn't do and that it's gatekept. He says it's nothing mechanical, but rather in the head called "the zone". He says the zone is a mental trick that helps with focus, reacts faster, see mistakes more easily, and learn faster on their own. Paying attention to every detail, everything you do, everything your opponent does, you start to see patterns and your own habits as well as the opponent's. Flame says he can't really do that because all the battle he's been on in the server has someone distracting him, he doesn't realize that he could be using the wrong items during combat. Itz says the zone helps with that, if Flame used their hatred to fuel him, he could beat them, and the quieter he is, the more he can hear during a battle. The zone is the ultimate state of focus, Itz says Flame needs to get rid of all the unnecessary thoughts and absorb himself into the game and that only the ones who have practiced earn the right to enter the zone. Itz and Flame go back up on top of the base and Itz says to practice meditating.  They look into the distance as the sun goes down, Itz says to close his eyes, breathe in and breathe out, and zone out all the distractions.

While they meditate, The Law's signature goat horn is blown, Itz says this is the perfect chance to put everything Flame just learned to use, Itz splashes invis and flies up, telling Flame he'll be watching from above. Flame walks up to the group of lawmen, they ask what he has to say for himself for all the crimes he's committed, Flame says nothing and pots up. Flame puts the mace to use, he can be seen entering the zone, more focused, and starts killing the lawmen. After killing the diamond lawmen, the two netherite players retreat. Flame tries to chase after them, but they're long gone. Itz comes down, Flame says he understands what the zone is now, and Itz says that was impressive and that there's one more test for Flame to prove if he's worthy of being a combat master. They walk to a destination, Flame asks what Itz did on the server and how it was like in his prime, Itz says he used to get hired to kill people and that he was unstoppable. Itz asks Flame what inspired him to become a combat master, Flame says the main reason was because The Law kept hunting him and he wasn't able to beat them and doesn't like being humiliated. Itz says he was just like Flame, always striving to improve, always learning, and became a combat master, but at one point you start winning every battle, get bored, and retire.

As they continue walking, a massive floating island comes into render distance, Itz says he found this landmark one day while exploring and wanted to bring Flame to it. Itz gives Flame his elytra to fly up, and they get up onto the island. Flame thinks his final test is to meditate there, but Itz says his final test is to drop him the mace. Flame thinks he's joking, but Itz is serious about it. Even though it's Lomedy's mace and he would be mad if Flame didn't give it back, Flame gives it to Itz. Itz stores it in his ender chest and says the final test is to fight him, and whoever pops three totems first would win. Itz pops two of Flame's totems and Flame has yet to pop one of Itz's. Flame goes down into a cave, Itz doesn't follow him down, so Flame uses this time to restock. He didn't understand what there was to learn about this, but then he remembered what Itz told him about the zone. Flame realized that Itz was testing Flame to see if he could adapt in this situation, he looks around in the building he was in and finds slow falling arrows stored inside of a pot. He comes up from the cave, Itz is awaiting him and Flame says he gives up and can end it right there, Itz says he expected better and starts to jump down, macing Flame, but before he could land the mace hit, Flame pulls out his crossbow and hits Itz with slow falling. Itz plays by Flame's rules, if Flame wanted to keep using slow falling, he'd put away the mace and go melee only. Flame, this time goes quiet and goes into the zone, he manages to turn the fight around and pop all of Itz's totems. He admits that he only had four arrows and was bluffing about how many arrows he had, Itz says the reason he took Flame's mace was because it's hard to lock in when enemies make you mad, but Flame has the mentality of a combat master and can control when he enters the zone, and he gives Flame the mace back. Itz says Flame is on his way to become a combat master and that it was really impressive that he went even with someone who is better than him and that he only needs to focus on cart to finally get rid of The Law and 
BAT
.

With one more trainer left to find, Flame already knew who to find, and so he heads back to the main server to find them.



Trivia


The video's original title was "I Got Trained By a Minecraft Combat Master".
