is me x swight tuff duo or nah lmk





I Secretly Teamed With My Minecraft Killer
 is the 100th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


After being picked up by 
Swight
 to be his sidekick, 
Flame
 joins Swight to help assist his mercenary jobs and get one on one training in order to beat 
The Law
, still invisibile to prevent his identity from being revealed. Their first job is to help defend a village from a team of mountain bandits, the leader of the village mentions that if they keep coming back, the whole village would go extinct, they also aren't very wealthy and offers the enemy team's vault full of items as payment. Swight agrees on the deal, taking everything the enemy team has once the mission is done. During their time off, Flame and Swight practice PvP, Swight teaches Flame the basics of shield disabling as well as some tips to help better improve his skills. In the middle of practice, a horn is blown, signaling that the bandits were coming. The leader shows them dripstone traps and TNT cannons set up all across the base for them to use, then they go into hiding to let the two deal with it. Flame tells Swight to bait the bandits into the holes so the cannons can blow them up, but after the second shot, the cannon blows itself up. Flame jumps down and gets the bandits attention on him, he goes back into the village and uses a knockback sword to knock the bandits into the dripstone trap and dropping dripstone on them, killing them without showing his name. Swight falls into the trap and Flame pops the bandit's totems in the meantime. Swight gets back up and Flame pops more totems and uses the trap to kill more bandits, he gets knocked into a trap himself with two bandits, he has no way to escape, Swight comes down and kills the bandits stuck down there with him. They kill the last of the bandits, Swight asks why Flame wasn't directly fighting them, Flame says he was popping totems, which gets Swight off his tail. The leader leaves their hiding spot and tells them about another village that was recently attacked and asks to bring any remaining survivors back to their village. 

During their expedition, Flame asks Swight about his job and who he goes after, Swight says it doesn't really matter who, and only cares about how skillful the player is and how much he gets paid. He also mentions how he despises people who kill for titles or vengenace. They get to the village, which seems to be raided, but they look through the houses and see a few players hiding in them. One of the players tell them to do a sweep of the houses for anymore players, the first house Flame steps inside of has a fall trap and a dripstone at the bottom of it, he pops a totem and his invisibility gets cleared, Swight asks if he needs help, and Flame says no. He breaks all of the armor stands and splashes invis again before Swight comes down to help. They take the two remaining survivors back to the village, one of them falls into a powdered snow trap when he wasn't looking, the other walks back into the village where all of the people cheer for him. The leader tells Flame and Swight that there's downtime for them as their scouts were on the hunt for the enemies base. 

They go back to training, Swight notices Flame's aggressive playstyle, but isn't able to get close to him, so he shows Flame how to bow boost. Next, Swight tells Flame how important game sense is and to pay attention to what the opponent is doing, they practice against each other so Flame can learn Swight's fighting style. The leader comes and tells them that they found the bandit's base and leads the two there himself, once they get near, he leaves and lets Flame and Swight deal with it. They get to the top of the base, where the roof is made out of glass, Flame tells Swight to jump in while he drops carts from above. The cart strategy manages to kill tons of bandits, but when Flame isn't looking, one of the bandits TNT minecarts Flame and pops his totem, Flame quickly splashes invisibility and has to fend off the bandit. Flame uses the strategy of analyzing their playstyle to prevent getting carted, the bandit loses the battle and runs away. Flame jumps in and carts the rest of the bandits.

The two collect the loot and Swight complements Flame on how smart he is and how their styles match well. While restocking, the signature Law horn could be heard, which meant The Law has caught up to them, and they have a strict no invisibility rule. The lawman says that they have intel on Flame and tells Swight how Flame went missing and presumably faked his death to prevent being hunted, and to look out for him and that he uses cobwebs a lot and is a quick learner, Swight looks at Flame suspiciously and says that the description matches with him. Swight asks Flame to let the invisibility run out to regain his trust, Flame tries to lie and say he has no name and other excuses, but he has no other way to convince otherwise, so he lets his invisibility run out. The lawman goes to call for backup and tells Swight to hold him off, Swight sounds angry at the fact that he's been working with the person he was hired to kill. Swight says he could kill Flame himself rather than have The Law back him up so he can get the credit he deserves. Flame tries to tell his side of the story, how The Law is the same team that took everything from him, but Swight doesn't care about his problems and only cares about completing his mission. 

Flame pots up and challenges Swight to a fight, giving Swight his reputation if he does succeed in killing Flame. With the both of them being skilled PvPers, Swight pulls out his netherite armor, the fight goes on until Flame tells Swight to make a deal and that he'll keep running, he says how he would tell The Law how Swight trained him and teamed with him, taking all of Swight's credit and tarnishing his reputation. Swight asks what Flame could even offer, Flame says he can take the vault and doesn't care about the loot, so they head down to the vault, where hundreds of armor sets are stored and has a good amount of other resources. Swight seems satisfied and lets Flame off the hook, but before heading off, Swight gives Flame credit for being able to get him to put his netherite armor on and to stand proud. He tells Flame to become a mercenary himself once it's all over, he then leaves Flame with one last piece of advice: Learn the rest of the items and to find different players with different skills in order to master them. Flame heads out of the base and begins his journey to find his next trainer.



Trivia


This is the 100th video of 
Unstable Universe
.

title: I Spent 100 Days Hidden in a Secret Minecraft Base...
content:
I Spent 100 Days Hidden in a Secret Minecraft Base...














Season


2






Episode


5






Upload date


Mar 12, 2025






POV


SpokeIsHere






Arcs


100 Days Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


ashswagg
TheRealSquiddo
Reddoons














ive been stalking 
ashswag
 ever since the war ended, and he led me to his secret base... it was time to get the ultimate revenge and ruin his life!!!!!!!!!!! sneaky snitch style





I Spent 100 Days Hidden in a Secret Minecraft Base...
 is the 32nd episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


After destroying 
The Invisible Mafia
, 
Spoke
 stalks 
ashswagg
 for weeks on end and stumbles across his hidden base, 
Point Nemo
. On the first day, ash goes out of the base and flies away, Spoke uses this as an opportunity to sneak into the base to look around, he then spots 
Squiddo
 and hides until he sees her go down a hidden path. On day two, he promises himself to stay inside of the base for a hundred days without being caught, he goes around finding more hidden entrances throughout the base, finding valuables as he goes along. On the third day, he decides to make his own secret base inside of the secret base. Over the next few days, he upgrades his base and makes hidden places where he can spy on ash and Squiddo, eavesdropping on their conversations. At one point, ash mentions needing to decorate the Dragon Egg room, which confirms that he still has the egg and is located inside of the base. Spoke wonders around and accidentally sets off pressure plates, playing noteblocks with a creeper head above it and emitting a creeper sound. He hides in the water as his invisibility runs out, hearing that ash and Squiddo were now on high alert and believes somebody is in the base, but in the end believed that it was something else they built that set it off. Spoke wanders around the base more and finds out about more hidden bases, he then sets up a room inside of his secret base to map out all of the rooms he's discovered. Days go by, and Spoke realizes in one of the tunnels he always headed left instead of straight, which lead to a secret Nether themed room with a portal. He sees Squiddo leaving the Nether as he came by, and goes in the Nether after her, the Nether has tons of Nether materials and a fountian of lava in the middle. Squiddo comes back to grab lava, Spoke hides in the fountain using fire resistance, and Squiddo mentions how the fountain of lava wasn't necessasry and picks the lava up. She leaves the Nether before the fountain is fully drained, and before Spoke's fire resistance ran out.

Afterwards, Spoke makes more secret entrances leading to his base, he spots Squiddo in a direction he's never seen before. He goes to investigate and sees Squiddo in her own hidden room, talking to her pet animals and building a house for them. While spying on Squiddo, Spoke's invisibility is about to run out, he's not able to drink more as Squiddo will hear it, so he parkours up on the clouds on the walls and up onto the corner of the roof. Squiddo doesn't spot him and he makes a tunnel leading back to his base from there. Spoke goes around the base and finds more hidden bases, where he finds a dragon head, which is considered rare on the server. One of the hidden entrances lead to a strange room with a bunch of mobs, Spoke gets anxious about getting caught with all his items, so he goes back. He sees Squiddo going through another direction that he's never seen before, he figures out how to activate the secret door, but it lead to only a room with a tree. He sits there for a few days until he decides to leave it, ash decides to come back on the same day and informs Squiddo that items have started to go missing from their chests. Ash says they need to set up more traps inside of the base and that if even one person knows where the base is, the entire thing would be compromised. For the next few days, Spoke builds more escape tunnels and looks for more traps and alarms. The next day, he realized that he never went through the room behind the lava wall, which lead to a strange meeting room with a room behind a painting, which was even more odd. The next day, he gets use out of the meeting room and overhears ash mentioning wanting to do a trade with Reddoons, the richest player on Unstable. Spoke plans on intercepting the trade and becoming the richest player himself. Over the next few days, he tries to look for the villager that was for trade, with no leads, he decides to watch one of them and follow them. He follows Squiddo down to a new hidden base, which lead down to an automatic sorter, but the room had no way out, so Spoke trapped himself down there for a day or two. Eventually, he finds a block of powdered snow disguised with the white carpets, where he finds tons of chickens in a hole with potions of wind charging and harming, he uses it to launch all the way up to a skybase full of shulkers.

The day after that, ash comes back and sounds the alarm, questioning where one of his leather armor sets went. Squiddo doesn't know and leads ash to her secret base she was working on, indirectly saving Spoke. He follows and hears ash saying they needed to set more alarms, so Spoke follows Squiddo to see where evrey alarm was placed so he could disarm them all. Squiddo tries to set one up in the mob room, but the mining fatigue didn't let her, so she leaves. Spoke uses this chance to stock up on potions to find any hidden entrances in the room, he finds a trapdoor behind a magma cube that lead to a door that required a passcode, he tries to break through it, but the mining fatigue didn't let him. He tries every other trick, but nothing helps, so he ends up mining the door down, which right after he realized he didn't have to do when there were redstone torches all around him. The room leads to a whole bunch of armor sets, with a few netherite sets, as well as a few weapons. He didn't want to steal yet, so he uses the button behind the armor stands to open another door, but it's too far away to press and run back. He tries to grab a riptide trident hanging above from an item frame, but it falls in the lava, however, he manages to get the other riptide trident. In his attempts to escape, he kills his fish George Junior. The hidden room had nothing inside of it, so he goes back and finds a button that lead to an exit that lead back to the mob room. While examining the mob room, Spoke spotted ash's name swimming out from one of the lava pillars and decides to check out if there were any bases above or under the lava pillars. He finds a lever behind the ghast, which opens the glass underneath one of the pillars, which reveals a stash with tons of rare items, but not the void one that ash mentioned. He sees ash heading down the lava, Spoke panics since he didn't want ash to see any particles, so he makes a portal from the room being built with all obsidian. He heads into the nether and when he went back through the portal, he was back in the hidden nether room and heads back to his base. 

A day later, Spoke makes a grave to bury his pet fish when ash leaves the base, then opens a shulker box full of fishes named George Junior and grabs another one. For the next few days, Spoke stays inside of his base because he was afraid to do anything. On day 67, he hears ash and Squiddo back in their meeting room, who reveals that Reddoons wanted to do the trade in six hours, so Spoke planned on hijacking the trade for himself. Spoke still had time before the trade, so he scouts out every room in case he missed anything, he tried to go back to the obsidian vault using the Nether, but the Nether portal in the hidden room lead to a random location in the Nether. He goes through another portal nearby and finds an ice path with a barrel of boats, once he reaches the end, he sees one of the last few villagers remaining on the server. Next, he goes underneath every chest in the base and makes a huge creates a hopper tunnel that lead to his stash of chests, allowing him to store all of the loot he was planning on stealing. With time still left to spare, Spoke decorates his base more before deciding to steal the villager for himself. His initial plan was to raid the entire base while the trade was happening, but stealing the villager would allow Spoke to get even more loot. He heads back to the hidden room with the villager and builds a railroad leading up to the surface. The water on the surface leaks onto the railroad, and as Spoke pushed the villager up, it drowns to death. The day before the trade, Spoke goes back to the meeting room where the trade would take place and replaced all the blocks underneath the carpet with hoppers, which would go back to his stash. He finishes setting it up as Reddoons arrives at the base, he listens on their conversation and ash tells Reddoons to drop the shulkers of mending books, which disappear out of thin air into the hoppers. Ash and Squiddo are confused, but take Reddoons to the villager and decides to deal with the mending books later. Spoke beats them to the villager room and waits for the chaos to unfold. Reddoons seems very disappointed and tells them to repay him with a villager or his mending books back and storms off. Ash gets Squiddo to look through every chest and count every item in the chests with Spoke following behind. Once all of the chests were accounted for, Spoke begins his raid. He fills up dozens of shulkers all full of their items, leaving the entire base empty handed.

Everything was going according to plan, Spoke planned on storing all the items somewhere else once the hundred days were up, but ash came back to the base and tells Squiddo and tells her how there's been an intruder here for a while and knew about the trade and rigged the room with hoppers. Spoke realized he forgot to break the hoppers that lead to his base, so he grabs a few important shulkers and burned everything else inside of his base. After seeing that they lost everything, ash tells Squiddo to leave and start a new life and apologizes for wasting her time. Throughout the next few days, Spoke tries to follow ash, but he doesn't see his name anywhere in the base. Eventually, he sees ash coming back to the base, but instead of going into the base, he turns left and dropped, so Spoke goes outside to see where he went. He finds a button that opened up a block inside of the cave, so Spoke presses it and enters the void base that they were talking about. Spoke opens up the chests and sees ridiculous amounts of loot, ash appeared to be invisible, he puts on his armor and drinks milk and demands Spoke, still invisible, to unmute. Spoke puts on his armor, but doesn't unmute, ash continues to threaten to kill Spoke if he tries anything. Spoke lets his invisibility run out, which somewhat shocks ash. Spoke explains how he managed to take a few items from ash, but ash says none of the items meant anything and calls Spoke worthless, he says the most valuable thing is long gone and reveals that he offered the Dragon Egg to Reddoons in exchange for the base. Spoke screams at ash for his decisions, he says that he could've traded anything else, and ash tells Spoke how Spoke only thinks about himself. Spoke says he'll find a way to get his hands on the Dragon Egg, before leaving, ash says Spoke will never find himself or truly be happy. On day 100, Spoke feels like he achieved nothing, and would need the Dragon Egg to be rich, so instead of keeping the loot to himself, he traded it all for the coordinates of Reddoons' base.



Trivia


Ashswagg is one of the two people who have a full set of music discs, as they're incredibly rare as mentioned in 
I Explored the Minecraft Great Sea
.

title: I Spent 100 Days Trapped in a Minecraft Void Base...
content:
I Spent 100 Days Trapped in a Minecraft Void Base...














Season


2






Episode


17






Upload date


May 28, 2025






POV


SpokeIsHere






Arcs


100 Days Arc
The Director Arc
 (semi-relevant)






Featured Creators (Description)


ParrotX2
JumperWho
Leow0ok
Derapchu
Moonwalking Spy














this video is the FINALE for a very good reason... btw i was the director !!!





I Spent 100 Days Trapped in a Minecraft Void Base...
 is the 44th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 




Plot


Spoke sees an abandoned base or so he thought. He sees 
JumperWho
 . Spoke decides to hold out until Day 2 and that's when he saw Jumper showing off her base to the rest of 
Bounty Assassin Team
. Spoke drank invisibility and followed them inside.

Spoke realises he had hit the jackpot for getting rich and realizes the base was suspended above the void. Spoke sees 
full netherite invisible players
 roaming the halls. On day 3, Spoke decides to explore the base. The base had areas to grow trees, mushrooms, and a mob grinder that seemed to be non-functional. On day 4, Spoke decides to eat some bread in the corner to muffle as much sound as possible so the base members don't hear him. On day 5, Spoke listened in on the conversation between Jumper and 
ParrotX2
. On day 6, Spoke is almost caught by 
Derapchu
, Parrot and Jumper. On day 7, Spoke hid from the spies. On day 8, Spoke found a vent. On Days 9 and 10, Spoke found more vents and explored them. He also found a bedroom of the spies that held invisibility. Spoke finds their meeting room. On day 11, Spoke got so lost he ended back up in the main room. Spoke found their map but he didn't know how to read it with just numbers. Spoke stumbled across a massive storage room and a cemetery. On day 12, Spoke roamed around the halls and eventually, stumbled across their server racks and control room that turned off/on lockdown, the lights, airlocks, etc... 

On day 13, Spoke made it back to the main room and found out how to get to the bedrooms. Spoke listens in on a meeting between Parrot, Derapchu, Jumper and 
Leow0ok
. On day 14, Spoke was back in the main room. On day 15, Spoke was cutting it thin on food so he tried to figure out which number on the map meant "food". Eventually (after roaming around) Spoke found their farm and took some bread. On day 16, Spoke is caught eating a carrot in the farm by Parrot and tells Jumper and Derapchu to lockdown the base. Spoke hides in the vents avoiding Jumper and Derapchu who are checking the vents. Parrot thinks this invisible player is 
The Director.


On day 17, Spoke decides this is his time to escape. Spoke fails to make it to the top due to his lack of firework rockets. On day 18, Spoke is caught by Parrot up in the ceiling, On day 19, Spoke barely escapes from Leow0ok. Spoke jukes them. On day 20, Spoke goes back into the control room and turns off the lockdown mode. Spoke turns everything off turning the base pitch black. On days 21 and 22, Spoke evades Jumper and Parrot. Parrot tells Jumper to fill the entire vents with water so they will either drown or must have access to a respiration III helmet. 

On day 23, Spoke listens to Parrots plan to remove any materials that are used to make invisibility potions. Spoke is caught in the vents but yet again he escapes from them. It was day 24 and 25, Spoke was running out of invisibility to stay hidden. Spoke found enough invisibility to last him 5 days in the potion room. Parrot decides to remove all sugar cane. Initially Spoke was confused on why Parrot told Jumper to remove sugarcane but that's when it hit him; sugarcane is an essential ingredient of making paper and therefore, firework rockets. Theoretically, Spoke could escape by flying out below the bedrock but the closest void hole was 50k blocks away. On day 26, Spoke stumbled across a flower room. On days 27 and 28, and 29 Spoke explored the vents hoping to find materials in the spy rooms.

Spoke didn't know who the Director was but he thought it was a cool name so he addressed himself as the director. By day 30, Spoke was running out of invisibility again. so he tried to find an ender chest. On days 31 and 32, Spoke went into the meeting room hoping  to meet an ender chest. Instead he saw Parrot. On day 33, Spoke left the meeting room in search of an ender chest. Throughout day 34, Spoke stalked his enemies. On day 35, Spoke saw a spy place an ender chest and realize he can't mine it due to the mining fatigue. On day 36, Spoke was on his way to his secret base to find he was locked out due to the mining fatigue. Day 37, all the cows were massacred. On day 38 there was no milk in the storage room either. On day 39, Spoke located the optimal tunnel that led to 3 different spy rooms conducting that milk was probably in one of the spy rooms. it took Spoke until day 40 to realize the map was actually useless and flipped. On day 41, Spoke swam into the graveyard. On day 42, Spoke nearly drowns. On day 43, Spoke brew some invisibility potions until on day 44, a random spy came into the room and started drinking all of his invisibility potions. 

On day 45, Spoke wanted to break an ender chest but Derapchu was in the other room. On day 46, Spoke saw and spy thought that he couldn't be cooler than the moonwalking spy. By day 47 Spoke was banking on the mob farm but it didn't. On day 48, Spoke almost gets caught by a spy. Spoke stumbles into a mysterious empty room on day 49. On day 50, Spoke explored the library finding hidden trapdoors disguised as decorative blocks. On days 51, and 52 Spoke started fishing. On day 53, Spoke went into his base and turned on toggle sneak to sleep. On day 54, Spoke tries his attempt at fixing the mob grinder. On day 55 Spoke finds a spy riding a pig. Spoke crafted rockets on day 56 and flew into the mod grinder. On day 57, Spoke tried getting out but he placed his boat out of reach so he was trapped. On days 58 and 59, Spoke went to listen to BAT's next meeting. On day 60, Spoke swapped important items with useless items. On day 61, Spoke threw out all of the food. On day 62, Spoke broke the auto-brewer. On day 63, Spoke tried breaking all the fishing rods, On day 64, Spoke gambled. On day 65, Spoke built laughing face emojis all over the floor. Spoke sees Parrot set up a decoy room. Spoke enters the decoy room alerting Parrot know Spoke was still in the base. 

On day 66, Spoke realizes he could make their lives as miserable as possible. On day 67, Spoke attempted to start a famine by breaking all the crops. On day 68, Spoke destroys all their fishing rods. On day 69, Spoke dropped all their saplings and bonemeal. On day 70, Spoke destroyed all the nether wart and re-broke the auto-brewer. On day 71 Spoke tried trolling the mysterious room. On day 72, Spoke removed all the lapis lazuli. On day 73 and 74, Spoke fell into a trance of walking in a circle. On day 75, Spoke tried breaking a block for a full minute. Spoke broke a block and now there was hole that lead into the void. Spoke hangs a cat named "whiskers" but he accidentally dropped it in the void. On day 76, he hangs a cat named "Kittens" over the void hole. He also poured buckets of water in the water filtration room. On day 77, Spoke scraps the idea of replacing the water in the fishing pond with lava. On day 78, Spoke crafts 32 tnt and turns  the 1 tnt into a TnT minecart. 

On day 85, 86, 87, and 88, Jumper discovers the map to be messed up. Spoke places sign saying "I AM THE DIRECTOR". A spy informs them of the water room attack in day 76. Spoke places another sign saying "THE DIRECTOR IS HERE". Jumper and Parrot find out Spoke hang their pets dangling over the void. Jumper attempts to rescue them but Spoke breaks the lead killing all of the pets. Spoke then places a lot of dirt attempting to lock them in their own base but Jumper has milk and mines out.  On day 89 Spoke makes a TnT Minecart trap, and multiple void holes to kill people. On day 90, Spoke's void hole kills the pig riding spy. On day 91, Jumper investigates but accidentally falls in but since she had an elytra she escapes the trap. On day 92 Spoke makes a cart trap. On day 93, Spoke sees Parrot stashing armor in the chest labeled with an oak door. 

On day 94, Spoke interrupts the meeting and leads them to the cart trap and pulls it failing to kill them. Spoke tries to escape but fails. They chase Spoke around the base. On day 95, 96, 97, 98, 99, and 100 Spoke attempts to make Leow0ok betray but fail. Spoke is eventually captured. Spoke is placed into custody but escaps via chorous fruit. Frustrated, they reluctantly accept Spoke had escaped.



Trivia


The video was originally titled "100 Days TRAPPED in a Minecraft Void Base".

title: I Survived 100 Days Inside a Hidden Minecraft Base
content:
I Survived 100 Days Inside a Hidden Minecraft Base














Season


2






Episode


8






Upload date


Apr 8, 2025






POV


SpokeIsHere






Arcs


100 Days Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


Reddoons
Yeah_Jaron
Mapicc
PlanetLord
Baconnwaffles0
















I am going to be stalking him, until he either quits the server, or gives me what I want.





I Survived 100 Days Inside a Hidden Minecraft Base
 is the 35th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


Immediately after the events of the 
previous episode
, Spoke takes off to find Red. Spoke buys coords from Jaron, but ends up getting scammed. He proceeds to stalk and follow Jaron and Red until he finds their base. While inside, Spoke follows them in invis, finding secret rooms and pulling tricks on them. When Spoke accidentally kills Jaron and Reds pet, a white fox, he goes to PlanetLord, a player who he used to be allied with, and had collections of rare pets, including a white fox. Spoke replaces the fox whom he killed with the one from Planet, and tries to go back about his days. However, he finds the Mapicc and Planet have followed him, marking their first interaction since the Season One Finale. They ask why he is stalking these players, and Spoke claims it is because Reddoons killed his pet fish. He tries to force the duo to leave, however they refuse to.  Mapicc refuses to leave his side, and they go about stalking Jaron and Red. Back in their hidden area away from Red and Jaron's space, the three of them have a bedroom building contest, spoke going for a minimalist style, whereas Planet and Mapicc both went for more maximalist styles. After planet accidentally blows up his room and a portion of Mapicc's, Spoke declares that he wins by default. They three of them argue for a moment before Mapicc says that they should invite Squiddo, Mapicc and Planet reminisce about Squiddo and their friendship, but Spoke shuts them down, claiming she is too busy with commissions. He tells them to go make tunnels instead. Shortly after this, Planet discovers the shulker box full of George Jr. fishes (that he uses to replace the fish after they die or he kills them), and Spoke forces him into silence, telling him to never tell Mapicc. Mapicc and Spoke discover a secret puzzle room and they try to walk across, however they are bombarded by arrows and the door still does not open. They attempt over and over ago to unlock but are unsuccessful until Planet claims he saw Yeah_Jaron complete the room. They try to complete it using the information they have, but are unsuccessful, until they look up and see the path carved onto the ceiling. They follow this path and discover a hidden room on the other side, an armory filled with netherite and diamonds. They also find a room that looks like it was meant to be a villager trading hall, however it is empty with the exception of a single farmer. After this, they pull a series of cruel pranks of Jaron, who is giving a base tour to his friend BaconnWaffles0. Bacon turns away from Jaron and shuns him, leaving the base. Shortly after this, they conduct the final raid, stealing endless amounts of valuables. Mapicc is caught by Jaron, but Planet takes the fall for them, urging the duo to complete the raid. Jaron gives chase to Planet, and eventually Spoke and Mapicc step in to ensure Planet doesn't get harmed. They fight for a while until Red logs on, and they argue verbally. Red goes to get the Dragon Egg, and Spoke chases him, trying to steal it before Red gets it. They pass the Egg around from party to party for a while until Red gets it and puts it in his ender chest. With this, Spoke turns to the viewer and explains that this was not the outcome he needed, nor wanted. He exclaims that he is going to stalk Red until he dies, quits, or gives him what he wants. He says that he is going to be the force that tears Red from his wealth, and says a variety of other ominous and cruel things. With that, the episode ends.



Trivia


The video was originally titled "I Survived 100 Days Inside a Hidden Base".

title: I Survived 100 Days on a Hardcore Minecraft Server
content:
I Survived 100 Days on a Hardcore Minecraft Server














Episode


120






Upload date


Mar 14, 2026






POV


FlameFrags






Arcs


The Kingdoms Saga






Featured Creators (Description)


Twirps
LettuceK
Spongs
Wemmbu
Lomedy
TeamKalal














On the Unstable SMP: The World's Biggest Hardcore Minecraft Server, I own one of the biggest bases to ever exist.





I Survived 100 Days on a Hardcore Minecraft Server
 is the 120th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


FlameFrags
 has one of the greatest bases on the Unstable SMP. However, the base was built by 
The Law
, and a group of lawmen come to claim back the base due to using too many resources on the base without permission and begin breaking down the base. Flame asks if he can do anything to keep his base and the commander tells him there's one thing in mind. Flame and 
Lomedy
 head over to the Law HQ and talk to the other commander who tells them they're in great debt for the mega base that was built for free for the next hundred days. Flame tries to give the commander netherite to pay off that debt, but the commander says Flame has more value than resources due to his skills. The Law hires Flame to be an elite and is given a squad to work alongside him, Flame picks Lomedy as his first squad member and heads outside to hire three more players. He hires two people with ease, but everyone else ignores Flame. With no hope, Flame says he'd take anyone at that point, 
Spongs
 then comes running up and admits that he's also poor and says they could work together again. The squad heads back to the commander, the commander gives Flame a horn to blow that signals him to be able to give instructions. The commander gives them their first task, which is to transport two happy ghasts to 
Capital City
.

They go on for days on the happy ghasts and on day 9, Flame spots a player following them on a happy ghast from a distance. They stop for a second to see who it is, Flame realizes that it's players apart of the 
arachn1d_
 group and tries to ride away as fast as possible. Flame and his squad stop, allowing Lomedy to switch happy ghasts and give him a bow and arrow to shoot them down. One of the squad members, 
Gunter_____
, rides forward where there's more arachn1d minions waiting for them. Gunter decides to jump down, Spongs wants to leave him behind, but Flame has to save Gunter as a Law elite, otherwise he gets fired and loses his base. He asks for Lomedy's mace and jumps down to assist Gunter in the fight. Flame kills them all and afterwards tells Gunter to tap in when he blows his horn. After a few more days, they deliver the shipment and make it back to Law HQ. The commander gives them their next mission, which is a rescue mission of a Law compound and to save any scouts if there are any. The compound is located the 
Northern Council
, Flame asks why the commander couldn't have told them that before since they were just at Capital City, and so it takes another eight days to walk there. 

They reach the front of the compound, Flame tells them they should scout it out first with invis, but their cover was blown almost instantly. A fight begins and Flame sees one of the scouts being interrogated by an elite arachn1d guard. Unfortunately for Flame, Gunter and his other squad member, 
JakeVC42_
, dies and causes Flame, Lomedy, and Spongs to all retreat. The arachn1d group is afraid to chase them to the top of the castle, and after a day of waiting up there, Flame has the idea to use TNT minecarts and have Spongs and Lomedy shoot them and detonate them. The plan works, but the hostage was still being held captive by the elite guard who threatens to kill them if Flame tried anything. They all go back up on top of the castle and wait for another few days. Flame tells Spongs and Lomedy to wait on top of the castle. Flame jumps down and starts a bow duel with the guard, his plan is to get rid of the guard's totem and kill him then. Flame places blocks to cover line of sight and strategizes by shooting the guard with a spectral arrow, distracting them, going invis and digging down under with a shovel and TNT minecart-ing, killing him in an instant. Flame manages to save the scout and they head back to Law HQ. The commander sees that Flame lost a few team members, which sets them back a bit. The commander gives them a more simpler task, just help out The Law by recruiting new members and to not slip up. 

On day 55, they find a group of players and he tries to convince them to join, but they don't trust him due to his reputation of killing over a thousand players twice. Spongs gives Flame the idea of using a voice changer and invis, which does work on another group of players. Flame's invis runs out without him realizing, and the players all back up once they see Flame's true identity. On day 64, they decide to explore and find a way to help out The Law. They stumble across a player that's on a reverse landmine, if they step off the pressure plate, TNT would explode beneath their feet. Spongs gets Lomedy to switch positions with the player, but that did nothing. Spongs has another idea by having all three of them towering up and put a fishing rod on them, which would launch them up in the air. The player goes flying up in the air, the TNT blows up, and the player blows up when they fall back down. They start boating around, Flame admits that they didn't need to kill the player and that they could've saved them by throwing an item on top of the wooden pressure plate. They then stumble across two players who were arguing about who found the island that they were both living on first. Flame sees that their render distances didn't let them see more than twenty blocks, so he gets them to follow him to actual land, where the argument is then solved. On day 78, they went back to the Law compound and built graves for their fallen team members. 

On day 84, they make it back to the Law HQ and is put on wall duty. After a few days, Flame goes back to his base to regear. The commander over at Law HQ comes to his base and gives them their hardest mission yet, to escort a player back to Wheat Civilization. He tells them that arachn1d attacked them over at Law HQ and was saved, but now needs to be brought home. The commander says they usually don't escort players, but they made a deal with the leader of the Wheat Civilization and they want him back safe and sound. Lastly, the commander reminds them that to be a lawman, you are willing to sacrifice yourself for others in the name of justice. Flame asks the player to lead them to his base and they begin their journey. When they get closer to the civilization, they see arachn1d's group surrounding the area and needs to get through safely. Spongs notices a group of arachn1d's soldiers coming from behind, arachn1d is there with them and he tells Flame that he shouldn't have killed his soldiers. Flame sees Spongs getting chased by the group and instructs Lomedy to keep escorting the player while he saves Spongs. Flame gets the group to shift their focus onto him and gives Spongs the opportunity to follow Lomedy. Flame then lures arachn1d and his group into a cave, he digs a small hole, arachn1d tells his soldiers to all jump down. Flame then pearls up and drops a cart on them and kills a majority of the soldiers. Flame kills off the rest of the soldiers, leaving just arachn1d and him. Flame asks why he's being hunted, arachn1d says that it's his fault, and Flame doesn't understand what he means. Arachn1d explains 
Parrot
 beat him in the election, and since Parrot robbed him of his chance, he wants to make a kingdom of his own and is planning on killing him. Arach1nd says people like Flame is a threat to his kingdom and says he won't hesitate to kill Flame unless he joins the kingdom. He then asks Flame to teach him how to fight and he'll make Flame more powerful than anybody else. Flame says he doesn't really care if he takes over the server and is only focused on becoming a combat grandmaster. 

Flame makes it to the front of Wheat Civilization, Spongs says the player died, but Lomedy reveals he's joking and they lets the player go back home. Flame goes back to Law HQ and gives the commander the journal he used to write down his progress. He asks if that's all he needs to do since it's closing in on day 100, but the commander tells Flame that many lawmen aren't allowed to see a certain someone, being 
LettuceK
. He doesn't trust the soldiers to visit Lettuce in prison and expect them to not free him, so he needs somebody trustworthy. Flame visits the prison and Lettuce says he doesn't want Flame there and asks why he's there. Flame says he was checking to see if he's still alive and begins to head off, but Lettuce stops him and asks what's been going outside of the prison. Flame explains he's changed the way he's been playing and that his goal is to become a combat grandmaster. Lettuce asks if The Law is still a thing and Flame says they actually sent him there. Lettuce says Flame may be lying about The Law sending him, but for his sake, he decides to believe Flame. With nothing else to talk about, Flame leaves and Lettuce tells him to look after The Law for him. It turns to day 100 as he walks up to the front of the Northern Council, and Flame had managed to keep his mega base.



Trivia


Flame said in the comments section that this video was delayed due to losing audio, re-recording, creative burnout and other reasons.


He also mentioned this video experimented more with his personality and PvP, but not all videos will be like this.

Arcs


The Invisible Mafia Arc






Featured Creators (Description)

 ✝

After our heist went wrong, we were trapped inside the walls of a massive mining city. Forced to collect diamond blocks until the end of time, we have one goal: escape. This is the story of how I Survived Minecraft's Most Corrupt City.





I Survived Minecraft's Most Corrupt City
 is the 18th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


The video begins with 
Parrot
, 
Wifies
 and 
Dean
 attempting to rob one of 
Reddoons
' vaults in 
Capital City
. They get caught by Reddoons and 
5 invisible guards
. Reddoons tells them to clear all their inventories or else they will all die so they proceed in clearing their inventories. Reddoons leads them to the top of his tower and makes them prove they don't have any items smuggled with them by using boats and tells them that if they want to get out, they would need to complete a quota of 10 000 diamond blocks. Reddoons leads them to the mining section of the city. Parrot uses his spyglass in front of Reddoons and he tells him to give him the spyglass or else he will double his quota.  as he mined 32 diamonds (3 diamond blocks and 5 diamonds). Parrot tells Luigi not to give away the emerald. , and

 all the diamonds they stole. At night, they remunerate the diamonds and are free. CoinMonke gets baffled about how much people have been freed and confronts Parrot, Wifies and Dean.

Reddoons points out the library vault was broken into. Coin tells Reddoons that four people have left because they met their quota. Ash
 is going to kill both of them and tells everyone including Coin to line up.

Lezy
 starts taunting Coin. Luigi captures Reddoons' interest only to ask for his emerald back. Reddoons tells everyone that he will double quota and will decrease Coin's payment. Far Lands
. The next day they find Reddoons flying into Mining City again to have another talk with Coin. Reddoons talks about how Coin is always a pushover and how he needs to actually kill someone. Coin goes to the roulette table and Reddoons tells 
Naparizel
 to go first. He wins therefore Reddoons doesn't get Coin kill him. Lezy interferes with Naparizel's turn so he's next. Parrot tries to stop Reddoons but he decides to pick Luigi instead. got freed from The Mafia
 however, Wifies tells Dean to stay because if they wanted to kill them, they would've done it already. title: I Trapped Secret Bases on the Unstable SMP...
content:
I Trapped Secret Bases on the Unstable SMP...














Season


2






Episode


56






Upload date


Oct 27, 2025






POV


SpokeIsHere






Featured Creators (Description)


Mapicc
Leow0ok
JumperWho














On the Unstable SMP, I made a mistake that could cost me my LIFE, so to make sure NO ONE finds out, I tracked down every witness to rig their secret bases with as many traps as possible...





I Trapped Secret Bases on the Unstable SMP...
 is the 83rd episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


The episode starts off with 
Spoke
 spying on a group of players heading to their secret base. He plans on trapping them inside of their own base, since an hour before they all saw him griefing their village and could snitch on him. For the first group of players, Spoke rigs the staircase and a few more areas of the base. When the players come back, 
Leow0ok
 happens to be with them, doing a trade with them. Once the trade is done, Leo leaves the base. Spoke uses this opportunity to set off a chest trap and killing one of the bystanders. He sets off the staircase trap, but the person manages to clutch. He activates one last trap and kills another player. The last person finds Spoke's hidden redstone area and confronts him. They then try to run away, but Spoke kills them. Spoke cleans up the evidence and sets up more traps for the next group of players who also lived in the base. Spoke sets off a few traps, killing the rest of the group. As he's leaving, he spots spies coming to investigate the base. He tries to trap the spies, but inevitably fails, he then manages to escape without being caught.

Spoke returns to the 
B.A.T. headquarters
 and goes to the library to find the coordinates of the next hidden base. Leo comes up to him and questions Spoke about what he's up to. He brings Spoke to the village that was griefed and asks Spoke what he was doing before. Spoke lies and says he was building with 
Mapicc
. Spoke then begins heading towards the next base, until he notices people following him from behind. He anticipated this, so he goes through the Nether and heads back the fortress that Mapicc was building. As the spies watch over them, Spoke sneaks out of the fortress and heads to the base.

When he gets to the base, three players are spotted, and they soon leave to collect seagrass for their turtle. Spoke sets up his trap once again while they're gone. When they arrive back at their base, Spoke manages to trap two of the three players, and the last one spots him. Spoke then uses a knockback sword to knock them down into a corner, where a backup trap is waiting, killing them. He overheard the players talking about more people coming back, and so he rigs the base with more traps. The players come back, and Spoke floods their base with lava and blowing it up in the process. Spoke looks at the damage he's done, he then sees the spies looking right at him. Spoke then comes up with a plan to kill the spies, since the spies had to neutralize their threats before heading back to base. He lures the spies into a small tunnel and sets off TNT minecarts, one dies to them, and Spoke kills off the other one himself. He then frames somebody else for the crimes he just did. He returns back to the fortress, where Leo is talking to Mapicc. Spoke wonders why Leo is back, and Leo says it's because two spies just died. Spoke acts clueless, but Leo says he knows Spoke was at the secret bases. Mapicc defends Spoke, pretending to be his alibi and saying that Spoke was there with him. Spoke says that the spies were watching them all along, but Leo says the spies only showed up to the secret bases. Leo hints that it could've been 
JumperWho
, the same person who gave Leo the spies he has now.

Spoke then heads to the borders of the amplified lands, revealing that all of the items he's been collecting has been used to pay off his debts for 
Quackenstein123
 and his family. The episode ends with JumperWho and one of her spies watching Spoke from afar.



Trivia


The video's original title was "Trapping Secret Bases on a Hardcore SMP...".

title: I Uncovered Minecraft's Greatest Secret
content:
I Uncovered Minecraft's Greatest Secret














Season


1






Episode


5






Upload date


May 17, 2024






POV


ParrotX2






Arcs


The PrinceZam Empire Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


Wifies
‬
SpokeIsHere
PrinceZam
Wemmbu
FlameFrags
ManePear
Peentar
Merffinn
LuigiToan
‪














This Minecraft player
 knows a secret... a secret so powerful that it could change Minecraft forever. So, why does he want me to find it?





I Uncovered Minecraft's Greatest Secret
 is the 5th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot








The episode begins with 
ParrotX2
 describing a mysterious music disk that he received from a player named 
SpokeIsHere
. Upon inserting it into a jukebox with a texture pack Spoke sent him, Parrot receives a message telling him that there is a huge secret in the server and that he should bring a friend to the set of coordinates described in the disk.  

Parrot invites a player called 
Wifies
 to accompany him in this journey and arrives at the first destination, a twin set of medieval towers facing a large stone gate in the side of a hill. Standing on both pressure plates on the towers, the gate on the hill blows up, revealing a large abandoned city complex. The two find a chest containing a music disk telling them to "follow the light,” but right after they open the chest and take the disk out, they hear TNT exploding, so quickly elytra out. Parrot realizes that they must go to the lighthouse in 
Zam Empire
 to find the next clue. Being concerned about how Spoke knew exactly when they had gotten their hands on the disk, Parrot hands 
Wifies
 his prized 
spyglass
 as a token of trust. 

After heading toward the Zam Empire, Parrot and Wifies don't find anything significant and instead encounter 
Wemmbu
 and 
PrinceZam
, who ask that they hand over the disks and let them take care of the secret instead. Parrot declines and 
Wifies
 splashes himself and Parrot with a potion of invisibility, escaping the clutches of the Zam Empire leader after a tense battle. Parrot and Wifies return to the lighthouse, noticing that it is blinking and decode it as a Morse code message which translates to "minus 64,” or the y level of -64 (in the void). 

After searching under the lighthouse, Parrot and Wifies discover a staircase leading to the void. They find another music disk telling them to fly in the void for two thousand blocks north, but after flying to the destination, they find a group of shulkers and a hole in the bedrock that was blocked off with obsidian. Parrot and Wives return to the hole they entered, but find that that hole has been blocked off as well. They return to the shulkers, running low on fireworks, and decide to fly to the void base of 
JumperWho
, but with Wifies too low on fireworks to make it, they come up with the solution of using fishing rods to conserve. 

Barely surviving the void, Parrot and Wifies play the new disk, which gives them the code of 9783, the password to PrinceZam's vault. Parrot and Wifies splash themselves with a potion of invisibility, and after sneaking past 
FlameFrags
 and 
ManePear
, they enter the vault where they grab the next disk and a lodestone compass just before 
Merffinn
 comes out of AFK. The two head to their destination, where a lodestone floats in the air in an ice spikes biome. Confused about where the next clue is, Parrot replays the message over and over again until they figure out that the "riddle" in the message is hidden in the phrase "it's pretty straightforward, it gets pretty straight to the point." After following a straight line between the point of a nearby ice spike and the lodestone, they find a chest beneath the ice containing another lodestone compass. 

Parrot and Wifies yet again follow the directions until they find a giant ice mountain with its insides carved out. An invisible player waits for them at the bottom in front of two large chests beside a parkour course that leads all the way to the top. He motions for them to put all their items in the chest before starting the parkour. They manage to make their way to the top with lots of close calls and retrieve their gear from two double chests as well as a third one that holds a lodestone compass and the next disk. They listen to the disk, which was just Spoke telling them good job and to continue finding the secret. Parrot then brings up the question of why he would want him to bring a friend, but they ignore that and head to the next location. 

Parrot and Wifies arrive at a giant obsidian dome and are greeted by the same invisible player that was waiting for them at the parkour. He places down two double chests and they put their stuff in it, but Parrot secretly keeps two invis potions and golden carrots. They head into the next challenge, a maze, but soon realize that they need to find the disk and get out as soon as possible because they hear the voices of Wemmbu and PrinceZam, who are likely here to hunt them down. They splash themselves with invis and eventually find their way to the exit, which is blocked, and since they have mining fatigue, they can’t get out. However, Wemmbu finds them and they strike a deal. If Wemmbu lets them go, then he can have the disk and turtle egg in the chest at the center. 

After their encounter with Wemmbu and PrinceZam, Parrot and Wifies decide to set an auto stasis chamber and sneak into PrinceZam’s vault to steal the disk, which will most likely be stored there. They splash themselves with invis, head into the vault, and steal the disk and turtle egg. The guards, ManePear and 
Peentar
, and PrinceZam and Wemmbu attack them. They escape into the nether, but Wemmbu and PrinceZam find them. Parrot tells them that they can work together to find Spoke and after they give him the turtle egg and disk and return to the overworld, he breaks the portal. They escape again and listen to the disk.

Once the turtle egg hatched, Parrot and Wifies follow it all the way to the ocean, where they see a giant shipwreck in the water. On shore, the invisible player is waiting for them again with three double chests. They put their stuff in the first two chests and are supplied with two turtle shell helmets and eight water breathing potions. In the water, they find a shipwreck in the middle and ruins surrounding it. There are four towers surrounding the ship, each containing an item frame that they quickly deduct would have to be containing an item for a big hatch in the corner of the ruins to open. They find all of the items and open the hatch, which leads to an underwater graveyard, where they figure out where the chest is and take the disk and another lodestone compass. 

It leads Parrot and Wifies to a jungle. They split up to search and Parrot finds a jungle temple containing the disk. When played, Spoke tells them to fly to 5000, 5000 in the nether. The invisible player is waiting for them at the coordinates and they put their stuff in the chests again. 

On the other side of the portal is an escape room. Parrot and Wifies successfully complete all of the rooms and drop into a house in the middle of a mesa biome. Upon closer observation, however, the mesa is just a custom escape room inside a 100 by 100 obsidian box. They manage to escape that as well and collect the last disk. Spoke says that they are one step away from learning the secret and that it will change their life. Parrot then brings up the notion that Spoke had him bring a partner to do the scavenger hunt with, as well as the sheer amount of obsidian and manpower needed to complete that escape room. They head back to Parrot’s base and find the invisible player waiting for them there.

The invisible player drinks a bucket of milk and reveals himself to be Spoke all along. He takes Parrot and Wifies to the final obstacle, which is a series of tasks they will complete to determine the player who learns the secret. But here’s the catch: only one player can make it out alive. The other will get chunk banned. Parrot and Wifies debate whether to take the risk or not, but knowing everything they went through, they agree that they’ll figure something out. As they progress through the challenges (a puzzle, redstone parkour, maze, potion obstacle course, another parkour, and a mini escape room), when they reach the end, Parrot and Wifies are tied. However, Spoke has a tiebreaker, which is a game of chess. Parrot takes Wifies aside and they decide to end in a stalemate so Spoke can't ban either of them. 

The plan works, but Spoke refuses to let both of them go. After a long moment between Parrot and Wifies, Wifies asks him if this secret is really worth it. Parrot tells Wifies that he knows what he's going to say, so Wifies gives Parrot his spyglass and steps into the chunk ban.

Once Parrot and Spoke arrive at the surface, Spoke reveals that there is no secret. He just wanted to get revenge on him for something he did in the past. LuigiToan
. arrive. He realizes that they were tracking Spoke the whole time and this was why they wanted to hijack the scavenger hunt so badly. They chase him around the sky and eventually make their way all the way to the chunk ban.

This is the first 
Unstable Universe
 video to be over 3 hours long.


This episode is where 
Wifies
 has his first debut.

title: Important Items in Unstable Universe
content:
"
Till we meet again, friend.
"
This article contains major spoilers from recently released episodes. Please proceed with caution.




Important Items
 in 
Unstable Universe
 are items that hold sentimental meaning to their players or are heavily lore relevant.



Parrot's Spyglass


Main article: 
Parrot's Spyglass


 
 
 
 
 


Parrot's Spyglass
 is a recurring item in Unstable. It was originally given to 
Wifies
 by 
Parrot
 in 
I Uncovered Minecraft's Greatest Secret
, mentioning that it has "sentimental value" to him. Eventually, 
Wifies
 gave it back to Parrot before chunkbanning himself. It appeared in most of Parrot's videos up until the finale of 
The Director Arc
. In 
Escaping Paragon: The Perfect Minecraft Prison
, Parrot was forced to drop the spyglass by Wifies onto the platform below, which he picked up before it despawned. Later on, Wifies forced Parrot to stand with him on pressure plates which would detonate hundreds of TNTs and blow them up if one of them stepped off. However, Parrot kept the spyglass and dropped it on the pressure plate, allowing him to walk off of the trap. Wifies stepped off his pressure plate to run towards the spyglass so he can pick it up one last time, setting off the TNT and killing him as well as destroying the spyglass in the process. Parrot still has a spyglass, albeit being a different one.



deanthebean9's Goat Horn


Main article: 
Deanthebean9's Goat Horn


 
 
 
 
 


Dean’s Goat Horn was a goat horn (Yearn) given to 
deanthebean9
 in 
The Search for Minecraft's Far Lands
 by 
Wifies
 after 
Parrot
 told him to do so. The horn was meant to be used if 
Dean
 was ever in danger, since Parrot assumed that Dean was not smart enough to use messages. Later, Dean admits that he was leaking their coordinates to 
The Mafia
, a faction that have been hunting them down, hence how they kept finding them every time, which led to Dean leaving the team after blowing the horn. Parrot later finds him in 
Unstable SMP: The First War
 in the jungle where they had their last argument, but refused to let him rejoin because of Dean's earlier betrayal. Wanting to help, Dean secretly rejoins the Mafia to help Parrot by sabotaging his mafia teammates during the war. Parrot, noticing this, tries to kill him, thinking he's a free kill, not knowing it was Dean because of invisibility. They both knock each other off a really high bomber plane, causing both of them to pop their totems when they land, which clears Dean's invisibility. Dean blew the horn one last time before the Mafia pulled his stasis, teleporting him into the void — the punishment for losing invisibility — and ultimately dies.



George Junior (Fish bucket)


Main article: 
George Junior (fish bucket)


 
 
 
 
 
 
George Junior
 is a salmon fish in a bucket that 
Spoke
 always keeps in his hotbar. Spoke has a full shulker of these and usually replaces him every time he dies. He is the oldest important item in the entire series dating all the way back to 
Episode 1
.

It also served as Spoke's secret identity (Fish bucket) while he was infiltrating 
The Invisible Mafia
.

The shulker box full of George Juniors was presumably destroyed when 
JamatoP
 burned all Spoke's inventory and ender chest in 
Finding 1000 Missing Minecraft Players
.



Gambit (Mace)


Main article: 
Maces § Gambit


Gambit
 is a mace owned by 
Wemmbu
. This was first given to 
Wemmbu
 by 
Yeah Jaron
. 
Yeah Jaron
 provided the weapon so 
Wemmbu
 could help defend the 
Skyblock Civilization
 from a raid by the 
The Invisible Mafia
. 
Wemmbu
 once lost it to 
FlameFrags
during a fight to save his friend, 
Eggchan
. The mace passed through several hands—from 
FlameFrags
 to 
ClownPierce
 and then to 
FerreMC
—before 
Wemmbu
 recovered it by defeating 
FerreMC
 in combat and taking him hostage.

Enchants:
 Density V, Mending, Unbreaking III, Fire Aspect II, Wind Burst I.



Crucible (Mace)


Main article: 
Maces § Crucible


Crucible
 is a mace originally belonged to a "Diamond Player" of 
The Invisible Mafia
 named 
Iqcniq
. After 
Eggchan
 Civilization collapsed, it was briefly stolen by 
Jaden MAN
, but 
Wemmbu
 eventually forced 
Jaden MAN
 to surrender it. This mace was stolen by 
Conexion
, also known as Sharpness, forcing 
Wemmbu
 to chase him into the 
Far Lands
. It was later given to 
FlameFrags
, who eventually returned it to 
Wemmbu
 because he felt he did not need it.

Enchants:
 Breach IV, Mending, Unbreaking III, Fire Aspect II.



Rejoicin's Sunflower


 
 
 
 
 
 
Rejoicin's Sunflower
 is 
Rejoicin
's favorite flower, possibly due to his Minecraft skin being based off one. He had multiple stacks of them in a double chest. He gave 
Wemmbu
 one in 
I Explored an Abandoned Minecraft Civilization
. Following Rejoicin's death, Wemmbu has always kept the flower in his Ender Chest, signifying his grief for him.

Alt (Netherite Chestplate)


Main article: 
Alt


 
 
 
 
 
Spoke
 wearing Alt in the thumbnail for 
I Almost Got BANNED from the Unstable SMP...
 
 


Alt
 is an exploited Netherite Chestplate that 
Spoke
 always wears. It was given to Spoke by 
JamatoP
 when they were testing out the exploits. It has every possible enchant that a chestplate can have, except for Thorns. It has a Snout armor trim with redstone material. Spoke also used to have other illegal exploited armor pieces but they were all broken (except for Alt) while fighting 
Wemmbu
 in 
How to Destroy the Unstable SMP
. It accompanied Spoke for more than 2 Seasons, before broken by 
Mapicc
 in 
Finding 1000 Missing Minecraft Players
.

This, alongside George Junior, is the oldest important item in the entire series.

Enchants:
 Protection IV, Blast Protection IV, Fire Protection IV, Projectile Protection IV, Mending, Unbreaking III.

It was later broken by 
Mapicc
 in 
Finding 1000 Missing Minecraft Players
 after 
JamatoP
 told him that Spoke was lying to him and that 
Leo
 didn't kill him but Spoke did.



🔥 (Netherite Chestplate)


 
 
 
 
 
Flame
's Chestplate on an Armor Stand  
 
 


🔥
 is a netherite chestplate that was worn by 
FlameFrags
. This is one of the only things 
Flame
 cared about on the sever as much as his love for combat. He was given it when he was a diamond player in 
The Mafia
, proof that he was one of the best players. It is an eye trim like all the players with ranks in the mafia. This chestplate had its trim material changed from Diamond to Redstone to match his anger after his base was raided and destroyed. It was later broken by 
Wemmbu
 with an 
Orbital Strike Cannon
 during their rematch.







Eggchan's Book


 
 
 
 
 
Eggchan
's Book (Book and Quill)
 
 


Eggchan's Book (Book and Quill) contains server information, and history; dating back to the Zam Empire Arc as it is the arc where Eggchan first joined. This book was written with information over the course of Eggchan, and Wemmbu's adventures on the Unstable SMP.

It is currently stolen by 
Invisible Guy
, which made him kidnap 
Eggchan
 to ask 
Wemmbu
 the location of 
orbital strike cannons
.

It's Impossible to Catch this Player
 is the 6th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


The episode starts off after 
Wemmbu's
 fight with 
SpokeIsHere
, in which Spoke escaped using an ender pearl stasis chamber. Wemmbu, of course, makes it his goal to kill Spoke. Spoke’s base was, of course, empty, so he heads towards 
ParrotX2's
 base to ask him if he knows Spoke’s whereabouts, but Parrot doesn’t tell him anything. The only other player on the server that could know where Spoke was was 
JamatoP
, but after interviewing him at his base, Wemmbu finds out that he doesn’t know anything. He is about to leave when he spots other players in the base and quickly hides. The other players turn out to be 
ManePear
, 
Sorhin
, and 
FlameFrags
, three of 
PrinceZam's
 guards who are also looking for Spoke. 

Wemmbu decides to follow the guards back to the 
Zam Empire
 to see if PrinceZam wanted to form an alliance with him in their search for Spoke. However, in the middle of their conversation, 
Mapicc
 jumps them and they see a plane launching TNT onto the Zam Empire in the distance. PrinceZam’s castle is blown up and a fight ensues between Wemmbu, PrinceZam, and his guards, ManePear, FlameFrags, Sorhin, 
LuigiToan
, 
ECorridor
, zzye, 
loppezz
, 
yungwillx
, and 
Peentar
, and Spoke’s cronies, Mapicc, 
JumperWho
, 
SykerMC
, 
TeamKalal
, 
Chiffoi
, Elemental_Man, 
RealReeon
, 
Only_A_Squid
, 
Derapchu
, 
What_Max
, 
Arcn
, ItsRyanStuff, and 
Sharooh
. They manage to blow up TeamKalal before Spoke’s goons stasis away.

Wemmbu and PrinceZam check with 
TheRealSquiddo
 first for the whereabouts of Spoke due to her previous affiliations with him. Squiddo agrees to DM them the coordinates of where Spoke last was. They find contraband items, stacked totems, and a spawn egg in her chests, so they 
chunk ban
 her.  

Wemmbu and PrinceZam spot Parrot and 
Wifies
 at the lighthouse on the outskirts of the Zam Empire. After a bit of prodding, Parrot reveals that Spoke sent them on a scavenger hunt for a secret that could change the server. Wemmbu demands the disk (when played with a texture pack reveals the next clue) they were talking about, but they refuse. Wemmbu and PrinceZam catch them breaking into the castle and chase them around the empire grounds, eventually losing them. 

They start heading to Squiddo’s coordinates, which are in the end. At the stronghold, they are attacked by Mapicc, 
Sharkilz_
, and RealReeon, three of Spoke’s henchmen who are guarding the portal. Mapicc and Sharkilz_ are able to escape while they manage to chunk ban RealReeon. 

Wemmbu and PrinceZam find a massive end base at the coordinates and sneak up on Spoke, JumperWho, and Derapchu. They chunk ban Derapchu and JumperWho, but Spoke escapes into the void. 

Seeing that chunk banning Spoke wasn’t as easy as they thought it would be, Wemmbu and PrinceZam come up with a plan to get him without a totem, then one-shot him with a 
mace
. They trade for a trial chamber map and mess around for a while before finding the chambers, where they get the ingredients for the mace. However, Arcn, Only_A_Squid, 
Fantst
, Sharooh, and Mapicc jump them in the trial chambers, so Wemmbu heads to the surface to get wood craft the mace while PrinceZam leads them to him. They then engage into a big fight and Arcn is chunk banned. 

Wemmbu and PrinceZam change plans and decide to go after Spoke’s henchmen, assuming that they will lead them to Spoke himself. They use an arrow tracker to track down Only_A_Squid and chunk ban him. They leave the underground base and after a bit of flying, spot a nether portal. They land to check it out and are attacked by Fantst and Sharooh, chunk banning Sharooh. 

The next location is a giant obsidian box. They break inside and see Mapicc, engaging in a fight. They are about to drop him when a group of invisible players that are later revealed to be Spoke, Sharkilz_, and Fantst  jump them. They take PrinceZam hostage and use him as a bargaining chip for the mace. Wemmbu burns the mace, so they start attacking again. Wemmbu and PrinceZam are about to die when they suddenly stasis away, leaving them broke. 

Once Wemmbu and PrinceZam regear themselves, they head to another obsidian box which, upon entering, isn’t infested with Spoke or his minions. Inside the obsidian box is a maze, and after wandering around, they find themselves back at the entrance. They assume that this is a trap set up by Mapicc until they hear Parrot and Wifies’s voice somewhere else in the maze. Wemmbu tells PrinceZam to barricade and guard the entrance while he starts searching for Parrot and Wifies. He is about to give up when he sees a name tag and mines in through the roof with a bucket of milk to counter the mining fatigue. He finds Parrot and Wifies without armour and makes a deal with them: if they show him where the disk is, then he’ll let them go alive. Wemmbu obtains the disk and turtle egg that was inside the chest at the center, but realizes that they need the texture pack Spoke sent Parrot to listen to the disk after Parrot and Wifies already left. 

Regardless, Wemmbu and PrinceZam head back to the Zam Empire to set a trap for Parrot and Wifies, knowing that they would likely try to steal the disk. Since the arrow tracker pointed them to Parrot and Wifies, they must be related to Spoke in some way. They put the disk in PrinceZam’s castle’s vault and set their ender pearl stasis chambers in a pile of gold and emerald blocks. 

Wemmbu and PrinceZam arrive at a manmade hole dug into the floor of an ocean decorated with custom coral, ruins, and many elder guardians. They come across a giant underwater castle and enter it, finding Sharkilz_ and chunk banning him after a short fight. However, not ten seconds after they ban him, the entire castle blows up, including the chunk ban, allowing Sharkilz_ to log back on and start attacking, as well as Fantst, who was hiding in the castle to jump them. In the end, they manage to chunk ban both Sharkilz_ and Fantst. 

Seeing that they only had one more location to go to, PrinceZam and Wemmbu split up so PrinceZam could go back to his empire to fetch more people and chunk bans and Wemmbu could stall Spoke. 

Wemmbu flies away until he eventually finds two twin towers guarding a blown up entrance into a mountain. He goes in and spots an invisible player, assuming that it was Mapicc. He communicates using signs and tells Wemmbu that he doesn’t care if he bans him off and that he would take Wemmbu to Spoke under a few conditions. 

The invisible player leads Wemmbu to a giant ice mountain that was hollowed out to create a parkour course inside. The player tells Wemmbu that he needs to complete the course without cheating and with no armour. After a few close calls with death, he completes the parkour, where he learns that this is part of the scavenger hunt Parrot and Wifies were doing. 

The player then leads Wemmbu to the next location, the same obsidian box he and PrinceZam previously found Parrot and Wifies in. The player tells Wemmbu that Spoke told him that he didn’t properly complete the maze. He forces Wemmbu to put all of his stuff in a chest and gives him two minutes to solve the maze. Wemmbu easily finds his way to the center and the player tells him that phase two is complete. He takes back all of his gear and the player leads him to the third location.

The invisible player puts down a sign that says “Squiddo’s castle.” Wemmbu, realizing that this wasn’t Mapicc, but instead, Spoke, starts critting him out, but he pulls his ender pearl stasis and disappears after a quick fight. 

Wemmbu elytras to Squiddo’s castle, assuming that Spoke is there. The castle is almost completely burned down with fire spreading everywhere. He quickly finds Spoke and lands in front of him. They quickly engage in battle while Spoke tries to overpower Wemmbu’s moral with his taunts. Spoke tells him that at the end of the day, no matter how many people Wemmbu chunk bans, he will still be on the losing side of this war. Wemmbu says that PrinceZam is bringing people right now to help him, but Spoke retorts that no matter how many materials or manpower he brings, the amount of gear Spoke possesses is unimaginable. After a long, long, fight, Wemmbu manages to steal Spoke’s shulker full of all his materials and finally drain him of his resources, forcing him to yet again stasis away. However, before he left, Spoke shot a few arrows that Wemmbu could use to track his location, which he must’ve intended for him to find. 

Before Wemmbu could process any of the information, he was teleported to PrinceZam’s vault by the ender pearl stasis chamber they had set earlier. He sees PrinceZam, ManePear, and Peentar battling two invisible players that had stolen the disk and turtle egg and realizes that Parrot and Wifies had come to rob them. They chase them all the way to their underground nether portal and head inside, where they quickly find Parrot and Wifies behind a cluster of magma blocks. Wemmbu and PrinceZam strike a deal with them that they would hand Parrot and Wifies the disk to decode and then they would work together to find Spoke. Once Wemmbu and PrinceZam return to the overworld, though, Parrot and Wifies break the portal and escape. Wemmbu and PrinceZam return to the nether to search for them, but it was already too late. 

They gather 
Merffinn
 and LuigiToan, two of PrinceZam’s guards and head in the direction Spoke’s arrows pointed towards. However, when they reach the location, they see something interesting, finding Parrot chasing Spoke around in the sky. They follow parrot and start attacking Spoke. He leads them into two obsidian surrounded staircases and into what must’ve been the final challenge in Parrot and Wifies’s scavenger hunt, which included a puzzle, a redstone parkour course, a maze, a potion obstacle course, another parkour, a mini escape room, and a life-sized chess set. 

A fight ensues in the last room with the chessboard, which Merffinn discovers contains an active chunk ban. Spoke, on the other hand, says a few last words to Parrot and steps into the chunk ban. Everyone is shocked and confused, but Wemmbu realizes that he would rather be chunk banned than die at the hands of the Zam Empire, which meant that prisons would have to be constructed to keep the chunk bans from being broken. Now, all that was left to do was rebuild the Zam Empire.



Errors


In various sections of the video, the health bar switches from hardcore hearts to regular hearts.


Trivia


This video was recorded with a pre-1.21 snapshot with the mace due to it's cooldown being similar to the sword's cooldown.
