title: It's Impossible to Find this Player
content:
It's Impossible to Find this Player














Season


1






Episode


12






Upload date


Jul 22, 2024






POV


ParrotX2






Arcs


The PrinceZam Empire Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


Wifies
 ✝
Jaden MAN
Spongs
Boosfer
Kierrrr
Its_Dev_
Wemmbu
ClownPierce














A few days ago, 
5
 
of
 
my
 
best
 
friends
 as well as 
ClownPierce
 all vanished. All that was left of them was a book with a set of coordinates. I have no idea where they went, but I'm going to find them.





It's Impossible to Find this Player
 is the 12th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


After five of 
ParrotX2's
 friends, 
rekrap2
, 
JumperWho
, 
Kenadian_
, 
Derapchu
, and 
Leow0ok
, disappear, along with 
ClownPierce
, the server's deadliest player, Parrot and 
Wifies
 head to the location that Clown left them. Upon arrival, they stumble across a massive sky island. Parrot and Wifies find two players, 
Jaden_MAN
 and 
Spongs
, who refer to themselves as the game masters. They tell Parrot and Wifies that if they want to find the missing players, they had to complete quests.  


Parrot and Wifies’s first quest is for a Heart of the Sea. They clean their inventories and the game masters give them a kit to complete the quest with. They destroy an underwater gold box in a lake and find a barrel with a lodestone compass. They are interrupted by two players named 
Kierrrr
 and 
Its_Dev
. They say that they have been ordered by a player named 
Boosfer
 to assist them in their quest, but Parrot and Wifies get suspicious, so they pot invis and run away. They come across Clown-themed ships and Parrot finds a book that says "Dig where the winds meet.” Wifies tells him that they have to go in the direction of the sails. After obtaining the Heart of the Sea, Parrot realises that it’s Derapchu's prized possession. They put the item into the corresponding quest temple and a blue beacon lights up.
 
 
 
 
the sky island 
Clown
 lead 
Parrot
 and 
Wifies
.
 
 
The game masters give Parrot and Wifies another kit and send them on another quest for a pair of netherite boots, Jumper’s prized possession. Parrot and Wifies find a town in the sky, but Kier and Dev show up again for "assistance.” They have to catch thirty-two fish, light all of the hot air balloons, replace all of the lanterns, repair all of the damaged crops, and fill all of the empty cauldrons. Parrot and Wifies place the lanterns. They find some flying machines and glowstone beneath carpets throughout the island. Parrot distract Kier and Dev by telling them that the hot air balloons are in the shape of an arrow, and they fly off. They follow a trail of glowstone to a sea lantern, where Wifies uses it to activate the flying machines. They look below a sea lantern flying machine and find the boots, which they place into a quest temple and activate a white beacon.
 
 
 
 
Town that Parrot and Wifies explored during the quest
 
 
 
 
 
 
The glowing flying machines Parrot and Wifies activate
 
 
Parrot and Wifies don’t find the game masters, but they see their ender chests and kits for the next quest. They decide to go talk to Boosfer about why he wants the items so much. They head to his headquarters, an office building in a jungle. Boosfer says that he steals people’s prized possessions and sells them for lots of money. Parrot asks him to stop bothering them, but he declines and says he doesn’t care. Parrot tells him that the items were meant to help them find their missing friends and that if Boosfer interferes, they may be gone forever.  

 
 
 
 
 
Flower field with a hidden poppy
 
 


 
 
 
 
 
Rekrap's base (the large tree Parrot and Wifies find)
 
 


Parrot and Wifies go on another quest to look for a poppy, which they have no idea who it belongs to. They find a massive flower field in which they have to locate a poppy within. While searching for the poppy, Parrot gets irritated by how many red tulips are in the fields since they look like poppies. After a long time of searching and going insane over flowers, they finally find the poppy. They dig under the poppy and find a cave with lots of poppies as well. They realize that the poppies lead to something so they follow the path of the poppies and eventually reach a valley.  

Parrot and Wifies explore the valley until they see more moss and grass, which leads to a large tree. They walk around it until Parrot gets mining fatigue. They decide to check the inside of the tree and find an escape room. It goes wells until they hear the tree burning down and fireworks being shot by none other than Kier, Dev and Boosfer. Parrot and Wifies hide from them, but after they find them, they ask for the item. Wifies offers to distract them while Parrot continues looking for the item, but he declines and keeps them busy instead. He begins bluffing and deletes everything from the book, writing, "Through the valley's last edge, under the boulder below" on the first page and "deez nuts" on the second page before giving it to them. 

After a while of meandering around, they uncover Parrot’s bluff. He leads them to where they were actually supposed to go and mines down, but realises that the tree is Rekrap's base. Since Wifies stashed the item in his ender chest, Kier, Dev and Boosfer threaten to kill them and blow up the base. Parrot doesn’t want them to, giving them leverage over him and Wifies. They tell them to bring the item to their headquarters in thirty minutes or else the base gets destroyed.

Once they leave, Parrot and Wifies start evacuating all of the animals in Rekrap’s base. They hear withers and find bomber planes. They bridge up to them and find 
Wemmbu
. He tells them that he was paid by someone anonymous to grief Rekrap's base. Parrot realizes it's Boosfer, Kier and Dev, and Wemmbu admits that they were the ones who hired him. He needs money to build another empire of his own and get revenge on 
PrinceZam
 and the 
Zam Empire
 by declaring war on them. Parrot tells Wemmbu that he doesn't need to stoop down Zam’s level to get revenge, and that they can rob Boosfer, Kier, and Dev, which Wemmbu agrees to. 

Parrot and Wifies place the flower in its quest temple’s item frame and activate the beacon. They retrieve their netherite gear to tell Boosfer that his plan to bomb the valley failed. He taunts them, and, realising that there is no point in staying, they head back to the quest temples.

Upon return, Parrot interrogates Jaden and Spongs about why they’re always absent. They play dumb and give them a cave quest. They are looking for a diamond, which Parrot assumes belongs to Leo. After entering the cave, they are met with another escape room. They complete it and find a cave maze. On the other side is an ancient city where they have to kill a warden to obtain a skulk catalyst needed to open a vault door. The warden is defeated and they find Leo’s diamond behind the vault door. 

Parrot and Wifies go back to the quest temples and activate the beacon for the diamond. However, Kier and Dev jump them and steal all of the items that they found. They just played dumb the entire time and waited for a chance to steal all of the items at once. There is nothing they can do without the game masters. When they finally arrive, Parrot lectures them about their irresponsibility and tell them that they need to deal with something else.

They head to the Wemmbu Civilization and form a plan to rob Boosfer, Kier, and Dev. Parrot tells Wemmbu that he will help destroy their base using an 
orbital cannon
 as long as Wemmbu only uses it on them and the Zam Empire. They launch the orbital cannon and grief Boosfer, Kier, and Dev’s base. After a successful heist in which they steal most of the Treasure Hunters’ riches, Parrot and Wifies head back to the quest temples.

Parrot tells the game masters to send them on the nether quest. They receive a book with six sets of coordinates. The first set has oddly placed nether quartz. They realise that it is morse code and they translate it to "Rurple," which is supposed to mean "Purple.” They go to the second set of coordinates but only find a lava ocean. They go to the third set of coordinates and are met with a bastion, along with a sign that says "840 32 cyan.” They head to the next set of coords and find a chest in a nether fortress with a magenta candle, a spruce button, an oak plank, and brown wool. The decode the blocks with their block IDs to find the message “670.5 brown.” They arrive above a lava lake and splash each other with fire resistance before jumping in and finding a sign that says “960.18 pink.” They go to the nether roof of the second set of coords and find two signs that say "390.43 blue” and "390.43 blue.” 

The last set of coordinates houses a library constructed over a lava ocean. Parrot and Wifies tame striders to ride and use the 
Dewey Decimal System
 to find specific books, which they use to unlock a vault at the back. They find a wither rose and Parrot realises that it belongs to Kenadian. They head back to the quest temples to activate their fifth beacon.

Parrot and Wifies go to the end quest. They do a parkour course/escape room to reach the portal to the outer end islands. They find a chest containing fireworks, elytras, and a book. They search the islands and find an end city with a cartography table and Wifies’s prized dragon head. Upon returning to the main end island, they run into Kier and Dev. They respawn the ender dragon and threaten to kill them. Parrot and Wifies obtain their gear through an ender chest in the end city and chase them away. They place Wifies’s dragon head in the sixth quest temple and activate the beacon. 

Parrot and Wifies head to their usual meeting place with Jaden and Spongs, but instead see Clown. Parrot asks him why there are seven quest temples since they completed all of the quests and only six beacons were lit. Clown tells Parrot that he is the last key. Parrot places down the final item to return the missing players, his precious 
spyglass
. Clown empties all of their inventories before leading them to what they worked to achieve all along.

Welcome to 
Proton
, Minecraft’s most secure prison.

content:
Its_Dev_














Alias


Dev






Pronouns


He/Him






Channel


@KIERandDEV






Info




Status


Alive

Kierrrr
Boosfer








Appearances




Appears in


Why I Destroyed Our Minecraft Server
It's Impossible to Find this Player
I Built Minecraft's Safest Civilization






Debut


Why I Destroyed Our Minecraft Server








Its_Dev_
, also known as 
Dev
, is a supporting character featured in 
Unstable Universe
. Him and his friend 
Kierrrr
 work for 
Boosfer
 as the 
Treasure Hunters
.



History


Boosfer sends Kierrrr and Its_Dev to steal specific items from 
ParrotX2
 and 
Wifies
. Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ try to intercept Parrot and Wifies during a quest, but they escape using invisibility.

Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ find Parrot and Wifies again. Parrot gives them a book, but edits the book to get rid of some important clues. They convince Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ that the hot air balloons around the area are in the shape of an arrow. Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ leave.

Parrot and Wifies go to Boosfers base, who is the leader of Kierrrr and Its_Dev_. They try to convince him not to steal these items, but he doesn’t listen. They leave.

Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ steal all of the items that Parrot and Wifies obtained from a quest.

Boosfer pays Wemmbu to destroy "the valley". Wemmbu finds Parrot and Wifies and agrees to team with them to steal items from Boosfer, Kierrrr, and Its_Dev_. They destroy the top layer of their headquarters with an 
Orbital Strike Cannon
. Wemmbu finds their secret vault of items and together, they steal thousands of netherite and diamond blocks from them.

Parrot and Wifies go to the end as part of their quest. They find Wifies prized dragon head. Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ try to kill them, but they escape to the outer islands. Parrot and Wifies find an ender chest and use the items in there to try to kill Kierrrr and Its_Dev_. They manage to escape.

Its_Dev_ and Kierrrr vote against Boosfer in 
The End Civilization
.

ItzRealMe

ItzRealMe
, also known as 
Itz
, is a character featured in 
Unstable Universe
, serving as the main antagonist of episode called 
I Got Hunted by the World's Best Minecraft Player
. Later he serves as the deuteragonist in 
I Got Trained By the World's Best Minecraft Player
.



Personality


ItzRealMe is incredibly stoic and cold, even coming off as rude to people who seem to idolize him, such as DylPickle. He is focused on his job and tends to streamline his thoughts and focus completely on his mission, blocking out things he deems as distractions, which can be a double-edged sword. He is self assured and very intelligent, as well as being a man of few words, believing that his actions speak louder than his words ever will. 



History


ItzRealMe tries to assassinate 
ParrotX2
. A team of people called 
Bounty Assassin Team
 save him from Itz. They escape from Itz by going to the nether. Their leader, 
Leow0ok
 invites Parrot to BAT. Parrot and Leow0ok see Itz inside of Parrot’s house. They start constructing a massive obsidian prison around Parrots house because they knew Itz would sit there patiently and wait for the prey.

BAT tries to kill ItzRealMe, but are forced to run away as it reveals that he has a 
mace
. Itz later finds Parrot in the 
BAT headquarters
. The BAT team saves Parrot. 

After this incident ItzRealMe comes to Parrot's room and tells him that 
The Director
 is the one who hired him to assassinate Parrot.  

Seeking to become a "Combat Master," 
FlameFrags
 tracked down the legend to his remote hideout to request training.

Initially reluctant to return to combat, ItzRealMe was persuaded when Flame pointed out that they shared a common enemy: 
the Law
, a faction hunting down elite players like them. Itz agreed to train Flame the mace techniques so that the student could eventually dismantle The Law, allowing both of them to live in peace.

The most vital lesson ItzRealMe imparted was the concept of "The Zone"—a state of absolute focus. He taught that a master must silence all distractions (including "yapping" or trash talk: "bro", "like", "dude", etc.) to observe the opponent’s habits and patterns. He emphasized that "the quieter you become, the more you can hear," using meditation as a tool to sharpen the senses.



Quotes




Every player no matter how long they've played, no matter what gamemode, no matter what weapons they use, everyone has their strengths and everyone has their weaknesses.



Itz
, to 
Flame
 in 
I Got Trained By the World's Best Minecraft Player


Trivia


As said by 
Parrot
, he is commonly known to be the "Best Minecraft Player", being first on the MCTiers Rankings and having Tier 1 in almost every gamemode before retiring on most of them.


He is now currently the #1 player in the entire world on MCTIERS.

Jaden_MAN
, or simply 
Jaden
, is a supporting character in Season 1 and the main antagonist in both the 
Pirate Arc
 and the Betrayal Arc. He is also the leader of The Pirates. He is a major character in the 
Kings Arc
, and the tritagonist of 
Wemmbu
's pov of 
Kingdoms
. Jaden_MAN is one of the only 
mace
 holders on the SMP and uses his riptide trident playstyle with his mace.



History


Season 1


A team of people, including Jaden_MAN, try to destroy 
Wemmbu's Civilization
. Wemmbu is able to win the war against them with traps.

A team of people, including 
FlameFrags
 and Jaden_MAN, invade Wemmbu's Civilization. The civilization manages to get them to run away, but the entrance area of the civilization is destroyed.

Jaden_MAN and 
Spongs
 are seen as game masters for a quest that 
ParrotX2
 and 
Wifies
 are tasked to complete.



Season 2


Wemmbu
 sees 
Spongs
 being robbed by Jaden_MAN and his team. 
Wemmbu
 saves Spongs and then he also robs him.

Jaden_MAN and his team threaten to kill 
Eggchan
 if 
Wemmbu
 does not drop all of his stuff and all of his stuff in his ender chest. Jaden_MAN exiles Wemmbu to the 
Pirate Islands
.

Wemmbu finds Jaden_MAN and tries to kill him. While fighting him, someone bombs Jaden’s castle. 
TheobaldTheBird
 tells  
Wemmbu
 and 
Eggchan
 that he was secretly helps them. Wemmbu and TheobaldTheBird try to kill Jaden_MAN.

Wemmbu and Eggchan follow Jaden_MAN down a hole into an 
abandoned underground civilization
. Wemmbu is given mining fatigue. They try to kill Jaden_MAN, but he leads them into a horde of wardens and escapes.

Wemmbu and Eggchan see Jaden_MAN trying to escape the civilization but manage to stop him from escaping. Wemmbu and Eggchan are knocked to the bottom of the civilization, and Jaden is able to get away from them. Wemmbu and eggchan go up a spire to try and find Jaden_MAN.

Wemmbu and Eggchan find Jaden in an armory. Because Jaden has a lot more gear than they do, they run away. They manage to trap Jaden between two iron doors. 
Wemmbu
 and 
Eggchan
 find a villager trading hall and enchant their gear. Wemmbu and Eggchan lead wardens over to Jaden to try and kill him, but see he escaped from his trap.

Wemmbu finds Jaden_MAN killing elder guardians and tries to kill him. Jaden almost kills Wemmbu, but Rejoicin stops the fight and tries to convince them to be friends. Jaden starts attacking Rejoicin. They try to kill Jaden, but he escapes.

Wemmbu and Eggchan learn that the civilization was going to have a vote to decide if they were going to go to the surface in a book, but the next page after that is blank. The team finds Jaden_MAN at a trap near a warden factory. Rejoicin is killed by a warden.

The team finds an elytra. Using the elytra and a mace, Wemmbu uses all of Jaden’s totems. Wemmbu makes him throw out all of his items, removes all of the chorus fruit in the civilization, and traps him underground in the civilization.

FlameFrags searches for Jaden until he encounters The LAW. 

After a long fight with The Law in the abandoned civilization, FlameFrags finds Jaden, who tells FlameFrags that Wemmbu was responsible for locking him inside the abandoned civilization before he breaks him out.

Jaden_MAN and FlameFrags form a team of Wemmbu's past enemies to kill him in the Farlands. After failing to kill Wemmbu, they fight Sharpness to get a mace to make killing Wemmbu easier. FlameFrags convinces Sharpness to give him his mace by telling him that he can duplicate it and then gives it to Jaden_MAN.

After acquiring a mace, Jaden, along with FlameFrags and the rest of the team, tries to kill Wemmbu in the mountain spike biome in the Farlands. The fight erupts into chaos as Sharpness and WyLL begin fighting and the rest of the team attack each other. Jaden fights FlameFrags until he lets him go. 

His new civilization is destroyed by Wemmbu. 

With the help of the 
Invisible Knight
, Jaden manages to capture the Marine Ranger base, laying the foundation for the new Pirate Empire. 

Jaden saves Wemmbu and Eggchan by killing Law members.  

Jaden houses both Wemmbu and Eggchan.  

Jaden leads a group of pirates with Wemmbu and Eggchan to destroy the orbital cannon set up by the law to take over The Great Sea. Jaden is captured by the Law.  

After Jaden is captured by The Law, he is imprisoned and LettuceK has a plan to use him as leverage over Wemmbu. This forces Wemmbu to think twice before attacking LettuceK.   

He is freed from prison by Spoke and his team with the accidental help of Flame and by extension, Wemmbu. When the teams regroup, Flame begins to fight Jaden, demanding Jaden hand over Lomedy's mace. In the six-day war in The Northern Council against Lettice and The LAW, Jaden uses his mace to help eliminate the 2500 player army alongside the protagonists and allies. 

Post-battle, Flame starts attacking Jaden again which causes a brief scuffle that is interrupted by Wemmbu. Wemmbu protects Jaden and challenges Flame instead, Jaden remains quiet during this exchange in the background.    

In 
I Explored the World's Largest Minecraft Server
, Wemmbu orders Egg to head to the Pirate Civilization to recruit Jaden for a 4v4. However, Egg fails to grasp what the situation was and relays the wrong request to Jaden but Jaden comes to help anyway. When he sees Wemmbu and realizes the true events Jaden is very confused but is still on-board to help. He stays by Wemmbu's side in what essentially became a 2v4 because the fourth random bailed and Eggchan was useless in combat. Jaden helps Wemmbu win the fight and is dismissed following the battle. 

In 
Searching For My Friend Who Went Missing
, Jaden protects Old Man 
Lynn
 and sees Wemmbu at his island. He is some what confused but agrees to help Wemmbu find Eggchan. FlameFrags is also present but Jaden and Flame struggle to cooperate together. Jaden arrives at the island and helps Wemmbu at the auction of 
Eggchan.
 Wemmbu loses his patience and starts to attack everyone at the auction with Jaden being his ally. Jaden fights Arachn1d, Yungyx, and the Invisible Player in the battle. Jaden continues fighting them until the Invisible Player says that he will kill Eggchan if they continue to fight. Jaden stops fighting for Wemmbu's sake and tells Wemmbu about the threat.

 wielders. He stole it from

.

 tried to force him to return the mace but

 hindered him to do so.


He is the antagonist of two arcs and yet turned into a ally for the protagonists (Particularly Wemmbu)

Jake is one of very few characters to gain significant screen time without being able to talk, often using only his expressions and movement to communicate.

I am protecting the server. I'm not protecting the server from 
Ashswagg
. I'm not protecting it from 
the Mafia
. I'm protecting it from you. Because you- you never change. You pretend to have morals then take advantage of those that you deem friends. You pretend that you're protecting us, but that family that you say you protect has been in fear for the past year. Fear of you.



JamatoP to 
Spoke
, 
My Best Friend Died on the Unstable SMP


JamatoP
, also known as 
Jamato
, is a supporting character—turned antagonist, featured in the 
Unstable Universe
. He was 
Spoke
's first ally on the server and now serves as his arch-nemesis as the leader of the 
Null Hunters
. He serves as the main antagonist of 
The NULL Arc
.



Personality


JamatoP was a kind individual as seen when he helped Spoke with figuring out how all the protections got on the same piece of armor and when he saves Mapicc from dying. He is bent on protecting the server even when that means losing his closest friends and allies, namely Spoke. He appears to be rather curious, willing to experiment with the exploits until he decided they were going too far at which he abandons Spoke and disappears. Even then, it seems that he deeply cared about Spoke's wellbeing until the latter attacked him after he revealed his plan to protect Mapicc from Spoke.  

After a period of hiding, Jamato seems to have developed a large amount of disdain for Spoke, as shown in the book he had written specifically for him to find in the gear set he gave him, stating that Jamato will make Jumper and Mapicc turn on Spoke if he ever tells them anything. By this time, Jamato had created the 
Null Hunters
 and seemed to go to extreme lengths to accomplish his goal of capturing Spoke and other players he deemed evil to make the server better and give everyone a chance to explore. Despite this seemingly self-righteous belief however, Jamato ordered Null to capture innocent players like 
PlanetLord
, 
CookieBunsquat
 and 
JumperWho
; infiltrated Spoke's team and broke Spoke's heart and his bond with Mapicc; and killed every player they met on sight, essentially defying his own purpose and integrity, showing that he was not above doing evil himself if it meant that he met his goals which he believed were for the betterment of the server. He even imprisons his friend 
Mapicc
 all to get revenge on the one he sees as the most dangerous person on the server.  



History


SpokeIsHere
 shows JamatoP a glitch which allowed him to get a full set of diamond armor with every protection enchantment, which is normally not possible. Jamato then guides Spoke through his base, where he shows him a lot of glitched features.

Jamato helps Spoke create glitched features in 
The Wonders
, such as a chunk suppressor. 

Spoke tells him that he wants to destroy all the end portals so that he can duplicate mobs without interference by other players, but Jamato disagrees. He says that Spoke just wants to play god. He says he doesn’t want to be part of this anymore. Despite this, Spoke still tries to convince him otherwise and shows him that he obtained a barrier block, and a command block.

Jamato later finds Spoke and sees that he’s going to use a machine to destroy The Wonders. He tells him this is not a good solution.

JamatoP vanishes.

Wemmbu
 finds JamatoP in his base after he’s vanished. Jamato says that he doesn’t know where Spoke is because he parted ways with him and hasn’t seen him since. Other players from the 
Zam Empire
 come into the base, and start attacking Wemmbu and Jamato and asking if they know anything about Spoke. Eventually Wemmbu and Zam Empire leave.

JamatoP's base gets blown up by 
The Mafia
 after 
Ashswagg
 finds out that the exploits he taught Spoke were patched. Spoke and 
PlanetLord
 find a revamped version made out of wood and finds a book alongside a book and quill saying that he’s either captured by the mafia or dead, and a lodestone compass that leads to the Mafia outpost.

JamatoP explores multiple locations in the server, including the 
Far Lands
 and 
The Underworld
. He settled near the 
Far Lands
 and built a house on a flowery mountain as his base.

JamatoP saves Mapicc from an attack by 
BAT
 using weapons that the BAT spies have never seen. The two escape to the 
Far Lands
 using an ender pearl cannon where Spoke (alongside PrinceZam) finds JamatoP's base that resides on the outskirts of the Far Lands. JamatoP is followed to a lighthouse by Spoke, where the two have an argument and JamatoP tells Spoke that he leeches off of the people he calls friends. JamatoP takes off all his armor and taunts Spoke, assuming that Spoke won't kill him. When Spoke tries to kill him, he swaps to his totem, which popped and triggered an exploit that instantly teleported him away. At the end of the video he is seen watching Spoke and his friends.

Soon after Spoke left his far land base, 
Wemmbu
 took 
4CVIT
's pearl cannon to the destroyed lighthouse and found JamatoP's flowery mountain base. He realized he arrived near the wrong direction of 
Far Lands
. Jamato appeared outside the house. Wemmbu tricked him to believe that he was trustworthy as 
Serpentbound
 was inviting him to his kingdom. Jamato took Wemmbu to a giant portal after navigating through wither traps. The portal led them to a lobby in 
the Underworld
, where Jamato asked 
soul keepers
 to guide them to portal to 
Far Lands
 near Serpentbound's Kingdom. They went through the portal, and Wemmbu revealed they would part ways and he was not 
Serpentbound
's friend. Jamato fought Wemmbu but he was quickly defeated due to being bad at PvP. He popped a totem and disappeared instantly using the same exploit.

In 
Minecraft Trapper VS Elite Bounty Hunters
, Spoke is hunted down by 
a group of players
 which seem immortal. They use the same exploit as JamatoP uses as when they pop their totem of undying they are instantly teleported via a stasis chamber. Later Spoke asks 
SirPig
 about who is doing all of this.  In their brief conversation, SirPig mentions that Spoke's chestplate was given to him as a gift by Jamato, and that the person who hired the hunters demanded said chestplate as proof of Spoke's death.

JamatoP appeared after Spoke, JumperWho and Mapicc found the fabric / fiber next to the infinite downward staircase, stating that he came to help them from 
Null Hunters
. Spoke discovered after a lot of theorizing that Jamato is indeed the leader of NULL that hunted him down. He fails to convince Mapicc about it, and instead, Mapicc treats it as a betrayal, believing that Jamato was actually helping them and Spoke worked with NULL to trap him. He broke Spoke's infamous 
Alt
 Chestplate inside a maze. After Mapicc does the job of breaking his armor, both Mapicc and Spoke are weakened and captured by NULL and are ordered to enter into a nether portal. Jamato burnt all of Spoke's belongings, including items in his ender chest, effectively removing Spoke's ability to do anything on the server making him as weak as a new player on the server. 

JamatoP's ruthlessness in his revenge against Spoke is clear as he tore Spoke's team apart and captured innocent players all to be part of his grand plan. It is likely he still has good intentions however he is shown to be ruthless in destroying the rebels and commands NULL.



Quot




"That was never the plan. Look, Minecraft exists in layers, we're here on the surface, and with exploits, you can go down, deep into the rock, grab your riches. But this-this is the foundations of Minecraft-the foundation of computers, if you're changing the ones and zeros, you're breaking the bedrock, that holds this all together. And there's nothing waiting for you, but the void.



JamatoP
 to 
SpokeIsHere
, in 
How to Destroy the Unstable SMP




You're not offering an opportunity; you're offering our downfall.



Jamato
, to 
Spoke
 in 
How to Destroy the Unstable SMP




This is the end, but not for the server. It's a new era that'll be better; without you.



Jamato
, to 
Spoke
 in 
Finding 1000 Missing Minecraft Players




This is your legacy now. Not as the hero you claimed to be, but as the reason why the rebels fell. All of them is on you.



Jamato
, to 
Spoke
 in 
Finding 1000 Missing Minecraft Players




It was always going to end like this.



Jamato
, to 
Spoke
 in 
Finding 1000 Missing Minecraft Players


Trivia


JamatoP is shown wearing full Netherite armor with Flow armor trims, which are very rare on the Unstable SMP as they're only found at a 22.5% chance in Ominous Vaults, all destroyed by ClownPierce, except for the ones in the Far Lands.


JamatoP's Minecraft Skin directly resembles 
Nailmaster Mato
 from Hollow Knight, a scrolling platfomer made by Australian indie developer Team Cherry.


JamatoP may have access to creative mode, shown when he disappeared and entered the Nether instantly when he touched the Far Lands portal in Wemmbu's perspective.


The exploit JamatoP used to survive Spoke and Wemmbu was already used by Wemmbu at 
PvP tournament
 (which caused him to say he had seen this before), as well as by 
Wifies
 when 
Parrot
 attacked him in 
Paragon
. It is likely shadow items, i.e. two "quantum entangled" reference to the same instance of totem, with one in the exploit user's hand and the other in a chest connected to comparator that triggers stasis machine. When the user's totem pops, the other reference in the chest also "pops", leading to the stasis being pulled.


JamatoP has access to deadly weapons that he used against the bat spies however in his fight with 
Wemmbu
 he never used any of the weapons instead he just got folded by Wemmbu.

JumperWho
, more commonly known as 
Jumper
, is a character in 
Unstable Universe
. Jumper is in charge of spies in 
Bounty Assassin Team
. She is shown to care a lot about morals and treats her spies very fairly. She sometimes however is forced to make difficult choices like allying with her enemies just for her morals. Her thinking is similar to 
Parrot
 in many ways.



History


Season 1


JumperWho is seen as a guard for one of 
The Wonders
.

JumperWho is seen as a guard for 
SpokeIsHere
 in an end base.

ParrotX2
 and his friends free JumperWho from a chunk ban. She agrees to help them break people out of prisons.

JumperWho is seen as part of early BAT when they are focused on killing 
ClownPierce
.

Spoke and 
Mapicc
 find JumperWho, who is AFK. They move her onto the nether roof. She comes back and they run away to the overworld. Spoke and Mapicc destroy the guardian farm.

Parrot and 
Wifies
 go on a quest to obtain certain specific items. They obtain a pair of netherite boots which is one of JumperWho's most prized possessions.

JumperWho is trapped in a prison called 
Proton
. She is put in solitary confinement. With the help of Parrot and the other prisoners, they are able to escape from prison.

JumperWho is seen as a member of 
The End Civilization
.

JumperWho joins 
District 13
.  She later leaves District 13 to join 
The Invisible Mafia
 after being unhappy with how things were going.



Season 2


JumperWho joins Bounty Assassin Team.

JumperWho puts a chest and a sign saying to run in Parrot's room with two stacks of pearls, and an invisibility potion. BAT comes into Parrot's room and tries to kill him as they think he is 
The Director
.

JumperWho finds Parrot in an abandoned city. She tells Parrot that she was the one who put the chest and sign in his room. Parrot becomes a JumperWho spy to figure out how he had been framed for being The Director.

JumperWho gives Parrot the pieces of evidence that BAT thought showed he was The Director. 
Leow0ok
 does a "mole check" to see if any of JumperWho’s spies were moles by having them hold a green shield. Parrot takes a green banner off of the wall and combines it with his shield. Parrot is the only spy who holds a green shield, showing that he is a mole. Parrot manages to escape.

Parrot finds a book asking Parrot to meet up with him. Parrot spies on BAT's meeting. JumperWho betrays him, telling them that Parrot is spying on them. Parrot manages to escape during the chaos. JumperWho tells Parrot that she was actually just pretending to betray Parrot because BAT didn’t trust her. Parrot discovers that someone was spying on them. JumperWho uses a goat horn to call back her spy, and kill the spy. 

BAT watches Parrot and The Director have a conversation, which convinces BAT that Parrot is not The Director. The Director teleports away. Leow0ok discovers that JumperWho killed a spy, and kicks her off the team.

JumperWho rejoins BAT after saving Parrot from death to help hunt down the Director. JumperWho leads them to a secret base that she and her spies created.

JumperWho sends spies to secretly spy on suspects for the Director while the Director visits Parrot. The Director holds a chest plate with a red trim on it, causing Parrot to believe the Director is Spoke, as Spoke wears that netherite chest plate. Parrot convinces Leow0ok and Derapchu to pretend to be spies so Parrot can threaten to kill the spies so that JumperWho confesses to lying about none of the suspects being the Director. Parrot fails to do so.

JumperWho and 
Derapchu
 are trapped by the Director in an obsidian room. Leow0ok later saves them using a happy ghast.

JumperWho works as a guard in 
Paragon
. Wifies reveals that he knows her spies identities and make Jumper work for him. This shows how much she cares about her spies.

JumperWho continues as a member of BAT. After 
SpokeIsHere
 kills several spies, she ends up conflicting with 
Leow0ok
. 
Leow0ok
 wants to kill 
Spoke
, but JumperWho requires finding the armor pieces of the dead spies as proof that Spoke was the one. 

JumperWho is one of the 16 candidates that get over 100 votes. She is pressured by Leow0ok to become a candidate. 

JumperWho drops out of the elections for unknown reasons but probably because she just did not want to and was forced by Leow0ok. 

JumperWho stalks 
Spoke
 and her spies attack him. After Leow0ok orders more of her spies to their death she finally loses it and helps Spoke fight  
Leow0ok
. 

JumperWho helps 
Spoke
, 
Mapicc
 and 
PrinceZam
 attempt to kill 
Leow0ok
.  She helps Spoke kill hundreds of Law men commanded by Leow0ok  using a rail gun. Later she faces Leow0ok and saves PrinceZam from dying. 

JumperWho fights alongside 
District 13
 at the the Battle of The Northern Council. 

After the battle, JumperWho gets a book from one of her spies revealing Leow0ok's location. She and 
Spoke
 attack Leow0ok and break his armour completely. Leow0ok eyes both of them with contempt and says his last words before teleporting away, only to realise that his enderpearl statis was rigged by Spoke. Leow0ok is killed in the void and Spoke probably informs Jumper about this. 

Spoke hires jumper and pulled JumperWho and her spies stasis when 
Null hunters
 attacked his base, and they has since been both hunted by these hunters. the two of them help each other fight the Null hunters but most, if not all, JumperWho's spies were killed by 
Null hunters
. She is saddened by this but for some reason does not blame Spoke for their deaths like she blamed Leow0ok.

JumperWho and Spoke explored the 
Far Lands
 under 
Mapicc
's lead. They met 
JamatoP
, who lead them into designed traps of Null Hunters, split them, made them turn against Spoke and captured all of them. Her former spy, 
CookieBunsquat
, was also captured by Null Hunters.



Trivia


Her name is derived from her old free Minecraft Pocket Edition skin named "Jumper?" and when she made her Minecraft username she changed the question mark to who and hence the name JumperWho.

On the Unstable SMP, I was looking at our home for the last time, because my 
enemy
, has returned.



SpokeIsHere
, opening monologue of 
I Almost Got BANNED from the Unstable SMP...


JumperWho's Spies
 (formerly known as the 
Bounty Assassin Team Spies
) were a group of invisible players led by 
JumperWho
 and approved by 
Leow0ok
. The group was split up when Leow0ok decided to devote spies as 
Law
 soldiers but Jumper disagreed because she thought this is abusing them. After the downfall of 
Law
, the spies were killed and Jumper was captured by 
Null Hunters
.



History


The Spies were first formed after the fall of the Invisible Mafia as a subgroup of the 
Bounty Assassin Team
 (BAT) under the supervision and leadership of JumperWho. The Spies were all given codenames and were instructed to stay invisible at all times. Numerous spies were killed by the various hunters dispatched by 
The Director
 to stalk and test 
Parrot
, BAT's newest member, and to see he how would react when put in various scenarios. JumperWho additionally kills one of the spies to keep Parrot and herself safe when Parrot was thought to be the Director. Under Parrot's order, Leo pretended to be one of JumperWho's spies near a TNT minecart for Parrot to interrogate JumperWho about whether she serves a spy for the Director, which ended up in Leo himself becoming visible and hunting down Parrot. The identities of the spies would later be used as leverage by The Director to blackmail JumperWho and force her to guard Parrot inside 
Paragon
.

Following 
Wifies
' death and the conclusion of 
the hunt for the player who doesn't exist
, the spies would replenish their numbers and move to a new base, where they would continue to operate under JumperWho and Leow0ok. Leo would dispatch the spies to follow 
SpokeIsHere
, as he suspected that Spoke had something to do with the deaths of a previous Spy duo. Over the next few months, Leo's usage of the spies as ground troopers would put strain on his and Jumper's partnership, as she disapproved of Leo's insistence on sending Spies to fight and kill Spoke. Eventually, The Bounty Assassin Team, and by extension, the spies, would ally with 
The Law
 and 
LettuceK
.  A squadron of spies sent by Leo to hunt and kill Spoke and his best friend, 
Mapicc
, were caught off guard and killed by a 
mysterious player
 using weapons they had never seen before during a failed ambush on Mapicc.

Following this, JumperWho, fed up with Leo throwing her spies' lives away for his personal crusade against Spoke, would gather the surviving spies still loyal to her and leave BAT, allying with Spoke to kill and ban Leow0ok. The Spies would continue to fulfill their purpose as scouts and intelligence gatherers during the war against The Law, which ended with LettuceK captured, BAT disbanded, and Leow0ok banned at the hands of Spoke. However, during the final battle at the 
Northern Council
, Mapicc had disappeared, leading to Spoke asking Jumper and the spies to help him locate his missing friend.

While Jumper was willing to help Spoke find Mapicc, she was hesitant to use her spies as soldiers, as that was the very reason she broke away from BAT and Leo. When the search for Mapicc took a mysterious turn at the revelation of a group of unknown players seemingly abducting hundreds of players across the server, Spoke managed to convince Jumper that the only way to get the backup they needed to complete their objective would be to use the Spies. Jumper hesitantly agreed, but not after ensuring that Spoke would give the spies a choice to decline accompanying them on the mission.

A squad of spies agreed to assist and were brought by JumperWho and 
SpokeIsHere
 to find a pearl cannon belonging to 
Null Hunters
 in 
Searching for 100 Players Who Went Missing
. However, the mission would end disastrously, and every participating spy was killed by the hunters.

The capture of Jumper and her former spy 
CookieBunsquat
 by Null Hunters marked the final downfall of Jumper's spies.

Parrot, this is your escape! I was the one person- remember our argument...



Kenadian to 
ParrotX2
, in 
Escaping Proton: Minecraft's Most Secure Prison


_Kenadian_
, or 
Kenadian
, is a character in 
Unstable Universe
.



Personality


Kenadian is highly intelligent, adaptable, and cautious. He like to always have a plan and have extensive knowledge of Minecraft mechanics and prison escaping.   

Fearful of the risk of his friends dying, he was initially determined to keep all of them safe and inside of the prison rather than let them take on a heavy risk of escaping 
Proton
. His pursuit for their team's safety leads him to nearly sabotage 
ParrotX2's
 breakout plan. Kenadian is very selfless when it comes to their friends and trusts them greatly, sacrificing himself to let 
Parrot
 escape, because he knew they would find his Stasis Chamber and break him out.  



History


Season 1


ParrotX2
 and a team of people including _Kenadian_ break 
Wifies
 out of his 
chunk ban
. 
SpokeIsHere
 is unintentionally broken out of prison as well.

Kenadian is trapped in a prison by 
ClownPierce
.

Kenadian is trapped in 
Proton
 by 
ClownPierce
. After helping everyone to escape, he gives the last elytra to Parrot, breaking him free. Later Kenadian was teleported out of Proton with a Stasis Chamber he built in his base.

Kenadian joins 
Far Lands
. He joins the farming district. 
Far Lands
 is eventually destroyed by 
The Invisible Mafia
.

Kenadian joins 
District 13
. He eventually leaves and joins the 
Mafia
 due to minimal progress.

Kenadian helps 
Parrot
, 
Spoke
, 
Mapicc
, 
Wemmbu
, and 
eggchan
 break into a spawn prison built by the 
Mafia
.



Season 2


Kenadian helps 
Wemmbu
 protect his base from 
TheobaldTheBird
. 
TheobaldTheBird
 later threatens to kill Kenadian unless 
Wemmbu
 has a fair fight with him.

Trivia


Following the release of 
I Broke into Minecraft's Most Secure Prison
, Kenadian proceeded to debunk the final prison in a 
video
 on his second channel.

Kierrrr
, also known as 
Kier
, is a supporting character featured in 
Unstable Universe
. He and his friend 
Its_Dev_
 work for 
Boosfer
 as the 
Treasure Hunters
.



History


Boosfer sends Kierrrr and Its_Dev to steal specific items from 
ParrotX2
 and 
Wifies
. Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ try to intercept Parrot and Wifies during a quest, but they escape using invisibility.

Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ find Parrot and Wifies again. Parrot gives them a book, but edits the book to get rid of some important clues. They convince Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ that the hot air balloons around the area are in the shape of an arrow. Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ leave.

Parrot and Wifies go to Boosfers base, who is the leader of Kierrrr and Its_Dev_. They try to convince him not to steal these items, but he doesn’t listen. They leave.

Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ steal all of the items that Parrot and Wifies obtained from a quest.

Boosfer pays Wemmbu to destroy "the valley". Wemmbu finds Parrot and Wifies and agrees to team with them to steal items from Boosfer, Kierrrr, and Its_Dev_. They destroy the top layer of their headquarters with an 
Orbital Strike Cannon
. Wemmbu finds their secret vault of items and together, they steal thousands of netherite and diamond blocks from them.

Parrot and Wifies go to the end as part of their quest. They find Wifies prized dragon head. Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ try to kill them, but they escape to the outer islands. Parrot and Wifies find an ender chest and use the items in there to try to kill Kierrrr and Its_Dev_. They manage to escape.

Its_Dev_ and Kierrrr vote against Boosfer in 
The End Civilization
.

Debut


I Survived Minecraft's Most Corrupt City










Welcome to the mines.



Reddoons, 
I Survived Minecraft's Most Corrupt City


Capital City
, led by 
Reddoons
 (and quoted by Ash to be 'basically his'), is a civilization in 
Unstable Universe
. The city is split into two parts: The Mines, and The City. The City is empty and it is dubious if The City was always a ruse for The Mines or citizens of Capital City were placed into The Mines prematurely to produce more diamonds.



Allyship


Most of Capital City's plot relevance is with it's allyship with 
The Invisible Mafia
. In 
I Infiltrated The Minecraft Mafia
, it is expanded upon that the allyship between Capital City and The Invisible Mafia is a one-way transactional relationship where Red will supply the Mafia with goods and the Mafia will remain neutral with Red.

In 
I Discovered a Minecraft Sky Civilization
, guards are shown to be stationed at Capital City, but in 
I Infiltrated The Minecraft Mafia
 they are gone, so it can be assumed that between videos, stations ended at Capital City, along with more interpersonal things like Red's position in the mafia.



The Mines


The Mines are a subsection of Capital City, being where most people in Capital City reside. It is alluded to be some kind of equivalent to a labor camp--minus it being prisoners placed in there; made to mine for valuable ores all day until nightfall. The Mines subsection was watched over 
CoinMonke
 as a warden.

The pitfall most workers found themselves in was the promise to be able to leave The Mines if they reach an absurd quota of diamonds, mostly being impossible without the help of Parrot stealing from Red's vaults. 

It gradually grew to also have a roulette table, following Red's gambling motifs, to kill one player after a week as a punishment for being the target of Red's suspicions.

The Mines are now seemingly defunct after I Survived Minecraft's Most Corrupt City.



History


ParrotX2
, 
Wifies
, and 
deanthebean9
 try to steal from Capital city. They are caught by Reddoons and five invisible guards. Reddoons says that they each need to get 1000 diamond blocks. They try to escape, but fail. Reddoons says they now need to get 10,000 diamond blocks.

They find a group of miners, with 
CoinMonke
 as the warden. Parrot spends his time mining. Parrot and his friends steal from Capital City vaults. Parrot gives 
PikaTM
 more than 3,000 diamond blocks and he is let free for meeting his quota. Parrot gives more people diamonds he stole from Capital City for them to be set free.

Reddoons finds out about people getting set free and sees that his diamonds have been stolen. He triples the required quota. Using "the smugglers", Parrot and Wifies are able to get white wool. They break into one of the vaults using the wool, as there are sculk sensors detecting sound. They get in and steal the diamond blocks. Coming back to the mine, Reddoons catches them. Parrot and Wifies store all of the shulker boxes of diamonds in pots to not get caught with the items.

Reddoons figures out that they used the pots to store the diamonds. Reddoons makes it so whoever has the lowest amount of diamonds plays a game of roulette to decide if they live or not. Deanthebean9 and Parrot are tied for lowest. Parrot loses, but CoinMonke says he can’t kill him, as he doesn’t want to kill him. Parrot threatens to tell Reddoons that he didn’t do his job unless he helps them steal from Reddoons. They find a bunch of different locks in the vault, but luckily they are able to brute force through them by trying all combinations, and breaking the redstone. They realize they forgot to bring shulkers and leave. CoinMonke tells them Reddoons plans to lock down all of his vaults.

Parrot overhears Reddoons talking to CoinMonke. Reddoons mentions that 
ashswagg
 suggested they kill people. Reddoons forces people to play a game which decides if they live or do not live. Reddoons rigs it so 
LuigiToan
 dies. CoinMonke refuses to kill him. Reddoons kills LuigiToan himself.

CoinMonke agrees to give the miners gear to steal Reddoons diamonds for leverage. The team gets caught. Reddoons gambles if they can leave or not. Reddoons lets everyone free except for Parrot, deanthebean9, and Wifies, even though he won his bet. Reddoons brings them to ashswagg and 
The Invisible Mafia
. Ashswagg suggests they join the Mafia, but they say no. They try to force them to join, but CoinMonke activates their stasis chamber and they escape.

Members of 
Skyblock Civilization
 investigate Capital City. They pretend to be members of The Mafia to infiltrate however, the invisible players are able to tell the fake ones and attack the Skyblock Civilization members.

But, anyways, uh, I guess I should say, "Welcome to Capitol City, Parrot!"



Reddoons
 to 
ParrotX2
, in 
The Unstable SMP Experience


Capitol City 2.0
, commonly known as 
Capitol City
, is a city leaded by 
Fymada
, located near spawn. Centered a few thousand blocks from 
Spawn
, this metropolis is a safe space for all players. It is home to many shops, jobs, and houses. Hundreds of players live here—which formerly included 
ParrotX2
 and 
TheobaldTheBird
.



Structure


Capitol City is home to many shops and structures. The city takes a "Desert Empire" theme, being made out of a lot of sandstone and other yellow blocks. But this is not all, as there are some more mental structuring as well. The City has many rules, some are not that great or fair. For example, there is a 90% tax on all items sold. The currency is diamonds, so for every 100 diamonds you make, you will only get 10 
after
 taxes. Most of these goods are sold on "Market Street". This is also where you could have had found 
ParrotX2
, as he used to run a potion shop there as well. There are many different buildings and places in Capitol City as well, each having their importance. 



Main Building


 
 
 
 
 
Picture of the Building 
 
 


The Main Building is one of Capitol City's most important attractions. Built in the middle of the complex, this tower is huge, reaching over a hundred blocks in height. This is also where you will most likely find 
Reddoons
, the owner of the city. He does meetings and tax calculations on the top floor. For people who want to explore The Main Building, there are only two known ways of reaching higher floors. You can either climb the ladder to the top—which will take a while or use the secret mini elevators that are reserved for guards and important people, as seen in 
Wemmbu
's "
Orbital Strike Cannon vs Unstable SMP
". Either way, you still must get a reservation before climbing to the top, as 
Reddoons
 is almost always busy. 



Train Station


 
 
 
 
 
Picture of the Station 
 
 
Capitol City's Train Station is an important part of the civilization. It consists of 50 tracks each leading to separate stations all across the spawn area of 
Unstable
. It costs four diamonds per ticket now, due to inflation, which might not 
seem
 like a lot, but it is because of taxes. In total, with 90% taxes, it actually costs forty diamonds to get only four back. Anyhow, you buy a ticket from the front desk for that price and your good to go—it just might take a while to wait in line. On the bright side though, you can look around to find less popular front desks, i.e like the one that 
Lezy
 ran, which had no people in line for it. 

Grand Hotel


 
 
 
 
 
Picture of the Hotel
 
 


The Grand Hotel is not just for a temporary stay, it's also a business outpost of some kind. Although not much is known about it canon-wise, it is still an important part of the city, being the second largest building in the complex. It can house up to 800 players due to some simple math, although there have still been reports that stay is way too expensive—even from 
Theo
 himself, who was in major debt to the hotel, having to give up his elytra, which he later received back after "paying back" his debts. 



Post Office/Mail Building


 
 
 
 
 
Picture of the Mailing Complex
 
 


The Mail Building/Post Office is home to the city's mailing industry, located near Merchant Street. Here is where you pick up and drop off mail, and from there, the workers will take care of the rest, carefully sorting out and placing your deliveries where they are supposed to be. The line is long, just like the Train Station, but you can still have a faster waiting experience if you just look around for a shorter line. 



The Lionels


 
 
 
 
 
Picture of the Left Lionel
 
 


The Lionels are some of the most exotic attractions in the entire city. They resemble two huge lions, each on a short pillar. They have a powerful sense in them that suggests to the city's strong power.



History


In 
The Unstable SMP Experience
, 
ParrotX2
 and 
Theo
 go to Capitol City, where 
Parrot
 finds a job in a potion shop, and a secret job with 
Theo
 of taking players out of spawn safely to Capitol City.  They make a lot of diamonds doing this, but they do get in trouble from 
Reddoons

The Search for Minecraft's Far Lands








Far Lands City
 was a civilization built in the 
Far Lands
.  



Structure


To thrive, the Farlands was divided into 3 different districts; the 
Builders
, the 
Farmers
, and the 
Warriors
. Each district's objective was to fulfill their role to benefit everyone in their Civilization.



Builders


Builders were tasked to build for the Civilization.



Farmers


Farmers were tasked to provide resources for the Civilization.



Warriors


Warriors were tasked to defend the Civilization and were the main and biggest faction.



Sorting


A player was put into a test to decide which district they belong in. They were required to kill a wither with 5 items of their choice. The player would then be sorted into their faction depending on what approach they take.



If the player decided to fight the wither head on, they were most likely to be sorted into the Warriors.


If the player decided to hide from the wither until it's gone, they were most likely to be sorted into the Builders.


If the player decided to devise a way to trap the wither, they were most likely to be sorted into the Farmers.

Leow0ok
 to

, in 
4 Minecraft Pros VS 2500 Players


Leow0ok
, also known as Leo, was the leader of 
Bounty Assassin Team
 on the Unstable SMP. He was a major character in 
The Director Arc
 being an antagonist in 
Parrot's
 video 
I Got Hunted by Minecraft Bounty Hunters
. He also is the main antagonist of 
Spoke's
 
BAT arc
. Leow0ok is a player who refuses to give up and sometimes thinks rationally. He is also willing to resort to the sword very quickly and has little restraint when doing something he believes is right and is usually seen as a morally gray character. At the end of 
4 Minecraft Pros VS 2500 Players
, Leow0ok promised 
Spoke
 that the war would never end until Spoke was dead. Following this he pulled his statis chamber, not knowing that it was rigged by Spoke and was then killed in the void.

Leow0ok is one of the more tragic characters in the Unstable Universe. His best friend was 
Nufuli
 who was killed by 
the Director
. His friend 
Derapchu
 left his team and he was forced to fight a war against Spoke. Even his closest ally, 
JumperWho
 betrayed him. Without his spies, wealth or any of his friends, Leow0ok ended his time on the server completely alone.



History


Season 1


Leow0ok is seen as a guard of a castle containing a large amount of duped items.

Leow0ok is seen as a guard of a sky base containing a large amount of duped items.

Leow0ok is seen at an end base.

Leow0ok and his team helps 
Parrot
 escape from 
ClownPierce
 in 
ClownPierce's Circus
.

Leow0ok agrees with Parrot and 
Wifies
 to put Parrot in an obsidian vault as bait for 
ClownPierce
. Wifies decides to go with him. ClownPierce, 
FerreMC
, and 
Mugm_
 come over and try to break in and kill Parrot. A fight between people against and with ClownPierce ensues. The team runs away from the fight.

Parrot and Wifies come to complain about how they were abandoned.

Parrot leaves to get a better team.

Parrot comes back and convinces Leow0ok and his team to kidnap 
BranzyCraft
, the only player ClownPierce cares about. They go to negotiate with ClownPierce now that they have Branzy. FerreMC comes back with Wifies as a hostage. Parrot agrees to let Branzy go, and ClownPierce lets Wifies go.

Leow0ok helps break people out of 
Proton
.

Leow0ok joins the 
Mafia
 to try and kill ClownPierce. He is allies with Spoke and 
Mapicc
. The three of them inflitrate The Mafia and get to gold level.



The Director Arc


Leow0ok is seen as the leader of 
Bounty Assassin Team
. He accepted Parrot into 
BAT
 as he could help hunt 
ItzRealMe
 down.

In 
I Got Hunted by a Minecraft Redstone Genius
, Leow0ok constantly scolds Derapchu for being a bad member.

Leow0ok is prepared to kill Parrot and almost does so, as he believed Parrot himself was the Director and have caused too much trouble and loss to BAT. Even when Jumper and Parrot give him the truth, Leo is still determined to believe that Parrot is the Director and then scolds Jumper for killing one of 
her spies
 when he attempted to kill Parrot the whole time.

TruOriginal
 tries to kill Nufuli, Parrot, Derapchu, and Leo using hacks. They are eventually able to escape. The 
BAT headquarters
 is destroyed by TruOriginal. He tries to kill them. Leo stays behind so BAT can escape. Leo eventually escapes and finds BAT.

TruOriginal tries to kill them but eventually runs away. BAT make a new base and guard it. TruOriginal tries to kill them again. BAT scares TruOriginal away by pretending they have a trap ready.

TruOriginal kidnaps Derapchu and Leow0ok while they are sleeping. He pretends to be Leow0ok using a hack and tries to kill Parrot and Nufuli. Using a trap, they are able to kill TruOriginal.

Nufuli leaves the team, and as he is leaving, the Director kills him. They see the Director and try to kill him. The Director uses a pearl cannon to escape. BAT use the pearl cannon to try and go after the Director. They find themselves in an obsidian room, where the Director tries to kill them using an army of zombies with netherite armor and weapons. They are able to escape.

BAT go over to a redstone shop to see if the Director is there. They eventually find a player wearing the same armor as the Director. They force him to drink milk, revealing he is 
MrCube6
. The real Director comes over and saves MrCube6. The Director tries to kill BAT using TNT but fails.

Jumper is re-added to BAT after saving Parrot from death. She leads BAT to a secret base that she created. The Director gives BAT a message, telling Parrot to meet up with him in one week.

SpokeIsHere
 finds the secret base BAT lives in and secretly pranks them and steals from them, and pretends he's the Director. Spoke is eventually caught and is forced to escape.

BAT spies on the Director and Parrot having their conversation. Jumper's spies spy on a list of suspects for people who could potentially be the Director. They see all of them online while the Director and Parrot have their conversation. Parrot sees the Director hold a chest plate with a red armor trim, causing him to believe the Director is Spoke, as Spoke normally wears 
that chest plate
. Parrot convinces Leow0ok and Derapchu to pretend to be spies so that Parrot can threaten to kill the supposed spies unless Jumper confesses. This plan fails as Leow0ok and Derapchu stop pretending to be spies after Jumper doesn't confess.

While Jumper and Derapchu are out of the base, Leow0ok tries to kill ParrotX2. He eventually decides to spare Parrot's life. Parrot tells Leow0ok to leave and he obliges.

Parrot goes over to Wifies' base. Jumper and Derapchu find Parrot at his base, and Parrot tells them about Leow0ok trying to kill him. The Director finds them.

Leow0ok helps 
FlameFrags
 learn 
crossbow carting
 and fights 
The LAW
. He seems to be wanted by them for some unknown reason.

The Director traps Jumper and Derapchu in an obsidian room over the void. Parrot and Leow0ok make a plan to save Jumper and Derapchu using a happy ghast named 
Sky
. Leow0ok saves them while Parrot distracts the Director.

Leow0ok works as a guard in 
Paragon
.



The Bat Arc


Leow0ok is still the leader of Bounty Assassin Team. 

After Spoke destroys a innocent village Leow0ok prepares a investigation against him. Spoke kills more spies. Leow0ok insists on killing Spoke despite Jumper telling him to gain sufficient proof first.

Leow0ok allows himself to have his enderpearl statis found by Spoke. Spoke, 
PrinceZam
, 
Mapicc,
 and 
Wemmbu
 attempt to kill him but Leow0ok escapes. He uses this as proof to continue hunting down Spoke and attempting to kill him. 

In 
My Best Friend Died on the Unstable SMP
, Leow0ok attempts to kill Spoke but his spies are blown up. He then pretends to kill Mapicc much to the horror of Spoke. Spoke pretends to be Leow0ok is in the 
Farlands
 and fight Zam and Mapicc to convince them not to leave him. 

TNT cart craters are in the BAT vault. Mapicc explains this by saying that Leow0ok might have abandoned his own team and had fought the other spies and Jumper. We don't know the reason for why this happened but we always knew that Jumper doubted Leow0ok. Since he no longer had command of BAT spies, he uses his connections with 
LettuceK
 so that he could use Law soldiers into hunting Spoke.

At the end of his video, Spoke seems to have finally found Leow0ok's true statis chamber which could allow him to kill Leow0ok once and for all. However, before he manages to get there he is teleported by Jumper.

It is revealed that Jumper split off from Leow0ok because he had the same mentality as LettuceK. Like LettuceK, he thought that all of his forces were expendable in battles. This results in Leow0ok using Lawmen to continue waging war on Spoke and Jumper. The two of them try to kill Leo, who also failed to kill any of them. 

He was a Law Commander at the Battle of The 
Northern Council
 fighting 
District 13
.  

After the battle, Spoke and Jumper find Leow0ok and start attacking him. Leow0ok promises that the war was never going to end and he pulls a stasis chamber, not knowing Spoke had rigged it. Leow0ok falls into the void and is killed, ending the war between him and Spoke.

LettuceK
, or simply 
Lettuce
, was a supporting character featured in 
Unstable Universe
 Season 1, and is one of the main antagonists in Unstable Universe Season 2. He is a minor antagonist in 
The Pirate Arc
, the secondary antagonist in 
The Betrayal Arc
, a major antagonist in both 
The Fake Identity Arc
 and the 
Skill vs Power Arc
, and he is the antagonist of 
The Kings Arc
. 



Personality


LettuceK portrays an intelligent personality throughout Season 2. He is willing to use violence and deception to achieve his goals and he calculates his moves carefully. He often uses other's fears as leverage, especially when he sees a threat.  He uses every strategy, gimmick or army that he has to fight. He rarely questions his own decisions from a moral standpoint, focusing instead on what he believes is the greater good. 

Unlike 
ParrotX2
, LettuceK plans out his actions and prepares for what is to come. He is a master strategist always looking at the future and planning ahead. He can see things that others can't and can predict unrest in the server. 



History


Season 1


This section is missing information and needs major improvement. Please help the 
Unstable Universe
 wiki by 
editing
 it.


LettuceK is seen as a member of the 
Zam Empire
 and tries to destroy 
Wemmbu's Civilization
.

LettuceK joins

.

LettuceK is seen as a miner in 
Capital City
.

LettuceK is seen as a member of 
Skyblock Civilization
.

LettuceK is seen as a member of 
Ice Mountain Civilization
 alongside 
Arcn
 and 
Loppezz




Season 2


LettuceK is seen as a pirate in the 
Pirate Islands
.

LettuceK is the leader of 
The Law
.

After the 2v1000 player fight, Lettuce managed to capture Wemmbu, and brought him into custody with the four other prisoners, 
Baablu
, 
Fanstst
, 
PrinceZam
, and 
Blurpenstein
.

At the end of 
2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Players
 we see him with Ace - 'justifying' his reasons for leading the 1000 players against 
Wemmbu
 and 
FlameFrags
.

Seen briefly watching the prisoners whilst they're mining or completing other tasks.

He held the server wide meeting, and offered to have a voting to make someone a king/ruler of Unstable. He suggested the reason he should be voted is because he had captured Wemmbu - to which he then brings him out onto stage.

In 
I Got Exiled from the Unstable SMP
, Lettuce sends someone from Law to try and kill 
Flamefrags
 and exile him from his base. Though, when that fails, he captures 
Lomedy
 at 
Merchant City
, and offers Flamefrags an ultimatium. Give in, or he kills Lomedy. When Flame ignores and attacks anyway, Lettuce blows the goathorn and has his Lawmen attack Flame - eventually leading to him being exiled from his base. 

In 
I got Exiled from the Unstable SMP
, during the end when LettuceK talks to FlameFrags, it seems as if LettuceK might have had good intentions in the past however his greed for power consumed him. LettuceK is really just a dictator but one who is favoured by the people. By the fact that he raises poorly equipped armies, letting them all die just to boost his reputation really shows that. 

Seen around the prison in 
Escaping Prison on the Unstable SMP
, and when the four prisoners (Wemmbu, Baablu, Fantst and Zam) make their escape through the ravine, he chases them and begins blowing up holes to find them faster. Wemmbu and Baablu make it into a cave, but Lettuce follows them, and once again blows up holes - leading to him finding the pair.

Back at the prison, Lettuce forces them to do an item check and mend their armour so that an escape like that can't happen again. Then takes the four of them down to solitary to leave them there forever - and 
Wemmbu
 till his execution.

At the end of 
Unstable SMP: The First King,
 Lettuce holds another server wide meeting to show who is on the leaderboard and how many votes they all have.

In 
I Explored the Minecraft Great Sea
, Lettuce is searching 
the Great Sea
 for Wemmbu, and he's looking for the discs for the Obrbital Strike Canon. He goes to the Frog Civilisation out in the 
Great Sea
 and at first tries barginning/reasoning with them, but once Wemmbu steps in, him and his Lawmen begin killing them as they are 'pirates' who deserve to die because they're a threat to the server. Kills their leader whilst 
Wemmbu
 and 
Eggchan
 are boating away.

Brings rail guns and an army of Lawmen to the floating Trading Town with the intentions of destroying the place - along with a few pirates. He succeds with this, and ends up bringing Wemmbu back down into trenches, and then fighting with 
Jaden
 in an attempt to kill or capture him - which he fails at. 

Does try chasing and macing 
Eggchan
 or 
Wemmbu
, but ends up flying away when Wemmbu pops one of his totems.

Reveals that he was following 
Wemmbu
 after he steals the disc shulkers, and calls down his army to try and kill Ouroboroid and Wemmbu. They end up killing 
Ouroboroid
, but 
Wemmbu
 escapes, leaving Lettuce and his army to finish off the Orbital Canon.

In 
I Ran for King on the Unstable SMP
, he gathers the contenstants together to tell them how the voting/competition is going to go. He speaks with them about the rules before telling them that they'll be staying at the 
Northern Council
. Bottom eight around the walls, and the top eight inside the main building. He allows everyone to get settled, and simple leaves them to it. 

The next day, he gathers all the contenstants again for another important announcement. Tells them that he's going to host a debate, so that the contenstants can introduce themselves to the server - and allow the server to know what their terms will be when they become king. Lettuce is paired up with ParrotX2. Says that the debate is in exactly one week, and then dismisses them again.

Gives the leading statement at the beginning of the debate, and introduces the commentator - 
Spepticle
, before heading back inside.

In his and 
Parrot's
 debate, he talks to the server about The Law have already accoplished under his rule, however, ParrotX2 instantly interjects - denying that The Law has actually offered as much help as they said they had. Lettuce then goes on to say that he's liberating 
The Great Sea
 - which gains great approval from the server. 

Denies Parrot's accusations of 
Wemmbu
 being loose - and then exposes that he knows Parrot killed 
Jackman
, and tells him that he's going to be executed right there and then. However, 
Spepticle
 steps in, to which Lettuce is shocked - but has no choice to accept his statement of him killing Jackman instead of Parrot. He knows he now can't blame it on Parrot as Spepticle has confessed. Lettuce - despite knowing its a lie, decides to execute Spepticle instead to make an example. 

Spepticle's execution gains Lettuce huge support from the crowd - and it seems he has no sympathy for Spepticle, so does it without second thought. Executing Spepticle by dropping an anvil on him. Lettuce uses his death as a threat - saying that anyone who doesn't meet justice in his eyes, will meet the same fate as Spepticle - execution. However, like Ouranos from Greek mythology, he prophesied one day Lettuce will meet the same fate as him; executed using an anvil.

In 
The Battle For The Great Sea
 LettuceK successfully captured 
Jaden-Man
 and The Law has total domination over The Great Sea (Even without The Orbital Strike Cannon, which was a blow nevertheless) LettuceK is shown as power hungry and he also does not care about any Law Men who he views as expendable. His intentions have started to divulge a lot from what they were with others like 
Deputy Ace
 starting to doubt him and that he is really doing good for the server. LettuceK also massacres Pirates who were not even fighting and would have posed no threat to 
The Law
. 

In, 
I Survived the Unstable SMP Purge
, LettuceK hosts a banquette inside of the 
Northern Council
 for the candidates to try and have them 'know each other more' - where in reality, he's setting them up for the purge. He's briefly seen 'helping' in trying to kill the assassins, but disappears soon after, and leaves 
Naparaziel
 as well as twenty of his Lawmen to die. At the end, we see him with 
Deputy Ace
 again, and Lettuce says how there is still one loose end whilst zooming into his mace - likely referring to how 
Wemmbu
 escaped capture, and how Lettuce needs to re-capture him.

In 2 Minecraft Pros vs 1000 hunters
 LettuceK commands The Law into trying to kill Parrot and Wemmbu. Deputy_Ace questions his motives again but quickly backtracks and obeys LettuceK order. At the end of the video we can see that LettuceK is quite deranged. He is shocked of Wemmbu's arrival and by this point has no restraint in trying to take over the server. LettuceK forcibly makes himself "The Interim Leader until the server is safe." He also blackmails Parrot into backing down. The shocked crowd shows that more people are starting to question LettuceK motives. The Law itself has mostly 8 year olds who don't know anything and most people with experience are starting to wonder if LettuceK would be the right leader.

in 
Minecraft Trapper vs 1000 players
, LettuceK is mentioned a few times. It seems like he has given thousands of Lawmen to Leow0ok who uses them to continue waging war on Spoke and JumperWho.

In 
Minecraft Pro VS 1000 players
,  (By Wemmbu) LettuceK threatens to kill Jaden Man if Wemmbu does not back down. He is also mentioned by MinuteTech who says that LettuceK manipulated him into giving Lettuce control over the end dimension.

In 
I Became King On The Unstable SMP
, he shows that he has control over Theo by teleporting him away after Parrot tries to break him out. He tells Parrot to endorse him, or he and his friend die. After 
Parrot
 publicly denies, he brings him to the original Capital City, where he orders 
Deputy_Ace
 to kill them when he blows his horn. Ace helps Parrot and 
Theo
 escape, which results in Lettuce ordering 
SargeLaw
 to kill him. LettuceK tells Parrot that he has some remorse for his actions but he is doing what needs to be done. 

Both he and SargeLaw are seen leading 
the Law army
 in the final battle against 
District 13
 alongside 
G0dOfWar
, 
Leow0ok
 and 
Purpled
. He tries to get Parrot to side with him saying that all of his hard work and pain would have been for nothing but Parrot refuses to backdown. After his first army fails, he sends a second, stronger army which is fully equipped with Netherite Gear which is also defeated. He continues fighting until the very end when he only has a chestplate. He flees from the destroyed 
Northern Council.
  Realising that everything he worked for was destroyed he soon after returns to the battlefield and surrenders, asking Parrot and 
District 13
 to kill him. After a voting session with the rest of the group, he is allowed to live, but is given a lifetime prison sentence. Parrot says that if the people elect LettuceK to be their king he will be allowed to rule over the server. Lettuce replies saying that the server is too far gone now and that the server would never be united again. In the final election LettuceK gets over 3000 votes but as he said Parrot has more votes than him and he loses the election and with that his freedom.

Before LettuceK is imprisoned he asks FlameFrags to change and shows remorse for his actions. This has a huge affect on FlameFrags as he begins remembering everytime other players called him out to which he only ignored. Flame replies to Lettuce that he will try before leaving.

It is currently unknown where LettuceK is imprisoned. He is the first 
antagonist
 to be properly punished (If you don't count 
Jaden MAN
 being trapped in the abandoned civilization and 
Wifies
 being killed.) He allowed thousands of players to be killed and his crimes were on the same level as 
Ashswagg
.   He is also the biggest antagonist of The Unstable Universe so far counting by videos and screen time.



Season 3


He is imprisoned in the Northern Council with mining fatigue, the same as Wemmbu's treatment.  He says to Parrot that his kingdom will collapse. He brings attention to a moment in the Kings Arc Finale where he says that the server is too far gone now. Despite Parrot coming to see him he refuses to give him any real valuable advice but mocks him for being a incompetent king. Parrot still does not understand why.

In 
Unstable SMP: Civil War
 Lettuce is seen still imprisoned with Soldier73. Though he has no lines in this episode and is only seen as a cameo.

Trivia

Mafia
 members his best friend and his professor as a joke.


Lettuce played as T0X1N in 
SOLO Player VS Toxic Minecraft Clan
.


He has been in at least 4 civilizations on the Unstable SMP.
