title: Minecraft Trapper VS Elite Bounty Hunters
content:
"
Till we meet again, friend.
"
This article contains major spoilers from recently released episodes. Please proceed with caution.




Minecraft Trapper VS Elite Bounty Hunters














Episode


119






Upload date


Mar 10, 2026






POV


SpokeIsHere






Arcs


NULL






Featured Creators (Description)


JumperWho














On the Unstable SMP, I was attacked by elite bounty hunters with unintelligible names and completely blank skins. This is how I fought back as a Minecraft Trapper...





Minecraft Trapper VS Elite Bounty Hunters
 is the 119th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


The episode begins with 
Spoke
 inside of his base enchanting, when all of a sudden his alarm alerted him of players nearby. Spoke assumes it was bandits and would have them go through his traps first, but they turned out to be more dangerous than he thought. 
Skinless players with jumbled names
 came barging in and dodge the first trap, run into the base and attack Spoke. This isn't a fight Spoke can take on, so he kites all of the hunters into the middle of the base and sets off a piston trap and drops all of them down on dripstone. Spoke wind charges a lever which activates a stasis, pulling 
JumperWho
 and her spies to investigate, as there were no death messages. Spoke believes that someone had hired these hunters to go after him, but doesn't know how to fight them if they don't fear death. Jumper says she's seen them, but doesn't know anything about the hunters. And even with her spies, there had no leads to figuring out who they are. Spoke packs up his base and Jumper gives him a paper with coordinates to a safehouse, but he doesn't take it if Jumper isn't going to work on the mission on finding 
Mapicc
. 

Spoke goes invisible and wanders off into the wilderness of the Unstable SMP. He talks to the viewers and explains that he hasn't seen Mapicc in over four weeks and after searching around for a few days, he hired Jumper and her spies to help. He says what was strange about the hunters was that they carried a shield with the same pattern as the one Mapicc gave him before the big battle against The Law. He goes closer to spawn to find more bases to camp in temporarily, finds a secret one in a mountain, and kills the person living there before him for being a hazard. He quickly realizes that was a bad idea since it would be shown to anyone nearby, and so he sets up a TNT minecart trap right above the entrance. He waits and sees the hunters coming closer, and when they enter the tunnel leading into the base, Spoke activates the trap, several hunters get their totems popped and they vanish instantly. Spoke escapes from the base with the remaining hunters chasing after him. The hunters have speed, which covers more horizontal ground and Spoke uses this to his advantage and uses pearls and his trident to get a lead from them. Spoke breaks into somebody's house and restocks, the hunters come shortly after and kill off the resident living there. He tries to leave the base fully invis, but the hunters see him and foils his plan. Spoke still manages to make it out and uses blue ice to gain speed and outrun them, and with no other choice, he decides to go to the coordinates to the safehouse. Spoke then decides to tower up and Elytra the rest of the way there. Although he dislikes using the Elytra, he thought it was necessary since it was an emergency. 

Only 200 blocks away, Spoke hides in a mountain quickly to use the bathroom and enables sneak toggle and lets the hunters run by. He inches closer and closer to the safehouse, but the hunters are tailing right behind him. Spoke enters the house, which seemed abandoned, but then spies come up from the ground and start fighting the hunters, giving Spoke time to escape. Jumper was also at the house and the two leave together as the hunters are distracted. Spoke asks if this was the safehouse, but Jumper said it wasn't and that it was just a house. As they run, the leader of the group, 
_1_88_____x
 chases after them, but then loses them after getting to the escape tunnel. At the end of the escape tunnel is the real safehouse, and Jumper instructs Spoke to stay inside of it until she and her spies handle it. Spoke says they don't know how the hunters work and he's seen it work in the past and says they're unkillable. However, Spoke knows a trap that can kill someone even with a totem and says that it's already built and will show Jumper it if he wasn't held hostage inside of the base they were standing inside of. 

They arrive at the trap, which turns out to be the same arrow railgun cannon they built inside in a previous episode. Spoke explains that you can trick the game into shooting it milliseconds after the first shot, and that it looks like there's three shots all in one. Jumper asks Spoke how he knows if killing them would stop this, but Spoke says it may not, but it would get a closer lead on figuring out where Mapicc is. Spoke brings up how Jumper had seen them before and asks what she saw, Jumper tells Spoke that she followed them along with her spies followed one of the hunters and based on what they found, they have a reason to believe Mapicc is still alive. She goes on and says how one of her traders went missing, so she went to the trader's base and saw the exact same hunters, so she followed the hunters for thousands of blocks, when all of a sudden, they'd stop moving and look into the distance. She got closer to get a better view of what happened and saw an armless player and they all started walking in a straight line. It was revealed that there was a bounty on that armless player's head and an hour later it was claimed and that they were dead, three hours before she saw that player marching. Spoke now understands that they're trying to break all of his armor to do the same thing to him. Spoke thinks this is a bigger threat than trying to find Mapicc and wants to put an end to this and wants to help out. 

As they walk to their destination, Jumper explains their targets have all had bounties on their heads, Spoke included, and Jumper went to Merchant City and kidnapped the person responsible for this. She says the person doesn't want to talk to Jumper or her spies, but was willing to talk to Spoke. They make it to the location and Jumper breaks a block, revealing a ladder going underground into an obsidian tunnel. Multiple spies guard the entire thing, and once they reach the obsidian box that holds the person, a guard breaks the obsidian, allowing Spoke and Jumper inside. The person that's responsible for this is 
SirPig_
, former mayor of 
Capital City
. He tells Jumper to leave and that everything is between him and Spoke. Spoke confronts SirPig and asks what he knows about the hunters, but SirPig says he has no idea. Spoke tries to bribe him to tell him information, but SirPig tells Spoke to stop worrying about him and start worrying about himself. Spoke says he's trying to work with him and asks for any clues, but all SirPig says is that all they asked for was a token to prove Spoke was dead as the chestplate gifted to him. Spoke asks for a name one last time or else SirPig dies, SirPig then pulls a fishing rod and stasises out. 

Spoke hears dozens of people right outside the box and tons of hunters come in and start attacking him. Jumper comes to help him get out, they get onto the surface, but the hunters make it up before them. Spoke tries to wind charge and pearl to get the hunters off their tail, but the hunters, specifically their leader, catch up quickly. The firework rockets shred through their armor and their resources slowly drain. Spoke tells Jumper he has a way to escape, but she won't be able to catch up and tells her to escape on her own for now. Spoke goes on top of a hill full invis and spots Jumper coming up, he quickly asks for an ender chest and grabs an invis potion from a shulker box. He splashes the both of them with invis and they go full invis and hide in a tree, losing track of the hunters. Jumper says her spies are in formation and they need to go activate the trap. The hunters stand looking at Spoke and Jumper, and as they get closer, Jumper commands her spies to come out. The spies serve as a distraction for the hunters. Spoke's armor starts to break, only having his chestplate and a turtle helmet left. Spoke and Jumper run from the fight with the leader, the only one chasing after them. As they near the trap, Spoke tells Jumper to get there first and he'll be there after. Spoke makes it to the house and kites the hunter around as Jumper prepares the trap. Once the trap is set up, Spoke runs towards it and wind charges above, and Jumper sets off the trap and kills them in an instant. Their inventory is scattered all over the floor, and Spoke picks up a book named "
mission: null
".



Trivia


The shield that both Spoke and the bounty hunters use is illegal to make in survival Minecraft. In survival, it only allows players to put six patterns, but this shield uses nine or ten, and is only obtainable using command blocks, as even using chat to type in the command is too long.


In the comment section of the video, Spoke says that he got sick and the video was originally meant to be aired a week earlier.


Throughout the video, Spoke can be seen visibly in danger whenever he's near roses, which hints that the death of 
iMajesticRose
 is what's been haunting him.

title: Minor Characters
content:
Minor Characters: A Small Explanation


Minor characters, in the context of the Unstable Universe, are characters that are barely plot relevant, yet have been documented here anyways.



How to Tell if the Character You Want To Add to the Wiki is Minor:


Ask yourself these questions:



Does this character have a youtube channel?


Does this character show up often/have a lot of screen time?


Does this character have a mic?


Does this character have an inportant role in the plot? If so, is it important enough to add more than a single bullet point or side note?


Does this character have enough info for at least a paragraph's worth of text?


They appear in big fights or in the background and just die or do nothing.


If the answer to most of these are "no" then you likely have a Minor Character on your hands.


Does the Unstable Universe Wiki have ALL the Minor Characters?


Goodness, no. We have several, but there are too many different people who have been on the server to count them all. The peeps we do have, however, are found in the following pages:

MinuteTech
, also known as 
Minute
, is a major supporting character in 
Unstable Universe
. He currently wields two of the last few remaining 
maces
 left on the server, with three more stashed away in a shulker box. He is the End Guardian and a former diamond tier 
Mafia
 member. 



Personality


Minute is a stoic and cautious individual, in part due to his prolonged experience of being on the run from 
the Mafia
. He  sets up multiple traps around the server, constantly moves his base, and always prefers to have a plan before carrying out operations. He views having teammates as a liability, but he is also shown being selfless and protective over his newfound friends- going out of his way to save 
Spoke
 and 
Mapicc
, sharing his resources (even God Apples, armor sets, and XP). He ends up sacrificing himself to allow 
Spoke
 and 
Planet
 to escape from the hundreds of 
Invisible Players.


He is a highly skilled player and PVPer, with his presence alone giving a sense of safety and security to his team who are confident in his abilities. Upon being forced to join the Mafia, he is immediately given the position of a diamond tier player. 



History


Season 1


Near the beginning of the server, Minute was a part of the original team that formed the Mafia. However, he left when 
Ashswagg
 assumed leadership and avoided the practice of setting a stasis chamber, preventing the execution that came from leaving. 

MinuteTech saves Spoke and 
Mapicc
 from the Mafia in the nether. Spoke and Mapicc secretly follow him back to his base. They are attacked underground by the Mafia. MinuteTech is able to kill one of the players using a mace and they manage to escape. 

PlanetLord introduces 
baconnwaffles0
 and 
TheRealSquiddo
 to MinuteTech. A Mafia member named 
BobDaGreenFrog
 tries to kill them, and baconnwaffles0 runs away. MinuteTech kills them. The Mafia starts trying to kill them. They mysteriously give MinuteTech a book, to which MinuteTech replies "no". The Mafia continues attacking them. They are able to escape. 

The team goes over to the outpost and finds a very large amount of invisible players. MinuteTech messages the team to run away after being handed a book. 

While 
Spoke
 and 
PlanetLord
 are in 
Jamato
's now destroyed base, they see Ashswagg. Ashswagg reveals that MinuteTech is now working for him, and orders him to kill Spoke and PlanetLord. Spoke and PlanetLord are able to escape from MinuteTech. 

Spoke has to fight a diamond tier player to become diamond tier. Spoke's totem of undying is used during the fight, revealing to Ashswagg that he is Spoke. Spoke and his friends try to kill Ashswagg but he escapes using a stasis chamber. The diamond tier player reveals he is MinuteTech. 



Season 2


MinuteTech got possession of the whole end. He controlled everyone who entered the End, but some players did not like this and tried to fight him. 
Baablu
 and 
Fantst
 had a goal to respawn the ender dragon, duplicate it, and bring it to spawn, with Babblu recruiting 
Wemmbu
 to help them. They succeeded, but Baablu betrayed Wemmbu and revealed he was just using him. Wemmbu and Minute then worked together to retake the end from their team. 

When in the 
Far Lands
, 
Eggchan
 set his spawn and became trapped in the end. Minute welcomed him and allowed him to stay with him in the end. 

When Wemmbu was visiting Minute and Egg in the end, he talked about how he had nothing to do on the server after becoming the strongest. Egg suggested he create a new identity in which he could experience the player as a normal server. Minute agreed to help Wemmbu fake his death, but warned him to be careful. 

One day, while selling an elytra to a random player, 
FlameFrags
 went into the end and confronted MinuteTech. Though at first the interaction was peaceful, it eventually broke into a fight when MinuteTech refused to tell him where Wemmbu was, which was Flame's objective. After an annoying fight, MinuteTech then reassures to Flame that Wemmbu is indeed dead but Flame refused to believe him. He then fled to the outer end islands. 

Wemmbu came through the end portal to visit and free Eggchan from his prison in the end. However, he is followed by players from the 
LAW
. Minute killed them and then asked Wemmbu what was happening where Wemmbu revealed that he was now a wanted criminal.  

Wemmbu caught up Minute and Egg on what had been happening on the sever, since they never left the end. After Wemmbu finishes, Minute revealed that he indented to give the end to the LAW due to wanting to do what was best for the dimension. He said that he doesn't agree with 
LettuceK
 being the solo leader of the sever due to what happened with the mafia, but since Lettuce had tried to take the end multiple times, he wouldn't be able to hold it for much longer.  

Wemmbu returned to the end to free it from the LAW. He found Minute in the outer end islands and Minute told them that he had stashed away resources that could help them fight the army. Wemmbu retrieved them. Minute, Wemmbu, and Eggchan went back to the main end island to fight the army stationed there. They escaped to the overworld, where Wemmbu would be able to use his orbital strike canons to defeat the rest of the army. Minute tells him to draw the fight away from spawn, due to the abundance of innocents in the area. Wemmbu did what Minute said and led the army away before defeating it, giving Minute control of the end again.  

JumperWho
 brings Minute to save Spoke, Mapicc, and 
PrinceZam
 from the Law. He was, however, upset at Spoke for raiding the End with 1000 players, and originally planned on killing him. Spoke apologized and Minute ends up sparing him.  

Minute fought alongside 
District 13
 at the Battle of the Northern Council. When the army was defeated, LettuceK fled. Minute and Wemmbu chased after him, but he escaped. While Wemmbu was angry, Minute told him that it wasn't necessarily a bad thing, since the server would now know who he really was and that was plenty of punishment. The two returned to the rest of District 13 to break the news. When Lettuce returned to the 
Northern Council
 and surrendered, they held a vote to decide what to do with him. Minute voted to spare him, mirroring what he had told Wemmbu earlier. Wemmbu also took his speech to heart and voted to let Lettuce live despite his former goal of killing the LAW commander.

.



History


 
 
 
 


While Mistrul was reading a book, 
FlameFrags
 and 
Lomedy
 found him and Flame challenges him to a fight. He refused to fight him, however, he snuck in a cheap shot with a 
mace
 and popped Flames totem. This is what started their fight.  This was your average fight. Mistrul hit flame, flame hit misrul. When mistrul got low, he ran from Flame, and attacked Lomedy. Flame called him a coward. Mistrul claimed his victory by stating that he popped two more totems than Flame, though the latter deemed these as cheap shots. Mistrul said Flame was beneath his concern and prompted Flame to leave.

He hunted Flame multiple times later and defeated him with 
Flowtives
, the actual leader and his PvP trainer behind Mist Civilization. Flame ran away and did a meditation to enter the zone. Flame wandered to the middle arena of the Mist Civilization, and found Mistrul waiting for a Duel. Flame was in the zone and killed Mistrul.



Trivia


His main combat style was Mace PVP.


He was also stated to be very impatient having killed someone because they took too long to deliver him breeze rods.

Helmet: Diamond Flow


Chestplate: Diamond Bolt


Leggings: Diamond Bolt


Boots: Diamond Bolt

MrCube6,

MrCube6
, also known as 
Cube
, is a character featured in 
Unstable Universe
. He serves as the main antagonist in 
I Got Hunted by a Minecraft Redstone Genius
.



Personality


Cube is portrayed as a redstone genius, being able to build ingenious traps and machines for varying purposes.His ability to think outside of the box while making his traps has allowed him to trap Parrot multiple times. He is described as being able to think several steps ahead and having a contingency plan for anything that could happen.



History


MrCube6 tries to assassinate 
ParrotX2
 by trapping him under the void. 
Derapchu
 finds Parrot and saves him.

Derapchu is trapped by MrCube6 on a pressure plate. Parrot and the team have to figure out which redstone lines to activate to save him and the entire base from exploding within a certain amount of time. MrCube6 also says that he sent a TNT bomber plane towards their base. They are able to save Derapchu.

Parrot sets up a trap and catches MrCube6. They trap him in a prison. MrCube6 manages to escape. MrCube6 steals all of the gear shulker boxes from the headquarters. MrCube6 gives these items to 
4CVIT
. Parrot and Derapchu take the shulker boxes of items back. A team of bandits try to steal from Parrot and Derapchu, but fail.

Bounty Assassin Team
 finds MrCube6 and detains him. 
JumperWho
 gives MrCube6 a  pot and a dandelion. MrCube6 escapes with a stasis chamber, but not before he gives Parrot a book by 
The Director
. The book states something about a dandelion, implying that The Director somehow knew that MrCube6 got a dandelion.

title: My Best Friend Died on the Unstable SMP
content:
My Best Friend Died on the Unstable SMP














Upload date


Dec 19, 2025






POV


SpokeIsHere






Arcs


BAT Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


Mapicc
Leow0ok
PrinceZam
ParrotX2
JamatoP
LettuceK
Loppezz














On the Unstable SMP, my best friend, Mapic, disappeared... leaving me to believe he had died, and Unstable being a hardcore server, he would never be able to return...





My Best Friend Died on the Unstable SMP
 is the 98th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


Spoke
 and 
Mapicc
 were running low on resources, so Spoke sends Mapicc off on a mission to get resources, Spoke convinces Mapicc to set an ender pearl stasis as well. Mapicc is given blue ice blocks and lily pads from Spoke when leaving in case he needs to escape. After an hour, Mapicc has yet to return, so Spoke pulls his stasis, Mapicc appears for a split second and sounds afraid, screaming that "We have to run" multiple times while he was running with arrows all over him, before getting teleported again. Spoke thinks that Mapicc was taken by Leow0ok and packs up his items and heads to the Mafia stash. Spoke arrives and sees the aftermath of the fight between Mapicc and the spies, the fight was taken recently, as their items were still on the ground. He sees signs of Mapicc being there, seeing that he used the blue ice during the fight. Spoke has the thought of Mapicc possibly being with 
PrinceZam
, and so he goes to Zam's base.

When he left the stash, eight spies are shown watching his every move, and follows him to Zam's base. Spoke flies and dodges their attacks while trying to look for an ice biome, where he had already set up TNT launchers that launched hundreds of TNT up in the air, killing all the spies except one, who turned out to be 
Leow0ok
. Leo starts to attack Spoke, planning to ban him off the server. Spoke uses a TNT and fishing rod stunt, but Leo's TNT minecart strategies were too strong for him. Spoke runs away and asks Leo if he's hiding anything, trying to get Leo to confirm if he knew what happened to Mapicc. He gets Leo off his trail and goes to PrinceZam's base, which appeared to have been ransacked. A hidden sign has a secret message that tells the coordinates of his new base, and so Spoke goes out to find it. A flashback is shown where Spoke and Mapicc were looting random bases and find banner patterns, Mapicc puts a brick pattern with an orange and yellow gradient on his shield. The flashback ends and Spoke flies by the base where the flashback took place. Spoke enters Zam's new base and asks him if he has seen Mapicc, to which he replies he has not seen Mapicc since a while, and how he's too busy moving from base to base. Spoke plans on going back to his bunker, but Zam says it's a bad idea, Spoke argues that Mapicc wouldn't be happy that all of his items were left there. Spoke then goes to their bunker and is greeted to an invisible player, who he assumes is Mapicc because they had the same brick pattern shield as him. The player drinks milk and turns out to be Leo. He says how Mapicc put up a good fight, but couldn't take on Leo and his spies, and took his shield as a token to show he killed Mapicc. Spoke is in denial, and Leo says he can believe that, but the truth is different, Leo then activates a void trap right below Spoke, in which he manages to save himself from, and Leo stasises away as multiple invisible spies appear behind paintings to try and knock Spoke down. Spoke uses chorus fruit to escape and then goes through the Nether, planning on blowing up Capital City to get proof Mapicc is alive. He returns to Zam's base and asks for a favor to send a message to LettuceK about his plans to destroy Capital City. 

When the time comes, Spoke walks up to the front gates of Capital City, 
Deputy_Ace
, a few lawmen and guards of Capital City await him, Deputy_Ace asks if Spoke thinks he can get away with blowing up Capital City, Spoke ignites a TNT and fishing rods them towards the guards, killing three in the process. Spoke blows up more guards and fights them off, Deputy_Ace and two guards flee, as they are unable to take on the fight. Spoke plants TNT around the entire city and builds a TNT cannon, waiting for somebody to tell him anything. He hears redstone being broken behind him and slowly looks back and sees 
Parrot
. Spoke sounds broken and asks if breaking the cannon will fix anything, Parrot tells Spoke he's about to destroy homes of hundreds and doesn't know what happened to him to cause him to be this way. Spoke says he didn't want to do this, and what he's doing isn't anything compared to what he's been put through by BAT and the Law, lamenting to Parrot that he doesn't have a home or a friend anymore, he says how Parrot wouldn't understand, but if he lost his closest friends, maybe he'd understand how he felt. Parrot informs Spoke that he's been through just as much as he has, and Spoke isn't the only one who's lost 
somebody
 
important
 to them. Spoke explains his situation to Parrot and mentions the shield pattern, Parrot knows about the shield pattern and says that Jumper had the exact same shield pattern. If what Parrot is saying is true, then that means the shield was a decoy and Mapicc could still be alive. Before heading off, Spoke tells Parrot to be the best king Unstable has ever seen and that the server needs him.

Spoke waits in front of the stash where Mapicc was last seen, meeting back up with Zam. They search for clues of where he could've went, Spoke reveals that neither The Law or BAT knows where Mapicc went and shows Zam that he discovered another floor of the stash where the spies were communicating with each other. The signs reveal that the spies planned on killing Mapicc, but Leo wanted to kill Mapicc himself. Another player came and helped Mapicc fight them off using weapons that haven't been seen before, somebody who knew Spoke but the spies didn't. The last signs say that they went a certain direction, and so Spoke and Zam begin to follow a trail that was left by Mapicc. They follow the ice blocks and lily pads placed by Mapicc, going from biome to biome, when they get to a snowy biome, they see light emitting from underneath the snow and look inside, which they find an ender pearl cannon. Spoke and Zam use it and spot a lighthouse in the distance, finding nothing there, so they keep moving. They spot a house in the distance with rings of flowers surrounding the entire house, confident that it's Mapicc and the mystery person, they head towards the house. As they wind charge up the flower field, Spoke spots the Far Lands in the distance, which reminds him of the only person he knows that resides there. Spoke finds Mapicc and 
JamatoP
, Spoke's first friend and one of the few players on the server that knew exploits about the game. Spoke doesn't sound grateful that Mapicc is alive, but rather feels betrayed that Jamato returned only now to save Mapicc. Mapicc explains how they escaped and that BAT isn't a problem anymore, but Spoke says that's not winning and that they're running. Jamato says that he's always wanted to explore and learn, never with the rest of the server, he says that his plan was to go all the way out with Spoke, but with the way things ended between them, he wasn't able to do so. All of them say they want to go and explore the world rather than fighting, Jamato offers Spoke the opportunity to as well, he doesn't respond and wanders off far enough where they don't see him set an ender pearl stasis. He returns and agrees to explore the world with them, he asks if they're all good and looks at Jamato, who's still unsure about how to feel about Spoke, but is still glad to have him there. 

While Zam and Mapicc are packing, Jamato says he has some loose ends to tie up and walks away, Spoke pearls away and goes invis to follow him to the lighthouse, Jamato knows Spoke is there and tells him to reveal himself.  Jamato and Spoke debate for a while where Jamato says how Spoke is just using his own friends for his own good. Spoke angrily replies that Jamato who claimed to have had decided to protect the server was nowhere to be found during the reign of 
The Invisible Mafia
. To which Jamato replies that the real threat to the server isn't The Mafia, it's Spoke. The server won't end with Leo or with The Law, and that Spoke is never satisfied. Spoke threatens to kill Jamato, and so he takes off all his armor and throws his totem off the lighthouse and tells Spoke to kill him. Spoke doesn't instantly try to kill him, and Jamato says, "That's what I thought," just as Spoke pots up and attacks. Jamato holds another totem out, which teleports him to a stasis set somewhere. 

Spoke goes invisible and goes back to the house pretending to be Leow0ok and using TNT minecarts to attack Mapicc and Zam. Getting close to death, Spoke pulls his stasis and blows up the netherite armor and puts on his normal armor and visible, he goes back to the house and pretends to not know what just happened. Spoke makes them believe that Leo followed them to the pearl cannon and they try to find Jamato. Spoke suggests going to the lighthouse and find a trail of explosions leading to the lighthouse. At the lighthouse, it's shown to be blown up and destroyed, Spoke makes Mapicc and Zam check the top so they don't hear him throw an experience bottle where Jamato threw his totem off, he then pretends to find Jamato's totem and experience, proving that Leo got to him and killed Jamato. They make a grave for JamatoP back at his house, Spoke instructs the two to go back to the lighthouse and give him some alone time to grieve. Once alone, he laughs maniacally; he knows Jamato is smart enough not to mess with him and that he almost had Mapicc and Zam convinced to turn their backs on him. Spoke says how in a different universe they could've been the best of friends and what it could've been. While that was all happening, Jamato is shown standing on the top of the Far Lands looking down at his house.



Trivia


This is Spoke's first time being inside of 
Capital City 2.0
, as well as being the last protagonist to come to Capital City.


This also marks Spoke's first time being near the Far Lands, same with being the last protagonist to near in the Far Lands. His first entrance to 
Far Lands
 was several episodes later, in 
Searching For 1000 Players Who Went Missing
.


Despite villagers being extremely rare, some villagers can be seen in the villages.


The hardcore hearts texture were edited in during the Capital City scene when Spoke opens up his inventory.

However, the overlay is not shown when Spoke opens his inventory during his fight with Mapicc and Zam and actually use the hardcore hearts texture.


When 
JamatoP
 and Spoke talked at the lighthouse, the sky was dark with lightning. Same lightning was seen when 
Null Hunters
 hunt Spoke later on.


When Spoke found the trail of explosions, he moved his cursor onto a red shulker full of TNT, indicating that he had deliberately created these explosions before he went invis and jumped Mapicc and Zam in order to convince them that Leow0ok had chased down and killed Jamato, and that he was just acting to be surprised. This makes sense because if Spoke had not picked up the totem dropped by Jamato down the lighthouse, made an explosion pit and dropped it to the pit, it would have either despawned or destroyed by the explosion if Jamato was the one who created the explosions and blew the lighthouse up.

content:
Mysterious Tomb

Resting place of the former hero's mace








Appearances 




Appears in


I Joined the World's Largest Minecraft Server (Wemmbu)






Debut


I Joined the World's Largest Minecraft Server (Wemmbu)












Behind the castle at the wheat village there is a path. It's not made of gravel or anything, it's just the absence of trees. If you follow it there for long enough, you'll find a blue cornflower which you'll need to break. That's all.



LordSirWessley
's instructions on how to find this place
[
1
]


The 
mysterious tomb
 is a major location in 
I Joined the World's Largest Minecraft Server (Wemmbu)
. It is where 
Wemmbu
 fought an invisible player for 
FieldsOfElysium's mace
. 



Description


The mysterious tomb's entrance is a drop-down into a pool of water which leads to a large cave with a large ravine-like skylight opening. Glowing amethyst crystals, fences, lamps, and large leafless trees can be seen scattered throughout the cave. Near the entrance, a wooden bridge sits atop a pool of water, walking over the bridge will trigger an arrow trap and spawn several wardens. 

There is a large sword with a cyan guard and yellow hilt near the back of the cave and in front of a waterfall. A broken bridge leads up to this spot. 



Lore


An unnamed hero who guarded the 
Wheat Kingdom
 placed their mace here for rest before quitting the server. According to 
FieldsOfElysium
, this player was a strong fighter and the Kingdom is endangered without them.

The only person the hero told of their mace's whereabouts is 
LordSirWessley
, whom Wemmbu sought out at the request of FieldsOfElysium. After a challenge, Wessley tells Wemmbu some vague instructions on how to find the tomb. Noticing Wemmbu's confusion, he explains that it is word-for-word what the hero had said to him. 

Wemmbu and 
Eggchan
 follow Wessley's instructions and find the tomb. Wemmbu breaks the blue cornflower and the door is revealed. Wemmbu accidentally breaks the door mechanism. They drop into the hole and Wemmbu loses a totem of undying while crossing the bridge and is forced to fight two wardens after. After defeating the wardens, Wemmbu and Eggchan make their way to the top of the cave where a large sword. The mace is in an item frame on the sword. 

Before Wemmbu can get to it, an invisible player snatches it. The two fight and Wemmbu launches several stab shots that ripped holes into the tomb's ceiling and floors. The invisible player yields and gives Wemmbu the mace.

The 
Northern Council
 is one of the largest builds constructed by 
the Law
, where 
LettuceK
 hosted speeches and conducted the election. It also serves as the de-facto capital of 
Unstable SMP
, where the King of the Unstable SMP lives and governs the server. 



History


This place was built and used by 
LettuceK
 and 
the Law
. The Northern Council was also where the largest battle in the history of the server happened when 
District 13
 fought 2500 Law-men and members of 
BAT
. This battle would change The Unstable SMP forever. After being destroyed in the battle it was rebuilt and continues to be the place where the king of the Unstable SMP governs the server (The King being 
Parrot
).



Speeches at the Northern Council


The Debates


The Debates in the Northern council were a series of speeches that were supposed to decide how the election really went. These speeches were conducted by LettuceK. It is notable that 
Spepticle
 was killed in one of these speeches. During these debates almost every single player in the mainland of the server attended them. Players were not allowed to wear armour and the whole place was guarded by a garrison of Law troops. 



The Law Speeches


The Northern Council also had speeches to Law men. The only time we really see this is when LettuceK gave The Law the order to hunt down Parrot and Wemmbu. It seems like LettuceK gave orders from The Northern Council. During the final battle of The Northern Council LettuceK had prepared for the battle before hand to give District 13 the false illusion of victory. It is possible that this was practiced at The Northern Council as it all Law troops knew where to go.



The Battle Of The Northern Council


Beginning


Parrot and the rest of 
District 13
 marched on the Northern Council. Parrot talks to Lettucek that he should have "
kept it between the two of them
" and they both walk back to their respective sides. Parrot, the leader of the group, tells Wemmbu to fire his devastating and death banning nukes, which slaughtered most of the diamond lawmen.

spawn
. They teleport away whenever their totem is popped, meaning that they can defy death except for an arrow cannon, which has killed one of their leaders, 
_1_88_____x
. They have higher speed stats than normal players, and traverse terrain through the Nether, allowing them to travel faster and easier to hunt down targets. They were first seen chasing down 
Spoke
. They all hold shields that have a pattern impossible to obtain in survival. Their job is to kidnap players written in books entitled 
mission: null,
 and kill any player they see on sight. 

The rest of Null Hunters patrol and take over the 
Far Lands
. They can light nether portals at 
Far Lands
 which cannot be done by normal players like 
Wemmbu
. 



Structure


Hierarchy


Null Hunters operate in squads and obey corresponding squad leader's order. Normal Null Hunters wear netherite flow-trimmed netherite armor sets. Squad leaders wear redstone flow-trimmed netherite chestplates. This chestplate-trim-color-based hierarchy system is similar to that of 
the Invisible Mafia
.





Practices


For those selected that go to 
spawn
:

Each active member has an ender pearl stasis chamber triggered via certain glitch by popping their totems.


They hunt down whoever appears on the leaders' 
mission: null
 books and their allies relentlessly, draining all targets' resources, including armor durability and food, until they surrender. The targets, after neutralized, are forced to march to a pearl cannon that leads to "the Road of Null" in the 
Far Lands
. Any passing-by players are killed on sight. Their hunting pressure is equivalent if not higher than that of 
the Invisible Mafia
.


Their targets include those who have bounty on their head and trappers or other wrongdoers.


Leaders use multishot black firework crossbows to slow down targets and help drain targets' resources.


Blow up the pearl cannon in case anyone tries to forcefully use it.


If one squad leader dies other leader(s) are immediately notified through some mechanism and the squad is merged to another squad.


For those staying at 
Far Lands
:

Patrol and take over Far Lands.


Neutralize and send players encountered through nether portal.


History


Mapicc
 was asked to join Null Hunters and given their shield on his way to the end with 
MinuteTech
.

Mapicc gave 
Spoke
 Null Hunters' shield as a gift. He was then captured by Null to their base in the 
Far Lands
. Null Hunters started to hunt down Spoke, 
Jumper
 and 
her spies
. Spoke and Jumper, losing almost all spies, were forced to defend themselves, investigate and find a way to counter whilst being intensely hunted.

Mapicc reappeared and lead them to the Far Lands through a 
pearl cannon
 which was presumably offset by Null Hunters. They travelled across multiple biomes, dodging Null Hunters and escapers from Null along the way. Inside a dark forest, they killed a squad of Null Hunters and captured 
their leader
, which lead them to an infinite downward staircase that is said to go to a scary place and connected to 
Null leader
 or Null base. 
JamatoP
, not revealing himself as the leader yet, met all three of them. JamatoP travelled with them, telling Null Hunters to slowly drain their resources and precisely attack them and steal stashes along the process. He and Null Hunters were able to capture JumperWho and Mapicc, and corner Spoke, finally revealing himself to be the Null leader. He forced Mapicc to break all Spoke's armor including 
Alt
, and then used Null Hunters to break Mapicc's armor until both of them are captured.



Thumbnails




Trivia


The exploit Null Hunters spawn squads used to teleport away when totem popped is likely shadow items, i.e. two "quantum entangled" references to the same instance of totem, with one in the exploit user's hand and the other in a chest connected to comparator that triggers stasis machine. When the user's totem pops, the other reference in the chest also "pops", leading to the stasis being pulled. A third reference may be created and placed in other squad leaders' inventories so if one dies others know and response immediately. Aside from Null Hunters and JamatoP, this glitch was also used by Wemmbu at 
PvP tournament
 as well as by 
Wifies
 when 
Parrot
 attacked him in 
Paragon
.


Only the Null Hunters at spawn get the totem teleport glitch as the Farlands Null Hunters don't get any.


They may originate from 
the Underworld
, as they have similar black skin as 
Soul Keepers
, and they travel through the Nether without 
ClownPierce
 knowing their existence. They may be the entities that lagged 
Wemmbu
 and 
Boosfer
 under the gold block altar, or may even be revived on the altar themselves though glitch (hence their glitched name and appearance).


Whenever they appear, sky darkens and lightning accompanies. Same lightning appeared in the background during the conversation between Spoke and JamatoP at the 
lighthouse
, in retrospect.

title: Orbital Dog Cannon
content:
FlameFrags in front of his Orbital Dog Cannon
 
 


The 
Orbital Dog Cannon
 is a machine constructed by 
FlameFrags
 back in 
Lifesteal S6
 (
1000 Armored Wolves VS Lifesteal SMP
, still manually trigger at that time), allowing him to teleport an army of thousands of armored wolves at him with a fishing rod similar to 
Wemmbu
's 
Orbital Strike Cannon
. The machine splash sitting wolves with speed, strength and fire resistance potions, before making them take fall damage, stand up and teleport to their owner, 
FlameFrags
, due to Minecraft mechanics.

It is superior to 
Orbital Strike Cannon
 in that



Being based on teleportation mechanics, it is not limited by spatial hinderance (though still need to be in same dimension) like obsidian roof.


Dogs can take lethal damage from nuke or other sources with their armors.


Swarms of dogs are hard to shield and relentlessly deal damage, as opposed to instant damage by 
Orbital Strike Cannon
 that is easily shielded.


It never damages its owner.


(If not on Unstable Universe) it triggers instantly without loading and does not need preset coordinates, while 
Orbital Strike Cannon
 needs loading and needs preset coordinates.


However, it also has severe limitations:



It require large amount of resources like meat and scute, which is hard to find on the Unstable SMP given mob cap, thus limiting the number of such cannons and their reload frequency.


It cannot be used to destroy structure.


The dogs can be countered by lava / fire, more than one orbital strike cannons or more than one explosives.


The Orbital Dog Cannon was used in several battles by 
FlameFrags
 against players that annoy him, 
Wemmbu
 and the army of 1000 people by the Law and 
Mist Civilisation
 members.

title: Orbital Strike Cannon
content:
Picture of cannon. Credit: 
[1]
 
 


An 
Orbital Strike Cannon
 is a Minecraft build featured in 
Unstable Universe
 utilizing various mechanics to be able to drop hundreds of TNT onto a chosen location. The machine was designed by 
cubicmetre
.

There can be two different types of shots. A nuke shot, which covers lots of distance but doesn’t have that much concentration of TNT per block, and a stab shot, which is tons of TNT concentrated on a single spot, usually going down to bedrock.

Orbital Strike Cannon is designed to use only in the Overworld, making 
Wemmbu
 passive when fighting 
the Law
 in the End.



History


Wemmbu
 shows 
Spoke
 that he can activate an orbital strike cannon using a fishing rod.

SpokeIsHere
 destroys 
The Wonders
 using an orbital strike cannon. Parrot builds an orbital strike cannon to stop the Wonders from being destroyed but fails.

Spoke destroys a sky base containing duped items using an orbital strike cannon.

Spoke accidentally destroys 
Jepexx
's base using an orbital strike cannon.

ParrotX2
 and 
Wifies
 help Wemmbu build an orbital strike cannon. Parrot and Wifies then use it to destroy the 
Treasure Hunters
 headquarters.

The 
Zam Empire
 destroys 
Wemmbu
's orbital strike cannon and adds a giant obsidian shield over the empire to stop an orbital strike cannon from destroying it. PrinceZam gets too confident after seeing Wemmbu's weakened state and he removes the shield. Little did he know, Wemmbu was ready to destroy the empire.

ClownPierce
 uses an orbital strike cannon to destroy PrinceZam's base in a prison as 
Pangi
 tried to escape to the nether. Wemmbu and 
eggchan
's base is also destroyed by ClownPierce.

ParrotX2
 uses an orbital strike cannon and connects it with a line of mirror receivers to remotely activate it without a fishing rod. He used it alongside 
BAT
 to kill 
TruOriginal
, the hacker that was hunting Parrot.

Wemmbu discovers an array of repeating orbital strike cannons in the farlands. Later on, he uses them to destroy the old Law base while trying to find 
FlameFrags
. He then asks 
Jaden_MAN
 if he knew where FlameFrags was. Jaden stalls and eventually attacks Wemmbu. After Wemmbu defeats Jaden, he destroys his Pirate castle. Wemmbu goes to FlameFrags' old base where he kills another player who dropped a compass leading to where FlameFrags was. After finally finding FlameFrags, Wemmbu uses his orbital strike cannons to finally defeat him and be considered the strongest player.

Wemmbu uses some of his orbital strike cannons against 
Boosfer
 and his bandits in BranzyCraft's abandoned base. He manages to kill all the bandits except for 
Boomie
. Wemmbu chases them down 
The Great Sea
 where he finally kills Boomie using his orbital strike cannons. 

ParrotX2 and TheobaldTheBird impersonate Wemmbu. While Wemmbu chases them down, he tries to kill them using his stab shots from his orbital strike cannons. 

Wemmbu uses three orbital strike cannon shots during his 
fight with FlameFrags against 1000 players
 to kill some of the players. After they won the battle, Wemmbu runs out of orbital strike cannons. He tries to use one against FlameFrags but FlameFrags dodges it.

The Law builds an orbital strike cannon to destroy the Pirates' base, but Wemmbu and eggchan destroy it before it can fire. 

Wemmbu returns to the Farlands to finally get his orbital strike cannons back. Wemmbu then uses the orbital strike cannons to fight against the Law, banning dozens of players and resulting in their long-awaited downfall. 



Trivia


It's important to note that the orbital strike cannons featured in Wemmbu's videos aren't actually possible as the cannon's firing location is predetermined, along with other technical reasons. They cannot fire instantly in real Minecraft as it is not possible to change game speed locally like Wemmbu did in the 
Far Lands
.

This is an orbital strike cannon.





Orbital Strike Cannon VS Unstable SMP
 is the 65th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


The episode begins with Wemmbu stating his intention with the 
Orbital Strike Cannons
: to use them to seek revenge on his enemies and defeat 
FlameFrags
, and obtain the title of the strongest player.

While on his journey to find Flame, he follows a few players towards 
Capital City
, a place that newer members of the server go to in order to find safety. While there, many of the players seem to ignore him as if he is just another person, which seems to agitate him. He manages to corner one of them by a lamp post, asking if they knew where FlameFrags was. They respond on a sign, saying that only 
Reddoons
 knows where Flame is, and that there is a queue he must wait in. Wemmbu threatens the player with his Stab Shot, an ability that his cannons possess, and they eventually take him to what is supposedly Reddoons' office.

In the office, Reddoons is not there, and there is only a player by the name of SirPig_ in the room. The original player who had taken Wemmbu to the office in the first place mentions to the others that Wemmbu had threatened to blow up the entire city if he was not taken here. Wemmbu then asks, again, where Reddoons is, or if anyone knew the whereabouts of FlameFrags. After once again nuking part of the city, SirPig_ finally tells Wemmbu that FlameFrags had gone to 
The Law
, a place south-west of Capital City. 

Once travelling there, he finds The Law's base, and he meets 
Falcuno
 and 
LettuceK
. They order a group of new players they'd supposedly pulled from spawn to kill Wemmbu. The players, only owning iron and leather gear, are unable to kill him. Wemmbu uses his Nuke Shot to massacre them all at once, and then demands to know where Flame is. LettuceK tells him that Flame was likely trying to get revenge on 
Jaden_MAN
 and that he could be in Jaden's base but he is reluctant to tell Wemmbu where the coordinates are. Wemmbu blows up some of the city with the orbital strike cannon. Lettuce gives Wemmbu the coordinates and Wemmbu destroys the entire city just to make sure they don't hunt him again.  

Wemmbu finds an old pirate base and notices cobwebs. Wemmbu begins reminiscing FlameFrags wiping out players in the base and realizes that the base is abandoned. Wemmbu continues searching for Jaden's base until he finds a castle with a pirate branding. He realizes that the castle belongs to Jaden_MAN. Wemmbu asks Jaden to tell him where FlameFrags is and blows up some of his castle with the Stab Shot. Jaden suggests that Wemmbu checks Flame's base and begins looking for books in his chests and barrels. After a while of going through his stuff it begins raining. Jaden leaves the castle and Wemmbu looks in the castle for himself and it appears that there are no books.  

Out of no where, Jaden begins attacking Wemmbu with his mace and his riptide trident. Wemmbu tells Jaden that if he wants him to stop then he has to tell him where FlameFrags is but he eventually gets more focused on Jaden's mace rather than FlameFrags' location and when the rain stops, the fight is over and Wemmbu tells Jaden to give him the mace. Jaden drops a bucket and runs away. Wemmbu picks it up thinking that it's his mace. He tries to chase Jaden but he loses him. Wemmbu begins nuking Jaden's castle. 

Wemmbu decides to listen to Jaden and go to Flame's abandoned base where he meets a player in gold armour named TREELEAF2021. TREELEAF2021 tells Wemmbu to do a scavenger hunt but Wemmbu doesn't listen and instead kills him with a Stab Shot. He then finds a compass named "FlameFrags..." and not having any other choice Wemmbu follows the compass. The compass leads him to an old Mafia stash that 
Wemmbu had raided during his training with ManePear
. Wemmbu waits on top of the pillar in one of the buildings until he finds FlameFrags. Wemmbu begins taunting FlameFrags, telling him that he is no longer the strongest player because he is about to take that title from him. Wemmbu uses a stab shot on FlameFrags and they begin fighting. They find themselves in an ancient city and wardens attack both of them. They eventually leave the ancient city and the fight continues. Wemmbu breaks Flame's chestplate and continues to blow him up with the stab shots. Wemmbu had finally defeated FlameFrags and he taunts FlameFrags for hiding and tells him that he will never be the strongest player ever again. Wemmbu stands on the same pillar from when the fight began before leaving.

Ouroboroid
 is a character in 
Unstable Universe
. 



History


Ouroboroid had access to slime mobs, and hands them over to the trader RockyUnleashed39 while invisible.

Wemmbu
 attempts to converse with him and later kill him, but Ouroboroid has access to enchanted golden apples, wind charges, and a riptide trident. He is able to escape.

Wemmbu obtains a screenshot of Ouroboroid who had revealed a compass for a split second, and 
eggchan
 calculates where the compass leads to. 

Wemmbu finds Ouro's base and they get in a fight. Despite having many totems of undying, Ouroboroid is overpowered, and Wemmbu is able to negotiate with him and tell him about 
LettuceK
's plans, and explain that Lettuce plans to destroy the Pirate Civilization. 

Ouroboroid takes Wemmbu to the storage. LettuceK was able to invisibly sneak in and steal a few shulker boxes with music discs in them. Ouro immediately threw a wind charge to the self-destruct button, but it was too late.

Wemmbu attempts to distract LettuceK while Ouroboroid gets gear. LettuceK kills Ouroboroid. 



Trivia


Ouroboroid may be related to The_Oroboros, the soldier of the Law due to their similar names, and armor trims.


LettuceK tells Wemmbu and Ouroboroid "I got the better of the two of you", which may have a double meaning in this regard.

Unstable Universe
. Pangi was a member of 
Wemmbu's Civilization

Skyblock Civilization
, and a member of the 
Zam Empire
. 



Personality

ParrotX2, or simply Parrot, is one of the four main protagonists of 
Unstable Universe
, alongside 
SpokeIsHere
,  
Wemmbu
, and 
FlameFrags
. Parrot is currently the king of Unstable Universe, a former member of the 
Bounty Assassin Team
, the creator of 
The End Civilization
, a former member and leader of the 
Warriors Council
 in 
Far Lands
, and the leader of 
District 13
.



Personality


Parrot is a highly calculated strategist; he compensates for his lack of PvP combat skills with exceptional intelligence. He is well-versed with the mechanics of Minecraft and often uses it to his advantage to solve puzzles or gain the upper hand. He is incredibly charitable and selfless, giving out riches to the new players of the server and regularly putting others before himself. His lack of PvP skills makes him susceptible to ambushes and attacks, so instead he strategies with others on the best form of action as well as letting other players take the brunt of most PvP action.

Despite his politeness to most players, he often can be cocky and egotistical when up against his enemies, using intimidation to gain the upper hand. When he is in a desperate and seemingly impossible situation, he will use sharp and condescending words to associate with them to the point it is considered amoral by his teammates. However, he primarily uses violence as a last resort. He is sometimes playfully cocky with his friends, especially his best friend, 
TheobaldThebird
, consistently claiming himself to be the “biggest bird” out of the two.

Parrot is also extremely idealistic and heroic, believing he has to be the one to save everyone on the server no matter the consequences on him or the friends around him, and always refusing to be selfish. His strong convictions can occasionally blind him to alternative viewpoints. Nevertheless, he is generally considered among the most morally upstanding players on the server.

title: ParrotX2/History
content:
"
Till we meet again, friend.
"
This article contains major spoilers from recently released episodes. Please proceed with caution.


"
The Ash Will Rise.
"
This article is unfinished or outdated by new episode info. You can help Unstable Universe Wiki by 
expanding it
.




History


Season 1


Parrot goes to his house, where he sees 
Wemmbu
. Wemmbu leads him to a massive crater that he found created by an 
Orbital Strike Cannon
, and says that he didn’t make it. Parrot thinks that 
SpokeIsHere
 made the crater. He checks 
The Wonders
, as he thinks that is why Spoke would be making an orbital strike cannon. 
Roshambogames
 tells Parrot that The Gardens of Babylon Wonder got destroyed. Parrot then goes on to see the destroyed wonder

He follows Wemmbu to his base, however he's nowhere to be seen after he enters.

Parrot discovers that The Crone wonder has been destroyed, the one 
Fantst
 was guarding. Parrot again follows Wemmbu back to his base, and he is again nowhere to be seen. He meets Wemmbu at a new TNT cannon Parrot built, and lies to Wemmbu telling him he made notes in an in-game book on how to find Spoke. He says he put it in the Ice Castle Wonder, and Wemmbu goes over there to find it. Parrot goes over to Wemmbu's base, and finds a secret vault under it, but doesn’t go into the vault. He goes back to his cannon where he sees Wemmbu. He tells Wemmbu that to find Spoke and his orbital cannon, he has to use the lag. Parrot leaves Wemmbu and builds his own orbital cannon.

Wemmbu finds Parrot with his orbital cannon and tells Parrot that he doesn’t know what he's doing. Wemmbu presses a button which blows up part of the cannon. Parrot leaves and goes to The Pyramid of Anubis Wonder. Spoke's orbital cannon destroys the build.

Parrot goes back into Wemmbu's vault to see what’s in there, and finds a bunch of weird contraptions. Wemmbu walks in with Roshambo, and Parrot hides at the top of the vault on the weeping vines. He hears them talk about him, and tells Roshambo to not let Parrot fire his cannons. After Roshambo leaves, Parrot jumps down and tries to attack Wemmbu, but stops when he realizes he likely couldn't kill him. Wemmbu leaves, and Parrot follows him, but stops when realizing that he doesn’t have enough rockets. He goes to his cannon, where Roshambo, 
Derapchu
, 
JumperWho
, and Fantst, all of the guards of the wonders come. They tell him he can't set the cannon off. Parrot tries to show them Wemmbu's vault, however the vault is gone.

Parrot comes back to his cannon, where it’s been destroyed. The server lags, indicating that one of The Wonders has been destroyed. He checks The Marshland Mansion Wonder, which’s been destroyed by Spoke's orbital cannon. Parrot agrees to save the Frosted Palace Wonder with the guardians of The Wonders. He plans that if he gets all the materials for the orbital cannon in fifteen minutes, and builds it all in one hour, then he can destroy Spoke's cannon before it destroys the Frosted Palace. They build the orbital cannon. After they’re done, they wait four and a half hours for it to destroy Spoke's cannon, however Spoke and Parrot’s cannon go off at the same time, though the Frosted Palace wonder is still destroyed.

Parrot finds a music disc accompanied by a texture pack. When played, it gives a message of Spoke saying that there’s a secret in the server, and that Parrot has to show that he deserved to know it. He gave Parrot coordinates to go to. Parrot invites Wifies to help him find this secret. He finds a medieval castle and opens the door by having him and Wifies step on 2 pressure plates. They obtain a disc and fly out as the castle is exploding to TNT.

Spoke sends him another texture pack, so Parrot plays the disc and it says that he has to "follow the light". Parrot assumes this means to go to the 
Zam Empire
. He sees Wemmbu at the castle, and after a bit of chatting with him, 
PrinceZam
comes over. Wemmbu and PrinceZam are eager to get information about what is happening, as it has to do with Spoke, and they plan to kill Spoke. Wifies and Parrot fly away over to the castle. Parrot almost dies multiple times as Wemmbu and PrinceZam attacks them, but eventually they’re able to escape. He waits for them to leave, and then sees that the lighthouse’s redstone lamp is blinking in morse code. The morse code comes out as "-64". They find a stairway in the lighthouse to the coordinates -64, and open a chest which contains a music disc.

The disc tells them to bring flight duration 3 rockets, and not flight duration one. They have to travel 2000 blocks north. They decide not to bring flight duration 3 rockets, as they realize that one flight duration one rocket can travel super far. They get to the coordinates and find a void base made out of chest minecarts and shulker mobs, however they realize that the opening is sealed with obsidian. They go back to the old opening, but realize that it has now been sealed with cobblestone and obsidian. They go back to the void base to try and figure out what to do. Parrot realizes that using a fishing rod, he can help Wifies travel more distance with his limited firework rockets. They go back to the old opening, and place a crafting table on the block where they broke a cobblestone. Parrot crafts a fishing rod, and uses that to fish Wifies all the way to a separate base 5000 blocks out, where there is a different void hole they use to escape from the void.

They use the music disc again which gives a code. Parrot figures out that this is the code to PrinceZam's castle. They break into the castle and take a compass.

They play the disc, and it says that the disc is "pretty straight forward" and that this riddle gets "pretty straight to the point". The riddle is “lodestone”. They follow the compass to a lodestone in an ice spikes biome. They eventually find a chest that contains another lodestone compass. They follow the compass to a parkour ice mountain. There’s a person in full netherite armor with the chestplate and leggings being trimmed with redstone. This person is Spoke, but Parrot and Wifies don’t know that. He signals for them to put their items in two chests. They oblige and do the parkour.

After finishing the parkour, the guard gives them a music disc along with their stuff. They play the disc and begin the next challenge. They follow a compass to a giant obsidian structure. The guard places two chests so Wifies and Parrot can put their items in there again. They go into the obsidian maze, and discover that there are people in it. These people are Wemmbu and PrinceZam. Wemmbu finds them in the maze while they have nothing. Parrot and Wifies agree to lead Wemmbu to the next clue. However since Wemmbu didn't have the texture pack, it would be useless to him. After PrinceZam and Wemmbu get the jukebox and disc, Wifies and Parrot leave.

They go to PrinceZam's empire to see if they hid the disc, so they break into the vault and get the disc and a turtle egg using an auto stasis, although nearly dying in the process.. They escape into the nether, but Wemmbu and PrinceZam find them. They convince PrinceZam and Wemmbu to go into the overworld so they can team up, but after they go into the overworld, they mine out of the nether cave and escape.

They use a turtle egg to get to a shipwreck, where the guard signals them to put away their stuff. They’re given five water breathing potions, and a turtle shell. They go into the giant ship and use the clues they are given to discover an underground area covered with sculk, sculk sensors, and sculk shriekers. Luckily, wardens don’t spawn with man-made sculk shriekers, which allows them to obtain the next disc and a lodestone compass.

They travel to the coordinates the lodestone compass is pointing to, a jungle temple. They take the music disc and leave. The disc says to go to the a specific set of coordinates in the nether. The guard tells them to put away their items. They go through a nether portal which leads to an escape room with multiple wardens. They eventually manage to get out.

They find themselves in a badlands biome, however it’s enclosed in an obsidian box, and no mobs can spawn. They explore around the area, and find a couple of useful items. They also find a cave spider spawner. Using slime block launchers and blocks they obtained from underneath sugarcane, they are able to get into a new room. They go back into the badlands biome as they’re probably missing something. They come back with more wool blocks, and finally escape with their items.

Parrot and Wifies go back to Parrot’s house, where they find the guard, who reveals that they’re Spoke. Spoke says that only one person can uncover the secret, and that the other person will be banned off the server. He has them put all of their gear into chests. They go down two different staircases. They go head to head in six challenges. After these challenges are completed, they’re tied 3 - 3. The final game they play is chess. Spoke shows an area marked with a red line, which is a 
chunk ban
 for whoever loses. Parrot talks to Wifies and plans to end the game as a stalemate.

Parrot and Wifies go through with the plan, playing out the chess game and ending it with a stalemate. Spoke says that somebody has to be banned. 
Wifies
 steps on the red line, banning himself. Spoke reveals that there was no secret, and that his plan was to give him a close friend such as Wifies, just to ban him at the end. Wemmbu and the Zam Empire find Spoke and begin to chase him. Parrot tries to help them kill Spoke, however Spoke bans himself in the chunk ban before they can do it, with Wifies also stuck in that chunk ban.

Parrot and 
Rekrap2
 attempt to break into the prison which holds Wifies and Spoke, to get Wifies out. They get caught and have to eat a chorus fruit to escape.

Parrot and Rekrap plan to free one of Spoke's henchmen, so they go over to an end dimension chunk ban to try and free them. Parrot builds a TNT cannon to try and explode the chunk ban, but the TNT cannon explodes itself and the guards notice. The guards almost kill Parrot, but he's able to fly away and hide. He comes back to try and make a new TNT cannon, but the guards come back. Luckily, Parrot is invisible so he isn't caught. He quickly builds another TNT cannon, but again this one fails to break the chunk ban. Parrot builds another TNT cannon, but this time he’s caught. He flies away and escapes.

Parrot tries to convince PrinceZam to temporarily disable the chunk ban and let Wifies out, but he says no. Parrot and Rekrap start breaking into an underwater prison. Parrot and Rekrap spawn withers, and after a while, one of the withers collides with the chunk ban, destroying it, freeing Derapchu.

Parrot and Rekrap and Derapchu go over to the next prison, which is built in a jungle. They start breaking into the prison. They manage to explode the chunk ban using a TNT cannon.

While traveling to PrinceZam's empire, the server crashes. When they join, they are sent back to a previous save. It appears that PrinceZam had added a new defense which makes it so that the server crashes when getting too close to certain locations, called a 
memory ban
.

The team go to a nether prison, and try to break in. They discover that there are three chunk bans in this prison. They manage to destroy one of the chunk bans.

They move onto an ice themed prison. Using flying machines, they are able to free Fantst. Fantst agrees to join their team to break people out of prisons.

They go to a sky prison. They are able to destroy the chunk ban.

Fantst chunk bans himself as he thinks that the prisons will just get harder and harder, and will be impossible to break into.

They go to a new end prison and use TNT minecarts to destroy the chunk ban. The teammate has no interest of teaming with them. The team goes over to the first end prison they went to, and easily destroy the chunk bans using TNT minecarts. The player freed is JumperWho, who agrees to help them.

The team uses the nether to avoid the memory bans that crash the server. They find the prison that holds Spoke and Wifies and try to break in. They retreat back to their cave area to plan an escape. They figure out how they can chunk ban the guards. They set up an underground chunk ban setup, and have JumperWho lead the guards to the chunk ban. They manage to chunk ban all of the guards. Parrot is able to get 
_Kenadian_
 to help them break out Wifies using a wither bore. They kill the baby piglins which are holding chunk bans using flying machines and TNT minecarts. They are successful in breaking out Wifies. They also accidentally free Spoke.

It is implied that Parrot breaks everyone out of every other prison.

PrinceZam hires 
ClownPierce
 to kill Parrot.

ClownPierce tries to kill Parrot. He uses all of Parrot's totems, but then leaves and tells Parrot to meet him at his castle. Parrot meets ClownPierce at his 
castle
 and ClownPierce gives him five seconds to run away. Parrot is able to get away from ClownPierce.

Parrot and Wifies find ClownPierce in a carnival. This is where he plans to have a fair 1v1 with Parrot. Parrot and Wifies 2v1 ClownPierce. They get mining fatigue meaning that they cannot break out and have to fight ClownPierce. 
Leow0ok
, 
Willsion
, and 
Woogiex
, enemies of ClownPierce, break Parrot and Wifies out before they die. JumperWho and Derapchu are also teamed with them and are enemies of ClownPierce. They bring Parrot and Wifies to their base. Parrot and Wifies are sent to ClownPierce's castle to blow it up. Parrot manages to escape.

Leow0ok agrees to put Parrot in an obsidian vault as bait for ClownPierce. Wifies decides to go with him. 
ClownPierce
, 
FerreMC
, and 
Mugm_
 come over and try to break in and kill Parrot. A fight between people against and with ClownPierce ensues.

Inside of the obsidian vault is an escape room. Parrot and Wifies try to find the escape. They figure out how to make it through the first two layers of the escape room. ClownPierce and his team break in. Parrot and Wifies hide in the second layer of the escape room. ClownPierce and his team find the second layer. Parrot and Wifies find an exit labeled B5 and escape.

Parrot and Wifies go to Leow0ok and his team to complain about how they were abandoned in the vault. Afterwards, Wifies comes to his base and sees that ClownPierce blew up the terrain around it. Parrot flies away to 
Wemmbu's Civilization
. ClownPierce eventually leaves after being unable to find Parrot. ClownPierce overhears Wemmbu and Parrot trying to team, and starts killing Wemmbu's villagers for information. ClownPierce eventually leaves.

Parrot and Wifies train for fighting ClownPierce. Parrot, Wifies, and the players against ClownPierce set up chunk bans at his castle. The team ambushes ClownPierce and his team. Unable to kill anybody, Parrot and the team leave and go back to the base. They see that the base has been completely destroyed.

Parrot goes over to Wemmbu's civilization to get a better team. Wemmbu agrees to team with Parrot. Parrot helps Wemmbu build chunk bans around the colony to stop intruders such as ClownPierce. Wemmbu tells 
ManePear
 and 
Merffinn
 that Parrot is a part of the colony, who are both guards of PrinceZam. Later, 
FlameFrags
 and a team of people come to destroy Wemmbu's colony. The invisible player in the fight is likely 
ClownPierce
. After the war, Parrot parts ways with Wemmbu and the colony.

Parrot comes back and convinces Leow0ok's team to help him kidnap Branzy, as he’s the only person ClownPierce cares about. They go to negotiate with ClownPierce now that they have Branzy. FerreMC comes back with Wifies as a hostage. Parrot agrees to let Branzy go, and ClownPierce lets Wifies go.

Parrot leaves to a jungle and starts building a base there. Wifies is able to find Parrot. He tries to convince him to come back and defeat ClownPierce. ClownPierce and FerreMC find his jungle base and destroy it. Parrot runs away.

Parrot comes back to Wemmbu's empire and sees it is destroyed. He goes over to ClownPierce's castle with the team, and starts destroying his castle. He tells ClownPierce he wants to 1v1 him in a fight. Parrot goes over to Branzy's base to kill him, but changes his mind after talking with Branzy.

Parrot fights ClownPierce in a 1v1. He had secretly made a trap with 30,000 TNT. Parrot is unable to kill ClownPierce with his trap. Parrot discovers ClownPierce blew up the headquarters secret meeting room.

Parrot discovers a book in his house. The book says to meet him at specific coordinates, and it has been written by ClownPierce. He thinks this book might have the answers to why certain players have disappeared from the server. Parrot and Wifies go to these coordinates and find two players, 
Jaden_MAN
 and 
Spongs
, who call themselves the game masters. They state that for the quest, they can only use items that they give them, and they cannot cheat. They tell them to get a heart of the sea and bring it back to them. They can only use iron gear for this. They go into an underwater trial and are able to get a lodestone compass.

Kierrrr
 and 
Its_Dev_
 find them while they follow the lodestone compass. They try to intercept the hunt, but Parrot and Wifies escape using invisibility. Parrot and 
Wifies
 find two ships which appear to be ClownPierce themed. They use the clue they find at the ships which say to go to where the winds meet. They find an escape room and quickly solve it and obtain the heart of the sea. They realize that Derapchu's most prized possession is a heart of the sea, meaning that each item will probably correlate to one of the missing players.

The next quest is to get a pair of netherite boots, which would make sense because netherite boots are one of 
JumperWho’s
 most prized possessions. They find a giant mountain which leads into the clouds, and go inside. They are given five tasks to help the town in the sky, which are found in a book. 
Kierrrr
 and 
Its_Dev_
 find them again. Parrot edits the book to get rid of some clues, and then gives the book to them. After they do all the tasks, they tell 
Kierrrr
 and 
Its_Dev_
 that the hot air balloons are in an arrow, and that they have to follow the arrow. This is a lie. After they leave, they figure out that by flicking a certain lever, it activates a bunch of flying machines which look like flying lanterns.

After finding the netherite boots, they go to 
Boosfer
, who is the leader of Kierrrr and Its_Dev_. They try to convince Boosfer not to steal these items, but he doesn’t listen. They leave.

The next quest is to get a poppy. They find a giant field of flowers, and they have to find which one is the poppy. They eventually find the poppy. They accidentally dig under the poppy and find a giant underground forest. They find a very long cave and follow it. It’s made out of only stone.

Eventually they find a valley. Following the valley, they find a giant tree. Inside of the tree, they find an escape room. After solving the escape room, they get a riddle. As they read that, Boosfer, Kierrrr, and Its_Dev_ come over to the tree and start destroying it. They see Parrot in leather armor, so Parrot runs away and hides. They are able to find Parrot and Wifies.

Parrot gives them a fake riddle. They figure out that it’s a fake riddle, but Wifies has already secured the item in his ender chest. They realize this is Rekrap2’s base. 
Boosfer
 and his team leave. Parrot and Rekrap figure out this is a save haven for the passive animals, so they start to move all the animals out. While moving the animals, they find multiple giant TNT bomber planes coming. This is because Boosfer paid Wemmbu to destroy the valley. After moving the animals in the mountains so they don’t get blown up, they build up using melon blocks.

Using melon blocks, they try to stop the planes. Wemmbu finds them and they agree to team up to steal Boosfer and his team’s items.

Parrot and Wifies go to the next quest, and they find a sculk themed escape room. They make it through the escape room and find a cave. After following the cave, they find an ancient city. The clue says that the key to the vault is the heart of a warden. This implies they have to kill a warden. They plan to use dripstone to kill the warden. After killing it, they make it through the vault and get a diamond. They put the diamond in the item frame at the base, however Kierrrr and Its_Dev_ find the diamond and steal it, along with all of their items.

Wemmbu, Parrot, and Wifies go to the headquarters to blow it up. They build an orbital cannon to destroy the base. After flying to the base, they activate the orbital cannon, completely destroying the top layer of the base. They use TNT and spawn withers to destroy the base. Wemmbu finds a stash of netherite blocks and diamond blocks and they steal all the items.

In the nether, Parrot and Wifies find a bunch of nether quartz which appears to be morse code. Once translated, it says 090.256 rurple. They go to the next coordinates and find a sign that says 840.32 cyan. They next find a chest which has items in it. They find that the items in the chest probably mean 670.5 brown. They find a sign under lava that says 960.18 pink. On the nether roof they find a sign saying 390.43 blue. They find a giant castle and go inside using striders. They use the codes they found to find books in the castle. After finding all the books, they bring it to the vault and input the books. In the vault they find the item, a wither rose.

They move onto the next quest, which is to go to the end. They go to the end with almost no items. In the end, they find an escape room-like obstacle course. After finishing the course, the book they find says “+ +”. They end up finding an end city, and inside is Wifies prized dragon head. Right before going through the end portal to escape, they find Kierrrr and Its_Dev_. They try to kill Parrot and Wifies, but they escape to the outer end islands. They get gear from end cities to try and kill the dragon to escape. They find an ender chest and get their gear from the ender chest, and escape the end.

Parrot and Wifies go back to the base, and find ClownPierce. They ask ClownPierce why people have been missing, but he says he doesn’t know. Parrot puts his last item, the spyglass, in the item frame.

Parrot and Wifies are trapped by ClownPierce in a prison called 
Proton
. Inside of the prison, they are given a small world with resources in it. They purposefully went into the prison to try and break some of their friends out. They realize no mobs are spawning in the prison. Wifies tries to go to a specific green section of the prison, but when he walks into the area, he gets chunk banned. The guard moves him into a hallway leading into a new cell of the prison. Rekrap gets transferred into the same room of the prison as Parrot. They find a house with a sign saying that JumperWho and Derapchu were here.

Wifies is un-chunk banned. Parrot realizes that the /msg command does not work because if you try to send a message, you get kicked from the server. When normally chatting, the messages do not show up in chat.

Parrot is transferred to the next prison. He finds _Kenadian_. Kenadian says he doesn’t know who designed the prison, but Parrot gets suspicious of him and Kenadian admits he designed the prison.

Parrot is transferred to the next room, which has Derapchu. They make maps to try and communicate. The guard transfers him to the next prison.
