title: ParrotX2/Relationships
content:
"
Till we meet again, friend.
"
This article contains major spoilers from recently released episodes. Please proceed with caution.


Relationships


Wifies


Wifies
 was formerly Parrot's best friend. After helping him with a plethora of tasks, such as breaking people out of prison, creating the 
End Civilization
 together, and more. This changed after Wifies faked his death, as he would go on to become the 
Director
. Wifies did a lot of immoral things as the Director, causing Parrot to highly dislike Wifies after learning about his new identity. Wifies trapped Parrot in a miniature world where they could build, and have fun together, called 
Paragon
.

Parrot still showed that he likely at least cared a little for Wifies still, even when Wifies died. When Wifies died, Parrot sighed. He also went back to get the spyglass that they were known for having, after he dropped it off of a building. Parrot still tried to kill Wifies multiple times unsuccessfully while he was in Paragon, however, after being led to a white room with quartz pillars and two pressure plates in the middle of a circle, Parrot was forced onto the pressure plates and Wifies said that stepping off would kill both of them by blowing up. Unfortunately for Wifies, Parrot had the spyglass. Using the spyglass, Parrot was able to step off and leave the chamber, where he would die to TNT.



DeanTheBean9


DeanTheBean was one of Parrot's best friends. They got to know each other during 
I Built Minecraft's Safest Civilization
 when Wifies and Parrot uncovered his identity by removing his invisibility with a trap. After some talking Parrot decided to allow Dean to join the civilization. After finding out about Dean's condition where if his invisibility ran out, he would get sent into the void, Parrot saves his life by telling him to set another stasis and the moment his stasis gets pulled they pull his second stasis. DeanTheBean would explore the server with Parrot and Wifies until their relationship drastically changed when it was revealed that he was helping the 
Mafia
 find his location when they were looking for the Far Lands Civilization. Parrot and Dean's relationship was slowly built back up, however, he unfortunately died due since he rejoined The Mafia and his invisibility was removed upon his totem popping. Dean's death had one of the largest effects on Parrot which led him to believe some players are just inherently evil. An example of this is when he tried to kill Ashswagg even though if he did every single player in the Mafia would die. He was only stopped because some of his friends were in the Mafia but then hated every single Mafia member including his former friends. He was disgusted when his friends 
R4trick
 & 
F1nlo
 joined the Mafia and ranked up even though they probably did not have a choice. 



Wemmbu


Wemmbu and Parrot met each other in Parrot's debut video where Wemmbu showed Parrot the crater. Since that they weren't really close, usually rivaling each other like during the 
PrinceZam Empire Arc
. In the Mafia arc, the two worked together in the 
District 13
 to defeat the Mafia. 

After that they don't talk for a while until Parrot starts to hunt Wemmbu down. Parrot was impersonating Wemmbu when Wemmbu met him. Their relationship doesn't get any better due to Wemmbu killing his pet Happy Ghast Sky, after exposing Wemmbu's identity, they split ways on bad terms. During the Kings/Election Arc (Kings for Wemmbu, Election for Parrot, check the arcs naming) Parrot was looking for Wemmbu and requested him to go back to spawn to expose LettuceK for his lies.

On the way back Wemmbu threatened to kill Parrot after boxing him up to which Eggchan stops him and they go back to spawn. They expose Lettuce they split ways again. They meet up again with Flame and Spoke and they defeat the Law, after that Wemmbu and Eggchan leave.



FlameFrags


Season 1


Flame is featured in Parrot's 
I Got Hunted by Minecraft's Deadliest Players
 attacking 
Wemmbu's Civilization
. 

In 
Unstable SMP: The First War
, Flame kills 
Dimofyy
 forcing Parrot and the remains of Dimofyy's squadron to think strategically to escape him. 



Season 2


In 
The Hunt for Minecraft's Deadliest Vault
, Flame goes to the nether and there he meets Parrot and 
TheobaldTheBird
. They team up and capture 
ClownPierce
's right-hand man 
FerreMC
. Flame betrays Parrot and tells Clown the location of where they're at for information about 
Wemmbu
. Upon arriving there, Clown tells Flame he doesn't know any information and upon hearing this, Flame betrays Clown giving  time for Parrot and Theo to escape and find Clown's nether vault. After raiding the vault, Parrot and Theo return to 
Capital City
 and their potion shop. Flame goes to their potion shop and gives Parrot a proposition. Find 
Wemmbu
 and in return he'll give them the coordinates of the tomb of 
The Invisible Mafia
.

In 
The Search for Wemmbu
, Parrot impersonates 
Wemmbu
 to gather intel about him and has a suspicion that The Invisible Knight was 
Wemmbu
. Parrot traps 
Wemmbu
 in the Capital City coutroom but since Flame was preoccupied, 
Wemmbu
 escapes. Then Parrot constructs an elaborate plan to trap 
Wemmbu
 in the same type of box to give him a false sense of security and for Theo to drain him of all resources. But when 
Wemmbu
 takes the pearl cannon he is teleported into the box where Parrot and Flame was waiting. 
Wemmbu
  tries to elytra mace them but he misses a wind charge that goes through the powdered snow then through lava igniting the projectile that ignited TNT. The TNT explodes and kills a group of tamed wolves and since 
Wemmbu
 threw the projectile, it says it was blown up by him. In return for all of Parrot's work, Flame drops Parrot a book with the exact location of the tomb  of the mafia. 



SpokeIsHere


Spoke and Parrot are currently close friends, but that wasn't always the case. In the beginning of Season 1, Spoke put Parrot and Wifies in a scavenger hunt and eventually chunk banned Wifies as a form of revenge towards Parrot for attempting to stop the destruction of 
The Wonders
.  

Parrot and Spoke became friends during the 
The Invisible Mafia Arc
 when they put their beef aside and teamed up to destroy The Mafia. When Spoke was about to destory 
Capital City
 because he believed his friend, 
Mapicc
 had died, Parrot told him to stop which had led to him continuing to find Mapicc instead of trying to make others' lives miserable.

Though currently, their relationship isn't as good as right now



TheobaldTheBird


Parrot and Theo met in 
Unstable SMP: The First War
 in the 
Far Lands civilization
. They were both part of the 
Warriors District
 and they worked together. Theo helped Parrot become the leader of the Warriors District and ended the dispute between the Warriors District and the Farming District. After The Mafia destroys the Far Lands civilization, Parrot creates District 13, however, Theo leaves District 13 due to the fact that they made minimal progress against The Mafia. 

They reunited when Theo saved him from two withers at spawn. Parrot thanked him for saving his life, so they teamed up together because Parrot knew that Theo would protect him at all costs. After him getting saved, he and Theo went to the nearest city, 
Capital City
, and created a potion shop there where both could get stacked. They also went on Treasure quests in the 
Great Sea
 and 
Verdaria
. They currently remain as best friends since their reunion.



Ashswagg


Ashswagg
 was the leader of the 
The Invisible Mafia Arc
 where he dragged people into becoming invisible knights who worked for him, and him only. Whoever didn't agree to work for him was killed, whoever got their identity revealed got thrown into the void. Parrot however, didn't agree with this high-stakes game and decided that he wanted to put an end to all of it. 
Ashswagg
 was also the person who had dragged many of Parrotx2's friends away from him, causing the death of 
Deanthebean9
, one of Parrotx2's close friends. The Invisible Mafia, led by 
Ashswagg
 on Unstable SMP were eventually defeated when a resistance alliance destroyed their ender pearls, with many members disbanded or killed following the destruction of their leader’s power base.



Leow0ok


Parrot and 
Leow0ok
 have a primarily antagonistic, high-stakes relationship, frequently interacting as enemies or rivals. Leow0ok tried to kill Parrot while they were part of different, often conflicting groups. But during the The Director Arc, they worked together in 
Bounty Assassin Team
 or BAT (formerly) to find the true identity of The Director aka 
Wifies
.  Leow0ok sometimes did not like Parrot because of how he did not accept his teammates or his mistakes. During The LAW arc, Parrot did not care about Leow0ok at all and fought him as an enemy to the end. It seems like he either does not know of his death or simply does not care for his former friend.



PrinceZam


Parrot's first encounter with PrinceZam was during the scavenger hunt Spoke had sent him out to finish with Wifies. 

They then worked together to chunkban Spoke, but Wifies was also trapped. Parrot tried convincing him to disable the chunk ban for 60 seconds, but he failed, causing him to break open every chunkban.

On the Unstable SMP, 
PrinceZam
 and Parrot generally hold a contentious, adversarial relationship characterized by power struggles, prison breaks, and mutual sabotage. Their conflict often involves Parrot breaking into PrinceZam’s secure prisons and sabotaging his projects (like stealing from his "
Kings/Election Arc
" initiatives), while Zam hires others to eliminate Parrot. 



LettuceK


Parrot and LettuceK were rivals during 
The Kings Arc
. While LettuceK (an antagonist) favors strict, organized control, Parrot represents a "Big Good" figure focused on empowering others, creating tension between their methods. During 
The Kings Arc
, Parrot was forced to go to prison by 
LettuceK
 because so Lettuce can be king of the Unstable SMP. However, he refound a rebellion called District 13, ultimately managing to beat Lettuce in the final showdown. His realisation at the vault of The Mafia was one of the things that led him to believe that no player is inherently evil. For this reason he spares Lettuce but still hates him.

Pirate City
, formerly known as 
Ranger Point
 is a massive marine-style complex located in the center of the 
Great Sea
. It is where 
Jaden
 develops his 
Pirate Civilization
.



History


Wemmbu
, disguised as Invisible Knight, and Jaden attempted to take over the base. However, they were both outnumbered and out-geared, forcing them to flee using a riptide trident. 

Parrot
 and 
Theo
 also broke in, and were captured and placed in the "Lobster Cage", before escaping.

Wemmbu killed 
TheLobsterMan
 in a 1v1, leaking his name to Jaden. He allowed Jaden to rebuild his Pirate Civilization. Jaden took over the base and transform it into a pirate outpost.

Jaden turned the outpost into a civilization of pirates, i.e. Pirate City. He rescued Wemmbu and leads him there.

LettuceK
 threatened to blow up the island with an 
Orbital Strike Cannon
. Wemmbu was able to destroy the orbital, but Pirate Civilization were abandoned, due to a large amount of attacks by LettuceK.

A large army led by Jaden was captured by 
the Law
. Due to high casualties the Law abandons its campaign to take over the Great Sea.

Jaden was freed and The Law was destroyed. Jaden probably returned to his position of power in the Great Sea.

The 
Pirates
 is a faction of bandits that formerly robbed civilizations and players. The team was led by 
Jaden_MAN
. After 
Wemmbu
 and Jaden took over 
Ranger Point
, Jaden developed Pirates into his 
Pirate Civilization
.



History


TheobaldTheBird
 is seen with a pirates shield. 

Wemmbu and Eggchan tried to make a civilization. They got invaded by The Pirates. Wemmbu kills the majority of its members. Wemmbu follows Spongs and after he returns to his civilization, it was blown up and Eggchan is held hostage. Wemmbu cleared his inventory (and Echest) as ordered by Jaden but he kept 
one of his maces
 in his Echest. 

Wemmbu and Eggchan were taken to the Pirate Islands. They were chased by members of the Pirates. Theo secretly helped Wemmbu with invisibility potions, and a trident. Jaden fled into a hole which leads to an abandoned civilization. 

Jaden was imprisoned by Wemmbu in 
an abandoned civilization
 and forced to return 
Wemmbu's other mace
.

Jaden used his Pirates to fight 
Flame
.

Jaden created a large castle. The castle was destroyed by Wemmbu. 

Wemmbu, as Invisible Knight, helped Jaden conquer 
Ranger Point
 which led to the rebirth of the Pirates as an important faction, Pirate Civilization.

However, during 
Wemmbu
's video, 
Unstable SMP: The Battle for The Great Sea
, the Pirates were completely wiped out in a battle with 
the Law
 with almost all members killed. The rest of the population of The Great Sea like DaFraDo
[
1
]
 were probably flagged as Pirates by the Law and are ruthlessly killed. 
LettuceK
 showed this when he killed innocent players at Frog Island. Other outposts occupied by Jaden's Pirates or other pirate factions were likely to have the same fate. However, even though all the Pirates were dead and Jaden was captured, Wemmbu finished the mission to destroy the 
Orbital Strike Cannon
 that LettuceK and the Law had built. The Pirates were then Inactive without any members surviving from the Battle and Jaden being captured.

After Jaden was released and the Law defeated, he probably went back to 
Pirate City
 and rebuilt his civilization. But this is speculation. Also this is supported by the fact that Wemmbu called the king of the pirates in the 4v4 fight.

PlanetLord
, or simply 
Planet
, is a supporting character featured in 
Unstable Universe
. He is a teammate of 
SpokeIsHere
 and 
Mapicc
.



History


Season 1


PlanetLord is guarding a skybase. Spoke comes to the skybase and destroys the duped items using an orbital cannon, despite PlanetLord trying to stop him.

PlanetLord is seen at an end base.

Spoke and Mapicc find a stash of what he thinks are duped items. He finds the chests are empty. A player named PlanetLord comes in and they try to kill him as he places shulker boxes which appear to be duped because they have identical items in all of them. PlanetLord is able to escape.

Spoke and Mapicc see 
Roshambogames
 and PlanetLord at a flower farm. 
The Mafia
 destroys the entire farm with TNT. 

Spoke and Mapicc find PlanetLord. The Mafia comes over and tries to kill them. They trap the Mafia players using a sand trap, though none of them die. They are able to escape.

Mapicc is captured by the Mafia. PlanetLord introduces 
Baconnwaffles0
 and 
TheRealSquiddo
 to 
MinuteTech
, a friend of Spoke. A Mafia member named 
BobDaGreenFrog
 tries to kill them, and baconnwaffles0 runs away. MinuteTech kills the Mafia member. The Mafia starts trying to kill them again. They mysteriously give MinuteTech a book, to which MinuteTech replies "no". The Mafia continues attacking them. Spoke is able to escape, though he almost dies.

TheRealSquiddo shows the team some coordinates that she was given that could be the coordinates to a Mafia outpost. She also states that everybody in the master builders group has disappeared. She says she was commissioned to do a build by an anonymous player.

The team goes over to an outpost and find a large amount of invisible players. MinuteTech messages the team to run away after being handed a book.

PlanetLord and Spoke discover that 
JamatoP
’s base is destroyed. Spoke and PlanetLord try to dupe items in the base, but realize that it doesn’t work anymore. 
Ashswagg
, the leader of the Mafia, comes in and reveals that all the glitches and exploits were patched, and that Jamato told him so. Ashswagg reveals that MinuteTech was working for him, and orders him to kill Spoke and PlanetLord. Spoke and PlanetLord escape.

Spoke and PlanetLord go under one of the wonders where they put weaponless mobs. They find that the mobs are named coordinates. They find a replica of Jamato’s base made out of wood, and all of the glitched features have been removed. He finds a book stating that if he is reading the book, he is captured or dead. It states he has exiled himself, that he has been hunted by the Mafia, that he was captured in an outpost, and that there is an item that can fix everything. They find a compass that is named “The Mafia”.

Following the compass, they find a Mafia outpost. They see Mafia members in a room. They go above the players and drop dripstone on them, killing one of the players and using the totem of undying of another player named 
Leow0ok
. Leow0ok agrees to team with them, and reveals he is only in the Mafia hire teammates to help him kill 
ClownPierce
. The outpost starts exploding. They follow a member of the Mafia to 
Mafia City
, where there are different tiers of Mafia members. They find Mapicc in a prison and break him out.

Spoke and the team are tasked to kill 
ParrotX2
 but fails. Ashswagg kills one of the members who was helping them. They run away. They are then tasked with guarding a vault. 
ManePear
 and 
Wemmbu
 start trying to break into the vault.

The team is now tasked to get diamonds. Ashswagg promotes them to gold tier.

The team is tasked with killing PlanetLord, but they do not kill him. Ashswagg talks to them. He orders ClownPierce to kill the Mafia members until whoever let PlanetLord go steps up. Spoke steps up and says he did it. They are dismissed.

Ashswagg tells Spoke that to become a diamond player, he will have to fight a diamond player that ashswagg assigns to him.

Spoke and the team come up with a plan to kill ashswagg. He starts fighting a diamond player to become diamond. Spoke’s totem of undying is used during the fight, revealing to ashswagg that he is Spoke. They try to kill ashswagg but he escapes by using a stasis chamber. The diamond player reveals he’s MinuteTech.



Season 2


Spoke borrows a snowy fox from PlanetLord.

PlanetLord helps Spoke raid a secret base owned by 
Yeah_Jaron
 and 
Reddoons
.

PlanetLord is seen competing in the trial to become a member of 
BAT
.



Season 3


PlanetLord is seen in the 
Far Lands
 leading a group of chainmail players. He helped 
Spoke
 and 
Jumper
 but was later captured by 
Null Hunters
 and presumably killed or sent through nether portal

Don't speculate about personal IRL stuff

PrinceZam to

, in

About


PrinceZam
, also known simply as 
Zam
, is a supporting character in 
Unstable Universe
. She was one of the two secondary antagonists (alongside 
FlameFrags
) in Season 1. He serves as the tritagonist of Spoke's 
BAT Arc
.   

He was the former ruler of the 
Zam Empire
, a faction that once thrived on influence and control. Early in the server, Prince Zam and 
Wemmbu
 had a very strong alliance, however Zam's paranoia and need for control ultimately led to him betraying Wemmbu. The Wemmbu Arc spanned several episodes, with Zam constantly obsessing over chasing Wemmbu down, then letting him escape and forcing Wemmbu to live in fear. This conflict comes to a head after Wemmbu detonates an Orbital Strike Cannon against Zam, when ClownPierce imprisons them together for entertainment. Zam and Wemmbu are forced to work together, and they become close again, although they are never truly allies again.  

Despite its earlier prominence, the Zam Empire ultimately fell, leading to its dissolution following internal and external conflicts, including opposition from notable figures like 
Wemmbu
, 
ClownPierce
 and 
Reddoons
. This collapse marked a significant turning point in Zam's arc within the server's story.



Personality


PrinceZam is known for her ambitious and tenacious nature, aiming to consolidate power and secure dominance through strategic planning and fortifications, such as the infamous wall that led to discord among other factions and various prisons where he chunkbanned many of his enemies. Zam's leadership showcased both determination and an ability to command respect, even amidst controversy. Zam is also characterized by an intense need for control of both her citizens and the full server, as well as extreme paranoia and concern over people who potentially pose a threat to the Empire. 



History


SpokeIsHere
 helps 
Mapicc
 steal from 
Zam Empire
. PrinceZam now wants to ban Spoke.

Wemmbu agrees to team with PrinceZam to kill Spoke. A war between people against and with PrinceZam starts as they are talking.

PrinceZam and Wemmbu interrogate 
TheRealSquiddo
 and threaten to chunk ban her if she doesn’t give information on Spoke. They check her barrels and find out that she has glitched items. She says that she did make a build in the end dimension, and DMs Wemmbu the coordinates. PrinceZam chunk bans TheRealSquiddo.

Parrot and Wifies go to PrinceZam’s base as a clue in a scavenger hunt set up by Spoke. Parrot and Wifies see Wemmbu, who questions them about a "disc" that they were talking about. Parrot says that Spoke left something at his base and that Spoke claims there’s a server secret, and they’re trying to find the next clue. PrinceZam comes over to them. PrinceZam says that they should give them all the information they found, however they don’t oblige. Parrot and Wifies fly away over to the castle and start exploring it while Wemmbu tries to kill them. Eventually they escape by flying out, and Wemmbu loses them.

Wemmbu and PrinceZam decide to go to the stronghold to get to the end base that TheRealSquiddo was talking about. Once they were there, they see there are three Spoke guards at the stronghold, 
RealReeon
, 
Sharkilz_
,  and Mapicc. They dig down to the stronghold, and make their way to the portal room. They find the guards and start fighting them. They flee to the end, except for RealReeon. They chunk ban RealReeon. They go into the end and start flying to the coordinates that the end base is at. They break into the base and start killing Spoke and his guards. Spoke is able to escape before being chunk banned.

Wemmbu and PrinceZam leave to the overworld to get some materials. This includes getting a mace. After going to the trial chambers and getting a heavy core, other people go into the trial chamber and see it’s already looted. Wemmbu and PrinceZam hide. The people who break into the trail chamber are Mapicc, Fantst, Arcn, Only_A_Squid, and Sharooh, all enemies of the Zam empire. Mapicc finds them and they start fighting.

Wemmbu escapes the fight and crafts a mace. PrinceZam escapes to the surface, and Wemmbu uses the mace to try and kill some of the players. All of the people flee the fight by running or using stasis chambers. Arcn is chunk banned by PrinceZam. They use the arrows that they left on the ground and a strategy with TNT to try and find the location of Spoke. They find a base that 
Only_A_Squid
 is at. They chunk ban Only_A_Squid.

They use the second arrow to find 
Fantst
 and 
Sharooh
. Fantst runs away and they chunk ban Sharooh. They find an obsidian box, and inside is the player Mapicc. Spoke and his teammates come in and start to fight Wemmbu and PrinceZam. PrinceZam’s armor all breaks, and he almost dies. Spoke and his team run away because PrinceZam holds a chunk ban.

Wemmbu and PrinceZam use an arrow to find an obsidian maze. They find two chests with peoples stuff inside of them. They hear Parrot in the maze. This is because Parrot and 
Wifies
 followed a clue left by Spoke which lead them to the maze. A guard who was there signaled for them to put all of their items in chests for no advantages in the maze. He eventually finds Parrot and Wifies who have no items. They agree to lead Wemmbu to the clue, however, because Wemmbu and PrinceZam don’t have the texture pack that goes along with the hunt, they would not be able to get any use out of it. Wemmbu gets a turtle egg and music disc from the chest. Wifies and Parrot get their stuff and leave the maze. 

Wemmbu and PrinceZam realize that they need a texture pack and begin chasing Wifies and Parrot, however they’ve already escaped. Wemmbu and PrinceZam store the disc and turtle egg in a vault.

They follow an arrow to an underwater base. They find Sharkilz_ and chunk ban him. The base explodes which gets rid of the chunk ban, meaning that Sharkilz_ is unbanned because the chunk ban is exploded. Fantst now comes to help Sharkilz_ kill Wemmbu and PrinceZam. They chunk ban Fantst and Sharkilz_.

Wemmbu and PrinceZam are teleported to the vault, where Parrot and Wifies are stealing the music disc and turtle egg. Wemmbu starts killing them, and they manage to fly away and escape. Parrot and Wifies dig down and go into the nether, however Wemmbu and PrinceZam find them in the nether, since they unluckily spawned in a nether cave. Parrot gives Wemmbu and PrinceZam the disc. Parrot says that to find Spoke they need a turtle egg, as baby turtles always go back to their home beach. They agree to team up, however after Wemmbu and PrinceZam go into the overworld to team up, Parrot and Wifies mine away and escape.

The Zam Empire finds and tries to kill Spoke. Parrot is also trying to kill Spoke with them, as Spoke had just chunk banned Wifies. Spoke goes into the puzzle area that Parrot and Wifies were in, and start chasing him. Before they can kill Spoke, he chunk bans himself, with Wifies also stuck in the chunk ban.

Parrot and Rekrap try to convince PrinceZam to disable the chunk ban for one minute so that they can let Wifies out. PrinceZam says no. Parrot breaks into all of his prisons.

PrinceZam hires ClownPierce to kill Parrot as he broke all of his prisons.

PrinceZam gives Wemmbu the task making 
a civilization
 to guard a vault. It turns out this is just a plan by PrinceZam to get rid of Wemmbu. The vault contains nothing.

Wemmbu goes to his 
Orbital Strike Cannon
 to try and destroy PrinceZam’s empire, but sees the orbital cannon has been blown up. Wemmbu and 
eggchan
 go back to spawn and see that the Zam empire has built a giant PrinceZam statue at spawn.

Wemmbu and eggchan discover that PrinceZam has started taking over the spawn. Once Wemmbu and eggchan are far enough from the Zam empire, 
ManePear
 tells them that he’s not a big fan of being a guard of PrinceZam, and that if they need help, he can help him.

Wemmbu and eggchan blow up the PrinceZam statue at spawn.

Wemmbu and his civilization try to use an orbital strike cannon to destroy the Zam Empire, but see that they’ve put a sheet of obsidian above the entire empire meaning that they can’t use the orbital cannon. They decide to try and break into the empire and kill PrinceZam. They are unable to kill PrinceZam. Wemmbu is able to escape.

Wemmbu convinces ManePear to betray the Zam Empire.

ManePear distracts yungwillx by talking to him while Wemmbu sets up a trap at his base. Wemmbu comes into the base invisible and pretends to be ManePear. He sets off the trap, but it fails to kill him. Yungwillx gets PrinceZam, 
Merffinn
, and 
Peentar
 on to help him survive. All of yungwillx’s armor breaks, so Wemmbu and ManePear take him hostage. They leave a message at Peentar’s house with instructions for him. They take Peentar hostage. 

While they are taking 
Sorhin
 hostage, the Zam Empire breaks out yungwillx and Peentar. The entire Zam Empire destroys Wemmbu's civilization. They trap Wemmbu in an obsidian box and they watch ManePear and FlameFrags fight. ManePear’s armor breaks, so he stops fighting. They both run away, but then realize that the Zam Empire took eggchan.

PrinceZam takes down the obsidian sheet protecting the Zam Empire. Wemmbu goes over to PrinceZam, with no armor, and they imprison Wemmbu. Wemmbu picks up 36 cakes, which normally shows he has no items in his inventory, but uses the crafting menu to store extra items to smuggle in four items. He uses the orbital cannon which lags the server, giving him enough time to give eggchan full netherite armor from his ender chest to escape. They break out of the prison. Wemmbu destroys the Zam Empire. ClownPierce comes and takes PrinceZam and Wemmbu to a prison.

PrinceZam and Wemmbu are trapped in a miniature version of the normal world with only three totems. PrinceZam tries to kill Wemmbu, but he’s able to escape, though PrinceZam uses three of Wemmbu’s totems.

Wemmbu and eggchan find PrinceZam to ask him if he found any lava, but PrinceZam starts attacking them. They run away.

PrinceZam and Pangi find Wemmbu and eggchan. They start fighting, but because they have better armor, Wemmbu and eggchan run away. They escape by digging underground. They find a slime chunk under PrinceZam’s base. They’re able to get enchantments by fishing.

ClownPierce sends his guard into the prison to try and kill them, and says that if you pop the guards totem, they’re teleported out. The guard teleported in is 
FerreMC
. PrinceZam and Wemmbu agree to co-exist to kill Ferre. Wemmbu and eggchan sees that they somehow got obsidian. Pangi goes to the nether, but gets chunk banned.

Wemmbu and eggchan build a creeper farm, but it doesn’t work. They go over to PrinceZam to ask why the creeper farm isn’t working, and see he has villagers. They ask how PrinceZam got obsidian, and he says that completing a raid can give obsidian. PrinceZam helps them diagnose the problem with their creeper farm. ClownPierce uses an orbital strike cannon to destroy PrinceZam’s base because of Pangi going to the nether to escape. PrinceZam thinks this is Wemmbu’s fault, so he tries to kill him. PrinceZam stops trying to kill him realizing that Wemmbu is better at PvP than him. He convinces PrinceZam to give Wemmbu his looting sword. Wemmbu and eggchan leave. Wemmbu comes back to his base and sees it is destroyed by the orbital cannon.

PrinceZam goes over to Wemmbu’s base and tries to kill him. PrinceZam now has maxed enchanted diamond armor. Wemmbu shows PrinceZam that if he gets close to killing him, ClownPierce will interrupt it. He proves this by taking off all his armor, and ClownPierce plays a sound saying that the next round of juggernaut is going to happen. PrinceZam and Wemmbu agree to team again to escape the prison. They use a TNT minecart to activate Ferre’s totem of undying, so he gets teleported out. ClownPierce says that he now knows about a potential escape plan.

A bunch of new members are put into the prison and PrinceZam tries to recruit them. These players include 
_Kenadian_
, 
SykerMC
, 
loppezz
, 
LuckyMixx
, 
Dol9hin
, and 
Spepticle
.

PrinceZam and his teammates comes over to Wemmbu and try to kill them. Eventually they leave. Wemmbu and his team set up a stasis chamber using honey. Wemmbu puts his pearl in the stasis chamber. ClownPierce starts activating people’s stasis chambers to trap them in the prison. Wemmbu is the only one who is able to escape using an ender pearl cannon.

Wemmbu and PrinceZam are trapped by ClownPierce in an escape room made by 
Wato1876
. They are eventually able to escape.

He is imprisoned by 
The Law
 ran by 
LettuceK
 but is broken out by 
SpokeIsHere
.

He joins Spoke out of debt and helps him attempt to get revenge on 
Leowo0k
. This fails and he leaves with 
Wemmbu.


He helps Spoke find 
Mapicc
 and then helps him get revenge on Leo again.

They construct an army, 
District 13
 (v2), with the help of 
JumperWho
 and her 
spies
 to defeat LAW and the remainder of BAT.



Boundaries


Shipping is okay (as long as it follows cc boundaries, no self-shipping/shipping with oc)


No NSFW


Trivia


PrinceZam is the actor for one of the members of 
Quackenstein
's village, 
TrucksAndTrains
. She showed this on a tweet.


Zam revealed in “
I Almost Got BANNED from the Unstable SMP…
” that she ran off to the Farlands during/post-Mafia arc.


Zam mentioned in a stream called Lifesteal SMP My Full Power** that she left Unstable for an undisclosed reason.

Escaping Proton: Minecraft's Most Secure Prison










Nothing is certain here except for one thing— once you're inside, there's no escape. But I promise that someday, somehow, I'm gonna break out.



ParrotX2
, 
Escaping Proton: Minecraft's Most Secure Prison


Proton
 was a prison built in 
Unstable Universe
 designed to hold many players at once. This prison was made for 
ClownPierce
’s entertainment, as he wanted to see what players would do when faced with it.



History


Escaping Proton: Minecraft's Most Secure Prison


Kenadian designs the prison. The prison is built and 
Eggchan
, 
ParrotX2
, 
Kenadian
, 
Wifies
, 
JumperWho
, 
Derapchu
, and 
Rekrap2
 are trapped in it.

They managed to escape the prison with help from 
Leow0ok
 and 
Wemmbu
. 

Kenadian
 is still trapped in the prison but they teleport him out using an ender pearl stasis chamber hidden in Kenadian’s base. 



Design


The prison is made of three main rings. Each ring is circle shaped and large, about the size of a biome. The cell is basically normal Minecraft terrain, except there was no sand or lava. On the borders of each cell are chunk-banned walls. There were only a few spots that sometimes had an inactive chunk ban, and they are hallways connecting the three cells. In the middle of the three rings is the control tower, and outside of all of it, are chunk-banned crying obsidian walls so thick that it goes outside render distance.

The hallways connecting the three cells are usually chunk-banned at the entrance, and the chunk bans are only temporary turned off when the prisoners are getting moved. There middle of these hallways are not chunk banned because there are solitary confinement cells located in between.

Around every hour, the players are moved to another cell through the hallways connecting the three cells by invisible armed guards. The guards are armed with things like splash potions of poison to control misbehaving prisoners. Each cell is usually designed to hold two prisoners. Each prisoner would usually see the same person every six hours.

When prisoners misbehave, the guards take the prisoner into a small solitary confinement cell for hours and even days depending on what the prisoner did. The cell is located underneath each hallway connecting the three cells. There are two per hallway. The cell has a calibrated skulk sensor connected to an inactive chunk ban. If the player were to place or break any blocks, it would activate the chunk ban.

Purpled
 is a minor antagonist featured in 
Unstable Universe
. He was the leader of the 
Far Lands
 Warrior Council before 
Parrot
's election.



Personality


Purpled is known to be a powerful, paranoid, and tyrannical player. Not only does he heavily dislike the Farmers and goes out of his way to tell the other Warriors about how pathetic the Farmers district is, he prioritizes hierarchy and power over peace and progress. 



History


Purpled is seen as the leader of the 
Warriors District
 in 
Far Lands
.

He made the choice to leave the Farmers alone in their time of need, yet he continues to be upset at the Farmers for not doing their jobs of providing for the Warriors, highlighting his hypocrisy. He is paranoid about Parrot, and betrays him and the Warrior Council by pretending to be Mafia members to attempt to maintain his position of power, but Parrot escapes. Parrot becomes the new leader because Purpled is outvoted by the council members.

In 
I Survived the Unstable SMP Purge
, Purpled is one of the remaining candidates in the “dining hall”. Everything was going well until 
LettuceK
 announces the second round, whilst a group of assassins try and kill the candidates. Purpled tries to fight, but he is outnumbered. Purpled escapes but at the cost of Naparizel’s life.

Lettuce calls the emergency meaning and tells the Unstable Members that Napa died, and he gives each candidate 120 votes to be split among the remaining candidates. After the votes are split, Lettuce announces the purge. All the candidates either run or fight and Purpled wants to fight. Purpled demands that Parrot give him his book and has 2 unknown affiliated players. Until Theo arrives at the Northern Council and decides to fight Purpled. Parrot then escapes and the fight between Theo and Purpled begins. Theo, using his TNT minecart combat style is able to wear down Purpled’s armor and in the end Purpled runs away and Theo calls it quits there to find Parrot. 

After the event of Parrot, Horace, and Fymada escaping a trap, the three are now on their way back to the Northern Council until Horace falls into a sand trap made by Purpled, he demands someone to give him the votes, in which Parrot says that Boosfer stole them. Purpled is angered by this response and gives Parrot and Fymada four hours to get the votes back. Parrot then sneaks into the Viking village Purpled owns and successfully helps Horace escape a trap that if he was to die, he would fall in lava. Purpled then goes after Parrot. Parrot manages to lose Purpled by hiding behind a tree.  

Purpled is one of the 4 remaining candidates in the election alongside 
Boosfer
, 
ParrotX2
, and 
LettuceK
.

He later renounced from the election and supported LettuceK. He then joined the Law at the Battle of The Northern Council.

Purpled is known to have been featured on 
The Dream SMP
.

Reddoons, 
I Survived Minecraft's Most Corrupt City


Reddoons
 is a supporting character featured in 
Unstable Universe
. He acted as the former mayor of 
Capital City 2.0
 and was an ally of 
The Invisible Mafia
. 



History


Season 1


ParrotX2
, 
Wifies
, and 
deanthebean9
 try to steal from Capital City. They are caught by Reddoons and five of his guards. Reddoons says that they each need to get 1000 diamond blocks to be able to leave Capital City. They try to escape, but fail. Reddoons says they now need to get 10,000 diamond blocks.

Parrot steals from Capital City vaults and gives people diamond blocks for them to be able to leave.

Reddoons finds out about the people getting set free and sees that his diamonds have been stolen. He triples the required quota.

Reddoons catches Parrot and Wifies after they have left a vault. Parrot and Wifies store all of the shulker boxes of diamonds in pots to not get caught with the items.

Reddoons figures out that they used the pots to store the diamonds. Reddoons makes it so whoever has the lowest amount of diamonds plays a game of roulette to decide if they live or not. Deanthebean9 and Parrot are tied for lowest. Parrot loses, but 
CoinMonke
, the guard, says he can’t kill him, as he doesn’t want to kill him. Parrot threatens to tell Reddoons that he didn’t do his job unless he helps them steal from Reddoons. 

Reddoons plans to lock down all of his vaults.

Reddoons forces people to play a game of roulette which decides if they live or do not live. Reddoons rigs it so 
LuigiToan
 dies. CoinMonke refuses to kill him. Reddoons kills LuigiToan himself.

CoinMonke agrees to give the miners gear to steal Reddoons diamonds for leverage. The team gets caught. Reddoons gambles if they can leave or not. Reddoons lets everyone free except for Parrot, deanthebean9. Reddoons brings them to 
ashswagg
 and the Mafia. Ashswagg suggests they join the Mafia, but they say no. They try to force them to join, but CoinMonke activates their stasis chamber and they escape.



Season 2


Reddoons is seen at a secret base with 
Yeah_Jaron
. Spoke secretly spies on him for 100 days in the base. Spoke eventually raids the entire base and destroys it. He tries to steal the dragon egg from Reddoons but fails.

Spoke spies on Yeah_Jaron and sees him enter a new secret base with Reddoons. He eventually again raids the entire base.

Reddoons becomes the mayor of 
Capital City 2.0
. He is seen as a tyrant, as he forces people to operate shops where they must pay him 90% of their earnings in taxes. However, they cannot escape because they are scared of the world outside of the city. He makes a deal with 
Parrot
 and 
TheobaldtheBird
 to forgive everyone's debt in exchange for them safely transporting Reddoons's friend (
Hexatope
) from spawn to the city.

Reddoons was out of town when Wemmbu came and demanded information about FlameFrags's location. To punish the city for not cooperating, Wemmbu uses an 
orbital strike cannon
 to destroy a portion of the city. Security is increased as a result.

In the same video, it is also mentioned that Reddoons had made a sacred pact with 
Boosfer
 to not harm the bandits outside of the city walls in exchange for the bandits not raiding the city, but it is unclear when the pact was made.

Redstone Town
 is a major location in 
Unstable Universe
. Unlike the chaotic outer world of the server, Redstone Town stands as the main trading outpost for redstone. It's a safe place where redstone experts and even people who need/have redstone can buy and sell powerful components used for some of the most complex machinery on the server, including key devices like 
Orbital Strike Cannons
 or arrow cannons.

In the town, there are some key landmarks as well, the main ones (that have been shown) being the "
Basic Redstone Shop
", run by 
4CVIT
 and the "
TNT Shop
".  With workshops, vaults, and powerful items behind its walls, it’s more than just a place to buy gear—it’s a critical supply line for survival and power. For the BAT team, their stop at Redstone Town isn’t just business—it’s the key to fighting back. 

Next was in 
Season 2
 when 
Wemmbu
 was looking for a way to the far lands when looking for 4CVIT so he could save 
Egg
. It was covered with 
Law
 guards at that time. He sneaked in going through the walls and trees, going through a mob farm and slime farm until he went into a bamboo farm right under 4CVIT base and talked to him. 4CVIT said he destroyed the pearl cannon into the far lands because too many people were threatening him. When Wemmbu threatened him to rebuild it 4CVIT called the Law guards and they chased Wemmbu out.

In 
Season 3
 
Parrot
 came here and asked 4CVIT to help him to build a cooked chicken farm. 4CVIT refused at first, but later felt bad and built a large enough farm for Parrot (except for most importantly, the chicken, which Parrot wins at an auction).

ReinaDrop,
 or 
Reina
 for short, was a member of 
ParrotX2
's failed 
Skymore Civilization
. 



Personality


Reina is very smart (and has great depth perception), as evidenced by her winning a 1v1 with Ralamus by dropping a piece of dripstone on him, and also shown by the clues left by Zoe, which used complex ciphers Zoe knew she was smart enough to understand. 

Sometimes she acts a bit cocky which annoys her allies like 
TheobaldTheBird
 however she is seen to be very smart even though she might act arrogant. 

Reina also has a vengeful side, as she desires to kill every last member of Cindercrest. Beyond this all-consuming drive, she is unsure of her overall purpose on the server and intends to quit once Cindercrest is eliminated. This is possibly due to her lack of motivation, which could stem from her overall sadness at the presumed death of Zoe444.  



History


Reina was one of the 10 survivors of the 1000 player civilization that was massacred by 
Cindercrest
. She and 
Zoe444
 were two of the survivors, taken instead to grow crops for Cindercrest. They eventually escaped but were split up. Reina was found in Skymore by 
ParrotX2
 and 
TheoBaldTheBird
, who gave her the news that Zoe had died. She then decided to join Parrot and Theo's quest to battle Cindercrest.

Reina won over the strongest bandit by using trident given by parrot to pierce dripstone and skewer opponent. She helped threatening the leader of Merchant City, 
DanchoGold
. She and Theo went to spy on 
Cindercrest
. She acted determined, confident and cautious, just like a clone of Parrot.

Reina controlled 
orbital arrow cannons
 to defend against 
Cindercrest
, which killed the majority of 
Cindercrest
 members over two battles.

History


ParrotX2
 and Rekrap2 attempt to break into the prison which holds 
Wifies
 and 
SpokeIsHere
 to get 
Wifies
 out. They get caught and have to eat chorus fruit to escape.

Parrot
 and Rekrap plan to free one of 
Spoke’s
 henchmen, so they go over to an end dimension 
chunk ban
 to try and free them. 
Parrot
 builds a TNT cannon to try and explode the chunk ban, but the TNT cannon explodes itself and the guards notice. The guards almost kill Parrot, but he is able to fly away and hide. Parrot comes back to try and make a new TNT cannon, but the guards come back. Luckily, 
Parrot
 is invisible. 
Parrot
 quickly builds another TNT cannon, but again this one fails to break the 
chunk ban
. 
Parrot
 builds another TNT cannon, but this time he’s caught. He flies away and escapes.

Parrot
 tries to convince 
PrinceZam
 to temporarily disable the 
chunk ban
 in 
Spoke's
 prison to let 
Wifies
 out, but he says no. 
Parrot
 and Rekrap start breaking into an underwater prison. They are successful in breaking out 
Derapchu
.

Parrot
 and Rekrap and 
Derapchu
 go over to the next prison, which is built in a jungle. They start breaking into the prison. They manage to explode the 
chunk ban
 using their TNT cannon.

While travelling to 
PrinceZam’s empire
, the server crashes. When they join, they are sent back to a previous save. It turns out that 
PrinceZam
 had added a new defense which makes it so that the server crashes when getting too close to certain locations. This is called a 
memory ban
.

The team go to a nether prison, and try to break in. They discover that there are three 
chunk bans
 in this prison. They manage to destroy one of the 
chunk bans
.

They move onto an ice themed prison. Using flying machines, they are able to free 
Fantst
. 
Fantst
 agrees to join their team to break people out of prisons.

They go to a sky prison. They are able to destroy the 
chunk ban
.

Fantst
 
chunk bans
 himself as he thinks that the prisons will just get harder and harder.

They go to a new end prison and use TNT minecarts to destroy the 
chunk ban
. The player has no interest of teaming with them. The team goes over to the first end prison they went to, and easily destroy the 
chunk ban
 using TNT minecarts. The player freed is 
JumperWho
, who agrees to help them.

The team uses the nether to avoid the 
memory bans
 that crash the server. They find the prison that holds 
Spoke
 and 
Wifies
 and try to break in. They retreat back to their cave area to plan an escape. They figure out how they can 
chunk ban
 the guards. They set up an underground chunk ban setup, and have 
JumperWho
 lead the guards to the 
chunk ban
. They manage to 
chunk ban
 all of the guards. 
Parrot
 is able to get 
_Kenadian_
 to help them break out 
Spoke
 and 
Wifies
 using a wither bore. They kill the baby piglins which are holding 
chunk bans
 using flying machines and TNT minecarts. 

The team is successful in breaking out 
Wifies
. They also accidentally free 
Spoke
.

,

, and

 burn the tree in Rekrap2's base.

 to destroy "the valley", which is revealed to be Rekrap2's base.

 and

 convince him not to destroy certain parts of the base.

. The prisoners are eventually able to escape with the help of

.

content:

SOLO Player VS Minecraft's Deadliest Faction
 is the 75th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


The episode starts with FlameFrags giving a summary about 
ClownPierce
 and his achievements, and he enters what seems to be a guard supply room for the 
ClownPierce's
 Nether Faction’s guards. Flame meets two guards and he kills them effortlessly. Flame keeps roaming around the Nether and he eventually meets 
ParrotX2
. Parrot, wearing a shield that matches the Clown's guard force. Flame thinks that means Parrot joined Clown's Guards and chases him. Parrot pulls a trap that makes Flame pummel down a chute but Flame block-clutches and saves himself. Flame enderpearls out to catch Parrot running away to a tunnel. Parrot digs the roof dropping lava on Flame but Flame pearls past. Parrot jumps down a hole and breaks a block to make Flame drop down another hole but Flame block-clutches to  prevent himself from dying. Flame then chases Parrot as Parrot runs to 
Theo
. Theo splashes invisibilty on both of them but Flame manages to catch Parrot and pop his  totem. Parrot then bluffs saying he has a TNT minecart trap that would kill all three of them. Parrot says Flame to go back to his job of working for clown but Flame says he isn't working for clown but instead trying to kill him. Flame and Parrot decide to make an alliance as both of them had  the same objective.  

Together, all three of them make  their way to the 
Nether Civilization
 to assassinate Clown or 
FerreMC
. Flame goes to the nether festival and Theo pressures him to fight a player named "GeneralChungus". Flame kills GeneralChungus. Flame and Theo make their way to the central building where they jump Ferre. Although Clown and his guards eventually make their way up to save Theo, they were unsuccessful and Ferre is taken hostage. Parrot denies Flame his fight against Clown purposefully by taking Ferre to a remote bunker. Parrot drops Ferre some maps and other junk making it seemlike the maps were useless. Parrot then lets Ferre free. Flame, furious starts attacking Parrot for letting Ferre out. Parrot tracks the general direction of Ferre and decides to hold a stakeout to see any guards of Clown passing by.  

Flame pretends to go AFK and Parrot says he is just using Flame to get to Clown's nether vault. Flame hears them and runs away to Clown's castle with the goal to betray Parrot. Flame recruits Clown and gives him Parrot's location in exchange for information about 
Wemmbu
. Together the group, makes their way to Parrot and jumps Parrot and Theo. Parrot is able to run away but Theo is captured. Parrot jumps down attempting to make negotiations so Theo is spared but instead, Parrot is captured too. Clown says he knows nothing about 
Wemmbu
. Before Parrot is executed, he apologizes to Flame for using him and Flame accepts it and tells Clown that they'd have to get through him first, betraying Clown. This gives Parrot and Theo time to find the vault. Clown runs away to catch Parrot so his vault isn't ransacked leaving his army behind. Clown's army is eventually defeated and Flame comes out on top. Afterwards, Flame decides to go to 
Capital City
 to offer Parrot a deal to find 
Wemmbu
. Flame offers Parrot the tomb of 
The Invisible Mafia
. Parrot accepts his deal. 



Trivia


The video was originally titled "Minecraft Combat Master VS Minecraft's Deadliest Faction"

flame v law





SOLO Player VS Minecraft Bounty Hunters
 is the 52nd episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


Flame's
 best friend, 
Jaden_MAN
, has mysteriously disappeared off the server, and he goes around asking players if they know where Jaden went. One player in specific, 
LettuceK
, tells Flame that Jaden is not someone he should be looking for, which makes Flame suspicious, so he follows Lettuce with invisibility. Flame makes it to the base of Lettuce's team of bounty hunters, he questions what it meant by Jaden is captured, and Lettuce says he worked to get things done and have Jaden captured, and so Flame attacks them. Flame quickly pops some of their totems, but is then shot with weakness arrows and is drained of resources. Lettuce proposes that Flame not look for Jaden and that they stop fighting, and Flame agrees just to get them to stop. Flame goes and spies on 
The Law's
 meeting invisible to get any intel on where Jaden could be. The first meeting had nothing important, but a few hours later they held another and Flame overhears them talking about 
Leow0ok
 taking on a 1v5 and ended up beating The Law, they also mentioned holding an auction a few days from then, so Flame plans on attending it to get a lead on Jaden's location. 

Flame goes to the destroyed 
B.A.T. Headquarters
 to look for Leo. Leo thinks he's there to kill him, but Flame says he's there to learn Leo's PvP techniques, which costed Flame an IOU to learn Leo's strategies. Leo shows Flame to use a crossbow and flint and steel to explode the TNT minecarts instantly, and they begin practicing together. With crossbow carting understood, Flame heads to the auction and uses his newfound knowledge and wipes out a good amount of players. Lettuce wants to talk it out and knows Flame won't get the information out of killing him, and he says the reason why he can't tell Flame where Jaden was is because he couldn't let others go through what he had to, so Flame lets him go.

Flame has an idea goes back to the B.A.T. Headquarters and asks Leo for a favor, Leo doesn't want to work with Flame, but Flame gives him an offer of a stack of experience bottles and Leo accepts. He tells Leo to turn himself in to see where The Law takes him and hope that they take the bait. They make it to The Law's base and Leo turns himself in, they take him outside of the base and head towards an ender pearl cannon, where Leo stops pretending and starts to fight The Law. Leo breaks the scaffolding leading up to the cannon, Lettuce and his lawmen begin to stack up. Leo says he's done his job, so Flame gives him the other half of the stack of experience and tries to stop The Law from escaping, but was too late. Flame uses the cannon and is teleported to the Pirate Islands. Flame chases them from island to island, until they reach the last island, which had to have Jaden. Flame carts the lawmen and they're forced to run into the castle. They all jump down the hole that leads to the 
Abandoned Civilization
, Flame asks again where Jaden is, but Lettuce says he needs to stay locked up for the good of everyone. After killing one more lawmen, Lettuce and the remaining lawmen flee and says Flame wins this time. Flame looks around the civilization and finds Jaden inside of a house and gives Jaden food before he starved to death. Flame said he dealt with The Law for Jaden, but Jaden doesn't know who Flame is talking about. Flame asks who put Jaden down there then, and Jaden replies, "It was 
Wemmbu
."

I'm currently surrounded by an army of toxic players. They destroyed my base, killed my wolves and tried to kill me and ban me from the Unstable SMP. I've spent weeks trying to stop these players and the only way to stop them is by finding the 
player
 leading them all but that's not going to happen if I die here. Good thing for me, I don't die

SOLO Player VS Toxic Minecraft Civilization
 is the 48th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


FlameFrags
 is surrounded by a group of toxic players that demand him to drop all his items, instead of doing so, he wipes them all out. Flame goes to find a base and finds 
Lomedy's
 base to reside in for the time being. The toxic clan finds Flame before he could even devise a plan on how to find the leader of the clan, they're all wiped out once again. One of the bodies dropped a lodestone compass, which gave him a clue to find the leader. After regearing, Flame travels towards the location, which is a castle on an island in the middle of the ocean. The toxic clan sees him and try to intimidate him to leave when he says he's looking for their leader. The leader, VEN0M, appears out of nowhere with a mace and revealed that he was a diamond trim Mafia member like Flame was. Flame however doesn't think VEN0M is intimidating despite having a mace and being as skilled as he is, so he takes on the fight against all of them at once. The army dies and it's only Flame and VEN0M left, Flame switches to a different sword and begins to beat VEN0M, causing him to run and call it a stalemate. Flame knew going into the toxic civilization base would take more resources, so he mends his armor and heads back to Lomedy's base where Lomedy was being pressed by more toxic players, and Flame takes of all of them and spares one when they give him a map. Flame trains Lomedy in PvP so he doesn't make Flame look bad later on, he teaches Lomedy how to use cobwebs to slow players down and heads off to the location on the map afterwards.

The map shows a location of one of the toxic clan's vault, Flame forces Lomedy to come with him to the vault. The location is inside of one of the clan's bases and Flame jumps all the guards outside, once inside the clan's territory kills the guards there, and goes into the vaults and kills the guards there too. Flame and Lomedy loot the vault and get a lot of good gear, more guards come in and Flame uses the TNT minecarts and flame bow he just looted to get rid of them. Flame goes out of the vault and kills the rest of the toxic clan that resided inside of that base and escapes, going back to Lomedy's base to meet back up with him. Flame and Lomedy talk and Lomedy reveals that his old teammate was a Mafia member with a mace. Flame tells Lomedy to go a thousand blocks out and set up TNT dupers, while Flame was waiting for Lomedy to return, VEN0M and a group of the toxic players confront Flame about the missing loot in his vault. VEN0M makes fun of Flame about how he thinks he's the immortal demon and Flame tells him to show him that he's not, and they begin fighting. Flame uses slow falling arrows to prevent VEN0M from using his mace, Lomedy returns to his base and gives his former teammate's mace to Flame to help. Flame easily kills off the toxic clan, leaving VEN0M alone again, who runs away again. Flame asks Lomedy why he gave him the mace, and Lomedy says that he's been alone ever since his teammate died and it was nice to hang around with someone again and wants to follow Flame along in his journey, but Flame says he works better alone. 

Flame heads to the TNT dupers Lomedy built and activates it, and it slowly moves towards the clan's base. Flame pearls into the base and jumps the guards, the TNT dupers come in and blow up the base at the same time, which helps kill some of them off. All of the guards die, and it's only Flame and VEN0M for the third time, Flame is confident he can kill VEN0M that he takes off all his armor except his chestplate, and inevitably maces VEN0M to death still. Flame goes back to Lomedy and returns his maces and get 
Ashen
 back before heading off.

SOLO Player VS Toxic Minecraft Clan
 is the 46th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe


I was returning to my camp on the Unstable SMP, when I saw them—





Plot


The episode begins in 
FlameFrags
 reuturning to his camp only to see people griefing it. The toxic players also kidnap 
Ashen
.  

FlameFrags follows the toxic players and attacks the first few people he sees in the base.  The players are using strength to increase their attack damage but this doesn't work on Flame as he kills the players in the first base.After killing the first wave of toxic players, FlameFrags blows up their base and follows the path into the next base.  

The players begin using poison arrows but that doesn't work on Flame as he kills them all. He then destroys their base and follows the path into another base.  

This time they use harming arrows. Flame barely manages to kill all of them and the last player dies from fire damage. Flame destroys the base and continues blowing up their base. 

Flame finds an enchanting table and he upgrades his armour before tracking down another base and destroying it until he finds Ashen. 

This time, the players have soul sand placed around their base and are wearing soul speed boots with the speed and weaving effects which makes them go faster on soul sand and prevents them from getting stuck in cobwebs as well as using slowness potions on Flame. Flame uses the harming arrows he got from the previous base to kill the players. He then loots the base, blows it up and leaves.

He then finds a base underwater. The players there are using water breathing, turtle shells and tridents. Flame doesn't have a hard time killing all of them. After killing all the players he places obsidian in all of their houses and griefs it.

At the next base, he goes down a ladder into complete darkness. He is ambushed by players shifting behind the doors and this time Flame barely kills all of them. After killing all of them he blows the base up.

Then he meets 
T0X1N
 and his 6 other commanders representing the leaders for every base up to now. Flame tries to free Ashen but they fight and the winner gets to keep Ashen. Flame kills some of them before his helmet and chestplate almost break so he picks up the dead players loot and he takes their armour to wear it. After some time he kills all of TOX1N's commanders.

TOX1N threatens to kill Ashen if Flame doesn't drop all his gear. Flame drops his potions and a water bucket but TOX1N allows him to keep his armour and weapons. TOX1N then forces Flame to send him a screenshot of his inventory. TOX1N then forces Flame to jump on a ladder on top of a pit of chickens. He then splashes a potion of wind charging and a potion of harming that sends Flame up into the sky. TOX1N's attempt at executing Flame has failed because Flame has wind charge clutched to negate his fall damage. He had pulled out a wind charge from his bundle hiding it from TOX1N.

Flame then kills TOX1N and frees his wolf Ashen.





Trivia


In a 
tweet
, Lettuce said this is his favorite recording he has done on Unstable.

I was out exploring on the Unstable SMP, when something strange happened. My wolf randomly teleported to me.





SOLO Player VS Toxic Minecraft Team
 is the 41st episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


FlameFrags
 was exploring the server until his wolf teleports to him and began growling, which only happens when a wolf gets attacked. FlameFrags decides to check on his base and he finds out his base was griefed by a toxic team. The team of toxic players had blown his entire base up and killed all his wolves and the wolf that teleported to him was the only survivor. 

FlameFrags heads out to set a temporary camp until he gets attacked by a band of players from the toxic team. They use pots to steal FlameFrags's weapon but FlameFrags proves that he can win a fight against these players with his fists. The toxic players loot FlameFrags's camp and destroy it and he has an argument with the remaining players. They reveal that their leader is 
Razor2gud
. FlameFrags's wolf kills one of the remaining players and one of them drops a lodestone compass. 

FlameFrags goes to where the lodestone compass leads to and finds Razor2gud. FlameFrags tries to confront Razor2gud but he taunts him and runs away. FlameFrags tries to have a fight with Razor2gud but he says that if he wants to fight him, he has to downgrade his gear. After switching to iron armour and weapons, Razor2gudbrings his army to try to kill FlameFrags. The fight goes well, they start using strength potions but FlameFrags is still able to kill all of them. FlameFrags finds a map in one of the houses and realizes that the base he raided wasn't the only base the players own. If he wanted to find all of their bases and destroy them as well as getting revenge on Razor, he had to find the bases. 

FlameFrags sets up another temporary camp inside a cave where he gives his dog new armour and a name, Ashen. FlameFrags uses his map to find a bunker since he knew that they could have TNT after what happened to his base. On his way to the bunker, FlameFrags finds another group of members from the same team. He goes into the bunker and is met with more people trying to defend it. FlameFrags defeats a wave of players there. He begins looting the base until another wave of players jump him.  He uses the fireworks and the crossboy he looted to kill them all. FlameFrags then blows up the entire bunker.

FlameFrags heads to another town and he kills the players living there in case one of them drops a lodestone compass. While he was looting a potion stash, he finds a bunch of strength potions and protects his dog until he gets confronted by Razor2gud and his team. FlameFrags crafts a bunch of TNT minecarts and he also enchants his iron leggings with blast protection to take less damage as well as gathering a few turtle master potions in case he's about to die. FlameFrags kills the army with the minecarts. FlameFrags has a fight with Razor2gud but he runs away again after his armour breaks. FlameFrags destroys the entire town until he finds another lodestone compass. 

FlameFrags arrives to other towns owned by the city and kills everyone there as well as blow up the houses. FlameFrags arrives at Razor2gud's base and he's not playing around anymore. As soon as he confronts them they continue to complai about FlameFrags having netherite armour while they have diamond armour. FlameFrags refuses at first but he downgrades his armour before having a fair fight in the colosseum. FlameFrags begins fighting Razor2gud and it goes well until Razor2gud activates a trap of TNT which was under the colosseum the entire time. As the team leave the colosseum, the TNT explodes and would've killed FlameFrags but he survived using turtle master. FlameFrags begins killing the remaining members of the team and blows up some houses in front of Razor2gud. Razor2gud begs for FlameFrags not to kill him as there are worse people out there but FlameFrags tells him that he will kill them all before killing Razor2gud.



Analysis


Ashen
 is the only survivor of the attack on FlameFrags' base as all the other wolves had died.


FlameFrags' chestplate changes from diamond to redstone.

wemmbu v flame





SOLO Player VS Unstable SMP
 is the 64th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


FlameFrags
 is running out of resources, and if he wants to stay alive on Unstable, he's going to have to get rich fast. Flame gets a chance of doing so when he comes across a mysterious invisible player offers Flame riches if he completes their quests. The player instructs Flame to take bring back stolen potions from a dangerous player named MisterLegend101, and so Flame heads to 
Capital City
 in search for him. When he gets to Capital City, nobody is around and it appeared to have been destroyed. He spots a random person and asks where everyone is and they explain that 
Wemmbu
 came by earlier and was looking for Flame, but Flame doesn't care about that as of now and continues looking for MisterLegend101. He finds MisterLegend101 right after and presses him for the potions, but MisterLegend101 says he doesn't have any and will give it back in two weeks, Flame pops his totems until he gives them up. He heads back to the invisible player and hands over the shulker full of potions. His reward is an enchanted golden apple, the invisible player tells him he can receive more if Flame gets a Happy Ghast. However, the Nether is a dangerous dimension as it's guarded by ClownPierce and his army, so he has to go deep into the Nether. He stumbles across Nether scavengers that offer to help him traverse the Nether if he protects them. While exploring, the scavengers explain how they supply groups such as 
B.A.T.
 and 
The Law
. They get to a part of the Nether that has been unlooted and finds a dried Ghast.

Headed back to spawn, Flame meets back with the invisible player, the player says they appreciate Flame's work and gives Flame a beacon, Flame doesn't think the beacon isn't a powerful item and demands for better items. The invisible player asks if Flame wants to know who they are, and they reveal themselves to be 
Spoke
, a person who's manipulated many people in the past, and Flame knows to not trust him because of that. Flame attacks Spoke because he knows that Spoke was scamming him, Spoke drops a book and goes into an escape tunnel. Flame reads the book that tasks him to kill a group of bandits called the Skullhounds and that this could be his final moments on the server. Unsure of how to find them, Flame visits The Law's base to get any intel on them. The Law's base has also seem to be blown up, Flame asks 
LettuceK
 if he knows anything about the Skullhounds, Lettuce says that they're located about 15,000 blocks out from spawn. Flame thinks that Lettuce could be lying, but Lettuce says he has no reason to as of now, seeing the current state that he's in and that he's been trying to kill them himself, but if Flame wants to do it himself, The Law wouldn't interfere. Lettuce also tells Flame to talk to Wemmbu to stop blowing stuff up, but Flame doesn't care about that right now.

Flame is out in the wild and finds a random player and asks if they know the leader of the Skullhounds, they point Flame towards a direction, he finds griefed villages and lava casts, as well as player's loot that has yet to despawn, meaning that they were nearby. He finds the Skullhounds and confronts them, they tell him not to care about what they're doing if he's not apart of Law or B.A.T., two of the bandits stall them while the other builds a small railgun behind him, however Flame notices due to not being able to hear his game, so he quickly places blocks and covers himself to prevent himself from being shot to death. The bandits jump him and puts up a tough fight, almost breaking Flame's armor and resorting to diamond armor, but Flame manages to kill them all off in the end. He picks up their shields and the main bandit's chestplate with trims as proof that he completed the mission. Back at spawn, Spoke is seen high up in the air, trying to avoid being attacked again. He drops down and Flame gives him the shield and armor and asks for his rewards, Spoke says he deserves to be rewarded and that he's trying to build any type of alliance because of his mistakes in the past and is trying to make up for it. Spoke gives Flame a book that leads to a Mafia stash that would lead him to a lifetime full of stashes. Spoke explains how there's so much loot that nobody knows about and that Flame would be rich forever and that the only reason why he hasn't gone there himself is because he's afraid of the people near there, how he doesn't need the loot and Flame needs it more than him. He mentions how he had Flame go through trials to prove that he's ready for this final mission and says they should work closely more in the future.

Flame makes it to the Mafia stash built inside of the mountains of a Bandlands biome that appears to be blown up and looted, each area he goes to has rooms full of chests that are all empty. Flame finds some diamond armor and experience bottles, allowing him to mend his Netherite, he walks out of a dining area and outside onto the bridges that link to other parts of the stash, he's then greeted with Wemmbu standing right above where he just came out of. Wemmbu asks for a rematch, Flame thinks it's pointless since he's beaten Wemmbu every other time, but Wemmbu says he thinks he's the strongest now, Flame laughs at him and Wemmbu sends down a stab shot right at Flame. Flame is shocked and confused at the powers Wemmbu has, he manages to get a few hits in, but is unable to for the most part due to Wemmbu flying in and out. Wemmbu uses an orbital strike cannon as well, making Flame even more confused than before, Flame still has confidence that he can beat Wemmbu even with his TNT powers. The stab shots blow through the entire mountain and reveals an ancient city underneath, Flame grabs a hoe and breaks the sculk for experience in order to mend his armor. Wemmbu stab shots out and Flame chases him, and Wemmbu spams orbitals to try and kill Flame. An invisible person drops Flame more potions to help him out. Now out of totems, Flame starts to use turtle master potions to stay alive, the invisible player drops a couple more totems for Flame. Wemmbu drops another stab shot on Flame, popping a totem, but more importantly breaking Flame's chestplate, his most prized possession. Flame tries to regear with his shulkers, but Wemmbu blows them up before he has the chance to. Without any more totems this time, Flame drops all the way down to bedrock and digs a tunnel to hide. Wemmbu talks knowing Flame probably hears him, he says he doesn't want to kill Flame and wants him to know he'll never be the strongest ever again and flies off.

Flame goes back to spawn where Spoke said he would be, instead of finding Spoke, a sign is placed saying, "Thank you my friend" with a wither rose right in front of it. Flame is upset that he lost to Wemmbu and destroys everything inside of his ender chest and inventory. He says to himself that it's over for Wemmbu, implying he's going to get stronger and get revenge on Wemmbu.



Trivia


The title of the video was briefly changed to "Minecraft SOLO Player VS Hardcore SMP" before it was changed back to it's original title.

It has since then been changed to SOLO Player VS World's Largest Minecraft Server.

SargeLAW
 or

 is a character in

. He was an officer of

.



History


Season 2


The Kings Arc


Unstable SMP: The Battle for The Great Sea


SargeLAW appears near the orbital strike cannon in The Law's battle against the pirates. He does not appear after that though.

SargeLaw is one of the officers in The Law with similar power to 
Deputy_Ace
, 
G0dOfWar
 and 
The Oroboros
. He commands elite Law units and players with full netherite armour. He is shown to be a good commander.



I Got Trained By A Minecraft Spear Master


In order to attract The Law, FlameFrags and ManePear blow up a village and kill its inhabitants, while instructing the survivors to ask The Law for help.

SargeLAW shows up. He mentions that his brother was 
SargeRaxby
, but he was maced and killed by Wemmbu in 
Escaping Prison on the Unstable SMP
.

While he is willing to fight solo, Flame and Mane ask him to call for reinforcements. Sarge's reinforcements are in full netherite armor (one of them has an elytra and a spear), and they are able to force ManePear to run and capture FlameFrags.

SargeLAW comes back after learning FlameFrags has escaped, alongside an army of players. He loses the fight and has to run away. 



2 Minecraft Pros vs 1000 Hunters


SargeLAW shows up at Smuggler's Pass with some Law soldiers, as well as eggchan. He waits for Parrot and Wemmbu invisibly but they find him. 

He decides to duel Wemmbu instead of attacking with all the soldiers as his revenge would be more satisfying that way. After losing the duel, he gets the soldiers to attack Parrot and Wemmbu. 

After Parrot and Wemmbu splash invisibility, SargeLAW starts carting random soldiers in hopes of exposing Parrot and Wemmbu. 

SargeLAW and TheG0DOfWar ambush TheobaldTheBird after he kills The_Oroboros. 



I Became King of the Unstable SMP (4 Protagonists)


SargeLAW sends troops at Law HQ to fight district 13. The troops are defeated and LettuceK orders SargeLAW to retreat from battle.

After Deputy Ace helps Parrot and TheobaldTheBird escape, SargeLAW ends up killing him.

SargeLAW fights at the Battle of The Northern Council alongside The Law.

During the battle he defects from the Law with a handful of soldiers and escapes the battle. 

He later shows up, attempting to sabotage Parrot's attempt to bring a boatload (or rather minecart-load) of cooked chicken to spawn, only to be tricked by Parrot with fake chest minecarts. 

SargeLAW is revealed to have taken over The LAW with a change of leadership. Parrot demands he joins The Royal Army but SargeLAW refuses. SargeLAW reveals that he plans on joining Cindercrest. Parrot then activates a TNT trap which kills the remaining 1000 LAW men and destroys LAW city. SargeLAW is presumably imprisoned.



Thumbnails




Trivia


SargeLAW is played by 
TeamKalal
 confirmed by Lettuce, who also mentions that he's a solid cart PvPer.


SargeLAW is known for killing his own team using carts.


Flame and Wemmbu often joke with him and make fun of him for trying to avenge his brother.
