title: Searching For 1000 Players Who Went Missing
content:
Searching For 1000 Players Who Went Missing














Episode


126






Upload date


Apr 28, 2026






POV


SpokeIsHere






Arcs


NULL






Featured Creators (Description)


JumperWho
PlanetLord
JamatoP
Mapicc
DevMCchamp
ItsAli
bluecube132
















The Unstable SMP is the largest Hardcore Minecraft server, with thousands of players joining every day. However, over the course of the past few weeks, at least a thousand of these players have gone missing....





Searching For 1000 Players Who Went Missing
 is the 126th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


Spoke
 recaps what he's gone through for the past month; looking for a thousand players, trying to find his 
best friend
, finding clues that players left behind, all to find out there are anonymous players take players to places that nobody else has seen before on the server.

The episode starts right where it left off previously, Mapicc unveils his identity and tells Spoke and 
Jumper
 that he doesn't have a lot of time and to pack everything they have and to meet him at a set of coordinates in a signed book by a player named Revenant44. This leaves the both of them speechless, but they had no other choice other than to listen to his instructions. 

They reach the coordinates and spot a tree getting broken and replaced, hinting that's where the hidden bunker is and so they go down the ladder. As they do, one of the 
Null Hunters
 watch them from a distance. At the bottom of the bunker, there are four eerie identical tunnels lit with redstone torches, Mapicc tells them to follow him down one. Spoke asks Mapicc what's happened to him and asks for an explanation about everything. Mapicc explains that he was captured by NULL , but was able to escape and has a chance to save the rest of the players. He then goes on to say that they're heading towards a pearl cannon that leads to a camp and they'll be able to gear up and meet up with Revenant, the same player who wrote the book, saved Mapicc. Just as they think they're safe, the Null Hunters hide in the walls of the tunnel and dig out and start chasing. Mapicc insists going to the pearl cannon is the only way out of this, so they keep running to the cannon. Spoke and Jumper hold them off easily and they make it to the cannon and pearl into it. 

As the three all teleport, Mapicc says the cannon had failed to teleport them to the right location and the hunters may have tampered with it. Spoke opens up his F3 menu and sees that they're 12 million blocks out and thinks it's going to take forever to go back to spawn, but Mapicc says being out that much is a good thing and begins walking towards the 
Far Lands
. Mapicc says to be careful of Null Hunters that could potentially be out in the Farlands since the camp is deep inside. The three of them go inside of the Farlands rather than the top to not show themselves, Mapicc says they'll keep going until they reach a biome he recognizes. When they reach the end of the tunnel, it's a biome that's all flowers, which isn't the one Mapicc recognizes. Mapicc then spots a Null Hunter so they sneak and watch him. They overhear 
their squad leader
 telling the rest of the hunters instructing them on what to do before they used their traveling methods to leave. They come out of hiding and start walking forward again, Mapicc tells Spoke and Jumper that there are other people that have escaped NULL and that NULL isn't the only things they should be worried about in the Farlands. Mapicc makes a point that with NULL capturing bad players, they're bound to do bad things even in the Farlands, so he suggests for Spoke and Jumper to blend in with them and not use their netherite armor. Spoke then suggests that they use the shortcuts that the hunters since there's a good chance they'd get lost in the Farlands, and so they do. As they run back the opposite direction, they spot a cave entrance and go inside. They splash invis for safety measures and spot Null Hunters running right past them. After all of them have passed, they come out of hiding and turn left and reach the red plains biome of the Farlands, which is the biome the camp is located at. Spoke asks why they don't go through the Nether, Mapicc tells him that nether portals are a bad omen and whoever has gone through the Nether that isn't NULL have never returned. He theorizes that the hunters may have taken these players into the Nether. 

Eventually, they find the campsite, but with no signs of Revenant anywhere. Spoke spots a hole caused by an explosion with cobwebs, signaling that the hunters had found the camp and took all of the gear. With no other leads, they have no other ideas and need to come up with something new. Mapicc has the idea of killing the other missing players, Spoke doesn't think that seems ideal. Just as they say that, a group of the missing players run their direction and they start running the opposite direction and towering up to the mineshaft up in the air with the players towering up as well. Spoke and Jumper put on their netherite armor and start attacking them, but they hear one of them say that they were the players that raided the camp. Spoke is confused and asks them to repeat themselves, they think that Spoke is a part of NULL because of his shield pattern and demands to know why he attacked the camp. Spoke explains to them that him and Jumper are the only players who know about NULL and what they've been doing, and that convinces them to team up. The Null Hunters start towering up, the missing players tell them to take their horses at the bottom and to head north while they fight off the hunters. Mapicc couldn't believe that they convinced the missing players to work with them, Spoke says although they are all bad people, they'd have to work with each other. It cuts back to the missing players being confronted by the Null Hunters, they make all the missing players take off all their armor and go through a nether portal. Spoke finally uses the time to ask Mapicc why he gave him the NULL shield. Mapicc goes to say when him and 
MinuteTech
 went to the end right before the final fight against 
the Law
, they split off and Mapicc encountered the Null Hunters for the first time. He says that they helped him by giving the shield and invited him to join NULL. Since he was about to fight a war, he couldn't join quite yet, but in the middle of the fight, they pulled his stasis due to him being way too trusting.

The three of them make it near the end of the biome, where chunks of the biome start appearing on top. Jumper spots Null Hunters coming from the distance, but Spoke says they can outrun them with their horses. Shortly after, they make it out of the red plains biome and enter the Farlands Rings biome. They go upwards and see names, and so they go to investigate. They find a house and a group of players surrounding a campfire playing a game. Spoke holds up the NULL shield and asks if they know anything about the group, the player speaking tells him that he should talk to their leader and brings them over to their leader, who is 
PlanetLord
. He invites them into a house with an enchantment table and allows them to gear up. After they get all new gear, Spoke asks Planet what he's been up to, Planet says he's been in the Farlands for a while and he used to explore a lot of the biomes before NULL started patrolling it and that him and the village believes the biomes weren't created naturally, but rather that whoever discovered the Farlands first on Unstable made them. The three go to the farm and collect wheat and carrots and begin fishing, when all of a sudden the same player that they talked to earlier gets killed by a Null Hunter. They go back invis and spy on the leader talking to Planet asking where Spoke had went, but Planet says he doesn't know in order to protect them, and so the hunters force Planet to go through a nether portal. Spoke sees the house they were just in and realizes he left all of his shulkers in the house, so he goes down to the house to collect them. The Null Hunters see that Jumper and Mapicc are above and start attacking them, causing them to run. 

They make it to the end of the Farlands Rings and enter a big plains biome with no trees or water. They run through that whole biome and enter a biome that's entirely dark and filled with black. They realize that the armor's enchantment glints is the only way to see in this darkness, so they take off their armor and place a torch to see each other. They come up with a plan to use this to their advantage, as the hunters don't know how to track them through this biome. They sneak up on a few of the hunters and kill them off one by one. One of the hunters drops chainmail armor, which meant Planet could have possibly died. The leader comes up to them and asks what they did to his team, and they start jumping the leader. Before they kill him off, he asks what they want. Spoke says he knows it's not easy to become a leader and wants him to answer a few questions. Firstly, he asks why they take players from spawn to the Farlands, but the leader says he's just the middleman and knows nothing and was sent by someone. The next question Spoke asks is who sent these hunters, but he isn't able to share that information, however, he can show the place where they come from. Spoke forces the leader to drop his netherite armor for precautionary reasons and make him take him to the place. When they reach the place where the Null Hunters travel through, he's too scared to go down the trapdoor and says he can't be seen with Spoke. The leader tries to run away, and Jumper kills him. They then drop down the trapdoor, which seems to be an infinite stone brick staircase that keeps going down and down. They finally reach the end, which has fibers that may lead to the different biomes like the leader said. Spoke says they should go to the bottom and starts lighting the place up with redstone torches to be able to see. JamatoP
 come into view. The episode ends as Jamato tells them that he's there to help.



Trivia


Unlike 
Wemmbu
, Spoke's ender chest did not get cleared when he entered in the Farlands.


Null Hunters
 can light nether portal in the Farlands.


The red plain biome, the fabric biome, and Mapicc saying "soul corrupted to darkness" are reference to Wifies' world that doesn't exist ARG series.


The endless downward ladder, and Mapicc saying "soul corrupted to darkness" may be a reference to 
the Underworld
.


The word "Revenant" means "a person who returns after a long absence or, in folklore, a visible ghost or animated corpse that returns from the dead to haunt the living" which suggests that Revenant might return.

title: Searching For My Friend Who Went Missing
content:
Searching For My Friend Who Went Missing














Episode


131






Upload date


May 9, 2026






POV


Wemmbu






Arcs


The Kingdoms Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


Lomedy
FlameFrags
Yungyx
Jaden MAN














eggchan is gone





Searching For My Friend Who Went Missing
 is the 131st episode featured in 
Unstable Universe




Plot


Wemmbu
 begins the episode by telling the viewers that he doesn't have a lot of friends, except his friend 
Eggchan
. Wemmbu then recaps his previous video, that a mysterious player wanted Egg dead, however during an encounter he and Egg split off and he hasn't found Egg every since. However, while he was split off from Egg he managed to kill the mysterious player who was revealed to be a player named 
Cytharam
. He believed that he managed to kill the mysterious player until he saw the mysterious player next to him. The player told him to meet him at his base and stasises away. Wemmbu asks the mysterious player where Egg is. The mysterious player tells Wemmbu that he doesn't know where Egg is. The player tells Wemmbu that Egg is valuable and that he needs to kill Egg or he will get captured and it will end badly for everyone .  Wemmbu eventually agrees to work with this player to find Egg. The mysterious player asks Wemmbu if he has any idea where Egg could be. Wemmbu tells the player that he has an idea. The mysterious player tells Wemmbu that he needs to restock his orbitals as he anticipates they will get into a lot of fights. Both of them head to a town to get information about Egg, they begin to look for a player who is selling armor. A player named Wheatgust rings a bell bringing them to his shop. Wemmbu then asks wheatgust if he has any armor that he doesn't need. Wheatgust shakes his head yes and gives armor to Wemmbu and the mysterious player. The mysterious player gives Wheatgust diamond blocks and Wemmbu and him began walking all over town. Then, 
Yungyx
 and 3 guards appear in the town and start interrogating people about the whereabouts of Egg. Yungyx tells the players that 
Arachn1d
 really wants Egg, Wemmbu asks the mysterious player why he wants Egg and the mysterious player tells Wemmbu again that Egg is too valuable. Wemmbu heads to the pond where Yungyx and begins fishing, secretly listening to Yungyx's conversation with the other players.

After a few seconds of listening to Yungy's conversation, Wemmbu maces Yungy catching him by surprise. Wemmbu begins fighting Yungy and his guards when the town guards starting fighting Wemmbu. Wemmbu manages to kill Yungy's guards and makes Yungy'x flee. The town guards continue to fight Wemmbu while Yungy continues to flee. Wemmbu jumps off a bridge with his elyta and flies to Yungy, however the town guards continue to fight Wemmbu. Eventually ,Yungy flees leaving Wemmbu and the town guards alone. The town guards continue to fight Wemmbu, they eventually stop and Wemmbu leaves the town guards. Wemmbu comes back to the mysterious player who tells Wemmbu that he should have kept a low profile as everyone from the town left leaving them with no information. Wemmbu and the mysterious player head to Egg's fishing spot to find any clues about where Egg could be. They don't find anything and Wemmbu asks the player why Egg is so valuable in the first place. The mysterious player ignores Wemmbu and Wemmbu begins to leave when the player tells Wemmbu fine. The player tells Wemmbu that Arachn1d isn't the only one hunting Egg down and that the only reason why Arachn1d is hunting Egg is to control him. Wemmbu then asks the player why he knows that information about Arachn1d's plans. The player tells Wemmbu that Arachn1d payed him to capture Wemmbu alive and that many of his enemies will pay big to keep him alive. Wemmbu believes that the planted wheat seed is a clue and the mysterious player says "The Wheat Village". The player then tells Wemmbu that they is where Egg is, they head to the Wheat Kingdom in hope of finding Egg. They discover that the Wheat Kingdom has been destroyed and find a group of players in the destruction. 

A player writes on a sign saying "This invis guy kidnapped Egg", Wemmbu then tells the invisible player that he has Egg all this time. The mysterious player tells Wemmbu why would he be working with Wemmbu if he had already gotten Egg. Wemmbu then believes that the mace that he has is the one that he gave to 
FieldsOfElysium
. Wemmbu then tells the player that the deal is off and attacks the player with a stab shot, killing a player from the group in the process. Wemmbu then unleases an orbital strike on the wheat farms blowing up a big chunk of it. Wemmbu continues to fight the player for a long time, using another orbital strike on him. The mysterious player stasises away and Wemmbu meets up to the group of players. The group of players reveal that someone was with the invisble player, that someone was 
FlameFrags
. Wemmbu comes to FlameFrag's base to find two players guarding the entrance. Wemmbu orbitals them instantly killing them and heads into Flame's base. He finds Flame, Lomedy, and the invisible player and knows that they have Egg. Flame tells Wemmbu that he is forced as he is in 
Cindercrest
. Wemmbu asks Flame why he is working with the invisble player. Flame tells Wemmbu that if he cooperates Egg won't die. Wemmbu then unleashes an orbital strike on Flame's base and starts fighting Flame. Wemmbu and Flame continue to fight, with Wemmbu continuing to stab shot Flame. Flame tells 
Lomedy
 to kill Egg and Wemmbu rushes after Lomedy trying to stop him. Wemmbu discovers an obsidian box and realizes that the invisible player took Egg. Flame tells Wemmbu that it is Wemmbu's fault, Wemmbu asks Flame why was he working with the invisible guy. Flame tells Wemmbu that he was working with him because he is in Cindercrest. Flame tells Wemmbu that he was asking Egg questions and when he refused to answer any questions, he put him in an obsidian box.

Wemmbu and Flame begin sailing to 
Linnwyrm's
 base, and find that Linnwyrm is afk because he is getting doordash. Lynnworm returns and is greeted by Wemmbu and Flame, Wemmbu asks Linnworm if he has see Egg. Linnworm tells Wemmbu that he hasn't see Egg, Wemmbu asks Linn how did he know that he needed the armor that he is wearing. Linn tells Wemmbu that ever since the Law had came out of power that there have been many players stirring in the world. He wanted Wemmbu to be at full strength if anything came up. Wemmbu asks Linnwyrm if he knew about the mysterious trimmed player,Linn tells Wemmbu that he knows the mysterious player. Wemmbu and Flame gives the recap of his story with the mysterious player. Lynn reveals that he knows where the mysterious player's base is and tells Wemmbu that it's time to get looking. 
Jaden_MAN
 then appears to help and Linn tells Wemmbu and Flame that they need all the help they can get. Flame and Jaden start arguing with each other, they eventually agree to work with each other. Wemmbu, Flame, and Jaden begin looting up to prepare for the journey to the mysterious player's base. Wemmbu begins disenchanting a bunch of fishing rods and bows to get xp for his armor. Wemmbu asks Flame for totems, hesistant Flame eventually places a shulker box full of totems which Wemmbu quickly snatches. Wemmbu, Jaden, and Flame begin to head out of Linn's base just before Linn gives them a warning about how dangerous the player. They begin to head off when they realize they've never asked the coords to the base. Once they have the coords. they sail to find an enormous island which they presume is the player's base. They approach the island and find Yungyx and Arachn1d with three guards who tell them that they want Egg. They all head up the mysterious player's to see Egg, they find Egg and the mysterious player. 

Egg greets Wemmbu and Wemmbu aks Egg how he got in this situation. The mysterious player tells everyone that he has a proposition, he tells them that who ever pays him the most will be given Egg. Wemmbu asks the player what happened to him, killing Egg of the server. The mysterious player then puts Egg in a remote stasis chamber for his safety. Everyone starts arguing about their riches until Flame tells everyone he is on the behalf of Cindercrest. Wemmbu being surprised asks Flame why. Flame tells everyone that Cindercrest needs Egg's knowledge. Getting impatient, Wemmbu tells everyone that he will kill everyone there, he then unleashes an orbital strike bringing in a huge fight. Everyone starts fighting each other, Jaden and Wemmbu manage to kill two of Arachn1d's guards before unleashing another orbital strike. The huge fight continues wth Wemmbu only focusing Flame. Flame then brings a bunch of armored wolf's to the fight, Wemmbu then starts fighting Yungy. Wemmbu eventually goes back into the fight with everyone. Wemmbu and Yungy fly into a cave and start dueling when the invisible player and and Flame enter as well. Wemmbu and Flame continue to fight for a long time, Wemmbu then goes after Yungy, he then notices an intresting building in the cave. Wemmbu then goes invis to hide from everyone. He goes into the mysterious cave building and finds a maze, Wemmbu begins to go through it until he digs down. He finds nothing and continues to got though the maze almost going into a trap. He finds a dripstone trap and realizes he could use the dripstone. 

He manages to pop the invisible player's totem with the dripstone revealing his name which is Flbthp. He chases after Flbthp and finds Arachn1d, Jaden, and an invis guy (possibly still Flbthp) in a big room. The invis guy tells them to wait for the representative for Cindercrest, Flame and Yungy both arrive and the mysterious player tells everyone he is willing to negotiate. Arachn1d tells the mysterious player that he will give him, the entire treasure of the caverns. The mysterious player accepts his offer and expects the offer to be true. Wemmbu asks Yungy and Arachn1d, why they want Egg so badly, Yungy tells Wemmbu that with Egg, they have him and with him they have a bunch of power which will allow for Arachn1d to be the rightful king. Yungy then tells Wemmbu that with him on their side they will win a lot of battles in the future.  The episode ends off with Yungy giving Wemmbu an ultimatum, join him in the caves or they will kill Egg.



Trivia


There was a moment in this video where Wemmbu was in creative mode.

title: Searching for 100 Players Who Went Missing
content:
Searching for 100 Players Who Went Missing














Episode


123






Upload date


Mar 25, 2026






POV


SpokeIsHere






Arcs


NULL






Featured Creators (Description)


JumperWho
TheobaldTheBird
ParrotX2
Mapicc
















Thousands of players have joined the Unstable SMP, but a small portion of those players have mysteriously disappeared, including my 
best friend.
 After finding out no one else was willing to solve this, I along with my teammate, JumperWho, made it our mission to find the missing players and hopefully reunite with my long lost friend...





Searching for 100 Players Who Went Missing
 is the 123rd episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


On the Unstable SMP, thousands of players are online concurrently, but a small percent of these players have disappeared within the past month. Most players don't seem to notice the disappearances, as death bans are super common, but 
Spoke
 thinks it may be something much more sinister going on. A case of this happening was his best friend 
Mapicc
, who went missing a month ago after spending years on Unstable. Spoke went on a search for him, which turned into a mission that unraveled one of the biggest mysteries on the server. Spoke goes on to recap what happened in the 
previous episode
 and the episode begins where it left off.

Spoke picks up the 
mission: null
 book and goes through the pages, which have usernames and coordinates linked to that player. He gives it to 
JumperWho
, neither of them know what it means. Jumper goes through the hundred pages to see if she recognizes a name, Spoke sees the bounty hunters coming from a distance and tells Jumper to invis up and run into the house. Both of them hide on top of lanterns just as the hunters barge inside the house and begin destroying it. A nether portal spawns nearby, another leader of 
the bounty hunters
 named 
_x_6_00
 comes through and gives the hunters extra resources. The leader builds a grave and goes back through the portal, the hunters then spread out and walk away. Once the coast is clear, Spoke and Jumper jump down from their hiding spot and go over to the grave and break the block underneath the wither rose. A chest appears under and there's a book signed by the leader, Spoke takes the book and reads it. It reads as following:

"
I know you stole it.


It doesn't belong to you.


Surrender and return what is ours.


Now, rebuild the portal.
"

Spoke gets scared at the fact that the leader knew he was going to break the portal, so they run towards a direction he knew the hunters didn't go. He mentions that some of the coordinates were close by and suggests that they should investigate in case this could have any leads on Mapicc's whereabouts. The first set of coordinates leads them to a house built out of cherry blossom wood, Jumper finds a dog left abandoned inside of the house, which confirms their theory that these players have gone missing. They begin heading over to another set of coordinates, they spot a nether portals in their path, signifying that the hunters are traveling through the nether to watch them. Spoke makes an escape tunnel in the nearby area because of this. Once Spoke builds the hole, they walk to the next set of coordinates and spots a player named Cornflakecapt4in living there. Spoke asks Cornflake if they've seen someone named Calvin6 and they say that Calvin was their teammate that went missing after he went out to get an enchantment table. Jumper goes through the book again and sees that Cornflake's name is also in the book at the exact same coordinates of Calvin, Spoke suggests that Cornflake should escape quickly. Cornflakes immediately starts digging into the ground. They see a nether portal spawn on a mountain close by, the hunters start attacking Spoke and Jumper, who barely have any resources to survive. Spoke has no more food or blocks, Jumper tells him that they need to run right then and now to one of their escape tunnels. Spoke doesn't have enough resources to get there, so he gets up on a mountain and gets invisibility from his ender chest. He goes back over to the base and rescues Jumper. 

A chase breaks out, Spoke spots another base in the distance and hides full invis in it. He hides on the outsides of the base and sees a boat placed on the ice. He doesn't know where Jumper is, so he has no way of contacting her and telling her to meet him over at the boat, but Jumper is already in the boat and spins around in it, showing Spoke that she was there first. The leader chases them, who drifts into a tree, giving them a bigger lead. When they get in water, the hunters are already all on boats and continue to chase. The hunters attempt to sink Spoke and Jumper's boat, Spoke tries to shoot and break their boats, but fails to. With no other option, they head back on land and continue heading towards the direction of Spoke's escape tunnel. Spoke towers upwards, but gets knocked off. He sees Jumper as soon as he falls and they start running again, the escape tunnel is right in front of them, Spoke breaks a melon and exposes the hole. He looks down and sees that there's not water down to bedrock and realizes the hunters broke the bedrock and turned it into a void trap. Spoke uses his Elytra and flies down slowly, he asks Jumper to drop rockets for him. The hunters have blocked off the entrance, Jumper makes up a plan real quick, she realizes the people are in the book for a reason and they're all trappers, so the coordinates in the book could have a void trap as well. The first set of coordinates have nothing, so they quickly go over to the next. As they continue to fly, Spoke's Elyta's durability wears down and is close to breaking until they spot something in the void. It's a happy ghast floating in the void with five players stuck on it. Jumper flies up and breaks the obsidian, she places water, but it doesn't flow down as blocks don't go beneath bedrock. Spoke steps up and pearls up, going through the obsidian entirely and breaks it. After Spoke gets up, he gets Jumper to get a saddle so they can all ride the happy ghast upwards, but because there's more than four of them, he asks if any of them were willing to jump and one of them jumps into the void. Spoke gives one of the players a pearl and they pearl up, Jumper then puts the saddle on the happy ghast and flies it upwards so the rest of them can swim up. As soon as they all make it up safely, Jumper gives them signs and asks what happened. One of them writes that they were trapped by someone named MisterMinion, who was the name in the book and were stuck down there for over three months. Spoke and Jumper leave them to be and lets them keep the base and leaves.

Jumper says she was right about NULL targeting bad players. Spoke says what they know about NULL is that they're ruthless and that they kill people, random people, friends, griefers, and it's more about their actions that affects players all around the server. Spoke says they need more help finding out what's going on. Spoke thinks that there's one player that could help them rally up players together, Jumper asks who he has in mind and Spoke says they need to go to spawn to visit the 
king
. They head to the front of the 
Northern Council
, Spoke nicely asks the guards to let them see the king, but they nod their heads no. One of them blows a horn, Spoke thinks they should start going full invis and sneaking in, just as he says that, Jumper sees 
TheobaldTheBird
 walking out of the Northern Council to see what they want. Spoke says they need to see the king, Theo doesn't allow to let them through without any reason, Spoke places down his ender chest and says he has goodies, which piques Theo's interest. Theo makes them pay two totems as down payment to walk foot inside the Northern Council and two pieces of netherite when they're at the front of the castle. Spoke says he does have netherite to give Theo and gives him directions to where it is, Theo writes it down in a book and quill, Spoke and Jumper run past him while he's distracted. Theo catches up to them and asks for his tip, Spoke gives him a stack of TNT. The three of them walk up to where Parrot is, Theo tells Parrot that Spoke and Jumper were there to visit and forces them to bow. Parrot stops Theo since they're his friends and asks how they've been. Spoke cuts to the chase, he asks Parrot if he knows anything about NULL. He explains Parrot what NULL has been doing and that players have gone missing inside of the book they got their hands on. Parrot says he has gotten zero reports about any player disappearances and that most of the coordinates inside of the book were inside of his kingdom. Parrot goes on to say this is the first time he's heard of this and he would've known if players were actually going missing. Jumper begins to explain how everybody in the book is theorized to be players who are trappers, griefers, scammers, bad people overall. Parrot says all of the people that have disappeared are bad and NULL is doing more good for his kingdom than bad. He doesn't believe NULL is a real thing, but rather that they're using him to find Mapicc and is willing to give them resources to find him and that NULL isn't a top priority for him. Spoke crashes out and says he's the king and that he should be worried about a mysterious group of players terrorizing his kingdom. In the end, Parrot tells them he doesn't have a lot of resources and gives them as much as he can. 

Spoke, Jumper, and five guards walk down the obsidian highway. Spoke asks Jumper if she has anybody they can ask for help, as Jumper answers, Spoke sees a nether portal on top of a lava cast and senses that something is wrong. The bounty hunters break out of the walls and instantly kill Parrot's guards. Another chase breaks out, Spoke and Jumper desperately try to boat away, but the bounty hunters are constantly on their tail. Spoke tries the tree strat again by hiding in a tree, but the hunters spot him. Spoke then wind charges up a lava cast and towers up, Jumper follows shortly after. Jumper accidentally misclicks and that causes them both to get knocked down. They make it back on ice, Spoke boats away, but gets stuck in a pothole. The hunters catch up, Spoke swims down into the water and digs into a cave and wind charges out, successfully juking out most of the hunters. He reaches the top of the tower again, he pearls away and pretends to get knocked off to distract the hunters. He spots Jumper in the distance and goes full invis in a boat to go save her. Spoke fails to boat away and sees another cave in the distance. He gets Jumper to follow him into the cave, the hunters come following and Spoke hides right below a waterfall and jukes the hunters again. He then uses this opportunity to make an escape tunnel. He climbs out of the tunnel and signals Jumper to pearl to him, they both jump down the tunnel, Spoke drains the water and places a dripstone where the water was, popping four of the hunter's totems and making them teleport. They go into crawl mode and begin to dig away, the hunters catch up, but end up losing their trail. 

As they surface, Spoke says they're back at square one and without the regear Parrot gave them, they would've died. He mentions how there's so much going on in the server for players to care and that just the two of them aren't enough to stop it all. Spoke says they only have one more option, and that's to use 
Jumper's spies
. Jumper dislikes the idea of using her spies and reminds him of the spies' actual purpose and that if they do go through with this plan, they would essentially be declaring war on NULL. They then decide to go to the last remaining set of coordinates to find any clues on Mapicc. The last house appears to be another regular house, Spoke looks around on the outside and sees there's a part of the house hidden somewhere and stumbles across a hidden passageway inside of the chimney hiding behind a painting. Inside of the secret room is random loot and a book hidden in an item frame named "
road to null
" signed by anticsparty06, a different player who isn't shown in the mission: null book. Spoke begins reading the book, it reveals that Antics hasn't left their base in weeks because 
they
 would find him and this time he doesn't think he would escape. Antics joined Unstable with the intent of building farm with friends and creating a factory to give new players gear in order to survive and wanted to be remembered as a good player. Antics starts to talk about NULL, they came rummaging the base and forced him to march for tens of thousands of blocks to a mountain, where a pearl cannon was built and was said to teleport them to the Road of Null. Antics never got to see where it lead, he attempted to offset the cannon and send his pearl elsewhere. Right before he was killed, his pearl landed in the middle of the 
Far Lands
. He was able to reach the border to find food and resources to build a pearl cannon of his own. He says NULL has been relentlessly hunting and watching him and asks for whoever found the book to come save them and gives them a set of coordinates; 50,000 in each direction. Spoke thinks this may lead to the coordinates of the pearl cannon and this is their only chance of saving the missing players as well as Mapicc. Spoke says they have to go into this world and makes a plan to gather up the spies while NULL is distracted. Spoke goes in one direction and Jumper goes towards another, before they set off, Jumper tells Spoke to give them a choice to come join them.

They get ahold of fourteen more spies and they all fly towards the pearl cannon using happy ghasts. Just as they reach the pearl cannon, another set of happy ghasts come flying from the other side of the mountain. NULL had gotten there at the same time and begin shooting arrows at the spies. Spoke comes up with a plan, goes full invis and jumps down. He walks to the pearl cannon and throws a pearl into it. The leader sees it being activated and blows the cannon up, and the hunters kill off Jumper's spies, causing Spoke and Jumper to retreat. Jumper sounds defeated at the fact that she brought her spies into war when she promised to keep them safe from any kind of conflict. They had lost the last players that could help them and with no pearl cannon to get to where they need to go. They head back to Spoke's hidden base from the previous episode, a lamp goes off signaling that someone is at the entrance and Jumper goes to see who it is. She comes back and tells Spoke someone is at the door and doesn't know who it is. Spoke comes up to the entrance and sees an invisible player with a copper helmet, diamond chestplate, copper leggings, and iron boots. The invisible player drinks milk and it is revealed to be Mapicc.



Trivia


The coordinates 50k, 50k is the exact same coordinates that Wemmbu used for his griefing services back in Season 1 in the episode, 
Why I Destroyed the Unstable SMP
.


At 1:00:07 you can see "Kill Spoke" on the frozen river.

title: Searching for a Civilization that Doesn't Exist
content:
Searching for a Civilization that Doesn't Exist














Episode


125






Upload date


Apr 14, 2026






POV


ParrotX2






Featured Creators (Description)


TheobaldTheBird














As King of the Unstable SMP, I recently sent 1000 players on an expedition outside of my kingdom. When I returned, all of them were missing. This is searching for a civilization that doesn't exist.





Searching for a Civilization that Doesn't Exist
 is the 125th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


As the king of Unstable, 
Parrot
 sent a group of players over a hundred thousand blocks out on an expedition. He made it their mission to build a civilization in this unexplored territory and determine if it was safe for the players inside of his kingdom to stay in. He gives them a week's time and promises to return by then to deliver more supplies. When the time comes, he makes the journey back to the civilization, which was given the name Skymore, to see that all thousand players had vanished. Parrot, 
Theo
, and a few guards look around for any signs of life and are skeptical of what happened. Parrot holds an emergency meeting with his guards and instructs them to search around the area, and so they all split off. Parrot and Theo stay together and investigate the civilization itself, as even Parrot has never seen anything like this before, Theo notices that the houses were unfinished and says he doesn't have a good feeling about this. Everything was still intact, it wasn't looted or griefed, it all happened all at once. After thirty minutes of searching, Parrot finds a sign inside of a house that tells a player named 
Reina
 that they had to run and to follow the farmland. They go down to the farmland, and Parrot notices that there's a pattern in the farmland and builds up, revealing a message written in morse code using dirt. Parrot deciphers it and it reads out, "
I RAN EAST, -
ZOE
". This gives them a clue of where to go next and figure out what actually happened. As Parrot was about to blow his horn to signal all his guards to return, 
Cachetale
 goes up to him and says he heard the horn, but Parrot says he hadn't. Parrot blows the actual horn this time and runs around the civilization, but only five out of the twenty guards returned. Parrot and his squad gets on their horses and heads east to see where the rest of the squad went, they overhear the same horn being blown and decide to keep going near it. Parrot discovers a secret stairway beneath a layer of dirt and wants to go deeper in, but the rest of his squad is too afraid to follow along. Parrot takes Theo along and tells whoever was down there to come out, but once they reached the bottom, all they found were  chests full of his squad's loot, implying that they died. Once they came back up, they see that even the ones who stayed above went missing as well.

Theo gets frustrated that Parrot keeps blowing the horn and revealing their locations, but Parrot says they have a clue to keep going and needs to figure out if these people are even alive still. They keep heading eastwards, but the more they headed east, the lesser the territory has been explored and won't know what to expect heading forward. They spot a town up ahead and go talk to the players inside of it, but none of them talk to them or really acknowledge them. Parrot goes around the town and finds a wall full of usernames, he spots the name zoe444 on the wall and thinks it could be the same person they're looking for. A person named capybaradunk comes from behind and asks if they know someone named Zoe and Parrot explains that they've been looking for someone named Zoe, capybara brings them into a house to talk. Theo asks what the signs are about, capybara goes on to explain how the town was created by new players who just logged on and and twenty people went out to go get food, but never returned. Parrot says the same thing happened to his civilization and that Zoe may have showed up at this town, capybara says Zoe was here and asked weird questions and acted strange before heading off. Parrot keeps asking if she left any clues behind, capybara says she did leave a message specifically for Reina only, Parrot kept asking for the message, so capybara gives it to him. Parrot reads the book and it ends up being another cipher. Parrot says they'll begin heading off, 
capybara
 is afraid they'd go missing too and begs for them to stay. Parrot and Theo still decide to go to figure out what's going on. Parrot knows that this part of the world was strange and that somebody or a group of players were up to this and were smarter and stronger than the average player and even Zoe knew that, hence why she left clues rather than being blunt. 

Parrot tells Theo that he tried to decipher it with no clues, however, this was a lie to mislead anybody that may be listening onto them and reveals that the actual clue wasn't the jumbled letters at the bottom of the book, but rather the first letters of each word which spelt out "
Find the white flowers
". Parrot and Theo ride their horses more east and follows the white flowers as said. After another 2,500 blocks they stumble across a camp of some sort. As they get closer, it seems to be deserted. On the tents they see a banner pattern that they've never seen before, one that resembles some kind of flame. Parrot overhears somebody digging dirt beneath them, Theo thinks Parrot is joking, but Parrot insists he heard it and decides to go back to their horses. Unfortunately for them, when they returned to where they parked their horses, they were stolen or vanished. Parrot finds it odd that if these players wanted to kill them, why go for their horses? Parrot writes inside of a book for Theo, he tells Theo that whoever these players are wants to think they ran out of resources and asks Theo to pretend to be out of food. Parrot believes that this would be enough to reveal whoever's been following them. In the desert, they find a ruin out in the middle of nowhere. It left no clues, so they move along. As they keep walking, they spot a random bed with a chest and a furnace, inside of the chest lies a book and quill. Parrot opens it and finds that it's another message written by Zoe, this time being a caesar cipher that tells Reina to head south from here. This message felt off to Parrot since this message was more simpler than before and that Zoe would've put a white flower inside of the chest to show that it was actually her that wrote it. Parrot decides to set up a farm and leave some items in the chest as bait for whoever's been following them. He pretends to explore around the desert to give the players enough time to hijack their items. As they come back, they see that their crops have been taken and most items in the chest. However, the book that Zoe had supposedly written was still there and they would've had every reason to take it, this reveals that this book was in fact fake. 

Parrot and Theo keep pushing east, following the white flowers that were placed every now and then. Parrot and Theo walk further into the forest, which brought them closer to where Zoe is. Eventually, they actually do run low on food and resort to towering up using the spruce saplings. Shortly after, they hear the horn being blown again. Parrot's plan was to wait for them to attack and fight back in order to detain and question the players. Worst case scenario, they would run away knowing who was after them. The people keep blowing the horn instead of attacking until it stops. A chest opens beneath them, Parrot breaks blocks and opens up the chest, which has two maps inside of it. Both of them take one each and see two icons forward and behind them, Parrot goes to chase the one upwards while Theo goes to the one behind. Before Parrot could continue chasing, he realizes something and goes back to Theo and tells him to stop. He explains to Theo that everything they've gone through, the players following them stopped whenever they heard Theo. They took everything from them, their teammates, their food, their horses, but never laid their fingers on Parrot or Theo. The map was their way of trying to separate the two and was afraid of Theo. Parrot has a plan and writes it in a book and gives it to Theo. Theo says this plan is stupid and doesn't want to follow Parrot around anymore and he decides to head back. 

Parrot follows the flowers and sees that it starts to become more common to see them as the horns follow him around. Eventually, he sees a house that's surrounded by white flowers for hundreds of blocks all around it and goes to investigate. He finds a book written by Zoe, it explains that something existed out there and anyone who left the civilization would never return, the survivors decided to call this entity "the monster". After two days, they were attacked by this so-called monster, which turned out to be a kingdom of players far stronger than they were. The survivors ended up relocating to this other kingdom named Cindercrest, which was a kingdom full of old players. Few of the survivors died from starvation, natural causes, or in attempts of escaping, which left only Zoe and her friend Reina. One day, Reina asked Zoe a question about the world being infinite and that made Zoe realize there was something wrong about the world, but didn't know what exactly. Zoe and Reina eavesdrop on two of the players conversation about taking back spawn. One of the players, 
saparata
, hears Zoe talking and that leads to Zoe running away before they executed them. Zoe ran back to Skymore since that was the only place she knew on the server and started to leave clues for Reina to find her. At the end of the book, Zoe says if Reina is the one that is reading it, she had mostly unfortunately starved to death and to answer the question she was asking herself.

As soon as Parrot finishes reading the book, the horn is blown and 
ShoeBilly
 stands at the front of the house. Parrot says that ShoeBilly has been the one terrorizing all these players and is going to declare war on his kingdom, Billy says to not blame him and he's only working for the highest bidder. Parrot gets angry that Billy took the lives of a thousand player, robbing them of a chance of playing on the server again. He asks Billy if he felt any remorse for killing any of them, Billy says not at all and that the only the strong are meant to survive and the only way to survive is to be a little bit selfish. Billy gets ready to kill Parrot and asks for his last words, Parrot yells for Theo to strike and he sets off a bunch of TNT minecarts that kill off the members of Cindercrest standing behind. A flashback plays to when Parrot wrote the plan in the book, he had Theo fake a reaction of an outrageous plan and to tail behind using the map. Theo holds Billy back as Parrot runs back to Skymore. Parrot stands up top on a castle at Skymore, Theo arrives looking roughed up and in full diamond armor rather than his usual netherite. Right before they head back, they see somebody running into the civilization. They go up to the player and see that it's Reina, she asks Parrot if he knows where Zoe is and Parrot gives her the book Zoe wrote. Parrot apologizes and says how he wanted to build this civilization to protect everyone. He looks at Theo and says they need to put an end to Cindercrest before they try to take back spawn. Theo says it's not possible and that he's even afraid of Billy, Parrot says he trusts Theo's judgement for saving his life countless amounts of times and decides not to jump right into a war. Parrot says they need to warn the rest of the server about Cindercrest a war actually breaks out. Reina steps up and says if Cindercrest never existed, she wouldn't have died and wants to help them fight. Parrot allows her to join them and the three of them head back to spawn.



Trivia


This episode referenced 
Wifies
' popular "Searching for a World that doesn't exist" ARG video multiple times with the title, the thumbnail, and Parrot claiming himself The King in Yellow in the video as well. The mysterious civilization that follows them behave like The King.

Wifies even commented on the video: Whatever you do at Skymore, keep going east ... 
Old Thumbnail


The horn that Parrot blew is the same as the one to call together 
JumperWho's spies
.

You should know the most out of anyone, that only the strong are meant to survive. And on Unstable, the only way to survive is to be a little bit selfish.



ShoeBilly_
 to

, 
Searching for a Civilization that Doesn't Exist


ShoeBilly_
 is an major antagonist in 
Unstable Universe
 
Season 3
. He is a bounty hunter in 
I Exposed a Corrupt Minecraft Civilization
. Billy is hired to kill 
TheobaldTheBird
 and 
ParrotX2
, but fails to do so. Billy is formally Theo's master/teacher, but even after training with Theo for months, Shoe is many times more advanced, especially at elytra-
macing
. 



Personality


ShoeBilly_ has been shown to be sadistic and spiteful to the server's new players, placing him firmly on the side of the old ones. Billy craves power and has no qualms about killing people to increase his own personal strength and influence. The danger Billy poses is further tempered by his confidence and PVP ability.



History


Shoebilly joins 
Capital City police
 and attacks 
Parrot
 and 
TheoBaldTheBird
. After a confrontation with Theo he retreats but also tells him that Parrot is using him and tries to convince him that the server is falling apart because of the new players. He later destroys a building with hundreds of new players inside. He plans a massacre in Captial City but the plot is foiled and he retreats to 
CinderCrest


CinderCrest
 hires him to destroy King Parrot's experimental civilization of 
Skymore.
 The civilization is easily overrun and without any mercy Shoebilly enacts yet another massacre this time killing almost 1000 players (The massacre is of the same level as the one Wemmbu and Flamefrags did in the 
2v1000
 but since the servers population has increased so much it does not affect the server in the same way) He then hunts down Parrot and attempts to separate him from Theo. (He probably does not want to fight Theo because of their past affiliation and how strong Theo is at PVP) Parrot finally confronts him after reading Zoe's story and asks him if he feels any remorse. Shoebilly says he feels none at all and tells Parrot that only the strong are meant to survive which reminds Parrot of old memories with 
Ashswagg
 but is forced into a confrontation with Theo. After a very hard-fought battle Shoebilly is forced to retreat but he appears to have broken all of 
Theo's
 netherite armour.

Billy helps CinderCrest attack Parrot's kingdom and was a big help in CinderCrest's victory over 
Fort Feather
. During the 
Merchant City
 battle he maces people until CinderCrest is forced to retreat. During the battle at 
Highwater City
 he attempts to destroy the arrow cannon stopping the CiderCrest army from advancing but was forced to retreat when the second arrow cannon, this on pointed at the sky, was shot at him. Flamefrags eventually utilizes a distraction to destroy the second arrow cannon allowing Billy to destroy the first. 
Arachn1d's team
 eventually shows up with 
Wemmbu
 and allows CinderCrest the victory despite their previous very low numbers. 



Trivia


It is revealed that ShoeBilly_ wields one of the only maces.


ShoeBilly_’s skin is a shoebill stork, a type of large predatory bird. This makes him a candidate for the biggest bird.


ShoeBilly once trained 
TheobaldTheBird
. (citation needed)


ShoeBilly said Theo and Billy are like each other (possibly insinuating that both of them are killers at heart).

1
]


The last time Billy met with Theo was in 
the farlands
[
2
]


ShoeBilly could have had reach or enlarged Hitboxes in the script as Billy seems to land even the hardest mace hits on Theo when Billy is in F5.


Billy doesn't know much about the personal relationship/history between Theo and 
Parrot
, stating Parrot would just leave him if he was a slight inconvenience
[
3
]


ShoeBilly_ has frequently exhibited symptoms of the mental condition psychosis, evidenced by his enthusiasm regarding his own crimes and generally murderous attitude.


ShoeBilly_'s in-game character and his voice is played by lahdoh.

title: Skill vs Power Arc
content:
*This episode is not a part of any arc, but is included here for comprehension purposes*
 
FlameFrags
 gets recruited by his friend 
Lomedy
 to help deal with 
Spongs
 and 
Willsion
, who've been harassing him and destroying his farm, but without any violence. After Spongs and Willie show up, Flame builds traps that nearly kill them. Flame sneaks onto their farm and steals their prized sniffer egg, so in retaliation they blow up most of Lomedy's farm. Flame helps Lomedy rebuild, and then they go and blow up the entirety of Spongs' and Willie's. Flame lets them live, though.

Flame gets tasked by an invis player to perform a number of tasks. He receives small rewards from each one, with the last task being to kill a group of bandits that actually put up a fight. The invis player is revealed as 
SpokeIsHere
, and he gives Flame a book with coords to an old 
Mafia
 stash. Flame goes there and finds a few shulkers of items before being attacked by 
Wemmbu
. Wemmbu calls down orbital cannon strikes on Flame, popping over a dozen of his totems, destroying his restock shulkers, and breaking his eye trim chestplate. In the end, Flame is forced to flee, having lost his title as the strongest player.

Flame returns to his old base, but finds it occupied by bandits. He kills some people for gear, then gets 
Lomedy
 to build him a new base, and then visits the Nether, which is ruled by 
ClownPierce
. Some of his minions attack, but Flame escapes them. Finally ready for a rematch, he heads to 
Capital City 2.0
 to get info on Wemmbu, only to be told Wemmbu is dead.

When pressed, that person tells Flame he got the info from 
Luke4472
. Flame finds Luke's base destroyed by the same bandits he fought for Spoke, and goes to their base, but finds no one. He finds some explorers and forces them to tell him where the other bandit bases are, and successfully finds and frees Luke. Luke tells him he heard it from 
MinuteTech
, so they go to the End. Flame fights Minute for the information, and Minute finally surrenders, only to once again tell Flame that Wemmbu is dead. Flame returns to his base, out of leads, only for 
Boosfer
 to show up with information on Wemmbu.

Boosfer makes Flame go get ender pearls from Capital City, and then protect him from an attack led by an invis player. Boosfer sends Flame to steal 
ParrotX2's
 helmet, since his broke, but Boosfer calls it invalid due to the bad enchantments. Flame finally decides to kill him if he doesn't give up the info, but then the invis player shows up again wit about twenty people. Flame kills most of them despite struggling, but the invis player convinces him that Boosfer doesn't actually have the information, and they should just kill him. Boosfer escapes, but not before telling Flame that ClownPierce is the one who killed Wemmbu.

Flame enters the Nether and finds Parrot and 
TheobaldTheBird
, who convince him they should team up, since both need access to Clown's castle. Flame and Theo sneak inside and fight 
FerreMC
, Clown's second-in-command, and kidnap him. Parrot, however, lets him go as part of his plan to find Clown's secret vault, which Flame doesn't care about. He overhears Parrot and Theo planning to betray him and goes to Clown, offering to bring him to Parrot if he talks about Wemmbu. Clown agrees, but fails to hold up his end of the bargain, so Flame kills every single one of his guards, then leaves. With all of his leads at an end, he visits Parrot in Capital City and hires him to find Wemmbu.

LettuceK
 shows up to Flame's base and invites him to 
Law City
, offering him the chance to either surrender or be captured in three days. Flame recruits Lomedy to help him prepare, and they sneak into Law City, learning that a shipment of gear is arriving soon. Flame kills the people bringing it, angering Lomedy, who is only partially satisfied by Flame's explanations. Flame decides to attack Law City early, but Lettuce brings about fifty people to fight him. After a very long battle, Flame kills almost all the people and leaves.

Parrot orchestrates a trap for Wemmbu, which works perfectly, revealing his identity. He and Flame start to fight, but 
The Law
 show up, necessitating an escape. Flame and Wemmbu alternate between fighting each other and the Law before finally running far away, all the way to Flame's base to regear, planning to kill the Law and then each other. The Law shows up and Flame and Wemmbu kill all fifty or so people there, forcing Lettuce to flee. They follow him back to his city, but he reveals that even if they kill him, the Law won't stop. Wemmbu offers a fight between the two of them and every single Law member, to which Lettuce agrees.

Lettuce brings a thousand people, and Flame and Wemmbu fight them all. Constantly struggling, Flame is convinced by Wemmbu to pick up a mace someone dropped, which he does, increasing his effectiveness. They eventually manage to kill every single player. Flame burns the mace and attacks Wemmbu, and they fight for a while before Wemmbu gives up the title of the strongest player, no longer caring. They depart on relatively good terms.

content:
Skyblock Civilization














Alias


Sky Civilization
Skyblock Civilization






Status

The Invisible Mafia
)






Info




Enemies


The Invisible Mafia








Members

Yeah Jaron
Members:
Wemmbu
Pangi
Wato1876
Straight
loppezz
Arcn
LettuceK
Naparizel
Horace_Altman
DumbIsDumb








Appearances




Appears in


*
I Discovered a Minecraft Sky Civilization






Debut


I Discovered a Minecraft Sky Civilization








Skyblock Civilization
 was a civilization created by 
Yeah_Jaron
, before being conquered by 
The Invisible Mafia
. 



History


Wemmbu
 sees a couple of players flying up. He decides to follow them and find the Skyblock Civilization. He finds a player named 
Pangi
 who brings him to Yeah_Jaron, their leader. He says that he has to be a citizen or die. Wemmbu tries to escape, but is caught by 
Straight
. Wemmbu is forced to do tasks.

Wemmbu and Straight fight in a sumo duel which decides if Wemmbu is let free or not. Wemmbu loses the sumo fight. Wemmbu does more tasks for the civilization. Wemmbu spies on the members talking about himself in the castle. 

When asked how Wemmbu found the civilization, he says that he just saw people flying up. They go down to see what Wemmbu was talking about. Once down, the Mafia finds and begins attacking them. They are able to kill two of the members, but the third member escapes. They go back to skyblock civilization, and Wemmbu smuggles in an ender chest.

While helping Pangi with building a drowned farm, Wemmbu messages 
loppezz
 to come over and distract him. While distracted, Wemmbu and 
Wato1876
 go to the storage and see they have materials not normally possible to obtain in normal Minecraft skyblock. Wemmbu convinces some of the members to distract Pangi and says it’s his birthday. Straight finds Wemmbu at the back of Yeah_Jaron's castle. Wemmbu says he was building an extra part to the castle. He goes into the castle. He spies on Yeah_Jaron and Straight having a conversation.

Wemmbu talks to Straight about how there are tons of items not normally obtainable in skyblock that they have.

The civilization uses an ender pearl to go down to the normal world. They go over to 
The End Civilization
 which has been raided by the Mafia. Wemmbu and the members of the Skyblock Civilization pretend to be one of the Mafia members. Their invisibility runs out and they start getting killed. The Mafia members escape.

They go over to 
Capital City
 and find more Mafia members, and another fight breaks out. They are able to escape from them.

Yeah_Jaron tells Wemmbu that there is a traitor. Jaron gives him a mace. Wemmbu exposes Yeah_Jaron for having items you are not normally able to get in skyblock, and says he is just trying to control the players. Wemmbu leaves the meeting. He sees that Straight has been with the Mafia the entire time. The Mafia takes over the civilization.



Trivia


According to Yeah_Jaron, the Skyblock Civilization was one year old.

Searching for a Civilization that Doesn't Exist








The 
Skymore Civilization
 was a failed civilization created somewhat far out from spawn by 
Parrot
, the king of the Unstable SMP. It was probably meant to solve the overpopulation crisis at Spawn, the Northern Council, and Capital City. 



History


The civilization was meant as a safe haven for the new players who have been getting attacked by older ones. ParrotX2 brings 1000 players there, promising to return in a week with supplies while they set up the civilization. However, when he returns, the civilization is abandoned. there is no clear cause as to why it is abandoned, but there is a sign from a player named Zoe to her friend, Reina. Later, we find out that this is a player named 
zoe444
 who escaped from the 
Cindercrest
 nation, leaving clues for her friend 
ReinaDrop
 to find. 999 of the original players have been killed by ShoeBilly and Cindercrest including Zoe, with the sole survivor being ReinaDrop. When the Cindercrest nation attacked Skymore, 990 players were killed with 10 being taken hostage. Soon, 8 more died, leaving only Zoe, who escaped after being scared by 
Saparata
 but died of starvation, and Reina, who is now traveling with ParrotX2 and 
TheobaldTheBird
 to defeat the Cindercrest nation.

Later we find that 
ShoeBilly
, a renowned assassin, slowly killed all 1000 players when they went on expeditions for food. The only survivors of Skymore were Zoe and Reina who were forced to grow wheat for Cindercrest.

Spawn
 is the server spawn of 
Unstable SMP
. It is a key central hub where players begin their journeys and interact with the server's evolving dynamics. Known for its semi-neutral status, Spawn has become a focal point of activity and strategy. Spawn's history is divided into 5 moments currently, each being more or less deadly than the other.





History


Wemmbu
, 
SpokeIsHere
 and 
ParrotX2
 all built houses in spawn.

The 
Zam Empire
 started taking over the spawn area by building a small village and building a giant statue of 
PrinceZam
. 
Wemmbu
 and 
eggchan
 blew up the statue of PrinceZam.

Spawn was torn down by 
The Invisible Mafia
 to create a giant prison to force new players to join the Mafia. The prison was designed by 
_Kenadian_
. Parrot, Wemmbu, eggchan, 
Mapicc
, and Spoke broke into the prison to find where pearls are transported to destroy the Mafia.

Spawn was griefed by the players, leaving behind massive lavacasts, exploded terrain, and withers. There were obsidian highways leading players out of spawn, one leading to 
Capital City
.

The withers in spawn were killed by 
ParrotX2
 and 
TheobaldTheBird
. Soon later rebuilt by 
Horace_Altman
 and his team to help make spawn a safer place for new players by making a main castle where they would spawn in, including a village in the surrounding area. With a path leading to Capital City. As well as a player who would handout 16 pieces of cooked chicken to new players whenever they would go downstairs from the initial spawn room.

Netherite Spear
 
 


The 
spear
 is a weapon that deals more damage the faster you move relative to your enemies. When they were first introduced to the 
Unstable Universe
, they were extremely over-powered due to the fact that players were using modified spears that would deal significantly higher damage than the normal version. However, after the events of 
I Got Trained By a Minecraft Spear Master
, modified spears ceased to exist.

They are frequently used by players to travel and paired alongside the 
mace
 for spear-mace combat, a form of combat that utilizes the spear's 
Lunge
 enchantment to move across short distances in a sort of "dash."

The Spider Web Faction I, who is a pretender to the throne, says that he should be the rightful king. Though initially irrelevant, the Arachnid kingdom poses a threat led by

. They serve as the secondary antagonists in 
the Kingdoms Saga.
 The faction was created by Arachn1da, a great threat to

 and has also allied with

orbital strike cannon

Structure


Leadership


Arachn1d is the leader of the Spider Web Faction, alongside with yungyx (A Commander) and Wemmbu (Second in command, albeit unwillingly).



Hierarchy


Different ranks hold different shields. Bottom Feeders and Citizens hold the same black and white pattern shields, but Citizens have Unbreaking III on theirs, while Bottom Feeders' shields remain unenchanted. Royalties hold the same pattern but with a purple horizontal beam across the shield. The leader, arachn1d, holds the same pattern but a fully red version.

Their civilization works in similar ways to the 
Invisible Mafia
 like how there is a ranking system. It has about 50 or so royals and the majority of its players are citizens and some unlucky ones are Bottom Feeders.   

Bottom Feeders have to work in the mines to help the kingdom get resources. The mines are dangerous as they are almost directly near a skulk biome. 



Ranking




Location


The location of the kingdom is in a snowy mountain. It's main base is completely dark and citizens get night vision potions for free.  Because of its location it also near an Skulk biome which can prove deadly some times as wardens can spawn.

Where were you during 
the Mafia
? We could have wiped them out in a single day with those 
exploits
; 
Ash
 would have been nothing! He would have been banned soon as he tried taking it over but no, you were gone. Aren't you trying to protect 
this server
? Wasn't that your goal?



SpokeIsHere
 to 
JamatoP
, in 
My Best Friend Died on the Unstable SMP


SpokeIsHere
, or simply 
Spoke
, is one of the four main protagonists of 
Unstable Universe
 alongside 
ParrotX2
, 
Wemmbu
, and 
FlameFrags
. 



Personality


Spoke has a very chaotic and manipulative personality. He is shown to ignore the needs or feeling of other in exchange for what he wants, deeming that everything he does is justified and must be accomplished. His egotistical nature is best reflected when he chooses to make an excuse of, underplay or deny his wrongdoings instead of admitting them, often lying even to his 
best friend
 about his actions. An example of this is when he killed all the witnesses, made an enormous lie and went all out to hunt down 
Leow0ok
 just to cover his accidental burning down of a single village. 

He is a good speaker and leader, being the only leader of 
an empire
 that did not promise anything to its member, as well as the one who gathered and lead the protagonists to defeat 
the LAW
. Despite this, he is continuously avoided by other players due to his reputation as an untrustworthy and dangerous individual as well as his enigma-like nature. 

Spoke, when idle, is mischievous and like to prank others, including tricking 
Parrot
 & 
Wifies
 to find secret and stealing items from 
Reddoons
. He is frivolous even when people surrounding him are deadly serious. An example of this is when he claimed to be 
the Director
, playfully said "boom boom boom", and pulled off TNT cart trap whilst being hunted by 
B. A. T.
 in their void base. He enjoys laughing over silly things like the moonwalking spy. He genuinely cares about his friends, in particular 
Mapicc
 and doesn't often hold grudges for very long.  

Spoke is reckless and self-endangering, like when he often builds a Nether portal for escaping despite knowing that the dimension was completely under the control of 
ClownPierce
. Despite this, he is quite intelligent and is shown have an extensive mental library of traps and escape methods. He has slowly started descending to madness like 
Ashswagg
 predicted. 

He lost his chestplate 
Alt,
 
Mapicc
, 
JumperWho
, all of his items, and his name as the player impossible to catch due to his obsessiveness with killing Jamato and revealing his identity. It is unclear whether he will redeem himself or go down a dark path. 



Relationships


Mapicc


Spoke and Mapicc has been best friends since 
How I Stole 10,356,000 Duped Items
. Mapicc is as mischievous as Spoke but he is against Spoke's chaotic, manipulative and egocentric behavior. Despite their differences, they are extremely close. Mapicc is immensely loyal to Spoke, assisting Spoke in his plans even if he doesn't approve. Mapicc also acts as Spoke's emotional anchor, with Spoke panicking every time Mapicc is in danger. Even going as far as to almost blow-up Capital City when he thought Mapicc died. 

Mapicc went missing again in 
4 Minecraft Pros VS 2500 Players
, and Spoke dedicated his time to finding Mapicc. Mapicc reappeared in 
Searching for 100 Players Who Went Missing
, and in the next video explains that he was captured by NULL.  

At the end of 
Finding 1000 Missing Minecraft Players
 Mapicc cut all ties with Spoke after learning of everything his friend lied about. He broke 
Alt
 but spared Spoke which caused both to be taken to the nether by 
Null Hunters
 and 
JamatoP
.



JumperWho


In season 1, Jumper worked for Spoke in 
It's Impossible to Catch This Player
 supposably for duped items. She later is temporarily chunk banned.

In season 2, Jumper worked with Leo to hunt down Spoke and expose his crimes. Jumper betrayed Leo when he began abusing her spies and instead proposed a team up with Spoke. Spoke initially refuses to do this, but later teams with her and they take down B.A.T. and LAW. She believes that Spoke did not commit his former crimes and works in coordination with him to kill Leo. 

In season 3, Jumper protects Spoke from 
the bounty hunters
 that are pursuing him and works on helping Spoke figure out what happened to Mapicc. She is hired by Spoke and becomes a close ally as she saves Spoke multiple times and helps him overcome the bounty hunters. She is eventually captured by the hunters and it's currently unknown if she knows what Spoke has done or is simply imprisoned.   



Wemmbu


Spoke and Wemmbu are enemies throughout the beginning of season 1 where they continuously attempt to kill each other until Spoke is temporarily chunk banned.

Spoke repairs relations with Wemmbu in 
The Invisible Mafia Arc
 and later works with him to destroy the Mafia.

Spoke lures Wemmbu and 
FlameFrags
 into a Mafia stash and since they're enemies they start fighting. Spoke orchastrated this and takes some items from Flame as proof of his demise.

Spoke broke Wemmbu out of prison and in return Wemmbu owed him a favor. Spoke cashed in the favor to assassinate Leo but they fail. Spoke demands another favor.

Spoke later gathers an army which includes Wemmbu to take down the Law. This succeeds.



FlameFrags


Spoke and Flame were enemies since 
The PrinceZam Empire Arc
 as he attempts to destroy the empire Flame was a part of. Flame then joins the Mafia which Spoke successfully destroys.

Spoke later leads an army to try and kill Flame which fails.

Spoke disguises himself as an invisible player and gives Flame quests in return for goods to trick Flame into doing his bidding. Spoke eventually lures 
Wemmbu
 and Flame into a Mafia stash to start a battle between the two enemies. Spoke fakes the death of Flame when neither die and steals some of his stuff to convince Leo of this.

Spoke later gathers an army that includes Flame to take down the Law. This succeeds.



ParrotX2


They had a bad relationship in the 
Princezam Empire Arc
, after Spoke made a very long scavenger hunt for some "secret". Which ended up with Wifies getting chunk-banned just for Parrot to know the "secret". Spoke reveals that there was no secret, just revenge, and says he's an idoit. 

Later on, they work together to take down Mafia which mends their relationship. 

Soon, Spoke tricks Parrot and the rest of BAT that the Director was hiding in their base, and once his identity was revealed, Spoke and Parrots relationship became bad. Not until Spoke was confronted at the top of Capital City threatening to blow it up after thinking that he has lost 
Mapicc
 does him and Parrot get back on good terms, later on working together to defeat The LAW and now consider each other friends.



LettuceK


Spoke barely knew LettuceK existed before The LAW take over however when LettuceK surrenders he views him with contempt and is more than ready to kill him with FlameFrags. This shows that Spoke would not be the one to give mercy to his opponents even though he did not fight LettuceK directly like the others and instead fought Leow0ok.



Ashswagg


Early in the series, Ashswagg manipulated Spoke into destroying several farms and resources. This act was designed to turn the server against Spoke and distance him from his ally, Mapicc. Ash also attempted to pressure Spoke into revealing server exploits. During Season 1, Spoke infiltrated into Ashswagg's Invisible Mafia. His code name was Fish Bucket. Ashswagg said that Spoke (Fish Bucket) is like him which is something Spoke had trouble disagreeing with.

Spoke later spares Ash's life after destroying The Mafia and cornering him. Ashswagg says that Spoke will turn out to be just like him and make a Mafia of his own. Spoke ignores this. 

In season 2, Spoke raids Ashswagg and 
TheRealSquiddo's
 base, 
Point Nemo
.



Leow0ok


During Season 1, Leo and Spoke were allies especially when Spoke infiltrated the Invisible Mafia. Spoke saw Leow0ok as an ally but sometimes there was tension between the two of them.

In Season 2, Spoke originally viewed Leow0ok as a normal player and an ally of sorts, but when word came out about Spoke's crimes he instantly turned against Leow0ok and hated him more than any other player on the entire server. To the extent of not being content with simply just killing him, he also wanted to humiliate Leo for attempting to kill him for his crimes. 

Spoke got ahold Leow0ok's ender pearl and could have used it to kill him at any time but chose to make it so the last person Leo every would see would be him by making a stasis to trigger both of them at the same time. His last act of revenge against Leow0ok was to look at him one more time as Leow0ok fell into the void.



PrinceZam


During Season 1, Zam's main goal was to capture Spoke. They held a grudge against each other until Spoke freed Zam from the Law prison in Season 2.

Spoke used Zam and held him close for his future plans and they both held neutral relationship, bounded by obligation.



PlanetLord


He raided Planet's dupe stash, but they became good friends. Spoke hunted PlanetLord when he infiltrated the Mafia but let him go. PlanetLord vanished after the invis mafia. They reunited in the 
Far Lands
. PlanetLord was then captured by 
Null Hunters
.



JamatoP


JamatoP was Spoke's first friend on the sever but left when he believed Spoke was going too far with the exploits and was trying to "play god". During the time he was gone, he was keeping an eye on Spoke and watching his every move. Eventually, he created 
NULL
 in an attempt to neutralize Spoke who he deemed as the biggest threat to the server's stability and peace.

Spoke
, to 
Wemmbu
 in

Dear Players of the UNSTABLE SMP, I, SpokeIsHere, plan to nuke Capital City. You have 1 hour to evacuate the citizens, but whoever tries to stop me will be SWIFTLY eliminated. If you wish to save your home, I have only one demand; prove to me that my best friend, Mapicc, isn't dead. Show me that's he's been at least captured or if he was somewhat alive. Because otherwise, I'll leave this server into RUINS.



Spoke
, to the residents of 
Capital City
 in 
My Best Friend Died on the Unstable SMP


“If you have an Elytra in you hotbar right now why didn’t you follow him!”



Spoke
, to

 in

Of course 
Null
 wasn't the one going to kill me. Of course 
Jamato
 wasn't the one going to kill me. He wanted you to do it. You're going to be the one—you're the one who's going to ban me.



Spoke
, to 
Mapicc
 in

Trivia


Spoke's real-life family has been featured on 
Unstable Universe
 in many instances.

In 
I Got Hunted by the Minecraft Mafia
, his younger brother 
BobDaGreenFrog
 was briefly featured.


In

, 
iMajesticRose
 and 
BeckyTronVIII
, his sister and younger brother respectively were featured.

 was featured.

 and

, 
BeckyTronVIII
, and 
Quackenstein123
, are featured again.


Spoke is one of the only holders of 
orbital strike cannons
, the others being 
Wemmbu
 and people in the Farlands.


Wemmbu
 still owes Spoke a favor.


Spoke’s first ever face reveal was a joke on a Mapicc livestream.


All poppies in Spoke's pov are replaced with rose (texture pack) except in replay mod view. This might be a reference to 
IMajesticRose
. Roses, or poppies, are therefore associated with death on Unstable SMP.


Spoke has the least amount of videos posted on 
Unstable Universe
 with only 25 videos.
