title: Stasis Chamber
content:
Stasis Chamber
, or simply 
stasis
, is an ender pearl that stays and oscillates at a safe place and can be triggered (pulled) by a variety of mechanisms, manually or remotely. It is widely used on the 
Unstable SMP
.



Mechanism


The ender pearl is thrown into an upward bubble column created by soul sand and water, or thrown at a strict angle towards some honey blocks on an oscillating piston. The former one can be turned into a trap by adding wind charged chicken launcher above the pearl and piston to remove soul sand under the pearl, with bedrock below the soul sand removed by glitch. The pearl will load the chunk so it is always triggerable. Fishing rod is connected to wirelessly pulling stasis by the same glitch used in setting fishing rod trigger for 
Orbital Strike Cannon
 and 
Orbital Dog Cannon
.



History


Wemmbu
 visited 
Proton
 prisoners and set stasis inside it to break everyone out.

The Invisible Mafia
 forced players to throw ender pearl and transport all portals to 
Mafia Stasis Chambers
 far away from 
Spawn
 and also the tomb of the Mafia far in the first void of the end ring. These stasis chambers, when triggered, send players into the void immediately and kill them. 
Ashswagg
 had the fishing rods to trigger the stases in Mafia Stasis Chambers to control the Mafia. Mafia Stasis Chambers was destroyed by 
Spoke
.

Wemmbu
 used stasis chamber to get in and out his most secure base.

MrCube6
 stasised away from BAT prison after leaving BAT a dandelion.

The PvP tournament where 
Wemmbu
 and 
FlameFrags
 participated had totem-triggered stasis chambers. This mechanism is likely related to Shadow Item glitch and is also used by 
Wifies
, 
JamatoP
, and 
Null Hunters
.

Parrot
 built a mirror-receiver-triggered stasis chamber. After revealing 
Invisible Knight
 is 
Wemmbu
, he got knocked into the void by an angry Wemmbu, and clutched by looking at the direction for mirror receiver.

Spoke
 used stasis chamber in the air activated by wind charge to infiltrate 
Leow0ok
's spies into the BAT secret vault.

JamatoP
 and subsequently 
Null Hunters
 elite squads used stasis chamber that are triggered by exploits to their totem of undying.

Wemmbu
 set a stasis chamber at 
Far Lands
 
Orbital Strike Cannon
 array to refill them whenever needed.

Spoke found 
Leow0ok
's stasis chamber and set trap to kill him alongside 
Wemmbu
 but failed due to Leo possibly already knowing this and having a backup stasis.

Spoke pulled off 
Mapicc
's stasis chamber which led him to discover 
JamatoP
, his archenemy. He used a stasis chamber to pretend he was Leo and manipulate Mapicc. His stasis chamber was pulled by 
JumperWho
 who asked for alliance against Leo.

Spoke later found 
Leow0ok
's stasis chamber again using arrow TNT triangulation and transported the pearl to a void trap, which killed Leo when he was cornered and tried to teleport.

Spoke
 pulled 
Jumper
 and 
her spies
' stasis to call for their help against 
Null Hunters
. 
SirPig_
 teleported away with fishing rod during Spoke's interrogation, leaving Spoke and Jumper in a passive and vulnerable position for Null Hunters to attack.

Swight
 is a supporting character featured in 
Unstable Universe
. He is extremely skilled in PvP and formerly a hired assassin for 
the Law
. He trained 
Flame
 in PvP.



Personality


Swight is characterized as a cold and calculating mercenary. Unlike other figures in the Unstable Universe who are driven by power or faction loyalty, Swight is motivated almost entirely by professionalism and profit. He views the world through the lens of contracts and compensation, famously showing no interest in the identity or "justice" of his targets—only in whether the requester can pay his fee. His loyalty is flexible. While he is reliable once a contract is signed, he is willing to negotiate with his own targets if they offer a better "deal" than his original employer, demonstrating that he values survival and gear over a reputation for honesty. In other words, he is like Wild Card in server's politics. You can trust him to follow the best deal, but you can never trust him to be a permanent ally. Swight hates people who kill for stupid purposes like vengeance, titles and etc.



History


Swight was originally contracted by 
the Law
 with a clear mission: to track down and eliminate 
FlameFrags
. To find a student worthy of his time, Swight hosted a tournament to see who was the "best player" for him to teach, eventually selecting a mysterious "invisible player."

Throughout their sessions, Swight put the player through rigorous combat trials, unaware that his student was actually his target, FlameFrags, using a secret identity. Swight’s training focused on elite PvP mechanics, reflecting his real-world status as a Tier 1 player in multiple disciplines.

The tension peaked when the invisible player was revealed to be FlameFrags. Instead of completing the assassination for the Law, Swight showed his true mercenary nature. He agreed to spare Flame and "betray" the original contract in exchange for high-tier gear vault. This solidified Swight as a character who values personal gain and skill over professional loyalty to any "Law."



Quotes




Stand Proud, You're Strong.



Swight
, to 
Flame
 in 
I Secretly Teamed With My Minecraft Killer

 from

As mentioned by 
Flame
, He is commonly known as one of the best players in all the Minecraft, being third on the MCTiers Rankings and having Tier 1 in UHC and Axe.


He has retired from Axe and UHC following the 
DangerMario
 scandal.

They will rue the day they put a pumpkin on my head!



Th3Blurpinstein, 
2500 Players VS Minecraft Combat Master


Th3Blurpinstein is a minor comic relief character in 
Unstable Universe
.  He was prisoned by the 
Law
 along with alongside 
Fantst
, 
PrinceZam
, 
Baablu
, and others for mass murder and other criminal acts to the server, which are not explicitly stated but hinted by 
LettuceK
 to be worse than anyone else's in the Law's prison.  He uses a low quality voice changer and has a permanent Curse of Binding pumpkin on his head.





Personality


Th3Blurpinstein usually acts as annoying, childish, and bratty. He is known for a recurring gag of being more dangerous as he seems, being put in solitary for long periods of time and given higher punishment than the rest of the prisoners, as well as him not telling what crimes he committed. He is usually the center of many jokes in the plot, as a comic relief character. 



History


Th3Blurpinstein is seen as a prisoner in the 
Law
's prison with the rest of the prisoners, and attempts to make friends with 
Wemmbu
, who brushes him off. 

When Wemmbu, PrinceZam, and Baablu plot to escape in the cafeteria, Th3Blurpinstein tries to snitch on them. PrinceZam starts an argument with Th3Blurpinstein and creates a distraction, allowing for them to escape. 

After Wemmbu's escape attempt, LettuceK implements a policy that every prisoners must wear Curse of Binding armor. Th3Blurpinstein steps on the pressure plate, and a curse of binding pumpkin is placed on his head.

LettuceK refuses to divulge Th3Blurpinstein's crimes, however, Th3Blurpinstein states that he has killed a large amount of people and that his lore is "really violent".

Th3Blurpinstein is then put into solitary confinement.

Later, when he's released, Th3Blurpinstein asks for help escaping the prison when Wemmbu and others are escaping. A Law guard frees him. He asks 
Lomedy
 to join them in the escape, but he refuses. PrinceZam (whom Blurpenstein had previously threatened and argued with) is seen later seen chasing him down, attempting to kill him. 

Th3Blurpinstein is seen again in the prison, recaptured. He is in solitary confinement talking to 
Parrot
, and distracts the guard when Parrot attempts to escape. This time he is seen, he acts more mature and says that he is now regretful of his crimes. 

Later, when 
Spoke
 breaks into the prison with the goal to find Parrot, Th3Blurpinstein is seen talking to them, and PrinceZam is now seen being friendly to him. He eventually escapes the prison during their fight. 

Th3Blurpinstein is seen as a prisoner in the 
Spider Web Faction
. 



Trivia


Blurpinstein is theorized to be a secret former netherite Mafia player and is acting dumb on purpose. This makes sense considering the existence of 
Quackenstein123
 who has a similar name and was a diamond Mafia player.


Blurpinstein swore his allegiance to Spoke, but it is unclear if this was serious or not.


Blurpinstein made friends with Lomedy inside the Law's prison.

TheG0d0fWar, to

TheGOdOfWar
 is a supporting character in 
Unstable Universe
.

He serves as a major antagonist in 
The Kings Arc
.

TheG0dofWar is a very skilled player in The Law with almost the same skill in sword as FlameFrags. He is a reflection of Pre-Law FlameFrags in a lot of ways. TheG0dofWar has a huge ego like how FlameFrags has one and he says he only has his name as a fierce PVPer just like how FlameFrags said the same. He as equal skill in sword and refuses to run from battle.



History


TheG0dofWar is one of the four commanders of 
The Law
, led by 
LettuceK
. He is seen when fighting against 
Jaden's Pirates
 and 
Wemmbu
. He also fights 
FlameFrags
 twice and beats him the first time.

In Flame's video, 
I Got Trained By a Minecraft TNT Master
, in which he serves as the main antagonist. We hear about TheG0dofWar by many players which say that he really is The God of War. Flame refuses to believe him but then he runs into him in the black market. TheG0dofWar pardons all criminals which lead them into telling him about Flame. Flame who is not very prepared for battle is forced to fight TheG0dOfWar but is decisively beaten by him in a stunning duel which puts Flame into shock. TheG0dofWar humiliates Flame in every single way forcing him to run from a fight which he would have never done before. After Flame trains with Theo, He vows to reclaim his title from TheG0dOfWar and goes into the desert to fight him.

The two met and started a duel. Flame's carts slowly begin to overpower TheG0dOfWar but he refuses to give up and continues to battle Flame. Flame continues to fight him and Law soldiers watch in awe as the battle continues. Eventually TheG0dofWar attempts to end the battle by running but Flame calls after him saying that he is not done yet. TheG0dofWar refuses to run from the battle and continues fighting Flame. In the end he runs out of resources. TheG0dofWar says that his title is the only thing he has but Flame continues to fight him. With half of his armor broken, TheG0dofWar finally surrenders. Flame spares him because it seems like he sees himself in him like how Flame was before The Law humbled him. Flame tells TheG0dofWar to never fight him again unless he is certain of being better then him.

It is possible that before the duel against Flame, TheG0dofWar and 
SargeLaw
 captured 
TheobaldTheBird.


In Wemmbu's video, "Minecraft Pro VS 1000 Players," TheG0dOfWar is seen in the end after Wemmbu and eggchan returns with 
MinuteTech
. He battles them alongside Lawmen.

After escaping to the Overworld, MinuteTech and Wemmbu battles TheG0dOfWar. He survives Wemmbu's orbital strikes without popping a totem, before Wemmbu leaves them in order to confront LettuceK and his lawmen, and MinuteTech is left to battle TheG0dOfWar by himself.



Thumbnails




Triva


His sword Chaos, his name, and his skin are all references to Kratos from the 
God of War
 series of video games.

TheRealSquiddo
, more commonly known as 
Squiddo
, is a character in 
Unstable Universe
.



Personality


Squiddo is an unserious, generous, and funny character. She is unwilling to kill players, as shown when she remained a copper trim in the mafia despite being one of the people closest to Ash. She is incredibly loyal to certain people and states that she misses Spoke, Mapicc, and the rest of her friends even long after she left to join Ash. She is sentimental, keeping a version of the "Garlic Hamster" pet at every single one of her bases. She also is shown to be very silly, as shown with her antics at Point Nemo. She brings out a less serious side of Ash, despite his stoic front. She is one of the only people in the series that he opens up to and trusts.



History


Season 1


Squiddo leads the master builders group. 
SpokeIsHere
 pays her to have the master builders group help Spoke build 
The Wonders
. 

Squiddo builds a portal and breaks an obsidian at the same moment that a chunk suppressor was accidentally activated by Spoke. Spoke sees this and tells her that it is a normal thing which happens when the server lags. Spoke then destroys the glitched portal and advises that she doesn’t share it and that nobody would believe her.

Squiddo's house is accidentally burned down by Spoke when he is trying to get rid of her duped netherite blocks.

Wemmbu
 and 
PrinceZam
 interrogate Squiddo and threaten to chunk ban her if she doesn’t give information on Spoke. They check her barrels and find out that she has glitched items. She says that she did make a build in the end dimension for Spoke, and DMs Wemmbu the coordinates. Zam chunk bans Squiddo.

Parrot breaks Squiddo out of prison.

Squiddo joins 
Wemmbu's Civilization
.



Season 2


Squiddo is seen in a secret base with 
ashswagg
 called 
Point Nemo
. Spoke later completely destroys the entire base and raids all of it.

Spoke, invisible, destroys Squiddo's base in 
the Amplified
 with fire and lava.



Boundaries


Shipping is okay


No NSFW


Trivia


Squiddo was the copper trim player that was with 
Ashswagg
 in the 
Far Lands
 after the Mafia had fallen.


She and 
Ashswagg
 are dating in real life, as they revealed in YouTube video and series of tweets on February 14th, and have joked about being married in Unstable Universe.


Squiddo has changed her skin several times between and during episodes, making her, 
Ashswagg
, 
Parrot
,  
Wemmbu
, and 
Mapicc
 the only characters to do so in all of Unstable.


Squiddo was offered the opportunity to be the fourth protagonist of Unstable. However, she declined as she wanted to focus on Lifesteal content and agreed to be a background character instead.

title: The BAT Arc
content:
*This episode is not a part of any arc, but is included here for comprehension purposes*
 
SpokeIsHere
 gathers an army of 1,000 players and creates the 
Spoke Galactic Empire
. He forcibly recruits builder 
Horace Altman
 to improve the empire, as well as deals with assassination attempts. His friend 
Mapicc
 joins him, and together they attack 
Sleepy Nation
, which betrayed them a while ago. After that they go to terrorize the End, only to find it's the home of their old friend 
MinuteTech
. After that awkward situation, Spoke deals with more assassination attempts, and finally his army starts to turn against him, forcing him to run away.

*This episode is not a part of any arc, but is included here for comprehension purposes*
 Spoke and Mapicc are attacked at their base by the army, but manage to escape through the Nether. There, they meet 
The Executive
, the new leader of the army. They try to fight the army, but eventually are forced to flee. They find a portal going to 
Leow0ok's
 base, another old friend of theirs. The three of them fight off the army together, killing them all, and Leo offers to let the two join 
BAT
, his team.

Spoke has to race a couple of other people in completing tasks to become a member of BAT. After failing a few and coming into conflict with ApexPoint multiple times, he learns that BAT hates 
FlameFrags
 and decides to use that. He pays Flame using stolen items to complete multiple different tasks, and sends a random player to go find 
Wemmbu
, another of BAT's enemies, to lure both to the same location. He secretly watches the battle, which Wemmbu wins, and then reports back to Leo saying he killed them. Leo's skeptical, but since he's heard reports of Wemmbu's death, he believes it and welcomes Spoke to the team.

*This episode is not a part of any arc, but is included here for comprehension purposes*
 Mapicc discovers an invisibility exploit, which he and Spoke utilize to troll a new player. ApexPoint returns, however, recruiting the new player. Spoke and Mapicc find 
TheRealSquiddo's
 base, and troll her, then eventually burn it down. Apex's team finds 
Jepexx's
 base and attacks, but Spoke is able to save both Jepexx and his horse. He and Mapicc sneak into Apex's base, but get spotted and run. They are followed back to their base, and Apex's team discovers the exploit. They use it against Spoke, who blows up their base and kills them to protect the exploit from getting out.

Spoke accidentally burns down a base while on a mission from Leo. To cover it up, he sets up traps at the witnesses' base, killing all of them, but Leo's spies arrive and start investigating. Leo himself questions Spoke, but Spoke deflects. He goes to his base with Mapicc and is watched by two spies, but escapes. He finds the other secret base of the remaining witnesses, successfully trapping it and killing everyone. However, two spies show up and attack him. He manages to kill both of them and returns to his base, finding Leo there. It's revealed that the spies Leo didn't actually send the spies, and he theorizes that 
JumperWho
 sent them instead. Spoke sneaks off to another base, where 
Quackenstein123
 lives, and gives all the items he's gotten to him, revealing his ultimate mission has been to atone for 
IMajesticRose's
 death.

More spies follow Spoke, but he kills them, obtaining a book that reveals BAT is investigating him. Jumper shows up, but he manages to outplay her and escape. Leo and Jumper are waiting for him at his base, revealing they're working together again, They let Spoke go due to a lack of evidence of his wrongdoings, but leave spies to watch. Spoke and Mapicc flee their base and kill one of their pursuers, obtaining coords to BAT's secret vault. Spoke sets up a plan and they kill another spy, whom Spoke impersonates to get inside, learning that Leo wants to kill him while Jumper wants to wait for evidence. Spoke flees the base and a player he recruited pretends to be him, resulting in his death. Spoke plans to use that player to prove his innocence, and visits Quackenstein again. Leo shows up as well, though, and threatens Quackenstein if Spoke doesn't give up, before flying away.

*All following videos are part of 
The Kings Arc
, but due to Spoke including them in his BAT arc playlist, they are also included here*


Spoke watches as Leow0ok and his spies destroy Quackenstein’s family base, searching for the armor pieces, prompting them to escape through a tunnel with Quackenstein and his family, sending them to safety via a Nether portal, where the family heads to their old snow base before breaking it. Leo and his spies catch up, forcing Spoke to reveal his inventory, but Jumper defends him due to a lack of evidence. Following a speech by 
LettuceK
, leader of 
The LAW
, Spoke plans to have Wemmbu kill Leo and later eavesdrops on Leo’s conversation to track him. After infiltrating The Law's base, Spoke offers to help Wemmbu escape in exchange for a favor, but Wemmbu refuses. Eventually, Spoke breaks the prisoners out, but when they confront Leo, it becomes clear that Leo's true motive was to catch Spoke in a mistake, proving his guilt as they prepare for an inevitable clash.

Mapicc goes on a mission to a BAT gear stash, but when he doesn't come back, Spoke follows the tracks and finds the place where he supposedly died. He refuses to believe it at first, until Leo shows up at his base holding Mapicc's shield. Spoke rigs 
Capital City
 to blow up unless he gets proof of Mapicc's life, but no one comes except for Parrot, and he wasn't even sent by the Law. However, he does convince Spoke to stand down. After some time, Spoke brings Zam to the BAT gear stash, where he found signs from spies that didn't join the fight, indicating another player was there and saved Mapicc. They follow the tracks, which eventually take them to the 
Far Lands
, where Mapicc is with 
JamatoP
, Spoke's oldest friend. Mapicc wants to live peacefully. Spoke and Jamato speak privately, both condemning each other for supposed villainy, and Jamato stasises away. Spoke disguises himself as Leo and attacks Mapicc and Zam, pretending to get scared off, then comes back as himself, revealing Jamato 'died'. The three of them resolve to kill Leo.

Spoke, Mapicc, and Zam find a village, which Spoke blows up using an exploit to get items from reluctant townsfolk. They visit BAT's secret library, where they find wreckage from a battle and realize someone is following them. They set up secret stasises and build a sky base, when beacons light up suddenly. Spoke follows them and finds Leo and a bunch of Lawmen. He warns the others, and they prepare to fight them off before escaping when the base is overwhelmed. They attack Leo and make him stasis away, then use an arrow trick to find his current location. On the way there, Spoke's stasis gets pulled.

It's revealed that 
JumperWho
 teleported Spoke and betrayed BAT, because Leo kept using her spies as soldiers. Spoke refuses her offer of teaming up, and instead sends a message to the Law, giving them his coordinates. He sets up traps with help from Mapicc and Zam, and then Jumper makes her offer again. He refuses it, and the three head to where Leo has set up camp. They kill his soldiers, but Leo takes Zam hostage. Jumper saves him, and Spoke has another argument with her. She shows him Leo's secret base, where he's been building TNT cannons. They successfully escape and take down more Lawmen, and Spoke finally agrees to team with Jumper.

Spoke, Mapicc, and Zam sneak into a Law prison and free the BAT spies imprisoned there, but are attacked by Lawmen. 
MinuteTech
 saves them, brought by Jumper, and Jumper sends her spies off. They report that 
ParrotX2
 is in the Law prison, and so the three sneak in (Mapicc and Minute are off getting Minute's other gear stashes). 
Wemmbu
 and 
FlameFrags
 break into the prison at the same time, and Spoke aids Flame in fighting. The three find someone surrounded by obsidian and guards, but it turns out to be 
Jaden MAN
 rather than Parrot. Spoke brings everyone, Flame and Wemmbu included, to his castle, where Mapicc and Minute meet them. They learn via spies that hundreds of Lawman are converging on a Law stash, and head there. Spoke sets up landmines and realizes Parrot and 
TheobaldTheBird
 are there. It turns into a massive battle, after which Parrot brings them all to 
District 13
. They go to the 
Northern Council
 and destroy Lettuce's army. Mapicc vanishes. After Lettuce surrenders, Jumper's spies report Leo's location, so the two go there. They trap him, but he activates his stasis. Spoke, however, found Leo's stasis chamber earlier and set it up over the void. Leo dies.





Trivia


This is the third arc to end in the antagonist dying.

The first was 
The Toxic War Arc
 with 
VEN0M
, and the second was 
The Director Arc
 with 
Wifies
.

title: The Betrayal Arc
content:
*This episode is not a part of any arc, but is included here for comprehension purposes*
 
FlameFrags
 joins a PVP tournament out of boredom, defeating 
Willsion
 easily. He learns his enemy 
Wemmbu
 is also there, then fights 
FerreMC
, and though it's closer, he still wins. Next is 
TheobaldTheBird
, who fights with TNT minecarts, so Flame enchants his leggings with blast protection. It's still a tough fight, but he wins, and his final match is against Wemmbu. They both pop two totems, but Flame wins.

Flame's friend 
Jaden MAN
 is missing, so Flame goes around interrogating people. 
LettuceK
 acts suspicious, and after spying on his team, 
The Law
, Flame learns they imprisoned Jaden. He loses a fight to try and make them tell him, but learns that 
Leow0ok
 managed to beat them. Leo teaches Flame TNT minecart PVP, which Flame uses to defeat the Law, but Lettuce would rather die than give up the info. Leo stages his capture so Flame can find their prison, and he does so successfully, forcing the Law to run to avoid dying, since Jaden has already been found by Flame.

Jaden gathers a team, 
The Avengers
, to kill Wemmbu, who imprisoned him. They find Wemmbu in the 
Far Lands
, but fail to kill him. Jaden and Flame split off from the others and find 
Conexion
, who joins their team and gives (with some trickery involved) Flame his mace, which once belonged to Jaden. The other half of the Avengers fail to kill Wemmbu, but they have a meeting point for a final battle. Flame comes up with a plan, but his team refuses to follow it, so he betrays them, fighting alongside Wemmbu. The Avengers are scared off, and Flame returns the mace to Wemmbu, its original owner. Suddenly, the stasis Flame set to get out of the Farlands is pulled.

It turns out to be the Law, but Flame escapes and meets up with Jaden. They are attacked again by the Law, then go to a nearby town whose inhabitants they rob, and then are attacked again. This time they chase the Law when they retreat, killing a couple, then continue on to their base. Flame gets trapped in an obsidian box, but survives multiple traps. The Law comes down to kill him, revealing Jaden betrayed him, but he escapes.

Flame meets up with his friend 
Lomedy
, but Lomedy gets attacked by Jaden and has his mace stolen. Jaden uses a Riptide trident to mace Flame, who eventually seeks shelter. Jaden gives him a compass leading to his new pirate base and leaves. Flame gears back up and goes off to fight him, but after a long battle, Jaden concedes that Flame has won and then flies off with his trident.

Derapchu
 continually causes problems, culminating in all of BAT's wealth being stolen. Parrot and Derapchu go out to recover it, and do so successfully, fighting off bandits along the way. Cube and Parrot meet for one final contest, and after Parrot outsmarts Cube, Derapchu arrives and takes him into custody. He gives Parrot a message from the Director, greeting Parrot.

BAT attempts to kill Parrot, but Jumper helps him escape, and later explains that BAT thinks he’s the Director. She sneaks him into BAT, but he gets caught and barely escapes. Later, she betrays him to BAT, but items she gave him helps him escape, and she later explains she had to regain BAT’s trust. One of her spies overhears them, forcing her to kill him. The Director arranges for a meeting with Parrot, which Jumper secretly brings BAT too. After the Director leaves, BAT finds the spy’s grave, and Jumper is kicked off the team.

BAT get attacked by 
TruOriginal
, a hacker. They escape, but he destroys BAT HQ. They flee and set up an underground base, then get materials to build a mirror receiver, planning to link it to their orbital strike cannon to kill Tru. That fails, however, and Parrot is nearly killed, but Nufuli helps him escape. Leo and Derapchu are captured, and Tru tells them to come to BAT HQ. They do so, and this time manage to successfully kill Tru with the cannon, and save Leo and Derapchu. Nufuli decides to leave the team, but gets killed by the Director.

BAT follow the Director and get trapped with netherite zombies, but kill them and claim the netherite. They bribe a shop owner for info, then follow who they believe to be the Director, but it's actually MrCube. The Director gives Parrot two weeks to find his identity, then tries to kill him, but he is saved by Jumper. Jumper brings them to her base, where they stay for a while, and after Parrot believes one of BAT betrayed, Leo tries to kill him, blaming him for all the bad things that have happened. He escapes and runs, but Jumper and Derapchu follow him, then get trapped by the Director, who will kill them if Parrot doesn't guess who he is. Parrot gets Leo to save them while he distracts the Director, only for the Director to reveal himself as 
Wifies
, having faked his death and done all this to test how Parrot reacts to things, in order to keep him safe forever. Parrot follows the Director.

Wifies brings Parrot to 
Paragon
, an inescapable prison for them to build a new life. Parrot tries to kill Wifies, then tries to escape, but a stasis chamber and invisible guards foil his respective attempts. He plays nice, then tries to kill Wifies when he's supposedly AFK, but Wifies planned that. They go back and forth for a bit, Parrot continually failing to outsmart Wifies, before he finally tries one too many times. Wifies makes him drop all his items and brings him to a room with two pressure plates, where if either of them step off, they die. Parrot reveals he snuck his spyglass in, and drops it, then leaves. Wifies steps off his pressure plate and grabs the spyglass, dying for real this time. Parrot escapes Paragon.

 † (deuteragonist)

Supporting Characters

 (minor antagonist)


Mixiku's bandits


Trivia


The episode 
Unstable SMP: Doomsday
 was also in the official playlist for this arc but Parrot removed it due to it being a part of 
The Invisible Mafia Arc
.

title: The End Civilization
content:
The End Civilization











							Castle
							
						







							Mafia Controlled
							
						








































Alias


The Void Civilization
Minecraft's Safest Civilization






Status


Inactive






Appearances




Appears in


*
I Built Minecraft's Safest Civilization
I Discovered a Minecraft Sky Civilization
Unstable SMP: The First War
I Created Minecraft's Greatest Empire






Debut


I Built Minecraft's Safest Civilization








The End Civilization
 was a civilization created by 
ParrotX2
, 
Wifies
 and 
deanthebean9
, before subsequently being conquered by 
The Invisible Mafia
.



History


Parrot and Wifies try to create a civilization in the end. They see that a player has been following them. They pop the totem of the person underground and find that it’s deanthebean9. He says he’s a part of the Mafia. They recruit him as a member in their civilization. They move villagers into their civilization. Players from the Mafia find them and start trying to kill them. They are able to escape.

Parrot hires 
Horace_Altman
 to build the civilization. They finish bringing the villagers and see Horace made a giant island. Parrot goes into the Mafia’s base to get deanthebean9 out of his stasis chamber. They are successful in getting him out.

Parrot breaks his bed in the overworld and goes back into the end. For some reason he now cannot leave the end. Parrot logs on the next day and sees Horace moved the entire island 100 blocks down. A couple of members join the civilization. Horace builds a giant castle at the civilization. He also builds outposts near spawn. 
Boosfer
 comes over and tries to take over the civilization. Horace sets up chunk bans around the civilization.

What_Max
 goes to an outpost to join the civilization, but finds that the Mafia is there. The civilization helps him escape, but Parrot almost dies.

Horace greatly expands the empire. Wifies shows Parrot that he found a giant crater near their base. Boosfer talks more about how he’ll run against Parrot. 
Fantst
 and 
LettuceK
 tell Parrot that there are invisible players circling around the chunk bans. The Mafia send multiple bomber planes, but the civilization is able to stop them. Parrot tells them in the meeting room that they are unable to leave the end if they don’t have a bed in the overworld.

Horace builds a giant dome around the civilization. Boosfer, 
Kier
, and 
Dev
 come over for the election. Boosfer is unsuccessful in winning the election. He tries to leave but gets chunk banned.

Deanthebean9 tells Parrot that yesterday an invisible player got into the civilization. A new bomber plane is sent to destroy the civilization. The mole from the Mafia is able to turn off the chunk bans. After the Mafia invades, all of the members of the civilization run away.

Parrot and his friends try to explode the civilization.

The Mafia reskins the civilization to be mafia themed. They use the civilization to imprison the members of the Warriors District.

 with the bubble.

The End of the Minecraft Mafia














Season


1

27 (final episode)






Upload date


Jan 30, 2025

SpokeIsHere






Arcs


The Invisible Mafia Arc
 (final episode)






Featured Creators (Description)


ashswagg
Mapicc

Cash

rev3rsalz
Pro4d














The Mafia
 has declared war on our server... After we obtained their leaked plans, we tried to warn the leaders of the peaceful civilizations. However, after the Mafia infiltrated their people and annihilated their homes, we realized our only hope in defeating the Mafia was by finding the Stasis Chamber…





The End of the Minecraft Mafia
 is the 27th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. This marks the finale of Season 1, as well as the end of 
Spoke
's perspective on Season 1.  



Plot


The video begins with 
Spoke
 and 
Mapicc
 at Square City, warning Cash about the Mafia attacking them. Cash ridicules them and tells them that the last thing his citizens would worry about is The Mafia running around and dismisses Spoke and Mapicc. Nico tells Cash that they are under attack and gets killed by an iron trimmed player. The iron trimmed player tries to kill Cash but gets his statis pulled. Cash thinks he defeated The Mafia but Ash walks into Cash's house and tells him that "everyone will be Mafia soon" and orders the gold trimmed player to kill Cash. The gold trimmed player tells Ash that Spoke and Mapicc are hiding on the roof and Spoke and Mapicc flee from Square city. Mapicc suggests that they use MinuteTech's trap but Spoke tells Mapicc that he's going to use his own instead. Mapicc asks Spoke if its the oak tree with flowers all around it and Spoke tells Mapicc that it used to be under a dark oak tree but he messed it up. Spoke and Mapicc get attacked by 2 diamond players who find and trigger his trap because of how obvious it is. They find MinuteTech's escape route which is a void trap. Mapicc tells Spoke the coordinates of the way out of the void trap and end up in a cave. 

Spoke tells Mapicc that they need to find coordinates to the other civilizations so they visit Squiddo to ask her for the coordinates of the other civilizations in Ash's desire board. Spoke also explains how the Mafia works to Squiddo and she gives them the coordinates to Sleepy Nation. While they fly there MinuteTech follows them. While exploring Sleepy Nation they get jumped by invisible players, however it turns out that the invisible players were Hannah and im_a_squid_kid. Spoke and Mapicc meet up with Wallibear. Wallibear tells them that their stashes were overrun by The Mafia and that half of their soldiers are dead. Spoke tells Hannah and Squid about the news and they all steal the items in the stash back from The Mafia. While they were on their way to return to Wallibear they find out that the place was all blown up and they see Ash and a diamond player. They make fun of Spoke, Mapicc and Minute and they also tell him that Wallibear is in the Mafia now. They go back to Sleepy Nation to warn Hannah and Squid that the Mafia is coming and they show them an alternate exit, however Hannah and Squid wear gold trimmed chestplates, pot up and jump them. Spoke tries to kill them but Minute tells them that they were forced into the Mafia and tell them not to kill them. They escape Sleepy Nation and Spoke has an argument with Minute. Minute leaves and Mapicc gets upset at Spoke for sending him off. They visit Squiddo again but they get jumped by the same two diamond players and an 
iron player
. Baconnwaffles blows up Squiddo's castle and they escape using Squiddo's void escape route.

Spoke and Mapicc check up on spawn only to find Mafia players destroying it. They fly away and spot Parrot and Wifies, they discuss about the desire board and Spoke assumes that the same place where he killed iMajesticRose was The Withered. Parrot, Wifies Spoke and Mapicc go to that location and find a diamond player destroying the house. They follow the diamond player and find a guy named Quackenstein. They intimidate Quackenstein but then later stop because they feel bad for him. Quackenstein tours them around the house and he also shows them a memorial for Rose. Spoke regrets killing rose. Parrot and WIfies leave the house. Spoke spends some time with Becky going fishing when Quackenstein meets them and Spoke promises to protect them. Quackenstein tells them to build a mountain over his town.

Spoke and Mapicc head to the end to get obsidian from the pillars until they spot Ash. They try to escape the end until Ash notices that there are people breaking blocks under him. He realizes that the people breaking blocks are Spoke and Mapicc and he calls them out to scare them. He also says that everything Spoke loves is now destroyed by the Mafia. A diamond trimmed player finds Spoke and Mapicc's hole and they attempt to kill them until Spoke and Mapicc escape. Spoke and Mapicc notice that Becky and Quackenstein are missing so they search for them until they find a staircase in Quackenstein's house that leads to a diamond player set along with a mace. They notice Quackenstein entering the room and they confront him. Spoke threatens to kill Quackenstein and he says that he actually met Rose and Becky before and that he feels better for killing Rose and Mapicc tells Spoke to stop and compares him to Ash. Quackenstein and Mapicc tell Spoke to put his mace down and Quackenstein tells him his backstory after Spoke puts his mace down.

At first it was just him and Rose. They travelled hundreds of thousands of blocks away from the server's initial problems (presumably Zam Empire or ClownPierce). Him and Rose were building houses and castles until one day a player named Ashswagg invited them join his team. He promised that if they built castles for him and joined the Invisible Mafia they would protect them and give them infinite resources. Quackenstein was suspicious initially but Rose saw this as a great opportunity to build so they agreed. After they finished building this castle it was being used as a statis chamber to torment the members. Ash told them not to write down the coordinates of the statis chamber however Quackenstein did write down the coordinates of the monument. After Quackenstein found out what the statis chamber was really about he assembled a team to try to take it down however, it was already destroyed. After Ash found out what happened, that's when Rose died. Spoke realizes that he has been hiding and that's why he has no invis and in iron armour. Quackenstein gives Spoke a book called "Mafia Eyes" that is signed by Ashswagg. Spoke then apologizes to Quackenstein for killing Rose. He explains that while he was infiltrating the Mafia he was put on a mission to kill Rose and that was why he killed her. Spoke and Mapicc say goodbye to Becky before leaving and they tell Parrot and Wifies that they found a potential lead to the statis chamber.

Parrot invites them to District 13 where Spoke shows everyone the book. Parrot sends Spoke out to destroy the stasis chamber. Spoke and Mapicc notice a giant crater. They try to find something until Mapicc finds a chest. The chest contains a book called "The Gateway" which is also signed by Ash and the contents of the book are "<" and ">" signs. They don't know what it means so they go back to District 13 to tell them about it. They also don't understand what the book means and they get upset at Spoke. After an argument Spoke gets kicked out of District 13 and he almost gives up until he finds a massive obsidian box that's way bigger than the one they were building when they met Parrot. They then return to District 13 to tell Parrot about the spawn prison and they head to spawn to plan how they are going to break in. Wemmbu and Eggchan distract the guards while Parrot, Spoke and Mapicc break in by setting their spawn, going to the end and going into the portal and into the prison. They find a room with an iron door where they throw a pearl but they don't realize it's purpose yet. They also find Wato as one of the guards. Parrot, Wato, Spoke and Mapicc go back to the room where pearls are being thrown and they follow it and find sandstone halls. They get spotted by a diamond player and they get chased by them. While hiding from the diamond player, Mapicc realizes that the book with "<" and ">" signs.

Spoke and Mapicc begin going through the directions of the book while being chased by Mafia players until they find what appears to be a dead end until they mine through the walls and find a tunnel. The tunnel leads to a pearl cannon where they throw the pearls and it sends them to where it would lead to. The pearl cannon teleports them to what looks like the middle of nowhere until they see a huge man made mountain. They think back to what Quackenstein said about building a mountain over his town and realize that the statis chamber may be inside the mountain. They find a castle with all the Mafia statis chamber pearls. They find one with Mapicc's name in it (with no pearl), one with Squiddo's name and one with Wifies' name. They accidentally pull one of their statises and it turns out that they are a no trimmed Mafia player. The no trimmed guy wanders around while Spoke and Mapicc follows him. A diamond player spots him and maces him. They find the exit and tell Parrot and Wemmbu about the statis chamber. Parrot suggests that Spoke mines the soul sand in the void so that the pearls fall in the void however they get jumped by multiple Mafia members. After the fight, Parrot tells Spoke to destroy the stasis chamber while Wemmbu, Eggchan and Wato distract ClownPierce. After arriving there they notice that the diamond players are suspicious. Spoke falls into the void and realizes he forgot a shovel. Spoke crafts an iron shovel and realize that it's not that good. Spoke eventually runs out of fireworks and Mapicc pulls his statis to save him.

Mapicc gives Spoke a shovel good enough to destroy the stasis chamber along with a ton of fireworks and Spoke makes it back into the void to destroy more statis pearls. Spoke mines out an entire section of pearls. Mapicc gets chased by diamond players while this is happening and since the diamond players notice that pearls are missing they fall into the hole and notice Spoke mining them. While the diamond players are trying to find Spoke, Mapicc goes back to his stasis chamber and notices that Spoke didn't throw his pearl this time leaving Spoke no option but to try to destroy all of the pearls. Spoke also notices the diamond players placing obsidian and after Spoke destroys all of the stasis chambers he realizes that the diamond players are placing obsidian to trap him there so that he dies. Spoke runs out of rockets and Mapicc makes a little cave for Spoke to chorus out. The diamond players die in the void after. Spoke and Mapicc happily fly around the place knowing that there are no pearls left. They find MinuteTech and they explain to MinuteTech how they managed to destroy all the statis chamber pearls. Minute tells them that he picked up a book which leads them to a house in the far lands along with a 
copper player
 and a statis chamber. They pull the statis chamber and it turns out that it's Ash. Spoke taunts and makes fun of Ash for losing his army and tells him that the statis chamber is destroyed. The Exploit Arc
 is the first arc in 
Season 1
 of 
Unstable Universe
.



Story


The episode begins with Spoke talking about how exploits have been appearing on the Unstable SMP. Spoke needed to talk to an old friend named 
JamatoP
. He says that exploits have been happening around the server, and he shows Spoke around to see what he has seen. Spoke does not like it, although he is tempted to wear the set of glitched armor that JamatoP has in his base. Since they had the same goal, Jamato decided to give Spoke the chest plate named 
Alt
. It becomes his signature item that Spoke has.

title: The Fake Identity Arc
content:
The Fake Identity Arc














Info




Season


2






Episode Amount


7








Episodes




First Episode


I Faked My Death on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP






Final Episode


2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Players






All Episodes


I Faked My Death on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP
I Secretly Joined My Enemy's Minecraft Team
How I "DIED" on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP
I Escaped Minecraft's Forgotten Dimension
I Got Impersonated on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP
I Got Hunted By Minecraft's Smartest Player
2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Players








The Fake Identity Arc
 is the third Wemmbu arc in Unstable Universe Season 2.



Story


Bored with the server, 
Wemmbu
 decides to fake his death and take on a new identity. He heads to 
Capital City 2.0
, the biggest current civilization, and joins the guard force there. While on guard, 
Boosfer
 kills a random player, so Wemmbu fights him, accidentally breaking a treaty between Boosfer's group of bandits and Capital City. The guard force fights the bandits, and Wemmbu is forced to use his mace against Boosfer, scaring off the bandits. He pursues them to their base and reveals his identity, killing everyone but Boosfer and 
Boomie
, whom he reoslves to hunt down.

Wemmbu joins up with 
Jaden MAN
, who's going on an expedition to the 
Great Sea
, which Boosfer mentioned. They fight the 
Ocean Rangers
, then head off to an island, then fight them again and get captured. Wemmbu manages to get them both out, though, and they manage to find Boomie. However, 
ParrotX2
 saves Boomie, forcing Wemmbu to follow them across the ocean until they finally stop. He kills Boomie and leaves, returning to Jaden. They go to the Ocean Rangers' base, where Wemmbu duels LobsterMan, their leader, and kills him, revealing his name. He makes Jaden promise not to tell anyone, then flies of to hunt Boosfer.

Wemmbu visits the End, and Egg tells him Boosfer's teamed with Flame now. Wemmbu also meets 
Salvationism
 again, the guard captain from Capital City. They put together a group to try and kill Boosfer, but fail. Salvationism decides to build a massive void trap, which fails to kill Boosfer or Flame. He and the entire guard force die in the resulting battle, but Wemmbu convinces Flame to help him kill Boosfer. Boosfer escapes through a Nether portal, and Wemmbu follows him.

On the other side is a void trap, and they both fall through. Instead of dying, though, they land in a mysterious world and are separated. Wemmbu finds a tower and brews potions, then gets attacked by some of the world's inhabitants. He and Boosfer are both imprisoned, but Wemmbu convinces Boosfer to give him his mace and a couple ender pearls, which he uses to kill the guard and escape. They head for the void hole, but the other players are already there guarding it. Boosfer gets through and is able to gear up Wemmbu, who kills three more people before they escape. He returns Boosfer's mace and promises to spare him if Boosfer never reveals his identity.

Wemmbu is accused of crimes he didn’t commit, and learns someone is impersonating him. He visits Egg and warns him, then visits Boosfer and finds the impostor already there. They fight but escape. Wemmbu learns a trial is being held in Capital City, and attends. He gets trapped with mining fatigue and fights two impostors, popping their totems to reveal Parrot and 
TheobaldTheBird
. Despite their best efforts, though, Wemmbu escapes.

Parrot and Theo show up, and Wemmbu chases them down a tunnel before being trapped in 
BAT Headquarters
. He fights Theo while trying to escape, and forces Parrot to use his escape method before escaping himself. Theo follows him, and they fight around the destroyed base before Wemmbu finally runs out of equipment and uses BAT's pearl cannon. However, Parrot planned for that, and now Wemmbu is trapped again. Parrot explains that he was hired by Flame to do this, and Flame shows up. While trying to escape, Wemmbu reveals his identity. He knocks Parrot into the void and attacks Flame.

Wemmbu and Flame fight until 
The Law
 show up. They escape and alternate between fighting each other and the Law, which keeps following them, before finally escaping and gearing up at Flame’s base. They attack 
LettuceK
 in 
Law City
, and Wemmbu proposes a fight between them and every single Law member, to which Lettuce agrees. Flame and Wemmbu get actually geared up, with EXP and potions, then head off to fight Lettuce’s army. Lettuce brings a thousand players, and Flame and Wemmbu fight and kill every single one of them, including one skilled mace wielder. They have one final battle, and Wemmbu gives up his title as the strongest player to Flame, then throws away the extra mace he got. Lettuce picks it up and threatens Wemmbu, who's almost out of gear. This leads directly into 
The Kings Arc
.

Wemmbu’s Banner for the Fake Identity Arc.

title: The Hunt for Minecraft's Deadliest Vault
content:
The Hunt for Minecraft's Deadliest Vault














Season


2






Episode


51






Upload date


Oct 12, 2025






POV


ParrotX2






Arcs


The Treasure Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


ClownPierce
TheobaldTheBird
FlameFrags
FerreMC
LettuceK
Twirps
Clown's guards














On the Unstable SMP, the nether dimension is ruled by ClownPierce, inaccessible to any normal player.





The Hunt for Minecraft's Deadlist Vault
 is the 78th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


Parrot's
 goal for this episode is to get to a secret, mysterious vault within the Nether, which is currently monopolized and controlled by the "King of the Nether" — 
ClownPierce
, who kills unauthorized players on sight if they are seen in the Nether. However, every few months, Clown hosts a festival in the Nether that everyone is allowed to attend, and Parrot uses this as an opportunity to find this hidden vault.

Parrot and 
Theo
 enter the Nether and, by sheer coincidence, run into Clown and 
FerreMC
 — his right-hand man— who immediately gives chase. Clown warns Ferre that the newcomers aren't there for the festival, but for the treasure inside his vault. The duo manages to escape without a particularly difficult fight and then proceeds to set up several traps and a small shelter. They craft shields with ClownPierce's banner pattern on them to blend in with his guards to not get caught.

However, Parrot encounters 
FlameFrags
 who demands to know why he is carrying Clown's shield. Parrot doesn't answer, and is pursued. The traps only manage to slow down Flame before eventually reaching the base, where Parrot bluffs that the entire place is rigged to blow at the break of a single block. It's revealed that Flame is in the Nether with the goal of killing Clown, and the three form a flimsy alliance. Heading to the festival, Flame burns an innocent shop owner's enchanted golden apple (his favorite item) and then refuses to recover it. While he and Theo go to investigate the festival, Parrot takes it upon himself to recover the enchanted golden apple. He wins one from another player by perfectly completing a 10-question quiz on Minecraft mechanics.

Parrot devises a plan: they will kidnap Ferre from Clown's fortress and interrogate him to find the coordinates of the vault. Infiltrating the fortress with invisibility potions, Theo and Flame try to break Ferre's armor to force him to come with them, but he activates an alarm, alerting the fortress of intruders. Parrot slips past the guards and Clown, who are searching the massive fortress, and finds the panel used to enter the deactivation PIN. Parrot breaks the mechanism, but Clown realizes that an outsider has disabled the alarm. They decide to check the top floors, where the fight with Ferre is taking place. To buy them time, Parrot pulls a lever that activates the Mining Fatigue effect throughout the lower levels. From the outside, Parrot makes his way to the roof. The building is so enormous that it takes him a full minute to arrive, but once he does, he blows a hole in the wall with TNT which Ferre is extracted and taken to the trio's temporary base.

They question him, but he refuses to give up the vault's coordinates. However, Parrot has a secret plan; he secretly places some random items and maps into Ferre's inventory, then giving him an elytra in exchange for revealing the coordinates of the vault. Instead, Ferre simply flees, and the team blames Parrot for being "stupid", even attempting to kill him. Parrot reveals his true plan to Theo and Flame, among the items he gave Ferre, Parrot had slipped in a locator map. Now, the original map that Parrot holds will show the location of Ferre, who is holding the copy, as long as he is within the map's range. The three track him to an open plain, hoping that someone else will follow Ferre to the vault, assuming Ferre is going there to get new items.

While they take shifts watching for passersby, Theo pulls Parrot aside and asks if there is any situation in which someone could outsmart him. Parrot replies that it's possible and once again lists the types of people on the server. "
There are those who want to have fun, those who want to build, those who want to farm, those who want to explore, those who want to rule over others, but also those who want everything for themselves. And if there's such a person, who has nothing to lose and somehow decides they want the entire server, they will take it, and there will be nothing to stop them!
"

"Don't treat him like a god," Theo scolds. But Parrot speaks the truth: "FlameFrags is such a person. He has done so many evil things, but in my opinion, he doesn't have the capacity to become the absolute ruler of the server. But if he decided to, no one could successfully stand in his way."

The two then move away so FlameFrags (who is AFK) won't overhear them. After their dialogue, they return, only to be surprised that he is gone.

This leads to a dramatic monologue from Parrot: "I always want to make the server a better place, but I think I'm always the one messing things up. There is no way FlameFrags can be a good person after all he has done, but is it right for me to use him for my own goals? What I did was definitively not a good thing, despite the fact that it was for the good of the server."

Shortly after, ClownPierce, along with FlameFrags who has revealed their location, attacks Parrot and Theo. They surrender after less than a minute of fighting. Flame tells Parrot that he heard everything and could no longer be on a team with him. "Why did you team up with Clown?!" Parrot asks in disbelief. "Because in exchange, he said he would tell me what happened to 
Wemmbu
!" Flame replies. "And how could you trust Clown?" Parrot continues to question him. ClownPierce intervenes: "How do you think I know what happened to Wemmbu? I've been in the Nether this entire time!" Clown gives Parrot a chance to say his last words. Parrot apologizes to Flame and awaits his death. "You two are coming with us," ClownPierce decides, planning to abduct them.

But then, FlameFrags stands his ground: "If you want to take them, you'll have to go through me first!" This is considered by many to be one of the most heroic moments on the server.

FlameFrags and Theo hold off ClownPierce's army while Parrot heads for the treasure. After some time, the villain appears, tampers with a redstone mechanism, and then leaves. Parrot presses a button, and a tunnel opens, leading straight into the massive vault. It is built as a pool of lava containing many bastions, with walls made of obsidian. The shape of the vault is a massive cuboid.

Parrot begins to look through the chests, but ClownPierce's voice speaks from behind him: "How dare you enter my vault? There is no escape now!"

Parrot is pursued and flees using the elytra Theo gave him earlier. A chase begins in the gigantic, but relatively low-ceilinged, space. As he flies from bastion to bastion, our hero loots as many chests as he can. In one of them are stacks of chorus fruit, which Parrot grabs and uses. By some chance, he teleports into an obsidian box housing the elder guardians—the mobs that inflict the Mining Fatigue effect. Parrot gets out, throws some items from his inventory, but as he drops his flint and steel into the lava, he realizes he could have used it to light a Nether portal to escape safely to the Overworld. However, in another chest, there is another flint and steel, which Parrot takes and later uses to exit the vault via the Overworld.

When he returns to Capitol City, Theo is surprised to see him still alive. FlameFrags enters the potion shop. This time, he doesn't want to steal or buy anything. Instead, he gives Parrot a task that he claims "only he can accomplish." Parrot says he will do it out of the goodness of his heart, not because he wants something in return.

"You must find the Mafia's tomb. There's a truly massive treasure there!" - Flame insists.

Parrot recalls all the dramatic moments from the Great War. Without much hesitation, he agrees. But FlameFrags adds a condition: in exchange, Parrot must find out what happened to Wemmbu.

I Bankrupted Minecraft's Richest Civilization








The Invisible Mafia
 was one of the main antagonistic factions in 
Unstable Universe
. It was a large and powerful authoritarian group led and owned by 
Ashswagg
. 



Structure


Leadership


The Mafia Leader, Ashswagg, commanded all the players in the faction. He initiated hits and where members would go. He was not invisible, talks, and didn't wear armor. It was said that if he did die, the stasis chamber of everyone in the mafia would activate, killing them in the void. According to 
MinuteTech
, the Mafia used to have a different leader who was less cruel. 



Hierarchy


The Mafia’s hierarchy was based around the color of your armor trims. The highest ranking members had diamond trims, and were tasked with the most important jobs. The better the material that the trim is made of, the higher ranking the member was, with no trim being the lowest tier. 

The majority of the Mafia were new players who don’t know much about the server. It was later revealed that after killing a player, unranked players were given the choice to either "leave" the Mafia or to rank up to Copper. If a player chose to leave, their stasis would be pulled and they would be killed in the void. 

When a player killed another player, their name appeared in the chat, revealing their identity. It was one of the only times when their identity was allowed to be shared. When a mafia member killed another player, they could rank up, and become anonymous again, unless they were a diamond trim mafia player.



Rankings and Armor Trims


Full Article: 
The Invisible Mafia Members


Each member of the mafia wore a netherite chestplate. Depending on the rank of the soldier, the chestplate was trimmed with the eye-armor trim, where the material of the trim decides the rank of the player.

For an Iron player, a Copper player or an untrimmed player to rank up, they needed to successfully complete 3 tasks/missions which were given by Gold trimmed mafia members.

For a Gold trim to rank up to a Diamond trim and get the mace, they needed to schedule a duel and beat a Diamond trim in a 1v1 to the death, overseen by Ashswag. If the gold trim succeeded in killing the diamond, both their usernames would show in chat, and the gold player’s ender pearl in the stasis would be moved into the separate and unique stasis chamber away from the other players, replacing the dead former diamond trim. This means that the amount of diamond trims would never increase, and that the gold trim needed to actually be a part of the mafia. 

All diamond trimmed mafia members had a mace, except for 
FlameFrags
, who disliked maces.

Diamond trim players were usually the players who lead attacks to destroy civilizations on the server, and were often accompanied by gold trim players.

Special trims like netherite or redstone trims were picked out by Ash, as the only netherite trim we've seen has been ClownPierce, and the only Redstone trim has been FerreMC.

mafia

Mafia
. The 
Mafia
 was created by

 and if a player doesn't do what 
Ashwagg
 tells them to do, they get killed.

 besides

"Higher Ups"
. Each Iron Mafia Player had full netherite armor with a Iron eye trim on their chestplates. Each member of The Iron Players got some windcharges and colored firework rockets so people can tell their part of the 
Mafia
. 

On the Unstable SMP, Diamond Ranked 
Mafia
 Members are the highest rank in the Invisible Mafia, all of them, excluding

. To become a Diamond Ranked Mafia Members, you have to kill another Diamond Rank, this was implemented so

 wouldn’t have to try and get new Maces. 





Practices


Each active member was made to throw a ender pearl into a tunnel of bubble columns leading to a heavily guarded large stasis chamber by trusted diamond players only. Their stasis was set in a stasis chamber, and if the stasis chamber was mined under so that once the stasis was pulled (activated), the player fell into the void, died, and got banned off of the server. This meant that if a mafia member was seen visible by other mafia members or by allies of the mafia and reported, they would teleport into the void and be killed. For this reason, mafia members did not carry any totems of undying, because if it popped, their invisibility would be removed and they would get killed anyways. This method of control was how the Mafia took over the server. It was later revealed that Ashswagg still had the enderpearl's of all former members in The Mafia Tomb. If any resources were taken from The Tomb, all former members of The Invisible Mafia would be killed meaning that The Mafia still technically exists.


Fireworks were used to signal the Mafia to or from an area/player. White fireworks called the Mafia away, black fireworks signaled the Mafia to an area to kill a player, and red fireworks signaled the start of a mission.


If Ashswagg died all members of the Invisible Mafia would be teleported to their statis chambers and would be killed in the void with him. This prevented any attempts to end the mafia by killing Ashswagg.

title: The Invisible Mafia Arc
content:
The Invisible Mafia Arc














Info




Season


1






Episode Amount


11








Episodes




First Episode


I Built Minecraft's Safest Civilization






Final Episode


The End of the Minecraft Mafia






All Episodes


I Built Minecraft's Safest Civilization
I Survived Minecraft's Most Corrupt City
I Got Hunted by the Minecraft Mafia
I Discovered a Minecraft Sky Civilization
The Search for Minecraft's Far Lands
I Infiltrated The Minecraft Mafia
I Mastered Minecraft Combat
Unstable SMP: The First War
Unstable SMP: Doomsday
Unstable SMP: The Mafia
The End of the Minecraft Mafia








The Invisible Mafia Arc
, is the second 
major
 arc in 
Unstable Universe
.



Story


SpokeIsHere
 and 
Mapicc
 suspect that 
Roshambogames
 has been duping more items. They obtain a list of coords to various farms from 
TheRealSquiddo
's base, and 
Ashswagg
 saves them from invisible attackers, but it's later revealed he sent the players, causing tension between Mapicc, who doesn't trust him, and Spoke, who does. Mapicc temporarily leaves the team, but Spoke convinces him to rejoin. Their End base gets destroyed by 
Wemmbu
 and 
Eggchan
, hired by Roshambo. They find Roshambo at a flower farm and realize he's never had any malicious plans, and then it gets blown up by invisible players, leading Spoke to finally realize Ash has betrayed them. They head around to previous farms and find them all blown up, so go to the last one. Ash is there, and he reveals he wants Spoke's exploits, then sends in invisible players. Spoke and Mapicc both barely manage to escape.

ParrotX2
 and 
Wifies
 decide to start an End civilization that no one can find. 
Deanthebean9
 promptly finds it, explaining he's part of 
The Invisible Mafia
 and was sent to kill them. They gather villagers for their civilization with help from 
Kenadian
, while 
Horace Altman
 builds the civilization. Parrot and Dean head to the Invisible Mafia HQ, where he pops Dean's totem. Dean gets teleported into the void, but Kenadian saves him using a stasis, freeing him. 
Boosfer
 shows up to claim the civilization, and Parrot agrees to hold an election with him. Horace builds chunkbans, and Parrot nearly dies to the Mafia while saving a new member. Their civilization grows, and Boosfer ends up losing the election. The Mafia gets into the civilization, forcing everyone to flee, but Parrot, Wifies, and Dean later return and blow it up.

Parrot, Wifies, and Dean try to break into 
Capital City
, but get caught by 
Reddoons
 and sentenced to the mines. They meet 
LuigiToan
, a miner, and 
CoinMonke
, the warden. They manage to sneak into Capital City and steal diamond blocks, paying off the debts of four miners before Red gets suspicious. Parrot attempts to blackmail him with the stolen diamonds, so Red builds a roulette wheel, forcing whoever mines the fewest diamonds to play. It ends up being Parrot, but Coin doesn't kill him, and Parrot uses that to blackmail him into helping break into another vault. They fail to steal anything, and play roulette again. Red kills Luigi, inspiring the miners to revolt. Parrot organizes a plan and they get into the primary vault, but Red's waiting for them, and he reveals everyone has been captured. Parrot convinces him to play roulette to decide the winner, and Red wins, but lets everyone go except for Parrot, Dean, and Wifies. He takes them to meet Ash, who wants them to join the Mafia, but they decline and escape.

Spoke and Mapicc get attacked by the Mafia, but saved by 
MinuteTech
, who initially refuses to work with them, but after they prove their worth in a second attack, he agrees. They split up to recruit people, and Spoke and Mapicc find 
PlanetLord
, but get attacked by more Mafia players and barely escape. They attempt to recruit Squiddo, but are chased by the Mafia. Spoke escapes and meets with Minute, but Mapicc gets captured. Planet arrives with Squiddo, and they head to her castle, where Ash supposedly left coordinates of some kind. They get waylaid by the Mafia along the way, but manage to shake them. Squiddo has to leave, but the other three follow the coords to a Mafia trap, where Spoke and Planet are forced to leave Minute behind. They decide to finally use exploits, heading to 
JamatoP's
 old base. However, the exploits fail to work, and Ash shows up with Minute, who has betrayed. Spoke and Planet escape and Spoke almost gives up, but Planet convinces him to try and find Jamato. They successfully find coords hidden under a 
Wonder
, and follow them to a base with a compass that leads to the Mafia HQ.

Wemmbu discovers 
Skyblock Civilization
, led by 
Yeah Jaron
 and guarded by 
Straight
, where he is forced to stay. There he finds 
Pangi
 and 
Wato1876
, and plots to escape with Wato. He, Jaron, and Straight head down to spawn, and are attacked by Invisible Mafia members, but Straight kills them. Back up top, Wemmbu and Wato realize Jaron has items unobtainable through skyblock, and plan to expose him. Wemmbu spies on Straight and Jaron, and afterwards Straight tells him he wants to help with the exposing plan. By talking to various citizens, they learn about Parrot's End civilization and Capital City both, visit both, and get attacked at both, but eventually manage to escape. Jaron secretly gives Wemmbu a mace, and implies Straight is a traitor; Straight later confirms this and gives Wemmbu the chance to leave, which he takes.

Parrot, Dean, and Wifies are pursued by the Mafia as they travel to Luigi's house. Inside, they find his diary and a compass to the Farlands, which they set out towards. They gear up during their travels, surviving multiple Mafia attacks and reading through Luigi's diary. Eventually, they find an obsidian wall and 
R4trick
, who offers to be a tour guide through the Mafia-controlled areas beyond, but he flees when the Mafia attacks them. They continue on, Wifies pushing to leave Dean behind, and finally it's revealed that Dean is the reason the Mafia keeps finding them. Dean sneaks away, forcing Wifies and Parrot to continue on alone. However, when Wifies burns the compass and tries to convince Parrot to run away with him, Parrot refuses and leaves him, continuing on his own. He eventually reaches the Farlands, and finds 
Far Lands Civilisation
, led by Horace, whom he convinces to help fight the Mafia.

Spoke and Planet find a Mafia outpost and break 
Leow0ok's
 totem, but he reveals he's infiltrating the Mafia to kill 
ClownPierce
. The three head to 
Mafia City
, where Planet leaves and they free Mapicc. The three are sent on various missions, encountering both Parrot and Wemmbu, and eventually rank up to copper tier, then iron. They are sent to hunt Planet, but fail to kill him, which their chaperone witnesses, leading to multiple players getting killed by Ash as he tries to figure out who did it. Leo and Mapicc both rank up to gold, but Spoke is left behind, as Ash knows it was him. He is sent to kill 
IMajesticRose
, an innocent player, which he does. Ash congratulates him, and informs him that to become a diamond player, he has to defeat one in a fight, which Spoke agrees to do. He secretly cheats at the fight, but his totem still pops, revealing himself as Spoke. Ash tries to get the diamond to kill him, but the diamond betrays instead, revealing himself as Minute, and letting them escape.

Wemmbu trades his mace to 
ManePear
 in exchange for training. They visit multiple Mafia outposts, killing many players and obtaining a lot of gear, which Mane uses to teach Wemmbu about proper kits. He sends him off to kill gold players, and Wemmbu successfully kills three. Mane sends him after a diamond next, and Wemmbu meets Spoke while searching. They get attacked by an invis player, and Wemmbu nearly kills him before realizing it's Eggchan, whom he brings back to Mane's treehouse. They visit 
Ice Mountain Civilization
 with the intention of killing a diamond player, and Wemmbu gets to test out the mace against invading Mafia members, but they fail to kill the diamond. Back home, Mane teaches Wemmbu how to use the mace. Later, Egg's Mafia stasis gets pulled, and Wemmbu goes to save him, fighting diamond 
FlameFrags
 for a long time before finally being forced to give up his mace. Wemmbu and Egg return home, but find Mane has left them, permanently.

Parrot joins the 
Warriors District
 of the Farlands. After his squad's leader dies, 
TheobaldTheBird
 becomes the new leader, as well as a member of the 
Warriors Council
. Wifies arrives at the Farlands and joins the Farmers District, who have a long-standing feud with the Warriors due to the latter thinking the former is useless. Parrot hopes to prove them wrong by using strategy to win a game of capture the flag. The squad gets sent to kill a diamond player but are forced to retreat. Parrot challenges 
DumbIsDumb
 for his seat in the Council, and wins using more strategy. Additionally, he visits Dean, living on his own in the jungle. Council leader 
Purpled
 reveals that the Warriors don't have enough members to meaningfully challenge the Mafia, and Parrot suggests merging the three districts. Purpled tries to have him assassinated, and Parrot uses that to seize control of the Warriors. He and the Farmers go to stop bomber planes from the Mafia, and in the process it's revealed that Dean was forced to rejoin, and his stasis gets pulled, killing him. The rest of the Warriors get captured, but Parrot and the Farmers successfully break them out of the End civilization. Parrot demands to be taken to Ash, who reveals that he knows where the Farlands are. Parrot stasises out.

Clown and Ferre burn down Mane’s treehouse. Parrot shows up and takes Wemmbu and Egg to District 13, where they plot to kill a diamond player. After a long battle, they succeed, giving Wemmbu a mace. He goes to Clown’s castle for revenge, but is forced to flee. Ferre takes Egg captive, but Wemmbu and Egg defeat him and force him to give up his mace in exchange for his life. They reuinite with Parrot and Spoke, then all head to a prison at spawn, where Wemmbu distracts the Mafia so the others can break in and hopefully find the Mafia's stasises. They succeed, but the Mafia attacks District 13. Wemmbu kills most of them, and while Spoke goes to destroy the stasises, he flies out with Egg to distract Clown and Ferre. After enough time has passed, they leave the fight and, with the Mafia successfully destroyed, decide to go make another civilization.

Farland City is destroyed. Horace builds 
District 13
 for those who remain, then joins the Mafia. Parrot, Wifies, and Theo go to assassinate Ash, but Clown stops them. Parrot kills 
Yusai
, a new recruit to District 13, out of suspicion that he's a Mafia spy. While surveying spawn, Parrot and Wifies meet Spoke and Mapicc, and they head to IMajesticRose's house to try and find clues. There they find 
Quackenstein123
, who supposedly has coords to the Mafia's stasises, but it turns out to be fake. The members of District 13 leave, so Parrot recruits Wemmbu, and they kill a diamond player to get him a mace, but then he leaves. They try to kill Ash but fail, and he gives them 24 hours to run. He finds them anyway, and Wifies joins the Mafia as a spy. Parrot, Spoke, and Wemmbu break into a prison at spawn, but fail to locate the stasises. Ash and Wifies confront Parrot, and he pulls Wifies' stasis, killing him. Parrot returns to District 13, which gets attacked. He leaves the battle and goes back to Farland City, lighting beacons around the server to serve as a distraction for Spoke, who successfully destroys the Mafia. Parrot later visits Ash, living in exile in the Farlands, who tells him 
the Director
 was the one who killed Wifies, not him.

Square City
 is destroyed by the Mafia, despite Spoke's and Mapicc's attempts to stop them. They regroup with MinuteTech, then head to 
Sleepy Nation
, where they manage to reclaim a stash of gear from the Mafia, but are betrayed by its inhabitants. Spoke kicks Minute out due to frustration. They meet Parrot and Wifies and find Quackenstein and 
BeckyTronVIII
, iMajesticRose's family. They find out Quackenstein is a diamond player, but he gives them coords to the stasis chambers. Those are believed to be false, but after breaking into a prison at spawn, Spoke realizes the book is actually a key to navigate a maze, and they successfully find the stasises. They returns to District 13, which gets attacked. After the battle, they return to the stasises. Two diamond players show up, and after Spoke destroys all of the stasises, they die in the void. With the Mafia gone, Spoke and Mapicc go to the Farlands and pull Ash's stasis, but Spoke decides not to kill him to avoid becoming like him. Ash promises that one day he'll have a mafia of his own, then flies off.

title: The Invisible Mafia Members
content:
The Invisible Mafia
 used different eye armor trims to represent the ranking of each member. Players start of without a trim. Usually, the lower ranking players know almost nothing about the higher ranking players and are usually unwelcome in another higher ranking tier in Mafia City. By completing missions, they can gain the copper, iron and gold eye armor trims. The diamond eye armor trim however, cannot be gained through completing missions.



Ranks of the Mafia


Untrimmed → Copper → Iron → Gold → Diamond → Netherite → Redstone → Mafia leader


Untrimmed


The Untrimmed Mafia members are the lowest ranking players in The Invisible Mafia. They are usually the soldiers, guards or messengers of the Mafia. A lot of them are players who don’t know much, and were indoctrinated in via spawn prison at spawn or the Mafia finding random players around the world.



Copper


The Copper Trimmed Mafia player is the second lowest ranked in The Invisible Mafia. They are higher ranking than the Untrimmed members, therefore they can command them in battles or in 
Mafia City
.



Iron


The Iron Trimmed Mafia members are sixth highest of ranks in The Invisible Mafia trimmed players. They outrank both Copper Trims and untrimmed, they are usually equiped with wind charges, and can use different colored fireworks to communicate with each other.



Gold


The Gold Trimmed Mafia members are the fifth highest trimmed players in The Invisible Mafia. They outrank the Iron Trimmed members, and are responsible for handing out missions for the lower ranking players via book and quill, and usually leading them.



Diamond


The Diamond Trimmed Mafia members are the fourth highest ranking trimmed player in The Invisible Mafia, and the most skilled. To achieve this rank, the Gold Trimmed players must kill a Diamond Trimmed player to gain their chestplate, meaning that the total number of diamond players would never increase. The Diamond Trimmed members all wield a mace, (Except FlameFrags, who dislikes maces) They lead armies and groups to destroy civilizations and to kill off any enemies of the Mafia. Notable players were as follows:



FlameFrags


mp6


MinuteTech


Quackeinstein123


VEN0M
 ✝


Iqcniq
 ✝


Crystzx


cocomelon2 ✝


Netherite


While only one person holds this rank that person being 
ClownPierce
 often called the deadliest minecraft player ClownPierce was given access to two maces. Meaning clown is one of the five people that have or have ever had two maces. Addtionally this rank serves as the third highest rank in the Invisible mafia as well as the exicutioner of the Invisible mafia.



ClownPierce


Redstone


While only one person holds this rank is 
FerreMC
. This serves as the 2nd highest rank in all of the Invisible Mafia as well as the second in command of the Mafia. Ferre also at one point had two maces.  One became 
Wemmbu’s
 gambit and another was Ferres own mace. As well as the Redstone trims command the Diamond players.



FerreMC


Mafia Leader


This is the highest rank in all of the Mafia whoever is in this role has absolute authority over anything going on in the Mafia, the statis chambers, who gets promoted, who dies, and especially who lives, this role has only ever been filled by two players the players being an unnamed leader who preceded Ashswagg who is the only other person to have this role.
