title: The Kingdoms Arc
content:
"
The Ash Will Rise.
"
This article is unfinished or outdated by new episode info. You can help Unstable Universe Wiki by 
expanding it
.




The Kingdoms Arc














Info




Season


3






Episode Amount


8








Episodes




First Episode


I Joined the World's Largest Minecraft Server






All Episodes


I Joined the World's Largest Minecraft Server
I Became a Minecraft Combat Master
100 Days as King of the Unstable SMP
I Survived 100 Days on a Hardcore Minecraft Server
Minecraft Pro VS 1000 Player Civilization
I Explored the Minecraft Mist
Searching for a Civilization that Doesn't Exist
1 VS 100 Player Minecraft War
I Got Hunted by the World's Deadliest Assassin
Searching For My Friend Who Went Missing
I Joined the World's Largest Minecraft Army
Unstable SMP: Civil War
1000 Players Simulate UNDERGROUND Civilization in Minecraft










All videos from the new Unstable SMP Kingdoms Saga in order! If you are new to the series, I would recommend starting here, and then backtracking to older videos if you want more content! also arc name is subject to change lol.


—
Wemmbu




The Kingdoms Arc
, or 
Kingdoms
, formerly known as 
The Kingdoms Saga
, is the 16th 
Arc
 of 
Unstable Universe
. *Spoke's 
The NULL Arc
 takes place at the same time, and video summaries will be included on this page as well*.

Story


Wemmbu
 kills some of 
Arachn1d's
 soldiers who accost him while he's building, then runs out of materials and heads to nearby Elysium for more. There, he scares off 
Yungyx
, and the leader mentions they used to have a diamond player protecting them, but he left the server and hid his mace somewhere. Wemmbu gets 
Eggchan
, then goes to meet with a player who might know where the mace is. 
LordSirWessley
 challenges them to a fight for the info, and Wemmbu recruits 
Jaden MAN
 and an unknown invis player to his side, while Wessley has 
TheGOdOfWar
 and 
Yungyx
. Wemmbu's side wins the fight, and they follow Wessley's instructions to a giant cavern, killing some players that try and attack them. There, the invis player from before takes the mace, but Wemmbu forces him to give it back after a fight, and they return to Elysium and give up the mace.

Flame video

ParrotX2
 gets booed during his 
coronation
, so he promises to fix the server. He starts off by killing all the withers at spawn with 
TheobaldTheBird
, then making 
Fymada
 the mayor of 
Capitol City
. He travels to 
Merchant City
 and competes in an auction for a chicken, during which Theo bets 100,000 diamonds. He attempts to get 
Redstone Town
 to help him build chicken farms, but only 
4CVIT
 helps. Parrot brings the food back to spawn, but 
SargeLAW
 attacks. However, Parrot manages to get away. 
Horace Altman
 has built a kingdom around spawn to protect new players, but many old players dislike Parrot for it. He goes to talk to 
LettuceK
, who tells him he's made a mistake.

SpokeIsHere
 is attacked by 
mysterious players
 in his base, but they stasis away before they can die. 
JumperWho
 arrives, and gives Spoke coords to a safehouse for if he gets attacked again. Spoke leaves and finds a random player's base, setting up a trap, but again the mysterious players stasis away when they should have died. Spoke flees to the safehouse, meeting up with Jumper. 
BAT
 spies hold off the hunters while Spoke and Jumper flee, but the red-trimmed leader nearly kills them. They escape and head to a base where 
SirPig
 is being held; he may have ties to the mysterious players. However, SirPig stasises away and the players attack. Spoke and Jumper run to an arrow cannon Spoke set up earlier, which they are able to use to kill the red-trimmed player, who drops a book titled 'null'.

I Survived 100 Days on a Hardcore Minecraft Server


FlameFrags is chilling at his 
Megabase
 until the same players that 
created it
 decided to start taking it down because they needed money, and so FlameFrags decides to work for the law to keep his megabase. He later goes on a series of missions, rescuing a captured law soldier from an Arachn1d guard, and failing multiple times to get players to join the law after the 
defeat
 at the 
Northern Council
. When he kills the Arachn1d elite, this is where Flame says he's not just a combat master, he is also a battle strategist. Flame rescues a player from 
The Wheat Kingdom
. On one of the final days, FlameFrags gets to talk to 
LettuceK
. Although FlameFrags had, in his opinion, teammates who had absolutely destroyed his gameplay in the 100 Days video, he decided to keep his mega base after a while. 

Eggchan gets kidnapped by an army of players. Wemmbu follows them and overhears a conversation between their leader and Arachn1d. Once Arachn1d leaves, he attempts to enter the army's base, but they have wardens as guards. He eventually manages to sneak inside and finds Eggchan. He is able to save him, and then kills the entire army. After he leaves, the invis player from before finds Eggchan's book of coordinates.

Parrot and Theo are attacked and imprisoned by Capital City's guard for supposedly killing 43 players. The 
Merchant City Vanguard
 breaks them out, because Theo still owes 100k diamonds. They sneak back into Capital City, with Parrot going to talk to Fymada, who is now nothing but a puppet. Meanwhile, Theo is attacked by his old trainer, 
ShoeBilly
. Parrot flees from guards and Theo is nearly killed by ShoeBilly. Parrot discovers a massive building where all of the new players are imprisoned, to be executed soon. Theo meets up with Parrot, but ShoeBilly finds them again and they're separated. Theo refuses to betray Parrot, so ShoeBilly leaves, saying he'll come back when Theo's ready. Parrot is cornered by guards, but convinces them to confirm they framed him. He reveals that he got Fymada to gather a bunch of citizens to witness the confession, proving his innocence. Later, Parrot and Theo discuss how it feels like there's someone out to get the new players.

The null book lists 100 players and coordinates. Spoke and Jumper find a base at the nearest set of coords, before being jumped by the mysterious players. They run to an escape tunnel they'd set up previously, but the players turned it into a void hole. However, they are able to escape through another void hole at the base of another player in the book, a notorious trapper. They visit Parrot for help, but he turns them down, since he's too busy with his kingdom. While leaving they are attacked again, and barely get away. They continue to visit the coords in the book, before finally finding a book at one location, explaining that the players are called Null, and that they have a pearl cannon called the Road of Null. Jumper gathers her spies and they head to the place, but Null is waiting. The cannon is destroyed and most of the spies die. Defeated, they return to Spoke's base, only for 
Mapicc
 to suddenly show up.

Flame joins 
The Mist
 to try and assassinate their leader, 
Mistrul
. He is forced to team with 
FluffalsSupreme
, but they continually get into conflict. Eventually, they settle it in a duel, where Fluffals dies. Flame brings Lomedy to the Mist, and they sneak out of the civilization to go looking for Mistrul. Members of Archan1d's army attack them there, and they take refuge in a cave. That cave turns out to be Mistrul's base. Flame fights him, but retreats when he attacks Lomedy. The two escape, but as they're leaving on a happy ghast, Lomedy is knocked off.

Parrot video

Mapicc gives Spoke coords, then stasises away. Spoke and Jumper find Mapicc with a pearl cannon at the coords, but Null attacks. They take the cannon to the 
Far Lands
 and hide from Null. They attempt to meet up with the player who helped Mapicc escape Null, but encounter other escapees instead, and then Null. They escape and find 
PlanetLord
 leading a small group of players, who give them a bit of gear. Null attacks and again they run, towards an unnaturally dark forest. There, though, they are able to ambush and kill several Null members, and force the last to take them to Null's leader. The member brings them to a trapdoor, which they go down, eventually finding a massive underground area. 
JamatoP
 shows up.

While searching for Lomedy, Flame gets attacked by Mistrul. 
NotSkrilley
 splashes him with invis and takes him to a small village of players who escaped Mistrul. Flame agrees to help them escape the greater Mist if they find Lomedy. Flame, Skrilley, and 
Flowtives
 go to a cavern, but Mistrul attacks them there and they barely escape. They are followed back to the village, which is destroyed, its citizens killed. Skrilley leads Flame to one more place Lomedy might be, but they find Flowtives and Mistrul there instead, with a grave for Lomedy. Flame fights them both, but is forced to run. With Lomedy dead, he enters the Zone and invades the Mist civilization, killing Mistrul in a 1v1 and wiping out a majority of the players there. He duels Flowtives, but chooses to leave him alive so he can live with his destroyed civilization. Flame returns to his base only to find Lomedy alive with Skrilley, having been hiding the whole time.

Wemmbu video

While coming back to spawn, Parrot, Theo, and Reina are attacked by bandits. However, Parrot recruits them as well as the larger group they're a part of to his army, which he plans to use to fight Cindercrest. They head to Merchant City for resources, but the leader 
DanchoGold
 tries to imprison them for Theo's debt. They take Dancho hostage instead, and use him to gain the allegiance of the Merchant City guard force. Parrot steals diamonds from him, then goes to the Nether to visit 
ClownPierce
, from whom he buys 40k TNT. He sends Theo and Reina on a scouting mission, during which they see Flame and ShoeBilly leading hundreds of Cindercrest forces. Parrot tries to recruit the Law, and those who don't join him, he kills with TNT and his growing army. He spends a lot of time recruiting other players, and when Theo and Reina return, he shows them his full army, around 15,000 players.

Jamato blackmails Spoke to stay silent, and brings them up to the surface. Spoke convinces them to go the opposite direction. Null continually attacks them along the way, but eventually they make it to a rainbow forest. They find a player there, who leads them into a trap. However, they convince the leader to give them a compass leading to a secret gear stash. They head there, losing resources to mobs, only for Null to steal the gear out from under them. Running low on food, they enter a nearby forest and find another settlement led by 
CookieBunsquat
, one of Jumper's own spies. While Jamato is re-gearing, Spoke disguises himself as a Null member and attempts to kill him, but Mapicc catches him. The two fight, eventually ending up deep underground, where Spoke's totem pops, clearing his invis. Mapicc leaves. Spoke eventually finds an exit into a maze, where he's met with Jamato, who confirms he is Null's leader and that Null exists to get rid of all the bad players in the world, most notably Spoke. Jamato leaves, and Spoke finds the exit. However, Mapicc shows up, revealing Jamato told him everything, and he breaks Spoke's prized chestplate. Null attacks, and Mapicc blames Spoke before being captured. Jamato returns and forces Spoke to burn all his items, including what's in his ender chest, before capturing him as well.

title: The Kings Arc
content:
The Election Arc










LettuceK
 announces the Election






Info




Season


2






Episode Amount


21








Episodes




First Episode


I Got Exiled from the Unstable SMP






Final Episode


Parrot - 
I Became King of the Unstable SMP
Wemmbu - 
Unstable SMP: The LAW
Spoke - 
4 Minecraft Pros VS 2500 Players
FlameFrags - 
2500 Players VS Minecraft Combat Master






All Episodes


I Got Exiled from the Unstable SMP
I Became a Prisoner on the Unstable SMP
I Became WANTED on the Unstable SMP
Escaping Prison on the Unstable SMP
I Got Hunted By the Minecraft LAW
Unstable SMP: The First King
I Explored the Minecraft Great Sea
I Ran for King on the Unstable SMP
I Survived the Unstable SMP Purge
I Got Trained By the World's Best Minecraft Player
Breaking Hardcore Minecraft to Get Revenge
2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Hunters
I Became a Minecraft Killer
I Explored the Minecraft Farlands
I Got Trained By a Minecraft TNT Master
Minecraft Trapper VS 1000 Players
Minecraft Pro VS 1000 Players
I Became King of the Unstable SMP
4 Minecraft Pros VS 2500 Players
Unstable SMP: The LAW
2500 Players VS Minecraft Combat Master










The Unstable SMP needs a ruler.



LettuceK
 to Unstable SMP, in 
I Got Exiled from the Unstable SMP
, 
I Became a Prisoner on the Unstable SMP


The Kings Arc
, also known as 
The Election Arc
, is the third 
major
 arc in 
Unstable Universe
.



Story


Note:
 Spoke's episodes will be included both here and at the 
BAT Arc
 page. 

FlameFrags
 gets attacked by members of 
The Law
, because their leader 
LettuceK
 has exiled him from a 50k radius around spawn. He attends an announcement Lettuce makes to the entire server, where Lettuce reveals his plans to hold an election for a king, as well as the fact that he has captured 
Wemmbu
. Flame returns to his base but gets attacked again. Realizing he needs trap supplies, he recruits a reluctant 
Lomedy
, and comes into conflict with the Law again. He ends up losing the fight and is forced to run away, swearing to not return until he's mastered PVP. 

Wemmbu gets imprisoned by Lettuce, weakened by his last fight with Flame. They run through the prison routine, where Wemmbu meets inmates 
Fantst
, 
Baablu
, and 
PrinceZam
, and guard 
Loppezz
. Lettuce takes him for the announcement, and on the way back someone splashes them with an invisible potion. Wemmbu tries to escape but gets recaptured, so Lettuce puts curse of binding armor on all the inmates before tossing Wemmbu solitary confinement. 
SpokeIsHere
 breaks in to offer Wemmbu his freedom in exchange for assistance, but Wemmbu refuses. 

Flame gets attacked by 
Deputy Ace
, Lettuce's second in command. He escapes the battle and goes to Lomedy's farm, convincing a very reluctant Lomedy to let him stay just to regear. While getting wind charges, the Law shows up, but Flame escapes them. Ace comes back with a dozen people and start blowing up Lomedy's farm. Lomedy gives Flame his mace, but Flame is unable to kill them all, and so runs. 

Wemmbu gets out of solitary and begins plotting his escape. He manages to obtain some signs, and uses them to talk to the other prisoners. They start trying to break each other's armor. Baablu has invis in his ender chest, so Wemmbu comes up with a plan to get them into the prison storeroom. It works, but Loppezz catches them. Baablu manages to keep one invis poition, though. While out mining, the prisoners attempt to use it to escape, but get recaptured. All of them are put into solitary, and Spoke returns. Wemmbu finally agrees to Spoke's plan, so Spoke kills the guards and frees the prisoners, allowing them to gear up. They fight their way out of the prison, killing two dozen Law members before being forced to run away.      

Wemmbu flees from the Law as they pursue him. He decides to return to the 
Far Lands
, to acquire more power, but when he attempts to take the ender pearl cannon he used previously, he finds it destroyed. The Law attacks, but he manages to get away and visits the End, to see if 
Eggchan
 knows how to build a pearl cannon. Instead, he ends up deciding to free Egg, but to do so he needs help from Spoke. Spoke offers him assistance if Wemmbu helps him kill 
Leow0ok
. Wemmbu tries but fails, and Sloke gives him the info on the condition that Wemmbu owes him another favor. Wemmbu frees Egg and they sneak into 
Capital City 2.0
, intending to run to the 
Great Sea
. The Law attacks them, and after a long fight Wemmbu is forced to surrender. However, 
Jaden MAN
 saves him, forcing the Law to flee, and he brings Wemmbu and Egg to 
Ranger Point
.      

ParrotX2
 gets a note from 'The Owl' telling them to attend a meeting, which is Lettuce's announcement. His friend 
TheobaldTheBird
 convinces him to run for king, and they find another note from the Owl with a compass. It takes them to a giant treehouse, under attack from a group of bandits, who have kidnapped someone. Parrot decides to save them even if it means losing the election, and follows them to their base. He and Theo manage to free the player, and the treehouse's citizens all vote for him as thanks. The bandits attack, but thanks to Parrot's planning they are beaten, with only the leader escaping. Parrot submits his name for the election, currently in sixteenth place.      

Spoke watches as Leow0ok and his spies destroy Quackenstein’s family base, searching for the armor pieces, prompting them to escape through a tunnel with Quackenstein and his family, sending them to safety via a Nether portal, where the family heads to their old snow base before breaking it. Leo and his spies catch up, forcing Spoke to reveal his inventory, but Jumper defends him due to a lack of evidence. Following a speech by LettuceK, Spoke plans to have Wemmbu kill Leo and later eavesdrops on Leo’s conversation to track him. After infiltrating The Law's base, Spoke offers to help Wemmbu escape in exchange for a favor, but Wemmbu refuses. Eventually, Spoke breaks the prisoners out, but when they confront Leo, it becomes clear that Leo's true motive was to catch Spoke in a mistake, proving his guilt as they prepare for an inevitable clash.      

Flame finds 
Swight
, one of the best PVPers, with a Law shield, so he goes invisible and requests training. There are five other competitors, and they are split into groups to fight bandits. Flame's group loses a memmber, while Yungy's doesn't. During a test fight, Flame's invis runs out, forcing him to hide. He gets a do-over on the fight and wins easily, leaving only him and 
Yungyx
 left. Swight sends them to face two elite bandits. Yungy runs away from the fight, but Flame manages to kill them both, and so Swight declares him the winner.      

Jaden tells Wemmbu the Law is building an orbital strike cannon and need a full set of music discs, which is rumored to be owned by an item collector. Wemmbu and Egg set out to find the collector, but instead find an island of frog worshippers. The Law find them, but they escape, ending up in a trading port. They find a vendor with slime balls, which are very rare, and Egg persuades him to reveal his buyer. They successfully locate the collector, and Wemmbu duels him, but eventually they make peace. However, Lettuce secretly followed them, and now he steals the music discs and kills the collector. Wemmbu and Egg escape.      

Mapicc goes on a mission to a BAT gear stash, but when he doesn't come back, Spoke follows the tracks and finds the place where he supposedly died. He refuses to believe it at first, until Leo shows up at his base holding Mapicc's shield. Spoke rigs Capital City to blow up unless he gets proof of Mapicc's life, but no one comes except for Parrot, and he wasn't even sent by the Law. However, he does convince Spoke to stand down. After some time, Spoke brings Zam to the BAT gear stash, where he found signs from spies that didn't join the fight, indicating another player was there and saved Mapicc. They follow the tracks, which eventually take them to the 
Far Lands
, where Mapicc is with 
JamatoP
, Spoke's oldest friend. Mapicc wants to live peacefully. Spoke and Jamato speak privately, both condemning each other for supposed villainy, and Jamato stasises away. Spoke disguises himself as Leo and attacks Mapicc and Zam, pretending to get scared off, then comes back as himself, revealing Jamato 'died'. The three of them resolve to kill Leo.      

Lettuce tell that the candidates will live in the Northern Council for their protection. Parrot receives another message from the Owl in his new home. However, while he's away a guard steals the book, forcing Parrot to kill him to get it back. Lettuce announces debates between the candidates, and he will be matched with Parrot. Parrot finally meets the Owl, revealed to be 
Spepticle
. During the debate, Lettuce accuses Parrot of killing the guard, but Spepticle intervenes and takes the fall, getting executed for it. Afterwards, Parrot hears of Capital City being under attack, and stops Spoke from blowing it up, which causes enough people to vote for him that he passes into the next round.      

Flame and Swight come across a base, where a group of players hire them to kill some bandits, who have lots of loot. They agree, and Swight trains Flame in bow boosting while they wait. When the bandits arrive, they fight them off, Flame using traps since killing would reveal his identity. The bandits retreat and they follow them to their base. Flame uses TNT minecarts, but after the bandits are killed, a Lawman shows up, and accuses Flame of being Flame. Flame reveals his identity, causing Swight to attack him, but after a long battle, Swight agrees to let him go.      

All the pirates attack the Law's orbital strike cannon, but Wemmbu steps into a trap that blasts him a hundred thousand blocks away. He visits the location of the 
Great Sea Treasure
, and obtains a Riptide trident as well as directions to another player. That player outfits him with proper gear, and he returns to battle. He attempts to break into the dome surrounding the orbital cannon, but fails due to ender guardians and retreats. At Ranger Point, he reunites with Egg and the remaining pirates (Jaden was captured), and they decide to make one last effort. After a long and hard battle, Wemmbu breaks inside and destroys the cannon.      

Flame finds 
ManePear's
 base, and although Mane initially doesn't want to train him, he later agrees, teaching him the basics. They attack a base full of elite bandits, and Mane tries to renege on the deal, but relents when Flame followed him. He teaches Flame how to use the spear, and then Flame convinces him to help find the Law's base. They debate Flame's mindset and ego on the way there. At a small village, they kill everyone while trying to get information, and 
SargeLaw
 shows up with Lawmen, managing to take Flame captive. However, Mane breaks him out, and they go on a rampage before parting ways.      

Bandits attack the Northern Council and kill 
Naparizel
. Lettuce reveals that Napa supposedly wrote a book requesting a 24-hour time where the candidates can kill each other to obtain books that contain Napa's votes. Parrot gives his up to save 
Horace Altman
 from 
Boosfer
, but Boosfer and 
Fymada
 both loses theirs to 
Arachn1d
. They follow Arachnid, but he sets up a trap for them, and Parrot and Horace are caught. Parrot signals Fymada to get help, and they are able to escape, forcing Arachnid to drop all the books so he doesn't die. On the way back, they are ambushed by 
Purpled
, who captures Horace. Parrot and Fymada break him out and return home, where Horace and Fymada let Parrot keep their vote books so he can pass on to the next round.      

Flame finds 
ItzRealMe
 at the old 
BAT Headquarters
, and requests training. Itz tests him in all four game modes: sword, spear, mace, and carts, then teaches him mace techniques, as well as 'the zone', where you must free yourself of distractions. Some random players show up and try to attack Flame, so he kills them. Itz brings him to a giant floating island and requests his mace, which Flame reluctantly gives. Itz attacks him, and Flame runs and hides before realizing Itz is trying to make him use the zone. He comes back out and successfully defeats Itz, earning his mace back.      

Spoke, Mapicc, and Zam find a village, which Spoke blows up using an exploit to get items from reluctant townsfolk. They visit BAT's secret library, where they find wreckage from a battle and realize someone is following them. They set up secret stasises and build a sky base, when beacons light up suddenly. Spoke follows them and finds Leo and a bunch of Lawmen. He warns the others, and they prepare to fight them off before escaping when the base is overwhelmed. They attack Leo and make him stasis away, then use an arrow trick to find his current location. On the way there, Spoke's stasis gets pulled.      

Lettuce announces another debate, and Parrot decides to go try and find Wemmbu, to prove Lettuce's incompetence. He finds him at the Great Sea and convinces him to team up. Parrot visits 
CoinMonke
, a smuggler, and he gives them a route back to spawn. They are continually attacked by Lawmen as they try to make their way back to spawn, since they have both been declared criminals. Wemmbu finally captures Parrot, planning to kill him for unveiling his identity, but Parrot convinces him they need each other to stop the Law. They reach the contact Coin gave them, but he turns out to be a Lawman and blows up TNT. Theo shows up there and fights 
The Oroboros
, one of the Law's commanders, killing him but being apprehended by 
SargeLaw
. Parrot brings Wemmbu to the debate, and accuses Lettuce of failing, but Lettuce cancels the election under the pretense of continued danger, and privately threatens Parrot to back down or else Theo will die.      

When Parrot visits Wemmbu, Wemmbu plans to kill him, and directs Egg to secretly follow them to attack at the right time. They are attacked by Lawmen multiple times, and Wemmbu also talks briefly with Egg, learning that he's trying to infiltrate the Law. They are caught by SargeLaw in a mountain, but Parrot, Egg, and Wemmbu are able to escape together, and Wemmbu kills the few Lawmen that follow them. He plans to kill Parrot, but Parrot convinces him that they need each other to defeat the Law. Wemmbu lets him live and attends the debate, then stasises away when Lettuce attacks him. He teleported to the same pearl cannon Spoke used where 
4CVIT
 and Egg are waiting for him.      

Wemmbu and Egg return to the Farlands. They are met by Jamato, and Wemmbu convinces him they are friends with 
Serpentbound333
, the leader of the Farlands civilization. Jamato brings them to a jungle with murals of places, one of which Wemmbu recognizes as 
The Underworld
. They enter the Underworld through a portal, then enter another portal that brings them to the correct side of the Farlands. Wemmbu attacks Jamato, since he doesn't need him anymore, but Jamato stasies away. Wemmbu and Egg are attacked by 
Nitenly
 and 
Firestar2008
, members of the Farlands civilization, on the way to the orbital cannons, but both are defeated. Wemmbu reloads the cannons and sets up a stasis for future use. They then find a stronghold and enter the End.      

Flame finds Theo, a master of TNT minecarts, and requests to train with him. He's reluctant to let Parrot go to the Great Sea alone, but eventually agrees. He teaches Flame some TNT minecart tricks, and then they go to the 
Black Market
 outside Capital City to get more minecarts. Flame also obtains several stacks of EXP. 
G0dOfWar
, one of the Law commanders, shows up, and Flame fights him but is forced to flee due to lack of gear. Theo trains him more, then sends him off to fight GodOfWar again. Flame meditates to enter the zone, then goes to GodOfWar's base. The two fight for a long time before Flame eventually forces GodOfWar to surrender, telling him to come back when he's stronger before leaving. All that's left now is to take out the Law.      

It's revealed that 
JumperWho
 teleported Spoke and betrayed BAT, because Leo kept using her spies as soldiers. Spoke refuses her offer of teaming up, and instead sends a message to the Law, giving them his coordinates. He sets up traps with help from Mapicc and Zam, and then Jumper makes her offer again. He refuses it, and the three head to where Leo has set up camp. They kill his soldiers, but Leo takes Zam hostage. Jumper saves him, and Spoke has another argument with her. She shows him Leo's secret base, where he's been building TNT cannons. They successfully escape and take down more Lawmen, and Spoke finally agrees to team with Jumper.      

Wemmbu and Egg find the End full of Lawmen, and Wemmbu realizes his orbitals don't work there. They escape to the outer islands, and Egg leads them to a stash of gear 
MinuteTech
 told him about. They find Minute himself, gear up, and then go back. After a massive battle, they escape through the End portal back into the Overworld. Minute and Wemmbu fight GodOfWar, and then Wemmbu flies to the 
Northern Council
 to confront Lettuce. Lettuce, however, threatens to kill Jaden if Wemmbu doesn't surrender.      

Parrot is taken prisoner by Lettuce, but an unknown person breaks him out. He attacks a random Lawman and learns where Theo is being held. He goes and successfully breaks Theo out, but Lettuce pulls a stasis he forced Theo to set. He then brings Parrot back to the Northern Council to force him to endorse him, but Parrot refuses. Lettuce brings Parrot and Theo both to 
Capital City
 to be executed, but Deputy_Ace saves them, and is killed by Lettuce for his betrayal. Parrot and Theo head to 
District 13
 and find it full of people, whom Parrot convinces to help fight the Law. They sneak into a Law outpost, but are forced to retreat. While plotting a way to break in, Spoke, Wemmbu, and Flame all show up and attack the base. They get the gear and all head to the Northern Council. After a massive battle, Lettuce surrenders. It's put to a vote whether he lives or dies, but Wemmbu chooses to let him live. Parrot restarts the election and wins, becoming the first king of the Unstable SMP.      

Spoke, Mapicc, and Zam sneak into a Law prison and free the BAT spies imprisoned there, but are attacked by Lawmen. Minute saves them, brought by Jumper, and Jumper sends her spies off. They report that Parrot is in the Law prison, and so the three sneak in (Mapicc and Minute are off getting Minute's other gear stashes). Wemmbu and Flame break into the prison at the same time, and Spoke aids Flame in fighting. The three find someone surrounded by obsidian and guards, but it turns out to be Jaden_MAN rather than Parrot. Spoke brings everyone, Flame and Wemmbu included, to his castle, where Mapicc and Minute meet them. They learn via spies that hundreds of Lawman are converging on a Law stash, and head there. Spoke sets up landmines and realizes Parrot and Theo are there. It turns into a massive battle, after which Parrot brings them all to District 13. They go to the Northern Council and destroy Lettuce's army. Mapicc vanishes. After Lettuce surrenders, Jumper's spies report Leo's location, so the two go there. They trap him, but he activates his stasis. Spoke, however, found Leo's stasis chamber earlier and set it up over the void. Leo dies.      

Lettuce threatens to kill Jaden if Wemmbu ever fights him again. Wemmbu leaves and meets up with Egg again, and then Jumper finds them and tells them Jaden is being held at the same prison Wemmbu escaped from. Wemmbu heads there and finds Flame at his base, gearing up, so they attack the prison together. While Flame goes in, Wemmbu stays on the surface to fight. Eventually, Jaden is released and he, Flame, Spoke, Zam, and Jumper come up. They all head to Spoke's castle together, meeting up with Mapicc, Minute, and Egg. They head to the Law outpost and pick up Parrot, who brings them to District 13 to make a speech. They march on the Northern Council and kill both of Lettuce's armies. Wemmbu and Minute chase Lettuce but fail to catch up, and they talk about killing Lettuce on the way back, influencing Wemmbu's decision to spare Lettuce after he surrenders. Wemmbu and Egg leave to start a new adventure.      

Flame is gearing up to free Lomedy from prison when Lettuce visits him and makes one last plea for him to stop. Flame refuses, so Lettuce leaves, and then Wemmbu shows up. They team up and break into the prison, Flame entering and killing guards with help from Spoke, Zam, and Jumper. Lomedy, however, refuses to go with him. Flame accompanies the others to Spoke's castle and then to the Law stash, though he doesn't see why they need Parrot. They destroy the Law's army at the Northern Council, and after Lettuce flees, Flame attacks Jaden, intending to get back the mace for Lomedy. Wemmbu intervenes, but their fight is ended when Lettuce returns. Flame doesn't understand why everyone wants to spare him, but makes a promise to Lettuce to try and do better, then goes back to the prison for Lomedy. He returns his mace, and Lomedy decides to go with him.

Debut


SOLO Player VS Minecraft Bounty Hunters










My name is LettuceK. I am the leader of an organisation called The Law. We are a group on the server that serves justice to evil and protects all of you every single day.



LettuceK
 to the Unstable SMP, 
I Got Exiled from the Unstable SMP
, 
I Became a Prisoner on the Unstable SMP


The Law
, also spelled as 
the LAW
, was one of the largest teams on the Unstable SMP. It was founded by 
LettuceK
 in early 
Season 2
 (right before 
The Director
's death) and serves as the main antagonists of 
The Kings Arc
. Their main goal was to "serve justice to evil and protect all players on the 
Unstable SMP
". 

After a battle against 
FlameFrags
 and 
Wemmbu
, losing 1000 of it's soldiers, The Law's goals changed. It's leader, LettuceK, is willing to do anything to achieve his goals, and uses The Law's influence to take over the server. Almost all 
members
 of The Law followed LettuceK's orders blindly and did not know the truth. These players truly believe that they are doing it for the good of the server.  

After the imprisonment of 
LettuceK
, The Law started spreading newspapers to inform people about what was going on in the server. It was revealed that The Law's new leader is 
CircusMaximus_
 in 
the Kingdoms Arc
, and that they had a major change of leadership making them now a good organization again.

Despite the change of leadership, 
SargeLAW
 and his rouge band of former Law members managed to take over Law and expanded its membership yet again and also planned to join 
Cindercrest
. Law was destroyed by 
Parrot
 and his 
Royal Army
 before they could join Cindercrest.



History


The Law prevented 
FlameFrags
 from trying to find 
Jaden_MAN
. Flame temporarily got rid of them and saves Jaden_MAN. Jaden later betrayed FlameFrags for The Law.

Wemmbu
 demanded that they tell him where FlameFrags is but they don't cooperate. The Law’s weak army attacked 
Wemmbu
, trying to kill him, which lead to Wemmbu blowing them up as well as destroying The Law’s base with 
orbital strike cannons
.

While Flame and Wemmbu's rivalry was ongoing, The Law got stronger and bigger in numbers.

The Law tried to imprison and kill Flame and Wemmbu and multiple times due to the crimes they've committed in the past. Flame and Wemmbu sneak into The Law's Headquarters and challenged Lettuce to a fight between them against every member of The Law, to which Lettuce agreed. They both killed all 1000 players Lettuce sent after them, leaving no one alive but himself. Flame turned on Wemmbu at the end of fight, wanting to continue their duel, which lead to Wemmbu giving up on the title of "The Strongest" and admitting Flame had won. Lettuce was then able to imprison Wemmbu who ran out all resources in the fight.

Wemmbu was taken to The Law Prison which also had 
PrinceZam
, 
Baablu
, 
Fantst
 and other criminals. Lettuce gave a speech in front of the whole server, where he announced that the server needs a ruler and announced the election. Wanting to become king, Lettuce brought Wemmbu in front of everyone and states that he would swiftly execute him if he was elected.

Spoke
 secretly offered his help to Wemmbu by helping him escape on three different occasions in exchange for his loyalty. Wemmbu refused the first two chances but later, having no choice, accepted Spoke's help on the third occasion.

The Law killed a large amount of pirates in the 
Great Sea
, as well as innocent players who didn't comply, and captured 
Jaden_MAN
. Lettuce was able to obtain enough music discs required to finish the 
Orbital Strike Cannon
, however, the machine was blown up by 
Wemmbu
 and 
eggchan
 eventually.

FlameFrags was imprisoned by The Law, but 
ManePear
 was able to help him escape, causing him to now be an enemy of The Law due to working with a criminal and helping him escape prison. They killed a huge number of Law elites.

Following the qualification of 
Parrot
 into the quarter-finals of the election, Lettuce commenced a purge. He hired assassins to kill 
Naparizel
 mentioned that Napa left a will that 1/7th of his votes (120 votes) should be equally distributed to all the candidates through books signed by him, and announced that all crime would be allowed between candidates in order for them to receive each other's votes in the next 24 hours. The 4 winners ended up being Lettuce, 
Purpled
, Parrot and 
Boosfer
.

The Law hunted down Parrot and Wemmbu but were unable to kill them. 
Law commander
 
The_Oroboros
 was killed in combat by 
TheobaldTheBird
.

Leow0ok
 dragged The Law into his war against Spoke and 
Jumper
. Spoke successfully killed hundreds of Law-men in battle. Following internal conflict in the 
Bounty Assassin Team
, Leow0ok joined The Law and became a 
High Ranking Commander
. 

LettuceK uses The Law's manpower to send huge armies against Wemmbu and MinuteTech in the end dimension. They both killed hundreds of Law-men in the battles. After Wemmbu defeated Law-men he confronted Lettuce, who threatened to kill Jaden_MAN. 

Law commander 
Deputy_Ace
 betrayed Law to help Parrot escape instead of killing him and SargeLAW killed him. 

Purpled
 joieds The Law as an 
Elite
 and was present during the final battle. 

The Law fought its final battle and were finally defeated by 
District 13
. 
SargeLAW
 deserted Lettuce in battle. The Law used its largest army of elites which were fully stacked with netherite armors but the army was still destroyed. The Law's reputation was destroyed because they lost thousands of players in the battle and Lettuce was captured.  
TheGOdOfWar
 left Law presumably to do PvP training. Not long after 
High Ranking Commander
 of Law, 
Leow0ok
 was killed by Spoke. 
Parrot
 becomes the king of the server, 
Wemmbu
 can finally roam free again and 
FlameFrags
 begins his journey of becoming a combat grandmaster.



After LettuceK


After the 6 day war, a lot of members of Law decided to leave and do their own thing and The Law's numbers have been declining since. The Law's old leadership was almost completely finished and a few remaining members of The Law's elite force have taken charge since.

After Law got defeated, a player by the name 
OrionCat
 was sent to deliver newspapers and they spotted 
FlameFrags
 and 
Lomedy
, handed them newspaper and told them that they aren't in bad terms with The Law anymore. The remaining Law-men even helped rebuild FlameFrags' base which was destroyed by a player wanting to challenge him. The Law now would truly help players following the change of leadership, under 
CircusMaximus_
, the new Law commander. He wanted nothing to do with old Law (under LettuceK).

Law built a huge base for FlameFrags but used a lot of resources which they no longer have a lot of, so they came to repossess the base they built for FlameFrags. FlameFrags wished to keep the base and asked if there was another way he could help. 
OrionCat
 introduced him to The Law's new commander who made FlameFrags join The Law for 100 days in exchange for having the base. FlameFrags helped The Law in multiple tasks but also loses two Law-men which made the commander upset. It seemed that The Law is also fighting 
Arachn1d
, with some of their outposts being captured and some members of Law are being taken hostage as well. FlameFrags' last task was to see if Lettuce was still alive and he was sent by the commander who feared that other Law-men will free Lettuce. This showed that The LAW's new leadership now no longer likes Lettuce.  

After FlameFrags left Law he was hired by them again to infiltrate 
The Mist
 and kill 
Mistrul
. FlameFrags infiltrated The Mist but fails to kill Mistrul. FlameFrags asks The Law to send him 
Lomedy
 which they did by force. LAW revealed that Mistrul had been killing many Law-men.  

During this time 
SargeLAW
 and his rouge band of LAW soldiers successfully took over The Law and replaced 
CircusMaximus_
 and new Law with his own dictatorship. He had a plan to join 
Cindercrest
. During this period Law's membership swelled again to 1000 Law-men under 
SargeLAW
. He recruited new players who have joined the server because of Parrot clearing Spawn and making it safe. Despite this Law lost focus of its ideals yet again. New Law's leadership were probably forced to join this or exiled.  

FlameFrags and Lomedy left Law and join 
Cindercrest
. 
SargeLAW
 took over leadership. King 
Parrot
 made a fateful decision. He forcefully asked SargeLAW to join his 
Royal Army
. Some new players of The Law decided to cross the bridge from 
Law City
 and join Parrot. Then SargeLAW revealed that he planned on joining 
Cindercrest
. Without mercy, Parrot activated a giant TNT trap that killed hundreds of Law-men who refused to join and also destroyed most of the 
Law city
. SargeLAW was presumably imprisoned or killed by King Parrot's army along with the rest of his troops. With this, the remaining 1000 players of The Law were all killed, except for the few who joined the Royal Army. This likely finished off The Law for good. It is unlikely that New Law had retaken control as they probably had joined the Royal Army. 

The members of LAW that defected to the royal army make their own LAW under Parrot but it is significantly weakened and is under the 
Royal Army
. Members of The LAW legion were probably destroyed by 
Cindercrest
 in order to advance to 
Highwater City
. 



Hierarchy


Most members of The Law were given protection 2 diamond armor, 5 golden apples, 16 bread and white banner shields containing The Law's insignia. They had very weak equipment but they had such large numbers that were unseen before in the server. These ordinary members of The Law were numbered in the thousands. Following the 6 day war there were still a lot members of The Law.

High ranking members of The Law which were part of 
The Law's Elite Force
 were given protection 4 netherite armor, and their shields have a black banner with The Law's insignia instead of a white one. They were very stacked but were almost completely wiped out in the numerous battles they fought in as The Law did not have the resources to recruit more. 

The Law also had high ranking officers such as 
Deputy Ace
, 
SargeLAW
, 
TheGOdOfWar
, 
The_Oroboros
, and 
Leow0ok
. These officers gave orders to Law forces around the server and were the main commanders of The Law.

G0dOfWar

Wemmbu

ManePear

FlameFrags

SargeLaw
. As Netherite is rare on the Unstable SMP, the only person we know for sure in The Law's Elite Guard are probably the commanders themselves.

In the 1v1000 it is shown that many of The Law's Elite Force had maces which points to the possibility of them being former Mafia players. These players also probably believe in The Law and are unaware of LettuceK's manipulation that allowed him to get total control. Members like SargeLaw think that they are hunting down a evil person and in FlameFrags's latest video he does not kill FlameFrags despite him attempting escape multiple times. This shows that at least most members actually believing in The Law's Ideals.

title: The NULL Arc
content:
The NULL Arc














Info




Season


3






Episode Amount


4








Episodes




First Episode


Minecraft Trapper VS Elite Bounty Hunters






Final Episode


Finding 1000 Missing Minecraft Players






All Episodes


Minecraft Trapper VS Elite Bounty Hunters
Searching for 100 Players Who Went Missing
Searching For 1000 Players Who Went Missing
Finding 1000 Missing Minecraft Players








The NULL Arc
, or 
NULL
, is an individual arc of 
SpokeIsHere
 in 
Unstable Universe
.



Story


It begins with Spoke inside of his base enchanting, when all of a sudden his alarm alerted him of players were nearby. Spoke assumes it was bandits and would have to go through his traps first, but it turned out to be more dangerous than he thought. 
Skinless players with jumbled names
 came barging in and dodges the first trap, runs into the base and attacks Spoke. This isn't a fight Spoke can take on, so he kites all of the hunters into the middle of the base and sets off a piston trap and drops all of them down on dripstone. Spoke wind charges a lever which activates a stasis, pulling 
JumperWho
 and her spies to investigate, as there were no death messages. Spoke believes that someone had hired these hunters to go after him, but doesn't know how to fight them if they don't fear death. Jumper says she's seen them, but doesn't know anything about the hunters, even with her spies, there had no leads to figuring out who they are. Spoke packs up his base and Jumper gives him a paper with coordinates to a safehouse, but he doesn't take it if Jumper isn't going to work on the mission on finding 
Mapicc
.

Spoke goes invisible and wanders off into the wilderness of the Unstable SMP. He talks to the viewers and explains that he hasn't seen Mapicc in over four weeks and after searching around for a few days, he hired Jumper and her spies to help. He says what was strange about the hunters was that they carried a shield with the same pattern as the one Mapicc gave before the big battle against 
The Law
. He goes closer to spawn to find more bases to camp in temporarily, he finds a secret one in a mountain and kills the person living there before him for being a hazard. He quickly realizes that was a bad idea since it would be shown to anyone nearby, and so he sets up a TNT minecart trap right above the entrance. He waits and sees the hunters coming closer, when they enter the tunnel leading into the base, Spoke activates the trap, several hunters get their totems popped and they vanish instantly. Spoke escapes from the base with the remaining hunters chasing after him. The hunters have speed, which covers more horizontal ground and Spoke uses this to his advantage and uses pearls and his trident to get a lead from them. Spoke breaks into somebody's house and restocks, the hunters come shortly after and kill off the residents living there. He tries to leave the base fully invis, but the hunters see him and foils his plan. Spoke still manages to make it out and uses uses blue ice to gain speed to outrun them, and with no other choice, he decides to go to the coordinates to the safehouse. Spoke then decides to tower up and Elytra the rest of the way there, although he dislikes using the Elytra, he thought it was necessary since it was an emergency. Only 200 blocks away, Spoke hides in a mountain quickly to use the bathroom and enables sneak toggle and lets the hunters run by. He inches closer and closer to the safehouse, but the hunters are tailing right behind him. Spoke enters the house, which seemed abandoned, but spies come up from the ground and starts fighting the hunters, giving Spoke time to escape. Jumper was also at the house and the two leave together as the hunters are distracted. Spoke asks if this was the safehouse, but Jumper said it wasn't and that it was just a house. As they run, the leader of the group, 
_1_88_____x
 chases after them, but they lose them after getting to the escape tunnel. 

At the end of the escape tunnel is the real safehouse, Jumper instructs Spoke to stay inside of it until she and her spies handle it. Spoke says they don't know how the hunters work and he's seen it work in the past and says they're unkillable. However, Spoke knows a trap that can kill someone even with a totem and says that it's already built and will show Jumper it if he wasn't held hostage inside of the base they were standing inside of. They arrive at the trap, which turns out to be the same arrow rail cannon they built inside in a previous episode. Spoke explains that you can trick the game into shooting it milliseconds after the first shot, and that it looks like there's three shots all in one. Jumper asks Spoke how he knows if killing them would stop this, but Spoke says it may not, but it would get a closer lead on figuring out where Mapicc is. Spoke brings up how Jumper had seen them before and asks what she saw, Jumper tells Spoke that she followed them along with her spies followed one of the hunters and based on what they found, they have a reason to believe Mapicc is still alive. She goes on and says how one of her traders went missing, so she went to the trader's base and saw the exact same hunters, so she followed the hunters for thousands of blocks, when all of a sudden, they'd stop moving and look into the distance. She got closer to get a better view of what happened and saw an armorless player and they all started walking in a straight line. It was revealed that there was a bounty on that armorless player's head and an hour later it was claimed and that they were dead, three hours before she saw that player marching. Spoke now understands that they're trying to break all of his armor to do the same thing to him. Spoke thinks this is a bigger threat than trying to find Mapicc and wants to put an end to this and wants to help out. vc bonbon 

As they walk to their destination, Jumper explains their targets have all had bounties on their heads, Spoke included, and Jumper went to 
Merchant City
 and kidnapped the person responsible for this. She says the person doesn't want to talk to Jumper or her spies, but was willing to talk to Spoke. They make it to the location and Jumper breaks a block, revealing a ladder going underground into an obsidian tunnel. Multiple spies guard the entire thing, and once they reach the obsidian box that holds the person, a guard breaks the obsidian, allowing Spoke and Jumper inside. The person that's responsible for this is 
SirPig_
, former mayor of Capital City. He tells Jumper to leave and that everything is between him and Spoke. Spoke confronts SirPig and asks what he knows about the hunters, but SirPig says he has no idea. Spoke tries to bribe him to tell him information, but SirPig tells Spoke to stop worrying about him and start worrying about himself. Spoke says he's trying to work with him, asks for any clues, but all SirPig says all they asked for was a token to prove Spoke was dead was his chestplate gifted to him. Spoke asks for a name one last time or else SirPig dies, SirPig then pulls a fishing rod and stasises out. Spoke hears dozens of people right outside the box and tons of hunters come in and starts attacking him. Jumper comes to help him get out, they get onto the surface, but the hunters make it up before them. Spoke tries to wind charge and pearl to get the hunters off their tail, but the hunters, specifically their leader catch up quickly. The firework rockets shred through their armor and their resources slowly drain. Spoke tells Jumper he has a way to escape, but she won't be able to catch up and tells her to escape on her own for now. Spoke goes on top of a hill full invis and spots Jumper coming up, he quickly asks for an ender chest and grabs an invis potion from a shulker box. He splashes the both of them with invis and they go full invis and hide in a tree, losing track of the hunters. Jumper says her spies are in formation and they need to go activate the trap. The hunters stand looking at Spoke and Jumper, and as they get closer, Jumper commands her spies to come out. The spies serve as a distraction for the hunters. Spoke's armor starts to break, only having his chestplate and a turtle helmet left. Spoke and Jumper run from the fight with the leader, the only one chasing after them. As they near the trap, Spoke tells Jumper to get there first and he'll be there after. Spoke makes it to the house and kites the hunter around as Jumper prepares the trap. Once the trap is set up, Spoke runs towards it and wind charges above, Jumper sets off the trap and kills them in an instant. Their inventory is scattered all over the floor and Spoke picks up a book named "
mission: null
".

Spoke and Jumper are then forced to run and hide by the appearance of more hunters. They build a grave for their fallen leader and leave a book in a chest before leaving.

The_Oroboros
 was a high ranking member of 
the Law
, being one of its commanders.



History


He was 
LettuceK
’s third or fourth in command in 
The Law
 and a fearsome crossbowman, often using tipped arrows to fight players, much to the chagrin of 
Wemmbu
, whose Achilles heel in combat is arrow effects, particularly slow falling. He has also used weakness arrows as well, particularly to counter 
FlameFrags
.

He was first seen fighting Wemmbu and The Pirates in 
I Explored the Minecraft Great Sea
.

He was seen guarding the orbital strike cannon in 
Unstable SMP: The Battle for The Great Sea
. He briefly fought Wemmbu, and fled from combat using an elytra.

He was killed by  
TheobaldTheBird
 In 
2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Hunters
 after a lengthy, destructive TNT minecart battle.



Trivia


Despite people suspecting he was related to 
Ouroboroid
 due to having a similar name as well as emerald armor trims, this was likely just a coincidence. But there is an ambiguity that creates doubt when Lettucek says to Ouroboide, ‘You know, Ouroboide, I really took the best from both of you,’ possibly referring to The_Ouroboros, since their first appearance is in the same video.


He has a bow named "Eternity".

title: The Pirate Arc
content:
The Pirate Arc
 is the third arc in 
Unstable Universe
.





The Pirate Arc














Info




Season


2






Episode Amount


4








Episodes




First Episode


I Created Minecraft's Most Secure Base






Final Episode


I Explored an Abandoned Minecraft Civilization






All Episodes


I Created Minecraft's Most Secure Base
I Created Minecraft's Grestest Empire
I Explored a Deserted Minecraft Civilization
I Explored an Abandoned Minecraft Civilization










Story


Wemmbu
 and 
Eggchan
 build a house, but are attacked by 
TheobaldTheBird
, who wants to fight them. They attempt to trap him using creakings, but when that fails, Wemmbu recruits 
Kenadian
 to help him build a base Theo can't break into, and while they complete the base, Theo still gets inside. He holds Kenadian hostage, prompting Wemmbu to finally fight him. Theo loses, but is able to escape due to Wemmbu running out of rockets.

Wemmbu and Egg gather EXP bottles and start their own empire, recruiting many people, including 
Wato1876
. After Wato and a player named 
Spongs
 are both mugged by 
players with pirate shields
, Wemmbu locates their base and kills almost everyone there. During his absence, Egg has taken over the empire and expanded it, recruiting Spongs and 
Arcn
. Wemmbu follows Spongs to the pirate HQ, but finds the place empty. He returns to the empire, where 
Jaden MAN
, the leader of the pirates, holds Egg hostage and forces him to give up all his gear, though he manages to keep his mace.

Wemmbu and Egg are exiled to a set of islands. They kill some people for gear before coming into conflict with some of the pirates, which they barely escape. Wemmbu retrieves his mace and they go to Jaden's castle. Wemmbu nearly dies before the castle somehow blows up, allowing him and Egg to escape. They are met by Theo, who reveals he's been secretly helping them all along, and they go to fight Jaden together, forcing him to escape down a mysterious tunnel. Wemmbu and Egg follow him.

Wemmbu and Egg find themselves in an abandoned civilization, trapped with Jaden due to mining fatigue. They manage to get some gear, also meeting 
Rejoicin
 and 
Loppezz
, the latter of which is a former pirate that they team up with. Wemmbu ends up on his own and fights Jaden with Rejoicin, but Jaden eventually escapes. Rejoicin gears them all up, and then they head to fight Jaden again. Rejoicin dies to wardens, and Jaden gets away, but Wemmbu finds a secret room with an elytra. He uses it to finally defeat Jaden, forcing him to drop all of his items, but letting him live since he can't escape. The three leave.



Major Characters


Wemmbu
 (protagonist)


Eggchan


Jaden_MAN
 (main antagonist)


TheobaldTheBird


Loppezz


Rejoicin


LettuceK


Arcn

title: The Power Arc
content:
The Power Arc is an arc in Unstable Universe. It is concurrent with the Betrayal Arc (second half of this arc) as well as the Director Arc



Story


Wemmbu
 and 
Eggchan
 get some gear by killing people, then plan to steal cows from another group to make an enchanting table. It all goes wrong, and Wemmbu is forced to kill them all. Now with proper gear, he heads to 
FlameFrags'
 house for a rematch, and they fight to a standstill. Flame shows Wemmbu around and then he leaves.

Wemmbu is raiding 
BAT Headquarters
 when he gets jumped by a couple players and their invisible assassin. He escapes and follows one player back to their base, and though the player doesn't know the assassin's identity, he gives the coords to his friends' bases. He gets ambushed at one such base, but kills his attackers, one of whom drops a compass that leads to 
Mafia City
, where 
WyLL
 is revealed as the invis hunter. Wyll says if Wemmbu kills the last person he’ll stop attacking him, so Wemmbu does so, but Wyll betrays him and traps him into the void. Wemmbu flies to a void hole at BAT HQ and escapes. He returns to the castle, where he kills most of Wyll’s team and nearly kills Wyll himself before he stasises out.

Wemmbu is recruited by 
Loppezz
 to kill 
Fantst
, who took over 
Ice Mountain Civilization
. Wemmbu goes in and kills some people, but Loppezz makes him stop when Fantst reveals the mountain is rigged to blow. They stealth around a bit before being caught and kicked out again. Wemmbu goes in and kills everyone except for Fantst, but the mountain gets entirely blown up. Somewhat guilty, he gives Loppezz some of his netherite before leaving.

Wemmbu meets 
Baablu
, who tells him about an End guardian stopping him from respawning the Ender dragon for lingering potions. Wemmbu agrees to help him, and fights the guardian, 
MinuteTech
, allowing the dragon to be spawned. Baablu’s team arrives, including 
Fantst
, and start trying to kill Wemmbu, prompting him to flee with Minute. Minute reveals to Wemmbu that Baablu's team wanted to respawn the dragon to dupe it and cause chaos. Wemmbu comes over to Minute's side. They manage to find an End city despite being chased, and gear back up with an ender chest. They return to the main island and kill some people, forcing the rest to flee. Minute and Wemmbu part ways.

Wemmbu enters a PVP tournament hosted by 
AJTHEBOLD
, hoping for a rematch with Flame. He easily beats his first opponent, but next up is 
WyLL
, who has slow fall arrows and restocks. Wemmbu still wins, though. After the match, Wyll gives him advice to beat 
Conexion
, whom he hates even more than Wemmbu himself. Wemmbu utilizes the advice to win the battle, and the final match is against him and Flame. Despite a long, close fight, Flame ultimately wins.

Sharpness (Conexion) steals Wemmbu’s mace by placing pots on the ground. Wemmbu accidentally places his mace in a pot, allowing Sharpness to steal it. Wemmbu and Egg head to the 
Far Lands
 to catch him, and find him at the old 
Far Lands Civilisation
. The battle turns into a siege, but Sharpness eventually escapes. Wemmbu and Egg deal with strange glitches before finding a copy of the 
Zam Empire
, complete with echoes of its members. Sharpness attacks, and after a long fight Wemmbu puts his mace in his ender chest. Sharpness gives him thirty minutes to gear up for a final duel, which Wemmbu puts to good use. During the battle, Wemmbu is severely outgeared, but finally manages to knock Sharpness into the void. He’s forced to save him to avoid his mace getting destroyed, though, and Sharpness stashes it in his ender chest before leaving.

Wemmbu gets attacked by 
The Avengers
, comprised of his old enemies. He manages to escape, and he and Egg find a strange build. Inside they meet 
Lakerek
, who fights Wemmbu using strange items from 'The Forge', and upon being defeated allows Wemmbu to kill him and acquire large amounts of gear, Some of the Avengers jump them, but Wemmbu forces all but one to flee, and he arranges a fight at a spikes biome in the Farlands. The Avengers show up there, but during the fight 
FlameFrags
 betrays. The two eventually scare off the Avengers, and Flame returns Wemmbu’s mace, which he got from Sharpness.

Wemmbu and Egg continue on, since Wemmbu wants to find the Forge. They find a trial chamber and fight Firestar2008, but he stasis-es away. Wemmbu destroys all the ominous vaults, and then they continue on. They find repeating dungeons containing god apples, obtaining close to a stack total, then continue on, dealing with bizarre world generation. Eventually they find another echo of Lakarek alongside others in an ocean monument, as well as five stasis chambers. Going further on, they are attacked by Nitenly, who was also in the echo. Wemmbu defeats him, and they bridge out over the void before finally locating a city in the Far Lands, which they believe to be 
The Forge
.

At the city, they meet a number of Lakarek’s friends, who tell them this is not the Forge, but let them wander freely anyway. Nitenly is still openly antagonistic, though. Wemmbu and Egg gather gear and destroy a stash of maces. Egg finds a compass that leads back out to the Farlands, where they find an array of orbital strike cannons, used by Lakarek. Lakarek’s friends show up there, and reveal this isn’t the Forge, which is actually back at base. At base, Wemmbu and Egg are presented with an End portal, and Egg jumps in front of Wemmbu to be knocked in by an arrow. Wemmbu 4v1s everyone, killing one and forcing two others to retreat. The last he forces to help him load every single orbital cannon there.

Wemmbu visits 
Capital City 2.0
 to try and find Flame, using his cannons as leverage, and 
SirPig
 tells him 
The Law
 has been hunting Flame. Wemmbu goes and fights the Law, learns Flame is after 
Jaden MAN
, then blows up their base. Jaden fights him using a mace, but Wemmbu scares him off and then blows up his entire castle. With no leads, he visits Flame's base and gets attacked by a random player, who drops a compass supposedly leading to Flame. Flame shows up, and they fight, Wemmbu struggling despite using his cannons and mace both. Eventually, however, he makes Flame run, and declares himself the strongest player of Unstable.



Trivia


This is the longest arc that only represents a single POV.


People often refer to the second part of the arc as the far lands arc.

title: The PrinceZam Empire Arc
content:
The PrinceZam Empire Arc














Info




Season


1






Episode Amount


15








Episodes




First Episode


How to Destroy the Universe






Final Episode


How I Solved Minecraft's Largest Escape Room






All Episodes


How to Destroy the Universe
This Button Destroys the World
Breaking into Minecraft's Most Illegal Vault
How I Stole 10,356,000 Duped Items
I Uncovered Minecraft's Greatest Secret
It's Impossible to Catch this Player
I Broke into Minecraft's Most Secure Prison
I Created Minecraft's Greatest Civilization
I Got Hunted by Minecraft's Deadliest Players
Why I Destroyed the Unstable SMP
It's Impossible to Find this Player
Unstable SMP: The PrinceZam Empire War
How I Escaped Minecraft's Largest Prison
Escaping Proton: Minecraft's Most Secure Prison
How I Solved Minecraft's Largest Escape Room








The PrinceZam Empire Arc
, or 
The Zam Empire Arc
 is the first arc in Unstable Universe.



Story


The Exploits


SpokeIsHere
 discovered a number of different exploits, and paid 
TheRealSquiddo
 using exploited items to create 
The Wonders
 as a cover for his work. 
Wemmbu
 began to suspect he was up to something, culminating in a battle beneath one of the Wonders that led to Spoke deciding to destroy the Wonders.

ParrotX2
 and 
Roshambogames
 tried to protect the Wonders as Spoke destroyed them one by one. Ro was revealed to be working with Wemmbu against Parrot, and the final Wonder was destroyed.

Wemmbu discovered a giant vault created by Spoke, supposedly containing exploited items, and broke through several layers of security before being met with Spoke, who revealed the vault to be a prison. Wemmbu narrowly managed to escape, forcing Spoke to stasis away.

Spoke teamed up with 
Mapicc
 to continue his quest to destroy exploited items, contained in a number of vaults made by Roshambo. They successfully destroyed several vaults of exploited items, destroying the houses of Squiddo and 
Jepexx
 in the process, before Ro trapped himself and Spoke in the End. Spoke followed him to his End base, where he revealed that there were no more exploited items. Spoke escaped and realized that the final vault was the first one he'd visited and found nothing at. He and Mapicc return and destroy the items there.

Spoke sent Parrot on a quest for the server's 'greatest secret', and Parrot recruited his friend 
Wifies
 to help. They made it through many trials, including an explosive cave, being trapped in the void, a giant ice parkour challenge, a maze of obsidian, an underwater scavenger hunt, and a giant escape room. During this time, they came into conflict with Wemmbu and 
PrinceZam
, who also wanted to find Spoke to kill him. Finally, they met Spoke in-person and completed the final trial, where Spoke revealed that one of them would have to chunkban themselves for the other to learn the secret. Wifies chunkbanned himself, and Spoke revealed the secret was fake all along, and he only wanted revenge against Parrot for an unknown thing. Wemmbu and Zam then arrived, and after a long chase Spoke chunkbanned himself to avoid being killed.

During the scavenger hunt, Spoke's henchmen blew up part of the 
Zam Empire
, so Wemmbu teamed up with Zam to ban Spoke. Using arrows left behind from the battle, they went around the server chunkbanning Spoke's henchmen one by one (including Squiddo, 
JumperWho
, 
Derapchu
, and 
Fantst
), although Spoke was nearly able to kill Zam through an ambush. Spoke invisibly forced Wemmbu and Zam to complete some of the same trials as Parrot and Wifies had been through. Eventually, Wemmbu fought Spoke at Squiddo's old base, but Spoke escaped via stasis. They were able to use arrows he fired to track him down, though, leading to his chunkban.



Zam Empire Conflict


After Wifies got chunkbanned, Parrot decided to break him out from the prison constructed by Zam, with help from 
Rekrap2
. After some initial difficulties, they were able to free Derapchu from another one of the chunkbans, and later on Fantst as well, though Fantst later chunkbanned himself because he was afraid of dying. As the prisons fell, the guards were moved to the prison containing both Wifies and Spoke, making freeing Jumper very easy. They were able to chunkban all six guards at the final prison, and Parrot recruited 
Kenadian
 to help him break in. After much difficulty, they successfully freed Wifies, however Spoke escaped as well. For that, Zam hired 
ClownPierce
 to kill him.

As a favor for helping to ban Spoke, Zam requested Wemmbu build a colony of the 
Zam Empire
 to protect a secret vault. Wemmbu recruited his friend 
Eggchan
 to help, but they were attacked by 
FlameFrags
, who'd betrayed the Empire. They got 
Horace Altman
 to build up 
their colony
, and also briefly met Parrot, learning that Clown was hunting him. Zam left 
ManePear
 and 
Merffinn
 to guard the colony, but Wemmbu learned that they were sabotaging the colony's defenses. Wemmbu and Eggchan freed Fantst from his chunkban, also acquiring a large amount of resources from Parrot's prison team. Parrot later returned to the colony, and it was revealed that Zam had hired Clown and likely betrayed Wemmbu. Flame and several others (including an invisible Clown) showed up to fight, and Flame nearly killed Wemmbu in the end, but stopped when Zam arrived. Zam and his guards then blew up the colony.

Meanwhile, Parrot and Wifies were being hunted by Clown, though neither knew why. During one fight, they were saved by 
Leow0ok
, Jumper, Derapchu, and 
Woogiex
, who then set up a vault with the intent of luring Clown in. Clown showed up with 
Mugm
 and 
FerreMC
, and the trap failed, though Parrot and Wifies escaped. They set up a chunkban at Clown's base, but that failed, and in retaliation Clown blew up Leo's base. Parrot left the Clown hunters and joined up with Wemmbu, helping to repel the attack, but left and returned to the Clown hunters after. They decided to kidnap 
BranzyCraft
, a friend of Clown's, but Ferre kidnapped Wifies, forcing Parrot to free Branzy. Disheartened, he ran away, but Clown forced Wifies to reveal Parrot's coords. Parrot and Wifies went to Wemmbu's Civilization, but found it destroyed. Angered, Parrot returned to the Clown hunters, and they blew up Clown's castle. Parrot decided to 1v1 Clown the following day, and planned to set up a trap as well as kill Branzy. However, Wifies was able to talk him down from killing Branzy, and Parrot instead just visited to talk to him about Clown. The day of the 1v1, Parrot activated the trap and Clown vanished. He and Wifies went to tell the Clown hunters, but found them gone with a sign left from Clown. Confused, they returned to spawn, and Parrot found a book waiting in his old base.

Since they had no resources, Wemmbu and Egg decided to become base-destroyers for hire. Roshambo was their first customer, paying them to destroy Spoke's End base, which they successfully completed. Woogie was the second, hiring them to destroy Ferre's. They had much more difficulty there, but were able to succeed, acquiring a lot of resources between stealing and Woogie's payment. ManePear, a sympathetic Zam guard, secretly gave them coords to a team called the Treasure Hunters. 
Boosfer
, a Treasure Hunter, hired them to destroy an entire biome. Egg had IRL stuff, but Wemmbu’a destruction was interrupted by Parrot and Wifies, who explained that the Treasure Hunters were actually the villains. Wemmbu received his payment, then they built an orbital strike cannon and destroyed the Treasure Hunters’ base, raising their vault. Wemmbu returned to Egg, and together they blew up the statue of Zam at spawn, officially initiating war.

In order to find Clown, Parrot and Wifies were forced to complete a number of challenges, each one tied to a prized possession of the missing players. They came into conflict with 
Kierrrr
 and 
Its Dev
 (minions of Boosfer) multiple times, culminating in them threatening to blow up Rekrap's base. Parrot and Wifies were able to stop Wemmbu from destroying the base, then resumed their quest. Kier and Dev stole all of the items they'd gathered so far, and so the two plus Wemmbu destroyed their base in revenge. The two then obtained the last items before being met with Clown himself, who revealed the seventh and final item was Parrot's prized spyglass. Parrot gave it up, and Clown forced them to remove their armor before taking them to his inescapable prison, Proton.

Wemmbu and some hired minions attack the Zam Empire, and Wemmbu nearly kills Zam, but is forced to flee due to his guards. He later returns and helps ManePear, who wanted to betray, get away, where Mane reveals that Zam is planning to attack Roshambo's civilization. Wemmbu heads there and manages to stall long enough for Ro's people to escape, then escapes himself. They decide to go after the top people of the Zam Empire, and successfully manage to capture 
Yungwillx
, 
Peentar
, and 
Sorhin
 through traps and blackmail. However, Zam and his guards arrived, freed them, and after a long fight successfully forced Wemmbu and Mane to surrender while capturing Egg. Wemmbu and Mane escaped, and Wemmbu considered giving up, but managed to create and enact a plan to save Egg and unleash his orbital strike cannon. The Zam Empire gets blown up and Zam and Wemmbu duel, ending with Zam finally apologizing for his actions. ClownPierce suddenly shows up and kidnaps them both.



The Experiment


Wemmbu, Zam, Egg, and 
Pangi
 all get dropped into Proton by Clown. They split into two groups, gathering gear and occasionally fighting. Clown sends in Ferre, forcing them to work together to survive. Pangi attempts to enter the Nether and gets chunkbanned, forcing Zam to agree to work with Wemmbu and Egg. They gather gunpowder for an ender pearl cannon, but Clown uses an orbital strike cannon on Zam’s base, which he blames and nearly kills Wemmbu for. Clown sends in Ferre again, forcing the three back together to fight him using TNT minecarts, which Ferre realizes is a weakness of the prison. They beat Ferre, and then Clown sends in a bunch of people, most of whom Zam recruits. Wemmbu gets Kenadian’s help to design a pearl cannon, and they fight Zam’s people, but Wemmbu reminds Zam that Clown won’t let either of them die, and he leaves them alone. Clown teleports all the newcomers out, and Wemmbu finishes the cannon as guards come in. Egg stays behind due to having no pearl, while Wemmbu successfully escapes.

Parrot and Wifies get switched between cells in the redesigned Proton, each meeting all five of the captured players. Parrot devises a method to communicate between cells (maps), and gets visited by Leo, who requests they build a stasis chamber for Wemmbu to sneak in contraband items. Parrot and the other inmates gather materials (using wandering traders to get saplings to get beehives for honey) while trying to hide from the guards, who are starting to catch on. Kenadian wants to stay, however. Jumper gets put in solitary confinement. They construct a stasis for Wemmbu, which Kenadian nearly sabotages, but Parrot convinces him not to. Wemmbu gets in and gears them up, then goes to find Eggchan, who's still trapped somewhere. The others head to the guard HQ and let Jumper out, then start destroying chunkbans to escape. The last one is unbreakable, forcing them to elytra-pearl past it, but they have one elytra too few, so Kenadian gives his up to Parrot, letting him escape. Once they're out, he sends them a message through the maps, and they go to his base and pull his secret stasis, freeing him too.

Zam and Wemmbu are trapped in an escape room together. After making it through some stages, Zam leaves Wemmbu behind, forcing 
Wato1876
, the designer, to save him. Wemmbu proceeds through the escape room with Wato's guidance, and eventually reunites with Zam after Wato leaves. Wemmbu obtains a mace, which they use to solve several more challenges, getting armor and gear along the way. Eventually, they escape into the End dimension, where Clown is waiting. He demands the mace. Zam escapes, but Clown respawns the dragon and starts fighting Wemmbu. Eventually, Wemmbu is forced to drop the mace. Clown leaves and Wemmbu escapes.
