title: The Search for Minecraft's Far Lands
content:
The Search for Minecraft's Far Lands














Season


1






Episode


21






Upload date


Nov 4, 2024






POV


ParrotX2






Arcs


The Invisible Mafia Arc
The Director Arc
 (pre-arc)
The Last Civilizations (subplot)






Featured Creators (Description)


Wifies
 ✝
deanthebean9
 ✝
R4trick
finiahn
Tai
Falcuno
PukiTV
Wato1876
RealReeon
DumbIsDumb
Sorhin
nezoshoki
TheSorta
Lamibee
Pro4d














Millions of blocks out on our Minecraft Server, there is rumored to be a city that lies in a strange place called the 
Far Lands
. With the 
Mafia
 quickly taking over our server, 
Wifies
, 
Dean
, and I must find this city to try and build an army to fight back. This is the Search for Minecraft's Far Lands.





The Search for Minecraft's Far Lands
 is the 21st episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


The video begins with 
ParrotX2
, 
Wifies
 and 
deanthebean9
 hiding from 
The Invisible Mafia
 in a remote forest after escaping 
Capital City
. The Mafia stops hunting them eventually. They planned on finding the far lands to recruit more people to fight The Mafia. While Parrot, Wifies and Dean explore a lush cave, Wifies gives Dean a goat horn and Parrot tells Dean that if they get jumped or if they are in any sort of danger, Dean has to blow the goat horn. They split off after that to get resources, however The Mafia found them. Dean blows his goat horn and they also hear explosions. They find Dean and they leave the cave.

They make a trip to Luigi's house. Parrot finds a book which happens to be Luigi's diary. They check the storage section of Luigi's house and find a lodestone compass which leads to the 
Far Lands City
. They head to the nether after finding a ruined portal to get brewing materials since they found a fortress immediately after lighting the portal. The Mafia finds them and starts blowing up the fortress. They go to the overworld to escape them.

Parrot and Wifies loot up a jungle temple to get arrows and other loot from the jungle temple. They also loot up a desert temple and get a bunch of TNT. After a while they get attacked by singular Mafia member. Parrot uses the TNT he got from the desert to make a minecart trap. They pop the totem of the invisible player and they get stasised into the void. They realize this is exactly what almost happened to Dean. Parrot, Wifies and Dean go to a jungle and Parrot asks them if he can trust them. They both say yes. 

They find a woodland mansion so they loot the woodland mansion to get totems. After each getting at least 1 totem, they leave the woodland mansion and enter an ancient city however, The Mafia found them again. Dean blows his goat horn and they start blowing up the ancient city, spawning a warden in the process. They managed to rescue Dean. They head to a village to trade with villagers for better gear then they leave the village. After a while they spot a massive obsidian border. They find a house next to the border and it turns out the house belongs to 
R4trick
 and 
Finiahn
. They explain that the wall was made by The Mafia. Parrot tells them he's thinking of going across the border. They ride camels across the border and they notice strange things such as craters,  trees without leaves, strange terrain, drained lakes, and more. Ratrick asks them why they want to go through Mafia territory and Parrot explains that it's to get to the Far Lands to avenge 
LuigiToan
. They all continue exploring, telling jokes and telling stories. They also blow up an iron farm built by The Mafia however, The Mafia spots them and tries to kill them. Wifies gives Parrot his chestplate since they broke his chestplate and Parrot tries to hide from them in a jungle. 

Parrot goes invisible and he chooses not to take his armour off because he thinks he has arrows all over him, however all of his armour pieces break. Wifies tells Parrot to take off his chestplate since there are no arrows on him and Parrot throws his chestplate away. Parrot tries to run away from The Mafia while being invisible. Parrot manages to lose them and Wifies finds him. Dean tells Parrot and Wifies that they stopped chasing him at one point. 

They head out of Mafia territory and go to the nether to loot up a bastion. 

After leaving the nether they find a trial chamber. They loot the trial chamber in peace until they get jumped by the Mafia in the trial chamber. They leave the trial chamber and start running from the invisible players. They escape in the nether because Wifies baits them by making another portal. Parrot has an argument with Wifies over Dean and Wifies tells Parrot that Dean is not going to die. They go back to the overworld to tame horses so that they can go to the nether roof and use the horses to go faster. They get jumped by The Mafia yet again in the nether roof. They head back to the overworld and find a remote jungle. Parrot goes on a mining trip to get materials until he overhears Wifies and Dean arguing. After eavesdropping, Parrot acts like he didn't hear anything. Wifies asks if they are going to keep going but Parrot tells them that they will if they tell him what's going on. Wifies and Parrot argue over Dean again until Dean tells them the truth.    

Dean admits to Parrot that he's the reason why The Mafia found them all the time and that they have been taking advantage of him not being skilled and apologizes for it. Parrot gets upset at Dean and he walks away. Wifies follows Parrot and they discuss about how Dean had even leaked their location. Wifies implies that maybe they got Dean to shoot arrows when they weren't with them. Parrot considers asking Dean about the arrows but while he talks about doing so with Wifies, Dean puts the lodestone compass he had in a chest, blows the goat horn and runs away. Parrot and Wifies thinks he's in danger after he blows the goat horn and they look for Dean until they see the compass. Parrot feels bad and tries searching for Dean but Wifies tells Parrot not to because he's been long gone already.      

Parrot and Wifies continue travelling without Dean, but things change as soon as they reach a village. Wifies tells Parrot to give him the compass so Parrot proceeds in doing so but in return, Wifies burns the compass. Parrot thinks it was a fake compass but Wifies tells him that it was the real one. Wifies tells Parrot he doesn't want to go to the Far Lands because he thinks Parrot will die. They have an argument about going to the Far Lands until Parrot walks away and throws his spyglass. Wifies apologizes to him in private messages but Parrot ignores him.            

Parrot spends the rest of his journey on his own. He finds the farlands but not the Far Lands City. Parrot finishes reading Luigi's journal and tries to throws the emerald away but his allay keeps giving it back to him. He finds a player named 
Qu1nten
. Parrot assumes Quinten is a part of the Far Lands because there would be no other reason why he would be out here. Parrot tells Quinten to lead him to the Far Lands city. Parrot tells him he needs to talk to Horace so Quinten leads him to Horace. Parrot warns Horace that The Mafia will find the Far Lands city and he talks about what The Mafia did to all of his friends starting with Luigi. He tells Horace that The Mafia killed LuigiToan, weaponized Dean's friendship thus making him run away and made Wifies burn the compass leading to the city because Wifies wanted survival over everything and finally tells him that The Mafia will find the place so they have to fight back and Horace is convinced.            



Trivia


In 
Spoke's
 
I Infiltrated The Minecraft Mafia
 episode it is revealed that the Mafia members that were chasing them in the trial chamber were 
Spoke
, 
Mapicc
 and a random gold trimmed player


Gallery


Parrot being chased by more invisible players after he found the trial chamber
Parrot With 
Horace Altman
, discussing the problems in the 
Far Lands City

title: The Search for Minecraft's Lost Kingdom
content:
The Search for Minecraft's Lost Kingdom














Season


2






Episode


40






Upload date


Sep 6, 2025






POV


ParrotX2






Arcs


The Treasure Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


TheobaldTheBird
DragonMC_
Boosfer
Mixiku
Derapchu
creakyv
YaBoiTae
Nezoshoki
Wifies
SomethingBlue_














Before the Unstable SMP was filled with tens of thousands of players, three friends built a hidden city to hide their fortune. They called it Verdaria. Since then, both the city and the treasure have been lost to time... waiting for someone to finally find them. This is The Search for Minecraft's Lost Kingdom.





The Search for Minecraft's Lost Kingdom
 is the 67th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
,



Plot


In the early days of the Unstable SMP, three people named 
Myra
, 
Luma
, and 
Verda
 built a city called Verdaria as a safehaven for them and their treasures. Word was spread quickly about the existence of Verdaria, allowing players to find it. Scared that their treasures would fall into the wrong hands, the three created a scavenger hunt that led to Verdaria's location before they all disappeared. Throughout the years, players have tried to look for this place, but none have succeeded. 
Parrot
 thinks that this place is made up, until 
DragonMC
 gave him a book that had coords in them and was signed by Verda herself. Dragon says he tried to look for the next clue himself, but to no avail, believing that Parrot would be able to find the location himself. 
Theo
, still skeptical, decides to join Parrot in his adventure. Parrot and Theo start to gather resources for their journey, leaving off with Sky, their happy Ghast. 

As they approached the coordinates, they find a crater, presumably made by the hundreds of players looking for the next clue. They look inside of the hole to find nothing, even as far as going beneath the bedrock into the void looking for the next clue. Parrot tells Theo the clue hasn't been found because nobody has looked in the right places. They start to fly up thousands of blocks in the air, hoping the next clue would be there. To Parrot's surprise, there is a shulker box floating up in the air. Theo flies to the shulker box, revealing that it was nametagged with another set of coords. The two set sail again to the next set of coords, until suddenly they were ambushed by 
Boosfer
 and his goons. Boosfer confronts Parrot, and Parrot pretends to just be exploring. Boosfer reveals that he knows about Verdaria too and wants to know where the next location is. Boosfer starts to get aggressive, threatening Parrot to tell him where he's going next. Parrot runs, until he's at a cliff, Boosfer and his goons catch up to him, Parrot, with no other choice, stalls out Boosfer by telling him where he's headed. Theo flies by with a pig with a saddle attached and Parrot gets on the pig, allowing them to escape.

Now that Boosfer and his group of bandits aren't on their tail, Parrot and Theo decide to continue their journey up on the Nether roof. Once they reached the next set of coordinates, they stumble across a waterfall up on a mountain. It reveals to be a lush cave, which doesn't naturally spawn in Plains. This proved that it was manmade, and so they explore around a bit. Theo accidentally sets off a trap, but neither of them got hurt. They then find a mural of Verdaria, as well as a fox trapped inside of a cage with the next clue in its mouth. Parrot assumes that the cage is trapped with TNT, so breaking the cage isn't an option. He covers up the floor with wool to prevent the sculk sensors from activating beneath them, he then places a dispenser facing the fox and places a steak in it and activates it, since food overrides any item that the fox holds in its mouth. Reading into the next hint, the next coordinates were  written using the pigpen cypher. It was also revealed that 
ClownPierce
 was the one of the players that tried to look for this location. As soon as Parrot and Theo leave the cave, Boosfer and his gang appears again, demanding the second book. Boosfer says the only way he would be able to get the book was to kill Parrot, and so a fight breaks out. Parrot quickly crafts a crossbow and rockets, allowing him to do massive amounts of damage to the bandits. Parrot and Theo run from Boosfer, going back through the Nether portal, Parrot's plan was to go through as Boosfer went through the portal.

The two successfully escaped once again, letting their journey continue on. After an hour, they made it to their next stop, which was a ravine that used to be a mining town that has since been abandoned. The two start looking for clues, but to no avail. With no other leads, they start exploring the ravine, stumbling upon a player named 
jagle
. Parrot gives the book to jagle, and jagle says he has no idea of what Verdaria may be. Parrot and Theo decide to stay in the ravine, hoping to find clues inside of the ravine. They build a temporary base, over the course of the next week they scour the ravine for anything. Parrot finally asks jagle what happened to this place, and so jagle explains that five years ago the ravine used to be a mining town, until one day, the three people who built Verdaria showed up asking him to hide something for them. Soon, ClownPierce came searching for answers, and jagle hid it from him. This caused Clown to kill everyone, leaving jagle, which caused him to hide the next clue from anybody else. Even jagle has never been to Verdaria, but he's heard what it holds, and that gives Parrot and Theo newfound hope to keep going. Hearing that Parrot wants to help out the server, jagle gives the next clue to Parrot. As soon as they were about to head off, Boosfer and his gang ambushes Parrot and Theo once again. Running low on resources, the two surrender and promise to give Boosfer the clue. Boosfer holds Parrot hostage, making him and Theo come with him to solve it.

The next set of coordinates lead to a jungle, they walk down a path, at the end of the path there's a book that has the last task inside of it. Boosfer reads it first, but he isn't smart enough to decipher it, so he lets Parrot read it. The last sentence of the book says, "I'm sorry. The final clue dies with me." Parrot quickly realizes this could be a trap, even mentioning the fact that the book was placed on top of a build of ClownPierce's head. The final clue didn't exist, which meant the search was all for nothing. They explore the jungle a little more before stumbling across a crater. The crater is filled with craters, but just barely out of sight is a staircase hidden inside. Going down reveals to be a huge obsidian box with pillars and an execution chamber inside of it. Boosfer and his bandits leave because there was no trace. Theo tells Parrot that this was a big waste of time too, but Parrot digs around, saying that the secret died with Verda. Parrot picks up the lava from the execution chamber, revealing a compass that lead to the location of Verdaria. This meant that ClownPierce tried to get the location through brute force, after it failed, he resorted to threatening Verda to telling him where it was. Verda didn't budge, causing her to sacrifice herself to protect the location, and to plant the compass.

Once obtaining the compass, they head to the city that was once rumored to be lost. After multiple Minecraft days pass, the compass finally turned. They start to head down, and it is revealed to actually be Verdaria, which has been untouched for years. They start to look through chests, only to have junk inside of them. They find a hidden path with more chests, with them being empty as well. Inside of the small room was a small sculpture, which happened to be in the small lush cave they saw earlier. Parrot breaks the painting that was on the sculpture, revealing a lever hidden inside of it. Once flipped, a secret entrance was opened, leading to another dropdown. Parrot and Theo gets filled with excitement as they see the treasure. There are hundreds of blocks of ore, dozens of diamond and netherite armor sets, and every enchantment book possible. The two fill up boat chests with the loot, tying them to Sky, and starts to fly back home. Theo asks Parrot, "You think the founders would be happy with us finding it?" Parrot replies, "I hope so."



Trivia


The locations of Myra and Luma are unknown so there is a chance they haven't died yet


Wifies has confirmed himself that he plays one of Boosfer's bandits in this video.

Millions of blocks out on the Unstable SMP, exists the 
Great Sea
... a vast expanse of ocean that's rumored to contain some sort of lost treasure. This is the Search for Minecraft's Lost Empire.





The Search for Minecraft's Sunken Empire
 is the 73rd episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


DragonMC
 gives 
Parrot
 and 
Theo
 a new book containing a clue to a lost underwater city. This time, the two don't hesitate to set off.

The journey takes them to the 
Great Sea
, a vast ocean expanse where the terrain and islands are unlike those in the vanilla game. At the first location, they find nothing and realize the chest with the next clue has already been looted. However, they spot a nearby island occupied by other players. This is a group called the "
Ocean Rangers
". They summon the travelers for questioning after claiming to have never heard of the lost city. Parrot and Theo agree, hoping the Rangers might provide more information.

However, they are forced to empty their inventories. Parrot manages to smuggle a bucket of fish and a bucket of axolotl into their cell, where they find another player named 
Boomie
. The players are underwater and afflicted with the Mining Fatigue effect. Theo complains about how Parrot always shares their hard-earned treasures with new players on the server. When their guard is called to a meeting, Parrot uses a little-known mechanic to remove the Mining Fatigue: by helping an axolotl kill a fish, any negative effects are cleared. They secretly retrieve their items, but the Rangers spot them. Boomie has nothing on him and makes a run for it. Just then, another squad arrives, led by an 
invisible player
 with a voice changer and 
Jaden_MAN
. They are clearly at war with the Rangers. The cell guard chases Parrot, but he manages to kill him using the fall damage caused by the ice from his Frost Walker boots.

The next clue leads to an archipelago of sunken ships. Both the Rangers' and the invisible player's groups are already there. Parrot lures the latter group by throwing Wind Charges to draw them towards the former. He and Theo use the ensuing chaos to reach the next clue: a piston, which in pirate speak (a reference to the in-game language option) is called a "raised deck," the phrase mentioned in the clue book. With their food running low, they decide to go fishing.

"What are you gonna do with that fish you're catching? Give it to some new player at spawn?" Theo asks sarcastically.

Silence.

"You need this stuff. What, are you going to give away your armor? Your fishing rod? You need all of this to live! If you give away everything you have, you'll be left with nothing!"

Parrot answers with wisdom:

"There are two groups of players on the server. The first has everything, and the second is left with nothing. But there's a third group—those who could have everything, but choose to share, giving to those in need. Because that is the right thing to do. Treasure, items, power—those are temporary things. If you take them, you'll end up alone."

Theo claps mockingly. "Bravo, for being so morally perfect!"

"This server needs help, and I am going to save it!" Parrot declares firmly.

"Since when are you like this?" Theo asks.

"For a while now. That's a story for another time."

"A story? A story about how you ended up at spawn with three carrots? Haha."

They soon reach a new island. They feed a dolphin to lead them to the nearest naturally-generated underwater treasure. This, in turn, leads them to another island, where they breed turtles, knowing the mother will return to her home beach to lay its eggs. But just then, the Rangers, led by 
TheLobsterMan
, catch up to them. Boomie is their hostage. "Either he dies, or you give us the clue!" TheLobsterMan commands. In either scenario, Parrot stands to lose something. Theo begs him to sacrifice the player, calling him useless. Instead, Parrot throws an invisibility potion at Boomie and pulls him with a fishing rod, giving the defenseless player a chance to escape. Parrot and Theo get away as well, but Theo has had enough of Parrot's heroic deeds, which risk everything to save every single soul. He abandons the mission.

Parrot, in a boat with Boomie, reaches the underwater city. On a small island next to it, Boomie states that maybe the best solution would have been to leave him to his fate, as he was truly a useless player. Parrot disagrees and promises to do everything he can for him.

Then, the surprise comes, a stab shot gets sent down, the invisible player had killed Boomie, under the pretext that he was a "threat to his identity." When Parrot says he has no idea who is standing before him, the invisible player replies that, in that case, there is no reason to kill him. He also refuses to take the treasure, claiming he doesn't need it.

Parrot takes the resources from the underwater city and returns to the first archipelago. Theo is waiting for him there, with their Happy Ghast, Sky, tied up. He apologizes, and Parrot forgives him. Now, Parrot has a clear idea of who this invisible player really is and shares that he will do everything in his power to foil his plan.

title: The Search for Wemmbu
content:
The Search for Wemmbu














Season


2






Episode


57






Upload date


Oct 27, 2025






POV


ParrotX2






Arcs


The Fake Identity Arc
 and 
The Treasure Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


TheobaldTheBird
FlameFrags
Eggchan
Wemmbu
Boosfer
LettuceK
Twirps














On the Unstable SMP, 
Wemmbu
 is by far one of the most powerful players on the server.





The Search for Wemmbu
 is the 84th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


The episode starts off with 
FlameFrags
 visiting 
Parrot
 in his potion shop at 
Capital City
 and asks to figure out what happened to 
Wemmbu
 in return for a set of coordinates of a 
Mafia
 stash in the End. Flame goes on about how Wemmbu beat him in a fight, and after that he was nowhere to be found. Both Parrot and Flame find that suspicious, and so Parrot goes to visit people all around Capital City, asking each person who they heard the rumors from. The last person he asks says 
eggchan
, Wemmbu's best friend, said Flame killed Wemmbu. Parrot heads to the End dimension, he searches everywhere for eggchan, but wasn't able to find him. He then threatens to blow up the End if nobody lived there, eggchan then reveals himself. Parrot asks eggchan what happened to Wemmbu, and he says that Wemmbu was maced to death, which didn't match up to the story to what he told others.

Parrot devises a plan and gets the same armor and trims as Wemmbu. Since Parrot doesn't know where Wemmbu is, he impersonates Wemmbu and robs a store in Capital City, framing Wemmbu as a thief to catch his attention. Parrot then goes around the server searching for Wemmbu, but finds nothing. He returns to Capital City and is stopped by guards for stealing. Wemmbu then appears in front of them, confronting Parrot for impersonating him. Wemmbu then tries to pop Parrot's totem, which would get rid of all potion effects he has on. Parrot quickly takes off his totem, so if Wemmbu kills him, his name would appear in chat. Parrot then tries to walk away since his invisibility was running out, but Wemmbu follows him. Parrot then goes to a silverfish farm, uses a potion of wind charging and potion of harming to launch himself thousands of blocks up in the air, leading to his escape.

Parrot's next idea is to go back to the End dimension and try to trick eggchan into thinking he was Wemmbu. When he gets there, eggchan pretended like Parrot didn't exist. This didn't help Parrot's case, and before heading back to the Overworld, Parrot mentions a courthouse meeting to eggchan. Parrot and 
Theo
 then travels to 
Boosfer's
 base for clues, since Wemmbu and Boosfer had an altercation before. When Parrot arrives at Boosfer's base, Boosfer asks, "Why are you wearing your invisibility again?" Parrot tries to use this time to get Boosfer to admit that the invisible player was Wemmbu, but Wemmbu appears shortly after. Boosfer can't tell the two apart, and makes them do trials to figure out who's the real Wemmbu. This doesn't solve anything, and so Wemmbu begins to attack Parrot, trying to pop his totem. Parrot runs out of the factory and swaps out with Theo, who's also pretending to be the invisible player. Parrot and Theo start to attack Wemmbu, and Wemmbu begins to mace them. This causes them to flee, they try to fly away using their 
Happy Ghast
, but Wemmbu kills it. With no other choice, they travel through the Nether to escape back to Capital City.

The next day, Parrot tells Flame that the invisible player has an Elytra and mace, but it wasn't enough evidence to prove that it was Wemmbu. His next plan was to trap the courthouse room, hopefully revealing Wemmbu's identity. He trades sets of Netherite armor in return for replicas of Wemmbu's exact armor and trims and hires people in Capital City to pretend to be the invisible player as well. Once the time comes, the courtroom meeting starts, and all of the players in Capital City are stasised out, which only left Wemmbu in the room. Wemmbu and Theo start fighting, and Parrot waits for Flame to show up, in which Flame ended up not doing. Parrot and Theo uses chorus fruit to get out, and Wemmbu escapes himself. Parrot wasn't going to give up easily, and begins to chase Wemmbu. They end up on a mountain, and Wemmbu asks Parrot and Theo why they care about him. One of Parrot's reasonings is because Wemmbu killed 
Boomie
, believing that Boomie was an innocent player, but Wemmbu tells him that Boomie was a bandit who killed random players. Wemmbu asks if they're going to stop hunting him now, but Parrot says that they're not going to stop until they revealed his identity. Wemmbu then heads towards them, ready to attack. Parrot and Theo build a roof above their head, and Wemmbu uses a stab shot to blow it up and popping both their totems. This causes the both of them to fly away.

Parrot flies to Flame's base asking where he was, and Flame says he was dealing with 
The Law
. He says that he was trying to prepare for the situation until The Law showed up to his base. Parrot has one last plan, he uses the exact same strategies 
the Director
 used against him to uncover Wemmbu's identity. He also sets up traps for Wemmbu. Parrot hides out in the stronghold and meets Wemmbu again face to face. He gives Wemmbu an ultimatum to reveal his own identity. Wemmbu, obviously not wanting to, starts to attack Parrot. Parrot flies through a massive tunnel, and at the end of the tunnel was the same meeting room used to trap 
MrCube6
 in. The plan was to have Theo and Wemmbu fight to drain his resources, and Parrot flees. 

He heads to the same ender pearl cannon that the Director built and throws a pearl into it. Parrot teleports millions of blocks out, where he meets back up with Flame, and the final trap is set. A flashback shows Parrot telling Flame to use the cannon and build a dome covered with obsidian and the insides with powdered snow, lava, and TNT. Parrot waits on the center platform for Wemmbu to show up. As predicted, Wemmbu ends up right across from Parrot. He then tells Wemmbu that this is the end of Wemmbu's fake identity. Parrot then explains how he figured out that The Invisible Knight was Wemmbu. He asks Wemmbu why he faked his own death, and Wemmbu tells him that he wants to enjoy the server like a normal player. Parrot said he knew the Invisible Knight was Wemmbui all along, but pretended not to know in order to save his own life. Wemmbu says that he could kill Parrot right now, but then Parrot reveals that Flame is there with them. Wemmbu then tries to escape, but whilist pearl catching, his wind charge went through the powdered snow and lava, causing the TNT surrounding the dome to explode. This caused the dogs both Parrot and Flame tamed to die in the explosion, showing their death in chat, as well exposing Wemmbu's name in the death message. 

Now that the job was done, Parrot has second thoughts about if revealing Wemmbu's identity was the right thing to do. Because there's no escape, Wemmbu and Flame end back up on the platform with Parrot, and Parrot tells Wemmbu to take off his invisibility. Parrot asks Flame for his end of the deal, and Flame gives the book with the coordinates to the Mafia tomb. Wemmbu asks why this happened, and Parrot says that he had to "tie up some loose ends", and tries to frame Wemmbu as a bad person for killing Boomie, Sky, and a bunch of innocent civilians in Capital City. Parrot tries to say more, but Wemmbu wind charges him off the platform. As Parrot's falling into the void, he looks in a specific direction, which activates a mirror receiver to set off a stasis, saving his life.



Trivia


The video's original title was “Hunting a Minecraft Player Who Shouldn't Exist”.

title: The Toxic War Arc
content:
Story


*This episode is not a part of any arc, but is included here for comprehension purposes*
 
FlameFrags
 is attacked by a group of players led by 
SpokeIsHere
. He loses his netherite armor in the fight, but gets ambushed by another group and kills them all. He heads to 
Merchant City
 and trades the gear for a netherite helmet, but gets attacked by the 
Bounty Assassin Team
. He gets netherite boots from the fight and escapes. 
Wemmbu
 attacks him at his house, but since neither can kill the other they stop and talk. Wemmbu gives him coords to Spoke's base, and he goes there, surviving multiple traps before Spoke flees. On the way out he's attacked again, and obtains netherite leggings, completing his set.

Flame's base is destroyed by a group of players led by 
Razor2gud
, who continually harass him. He finds their base and kills them, finding a map showing a dozen other bases of the same team. The first base he raids gives him TNT, which he uses to destroy all future bases. Razor jumps him with another army, but he uses TNT minecarts to kill them all, then goes on a base-destroying spree before finally arriving at the last, Razor's castle. Razor challenges him to a 1v1 and tries to cheat, prompting Flame to kill everyone, Razor included.

Flame’s 
dog
 is kidnapped. He follows them to their giant base, which is divided into sections, each one inhabited by so-called masters of a specific potion. Flame defeats the strength, poison, swiftness, harming, underwater, and glowing groups before coming to the final one. 
T0X1N
, the leader of the team, jumps Flame with his minions, but Flame kills everyone except for him. Toxin threatens to kill Ashen, forcing Flame to drop all his things to try and kill him, but Flame survives and 1v1s Toxin, killing him just before he can kill Ashen. They leave together.

Flame gets ambushed by more players, but he kills them all. While looking for a new base, he finds 
Lomedy’s
 farm, and forcibly moves in. More players attack, and one drops a compass that leads to the base of the leader, VEN0M, a former diamond player. Flame beats him but fails to kill him, and returns home. More players attack, with actual skill, and Flame wins only due to Lomedy giving him a mace. Lomedy builds TNT cannons to assault Venom’s base, while Flame goes in and kills everyone. He wins a 1v1 with Venom despite having half armor, killing him, and gives Lomedy both the maces before leaving.

title: The Treasure Arc
content:
The Treasure Arc is an arc in  
Unstable Universe
 Chronologically, it follows up on 
The Director Arc
, happens concurrently with 
The Fake Identity Arc
, Skill vs Power Arc, and is followed up by 
The Kings Arc
.





The Treasure Arc














Info




Season


2






Episode Amount


6








Episodes




First Episode


The Unstable SMP Experience






Final Episode


Finding the Tomb of the Minecraft Mafia






All Episodes


The Unstable SMP Experience
The Search for Minecraft's Lost Kingdom
The Search for Minecraft's Sunken Empire
The Hunt for Minecraft's Deadliest Vault
Hunting a Minecraft Player Who Shouldn't Exist
Finding the Tomb of the Minecraft Mafia










Story


ParrotX2
 takes an End portal to spawn after escaping 
Paragon
. Withers are everywhere, but his old friend 
TheobaldTheBird
 saves him and takes him to 
Capital City 2.0
, led by 
Reddoons
. Parrot runs a shop there, but it soon becomes a smuggling business, as citizens pay the duo to get their friends from spawn to Capital City. They continually come into conflict with 
Boosfer
. Eventually, Reddoons finds out about this, and asks Parrot to save his friend 
Hexatope
. Parrot agrees, on the condition that Reddoons forgive the debt of everyone in the city, to which he agrees. They successfully save Hexatope, and everyone celebrates.

Parrot and Theo hear about the lost city of Verdaria, rumored to be home to amazing treasures. They successfully solve the first few clues, but Boosfer is after the treasure too. He finally corners them and forces them to help him, but they hit a dead end, since the final clue was apparently destroyed to stop 
ClownPierce
 from getting it. Boosfer leaves, but Parrot figures out the real final clue, and they find Verdaria, loading up their happy ghast 
Sky
 to carry all the treasure away, with the intention of distributing it to the players.

Parrot and Theo hear about a treasure in the 
Great Sea
. They head there and meet 
TheLobsterMan
, who takes them prisoner along with 
Boomie
. They escape, inadvertently helped by 
an invisible player
. They follow a couple more clues before Lobster's group catches up again, trying to use Boomie as leverage to get a clue from Parrot. Parrot manages to get them both out, but splits off from Theo after an argument over their plans for the treasure. The invisible player kills Boomie, and Parrot finds the treasure, making up with Theo and heading off, but secretly planning revenge on the invisible player.

Parrot plans to steal from ClownPierce's vault next. While in the Nether, he meets 
FlameFrags
, who's also looking for Clown, and they team up. Flame and Theo successfully kidnap 
FerreMC
, Clown's right-hand man, but Parrot lets him escape as part of a plan to track him. He and Theo talk, and he reveals he's planning to betray Flame, but Flame overhears this and brings Clown to the location. Clown lets him say his last words, and Parrot apologizes to Flame, causing Flame to switch sides. Parrot escapes and finds the vault by following Clown, but Clown catches him. He escapes with barely any gear and returns to Capital City with Theo. Flame shows up in his shop and hires him to find 
Wemmbu
.

Parrot decides to impersonate Wemmbu, thinking he’s the invis player from before. He successfully gets the real invis player to show up, fighting him multiple times before he kills Sky with a mace, confirming his identity. Parrot sets up a trap in Capital City, which works, but Flame doesn’t show up, allowing Wemmbu to escape. Parrot decides to channel 
the Director
, and sets up one final trap, which works flawlessly, getting Wemmbu into an inescapable cell along with Flame. His work done, Parrot gets coords to the loot stash Flame promised him, then leaves.

Parrot and Theo head out to the loot stash, left over by 
The Invisible Mafia
. Once there, they witness 
Marlowww
, the guard, kill a group of bandits, and help one escape. He brings them to an End base, where Parrot gambles against 
Rasplin
 for the key to access the treasure. Marlow shows up and kills Rasplin, and Parrot and Theo flee back to her island. They manage to steal the key from Marlow and sneak inside, where Theo supposedly sacrifices himself to Marlow so Parrot can escape. Parrot finds Marlow's room, and learns that she's guarding the stash to protect people, since if a single item is taken stasis chambers will activate and kill hundreds of people. Parrot leaves without taking anything, and swear off treasure hunting as he and Theo return home.

title: The Underworld
content:
The Underworld











							The Castle
							
						







							Center
							
						







							The Fields
							
						






















































Alias


The Forgotten Dimension
Void Civilization
Nether Void Civilization
The Underworld






Status


Active






Info




Enemies


Wemmbu
Boosfer
The Invisible Mafia








Appearances




Appears In


I Escaped Minecraft's Forgotten Dimension
I Explored the Minecraft Farlands






Debut


I Escaped Minecraft's Forgotten Dimension












Somehow, below the bedrock in the Nether dimension, was a completely new world.



-
Wemmbu
, monologing to himself, 
I Escaped Minecraft's Forgotten Dimension


The Underworld
 is a world underneath the bedrock of the nether, where the void should be. Only a select few players are able to place blocks in the underworld, them living in The Underworld and are called "
Soul Keepers"
. Mapicc referred to a place called the "Underworld" but it is technically not proven that that is the same dimension being referred to, though it is very likely.  



Structure


Description


This place is primarily dark and gray. Although the Underworld is almost completely devoid of any color, you can still see some vibrance, especially of green, placed on the buildings and landmarks. Withers can be found throughout as well, and structures like a castle and a graveyard can also be noted. You can also find deep chasms here. 

In an unknown location in the Underworld there is a portal hub that can teleports to presumably multiple points of interest in the server. Although as of now we've only seen 2 of 20~ portals being the one to Serpentbound's kingdom, and the one to the unknown flow forest 



Glitches


Placing and Breaking:


 
 
 
 
 
Picture of the Gold Block, teased at the end of the world's debut video
 
 


In this dimension, only the citizens (Players with green armor trims) have the ability to break and place blocks. The reason for this is unknown.



The Gold Block


The Gold block is located in (about) the middle of the castle, and standing on it or near it makes your game extremely laggy.



Nether Portal Lobby


The Underworld has connection to 
Far Lands
 in every direction through a lobby of nether portals guarded by 
Soul Keepers
.



History


Wemmbu
 and 
Boosfer
 were fighting. They both dropped into the Nether's void. They thought they were going to die, as there was no escape. Instead of taking damage, they landed on a blocked surface, something they did not expect. 
The residence
 hated their pressence and proseded to try and kill them. Thanks to PVP and a bit of luck, they survived this and escaped.  

Near the end of 
My Best Friend Died on the Unstable SMP
, Mapicc mentions that 
JamatoP
 has been to the underworld which basically comfirms the theory that The Underworld is home to glitches, giving Jamato more power than before. 

Wemmbu
 travels to the opposite end of the 
Far Lands
 in negative X direction where Jamato's flower base is compared to that in positive Z direction where he got his orbital strike cannons. Jamato finds Wemmbu and 
eggchan
 rummaging through his house and takes them to go to 
Serpentbound
 when Wemmbu says he knows the 
Far Lands people
. As they walk through the Far Lands forest, Wemmbu and egg find small monuments in the floor and Wemmbu mentions that one of them looks like the Underworld. Jamato tells him he's not supposed to know about that place and to not go there. Afterwards, they go through the forest's nether portal, which sends them into the Underworld where the soul keepers have portals linked to important places of the Far Lands. 



Theories


Main article: 
The Underworld Theories



They are rumored to connect to the 
Null Hunters
 because of their skins, names, and totem effects.



Navigation

?
]

title: The Unstable SMP Civil War
content:
The Unstable SMP Civil War is the current war between the 
Royal Army
 of 
Parrot's Kingdom
 led by 
ParrotX2
 and the faction 
Cindercrest
, led by 
Saparata
. 

The Unstable SMP Civil War began when 
Cindercrest
 forces launched an assault of 
Fort Feather
, a military base created by 
Parrot
 to train his soldiers and to defend his kingdom from 
Cindercrest
. While 
Cindercrest
 could not successfully take the fort by ground assault, they were able to turn tide of the battle turned when they used a Redstone Blimp to launch an airborne assault using paratroopers with slow-falling. The short battle ended in victory for 
Cindercrest
 because of the greater fighting power of the their soldiers once they were inside the fort, and the Fort Feather legion of the 
Royal Army
 retreated to 
Merchant City
 through an underground tunnel. The fort was partially self-destructed by 
Parrot
 using TNT in an attempt to kill the 
Cindercrest
 soldiers, and he partially succeeded, making the battle not a total loss.

The second major battle of the Unstable SMP Civil War took place at 
Merchant City
, which is a strategic location as it serves as 
Parrot's Kingdom's
 eastern gateway. The battle started when the 
Cindercrest
 army arrived at the gates of 
Merchant City
, but after talking with 
Saparata
, 
Parrot
 tricked him instead launching another airborne assault. This time however, the 
Royal Army
 had set up a anti-air arrow artillery cannon using Redstone, so when the 
Cindercrest
 paratroopers begun falling down with slow-fall, they were fired on and many were killed in the sky before they could reach the ground. The few soldiers that managed to not get shot were mostly killed on the ground by the 
Merchant City Vanguard
 legion and the remaining soldiers of the Fort Feather legion, both of which were present here. The battle ended in victory for the 
Royal Army
.

The third major battle of the Unstable SMP Civil War took place at 
Highwater City
, which was an important location as it produced 80 percent of the food for 
Parrot's Kingdom
.

The Wonders
 were five builds used to store glitched items and features. The builds were originally created by the Master Builders, and used by 
SpokeIsHere
 and 
JamatoP
 to store glitched features. Each wonder has a guard, who is not allowed to check inside of any wonders. 



List of The Wonders


The Gardens of Babylon:


This massive temple is most likely based off of the Hanging Gardens of Babylon, an ancient structure destroyed by earthquake. This Wonder, placed in a savanna biome, with its gardens full of lush acacia trees and yellow flowers, was the first to be blown up by an orbital cannon. 



The Frosted Palace:


The Frosted Palace is a huge ice castle built on a snowy hill surrounded by ice. This gargantuan build is filled with extraordinary details, scattered with large stone rocks, giant trees, and ice spikes. This wonder was the last to be destroyed, attempted to be saved by 
ParrotX2
, but was blown up nonetheless.



The Crone:


The Crone is a massive stone statue standing on a plain completely surrounded by river. The cloaked woman holds a staff in her right hand and an unknown object in her left. This Wonder was the second to be blown up.



The Marshland Mansion:


The Mansion is located in a swamp biome. This large overgrown manor, filled with trees, uses froglights to light up its mud and copper walls. The Marshland Mansion was the fourth Wonder to be destroyed.



The Pyramid of Anubis:


The Pyramid of Anubis is an ancient Egyptian-styled pyramid dotted with hieroglyphics and contains a gold cap. Each side of the pyramid holds two large  statues of Anubis, the Egyptian god of funerary and care of the dead. This Wonder was the third one to be destroyed.



History


Spoke pays 
Squiddo
 to have the Master Builders build them. His plan is to make them so beautiful that no one wants to destroy or mine into it. Spoke and Jamato create the first glitched features in the wonders. The builders do not know that Spoke and Jamato are creating these in the wonders.

Spoke hires 
Jumper
, 
Roshambogames
, 
Fantst
, 
Derapchu
, and 
Wemmbu
 to guard the wonders.

Wemmbu discovers what is inside The Wonders and started to attack Spoke.

Spoke destroys all of the wonders, despite Parrot trying to stop them from being destroyed.

TheobaldTheBird

TheobaldTheBird
, also known as 
Theobald
 or most commonly 
Theo
, is a supporting character and the deuteragonist of 
Parrot
's 
Season 2
 videos featured in the 
Unstable Universe
. He has been Parrot's best friend and teammate since 
Wifies
' death.



Personality


Theo is a highly skilled and charismatic player, being a PVP minecart focused fighter. He is Parrot’s best friend and loyal bodyguard, with Theo being highly protective of the other and often putting his friend before himself, even in life-or-death scenarios. Theo is often the victim of friendly robbery and teases from allies which he always indignant of. He is shown to be highly airheaded outside of battles, with him having issues with writing, reading and numbers. This bird-brained personally leads act as a comic relief and he tends to lean into this trait of his to lighten dark situations. However, he is prone to aggressive outbursts and has an incredibly short temper. Additionally, he regularly uses intimidation and violence against others to get what he wants.

Theo shares Parrot's vision of wanting the sever to be a safe environment for newcomers of the server without the threats of being banned or facing corruption. Theo has his ideals about helping the server, he is also sensible and focuses on saving the live of the many rather than the lives of the few. He is an adamant individual, sticking to his guns despite external influences and people of his past, such as 
ShoeBilly_
. Rather than dwelling on his past, he focuses entirely on the future of the Unstable server.



History


Season 1


TheobaldTheBird is first introduced in the 
Unstable SMP: The First War
 as a member of the 
Far Lands
 Warrior faction, initially seeming cold stoic to Parrot. During a competition with 
ParrotX2
, he pops the totem of undying of 
Purpled
 using TNT mine carts, meaning he becomes a mission leader. He helps Parrot become the leader of the Warrior faction after the other 3 members of the council try to kill the both of them.

After the Far Lands Civilization is taken over by 
The Invisible Mafia
, TheobaldTheBird joins 
District 13
. He later leaves District 13 due to minimal progress.



Season 2


Wemmbu
 and 
Eggchan
 travel millions of blocks out to make a base alone. TheobaldTheBird secretly follows them, as he wants to PvP someone. TheobaldTheBird leaves. Wemmbu and Eggchan set up a trap with the creaking. TheobaldTheBird destroys their base again and their trap fails. 
Kenadian
 helps Wemmbu and Eggchan make their base more secure. TheobaldTheBird breaks into the base and tries to kill Wemmbu. TheobaldTheBird threatens to kill Kenadian if Wemmbu doesn’t have a fair fight with him. TheobaldTheBird eventually runs from the fight.

TheobaldTheBird secretly helps Wemmbu survive in the 
Pirate Islands
. He helps Wemmbu try to kill 
Jaden_MAN
.

TheobaldTheBird enters a PvP tournament, but loses to 
FlameFrags
.

TheobaldTheBird meets ParrotX2 at spawn and saves him from a wither. He then leads parrot to 
Capital City
, and reintroduces him to 
Reddoons
. When Reddoons goes afk, Theo gets ParrotX2 to come with him to the black market, where they meet Puqi_, and are paid 64 diamonds to bring Puqi_'s friend 
DragonMC
, from spawn to capital city. Reddoons eventually catches them helping people escape spawn, and have them help his friend Hexatope escape into capital city, and promises to remove all debt from the citizens if they do so. The citizens give ParrotX2 and Theo an elytra.



The Lost City


Parrot and Theo attempt to find 
Verdaria
.

After escaping the wither, a new wither begins attacking him. TheobaldTheBird saves Parrot from the wither.

Parrot fears that Theo will kill him. However, Theo says that he won't. They both venture to Capital City, which has now been completely remade, at spawn. After arriving, Theo uses the nether star from the dead wither to pay off his debt and Parrot opens a potion shop.

Running the shop did not go according to plan however, and only one sale was made. Theo and Parrot go to spawn to help players escape spawn for payment.

Parrot and Theo enter a betting game led by Boosfer, which turns out to be a scam. Figuring this out, Parrot is able to steal their entire stash of three enchanted apples, three totems and three netherite ingots.

Parrot gets a letter and a lodestone compass, from Leow0ok, explaining how Bounty Assassin Team is being remade. In the book, he instructs Parrot on how he could get a happy ghast. They are however, attacked by Boosfer and his guards, while going to the location. They are able to escape with the happy ghast.

Once back in Capital City, Parrot places the Happy Ghast in Reddoons' Animal Care Department. Reddoons asks Parrot to help 
Hexatope
 escape from spawn. In return, Parrot asks for the clearing of debt of all citizens of the city. Reddoons agrees.

Hexatope is able to escape spawn. Before they can enter Capital City, Boosfer and his guards confront them. Parrot and Theo are able to kill them, and Boosfer has to run away.

Reddoons absolves everybody of their debt in Capital City.

Parrot and Theo are told about 
Verdaria
, a civilization with a large amount of resources. They go to a specific set of coordinates, which supposedly contains the first clue for where Verdaria is. Parrot and Theo find a crater at the coordinates, from players looking for the next clue. They do not find anything in the hole. They discover, very high up, a shulker, name tagged a specific set of coordinates. Boosfer tries to threaten Parrot into telling him where he is going. Parrot is able to escape with the help of Theo.

Parrot and Theo eventually reach the next set of coordinates. Theo and Parrot accidentally set off a trap in a mountain. After exploring inside the mountain, they eventually find a fox trapped inside of a cage with the next clue in its mouth. Parrot assumes that the cage is trapped with TNT, meaning that they couldn't break any blocks. Using wool, he is able to get the item out of the fox's mouth. The item contains the next set of coordinates.

Boosfer and his guards attempt to kill Parrot and Theo, but fail.

After an hour, they make it to the next set of coordinates, which is a ravine that used to be a mining town that has since been abandoned. The two start looking for clues, but do not find anything. They find a player named Jagle. Parrot gives the book to Jagle, and Jagle says he has no idea of what Verdaria may be. Parrot and Theo decide to stay in the ravine, hoping to find clues inside of the ravine. 

They build a temporary base, and over the course of the next week they scour the ravine for anything. Parrot asks Jagle what happened to the ravine, so Jagle explains that five years ago the ravine used to be a mining town, until one day, the three people who built Verdaria showed up asking him to hide something for them. Soon, ClownPierce came searching for answers, and Jagle hid it from him. This caused Clown to kill everyone, leaving Jagle, which caused him to hide the next clue from anybody else. Hearing that Parrot wants to help out the server, Jagle gives the next clue to Parrot. As soon as they are about to leave, Boosfer and his gang ambushes Parrot and Theo once again. Running low on resources, the two surrender and promise to give Boosfer the clue. Boosfer holds Parrot hostage, making him and Theo come with him to solve it.

The next set of coordinates lead to a jungle. They walk down a path, at the end of the path there's a book that has the last task inside of it. Boosfer reads it first, but he isn't able to decipher it, so he lets Parrot read it. The last sentence of the book says, "I'm sorry. The final clue dies with me." Parrot quickly realizes this could be a trap, even mentioning the fact that the book was placed on top of a build of ClownPierce's head. They eventually find a crater. They find a staircase, and going down, they find a huge obsidian box with pillars and an execution chamber inside of it. Boosfer and his bandits leave. Parrot picks up the lava from the execution chamber, revealing a compass that leads to the location of Verdaria.

Afterwards, they go to the coordinates of Verdaria. They eventually find Verdaria. Parrot and Theo find a room filled with treasure. They give a large amount of treasure to other players.

DragonMC__ comes to Parrot and Theo's potion shop, saying that he had bought the clue but couldn't solve it. Parrot and Theo then follow the clue to the 
Great Sea
. They find the first chest but realize that it has already been looted.

Parrot and Theo go to a different island where they find a team called the ocean rangers. The team forces them to empty their inventory. Parrot manages to smuggle in a bucket of fish and a bucket of axolotl.  

The ocean rangers take Parrot and Theo back to there base where they are locked in an underwater cell with a conduit for water breathing. Inside they met a player named 
Boomie
. Parrot, Theo, and Boomie escape.

Parrot and Theo find an island, with a dolphin. Once they feed the dolphin it leads them to the nearest naturally generating buried treasure, leading to an island with turtles. Parrot and Theo save Boomie from the ocean rangers, who were trying to use Boomie as a hostage. Theo leaves, and stops trying to find the lost treasure. Wemmbu, invisible, kills Boomie with an orbital strike cannon. Parrot collects the treasure.

Parrot and Theo go into the nether dimension, owned by 
ClownPierce
. Their goal is to steal from ClownPierce's vault to give to other players. Clown and Ferre try to kill Parrot and Theo, but they escape. Parrot and Theo find FlameFrags. Flame tries to kill them due to Parrot and Theo wearing shields designed for people who work for ClownPierce. Parrot says that he has a trap, which would blow Flame up, causing him to stop attacking. Flame, Parrot, and Theo form an alliance as Flame is trying to kill ClownPierce.

Flame and Theo try to kidnap Ferre to use as leverage. Parrot gives Ferre a map, and lets him free, assuming that they can use the map to find the location of the vault. Parrot shares with Theo that he dislikes FlameFrags, and Flame is secretly able to hear them. Flame leaves, and Parrot discovers Flame was able to hear them. Flame betrays Parrot, and tells ClownPierce the location of parrot. Clown attempts to kill Parrot. Parrot apologizes to Flame, causing Flame to save Parrot and Theo.

Parrot finds the location of the vault. He attempts to steal items from the vault, but ClownPierce finds him, and attempts to kill him. Parrot is able to escape using chorus fruit. He goes back to steal more items, then he escapes again.

Flame asks Parrot to help him find out where Wemmbu is, and in return says he will give Parrot the location of the Tomb of the Mafia. Parrot goes to the location of Eggchan, Wemmbu's friend, and asks where Wemmbu is. Eggchan's story is not consistent with what he had said before, causing Parrot to be suspicious. Parrot, assuming Wemmbu is the Invisible Knight, comes back, invisible. Eggchan is able to deduce that the invisible player is not Wemmbu. Parrot impersonates the Invisible Knight, and does bad things as him, causing the Invisible Knight to be no longer allowed to come to Capital City.



The Election Arc


In the video I Survived The Unstable SMP Purge, Parrot attends a meeting held by Lettuce, and gets jumped by assassins. 
Naparizel
 dies and Lettuce then announces The Purge, where candidates can kill each other for books. Purpled attacks Parrot for his books, knowing that Parrot is weaker than others in pvp. Theo comes and helps parrot, popping Purpled’s totems multiple times while Parrot escapes. 

Theo later meets another player named 
PearitX2
, and goes with Pearit to restock and get more votes. Pearit used a voicechanger, so Theo didn’t know it was an imposter. 

After Parrot recieves 
Horace Altman
 and 
Fymada
’s votes, he returns to his tower in the 
Northern Council
. Then, he finds Theo with Pearit and gets really confused. Pearit runs away and is never seen again. 

After Theo and Parrot reunite at the Northern Council, the two express doubt about Parrot’s chances in the election regardless of his endorsements from Horace and Fymada, as he was still around six thousand votes off of Lettuce. Parrot then considers one last possibility to swing the election in his favor, 
someone
 they needed to find.

Theo then appears again at the climax of 
2 Minecraft Pros vs. 1000 Hunters
, appearing in earnest to 1v1 
The_Oroboros
 in cart combat, furious at the Law for nearly blowing up Parrot after successfully luring him and 
Wemmbu
 into a trap. He manages to finally slay The Oroboros, but is subsequently taken captive by 
SargeLaw
 and TheG0dofWar, as proclaimed by 
Lettuce
 at the Second Debate. Parrot, in a dark rage and remembering all the good times with Theo and how much he truly depended on his friendship over the past months, tells Lettuce that he should’ve kept their strife between the two of them.

Before his defeat of The_Oroboros and capture, Parrot and Theo are encountered by 
FlameFrags
, who requests Theo to train him in TNT minecart combat, since he is the master of it. Initially, Theo and Parrot are hesitant, but Parrot eventually persuades him to train Flame after Flame vows he will use all of his new combat skills to battle the Law. Theo admits later he thought would be a waste of his time. However, he is surprised when Flame exhibits above-average skill in cart combat, and agrees to train him further. Theo then admits he has not brought enough carts to continue, so they go to the 
Black Market
 under 
Capital City
 to purchase more.

However, as Flame acquires more carts, one of the commanders of 
Lettuce
, 
G0dOfWar
, arrives, having been alerted by a Law officer guarding the entrance to the market. Theo attempts to diffuse the situation after Flame is found but is unsuccessful, and G0dOfWar swiftly defeats Flame in battle as the two retreat from the market.

Theo acknowledges the defeat but encourages Flame in spite of it, showing him the terrain-based mechanics of TNT minecart combat and the importance of timing and feet placement. Flame picks up the style quickly, impressing Theo. He also shows off the alternative yet more destructive method of crossbow cart combat.

After they finish basic training, Theo urges Flame to put his new skills to the test in combat and avenge his defeat to G0dOfWar. Flame and Theo part ways soon after.

Possibly after or even before FlameFrags had his duel with TheG0dofWar, Theo fought 
The_Oroboros
 in a very heated duel. Theo used his TNT Minecarts to their fullest potential and it let him kill a dangerous commander of The Law.  Following this, G0d0fWar and SargeLaw turned up and detained Theo under LettuceK's orders. Theo is now being used as a hostage, possibly in the same prison as 
Jaden MAN
, another prisoner captured by the law.

title: This Button Destroys the World
content:
This Button Destroys the World














Season


1






Episode


2






Upload date


Apr 27, 2024






POV


ParrotX2






Arcs


The Exploit Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


Wemmbu
Roshambogames
Fantst
JumperWho
Derapchu














I don't know why 
he
 pressed the button, and I don't know what they're hiding from me. All I know is that my only option is to save the rest of the world from the button... because This Button Destroys the World.





This Button Destroys the World
 is the second episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
 and the first episode released by 
Parrot
. 



Plot


The episode starts with 
ParrotX2
 entering his own base to encounter 
Wemmbu
, who claims to have something greatly interesting. Seeing Parrot's confusion, Wemmbu prompts him to follow.

Parrot flies behind Wemmbu until they reach a large crater in the ground. Wemmbu claims that he wasn't responsible for the destruction, and that it was a test site for an 
orbital cannon
—a weapon that can destroy any location at a whim. Together, Parrot and Wemmbu deduce that the cannon must belong to 
SpokeIsHere
, as he'd seen Wemmbu build one before, but they don't understand why Spoke did it. 

They decide to check 
The Wonders
. Although Parrot doesn't know who built The Wonders and why, he assumes that they would be the only builds worthy of being targeted by Spoke. 

Along with Wemmbu, Parrot returns to his base to brainstorm a plan to stop Spoke. However, they get interrupted by 
Roshambogames
 who informs them that the server is lagging and that the Wonder he'd been guarding had been nuked by a giant mass of TNT. Roshambo leads them to the Wonder and shows them the destruction. Wemmbu confirms that it's the work of an orbital cannon, and proceeds to explain to Roshambo what that is. Parrot discovers a netherrack room beneath the destroyed monument. He asks Wemmbu what his thoughts are about it, but Wemmbu dismisses it and says it's probably useless.

Parrot  realizes that if nobody will try to stop 
The Wonders
 from getting destroyed, he'll have no choice but to protect them himself. To do that, though, he needs to build an orbital cannon of his own, but he has no idea how. He decides to start practicing with small machines until he can understand how to build an orbital cannon. While flying over a Wonder, he spots Roshambo. Parrot  asks Roshambo about the netherrack box beneath his Wonder, but Roshambo says he's never seen one. Confused, Parrot returns to his attempt at a TNT machine, only to discover that it had been griefed with obsidian.

Later, Parrot calls Wemmbu to show him his machine and ask for help. Wemmbu sees the machine and claims that it won't do any damage at all, but when Parrot activates it, it launches both of them into the air. After the initial explosion, the machine continues to detonate multiple rounds of TNT until Parrot manually breaks it. He  complains to Wemmbu that he'd previously created a cannon that got destroyed, but Wemmbu laughs and suggests that Parrot had probably done it by himself on accident. 

Wemmbu  leaves, but Parrot is certain that his redstone had been ruined by another player. He wonders why Wemmbu tried to cover that up, and why, despite knowing how to, he wasn't assisting Parrot in building the orbital cannon.

Parrot spots Wemmbu talking to Roshambo at the 
Marshland Mansion
 and decides to listen in on their conversation. They seem to be talking about illegal items, and about offering them to other players. Roshambo talks about how he needs the items because he has nothing left, and that the others probably don't, but Wemmbu reassures that it'll become the same for them. Wemmbu  expresses his concerns about Parrot catching on to their plans. He advises Roshambo to stop destroying Parrot's builds and tells him to be more subtle about the distractions. Finally, Roshambo says something about trying to get the others on their side. Wemmbu leaves, and Parrot follows him.

Wemmbu flies toward his base at spawn, and due to being distracted by a skeleton, Parrot loses him. He enters the base and calls out to Wemmbu, but is met with no reply, so he leaves.

Parrot continues his attempts at building cannons, and a while later, Wemmbu comes back to check on him. Parrot explains that he thinks building an orbital cannon requires power and precision, but Wemmbu says that he doesn't get what Parrot means. Parrot demonstrates his latest machine on an iron golem, and it ends up successfully killing it, but the server experiences a lag spike. The two players fly back to spawn and Parrot tries to celebrate his achievement, only for Wemmbu to criticize how it lagged the server. Parrot is confused and he claims that he's tested the machine multiple times without it lagging. Wemmbu realizes that Parrot's machine isn't supposed to lag and flies off.

Wemmbu leads Parrot to a Wonder, 
The Crone
, and discovers that it's been blown up. The guard, 
Fantst
, explains that a ball of TNT appeared and destroyed it. While Fantst complains about his loss, Parrot observes various redstone components within the debris and asks him about them. Fantst says he doesn't know anything, and Wemmbu suggests that it might be the remnants of a cobblestone duper. Parrot argues that cobble dupers don't appear like that. He asks about what their plan is now, but Wemmbu leaves. After confirming that Fantst truly has no clue about the redstone, Parrot attempts to follow Wemmbu. He spots Wemmbu entering his base at spawn, but when Parrot goes in to look for him, he isn't there.

A while later, Parrot calls Wemmbu to show him another cannon. It's able to fire TNT at specific locations according to which button is pressed on the machine. Wemmbu messes around with it before agreeing that it's cool. He asks Parrot why he's testing the machine on the ocean instead of on land, to which Parrot responds that he's not interested in destroying things. Parrot asks who built The Wonders and accuses Wemmbu of lying when he says he doesn't know. Wemmbu and Parrot have an argument about it. When Parrot states that Wemmbu can build an orbital cannon but refuses to help, Wemmbu reveals that he's only interested in knowing where Spoke's cannon is, but refuses to tell Parrot why. Wemmbu asks Parrot where Spoke is, but Parrot doesn't know. He claims that he does, however, have notes on how to find Spoke's orbital cannon and says that he's kept the notes in the 
Frosted Palace
. Wemmbu leaves in pursuit of the book containing the notes.

With him busy, Parrot decides to check Wemmbu's base once more. He reaches it, and after some searching, finds a hidden lever that opens a secret passageway. Parrot drops down and follows a very long tunnel to a 3 x 3 iron door with a button next to it. Parrot contemplates pressing the button, but decides against it as he thinks Wemmbu will catch him. He flies out of Wemmbu's house.

Parrot returns to the last cannon that he'd made, and finds Wemmbu using it. When Wemmbu sees him, he asks Parrot where he's been and why the notes weren't in the monument. Parrot apologizes and says they were in his base and he went to grab them. Wemmbu asks Parrot for them, and Parrot replies by asking why Wemmbu wants them anyway. Wemmbu says that he just wants to destroy Spoke's cannon, and he and Parrot bicker for some time. Finally, Wemmbu asks him how to find Spoke's cannon, with or without notes, and Parrot claims that they have to use the lag. Seeing Wemmbu's confusion, Parrot explains that they can use the velocity of the TNT and the time to calculate the distance from Spoke's cannon. Wemmbu agrees with the idea. Parrot realizes that even if they destroy Spoke's orbital cannon, only two of The Wonders will remain standing at best. He tells Wemmbu that he is ready to build the orbital cannon and asks him for help. Wemmbu questions why Parrot even wants to build one, and Parrot says that he wants to blow up Spoke's, but Wemmbu says it's a bad idea to blow up that location. Parrot leaves.

He still doesn't know why Spoke is destroying The Wonders, and he doesn't know what Wemmbu is hiding in his base. There's something about the server that he just doesn't understand, but there's only one thing he knows he can do. Parrot builds an orbital cannon.

Once Parrot has built the cannon, Wemmbu shows up and accuses Parrot of not knowing what he's doing. Parrot says that he does and when Wemmbu asks if Parrot even found Spoke's location, Parrot says that that's what he's waiting on. Wemmbu starts criticizing parts of Parrot's redstone, and Parrot asks why Wemmbu doesn't just build the cannon himself. Wemmbu says he doesn't understand why Parrot is so insistent on using an orbital cannon and says he's wasting time, but Parrot says that he's not wasting time if the machine works. Wemmbu claims that the cannon will blow itself up when activated, then proceeds to mess with it so that it does, and says that Parrot doesn't understand anything that's going on. Parrot states that Wemmbu used to guard a Wonder, to which Wemmbu says that he did until said Wonder got destroyed, so Parrot asks why Wemmbu doesn't care. Wemmbu explains that just because he guarded it doesn't mean he cares. Parrot says that blowing up Spoke's cannon is the only way to prevent him from destroying the other Wonders, and that he doesn't get why Wemmbu doesn't want that. In return, Wemmbu says he doesn't get why Parrot cares so much, but Parrot says that it's because nobody else is doing anything about it—not even Wemmbu, who used to be a guardian. Wemmbu says that he used to care until everything important in his monument got nuked, so Parrot reminds Wemmbu that he said at the beginning that The Wonders were pointless. Wemmbu says that they are, and Parrot leaves.

Wemmbu follows Parrot to another Wonder. Parrot gives Wemmbu one last chance to explain, but Wemmbu says he doesn't know what Parrot is talking about. Parrot states that there's something beneath every Monument and says he'll dig straight into the one they're standing on. However, before he can start digging, a mass of TNT appears and destroys it. Parrot and Wemmbu watch as the Wonder is blown up, and Wemmbu reminds Parrot that they can now pinpoint Spoke's location. They discover the coordinates and Wemmbu leaves. Parrot notices that there are redstone machines beneath the debris of the monument.

He realizes that the only way to find out what Wemmbu is hiding is to enter the secret room in his base. Parrot goes there and presses the button. He goes inside to discover one of the machines he'd once seen in the remains of a Wonder, along with that seem to be duped fireworks. While he's investigating, however, he hears Wemmbu and Roshambo coming into the room. Parrot hides in the weeping vines on the ceiling, eavesdropping on their conversation. Wemmbu says that Parrot is getting too close to properly finishing the orbital cannon, and that he needs Roshambo to take care of him—that Parrot's cannon mustn't be fired under any circumstances—and says he'll give Roshambo what he wants. Once Roshambo leaves, Parrot drops down, hits Wemmbu, and threatens to kill him. Upon realized that Wemmbu is more skilled than him, Parrot proceeds to interrogate him instead, but Wemmbu runs away.

Parrot flies after him and threatens to just keep chasing him, but Wemmbu claims that Parrot doesn't have enough rockets to get to where Wemmbu's headed. Parrot stops following Wemmbu, returns to his orbital cannon, and starts fixing it.

While he's working on the cannon, he gets interrupted by Roshambo who tells him to stop. Roshambo is followed by 
JumperWho
, 
Derapchu
, and Fantst. He says there's no reason to set the cannon off, but Parrot argues that he wants to save The Wonders. Roshambo explains that most of them at this point are gone, and firing the cannon will only perpetuate a cycle of destruction until everything else is gone, too. Parrot tells him that the cannon is set to fire in ten minutes, and Roshambo says either Parrot should prevent that or he'll prevent it himself. Parrot questions the other three guardians if they're on Roshambo's side, and they say that they are. When Parrot asks what he told them, Roshambo says that it doesn't matter. Parrot claims that Roshambo is being manipulated by Wemmbu, and Roshambo points out that Parrot is being manipulated by Spoke. Parrot disagrees and tells the other three about how he discovered a vault in Wemmbu's base with duped items. He prompts them to follow him to the base to prove that Roshambo and Wemmbu have been planning something. 

After accusing Parrot of trying to distract them, the group eventually follows him to Wemmbu's base. However, when he leads them into the base, he discovers that the door to the secret room is gone. Roshambo's group talk about how they now only have five minutes left to stop the cannon and start chasing Parrot as he tries to run away.

When Parrot stops, they start fighting him. He says that he doesn't understand what they're trying to accomplish before flying off once more. Parrot tries returning to his cannon and states that it's firing in twenty seconds. When he reaches it, however, he finds the machine being blown up. Roshambo says that Parrot should've listened. Parrot starts hitting him. Everybody starts fighting Parrot, but they all stop when they experience a lag.

The five of them fly to one of the last monuments to find it destroyed. Parrot tells Roshambo that it's his fault and that they could've destroyed Spoke's cannon and prevented it, but Roshambo chose to let it happen. Fantst states that there's still one Wonder left, and he asks Parrot if there's any way to prevent its destruction. Parrot claims that it's possible if Roshambo doesn't try stopping him, and Roshambo says that he won't. Parrot explains how he discovered that the orbital cannon, specifically Spoke's one, fires every six hours, but the loading chamber can be optimized to make it 25% faster, meaning that if they can gather all the materials in fifteen minutes and build the whole thing in an hour, they could destroy Spoke's cannon before the next time it fires. Everybody agrees to help, but Roshambo says he's not making any promises.

Roshambo and his teammates  bring Parrot all the materials in front of the final Wonder, and Parrot tasks them to construct a bunker using obsidian in front of the Wonder while he builds the cannon. Everyone gets to work. Parrot finishes the orbital cannon, and finally presses the button.

Parrot, Roshambo, Jumper, Derapchu, and Fantst enter the obsidian bunker and wait for four and a half hours until the cannon fires. The server experiences a lag, signalling that the cannon has fired, and they immediately try to dig out, but the server continues lagging for longer than it realistically should. 

Finally, when they get out, they discover that Spoke's and Parrot's orbital cannons have gone off at the same time. They all watch as the final Wonder is blown up. When Fantst says that they've lost, Parrot states that everyone has.
