title: This Player Stole My Identity
content:
This Player Stole My Identity














Season


2






Episode


52






Upload date


Oct 14, 2025






POV


Wemmbu






Arcs


The Fake Identity Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


ParrotX2
TheobaldTheBird
Fantst
















Why is this guy pretending to be me?





This Player Stole My Identity
 is the 79th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


The episode begins with 
Wemmbu
 and 
Fantst
 inside of a restaurant, having a casual conversation. 
LettuceK
, the leader of a team called 
The Law
 and a few of his members, arrive and accuse Wemmbu (as the invisible player) of stealing from 
Capital City
. Wemmbu attempts to defend himself to Lettuce by saying he doesn't need to steal, but Lettuce begins to pot up. Wemmbu escapes from the restaurant and loses the trail of his pursuers, successfully leaving 
Merchant City
.

Wemmbu returns to Capital City to figure out who's been impersonating him, traversing sneakily to avoid getting caught and makes a secret base near the front gate to observe players going in and out of the city to catch his impersonator. Soon, he spots an invisible player wearing his exact same armor and trims, prompting a confrontation. However, the impersonator insists that Wemmbu is impersonating them, not the other way around. The other invisible player has a totem in their offhand, and so Wemmbu uses that as his time to attack them to pop their totem to reveal their identity, not to kill them. The player takes the totem off so Wemmbu can't reveal their identity without revealing his own. The invisible player tells Wemmbu to "count his days" before trying to leave, but Wemmbu follows suit. The impersonator actives a hidden contraption that launches players up thousands of blocks in the air, and Wemmbu loses them in the sky.

Since there's only three players who know Wemmbu's true identity (his friend 
eggchan
, 
Boosfer
, and 
Jaden_MAN
), he goes to Egg in the End Dimension to get Boosfer's location to get leads on his impersonator. Egg tells Wemmbu that Boosfer is back at the mushroom island. When he gets there, he sees the impersonator had beaten him to Boosfer, and since Boosfer couldn't tell the two apart, he suggested them to undergo a set of trials to prove which invisible player is the real Wemmbu. The first trial is to make a one block neo, but both of them fails. When that doesn't work out, Boosfer assigns them to get them a coal block, Wemmbu refuses and the impersonator goes. This doesn't prove anyone's identity, and the impersonator tries to manipulate Boosfer to say something only the real Wemmbu would know. Fed up of the back-and-forth strut, Wemmbu tells Boosfer to stay quiet and attempts to pop the impersonator's totem. The impersonator runs out of the factory to "swap out", revealing a second impersonator named "Agent 22". The two team up on Wemmbu, and with no other choice, Wemmbu brings out his mace. The impersonators try to escape using a Happy Ghast, but Wemmbu flies up high to detect being seen, due to his cape and Elytra being purple. He drops down and kills the Happy Ghast, prompting one of the two impersonators to yell "SKY!" (indirectly revealing their identities). However, the two impersonators still manage to escape from Wemmbu.

Wemmbu goes back to the End DImension again to meet back up with Egg, this time to ask if there's an easier way to get to the 
Great Sea
 without having to wait for rain to travel with his Riptide Trident or go through the Nether. Egg tells Wemmbu that Jaden has teamed up with Capital City to make a dolphin highway to his Pirate Civilization, but before Wemmbu goes through the portal to return to the Overworld, Egg stops Wemmbu and tells him how one of the impersonators came through the End as well and mentioned a courtroom trial, which opens an opportunity for Wemmbu to pop their totem and reveal the impersonator's identity(s).

When Wemmbu arrives back in Capital City, he sees other invisible people with his same armor trims going to the courtroom, likely the trial Egg was talking about. When he walks in, there are dozens of invisible players with his same armor. The main impersonator speaks up, saying that they gathered all of the people here to uncover the identity of "The Invisible Knight." It was then revealed that this courtroom was a trap, as all of the invisible players get stasised out besides the main impersonator standing on the stage and Agent 22. The courtroom is boxed in a layer of obsidian and Elder Guardians are beneath, trapping the three inside and causing mining fatigue so Wemmbu can't mine out. The main impersonator boxes themselves in with glass while Agent 22 tries to kill Wemmbu. 

Wemmbu pops Agent 22's totem, revealing it to be 
TheobaldTheBird
. Wemmbu and Theo fight each other, but Theo accidentally carts and blows up the glass blocks encasing the other impersonator. Wemmbu immediately pops their totem, revealing the main impersonator to be 
ParrotX2
. Parrot and Theo try to devise a backup plan since 
FlameFrags
 failed to show up, and then chorus fruit out of the courtroom, leaving Wemmbu inside. Quickly hatching a plan, he retrieves Ender Pearls from his ender chest without them looking. Wemmbu tries to pearl glitch out of the obsidian, but to no avail. Parrot, catching onto Wemmbu's trick, traps Wemmbu in glass while he's in crawl mode. Because the courtroom is made out of wood, Wemmbu crafts a crafting table makes ladders, escaping successfully by pearl glitching out with the ladder.

The episode ends with Wemmbu and his dialogue:

"
The impersonator was named Parrot, one of the smartest players on the Unstable SMP. But I had no clue why he even cared about what I was doing, or what he meant by not having a choice to hunt me down. The only thing I know for certain was that this was not going to be the last time that I was going to be seeing Parrot.
"

No matter what you place, no matter what you try, no matter how far you run... nothing's going to work. I am a god. I am immortal.



TruOriginal
 to 
BAT
, in 
I Got Hunted by a Minecraft Hacker


TruOriginal
 was a minor antagonist featured in 
Unstable Universe
 during 
the Director Arc
.



History


TruOriginal first appeared as a mysterious "hacker" hired by 
The Director
 to eliminate 
Parrot
 and the 
Bounty Assassin Team
 (BAT). He was first encountered in a completely destroyed town, which he claimed to have leveled simply out of boredom. From the start, he demonstrated abilities far beyond a normal player, including teleportation, walking on water, and the ability to morph into other players to deceive his targets.

Throughout his hunt, he proved to be a nearly unstoppable force. During a confrontation in a flower field (owned by 
R4trick
 and 
F1nlo
), the team discovered his only notable weakness: Cobwebs, which managed to slow him down despite his hacks. However, TruOriginal's ego grew rapidly; he eventually proclaimed himself "way above The Director," abandoning his original orders to keep Parrot alive and instead attempting to kill the entire team for his own amusement.

In a desperate final stand at 
BAT Headquarters
, the team lured him into a false sense of security. While TruOriginal believed he had trapped them, 
Nufuli
 used a Mirror Receiver to trigger a maximum-power blast from the 
Orbital Strike Cannon
. TruOriginal was caught in the center of the explosion, which destroyed the base and presumably killed him. He was seen wielding a 
mace
, which was destroyed along with him in the blast.



Trivia


He was one of the few 
mace
 wielders.


TruOriginal's full list of powers was immense. Not only could he alter his speed to ludicrous values and fly, but he could take on the appearance of other players and create false duplicates of himself. He could also mine multiple blocks at a time and walk on water, and he was even able to slow down time and swap his location with that of another player. He was possessed of a "kill aura" and could instantly remove all of the items in a player's inventory when they hit him. Some of his dialogue hinted that he had a full list of hacks that he could modify at will.

content:

This article is unfinished or outdated by new episode info. You can help Unstable Universe Wiki by 
expanding it
.
Additional Notes: unfinished page


Unstable Events
 is the official Discord & Minecraft server for Unstable members to host events created in June 2025. The first event was hosted by 
SpokeIsHere
 for his Spoke Galactic Empire video. 



Info


The link to the Unstable Events Discord server is 
https://discord.gg/unstableevents
, and the server IP is UnstableEvents.net

There are a variety types of events in the Unstable Events such as: 



Mocap Events


Recording Events


Beta Testing


Plot Build Events


Thumbnail Events


Mocap Events


Mocap Events are events where players wander around a specific location in the server while getting recorded. They are often used for scenes used in the intros of a video. 



Recording Events


Recording Events are events hosted to get players into the actual videos and are actually canon to the Unstable SMP Lore. The first recording event was by 
SpokeIsHere
 for his 
Spoke Galactic Empire
 video.



Beta Testing


Beta Testing events are usually called by the admins (Horace, and Lukas) for a few players to test and debug the server. 



Plot Build Events


The Plot Build Events are in a seperate SMP (in the Unstable Events server) where players can build and their builds have a chance of actually getting in an Unstable video.



Thumbnail Events


Thumbnail Events are usually hosted to assist in making a thumbnail for an Unstable SMP video.   



Compatibility


In order to play on the Unstable Events server you must have:



Minecraft Java Edition (not a cracked version) 1.21.6-1.21.11+

Some events (usually beta testing events) support Java Edition 1.21.9 only.


Minecraft Bedrock Edition (the latest version supported by Geyser)


History


The Discord server was created in June 11, 2025. The server was made public in June 25, 2025 after they had finished the server.

title: Unstable SMP
content:
This article is about introduction to the server itself.  For the Youtube series featuring the server, see 
Unstable Universe
.




Unstable SMP
 is the server where 
Unstable Universe
 takes place.



Background and Characteristics


Unstable SMP is an explicitly scripted, anarchy, hardcore server.


The protagonists' personality are based on their 
Lifesteal
 S4–S5 counterpart, so you can view it as a Lifesteal spinoff.


Death message only show locally except for Mafia member teleportation to void death. Starting from 
Season 2
, death is accompanied by a sound effect.


Resources are severely limited, as mobs rarely spawn, villagers and ominous vaults have been destroyed since 
The Invisible Mafia
, and netherite and potions was monopolized by 
Nether Civilization
 lead by 
ClownPierce
.


Brief History


The three protagonist set their bases at spawn, fought over exploit items and 
The Wonders
 builds. 
PrinceZam
 created an 
empire
 but later betrayed 
Wemmbu
, leading to the empire's downfall. 
The Invisible Mafia
 took over the server including spawn, and hunted players to every corner of the world, so the three protagonist form 
ally
 to destroy it.

Parrot
 was hunted by an invisible player called 
the Director
, which turned out to be someone he was more than familiar with. Wemmbu and 
Flame
 fought each other multiple times. Wemmbu went to 
Far Lands
, came back with 
Orbital Strike Cannons
 to sweep across the server. 
Spoke
 ran into issue with 
Bounty Assassin Team
 despite the latter saved him from a disastrous 
civilization
 creation attempt. 
The Law
 led by 
LettuceK
 tried to take over the server. Protagonists were forced to unite and fight it again. Parrot vied for the king of the server and tried hard to assume the responsibility. Flame became a combat master.

Spoke and 
Mapicc
 were hunted and captured by a group called 
Null Hunters
. Wemmbu and 
Eggchan
 were hunted by an 
Invisible Guy
. Parrot's Kingdom was under threat by 
old players
.



Overall Map


Main page: 
Map:Unstable Landmark Map


Main page: 
Map:Unstable Farlands landmark Map























Unknown but important: 
The Forge




Lore


The server starts years earlier than the 1st episode, so there is 
First Generation Players
 that might have created the terrain in the 
Far Lands
.

The server might have reference to 2b2t, the largest anarchy server. The lava cast filled, chaotic spawn in 
Season 2
, the great sea, the glitches and the admin behind the server all have similar appearance on 2b2t. 2b2t started from early Minecraft versions (which give rise to the great sea on it) and later upgrade to modern versions, so the same may hold for Unstable SMP, hence the existence of so many weird terrain, 
Far Lands
, and a lot of glitches that can be exploited.


The server contains exploit that are unique to it.


The server contains terrains that are not found on other servers: 
Great Sea
, 
The Amplified
, 
The Mist
, 
Far Lands
, 
The Underworld
, 
Skyblock Civilization
, ... They are generally built by 
Horace_Altman
 builder team behind the scenes.


The server may have admins unknown to us.


Unspoken Rules


No /msg, discord, or group voice chat allowed since 
Season 2
. Only way to communicate is proximity chat.


No logging off allowed (immersed storyline)


No chunkban allowed since Season 2.


No hacking allowed except for 
TruOriginal
.


Beds, respawn anchors and end crystals exist (in limited amount, as all require mob resources to be renewable) but cannot be used as explosives or in PvP.


Trivia


Unstable SMP is actually filmed on multiple servers instead of one server.


The hardcore hearts seen in the videos are texture pack. Deathban functions as hardcore.

title: Unstable SMP: After The Mafia
content:
Unstable SMP: After The Mafia














Episode


28






Upload date


Feb 2, 2025






POV


Wemmbu






Arcs


The Pirate Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


eggchan
TheobaldTheBird
Kenadian














wemmbu
 and 
egg
 try to have a 2 week minecraft phase





Unstable SMP: After The Mafia
 is the 28th episode featured 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


Wemmbu
 and 
Eggchan
 try to begin a new life, away from fighting. After defeating the Mafia, they run millions of blocks away to a Pale Garden biome and begin to make a house, the first real base that they've had since Mane's tree. While designing their new home, they get interrupted by 
TheobaldTheBird
. He has followed them and is looking for a fight. Theo says that he knows Wemmbu is a good enough player to give him an entertaining fight, but Wemmbu is too stubborn to give him what he wants. 

Theo begins destroying their base and says he'll give Wemmbu some time to prepare for when he returns. Wemmbu and Eggchan prepare for this by making a creaking trap that they intend to drop Theo into. However, their trap doesn't work, and when Theo returns, he griefs their base again. Tired of this and not wanting to give into Theo's wishes, Wemmbu sets out to find 
Kenadian
 to commission him to make their base secure. At first, Kenadian was scared but eventually he does end up helping Wemmbu. He explains what Wemmbu and Eggchan need to do to secure their base. Theo interrupts them again. Wemmbu tells Theo that if he wants to fight him, he has to let them build the defenses and Theo has to break into the base. Theo tells Wemmbu that he will come back in a week.

Wemmbu and Eggchan begin making their defenses. They finish making the defenses and they're confident that Theo won't break in. Theo returns and begins trying to break in. Wemmbu watches Theo while being invisible. Wemmbu realizes that his break in attempt might end up successful, so he sabotages him by griefing the tunnel. Wemmbu steals some of his shulkers and taunts Theo. He successfully breaks into the base and activates both Wemmbu and Egg's stasises. Wemmbu is still too stubborn to fight so Theo takes Kenadian hostage and threatens to kill him unless they fight. Wemmbu takes the 1v1. Theo gets annoyed by the creakings and he leaves the base with Kenadian. Theo tells Wemmbu that if he doesn't fight him outside the base he will kill Kenadian. Wemmbu leaves the base and asks Theo about Kenadian. Theo tells Wemmbu that he killed him and later tells him that he let him go. Wemmbu takes the fight and ends up winning the fight against Theo. Theo leaves, telling Wemmbu that it was worth it.



Trivia


This video's original title was "I Created Minecraft's Most Secure Base" however, Wemmbu changed the title.


Before seasons were abolished, this was the first episode of Season 2.


The video's thumnail was updated sometime in April 2026, this is the fourth thumbnail where Wemmbu's cape can be shown.

The new thumbnail further proves that Wemmbu was willing to settle down and give up PvPing if it weren't for Theo.

 invading the

 civilization. After the Far Lands civilization gets destroyed by the The Mafia, Parrot, Wifies and the people are determined to defeat The Mafia. All the remaining citizens of the civilization were either hiding, dead, or joined The Mafia. Before this, Parrot had tried to get everyone they could to join them by lighting beacons but no one showed up.

Horace builds 
a bunker
 that's closer to spawn named 
District 13
 and Parrot invites 
rekrap2
, 
JumperWho
, 
Ratrick
, and others to join District 13 however while they were inviting Ratrick and Finiahn to join, Wifies places beacons and The Mafia starts attacking them. Wifies states that they're losing. After defeating the invisible players Ratrick and Finiahn join District 13. Parrot and Wifies check up on the beacons they lit before The Mafia destroyed the Far Lands however, they were destroyed. 
Kenadian
 invites 
Derapchu
 to District 13. Horace gives everyone them a tour around the base and after finishing the tour, he joins The Mafia. Horace's reason for joining The Mafia is because they let him build without letting anything get destroyed, he can see his friends again and finally, he was tired of everything he built for Parrot getting destroyed by The Mafia.

Parrot, Wifies and 
TheobaldTheBird
 infiltrate 
Mafia City
 to attempt to kill 
Ash
 until 
ClownPierce
 appears. Parrot points an arrow at Ash but he teleports away before Parrot shoots leaving Clown with no choice but to attempt to kill them. Clown uses his mace to try to mace him and for breach swapping. Theo uses carts to try to kill Clown. Upon near death they run away and return to District 13 until they notice a new member named Yusai join. Yusai is a new member hence why he doesn't have any armour. Parrot gives him 23 iron and he crafts a full set of iron armour (24 iron is required to make a full set or iron armour). Parrot kills Yusai thinking that he is affiliated with The Mafia.

Parrot and Wifies then check out 
Spawn
 until they notice members of The Mafia destroying it and constructing an obsidian box. They also find 
Spoke
 and 
Mapicc
 who were also checking out spawn. Parrot and Wifies then run away but Spoke and Mapicc chase after them to ask them if they know what the Mafia is and Parrot and Wifies tell them they do. Spoke then reveal to Parrot and Wifies that he infiltrated the Mafia and he was on a 
mission to try to kill Parrot, Wifies and Dean while they were in a trial chamber
. Spoke mentions Ash's desire board and while they list the civilizations in the board they try to figure out what The Withered is. Spoke mentions that he was on a mission to kill 
iMajesticRose
 and assumes that the house that she built with 
BeckyTronVIII
 was The Withered so they go to the house only to find a 
diamond player
 destroying the house. 

They follow the diamond player and eventually they find a town and a guy with full iron armour. Parrot, Wifies, Spoke and Mapicc intimidate him and he says that he already gave The Mafia everything he had. Spoke asks Quackenstein if he knows what the Mafia is but he lies to them and says that he doesn't. Quackenstein then tours them around his town and they notice a grave that they made for Rose. Parrot and Mapicc confront Spoke about the Rose's death. Mapicc states that they have a connection to the Mafia because why would Ash just want her dead. Parrot and Wifies leave to let Spoke and Mapicc deal with everything. Wifies claims that Quackenstein is the diamond player because they followed the diamond player just to find him. 

After waiting for a long time, Spoke tells Parrot and Wifies that he found a book that may potentially lead to the stasis chamber named "Mafia Eyes" and is signed by Ash and because of this Parrot invites him and Mapicc to District 13 and tells them the news. They begin partying now that that they have hope that The Mafia is going to end until Spoke gives them a book named "The Gateway". The book only contains greater than (<) and less than (>) signs. No one knew what the signs meant and Spoke thought someone there would. Spoke and Mapicc argue with the rest of District 13 over the book and they get kicked out of District 13 for spreading "false hope", everyone except for Wifies leaves District 13 due to minimal progress with some of them even joining The Mafia.

Parrot finds 
ManePear
's destroyed base and finds 
Wemmbu
 and 
Eggchan
. Parrot asks Wemmbu if The Mafia was responsible for destroying his base, Wemmbu responds saying that Clown was responsible. Parrot tells Wemmbu to join District 13 to fight back against The Mafia and ClownPierce. Wemmbu tells Parrot that he's only joining District 13 to kill Clown. Parrot invites Wemmbu to the District 13 and tells Wemmbu that he needs him to distract ClownPierce because he wants to kill Ash. Wemmbu then tells him he needs a mace to do so, because of this they make a trap and light a beacon to bait Mafia members into showing up. They get jumped by a bunch of Mafia members and the diamond player and after killing all of them except for the diamond player, they trigger the trap and the diamond player falls into their trap. They kill the diamond player after a while. Upon returning to District 13, Wemmbu abandons them, telling them that he doesn't need them anymore now that he has a mace. He tells Eggchan he will return to take him after he kills clown. 

Parrot and Wifies infiltrate Mafia City again. They fly to each rank's towns and pretend to be the trim the town is based off of. They eventually reach Ash's castle and they find Ash and a 
copper player
 in the castle. Ash notices that the "diamond players" aren't holding their maces. Parrot tells Wifies to kill Ash and he points an arrow at him again. Ash tells Parrot that if he kills him, everyone in The Mafia is going to die including Ratrick, 
Kenadian
, 
Wato
, etc. Parrot tells Wifies to try to kill Ash again. Ash tells Parrot that your morals make you weak and they arent the first people to try to kill him and he's sick of it. He tells them that if they don't join The Mafia in 24 hours he will kill both of them before Parrot and Wifies leave Ash's castle. As Parrot and Wifies leave Mafia City they find Ratrick and Finiahn with copper eye trimmed chestplate. They ask Parrot and Wifies if they joined The Mafia but Parrot responds telling them that they tried to kill Ash. Ratrick and Finiahn tell Parrot and Wifies that they drowned someone's cat and threaten to kill them if they try to save it because they were messing with The Mafia. Parrot gets disappointed in them and runs away.

Parrot and Wifies run 1 million blocks away from Mafia City to a snow biome and they build a house. While building the house, Wifies then tells Parrot to tame a dog and they also make traps. After a while, they finish the house and all the traps. Ash finds them and leaves them a sign that says "found you" indicating that he found them. Parrot breaks the sign and they start to panic. Ash and a diamond player overhear their conversation and ring a bell 12 times since Wifies mentioned that it's been 12 hours since they ran away. Parrot spots them but because of the snow he can barely see them and they get away. They try to move on from the incident when they Parrot and Wifies have a conversation about why Wifies cares about the beacon so much. Wifies explains that it's more than just making a point and call for help but instead it's a sign that there are people willing to fight The Mafia and the beacons are the opposite of The Mafia wearing invisibility. He tells them that the beacon is a sign that people don't have to live kneeling anymore. Parrot tells Wifies that everyone is now either in The Mafia or hiding which isn't enough to take down The Mafia and then also tells Wifies that anyone who joins The Mafia is evil because they killed Dean and Luigi. Wifies denies that stating that the majority of people who are forced into joining or else they will be killed. Wifies tells Parrot to keep lighting beacons because they haven't lost. 

Upon returning to their house Ash and a diamond player appear and Parrot tries to kill him once again. Ash tells Parrot that he is done with Parrot trying to kill him and gives both him and Wifies an invisibility potion and forces them to join The Mafia within 10 minutes. Wifies tells Parrot that he is going to join the Mafia so that Parrot gets time and he gets more information about The Mafia. After joining The Mafia Ash taunts Parrot by stating that The Mafia is going to take over the server and tells the diamond player to get his squadron and hunt Parrot down if he doesn't return.  

After Parrot returns to District 13 Spoke and Parrot discuss about how they can use the spawn prison to find the stasis chamber. After they make it to the spawn prison they realize its not a small obsidian box anymore. They plan to break in to the prison using an end portal while Wemmbu and Eggchan distract the guards from above. Parrot, Spoke and Mapicc go to the end and into the spawn prison. They pretend to be guards in the prison until they find Wato and Kenadian in the spawn prison. Kenadian leaves to fix the spawn prison entrance while Wato leads them to the place where new players throw their pearls.  

They follow where the pearls would be thrown and find sandstone halls. While exploring the sandstone halls, Parrot, Spoke and Mapicc spy on a diamond player transporting the pearls. They get caught and they run away from the invisible players. After Parrot loses them, they split up. Parrot finds 
a guard
 transporting pearls and he forces the guard to unmute, the guard tells him that that he's transporting pearls because he was told by The Mafia. Parrot tells the guard to take him to where he's supposed to bring the pearls. Parrot doesn't believe him much so he tries to kill him again. The guard tells Parrot that the place he lead him to was where he was supposed transport the pearls to and that he doesn't get anything from doing it. Parrot asks the guard why he joined the server. The guard tells Parrot that he thought it would be a cool server to join but so far it hasn't been for him because all he has done was transporting pearls, he never even entered the nether. Parrot tells him that he's helping a force of evil by transporting despite the guard not knowing what they have done. Parrot tells him that 
Dean
, one of his best friends 
was killed by The Mafia
. He asks the guard what type of Mafia member is he if he hasn't destroyed anything or ruin others' lives. The guard responds telling him that he's just a player. Parrot then tells him that he cannot kill him and walks away. 

Parrot then finds Wemmbu and Wato and they get out of the halls. Parrot tells them he's going to stop by a different location. After Parrot arrives to the house that he and Wifies made, Parrot is confused on why Wifies isn't responding to him until Ash shows up and starts taunting Parrot. Parrot tells Ash that him using Wifies' stasis chamber as leverage is pathetic. Ash responds telling him that the only way the server can thrive is if everyone is unified under one cause and Wifies understands that hence why he left him if it even is Wifies. He then continues to taunt Parrot before forcing him to splash invisibility again. Wifies shakes his head telling Parrot not to. Parrot tells Ash that he would never join The Mafia, Ash then pulls Wifies' stasis and kills him. Ash asks Parrot why he thinks The Mafia wears invisibility just like when he told Parrot where the Far Lands civilization was, Parrot replies calling him a coward which angers Ash. Ash calls Parrot wasted potential before ordering the diamond player to kill him. Parrot gets jumped by the diamond player and he barely managed to trap him using the mines he had set with Wifies earlier. 

Parrot returns to District 13 and tells everyone that Wifies got killed by Ash but Spoke tells Parrot that he found the stasis chamber and the book with "<" and ">" signs was actually the map that leads to the stasis chamber. Parrot tells Spoke to mine the soul sand that each stasis pearl join. However, they get unexpectedly jumped by The Mafia. They killed the diamond player and every other Mafia member in the fight, successfully winning the fight. Parrot tells Spoke to mine the stasis chamber because he has a plan.  

Parrot arrives to the 
Far Lands
 civilization after The Battle of Stasis one last time to light a beacon. Before he lights the beacon he gets reminded of his conversation with Wifies regarding the beacons. Parrot starts lighting beacons all over the server and Mafia members start drinking milk. The guard transporting the pearls also surfaces and drinks milk, removing his invisibility. Parrot and Wifies have one last talk, Wifies tells Parrot not to die due to his tendency of doing stupid things without any proper planning leading to near death moments. Parrot thanks Wifies for being his friend and Wifies fades away.

Spoke visits Parrot's house and tells him that watching all the Mafia members drinking milk and getting rid of their invisibility was a beautiful moment, Parrot asks him if Ash is dead. Spoke tells him that he isn't dead and tells him where Ash lives. Parrot goes into the farlands to visit Ash. He tells Ash that he forgives him for all the people he killed including Wifies. Ash responds telling Parrot that he didn't kill WIfies and that there's an extremely powerful player who never revealed themselves but they call themselves "
The Director
". He says that The Director was responsibly for killing Wifies and he called Parrot pathetic for thinking that he will kill The Director. Parrot leaves the farlands not believing Ash.

title: Unstable SMP: The Battle for The Great Sea
content:
Unstable SMP: The Battle for The Great Sea














Episode


101






Upload date


Dec 26, 2025






POV


Wemmbu






Arcs


The Kings Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


Jaden_MAN
LettuceK
















the law doesn't cover the great sea





Unstable SMP: The Battle for The Great Sea
 is the 101st episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


The Law
 has finished building their orbital strike cannon, but it would take hours to wipe out Pirate City, so 
Wemmbu
, 
eggchan
, 
Jaden
 and his 
pirates
 head towards the island where the cannon is built to destroy it. The pirates head up onto the island first, Wemmbu tells egg to back up as the first layer of defense burns down, an orbital strike lands right in between the two factions and kills a dozen players. Egg scouts out and says to jump in once all of The Law's traps get set off. Wemmbu's objective is to destroy the cannon, not needing to fight, there are too many of them to kill off, and it didn't help that they used slow falling to prevent him from using the mace. Wemmbu realizes most of the pirates were dead and he was the Pirate's only hopes of surviving. He flies towards the cannon but is maced out of the air by 
LettuceK
, they both drop down and Lettuce says he's close to stopping Wemmbu and calls his group of allies, 
Deputy_Ace
, 
the_Ouroboros
, 
TheG0dOfWar
, and 
SargeLAW
. Wemmbu threatens to mace all of them and pots up, all of them seem to back up from Wemmbu, as he's about to head into the fight, Lettuce activates a machine that sends a massive amount of Breezes, launching him millions of blocks out. Wemmbu shields the attack and hits an island with a watchtower, stopping his momentum.

Wemmbu explores the tower and finds a book that talks about islands and civilizatiosn all around the 
Great Sea
, he finds a map that tells him where the tower is and where the hidden 
Atlantis
 treasure is, so he boats towards the direction of it. He finds the hidden treasure that was unlooted by 
Parrot
, but none of it would help him traverse the Great Sea. Wemmbu rereads the book and discovers that there's a layer underneath the temple, he finds the hidden door and opens it, he swims down under and meets two players that live there and asks for a riptide trident. They say they need theirs in order to move around, Wemmbu sounds impatient and thought about killing them for their tridents, but is reminded of the rare item collector and decides not to kill them for it. The two ask Wemmbu to help kill off the elder guardians that protected the temple so they could build again, Wemmbu agrees to if that meant he'd get a trident, so he goes up and digs the floor of the temple and kills all of the elder guardians, mending his Elytra and maces in the process. He goes down and asks for any gear and the trident, they give him a turtle helmet and says they got their trident a long time ago. They mention somebody named old man Linn who would give him a trident, they give Wemmbu the general direction of the island, and so Wemmbu sails off.

Wemmbu arrives at a massive island with big wizard-like towers, he goes to the main tower and finds a player named 
Linnwyrm
, the player that the two were talking about. Wemmbu asks for a trident and Linn asks what's it to him, so Wemmbu describes his situation and mentions the book. Linn asks to see it and Wemmbu gives it. Linn says that he wrote the book himself and lost it, he says because Wemmbu returned the book back to him and sees how Wemmbu didn't kill the builders for their tridents, he gives Wemmbu his own trident in return, he then takes Wemmbu to his armory to regear for battle. Wemmbu takes some resources, the netherite sets and puts trims on one before heading back.

Wemmbu makes it back to the original island, seeing The Law had completely revamped it and made a huge base to protect the cannon. He kills some of the lawmen that spotted him and attempts to dig into the base while having mining fatigue and Deputy_Ace attacks him before he could break the first block. A fight breaks out between Wemmbu and The Law, Deputy_Ace mentions how Jaden surrendered to The Law. Lettuce and his group arrive, Lettuce says that the Pirates are gone and there's nothing to fight for, so Wemmbu tries to prove it by popping a totem which clears all effects and breaks into the first layer of the base. He's unable to do anything while three people are attacking him at once, so he breaks out and riptides and flies back to Pirate City. Back at Pirate City, it seems to be deserted, he looks around for players and sees players huddled up in front of the main tower. Egg and the few remaining pirates are there, Wemmbu asks what happened to the city and egg explains that Jaden got captured and the rest had to retreat. Egg tells Wemmbu to lead the rest of them and how they were thinking about building their own TNT cannon to destroy it. Wemmbu gives his idea of sneaking in to find Jaden and destroy the cannon while the Pirates distracted the lawmen guards.

They boat towards the island, Wemmbu and egg use their invis potion and swim towards the island. Wemmbu tries breaking through the walls, but gets struck with mining fatigue, as well as the inner layer of the walls being built with obsidian. With no other way to dig through, Wemmbu gives egg wind charges and the two make it over the watchpoint. Wemmbu digs underneath the main base and hears Deputy_Ace mention that the cannon is done in ten minutes, so they have to commence the attack immediately. Wemmbu kills a Law guard, signaling for the Pirates to come in and distract. Wemmbu and egg try to stealthily sneak in, but the_Oroboros spots them and attacks, Wemmbu blocks egg in obsidian to break into the base without getting attacked, which failed. Wemmbu tries to tell egg to go inside of the base, but the entrance gets blocked off. both of them get their armor durability drained, sand so they head out of the base and onto the shore, egg says Linn is there to hand over items to Wemmbu and holds The Law off in the meantime. Linn gives Wemmbu a new set of netherite armor and advises Wemmbu to use the spear, Wemmbu asks Linn to help fight, but Linn declines due to him being a pacifist. Wemmbu crafts the spear and impales the lawmen. More troops start coming from the distance, Wemmbu uses both the spear and his mace to kill off the lawmen, he runs out of rockets which turned the outcome of the fight. It begins to rain shortly after, and Wemmbu riptides back towards the base and spears off tons of lawmen guards protecting the entrance of the base. He opens up a door using a key and tries to lock himself in to find the cannon, but the lawmen manages to barge in, so Wemmbu flies out and goes back to egg. Egg tells Wemmbu to place the TNT minecart, but Wemmbu lost the rails, so they craft some quickly. They detonate the TNT minecart, exposing the cannon, they break a few components of the cannon and it blows itself up, then leave quickly after. Lettuce asks Deputy_Ace why he didn't set off the cannon, Deputy_Ace stares at Wemmbu while he escapes, not attempting to fight back.

Wemmbu and egg head back to Pirate City, they realize that they're the only ones left and agree to leave Pirate City in order to keep it alive. They then head back to the Farlands to replenish Wemmbu's strikes. 



Trivia


This is the second time the spear has been shown in an Unstable video, but first to show the spear in action.

Although the spear has officially been added into the game, a mod was still used to add spears for the video


The orbital strike cannon is one of cubicmetre's designs, but was modified to work differently on Unstable.


This is the first time Wemmbu isn't holding a mace in the thumbnail since 
I Explored an Abandoned Minecraft Civilization
.

Unstable SMP: The Eggchan Empire
 is the 30th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


The episode begins with 
Wemmbu
 and 
Eggchan
 flattening the land of ManePear's abandoned treehouse to build their empire. Eggchan explains to Wemmbu that a success factor for an empire is that their leader has to be able to provide resources for everyone. After some brainstorming, Wemmbu tells Eggchan that he will provide experience bottles for his citizens, however, he has to look for them since all the villagers are dead. Wemmbu begins exploring the server to find experience bottles. Wemmbu threatens players in posession of experience bottles. He begins looting abandoned stashes for experience bottles too. On his journey of aquiring experience bottes, he runs into a player named 
Spongs
, who attacks them after Wemmbu steals his experience bottles. Spongs gives Wemmbu the remaining experience he has.   

After returning to the empire, Wemmbu and Eggchan stash the experience bottles in shulker boxes and they work on sugar cane and gunpower farms for firework rockets. While working on the farms, they get robbed and attacked by players with pirate shields. The player who Wemmbu had robbed earlier confronts him and tells him that he wont win the fight as he is outnumbered. Wemmbu kills them using his mace and the player who had confronted him had escaped but he was so focused on killing them that by the time he was finished, his items had despawned and Wemmbu had used up some of his experience bottles.   

Wemmbu recruits his first citizen, 
Wato1876
. Wato gets irritated by Wemmbu but after some convincing, he joins the civilization. Wato's first task is to remove the remains of ManePear's treehouse. Eggchan tells Wemmbu that they have no experience bottles left and Wemmbu has to go somewhere to get some. They tell Wato that they are going to leave. They continue exploring the server to loot abandoned bases and civilizations. They find a strangely generated forest and the explore it. An invisible player attacks them and it is later revealed to be 
Pangi
. Pangi tells them that he is guarding the house and it belongs to 
PrinceZam
 and he retired in this house after leaving 
the prison
. Pangi allows Wemmbu and Eggchan to take the experience but since they don't have shulker boxes, they return to the empire and get Wato to do it for them. Wemmbu and Eggchan continue improving their civilization to recruit more players. Wemmbu recruits 
Arcn
 to defend the civilization and 
Dione4k
 from his old civilization to make firework rockets for him.    

Wato returns with no items and he gets pissed about getting robbed on his way and he lost all the experience. Wato also explains that his entire ender chest was cleared and he was robbed by players with pirate shields. Wemmbu begins searching the server for any pirate base. After a week of searching, he finds the pirates in Spongs' base. 
Jaden_MAN
, who is the leader of the pirates attempts to rob Wemmbu and they begin fighting. During their fight, Spongs begs Wemmbu to help him as he is stuck in a cage with no food. Wemmbu helps Spongs and kills one of the pirates but he loses Jaden_MAN and the rest of the pirates. Wemmbu confronts Spongs regarding a stash since they were trying to rob him from his stash. Spongs shows Wemmbu where the stash of experience bottles are after he threatens to blow up his house. Wemmbu takes some experience and returns to the empire.      

As Wemmbu explores the empire, he notices a lot of improvements and a tower built by 
Horace Altman
 with Eggchan's eyeball. Wemmbu heads to the Eggchan tower to talk to him about the experience they owed Arcn, Horace and Wato. During their conversation, Eggchan tells Wemmbu that Wato found a pirate base and Wemmbu enters the base to try to retrieve the stolen items. As Wemmbu fights 
Loppezz
 and her army, he runs out of firework rockets and his elytra is low on durability. Wemmbu steals materials from their base and creates firework rockets and he uses some experience to mend his elytra. Wemmbu eventually runs out of experience and he uses spare armour after his gear runs out of durability. The spare gear begins to break and Wemmbu begins using iron armour and he runs out of rockets again. Wemmbu begins digging straight down to escape Loppezz and since she doesn't have a pickaxe, she gives up. Wemmbu finds a spawner and uses it to fully repair his armour. He robs their base to find more sugar canes and makes rockets again. He also spawns withers to destroy the base. Loppezz runs away as her army is dead and Wemmbu finds the experience and returns it to Eggchan.      

During the next few weeks, they begin expanding the empire, recruiting new citizens and setting up raiding parties to get richer. Eggchan sends Wemmbu out to do tasks such as giving training people like Willerhide. Since he had nothing to do he decided to visit Wato in his house. Wato is still pissed about the fact that he was robbed. They begin arguing and Wemmbu leaves. He gives Pangi a visit again to ask him when PrinceZam stopped caring about his empire. Pangi gives Wemmbu some advice and he returns to the empire. He begins collecting taxes with Eggchan and he finds Spongs in the civilization. Spongs flies away. Wemmbu follows Spongs and finds a Pirate base and returns to the civilization. Eggchan asks Wemmbu if he killed Spongs which Wemmbu denies. Wemmbu returns to the Pirates base to find Spongs but he can't find him and he begins to realize that he fell for a trap. Wemmbu returns to his empire only to see Jaden_MAN taking Eggchan hostage. Wemmbu immediately tries to kill Jaden_MAN but he uses Eggchan as leverage to prevent him from doing so. Eggchan states that Arcn had also betrayed them. Jaden_MAN tells Wemmbu to drop his items or else he will kill Eggchan. Spongs was also just bait so that the Pirates would invade the empire when Wemmbu was gone. They threaten to kill Eggchan again so Wemmbu drops all his items leaving Gambit in his ender chest.        



Trivia


This is the first episode to:

Have YouTubers use voice changers when acting as players.


Use 
AZALI
's music.


The video's original title was “I Created Minecraft's Greatest Empire”.

title: Unstable SMP: The First King
content:
Unstable SMP: The First King














Upload date


Dec 7, 2025






POV


ParrotX2






Arcs


The Kings Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


TheobaldTheBird
LettuceK
Wemmbu
Dtowncat
HerobaneNair
Kibaxmc
Pro4D
Lightisytic
qCxsh
TomLWSM
nezoshoki
Imvenpu
loppezz
Twirps














LettuceK held an emergency announcement where he announced that he would be holding an election for King of Unstable.





Unstable SMP: The First King
 is the 94th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


Parrot
 finds a lectern placed inside of his potion shop which tells him to go to the server-wide announcement 
LettuceK
 was holding that day, although Parrot didn't intend to go to it, the book gave him a reason to. Parrot and 
Theo
 make their ways to the front and Parrot crafts a spyglass for the both of them. During Lettuce's speech, he mentions how anybody with over a hundred votes will be entered in for the election, which gives Parrot the idea to run. Once the speech is over, Parrot and Theo are walking back to 
Capital City
, Theo is fascinated at the idea of somebody wanting to save the server, but Parrot changes Theo's mind by telling him that Lettuce has rigged the election before it had already started. Back at the potion shop has another book, the book tells Parrot to follow the lodestone compass to a tree, the instructions given to by a player named "
The Owl
". Theo wants Parrot to campaign, but Parrot wants to follow the compass instead, so Theo agreed to come with.  Two references to the Mafia are made along the way – the obsidian road is made with obsidian from the massive spawn prison, and the remains of the bombers soar in the sky. 

While walking, Parrot calls out invisible players that were following them from spawn. The group call themselves the Phantoms, bandits who go robbing other players. One of them, Kibaxmc, says he's doing this for his boss - he lacks kills and resources have been tight lately. Parrot handles the leader and has Theo handle the other two, the perspective switches to Theo's, where he kills both of the Phantoms in mere seconds. Parrot leads the leader to a deep cave, pearls upwards without the leader looking and jumps down the cave and bows him down when the pearl lands. 

Parrot and Theo take the horses of the Phantom, Parrot is unsure of what the journey ahead has in store for them and doesn't want to put Theo in danger, so he offers Theo the chance to head back, but Theo says they're in it to win it and they continue forward. After a few more hours, they make it to a jungle, where they stumble across a massive tree village. Parrot flies into the village and asks Dtowncat, the leader of the village why the tree is burning down and who did it, in which Dtowncat said the Phantoms did. Parrot flies the direction that Dtowncat gave him and it begins to rain, which caused a heavy fog to disrupt his vision and unable to see more than twenty blocks in front of him. Parrot spots the Phantoms as well as the hostage and goes to confront them, Parrot tells the hostage he can come back with him, but the Phantoms threaten to kill the hostage if he stepped forward. One of the bandits, Kibaxmc wants to kill Parrot for killing the Phantoms the day before and the rest go back to their base. He insults Parrot: "What are you going to do about it? You're worthless! You're a scum!" Parrot had no tricks up his sleeve and was in unfamiliar terrain, so he flies away and back to the tree to meet back up with Theo. Parrot talks to Dtowncat and he explains that this village is called Treebo Village and it was built years ago, because it's a remote location, they were unaware of the election going on. Dtowncat then explains how the Phantoms comes by every now and then and takes their items, Parrot asks if he has contacted 
The Law
, but he says Treebo Village is too far away for them to care. After hearing this, Parrot is destined to help save the hostage get back to the village. Theo reminds him that the elections are close, and Parrot replies, "This is the right thing to do." 

Parrot retraces his steps and sees a trail the Phantoms made while traversing the jungle. It starts to rain and so Parrot and Theo dig in a side of a mountain until it stops raining. Theo asks how doing all of this will help Parrot win the election, Parrot says it won't, he can't let the Phantoms get away with their wrongdoings. Deeper within the jungle it becomes more amplified, which would make it harder to spot any clues, but Parrot spots a cave entrance inside of a huge ravine. Parrot looks into the base and sees all the Phantom members, so he digs above their base, low enough to the point where PajamaSammy, the hostage, can hear them. Parrot grows glowberries so they can climb up, and the Phantoms immediately notice. Parrot overhears them say that they're going to destroy Treebo Village tomorrow, and they all make a run for it once the coast is clear. Once outside, Parrot flies up with an Elytra and shoots down the Happy Ghast the Phantoms were riding on to slow down their journey there, killing one Phantom in the process. Parrot and Theo bring Sammy back to the village, and Dtowncat holds a small meeting with everybody in the village, and they all submit their votes for Parrot, with over 108 votes, he's eligible to be in the election. Parrot steps up to talk, he can't go back to spawn yet, and would rather help defend the village from the Phantom's attack tomorrow. 

The day of the attack is here, Parrot and Theo's plan is to knock the Phantoms off with knockback swords as they removed all railing preparing for the raid the day before. As Parrot and the village are fighting off the Phantoms, Theo fights HerobaneNair, the leader of them all. The defenders' strategy  strategy works and the casualties are 7:7 when only Herobane and Kibaxmc, his right hand man, remain. They kill off every Phantom besides Herobane and Kiba, his right hand man, Parrot spots them on the other side of the tree and goes assist the members of the village. Kiba gets outnumbered and is killed, Herobane runs off into the distance. Parrot lets him run free and tells him to never come back to the village. Another meeting is held, although Treebo Village lost a few players, they are finally able to be at peace again. Parrot and Theo start heading back towards spawn, forgetting where their horses were placed, but PajamaSammy tells them to follow him back to the Phantom's hideout where he reveals a hidden ice boat highway that leads all the way to spawn. As they boat, Parrot realizes that The Owl wanted to show him that there are players that are in need who are unable to get help. This marks the beginning of a new mystery – who is The Owl and how exactly did he select Parrot as the “chosen one”?

At the end of the episode, Lettuce hosts another announcement, he reveals that over sixteen 
Candidates
 received over 100 votes, and to keep things fair, they will halve the total amount of  
Candidates
 every two weeks, and only the top half with the most votes will move on. Parrot is at the very bottom, only having 109 votes.



Trivia


This is one of the few videos where another player's POV is temporarily shown, this time being Theo's.

The other videos are 
I Broke into Minecraft's Most Secure Prison
 with 
Rekrap2
 and 
JumperWho
, 
I Got Hunted by Minecraft's Deadliest Players
 with 
JumperWho
 for a second time, 
Escaping Paragon: The Perfect Minecraft Prison
 with 
Wifies
, and 
Hunting a Minecraft Player Who Doesn't Exist
 with 
Leow0ok
 and JumperWho for a third time time.


In the thumbnail, Parrot is shown wearing a crown despite not ever wearing one. However, this is because loppezz made the thumbnail for this video and put a crown on Parrot's skin to make it.

Loppezz has since then removed the skin off of her NameMC skin history, most likely to prevent people from seeing leaks.


Both ReinaDrop and ShoeBilly's actors, hpneybee and lahdoh play themselves respectively as citizens of 
Treebo Village
 in this video.

title: Unstable SMP: The First War
content:
Unstable SMP: The First War














Season


1






Episode


24






Upload date


Dec 7, 2024






Timeline


The Invisible Mafia Arc
The Last Civilizations (subplot) (final episode)






POV


ParrotX2






Featured Creators (Description)


Wifies
 †
TheobaldTheBird
Kenadian
Purpled
Wato1876
deanthebean9
 †
Naparizel
 †
Lamibee
Cristalit
nezoshoki
R4trick
lezy
DumbIsDumb
meta64
PikaTM
TheSorta
Pro4D
Falcuno
Dimofyy
 †
CoinMonke
avatardotpng
madmaruu
finiahn
Horace Altman
Sharooh
Fantst
ashswagg
FlameFrags
Arcn
PierceTRV














The Mafia
 is growing faster than ever, destroying every last civilization that stands in their way. If we don't stop them soon, it's going to be too late. This is Unstable SMP: The First War.





Unstable SMP: The First War
 is the 24th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


The video begins in 
The Mafia
 invading most of the 
Farmers District
 and killing most of it's members.

Horace splits the civilization into 3 factions. The 
Farmers District
, the 
Warriors District
 and the 
Builders District
. The Farmers supplies everyone with resources, the Warriors are the fighters and the Builders are the humble ones. 
Parrot
 wants to become a warrior because he wants to avenge 
LuigiToan
. To determine Parrot's faction he has to go through a test. How the test works is that you have to use ~5 items to kill a wither. Parrot uses chickens, an instant damage potion, a wind charging potion and a mace. After completing the test, 
Horace
 tells Parrot that a warrior would usually kill the wither normally, a builder would wait until it's gone and a farmer would trap it or use some strategy but Parrot didn't do any of that which shocked him. Horace and 
CoinMonke
 tell Parrot that he is both but he also tells him that there's a conflict between the Warriors and Farmers, therefore he won't make a fourth faction for Parrot because the Warriors and Farmers wouldn't like that. Parrot chooses to join the Warriors.

Parrot talks to two of the council members, 
Lamibee
 and 
Dimofyy
 about The Mafia but they tell him that he has to go on his first mission in half an hour. Parrot flies next to the statue which is where he meets 
TheobaldTheBird
. Theo tells Parrot that he regrets joining the Warriors because he was on a mission where he had to collect resources even though that's the Farmers' job. Parrot asks Theo if he joined the Warriors to fight The Mafia but to his surprise, Theo doesn't know what the Mafia is. Parrot asks Theo why he even joined in the first place if he isn't fighting The Mafia. Theo tells him it's to prove that he's the best. 

Dimofyy announces to his squad that they are going to destroy one of The Mafia's outposts and loot anything valuable. As they enter the outpost they spot 2 invisible players. They jump the invisible players but they flee. Dimofyy gets disappointed at them and tells them that they have to train more. Parrot asks if he has TNT and Dimofyy pulls out a shulker full of TNT. They blow up the outpost and Parrot notices an obsidian tunnel. As they walk through the tunnel, the lights inside turn off and they get mining fatigue. They see a 
diamond player
 who jumps them and the diamond player who is revealed to be 
Flamefrags
 (death message), kills Dimofyy. Parrot lights a portal and they escape through the nether. 
Lezy
 finds Parrot and tells him that everyone wanted Dimofyy to die because he was annoying and thought so highly of himself.

Parrot and the rest of the squad head back to the Far Lands city to talk to the 
Warriors Council
 about Dimofyy's death and how they managed to escape. The leader 
Purpled
 starts calling Parrot a farmer for escaping the way a farmer would. Purpled makes an announcement that Dimofyy is dead so he will be opening a new spot in the council. He tells everyone that if they want to become a council, they have to pop his totem in a 1v1 and he will duel them in 30 minutes. Parrot is the only person who arrives within 30 minutes so Purpled gives him the shield until Theo enters. Parrot removes his shield as he now has to duel Purpled to get it. Before Parrot duels Purpled, 
Naparizel
 explains the rules to him. Parrot loses the duel and Theo steps in and wins the duel using TNT minecarts therefore earning a spot in the Warriors Council. 

Parrot starts checking the city out until 
Wifies
 appears out of nowhere. Parrot walks away but Wifies follows him because he wants to apologize to Parrot. Parrot tells Wifies that he doesn't want to talk to him and he flies away to go for another mission. Theo and his squad fly to 
Zam Empire
 to set up mines to disrupt whatever they are planning. They head to a different location since there's no activity where they were currently at until they get jumped by a few Mafia members. Theo kills all of the Mafia members that were jumping them and they continue building mines. Purpled gets impressed by Theo killing 11 Mafia members. Theo tells Purpled that there's no point in sending them on random missions because they could end The Mafia if they actually tried to kill them instead of putting members on pointless missions. Parrot agrees with Theo and Purpled decides to put them on a harder mission and he also warns them that the last time people were put on this mission all 4 members died. 

Parrot decides to check out the Farming District and sees a familiar face. 
Kenadian
. Kenadian tells him that he's the leader of the Farming District and also assumes that Parrot wants to join the Farmers because of Wifies also being part of the Farming District. Parrot tells Kenadian that he's in the warriors already and asks why the place looks abandoned. Kenadian doesn't want to tell Parrot why because he's a Warrior. Parrot tells Kenadian that he's both a Warrior and a Farmer and Kenadian sends him to the Farmer's council room. Kenadian, 
Wato
 and Wifies discuss about Parrot being both a Warrior and a Farmer. Kenadian tells Parrot that after he left Parrot's 
End Civilization
, he joined Horace's Far Lands civilization and became the first farmer. He explains that the Warriors were supposed to protect the Farmers and the Farmers are supposed to provide them resources to protect them and he built the Farming District several million blocks away from the farlands and he thought the Warriors would help protect them, however Kenadian had 3 days notice that The Mafia is about to attack them. He tried to contact the Warriors but none of them responded and The Mafia destroyed the Farming District and killed about 70-80% of the Farming District. After this, they stopped giving them resources.

Parrot tells them that they have to put it aside and that he will try to fix everything. All 3 of the Farmers don't believe Parrot and he gets pissed when Wifies starts talking and he claims that Wifies is only in the Far Lands to sabotage Parrot. Wifies denies that statement and tells him that if he was trying to sabotage him he would be doing that. Parrot states that the war is unwinnable if they don't put their differences aside.

The Warriors play a game of capture the flag to train. Parrot doesn't have a team so he teams up with all the farmers including Wifies. Since the teams were outnumbered 
meta64
 joins Parrot's team. They place their banner/flag behind a tree and put bone meal on grass so it's not that easy to find. They then light a portal to the nether and splash each other with invisibility. After returning to the overworld they burn the forest to distract the Warriors while Parrot uses a chicken blaster made by Wifies. He splashes himself with invisibility and slow falling and launches himself using the chicken blasters and he steals the Warriors' flag and places it next to their flag and wins. The Warriors get embarrassed by how they lost.

Wifies apologizes to Parrot again and tells Parrot that he wants to help him. Parrot tells Wifies that he wants to be a part of the Warriors council but in order to do that he has to beat one of the members in a 1v1 but since he believes there are no strategies he doesn't know how he could win and also tells him that he's going on a mission and the last time a squad went on this mission, they didn't make it out alive. Wifies tries to provide Parrot with help but Parrot denies it and walks away. After a few days of practicing archery to use debuff arrows against The Mafia, he asks Wifies for help for using static targets. Wifies suggests doing a mini bow duel with the debuffs. Parrot loses at first but after a few rounds he finally wins a round against Wifies. He starts consistently winning every bow duel against Wifies. After this, Parrot practices switching arrows and targets with Wifies. The final phase of practicing is another duel where Wifies uses melee to attack Parrot while Parrot uses only a bow and the arrows. Parrot wins the duel. 

Parrot and Wifies have a conversation about fighting in the war. Wifies tells Parrot that if he's going to fight in the war, he will too. Wifies also gives Parrot back his spyglass that he dropped in their argument during their journey to the Far Lands as a promise that Parrot won't die. Parrot wonders what 
Dean
 is into and he considers checking up on him to say goodbye. Parrot goes back to the jungle where he last saw Dean. He notices a trail of netherrack and he follows the trail which leads to a dark oak forest with a shack. Parrot calls out Dean and he responds. He finds Dean fishing. Dean tells Parrot that he made the trail so that someone could find him. Parrot tells Dean about the mission he's about to go to and says goodbye to him just in case he doesn't make it out alive. Dean gives Parrot a tour of his house and also blows the goat horn again because he doesn't care about The Mafia finding him. Dean asks Parrot if he can come with him but Parrot tells Dean that he wont because he doesn't trust him. Dean apologizes and tells Parrot he will do anything to get him to trust him again. Parrot tells Dean to stay until he wins the war. Dean asks Parrot if he could tell him when he finally trusts him again. Parrot tells Dean he will and returns to the Far Lands.

Theo leads all of them to 
Mafia City
. His plan was to take out a diamond player after going up through all their stages. They search all the diamond players' castles but they don't see anyone. They continue exploring until Parrot notices a diamond player. The diamond player tries to kill the entire squad. Theo tells all of them to leave him with the diamond player however, a gold player and another diamond player tries to kill them. Parrot uses the debuff arrows against the diamond player that he practiced with Wifies. The diamond player pops Parrot's totem multiple times. Theo and the squad retreat. As they leave Mafia City the diamond players follow them. Parrot tells them to go back to Mafia City while being invisible to disguise as a no-trimmed member and the diamond players will lose them. They all proceed in doing so and they lose the diamond player. After reuniting with Theo, they return to the Far Lands. Purpled gets disappointed when he finds out they didn't kill the diamond player but he gives them all diamond silence trimmed boots. Theo explains that if it weren't for Parrot they would've all died. Parrot tells Purpled that they have to fight against The Mafia strategically if they want to win. Purpled tells Parrot that he makes the decisions along with the rest of the council. Parrot says he wants to join the council. Purpled tells him that he has to 1v1 a council member. Parrot chooses 
DumbIsDumb
. Purpled tells him that Dumb is one of if not the most skilled fighter in the Warriors Council. Parrot changes his mind but it's already too late.

Parrot returns to the Farming District to ask Wifies for help again. Parrot explains to Wifies what happened and why he needs Wifies' help. Parrot suggest they make something above them since they normally wouldn't look above them. They head above the colosseum where they build an ice platform. They finish building the ice platform and Wifies tells Parrot he will break the ice from above while he's fighting Dumb. The fight begins and Parrot tells Wifies to break the ice now that they're fighting. As the water starts flooding the arena, Parrot uses it to his advantage, he uses his tridents to hit Dumb while he's completely unprepared. Parrot breaks Dumb's helmet and later breaks his boots. Parrot pops Dumb's totem and Dumb gives his shield. Parrot shows the council shield to Wifies.

Parrot's first council meeting begins. Parrot begins talking about how the missions are pointless and they have to actually do something impactful against The Mafia. Purpled tells Parrot that he doesn't think they can defeat The Mafia due to the fact that The Mafia outnumbers them, so he's putting members of the Warriors on little missions to give them false hope. Theo agrees with Parrot saying that they need to do something that will actually impact The Mafia. Parrot suggests that they unite all the factions. Purpled disagrees because he doesn't want anything to do with the farmers. The argument continues until Purpled walks away. Upon returning, Purpled tells them that a builder was spotted by a Mafia member and they have to deal with the Mafia member. Purpled tells Parrot to get people since he doesn't have a squad so Parrot makes a squad with the Farmers. They head to the nether roof and split up to find the Mafia member.

They eventually find the Mafia member and it appears to be a 
gold trimmed player
. They jump the gold trimmed player but the gold trimmed player escapes using chorus fruit. Kenadian provides them with chorus fruit and they eat it to leave the nether roof, however by that point the gold player has been long gone. Parrot suggests they go to Mafia City because that's where the gold player could be heading, disguise as diamond players and try to catch him. Upon arriving close to Mafia City, Parrot mines a lot of trees to make signa because Mafia members communicate using signs. Kenadian pulls up spare eye trim smithing templates he possibly obtained before The Mafia began taking over the server. Parrot poses as a diamond player and looks for the gold player. 

Parrot finds the gold player and tries to convince him that he can give 
Ash
 the message. Since the gold player doesn't trust him enough he ignores Parrot and walks away. Parrot chases him and tells him to unmute himself. The gold player gets suspicious because the voice sounds familiar but Parrot convinces him otherwise. He convinces him that it's not worth giving Ash the coordinates and he's not going to rank up. Parrot tells him that he's a bit jealous about him finding the Far Lands civilization. Parrot tells him that he will join the squadron of diamond players. The gold player is convinced and Parrot tells the squadron to make a trap. Upon arrival, the gold player is suspicious again. The squadron of farmers start praising him and act impressed. The gold player asks him why he hasn't seen their faces but he has heard their voices. Parrot reveals himself and Kenadian activates the trap, killing him in the process.

Purpled gives Parrot silence trimmed leggings for killing the gold player. Parrot tells Purpled that the farmers were the reason why he was able to kill the gold player. Purpled thought he was going to get a squadron of warriors. Purpled explains that it's the warriors job to protect the civilization which in response, Parrot brings up the Warriors abandoning the farmers while they were being attacked. Purpled says it isn't his problem. Theo suggests that they unite the Farmers and the Warriors again. Parrot tells Purpled that they should apologize to the Farmers. Purpled and 
Naparizel
 tell Parrot that he has to become a leader if he wants to make decisions. Parrot and Theo continue arguing with Purpled until the meeting is dismissed.

Theo talks to Parrot about the meeting and tells him Purpled sees him as a threat. Theo then tells Parrot that he's exactly what the Warriors need leadership-wise. Parrot tells Theo how much he cares about winning the war against The Mafia. Theo wonders how the Farmers are so drawn to Parrot but hate the rest of the Warriors. Parrot tells Theo that when his test results came, Horace said he was both a Warrior and a Farmer. They continue to discuss about the beef with the warriors and the farmers. Theo tells Parrot that maybe the reason why the council hates Parrot is because he has something that they don't and since Parrot arrived things have changed. Theo leaves after the conversation. 

Parrot visits Dean again. Dean notices Parrot's armour trims. Parrot tells him that it's from the Far Lands and Dean gets a bit jealous about it. Dean tells Parrot about what he's been up to the whole time. Parrot asks if everything has been good and Dean says that everything has been good so Parrot decides to leave but Dean asks if he could go with Parrot again. Parrot asks him what he would be able to do if he did go with him. Dean wants Parrot to trust him. Parrot tells Dean he will trust him after the war. Dean responds saying "What if you don't? What if you just die and I'm stuck here and nobody "will ever trust me again?". He also states that Wifies might die too.  He tells Parrot that Ash was the person who took him when he had nothing and he thought he could have friends. Parrot responds by saying that The Mafia isn't a sense of community. Dean didn't know that at the time. They just told him that he would have all the freedom he could've ever wanted if he joined. He then states that the war is not winnable. He's seen it all while Parrot has just seen a fraction of it and Parrot is going to die in the war and he will be alone. Parrot asks Dean why did he betray him if he cared so much about the war and tells him that everything will be fixed after the war before leaving. 

Purpled starts another council meeting. Parrot asks if Purpled could come up with a war strategy since it's been just mission after mission. Parrot asks what the point of the Warriors faction existing if they aren't coming up with strategies to beat The Mafia. They begin arguing again but Purpled admits that the missions they have been doing was just to give everyone false hope. Purpled dismisses everyone except for Parrot and he tells Parrot to deliver a bunch of things to a set of coordinates. He gets Parrot to clear his inventory and fill it up with shulkers. Parrot enters an obsidian hole which leads to a tunnel and as he places all the shulkers he gets jumped by all the council members. Theo arrives trying and helps Parrot. Parrot barely manages to escape. 

After Parrot and Theo return to the Far Lands they confront Purpled and Theo tries to kill him Purpled continues talking as if nothing happened. Parrot asks Purpled why he tried to kill him and Purpled says that it's because Parrot is trying to drag the into war. Purpled tells Parrot that he's the one tearing them apart. Naparizel and 
Lamibee
 agree with Parrot this time Parrot decides to do a poll on who should become leader of the Warriors faction. Everyone votes for Parrot and Purpled gives him the armour. Parrot is now the leader of the Warriors. Parrot does a speech. During the speech he destroys all the silence trimmed armour and tells everyone to replace any silence armour trim with their normal armour because he believes that the way Purpled used to run the Warriors faction was corrupt and they gave everyone false hope and he tells everyone that unity is stronger than hope. The warriors including Parrot apologize to the Farmers for abandoning them. The Farmers accept their apology. Parrot states that the true enemy is Ash and The Mafia and tells the Warriors to destroy anything important to The Mafia and what keeps them invisible and he would join the Farmers for their mission. Parrot concludes the speech by stating that a new era is born. An era of trust, unity, hope and forgiveness. Parrot keeps the word forgiveness in his mind as he is about to visit Dean again. 

Parrot goes for another visit with Dean but he notices that Dean is missing. He doesn't see any traces of him anywhere. Parrot tells Wifies that Dean wasn't present. Parrot and Wifies talk to the rest of the Farmers to go to the mission that Parrot mentioned in the speech to destroy all the Mafia A1C bombers. They head near 
Spawn
 and find a lot of A1C bombers. They begin destroying the A1C bombers but however while doing so they see them starting. They try to disable them but they get jumped by Mafia members. Parrot follows a Mafia member but they just fly away. Parrot and Wifies continue fighting the invisible players while Kenadian and 
Wato
 destroy the A1C bombers. Parrot tells them that he will drop an invisible player. The invisible player is shooting it's own teammates and Parrot decides to drop him. The invisible player's totem pops and it's revealed to be Dean. Dean blows his goat horn one last time before getting killed in the void. Parrot gets furious and tries to kill one of the Mafia members until the diamond player shows up and starts macing him. After flying away to an island they talk about what happened however Parrot isn't in the mood after witnessing his friend die. Parrot realizes that he was shooting the other Mafia members because that was his way of trying to earn their trust back.

Parrot goes back to Dean's shack to bury Dean. After writing the sign in the gravestone he says "I trust you". Ash interrupts the funeral and starts mocking Dean, comparing his life to a cockroach saying that he was pointless. Ash states that he knew Dean was going to betray him when he rejoined The Mafia and he also put Dean on that mission intentionally so that Parrot could kill him. Parrot gets furious and threatens to kill Ash. Ash tells him that he kidnapped the entire Warriors faction and will execute them. Parrot tries to kill Ash but he teleports away using a stasis chamber. 

Upon returning to the Far Lands civilization, Parrot tells the Farmers about the Warriors getting kidnapped. They come up with a plan to break in to one of Ash's prisons. It turns out that it's located in The End Civilization before going to the end, they all set stasis chambers. As they arrive to The End Civilization, Parrot notices the city was retextured into a Mafia theme (possibly the reason why they didn't blow it up). As they sneak through the entire city, they break into the cell where the Warriors are held hostage. The Farmers place an ender chest to provide the Warriors with gear. As they break out of the cell, they notice the chunk bans being reactivated. Parrot tells 
Cristalit
 to try to fly out of the civilization to test if the chunk bans are active and he gets chunk banned. They get caught by diamond players. Parrot tells the Warriors to distract the diamond players while the Farmers, including Parrot build a chicken blaster pearl cannon. After finishing building the chicken blaster pearl cannon, Parrot tells the Warriors to throw a pearl while the Farmers distract the diamond players. A diamond player catches them so Parrot activates the cannon, teleporting all of them away from the city. Parrot tells the rest of the farmers to activate their stasises and tells Wifies not to pull his because he has to talk to Ash. 

Parrot tells the diamond players to take him to Ash. He even clears his entire inventory. As they take him to Ash's castle Parrot tells Ash that he's lucky he didn't bring a sword. Ash tells Parrot that if he dies, the entire Mafia goes down with him. Parrot tells Ash that he wonders how he can get people to listen to him. Ash shows him around the castle but gets interrupted by Parrot reminding him about 
when he said that fear is control
 to tell him that the opposite of fear is unity. He tells Ash that he wants to duel him but Ash clowns on him and continues showing him around the castle. Parrot notices the dragon egg and a desire board. He notices the farming district isn't red on the desire board. Ash asks Parrot if he has ever stopped to ask himself why The Mafia always wears invisibility and tells him that it's a symbol and it's part of something bigger and compares that to how the farming district is part of the Far Lands. Ash tells Parrot that he knows where the Far Lands civilization is and he is sending battalions of 2 diamond players each and he tells Parrot the exact coordinates of the Far Lands. Parrot pulls his stasis and looks over the Far Lands civilization.

's first level, the "noob rank"

's gold-player trap looks like a Mafia structure, but is nothing but a trap to kill him

's trap to kill Parrot,
