Unstable SMP: The Farm War
 is the 61st episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


Lomedy
 asks 
Flame
 for help fighting a war, but it turns out to be all over crops. Flame thinks it's nonsense, but Lomedy shows a horse with maxed out attributes as a reward, so Flame agrees to help outfarm Spongs and Willsion, Lomedy's rivals. Lomedy explains the rules of being a farmer to Flame, which is to wear leather armor and not to use weapons, so Flame sets traps all across Lomedy's farm to kill them. When nighttime comes, 
Spongs
 and his group of farmers come and rob the farm. Two robbers die to traps, Spongs and 
Willsion
 chase Flame around the farm to try and kill him seeing that he's in full leather. Spongs and Willsion leave after destroying the farm enough, Flame and Lomedy clean up the farm and head to a farmer's trading town after. They get to the trading town and Flame asks to trade with one of the players, but they're afraid of Flame because of his reputation. Lomedy takes over and gives the player crops, the player looks at Flame afraid and Flame raises his voice at them and drops all the enchanted books.

When they get back to the farm, they see Spongs trashing it. Flame confronts Spongs, but Spongs laughs at him for following the farmer's rules of no weapons and that he can't do anything, and Flame proves them wrong by killing Spongs' team of farmers with just strength and a hoe. Flame beats Spongs and Willsion nearly to death and they flee. Flame wants payback on Spongs and Willsion for destroying their farm for the third time, so they head over to their farm and robs them of their crops. They spot Lomedy and Flame, and they hide inside one of the buildings, Flame and Lomedy then plan to steal their camel and sniffer egg, Flame gets the sniffer egg and Lomedy is already on the Happy Ghast with the camel attached ready to go. Spongs and Willsion are on the ground and will keep chasing them, so Flame goes down to distract while Lomedy finds a safe place to hide the animals. Flame finds Lomedy on top of a mountain and they continously knock Spongs and his team off, Flame leaves once he sees Lomedy has left as well. They meet back up in jungle and stumble across an abandoned jungle village, they loot the village for anything valuable for Lomedy's farm. Lomedy finds a small hole underneath one of the houses, and they go down, which turns out to be a huge maze with ravagers inside. They get to the end of the maze and find a Netherite hoe, with the hoe, a camel, and sniffer egg, they've became richer than the usual farmer. Flame and Lomedy go back to their farm and dance to Lava Chicken and clean their farm up, Flame goes in their house and falls into a fall trap and manages to pearl clutch and glitch into a block, saving his life. Spongs and Willsion blow the farm up again and Flame doesn't know what to do other than killing them to, they taunt and laugh at Lomedy for not being able to protect his own farm, leaving him with no more crops or animals, they leave. 

Lomedy is upset that Flame dragged him into this by using violence and that everything could've been prevented if they gave Spongs and Willsion what they wanted. Lomedy is about to give up farming entirely and give all his stuff up, but Flame tells him to stay and farm with him one last time, and they repair the farm and make it look better than it was originally. After helping Lomedy, Flame is about to head off and deal with Spongs and Willsion himself to get his pets back, but Lomedy decides to help him out and sets up TNT dupers that faced Spongs and Willsion's farm. Flame finds his dog and the horse in the farm and places them somewhere safe and blows the horn, signaling to Lomedy to activate the TNT dupers. Flame reveals himself and walks around not doing anything. He tells them that he will never be farmer, but he's better at taking things one step further than them and tells them to look around. The TNT dupers are in range and start destroying every single bit of their farm, Flame doesn't kill Spongs or Willsion, and would rather keep them alive and have them live with their destroyed farms knowing they won't ever be the greatest farmers of Unstable. Willsion gives up all his items after losing everything and Spongs gives up being a farmer and head off in different directions. Without Spongs and Willsion in Lomedy's way, he can become the best farmer, and as promised, he gives Flame the horse as a thank you for helping him.

Unstable SMP: The LAW
 is the 114th episode featured in Unstable Universe. This marks the end of 
Wemmbu
's perspective of 
The Kings Arc
.



Plot


The episode starts off with the events of the previous episode, 
LettuceK
 threatens 
Wemmbu
 that if he ever crosses him or 
The Law
 again, he would ban 
Jaden
 off of the server. Wemmbu thinks about shooting a stab shot directly at Lettuce, instead he flies away. He meets up back with 
eggchan
 at an 
old base
 they built underground and he catches egg up with whats been happening. Wemmbu spots invis particles in their enchantment table and blocks it off and threatens to blow them up unless they reveal their identity. Egg says they've been chill and the person drinks milk, revealing to be 
JumperWho
. She explains that she's friends with Jaden and that Lettuce is going to execute him no matter what. She tasks Wemmbu to free him from the prison before Lettuce does so. Wemmbu agrees to do so and tells egg to meet him at 
FlameFrags
' base while he nukes the prison. Wemmbu flies over to Flame's base and sees Flame readying up for something, the both of them have the same goal in common, which is to break a friend out of prison, and so they team up to kill all the lawmen over at Law HQ.

They head over to the Law HQ and a fight breaks out, 
SargeLAW
 commands the guards and team kills most of the lawmen with his minecarts rather than doing damage to either Flame or Wemmbu. The two kill off every guard except SargeLAW. Wemmbu picks up a dead lawman's netherite armor and caused mass destruction on the entire place. Wemmbu tells Flame where Lomedy is located while he sits up top and keeps an eye out for more guards. He goes up a floor of the building he's in to Lettuce's office and takes a peek at a book sitting on the lectern, it's Lettuce's old book where he talks about being a side character in an 
unstable universe
 and wishes to have control of his own life
,
 having been written all the way back in the 
Sky Civilization
 days. He takes the book and hears a lawman spying on him underneath and kills them, he sits on top of a roof until he hears the Law's horn, more lawmen barge into the HQ as well as Lettuce. Wemmbu immediately starts stab shotting the lawmen and Lettuce asks what Wemmbu is doing, Wemmbu says he's a bystander and that he's only fighting back because it's self defense. He then shifts his focus on killing lawmen, but once his totem pops, he quickly flies out of the base and Lettuce chases him. Wemmbu says he had no choice in coming over because Lettuce was going to kill Jaden no matter what and asks what he's ever done to Lettuce to deserve everything. Lettuce says Wemmbu has killed his friends and destroyed every civilization that he joined and Wemmbu joined after. Lettuce says he's not a hero, but he needs to do what needs to be done. Wemmbu says he's trying to bring order to a server where it doesn't belong, Lettuce says he's going to prove everyone wrong and pulls the fishing rod, but a death message with Jaden's name doesn't show up. Seconds later, Jaden, 
Spoke
, Jumper, and 
PrinceZam
 come to them and attempts to kill Lettuce. Another wave of guards come to assist Lettuce, but it's not enough. Lettuce flies away from the fight, Wemmbu tries to follow, but runs out of rockets and tries to do the infinite fly method, but it's too slow to continue the chase. He goes back to the group and Spoke explains the plan on finding 
Parrot
 and he brings them all to his Amplified castle.

They get to the castle where 
Mapicc
 and 
MinuteTech
 are already there, Spoke gathers them all up and tells them the overall plan, one of Jumper's invisible spies comes and gives her a book, which tells them all information saying that The Law has lawmen coming to a remote location the opposite direction of where spawn is located and it may be where Parrot is. Wemmbu agrees to help Parrot, as soon as Jumper gives the coordinates out, Wemmbu immediately flies over to the island. By the time he lands, Spoke is already there before him. The group of lawmen that Jumper's spy was talking about starts to arrive, Wemmbu sets off an orbital and Spoke tells Wemmbu to start fighting, but Wemmbu gets stubborn and decides not to help fight. It's only until Flame pulls up when Wemmbu starts to help fight. During the aftermath, Parrot and 
Theo
 continue looting the island and get it all attached to a happy ghast. Wemmbu flies back to the castle with his Elytra while the others are still on their way back. Once everyone else is back, Parrot says that he revamped his old District 13 base to hold his army and they should converge into one. Flame pulls Wemmbu aside and says egg may have gone to Flame's old base over at spawn. Wemmbu goes to the old base and finds egg in front of the base, egg says he's ready to fight, but Wemmbu says he already broke Jaden out of jail and everything, they then head off to the District 13 base. 

Wemmbu breaks the redstone door attempting to enter District 13, Parrot starts his speech when Wemmbu gets there, mentioning how The Law has affected all of them in a way and that today is the day they destroy The Law. All of them march into Northern Council, frames begin dropping the closer they get to the middle. When they arrive, Wemmbu holds back the group and gives Parrot time to talk to Lettuce first. He then flies up to get a better view, and once Parrot is done with his talk, Wemmbu sets off three orbitals and kills hundreds of lawmen in seconds. The first battle starts, but also ends relatively quickly, and so they go up to where the palace is and sees Lettuce and his commanders. They all confront Lettuce and calls him a coward, but Lettuce tells them to look behind and all his netherite guards come out from behind the watchpoint towers, commencing the second battle. Throughout this battle, Wemmbu blows up a majority of the Northern Council and kills some lawmen along the way. With Lettuce being the only one left, everyone focuses on him and breaks all of his armor, Lettuce flies away once more and Wemmbu pursues him, but runs out of rockets mid-chase. He gets wind charges from his ender chest and tries to continue chasing, Minute tries to continue chasing after him, but comes back to Wemmbu and says Lettuce had an escape route ready. On their way back, Minute says it's not bad that Lettuce was able to get away and that the server sees him for who he actually is and that he has to live knowing the mistakes that he's made. 

The two make it back to the Northern Council and give the news of Lettuce escaping, all of them sound exhausted after fighting for hours on end. Flame starts to kill Jaden to get Lomedy's mace back, Wemmbu jumps in to defend Jaden. In the middle of the fight, Lettuce comes back empty handed and surrenders. Wemmbu goes over to Parrot's side, ending the vote in a tie, so they encase Lettuce in an obsidian cage. Wemmbu hands Lettuce his old sky civilization book as a reminder and Lettuce calls him cruel. Wemmbu grabs egg and they head out of the castle, Parrot asks where they're headed next, egg says the library, but Wemmbu says otherwise and heads off.  They run on the highway and see Flame in the distance, Wemmbu asks what his problem is with Jaden and Flame explains that Jaden's mace belongs to another friend. Flame asks where they're headed, Wemmbu says he has an idea and turns right from the highway.

This is the longest post-mafia arc episode, beating 
4 Minecraft Pros VS 2500 Players
 by about 2 minutes.

title: Unstable SMP: The Mafia
content:
Unstable SMP: The Mafia














Season


1






Episode


26






Upload date


Jan 21, 2025






POV


Wemmbu






Arcs


The Invisible Mafia Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


eggchan
ClownPierce
FerreMC
ParrotX2
SpokeIsHere
Wifies
Wato1876
Kenadian
Mapicc
FerreMC
Naparizel
lezy
Falcuno
TheSorta
TheobaldTheBird
Novagriddy
Loppezz
Arcn
FlameFrags
finiahn
r4trick














minecraft war





Unstable SMP: The Mafia
 is the 26th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. This marks the end of 
Wemmbu
's perspective in Season 1.



Plot


The video starts off with 
Wemmbu
 and 
eggchan
 hanging out in 
ManePear
's 
treehouse
. 
ClownPierece
 and 
Ferre
 unexpectedly come and burn the whole tree down. They start attacking Wemmbu and egg, causing their resources to dwindle. Egg manages to escape first, letting him be able to create an escape tunnel for Wemmbu. The two manage to escape through the Nether and hide out for 24 hours until the coast is clear. They go back to the treehouse, staring at the remains of it. Wemmbu vows to kill Clown because of what he has done.

Parrot
 appears behind the two, asking them to join his team again. A flashback appears of Parrot asking them to join prior to the attack, and Wemmbu rejecting Parrot every time. Parrot tells Wemmbu that their interests are aligned by the fact that Wemmbu wants to kill Clown and that Parrot wants to destroy the Mafia.

Parrot leads Wemmbu and Egg to District 13 and devises a plan to take down 
Ashswagg
. However, Wemmbu doesn't care. Parrot then tells Wemmbu he should be the one to distract Clown, or at least give them enough time to go through with their plan. Wemmbu requests to get him to fight a diamond trim Mafia player with a Mace he'll go along with their plan.

Wemmbu, Egg, Parrot, and 
Wifies
 go to a beach near spawn to set up a fall trap. Wifies sets up a beacon that alerts nearby Mafia members to their location. Eventually, a Mafia player shows up, but it was a non-trim. The second wave arrives, only an iron trim and a few non-trim show up. They kill the Mafia members with ease. After a while longer, a diamond trim finally shows up with other trimmed players as well. The fight lasts a while, once the diamond trim is alone they set the trap off. They all manage to corner the diamond trim, and as the diamond trim tries to escape, Parrot gets the kill.

They all go back to the District 13 base when Parrot and Wemmbu start arguing, both of them trying to take credit for obtaining the mace. Wemmbu says after getting the mace, he has no point in helping Parrot anymore. Before heading off, Parrot tells Wemmbu where Clown could be located. Wemmbu flies to Clown's castle and pots up for a fight. He sneaks into the castle, but almost blows his cover by breaking a sand block, causing the others to fall. He then jumps Clown and Ferre. After all his armor breaks and his restocks run out, he decides to flee from the battle. Clown and Ferre chase, but not for long.

Wemmbu decides to go back to District 13, only to find nobody is there. He then revisits Mane's treehouse again, meeting back up with Egg. Egg tells Wemmbu he has a plan, and the two go fishing. Eggchan suddenly teleports away, and Ferre whispers to Wemmbu that he has Egg held hostage in the jungle temple near the treehouse and to return back. Ferre tells Wemmbu that he was assigned to kill him. If Wemmbu dies, Ferre would let Egg free. Egg tells Wemmbu to "execute order 36", which is their secret code to set off a trap. Dozens of TNT minecarts go off, killing the two gold trim players that were with Ferre immediately. However, Ferre survives. Wemmbu and Egg fight off Ferre, eventually breaking all his armor. Wemmbu tries to get the mace off of Ferre, but Ferre stashes it in his ender chest and tries to fly away before Wemmbu could kill him. Caught one last time, Ferre hands over the mace for Wemmbu to spare his life.

Egg says his actual plan was to stasis back and put a beacon where their treehouse was and pretend to be a Mafia member. Egg then advises Wemmbu to rejoin Parrot, since working with other players makes him stronger. The two head back to District 13, but were met with 
Spoke
 and 
Mapicc
 instead. As they asked each other why they were looking for Parrot, Parrot appears. Parrot tells Spoke the reason why the resistance left was because of Spoke. Wemmbu and Egg build a house inside the base while they argue. Meanwhile, Spoke devises a plan to destroy the Mafia without having to kill Ash.

All of them head to spawn, Wemmbu's objective is to distract all the Mafia so the others can break in. Wemmbu says they need a team name and Spoke suggests "Team Unstable". Wemmbu tries to break into the prison, but remembers that they're supposed to be distractions. They head up to the top of the prison, and trimmed players spot them and begin to attack. Wemmbu easily kills all of them with his mace. While contemplating dropping down into the prison and freeing any new players, more guards come and jump them. Wemmbu kills all but one iron trim, telling him to call for backup.

A third wave of Mafia members show up, and realizing they can't win the fight, they fly away. Wemmbu escapes for a second, only to be found again. He has no other choice but to jump into the hole. He meets up with 
Wato
, who isn't an actual Mafia member, and they make up for Wemmbu ditching Wato in Sky Civilization. Wato shows Wemmbu around the prison, and eventually they meet up with 
Kenadian
. They find where the pearls are being moved around, Wemmbu throws a pearl in and jumps in to get it. Parrot and Wemmbu meet back up, and they get out of the prison. Parrot instructs Wemmbu and Wato to head back to District 13 while he does something else. Spoke, Mapicc, and Egg are already there waiting for them.

Parrot comes back, saddened, saying that Wifies had died. Spoke explains how he found where the ender pearls are located and how he plans on taking it down. Wemmbu builds another house while this goes down. Spoke then instructs Wemmbu to kill Clown, or at least distract him while their plan is in action. Mafia members come and raid their base, griefing it and attacking them. Egg manages to kill a diamond player. After the fight, Wemmbu realizes fighting Clown would be pointless since they're at the same position as they were when he fought the first place. Egg says to ask Clown for a fair one on one fight, and Wemmbu goes to do so.

Wemmbu goes back to Clown's castle and proposes an actual duel, since all the previous times it hasn't been a fair fight. Clown and Ferre start to argue with each other as Wemmbu and his friends stare. Ferre flies off, and the fight begins. In the end, Ferre comes back and they all stasis out. They wait at the District 13 base to see if Spoke and Mapicc come back, but get impatient. Wemmbu and Egg head off back to their treehouse.

The video ends with Wemmbu and Egg heading off to build their own base.



Trivia


This episode's title was originally "How I Survived the Minecraft Mafia" and was later changed to "Unstable SMP: The Minecraft Mafia" before getting shortened to "Unstable SMP: The Mafia".

The title was also briefly changed to "Unstable SMP: The Invisible Mafia" before getting changed back to "Unstable SMP: The Mafia."

entire minecraft empire vs 1 tnt cannon





Unstable SMP: The PrinceZam Empire War
 is the 13th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.  



Plot


The episode starts off with 
Wemmbu
 and 
Eggchan
 assembling a team of players, ItsLilKae, 
LuckyMixx
, and 
Block_Facts
, to wage war on the 
Zam Empire
. He plans to use the 
orbital cannon
 that 
ParrotX2
 and 
Wifies
 helped him build to strike the empire first before attacking. He leads the team to the empire, but discovers that it has a giant obsidian roof covering the entire empire. Wemmbu ditches the orbital cannon part of the plan and his team engages into combat with the guards, 
Pangi
, 
Dol9hin
, 
loppezz
, 
LuigiToan
, 
WyLL_
, and 
What_Max
. He himself sneaks off to 
PrinceZam's
 castle to murder him. 

A fight ensues between Wemmbu and PrinceZam and his minions. He eventually manages to get himself and Zam alone in a cave. He is on the verge of killing Zam when his guards arrive. Wemmbu is trapped and PrinceZam starts taunting him on how weak he is. Wemmbu retorts that Zam can never take a fair 1 v 1; he calls his guards to do all of his dirty work. He pulls off an escape and reconvenes with Eggchan at the 
Wemmbu Civilization
. 

Horace_Altman
, a builder they hired, has renovated their empire, repairing it from the TNT and making a bigger obsidian wall around the expanding empire. Wemmbu pays him with netherite ingots he and Egg stole from the 
Treasure Hunters'
 vault. 

Wemmbu realises how outnumbered they really are and he and Eggchan form a plan to sneak into the Zam Empire again to fetch 
ManePear
, a Zam guard who betrayed, conveniently AFK during their previous fight. He theorises that with Mane’s PVP skills and knowledge of the empire, they could potentially defeat Zam. He pots invis and sneaks into the Zam Empire, distracting the guards with firework traps they set up around the empire. He frees Mane from the obsidian box he trapped him in while AFK and they escape back to the Wemmbu Civilization. 

Mane tells Wemmbu that PrinceZam will launch an attack to conquer the 
Roshambogames Civilization
. Still unsure of ManePear’s ulterior motives, he traps Mane in another obsidian box since he doesn’t have a pickaxe and decides to go check it out. If the Zam Empire is really taking over 
Ro's
 civilization, then he’ll know that Mane is telling the truth. 

Wemmbu sets an ender pearl stasis, pots invis, and heads to the Ro Civilization. He sees 
FlameFrags
 and 
Merffinn
 at the entrance, interrogating Ro. They make a deal that Flame will duel Ro. If Ro wins, his empire will be left alone. If Flame wins, then he will have to surrender everything. They head to an arena in the empire and the fight begins. Flame pulls out a wooden sword to fight Ro with, and easily gains the upper hand. All of Ro’s armour pieces except for his chestplate pop, and Wemmbu shows himself in defence of Ro. 

Wemmbu tells Flame that he’ll duel Flame instead, and heads elsewhere with Ro to prepare. He tells Ro to pack everything of value up and take the citizens somewhere safe while he distracts Flame. He returns to the arena and the duel starts. Ro finally confirms that everyone is out after a few minutes and Wemmbu stasises away. 

He meets back up with Egg and they free Mane from the obsidian box. They go to the renovated town hall and discuss their plans moving forward. Since they don’t have the manpower to take all of Zam’s guards at once, they decide to take down all of the high-ranking officers before going for Zam himself. Regarding the failed attack they launched on the Zam Empire, Zam probably wouldn’t be online without Flame anymore. They go with 
yungwillx
 first, because he is the easiest to kill and is prone to traps. He owns a castle and heads there when he isn’t working for Zam, so they decide to set a TNT minecart trap there. 

Since the Zam Empire doesn’t know that Mane betrayed yet, he will distract yungwillx while Wemmbu sets up the trap. Wemmbu fumbles with the trap, and yungwillx is confused as to why Mane is visiting him, but they manage to make it work. They escape before their cover can be blown, but they still need to activate the trap. They disguise Wemmbu as Mane and pot invis while Mane goes without armor to activate the trap. Wemmbu arrives back at yungwillx’s property and Mane types in the chat that his mom is in the room, so he is muted. He also accidentally potted invis instead of speed. However, when Mane activates the trap, it fails to kill yungwillx, and they are discovered. They engage in combat, but Zam and his guards arrive. They pop yungwillx’s armour and tell the Zam Empire forces that if they don’t leave, then they will kill yungwillx. After some debate, Zam and his guards fly off. They take yungwillx hostage and imprison him in the Wemmbu Civilization’s colony. 

Wemmbu, Mane, and Egg meet again in the town hall. Wemmbu wants to kidnap 
Peentar
, yungwillx’s closest friend on this server, next. Since Zam is probably already planning to retrieve yungwillx, they’ll leave a note for Peentar in his house telling him that if he doesn’t come alone to the Wemmbu Civilization, they’ll kill yungwillx. Egg tells Wemmbu that he shouldn’t do this, and that he’s just following in Zam’s footsteps at this point, but he doesn’t care. 

Wemmbu writes the book, telling Peentar to make a secret underground tunnel system to the Zam Empire and Zam’s castle and set a trap beneath Zam’s throne before coming to the Wemmbu Civilization. They sneak into the Zam empire and successfully finish the job, setting fire to his house in the process. 

Peentar eventually arrives and Wemmbu and Mane let him see yungwillx on the condition that he drops all of his items. However, it is a trap and they successfully imprison Peentar as well. Mane wants to just kill them both, and Wemmbu starts siding with him, but Egg protests, saying that they can still use the prisoners for leverage, and that it is morally wrong. Wemmbu finally relents, but Egg says that he still doesn’t want any part in this bloodshed. 

Wemmbu and Mane go to the Zam Empire to see if Peentar had built the tunnels and the trap. He did, in fact, build them, so they go to the trap and activate it, thinking that Zam is on the throne. Instead, the trap fails and all they accomplish is trapping 
Sorhin
, another one of Zam's guards. With a failed trap, they just decide to cover their tracks and take Sorhin prisoner. 

Once Wemmbu and Mane arrive at the Wemmbu Civilization, things take a turn for the worse. They hear lots of withers spawning, and discover that Zam has freed yungwillx and Peentar and is launching an attack on the empire. They try to fend off the Zam Empire, but their civilization is bombed all the same, like last time. They trap Wemmbu and pop everything except his chestplate, but in the end, Wemmbu surrenders and says that he’ll leave the Zam Empire alone and just mind his own business. PrinceZam spares him and gives him a second chance.

Mane, however, decides that it is a good idea to challenge FlameFrags, the Immortal Demon, to a duel to the death to see who is the stronger player once and for all. Wemmbu gears him up and they start fighting while the rest of the players spectate from the side. Before either side could win, though, Mane pauses and takes off all of his armour, seeing that he was starting to lose. Zam says that they won’t bother the Wemmbu Civilization anymore if he doesn’t bother them. 

Wemmbu pots invis, tired of Zam’s yapping, and runs away. He and Mane both escape, but before he is able to make it out, he sees Egg being held captive by Zam and his guards. Zam tells Egg that he’ll let Wemmbu go, but he’ll keep him indefinitely. Wemmbu realises that Egg is already long gone and just leaves. 

Wemmbu, Mane, and Lucky regroup on an island near the Zam Empire, which has their obsidian roof taken down, and regear themselves. They discuss their plans moving forward. Mane still wants to fight, but Wemmbu opposes him. However, there is still one way to get revenge on the Zam Empire. 

He heads into the Zam Empire and sets off a TNT bomb to catch the guards’ attention. They eventually see him and he asks to be taken to Zam. The guards lead him to the castle, and he sees Zam sitting on his throne. Zam, confused, asks why he’s here. Wemmbu replies that since his civilization is no more, and all that he can do is just play alone on this server, he might as well just create a new singleplayer survival world. In short, he wants to turn himself in. Zam sees nothing that he could do to oppose him anymore, so he takes Wemmbu down to Egg and tells him that he’ll take the liberty to imprison him with Egg as a final wish. 

Before entering the prison, Zam tells Wemmbu to clear his inventory and gives him thirty-seven cakes, thirty-six for his inventory and one for his offhand, to check that he really has a clear inventory. Wemmbu, however, outsmarts him by picking up all of the cakes and putting his ender chests, elytra, and a stack of notches in his four crafting slots. He pulls the act off, gears himself from his ender chest, frees Egg, escapes, and activates the orbital strike cannon.

Zam and his guards are shocked, and start chasing him down as TNT rains from the sky in multiple strikes, lagging the server. Egg manages to escape, and Wemmbu eventually loses Zam’s minions, leaving only him and Zam. They start fighting, and Zam berates Wemmbu for destroying everything that he worked for from the start of this server. Wemmbu taunts him about how it feels to have all of his work destroyed in a matter of minutes, and that this was entirely his fault. 

They drain each other of their resources and, in the end, land on the roof of a house overlooking the harbor. Wemmbu asks Zam why he betrayed him, but Zam tells him that he has no business knowing that. Wemmbu pushes more, and Zam finally relents, apologizing to him and saying that they both have made lots of mistakes. Wemmbu admits that they’re essentially even now.

They are interrupted by 
ClownPierce
, who lands and starts threatening to ban Wemmbu off of the server. He tells them both that they’re coming with him.



Trivia


This video's title used to be "I Fought Minecraft's Greatest War". It was then changed to "Unstable SMP: The Empire War" and was finally changed to "Unstable SMP: The PrinceZam Empire War".

Welcome to the Unstable Universe Wiki!






 


 


 


 










 




 




 










I Became a Minecraft Combat Master

Parrot

We currently have

19,972

620 articles
 and 
1,450 images
 on this wiki as of 22 May 2026. 












MEET THE PROTAGONISTS




CHECK OUT THEIR DEBUT


How to Destroy the Universe
Spawning command blocks, item duplication, and world tearing - all exploits that were patched out of the game years ago. However, they have seemingly returned to our server..
This Button Destroys the World
I don't know why he pressed the button, and I don't know what they're hiding from me. All I know is that my only option is to save the rest of the world from the button... because This Button Destroys the World.
Breaking Into Minecraft's Most Illegal Vault
Rumored to house millions of illegal items, breaking into this vault will instantly make any player the richest on our server.. Which is why I knew I had to raid the vault myself.
I Became Immortal on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP
I'm currently falling 80 blocks onto a dripstone trap, the fall strong enough to kill me through full protection full Netherite armor - and ban me from the Unstable SMP. Most players would die here, but I'm not most players.




Discord Servers


Official Unstable Events Server
Unstable Universe Wiki Server




 


 






		Advertisement









 
 
 
 
 
Happy 2 year anniversary of UU
!
 
 


Episode Order


Member Roster




LATEST EPISODE




Unstable SMP: Civil War


After I Became King of the Unstable SMP, the world split into two different sides: the new players, and the old ones. Soon enough, most of these players left my Kingdom and joined Cindercrest. And just like that... a Civil War had begun.






KINGS ARC FINALE




I Became King of the Unstable SMP


After Lettuce paused the Unstable SMP election and declared himself the interim leader, he captured me and my best friend Theo. Now I have to start from scratch, escape, save Theo, and defeat Lettuce. This is How I Became King of the Unstable SMP.




4 Minecraft Pros VS 2500 Players


On the Unstable SMP, I assembled the best team of players to fight back against the LAW and my greatest enemy, Leo! This is how I fought a war with Parrot, FlameFrags, and Wemmbu…




Unstable SMP: The LAW


temu avengers




2500 Players VS Minecraft Combat Master


On the Unstable SMP, the world’s largest hardcore Minecraft server, the strongest players and I are about to fight an army of 2500 players all at once.






MAFIA ARC FINALE






The End of the Minecraft Mafia


The Mafia has declared war on our server... After we obtained their leaked plans, we tried to warn the leaders of the peaceful civilizations. However, after the Mafia infiltrated their people and annihilated their homes, we realized our only hope in defeating the Mafia was by finding the Stasis Chamber…




Unstable SMP: Doomsday


After the fall of the server's last civilization, my friends and I have no choice but to build a resistance to take down the Invisible Mafia once and for all. Through betrayal, struggle, and friendship, we try to find the answer to a singular question: Why does the mafia always wear invisibility? This is Unstable SMP: Doomsday.




Unstable SMP: The Mafia

Wato1876
, also known as 
Wato
, is a supporting character in Unstable Universe. He is known for building escape rooms, taking commissions from other players.



Personality


Wato is shown to be mostly reserved, choosing to stay hidden rather than actively take part in conflict. He also generally dislikes social interaction with other people, being highly inscrutable to both 
Wemmbu
 and 
PrinceZam
.  

Despite his deadpan personality, he does seem to somewhat develop a unique friendship with Wemmbu; later on 
during the latter's escape
, he expresses genuine concern for his safety, going as far as defying 
ClownPierce
's orders to secure their safety. He values loyalty, although he recognizes that sometimes people do what is necessary for survival. he is stubborn and holds his morals near to his heart, although he is willing to let them go if he is in danger.   

His closest ally seems to be Kenadian, and he often follows his lead, like when he joined the mafia with him. They also were the leaders of the Farmers Faction together, alongside Wifies.

Wemmbu and PrinceZam are trapped by ClownPierce in an escape room made by Wato1876.

You'll never be the strongest ever again.



Wemmbu
 to 
FlameFrags
, in 
Orbital Strike Cannon VS Unstable SMP


Wemmbu
 is one of the four main protagonists of 
Unstable Universe
, alongside 
ParrotX2
, 
SpokeIsHere
, and 
FlameFrags
. Wemmbu was the founder of 
Wemmbu's Civilization
, was a member of the 
Zam Empire
, a member of the 
Skyblock Civilization
, and a member of the 
Ice Mountain Civilization
. He currently holds two of the few 
maces
 left on the server, and a large supply of 
orbital strike cannons.




Personality


Wemmbu is loud, sarcastic, competitive, and emotionally explosive. His behavior frequently oscillates between friendly banter and destructive hostility, depending on how threatened he may feel in the moment. He has a tendency to act within his own self interest, sometimes refusing to help others unless there is something for him to gain. 

He is quick to resorting to violence and has a desperate need to be "the strongest." He believes in doing whatever it takes to achieve victory and that fighting with honor is an unnecessary limitation (a belief he learned from 
ManePear
). Although he can be cunning, his impulsivity often leads to a lack of strategic thought behind most of his decisions. He is an extremely skilled and capable fighter who holds great respect for his weapons, particularly his signature maces, 
Gambit
 and 
Crucible
. Wemmbu is also known for his use of 
Orbital Strike Cannons
 that he uses whenever he feels outnumbered or outskilled (for example, when Wemmbu fought 
FlameFrags
 and opted to blow him up with his Orbital Strike Cannons rather than fight fairly). 

Wemmbu is also heavily protective of his best friend 
Eggchan
, despite the latter's weakness and inexperience with the game. He has also grown to learn to forgive his enemies rather than kill them (
PrinceZam
, 
Jaden_Man
, and 
LettuceK
) and that violence isn't the answer to every problem he faces, such as when he had a chance to kill two players to steal their Riptide tridents and instead chose to help them in exchange for a trident.



Gear




Relationships


Eggchan


Wemmbu and Eggchan are best friends, getting along despite Wemmbu frequently teasing and bullying Egg. They met when Wemmbu invited Eggchan to his empire in 
I Created Minecraft's Greatest Civilization
, and have a very close bond, shown by how Egg is constantly being kidnapped by people who want something from Wemmbu. 

Egg is usually Wemmbu's moral anchor (except for the incident of hanging a player over boiling lava to get them to talk), often holding him back from violence. When he's not there, such as when Egg was stuck in the end, Wemmbu often shows little moral restrain and tends to go on a villain arc. 

Wemmbu often has to rescue Egg from dangerous situations, due to Egg's lack of PVP skill. However, Wemmbu doesn't understand a lot of the things Egg talks about and often makes fun of him for using big or scientific words.

They were together until Egg sacrificed his own freedom to allow Wemmbu to escape prison, and met again in 
I Mastered Minecraft Combat
, when Wemmbu popped the totem of an invis mafia player who ended up being Eggchan.  

After the Mafia ended Egg and Wemmbu stuck together and were able to move past their disagreements in 
Unstable SMP: The Eggchan Empire
, showing the resilience of their friendship. In the farlands, Egg sacrificed himself for Wemmbu, getting shot into the end so Wemmbu didn't have to.

Egg was later freed, and they've been adventuring together ever since.



SpokeIsHere


Spoke
 and Wemmbu were enemies back in 
PrinceZam Empire Arc
, with Wemmbu working with 
PrinceZam
, 
ParrotX2
, and 
Wifies
 to defeat the exploiter. 

Later on, they fixed their relationship and worked together to destroy 
The Mafia
.

Spoke was the one who led Wemmbu to the mafia outpost where he fought 
FlameFrags
. He helped Flame survive the fight against Wemmbu by giving him totems.

Spoke broke Wemmbu out of prison and in return Wemmbu owed him a favor. Spoke used the favor to assassinate 
Leo
 but failed. In exchange for his help, he told Wemmbu how to get 
Eggchan
 out of the end.

Later in the "Kings Arc,” Spoke helped Wemmbu as one of the 4 protagonists in the final Law Battle.  



ParrotX2


Wemmbu and Parrot worked together in the 
PrinceZam Empire Arc
 to defeat 
Spoke
, an exploiter. They teamed up when they realized Spoke was making them do the same puzzles.

Wemmbu helped Parrot hide from 
ClownPierce
, who was hunting him. He lied to ClownPierce and gave Parrot a place to hide in his empire.

ClownPierce created a prison, 
Proton
, in which he imprisoned various members of Unstable for his entertainment. Wemmbu escaped this prison and later returned to help Parrot and his friends.

Parrot and Wemmbu teamed up during the reign of the 
Invisible Mafia
. Parrot helped Wemmbu come up with a plan to kill a diamond player and get a mace. Wemmbu distracted ClownPierce and 
FerreMC
 while Spoke destroys the stasis chambers and Parrot kills 
Ashswagg
. While Parrot did not kill Ashswagg, they did successfully defeat the Mafia.

Parrot was hired by 
FlameFrags
 to find Wemmbu, who had faked his death. Parrot pretended to be Wemmbu’s alternate identity, The Invisible Knight, and managed to reveal him using wolves.

Parrot asked for Wemmbu’s help in the election. Parrot helped Wemmbu sneak back to spawn to reveal that he had escaped 
LettuceK’s
 prison. They successfully returned to the 
Northern Council
 and revealed Lettuce’s incompetence.

Wemmbu and Parrot worked together, along with Flame, Spoke, and various other players, to defeat 
The Law
.



FlameFrags


FlameFrags worked under 
PrinceZam
. At Zam’s request, he pretended to betray the empire and attacked Wemmbu’s empire, destroying it numerous times.

FlameFrags joined the 
Mafia
, where he kidnapped 
Eggchan
 and made Wemmbu give him his mace in exchange for Egg’s life.

Wemmbu attacked Flame’s base, but the fight ended in a stalemate as Flame showed Wemmbu around his house.

Wemmbu imprisoned Flame’s ally, 
JadenMAN
, in an underground civilization. Flame agreed to help Jaden get revenge, forming the 
Avengers
 and hunting down Wemmbu in the 
Far Lands
. However, Flame ended up betraying the team and gave Wemmbu back his mace which had been stolen from him by 
Sharpness
.

Flame and Wemmbu fought in a PVP tournament, where they constantly taunted each other throughout the rounds. Flame beat Wemmbu in the finals.

Wemmbu and Flame fought at an abandoned mafia outpost. Wemmbu used orbital strike canons and nearly killed Flame. Flame thought the fight was unfair and demanded a rematch.

When Wemmbu faked his death, Flame hunted him down, not believing the lie. He worked with 
Parrot
 to reveal Wemmbu’s identity. Before they could fight, however, 
The Law
 came.

The two put their fight on hold to kill The Law, fighting 1000 players. They grew closer in the experience, becoming friends after Wemmbu gave Flame the title of Strongest Player. They fought together once again to defeat the Law for good, their dynamic changing from hostile rivals to friendly competitors.



ManePear


ManePear
 helped Wemmbu destroy the 
Zam Empire
 after ManePear revealed he was unsatisfied by the working conditions.

Wemmbu later sought out ManePear as a mentor, so he could become a better fighter. ManePear agreed to be his mentor after Wemmbu revealed he had a mace. However, Wemmbu was constantly disobeying ManePear and going against him, so ManePear left a sign that read “Lost Cause.” He hasn’t been seen by Wemmbu since, but Wemmbu still uses the techniques ManePear taught him in his fights.



PrinceZam


PrinceZam and Wemmbu became allies in 
It's Impossible to Catch this Player
, united by their common goal of finding Spoke. They got along well until Zam asked if Wemmbu would betray him, and Wemmbu said he would if it was convenient. Wemmbu then left Zam in a 4v1, planting further distrust, but made up for it by elytra-macing their enemies. Despite his previous statement, Wemmbu seemed to be loyal to Zam, going as far as giving up his mace to save Zam's life.

PrinceZam tasked Wemmbu to expand his 
Civilization,
 claiming it had a vault of valuables under it but telling Wemmbu not to check the vault. Wemmbu obeyed. However, as assassins were sent after Wemmbu, Zam became a prime suspect and when Wemmbu checked the vault, there was nothing there. Zam blew up Wemmbu's empire and called him weak, saying he was too pathetic to kill. 

Zam gave Wemmbu an out, saying if Wemmbu left Zam alone Zam would do the same for him. However, Wemmbu wanted revenge and waged war on the Zam Empire, blowing it up with an orbital strike cannon. Throughout the war, Zam refused to kill Wemmbu, even when it made no sense and angered his guards.

During their final fight, Zam realized his mistake, but it was too late and both Zam and Wemmbu were put in a large prison by 
ClownPierce
. Zam was first paranoid and tried to kill Wemmbu, with Wemmbu avoiding Zam at all costs, but eventually they were able to begrudgingly get along and work together. This was ruined when Clown destroyed Zam's second empire as punishment for them working together, and Zam continued plotting to kill Wemmbu. Despite this, Wemmbu no longer held a grudge against Zam, since they were "even", and just wanted Zam to stop trying to kill him.

They were then put in an escape room, also by Clown, and this time they were willing to get along to escape. At first they were annoyed at having to work together, but soon they grew to actually like each other again. Wemmbu even fought ClownPierce so Zam could have a chance to escape.

Later Wemmbu was put in prison by the 
Law
, and reunited with Zam, who was also in prison. They got along and worked together to escape, with their relationship being fully repaired. They also fought in the Law war together.



ClownPierce


ClownPierce
 and Wemmbu are enemies on the Unstable SMP.

Wemmbu helped 
ParrotX2
 hide from Clown, who was hunting him.

Clown captured Wemmbu and 
PrinceZam
 after the PrinceZam Empire War. He put them in a prison, 
Proton
, for his own entertainment. When Wemmbu escaped, he captured him again and put him in an escape room with Zam. Wemmbu ended up fighting Clown at the end of the escape room to let Zam escape, although he lost the fight.

Wemmbu fought ClownPierce and 
FerreMC
, who were both apart of the 
Mafia
. He failed his first fight against them, being forced to run, but he came back and managed to hold his ground against Clown while  
Eggchan
 and 
Wato1876
 distracted Ferre. Wemmbu left when he determined he had bought Parrot and 
Spoke
 enough time to defeat the Mafia.

ClownPierce was falsely accused of killing Wemmbu by 
Boosfer
, who lied and told 
FlameFrags
 he had done it. Flame eventually found out about Boosfer’s lie. 



LettuceK


Lettuce was a part of the 
Skyblock Civilization
, the civilization Wemmbu found in the sky that he had a part in destroying. Lettuce was also part of the 
Ice Mountain Civilization
, which Wemmbu coincidentally also destroyed.

Wemmbu blew up 
The Law
’s base while trying to find 
FlameFrags
.

Later, during the 
Fake Identity Arc
, Lettuce interrupted Wemmbu’s fight with Flame, sending in Lawmen to kill Flame. They also hunted down Wemmbu after finding out he was alive. Flame and Wemmbu told Lettuce to send his entire army after them. He sent 1000 players, which the duo killed.

Lettuce captured Wemmbu after he fought Flame. He took a mace Wemmbu had dropped and imprisoned him. He brought him to the 
Northern Council
, where he announced to the server that Wemmbu was alive, imprisoned, and set to be executed for his crimes if Lettuce were to become King of Unstable.

Wemmbu escaped the Law prison with the help of 
Spoke
, but Lettuce kept it a secret in fear of losing support.

Wemmbu fled to the 
Great Sea
, seeking the help of his friend, 
JadenMAN
. Lettuce was attacking the Great Sea and was actively building an orbital strike canon to destroy Jaden’s Pirate Empire. Wemmbu tried to stop him, but failed. Lettuce captured Jaden and the empire was abandoned.

Parrot brought Wemmbu to spawn to expose Lettuce.

Wemmbu broke into the Law prison to free Jaden. He had already been rescued by Spoke, but he ended up teaming up with him and Flame (later also Parrot) to defeat Lettuce. They beat the army, but then had to decide what to do with Lettuce. Despite Wemmbu’s former urge to kill Lettuce, he voted to let him live after having a conversation with 
MinuteTech
.

When Lettuce was put in a cage, temporarily until he would be transferred to a formal prison, Wemmbu gave Lettuce a book he had written in the SkyBlock Civilization.

Trivia


He is surprisingly good at 1.8 PvP, his first channel being assorted Bedwars clips.


He often overestimates his 1.9 skill level, as when he tried to claim to 
ManePear
 on two separate occasions that he was high tier and the same level as 
Mane
, only to be badly beaten by 
Mane
.


After being told to "lock in" by 
ManePear
, Wemmbu actually did. Not only killing three gold tier players and bringing back their chestplates to 
Mane
, but even holding his own against 
FlameFrags
 on the occasion when 
Flame
 was attacking Snow Civilization.


He found a sign at the end of his training arc left by 
ManePear
 who went missing, which read "lost cause". It is not totally clear what Mane meant by this, but Wemmbu afterwards told Eggchan that ManePear was not coming back.


In 
Spoke's
 video 
I Survived as a Hardcore Assassin
, it's shown that 
Spoke
 was behind the fourth Wemmbu vs Flame rematch and he pretended to kill Wemmbu and lied about his death.


He killed 
Sky
 the Happy Ghast, making him an enemy to 
Parrot
 and 
TheobaldTheBird
. 
See all happy ghasts here: 
Museum Of Happy Ghasts


When he went invisible after faking his death, he chose netherite as his trim material because of 
MinuteTech's
 own trims. He decided not to wear netherite armor to not bring attention to himself but having netherite trims made the effort useless, as it stood out.


He hates when other people have maces and will try to kill them.


He is told by 
MinuteTech
 that his rivalry with 
FlameFrags
 is going to kill them both one day.


His Density-enchanted mace is named Gambit, while his Breach-enchanted mace is named Crucible. Only Gambit has the Wind Burst enchantment on it.


He had a netherite sword named Nightrider.


He holds the record for the longest video in the series, being "
I Mastered Minecraft Combat
" which is 3:59:59 long.


Ironically, he also holds the record for the shortest video in the series, being "
How I SURVIVED the Unstable SMP
" which is 24:21 long.


In April 2026 he is the 5th most subbed member after 
Cash,
 
AJTHEBOLD
, 
NotNico
, and 
Wifies
. He has the most subs for a protagonist followed by 
Parrot
.


Before starting Unstable, Wemmbu was known for using hacks and exploits, similar to Spoke. However, unlike Spoke, we don't seem him using hacks or exploits in Unstable.


He still owes Spoke a favor.


The crown on his head is actually not a crown but it is a tiara as in one of his old videos he says that he thinks crowns are overused.


Wemmbu's IGN was originally lowercase "wemmbu" when the series first started.

title: Wemmbu's Civilization
content:
Wemmbu’s Civilization














Alias


Wemmbu's Empire
The Grand Empire






Status


Destroyed By 
Zam Empire






Info




Goal


To Estabilish a Colony of 
Zam Empire
 (Told to 
Wemmbu
 by 
PrinceZam
)
To Kill 
Wemmbu






Allies


Zam Empire
 (formerly)






Enemies


Zam Empire








Members




Owner


Wemmbu








Appearances




Appears in


*
I Created Minecraft's Greatest Civilization
I Got Hunted by Minecraft's Deadliest Players
I Got Trained By a Minecraft Spear Master
 (flashback)






Debut


I Created Minecraft's Greatest Civilization










 
 
 
 
 


Wemmbu’s Civilization
, or 
The Grand Empire
, was a Minecraft civilization established by 
Wemmbu
 within 
Unstable Universe
. The civilization was marked by large-scale constructions, a well-structured society, and strategic planning, though it did not dominate the server. It focused more on creative experimentation with empire-building, establishing territories and resource management. Despite its efforts, the empire never gained widespread control over the server but was still a notable feature due to its ambitious designs and infrastructure.



History


PrinceZam
 tells Wemmbu to do him a favor. He wants Wemmbu to make a civilization to guard a vault. PrinceZam tells him not to go inside. Wemmbu gets his friend 
Eggchan
 to help him build his empire. 
FlameFrags
 comes over to Wemmbu. FlameFrags acts like he is not a guard of PrinceZam, and he’s not wearing his PrinceZam gear. FlameFrags starts attacking Wemmbu. Eggchan pulls Wemmbu’s stasis chamber, which means that Wemmbu escapes. Wemmbu gives eggchan all of his armor.

Wemmbu sends Eggchan to distract FlameFrags. Wemmbu uses TNT minecarts to try to kill FlameFrags. It pops his totem and they mine down to try and escape. Eggchan accidentally breaks all of Wemmbu’s armor.

The civilization recruits a new player, 
C4CorvetteOwner
. A team of people including 
Jaden_MAN
 come over and try to kill the Wemmbu empire. Wemmbu is able to win the war against them with traps.

Wemmbu has a professional builder, 
Horace_Altman
 help him build the empire. After a day has passed, they come back to the base and see Horace has built a village. They invite a couple of new residents. 
ClownPierce
 is seen chasing an invisible player in the civilization. ClownPierce eventually leaves. ClownPierce comes back and hears Wemmbu talking with Parrot. He starts killing villagers to try and get information, but Wemmbu tells him he has no information. Parrot leaves.

ManePear
, 
Merffinn
, and PrinceZam come over. PrinceZam comes over to check up on the colony. He says that FlameFrags betrayed him. Wemmbu asks if he put a bounty on Parrot and hired ClownPierce to kill him, but PrinceZam says that he is not affiliated with ClownPierce. PrinceZam leaves his two guards at the vault to help the citizens not die.

Wemmbu and eggchan go over to Parrot’s testing base where they experimented on how to break into prisons. He takes a bunch of useful items there, including full netherite armor, golden apples, etc. They destroy the chunk ban that 
Fantst
 is in, and ask him if he wants to join their civilization. He agrees to join it. Horace adds giant obsidian walls around the empire.

Wemmbu hears Merffinn and ManePear messing with their rail gun. Wemmbu and eggchan discover that they broke their railgun. They decide to see what the vault is. They dig down and discover it is an obsidian box with nothing in it.

Parrot comes back to the empire and asks if they can protect him from ClownPierce. Wemmbu agrees to help him. Parrot has the idea to put chunk bans around the empire to protect it from invaders.

A team of people including FlameFrags and Jaden_MAN invade. The civilization manages to get them to run away, but the entrance part of their colony is destroyed. Parrot parts ways with the empire. Wemmbu and eggchan try to figure out how they could kill FlameFrags. While planning, FlameFrags comes over and tries to kill them. Wemmbu almost dies, but PrinceZam logs on and FlameFrags says "I guess you have to live now." PrinceZam comes over to the civilization to check on Wemmbu. Wemmbu tells him that he found out that there was nothing in the obsidian vault they had been guarding.

PrinceZam destroys all of his civilization and tells him to pretend like none of this ever happened. He says that his original plan was to chunk ban Wemmbu, but he changes his mind and says that Wemmbu is too weak to even be a threat anymore.

Wemmbu goes to his orbital cannon to try and destroy the 
Zam Empire
, but sees the orbital cannon has been blown up. Wemmbu and eggchan go back to spawn and see that the Zam Empire has built a giant PrinceZam statue at spawn. They blow it up.

Wemmbu and some of the members of his civilization try to use a new orbital cannon to destroy the base, but see that they’ve put a sheet of obsidian above the entire empire meaning that they can’t use the orbital cannon. They decide to try and break into the empire and kill PrinceZam. They are unable to kill PrinceZam.

Wemmbu convinces ManePear to betray Zam Empire.

Wemmbu sees that FlameFrags and Merffinn are trying to invade the 
Roshambogames Civilization
. FlameFrags almost kills 
Roshambogames
 with a wooden sword, but Wemmbu stops him. Wemmbu challenges FlameFrags to a 1v1. He manages to get everyone in the Roshambo empire to evacuate, and he escapes using a stasis chamber.

Horace_Altman expands Wemmbu's new civilization greatly, and makes it fire-proof.

ManePear distracts 
yungwillx
 by talking to him while Wemmbu sets up a trap at his base. Wemmbu comes into the base invisible and pretends to be ManePear. He sets off the trap, but it fails to kill him. Yungwillx gets PrinceZam, Merffinn, and 
Peentar
 on to help him survive. All of yungwillx’s armor breaks, and they take him hostage, forcing Zam and his guards to leave. Wemmbu and ManePear take yungwillx to the dungeon. They leave a message at Peentar’s house with instructions for him. They take Peentar hostage and put him in the dungeon. ManePear and Wemmbu think about killing the hostages, but are dissuaded by eggchan. While they are taking 
Sorhin
 hostage, players from Zam Empire break out yungwillx and Peentar before regearing them with Zam Empire ear. 

The Zam Empire destroys Wemmbu’s civilization. They trap Wemmbu in an obsidian box and watch ManePear and FlameFrags fight. ManePear’s armor breaks, so he stops fighting. They both run away, and Zam imprison eggchan.

title: Wemmbu/History
content:
"
The Ash Will Rise.
"
This article is unfinished or outdated by new episode info. You can help Unstable Universe Wiki by 
expanding it
.
"
Till we meet again, friend.
"
This article contains major spoilers from recently released episodes. Please proceed with caution.




History


Season 1


Wemmbu secretly spies on 
SpokeIsHere
 having a conversation with 
JamatoP
, and hears them talking about an exploit. Jamato gives Spoke an armor set, to which 
Spoke
 reacts to the armor set surprised. Wemmbu leaves into a nearby cave. In the end dimension, Wemmbu asks Spoke what his armor is. Spoke lies to him and says that he grinded for the armor himself. Wemmbu is interviewed to guard one of The Wonders. He shows that using a fishing rod he can activate an 
orbital strike cannon
. This gets him the job to guard one of 
The Wonders
. Wemmbu gets more suspicious of Spoke when he meets him in the end, where Wemmbu is not guarding The Wonders. Wemmbu respawns the dragon, suffocating Spoke in obsidian in an end pillar he hollowed out. Spoke is able to get out, and Wemmbu questions Spoke. Spoke starts trying to kill him, but Wemmbu is stronger than him. Wemmbu is unable to kill Spoke as he escapes using the outer end islands. Spoke checks one of The Wonders and exclaims that "it" is still here, referring to the glitched items that he stores in the wonders. Wemmbu hears this and says "what’s still here, Spoke?". He attacks Spoke, almost killing him. Spoke escapes by mining out of the wonder. Wemmbu and ParrotX2 discover that The Wonders were being destroyed. Wemmbu uses Parrot to give him the coordinates of Spoke. At those coordinates, he finds a massive vault of duped items, and attempts to break in. 
Tyrad
 finds him, a guard of the vault. Tyrad fails in to stop him from breaking in. He also spots 2 other guards, 
Sharkilz
 and 
RealReeon
. He kills Tyrad, and escapes from them. He finds the guards again, but this time 
Only_A_Squid
 is also there. Wemmbu escapes again. Wemmbu breaks into the main area, where he’s trapped in an area full of chest minecarts with a warden.  

Spoke says that Wemmbu’s stuck in his prison. Wemmbu manages to escape by going to a corner, destroying a couple of chest minecarts, and mining out. He tries to kill Spoke, but Spoke escapes. He finally escapes the vault by mining out. He finds Spoke and attempts to kill him, but he escapes again using a stasis chamber. Wemmbu asks Parrot if he knows where Spoke is, to which he says no. He then finds JamatoP in his base after he’s vanished. Jamato says that he doesn’t know where Spoke is because he parted ways with him and hasn’t seen him since. Other players come into the base, 
ManePear
 and FlameFrags, and start attacking Wemmbu and Jamato and asking if they know anything about Spoke. Wemmbu explains that he’s also trying to find Spoke. They explain that they’re part of the Zam empire. They go over to the Zam Empire, where PrinceZam is with his two guards 
Peentar
and 
yungwillx
. He agrees to team with PrinceZam to kill Spoke. 
Mapicc
 comes into the room and starts attacking PrinceZam. Part of the room they are in explodes. They chase after Mapicc to try and kill him. A war breaks out between people against PrinceZam, and the Zam empire. The only person who died was 
TeamKalal
, since everybody against PrinceZam got away using stasis chambers. PrinceZam and Wemmbu interrogate 
TheRealSquiddo
 and threaten to chunk ban her if she doesn’t give information on Spoke. They check her barrels and find out that she has glitched items. She says that she did make a build in the end dimension, and DMs Wemmbu the coordinates. PrinceZam chunk bans TheRealSquiddo.

Parrot and 
Wifies
 go to the Zam Empire as a clue in a scavenger hunt set up by Spoke. Parrot and Wifies see Wemmbu, who questions them about a "disc" that they were talking about. Parrot says that Spoke left something at his base and that Spoke claims there’s a server secret, and they’re trying to find the next clue. PrinceZam comes over to them. He says that they should give them all the information they found, however they don’t oblige. Parrot and Wifies fly away over to the castle and start exploring it while Wemmbu tries to kill them. Eventually they escape by flying out, and Wemmbu loses them. Wemmbu and PrinceZam decide to go to the stronghold to get to the end base that TheRealSquiddo was talking about. Once they were there, they see there are three Spoke guards at the stronghold, RealReeon, Sharkilz_,  and Mapicc. They dig down to the stronghold, and make their way to the portal room. They find the guards and start fighting them. The guards flee to the end, except for RealReeon. They chunk ban RealReeon. They go into the end and start flying to the coordinates that the end base is at.

They break into the base and start killing Spoke and his guards. Spoke is able to escape before being chunk banned. They leave to the overworld to get some materials. This includes getting a 
mace
. After going to the trial chambers and getting a mace, people go into the trial chamber and see it’s already looted. Wemmbu and PrinceZam hide. The people who break into the trail chamber are Mapicc, 
Fantst
, 
Arcn
, Only_A_Squid, and 
Sharooh
, all enemies of the Zam empire. Mapicc finds them and they start fighting. Wemmbu escapes the fight and crafts a mace. PrinceZam escapes to the surface, and Wemmbu uses the mace to try and kill some of the players. All of the people flee the fight by running or using stasis chambers. Arcn is chunk banned by PrinceZam. They use an exploit that has to do with arrows and TNT to try and find Spoke. They find Only_A_Squid at a base and chunk ban him.

They use the second arrow to find Fantst and Sharooh. Fantst runs away and they chunk ban Sharooh. Wemmbu and PrinceZam find an obsidian box, and inside is Mapicc. Spoke and his teammates come in and start to fight Wemmbu and PrinceZam. PrinceZam’s armor all breaks, and he almost dies. PrinceZam holds a chunk ban which scares them away. 

Wemmbu and PrinceZam use the arrow to find an obsidian maze. They find two chests with peoples stuff inside of them. They hear Parrot in the maze. This is because Parrot and Wifies followed a clue left by Spoke which lead them to the maze. A guard who was there signaled for them to put all of their items in chests for no advantages in the maze. He eventually finds Parrot and Wifies who have no items. They agree to lead Wemmbu to the clue, however, because they don’t have the texture pack that goes along with the hunt, they would not be able to get any use out of it. Wemmbu gets a turtle egg and music disc from the chest. Wifies and Parrot get their stuff and leave the maze. Wemmbu and PrinceZam realize that they need a texture pack and begin chasing Wifies and Parrot, however they’ve already escaped. Wemmbu and PrinceZam store the disc and turtle egg in the vault.

They follow the arrow to an underwater base. They find Sharkilz_ and chunk ban him. The base explodes which gets rid of the chunk ban, meaning that Sharkilz_ is unbanned because the chunk ban is exploded. Fantst now comes to help Sharkilz_ kill Wemmbu and PrinceZam. They chunk ban Fantst and Sharkilz_. Wemmbu finds a destroyed castle from the first clue that Parrot and Wifies found. He finds an invisible player, who is later revealed to be Spoke. The invisible player says he will take Wemmbu to Spoke. He brings him to an ice parkour mountain, which is the second clue that Parrot and Wifies found. He tells him to do the parkour, however Wemmbu cheats his way through it. The invisible player leads him to the maze he was in earlier. He puts all his items in the chest, except for some enchanted golden apples, two pearls, and a totem of undying.

He completes the maze. The guard tries to trap him using obsidian, but Wemmbu uses his ender pearl to escape. The invisible player leads him to a shipwreck, also a puzzle that Parrot and Wifies had to solve. The player writes on a sign that Squiddo’s castle is the location of Spoke, to which Wemmbu reacts by trying to kill him. The player escapes by using a stasis chamber. Wemmbu finds Spoke at Squiddo’s castle, which is being burned. He starts killing Spoke. Spoke escapes by using a stasis chamber. 

Wemmbu is teleported to the vault, where Parrot and Wifies are stealing the disc and turtle egg. Wemmbu starts killing them, and they manage to fly away. Parrot and Wifies dig down and go into the nether, however Wemmbu and PrinceZam find them in the nether, since they unluckily spawned in a nether cave. Parrot gives Wemmbu and PrinceZam the disc. Parrot says that to find Spoke they need a turtle egg, as baby turtles always go back to their home beach. They agree to team up, however after Wemmbu and PrinceZam go into the overworld to team up, Parrot and Wifies mine away and escape. The Zam Empire finds Spoke and try to kill him. Parrot is also trying to kill Spoke with them, as Spoke had just chunk banned Wifies. Spoke goes into the puzzle area that Parrot and Wifies were in, and start chasing him. Before they can kill Spoke, he chunk bans himself, with Wifies also stuck in the chunk ban.

PrinceZam tells Wemmbu to do him a favor. He wants Wemmbu to make a colony to guard a vault he has. PrinceZam tells him not to go inside the vault. Wemmbu gets his friend 
eggchan
 to help him build his empire. FlameFrags comes over to Wemmbu. FlameFrags acts like he is not a guard of PrinceZam, and he’s not wearing his PrinceZam gear. FlameFrags starts attacking Wemmbu. eggchan pulls Wemmbu’s stasis chamber, meaning that he escapes. He gives eggchan all his netherite armor. He sends eggchan to distract FlameFrags. Wemmbu uses TNT minecarts to try to kill Flame. One of thmempops his totem and they mine down to try and escape. eggchan accidentally breaks all of Wemmbu’s armor.

They build a villager breeder to automatically produce villagers. They make a pumpkin farm and build an obsidian wall around the base. They start a raid to get totems of undying. They recruit a new player, C4CorvetteOwner. A team of people including Jaden_MAN come over and try to kill Wemmbu. Wemmbu is able to win the war against them with traps. Wemmbu has a professional builder, 
Horace_Altman
, help him build the empire. After a day has passed, they come back to the base and see Horace has built a village. They invite a couple of residents, including TheRealSquiddo, Dione4k, and Block_Facts. 
ClownPierce
 is seen chasing an invisible player. He eventually leaves. ClownPierce comes back and hears Wemmbu talking with Parrot, who was the invisible player. ClownPierce starts killing villagers to try and get information, but Wemmbu tells him he has no information. Parrot leaves.

ManePear, 
Merffinn
, and PrinceZam come over. PrinceZam comes over to check up on the colony. He says that FlameFrags betrayed him. Wemmbu asks if he put a bounty on Parrot and hired ClownPierce to kill him, but PrinceZam says that he is not affiliated with ClownPierce. PrinceZam leaves two guards at the vault to help the citizens not die. Wemmbu and eggchan go over to Parrot’s testing base where they experimented on how to break into prisons. He takes a bunch of useful items there, including full netherite armor, golden apples, etc. They destroy the chunk ban that Fantst is in, and ask him if he wants to join their civilization. He agrees to join it. Horace adds giant obsidian walls around the empire.

Wemmbu hears Merffinn and ManePear messing with their rail gun. Wemmbu and eggchan discover that they broke their railgun. They decide to check inside of the vault. They dig down and discover it is an obsidian box with nothing in it. Parrot comes back to the empire and asks if they can protect him from ClownPierce. Wemmbu agrees to help him. Parrot has the idea to put chunk bans around the empire to protect it from invaders.

A team of people including FlameFrags and Jaden_MAN invade the colony. The empire manages to get them to run away, but the entrance part of their colony is destroyed. Parrot parts ways with the empire. Wemmbu and eggchan try to figure out how they could kill FlameFrags. While planning, FlameFrags comes over and tries to kill them. Wemmbu almost dies, but PrinceZam logs on and FlameFrags says "I guess you have to live now." PrinceZam comes over to the empire to check on Wemmbu. Wemmbu tells him that there is nothing in the vault. PrinceZam destroys all of his empire and tells him to pretend like none of this ever happened. He says that his plan was to chunk ban Wemmbu, but he is too weak to even be a threat to the Zam empire. 

Wemmbu goes to his orbital cannon to try and destroy PrinceZam’s empire, but sees the orbital cannon been blown up. Wemmbu and eggchan go back to spawn and see that the Zam empire has built a giant PrinceZam statue at spawn. Wemmbu and eggchan set up a job where people can hire them to blow up things. 
Roshambogames
 hires Wemmbu and eggchan to blow up Spoke’s end base. They are successful in doing so. 
Woogiex
 hires them to blow up 
FerreMC
’s base. They find that Ferre has a secret tunnel system in his tower, so they go to investigate. Ferre catches him and Wemmbu tries to escape. He goes underground, and eventually Ferre leaves. Wemmbu and Eggchan come back to destroy the base.

They send three TNT missiles to destroy the base. They are able to destroy the base using TNT, and are able to escape by going underground. Woogiex gives Wemmbu and eggchan their payment of a shulker box of netherite ingots. Woogiex says that all of the members of the team against ClownPierce have disappeared. Wemmbu and eggchan discover that PrinceZam has started taking over spawn. Once far enough from the Zam empire, ManePear says that he’s not a big fan of being a guard of PrinceZam, and that if they need help, he can help him. ManePear tells Wemmbu and eggchan to go over to the treasure hunters base and give them coordinates to go to. Once there, they see 
Kierrrr
 and 
Its_Dev_
. It turns out that Kier and Dev are working for 
Boosfer
. They say they’re not the treasure hunters, but this is a lie. Boosfer pays Wemmbu and eggchan to destroy "the valley". Wemmbu creates TNT bomber planes to destroy the valley. He also discovers there is a giant tree in the valley. While destroying the valley, he finds Parrot and Wifies.

Parrot and Wifies explain that this is 
Rekrap2
’s base which they are trying to protect from Its_Dev_, Kierrrr, and Boosfer. Wemmbu ignores this and continues blowing up the base. Parrot also says that a bunch of players on the server somehow just disappeared. Wemmbu agrees to team with Parrot and Wifies to steal from Boosfer and his team, and go on his quest. Parrot and Wifies say that Wemmbu is allowed to blow up specific parts of the build.

Parrot and Wifies help Wemmbu build an orbital cannon to destroy Boosfer's base. Wemmbu agrees to only use one shot on Boosfer and one shot on PrinceZam. They use the orbital cannon, withers, and TNT to destroy their headquarters. Wemmbu finds their vault of items. Wemmbu steals thousands of netherite blocks and thousands of diamond blocks.

Wemmbu and eggchan blow up the PrinceZam statue at spawn.

Wemmbu and his civilization try to use the orbital cannon to try and destroy the Zam Empire, but see that they’ve put a sheet of obsidian above the entire empire meaning that they can’t use the orbital cannon. They decide to try and break into the empire and kill PrinceZam. They are unable to kill PrinceZam. Wemmbu is able to escape.

Wemmbu convinces ManePear to betray the Zam empire.

Wemmbu sees that FlameFrags and Merffinn are trying to invade Roshambo’s empire. FlameFrags almost kills Roshambo, but Wemmbu stops him. Wemmbu challenges FlameFrags to a 1v1. He manages to get everyone in the Roshambo empire to evacuate, and he escapes using a stasis chamber.

Wemmbu decides to rebuild his empire. Horace_Altman expands Wemmbu's empire greatly.

Wemmbu plans to take a member of the Zam Empire hostage. ManePear distracts yungwillx by talking to him while Wemmbu sets up a trap at his base. Wemmbu comes into the base invisible and pretends to be ManePear. He sets off the trap, but it fails to kill him. Yungwillx gets PrinceZam, Merffinn, and Peentar on to help him survive. All of yungwillx’s armor breaks, and they take him hostage. They leave a message at Peentar’s house with instructions for him. They take Peentar hostage. 

While they are taking Sorhin hostage, the Zam empire breaks out 
yungwillx
 and Peentar. The entire Zam empire destroys Wemmbu’s colony. They trap Wemmbu in an obsidian box and they watch ManePear and FlameFrags fight. ManePear’s armor breaks, so he stops fighting. They both run away, but then realize that they took eggchan hostage.

PrinceZam takes down the obsidian sheet protecting the Zam empire from an orbital strike cannon. Wemmbu goes over to PrinceZam, with no armor, and they imprison Wemmbu. He fills his inventory with cakes to prove he has not smuggled in any items, but uses the crafting menu to store the extra items to smuggle in four items. He uses the orbital cannon which lags the server, giving him enough time to give eggchan full netherite armor from his ender chest to escape. They break out of the prison. Wemmbu destroys the Zam empire, and ClownPierce comes and takes PrinceZam and Wemmbu to a prison.

PrinceZam and Wemmbu are trapped in a miniature version of the normal world with only three totems. PrinceZam tries to kill Wemmbu, but he’s able to escape, though PrinceZam uses three of Wemmbu's totems. eggchan is also put into the prison. eggchan and Wemmbu wait for 
Pangi
 to be put into the prison to steal his totem. They get the totem and leave. They gear up underground and get full iron armor. They build a skybase in the corner of the map.

Wemmbu and eggchan find PrinceZam to ask him if he found any lava, but PrinceZam starts attacking them. They run away.

PrinceZam and Pangi find Wemmbu and eggchan. They start fighting, but because they have better armor, Wemmbu and eggchan run away. They escape by digging underground. They find a slime chunk under PrinceZam’s base. They’re able to get enchantments by fishing.

ClownPierce sends his guard into the prison to try and kill them, and says that if they pop the guards totem, the guard is teleported out. The guard teleported in is FerreMC. They are able to pop his totem. PrinceZam and Wemmbu agree to co-exist. They see that PrinceZam somehow got obsidian. Pangi goes to the nether, but gets chunk banned.

Wemmbu and Eggchan build a creeper farm, but it doesn’t work. They go over to PrinceZam to ask why the creeper farm isn’t working, and see he has villagers. PrinceZam says that completing a raid can give obsidian. PrinceZam helps them diagnose the problem with their creeper farm. ClownPierce uses an orbital strike cannon to destroy PrinceZam’s base because of Pangi going to the nether to escape. PrinceZam thinks this is Wemmbu’s fault, so he tries to kill him. PrinceZam stops trying to kill him realizing that Wemmbu is better at PvP than him.
